exercises.title: intRel_refl

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: intRel p p 展开后两边都是同一个 Nat 表达式，直接 Eq.refl。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: Nat.add (fst p) (snd p) = Nat.add (fst p) (snd p)。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Eq.refl。

exercises.template:
theorem intRel_refl (p : Prod Nat Nat) : intRel p p :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem intRel_refl (p : Prod Nat Nat) : intRel p p :=
  Eq.refl (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p))

exercises.name: quot_lift_eq
exercises.title: **下降函数在相关代表元上取同一个值**。
exercises.prompt: 练习 1（L 类，本单元旗舰之一）：**下降函数在相关代表元上取同一个值**。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body:
两边都**算得动** —— 各自 iota 成 `f a` 与 `f b`，而 `f a = f b` 正是
良定义性假设在 `a`、`b` 上的实例 ⇒ **一行**。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `lift f h (mk a) = lift f h (mk b)`（假设 `r a b`）。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: 良定义性假设 `h`（三条实参：`a` · `b` · 相关性证明）。

exercises.template:
theorem quot_lift_eq (α β : Type) (r : α → α → Prop) (f : α → β)
    (h : ∀ (a b : α), r a b → f a = f b) (a b : α) (hab : r a b) :
    @Quot.lift.{1, 1} α r β f h (@Quot.mk.{1} α r a)
      = @Quot.lift.{1, 1} α r β f h (@Quot.mk.{1} α r b) := by
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem quot_lift_eq (α β : Type) (r : α → α → Prop) (f : α → β)
    (h : ∀ (a b : α), r a b → f a = f b) (a b : α) (hab : r a b) :
    @Quot.lift.{1, 1} α r β f h (@Quot.mk.{1} α r a)
      = @Quot.lift.{1, 1} α r β f h (@Quot.mk.{1} α r b) :=
  h a b hab

exercises.title: **常函数总能下降**（它的良定义性义务是自反那一条）。
exercises.prompt: 练习 2（L 类）：**常函数总能下降**（它的良定义性义务是自反那一条）。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: iota 之后两边都是同一个 `b` ⇒ 自反。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `lift (fun _ => b) … (mk a) = b`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: `Eq.refl`（**要写全宇宙层级与论域**）· 良定义性那一项写成忽略两个代表元的 λ。

exercises.template:
theorem quot_lift_const (α β : Type) (r : α → α → Prop) (b : β) (a : α) :
    @Quot.lift.{1, 1} α r β (fun (_ : α) => b)
      (fun (a1 : α) (a2 : α) (h : r a1 a2) => @Eq.refl.{1} β b)
      (@Quot.mk.{1} α r a) = b := by
  sorry

exercises.name: quot_lift_comp
exercises.title: **下降函数与 `mk` 复合回到原函数**（逐点形态 —— 本语言没有函数外延， 所以"函数相等"一律写成 `∀ a, …`）。
exercises.prompt: 练习 3（L 类）：**下降函数与 `mk` 复合回到原函数**（逐点形态 —— 本语言没有函数外延， 所以"函数相等"一律写成 `∀ a, …`）。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把那个 `λ q` 作用在 `mk a` 上，剩下的就是 iota ⇒ 自反。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `(fun q => lift f h q) (mk a) = f a`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: `Eq.refl`（写全宇宙层级与论域）。

exercises.template:
theorem quot_lift_comp (α β : Type) (r : α → α → Prop) (f : α → β)
    (h : ∀ (a b : α), r a b → f a = f b) (a : α) :
    (fun (q : @Quot.{1} α r) => @Quot.lift.{1, 1} α r β f h q) (@Quot.mk.{1} α r a) = f a := by
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem quot_lift_comp (α β : Type) (r : α → α → Prop) (f : α → β)
    (h : ∀ (a b : α), r a b → f a = f b) (a : α) :
    (fun (q : @Quot.{1} α r) => @Quot.lift.{1, 1} α r β f h q) (@Quot.mk.{1} α r a) = f a :=
  @Eq.refl.{1} β (f a)

exercises.name: quot_lift_id
exercises.title: **恒等函数下降回恒等**（iota 的直接实例，后面练习 6 就靠它）。
exercises.prompt: 练习 5（L 类）：**恒等函数下降回恒等**（iota 的直接实例，后面练习 6 就靠它）。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: iota ⇒ 自反。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `lift id (…) (mk a) = a`（关系取"相等"）。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body:
`Eq.refl`（写全宇宙层级与论域）· 关系那一处写成「两个参数相等」那个函数

exercises.unit: 单元② 商类型与良定义性（复习）
exercises.name: quot_mk_injective
exercises.title: **按相等作商，`mk` 是单射**。
exercises.prompt: 练习 6（L 类，**本单元旗舰**）：**按相等作商，`mk` 是单射**。

hints.label: 思路（**缩回技巧**）
hints.body:
练习 5 的那个下降函数是"缩回"（作用在 `mk a` 上给出 `a`）；
把**它**分别作用在两个代表元上，等式就变成"缩回值相等" —— 再用本课的搬运引理
`rel_subst_right` 沿 `mk a = mk b` 把 `缩回 (mk a) = 缩回 (mk a)` 搬成
`缩回 (mk a) = 缩回 (mk b)`，而它**算一算正是** `a = b` ✓

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: 商里相等的两个元素 ⇒ 两个代表元相等（关系取"相等"）。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body:
`rel_subst_right`（论域写 **那个商的类型**（点名声明星）、
关系取"两边的缩回值相等"、`a b c` 三个点按 `(mk a) (mk a) (mk b)` 给、等式是那条假设）·
`Eq.refl`（写全宇宙层级与论域）· **别用 `congrArg`**（大类型上解不出宇宙层级，实测）✓

exercises.template:
theorem quot_mk_injective (α : Type) (a b : α)
    (h : @Quot.mk.{1} α (fun (x y : α) => x = y) a =
      @Quot.mk.{1} α (fun (x y : α) => x = y) b) : a = b := by
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem quot_mk_injective (α : Type) (a b : α)
    (h : @Quot.mk.{1} α (fun (x y : α) => x = y) a =
      @Quot.mk.{1} α (fun (x y : α) => x = y) b) : a = b :=
  rel_subst_right (@Quot.{1} α (fun (x y : α) => x = y))
    (fun (u : @Quot.{1} α (fun (x y : α) => x = y))
      (v : @Quot.{1} α (fun (x y : α) => x = y)) =>
      @Quot.lift.{1, 1} α (fun (x y : α) => x = y) α (fun (x : α) => x)
          (fun (x y : α) (hxy : x = y) => hxy) u =
        @Quot.lift.{1, 1} α (fun (x y : α) => x = y) α (fun (x : α) => x)
          (fun (x y : α) (hxy : x = y) => hxy) v)
    (@Quot.mk.{1} α (fun (x y : α) => x = y) a)
    (@Quot.mk.{1} α (fun (x y : α) => x = y) a)
    (@Quot.mk.{1} α (fun (x y : α) => x = y) b) h
    (@Eq.refl.{1} α
      (@Quot.lift.{1, 1} α (fun (x y : α) => x = y) α (fun (x : α) => x)
        (fun (x y : α) (hxy : x = y) => hxy)
        (@Quot.mk.{1} α (fun (x y : α) => x = y) a)))

exercises.unit: 单元② 商类型与良定义性（复习）
exercises.name: quot_all_eq
exercises.title: **按"恒真"作商，任何两个代表元在商里相等**。
exercises.prompt: 练习 7（D 类）：**按"恒真"作商，任何两个代表元在商里相等**。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `Quot.sound` 要的那条相关性证明是"恒真"⇒ 交出一个 `True` 的证明（它没有参数）。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `mk a = mk b`（关系取 `fun _ _ => True`）。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: `Quot.sound`（**结论含 `Eq` ⇒ 点名声明星**）· `True.intro`。

exercises.chapter_title: 整数：从 ℕ 到 ℤ
exercises.unit: 单元② 商类型与良定义性（复习）
exercises.name: quot_lift_unique
exercises.title: **唯一性** —— 任何在代表元上与 `f` 一致的商上函数， 都逐点等于 `lift f h`。
exercises.prompt: 练习 8（L 类，旗舰之一）：**唯一性** —— 任何在代表元上与 `f` 一致的商上函数， 都逐点等于 `lift f h`。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body:
对商元素做归纳（`Quot.ind`）；代表元那一步就是"两个东西都等于 `f a`"，
而 `lift f h (mk a)` **算得动**成 `f a` ⇒ 直接把假设交出去。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `(∀ a, g (mk a) = f a) → ∀ q, g q = lift f h q`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: `Quot.ind`（**动机写成 λ，里面出现 `g`、`f`、`h` 这些固定参数**）· 假设 `hg`。

exercises.template:
theorem quot_lift_unique (α β : Type) (r : α → α → Prop) (f : α → β)
    (h : ∀ (a b : α), r a b → f a = f b) (g : @Quot.{1} α r → β)
    (hg : ∀ (a : α), g (@Quot.mk.{1} α r a) = f a) (q : @Quot.{1} α r) :
    g q = @Quot.lift.{1, 1} α r β f h q := by
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem quot_lift_unique (α β : Type) (r : α → α → Prop) (f : α → β)
    (h : ∀ (a b : α), r a b → f a = f b) (g : @Quot.{1} α r → β)
    (hg : ∀ (a : α), g (@Quot.mk.{1} α r a) = f a) (q : @Quot.{1} α r) :
    g q = @Quot.lift.{1, 1} α r β f h q :=
  @Quot.ind.{1} α r (fun (q' : @Quot.{1} α r) => g q' = @Quot.lift.{1, 1} α r β f h q')
    (fun (a : α) => hg a) q

exercises.unit: 单元② 商类型与良定义性（复习）
exercises.name: quot_lift_const_all
exercises.title: **商是"单点"的**（恒真关系的商上，下降函数是常值）。
exercises.prompt: 练习 9（D 类，本单元收尾）：**商是"单点"的**（恒真关系的商上，下降函数是常值）。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body:
对两个商元素**各做一次归纳**（`Quot.ind` 用两次）；两个代表元那一步
直接由良定义性假设给出（相关性证明取 `True` 的证明）。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `∀ q1 q2, lift f h q1 = lift f h q2`（关系取 `fun _ _ => True`）。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body:
`Quot.ind`（两次；**外层动机里出现 `q2`、内层动机里出现 `mk a`** ——
它们都是固定项，可以出现在动机里）· 良定义性假设 `h`（三个实参：两个代表元 + `True.intro`）。

exercises.template:
theorem quot_lift_const_all (α β : Type) (f : α → β)
    (h : ∀ (a b : α), (fun (_ _ : α) => True) a b → f a = f b)
    (q1 q2 : @Quot.{1} α (fun (_ _ : α) => True)) :
    @Quot.lift.{1, 1} α (fun (_ _ : α) => True) β f h q1

theorem quot_lift_const_all (α β : Type) (f : α → β)
    (h : ∀ (a b : α), (fun (_ _ : α) => True) a b → f a = f b)
    (q1 q2 : @Quot.{1} α (fun (_ _ : α) => True)) :
    @Quot.lift.{1, 1} α (fun (_ _ : α) => True) β f h q1
      = @Quot.lift.{1, 1} α (fun (_ _ : α) => True) β f h q2 :=
  @Quot.ind.{1} α (fun (_ _ : α) => True)
    (fun (q1' : @Quot.{1} α (fun (_ _ : α) => True)) =>
      @Quot.lift.{1, 1} α (fun (_ _ : α) => True) β f h q1'
        = @Quot.lift.{1, 1} α (fun (_ _ : α) => True) β f h q2)
    (fun (a : α) =>
      @Quot.ind.{1} α (fun (_ _ : α) => True)
        (fun (q2' : @Quot.{1} α (fun (_ _ : α) => True)) =>
          @Quot.lift.{1, 1} α (fun (_ _ : α) => True) β f h
            (@Quot.mk.{1} α (fun (_ _ : α) => True) a)
            = @Quot.lift.{1, 1} α (fun (_ _ : α) => True) β f h q2')
        (fun (b : α) => h a b True.intro)
        q2)
    q1

exercises.solution:

    mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat 2 5) (@prod_mk Nat Nat Nat.zero 1) =
    @prod_mk Nat Nat 5 2 :=

exercises.unit: 单元⑥ 整数加法的良定义性
exercises.name: add_shift
exercises.title: add_shift

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把左式按结合律拆成 a+((c+b)+d)，再用交换律把 c+b 换成 b+c，最后按结合律拼回右式。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: add_assoc（两次，方向相反）· add_comm · Eq.subst 与 Eq.trans。

exercises.template:
theorem add_shift (a b c d : Nat) :
    Nat.add (Nat.add a c) (Nat.add b d) =
    Nat.add (Nat.add a b) (Nat.add c d) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem add_shift (a b c d : Nat) :
    Nat.add (Nat.add a c) (Nat.add b d) =
    Nat.add (Nat.add a b) (Nat.add c d) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add (Nat.add a c) (Nat.add b d))
    (Nat.add a (Nat.add c (Nat.add b d)))
    (Nat.add (Nat.add a b) (Nat.add c d))
    (add_assoc a c (Nat.add b d))
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (Nat.add a (Nat.add c (Nat.add b d)))
      (Nat.add a (Nat.add (Nat.add c b) d))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add a b) (Nat.add c d))
      (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
        (fun (m : Nat) => Nat.add a (Nat.add c (Nat.add b d)) = Nat.add a m)
        (Nat.add c (Nat.add b d)) (Nat.add (Nat.add c b) d)
        (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (Nat.add (Nat.add c b) d) (Nat.add c (Nat.add b d)) (add_assoc c b d))
        (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add a (Nat.add c (Nat.add b d)))))
      (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add a (Nat.add (Nat.add c b) d))
        (Nat.add a (Nat.add (Nat.add b c) d))
        (Nat.add (Nat.add a b) (Nat.add c d))
        (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
          (fun (m : Nat) => Nat.add a (Nat.add (Nat.add c b) d) = Nat.add a (Nat.add m d))
          (Nat.add c b) (Nat.add b c)
          (add_comm c b)
          (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add a (Nat.add (Nat.add c b) d))))
        (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
          (Nat.add a (Nat.add (Nat.add b c) d))
          (Nat.add a (Nat.add b (Nat.add c d)))
          (Nat.add (Nat.add a b) (Nat.add c d))
          (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
            (fun (m : Nat) => Nat.add a (Nat.add (Nat.add b c) d) = Nat.add a m)
            (Nat.add (Nat.add b c) d) (Nat.add b (Nat.add c d))
            (add_assoc b c d)
            (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add a (Nat.add (Nat.add b c) d))))
          (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
            (Nat.add (Nat.add a b) (Nat.add c d))
            (Nat.add a (Nat.add b (Nat.add c d)))
            (add_assoc a b (Nat.add c d))))))

exercises.name: addRep_wd
exercises.title: addRep_wd

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: hypothesis h 就是 a+b' = a'+b；两边各用一次 add_shift 把 c、d 配进去，再用 h 换掉中间那一项。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: add_shift（两次，一次取对称）· Eq.subst（谓词固定右端 (c+d)）· Eq.trans。

exercises.template:
theorem addRep_wd (a b a' b' c d : Nat)
    (h : intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b')) :
    intRel (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
           (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b') (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem addRep_wd (a b a' b' c d : Nat)
    (h : intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b')) :
    intRel (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
           (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b') (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d)) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add (Nat.add a c) (Nat.add b' d))
    (Nat.add (Nat.add a b') (Nat.add c d))
    (Nat.add (Nat.add a' c) (Nat.add b d))
    (add_shift a b' c d)
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (Nat.add (Nat.add a b') (Nat.add c d))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add a' b) (Nat.add c d))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add a' c) (Nat.add b d))
      (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
        (fun (m : Nat) => Nat.add (Nat.add a b') (Nat.add c d) = Nat.add m (Nat.add c d))
        (Nat.add a b') (Nat.add a' b) h
        (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add (Nat.add a b') (Nat.add c d))))
      (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add (Nat.add a' c) (Nat.add b d))
        (Nat.add (Nat.add a' b) (Nat.add c d))
        (add_shift a' b c d)))

exercises.title: add_zero

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先用交换律把 a+0 换成 0+a，再用 zero_add 收尾。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: a + 0 = a（ℕ 上的加法零元在右）。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: add_comm a Nat.zero · zero_add a · Eq.trans。

exercises.template:
theorem add_zero (a : Nat) :
    Nat.add a Nat.zero = a :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem add_zero (a : Nat) :
    Nat.add a Nat.zero = a :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat (Nat.add a Nat.zero) (Nat.add Nat.zero a) a
    (add_comm a Nat.zero)
    (zero_add a)

exercises.name: addRep_comm
exercises.title: addRep_comm

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把右边的 d+b 换成 b+d（改写右加数），再把 a+c 换成 c+a（改写左加数）。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: add_comm d b · add_comm a c · Eq.subst · Eq.trans（每次改写都取「可证的那一边」为自反）。

exercises.template:
theorem addRep_comm (a b c d : Nat) :
    intRel (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
           (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem addRep_comm (a b c d : Nat) :
    intRel (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
           (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add (Nat.add a c) (Nat.add d b))
    (Nat.add (Nat.add a c) (Nat.add b d))
    (Nat.add (Nat.add c a) (Nat.add b d))
    (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
      (fun (m : Nat) =>
        Nat.add (Nat.add a c) (Nat.add d b) = Nat.add (Nat.add a c) m)
      (Nat.add d b) (Nat.add b d) (add_comm d b)
      (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add (Nat.add a c) (Nat.add d b))))
    (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
      (fun (m : Nat) =>
        Nat.add (Nat.add a c) (Nat.add b d) = Nat.add m (Nat.add b d))
      (Nat.add a c) (Nat.add c a) (add_comm a c)
      (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add (Nat.add a c) (Nat.add b d))))

exercises.name: addRep_assoc
exercises.title: addRep_assoc

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 左端把 (a+c)+e 按结合律拼成 a+(c+e)；右端把 b+(d+f) 拼成 (b+d)+f。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: add_assoc a c e · add_assoc b d f（取对称）· Eq.subst · Eq.trans。

exercises.template:
theorem addRep_assoc (a b c d e f : Nat) :
    intRel (addRep (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
                   (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f))
           (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)
                   (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f))) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem addRep_assoc (a b c d e f : Nat) :
    intRel (addRep (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
                   (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f))
           (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)
                   (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f))) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add (Nat.add (Nat.add a c) e) (Nat.add b (Nat.add d f)))
    (Nat.add (Nat.add a (Nat.add c e)) (Nat.add b (Nat.add d f)))
    (Nat.add (Nat.add a (Nat.add c e)) (Nat.add (Nat.add b d) f))
    (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
      (fun (m : Nat) =>
        Nat.add m (Nat.add b (Nat.add d f)) =
        Nat.add (Nat.add a (Nat.add c e)) (Nat.add b (Nat.add d f)))
      (Nat.add a (Nat.add c e)) (Nat.add (Nat.add a c) e)
      (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (Nat.add (Nat.add a c) e) (Nat.add a (Nat.add c e))
        (add_assoc a c e))
      (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add (Nat.add a (Nat.add c e)) (Nat.add b (Nat.add d f)))))
    (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
      (fun (m : Nat) =>
        Nat.add (Nat.add a (Nat.add c e)) (Nat.add b (Nat.add d f)) =
        Nat.add (Nat.add a (Nat.add c e)) m)
      (Nat.add b (Nat.add d f)) (Nat.add (Nat.add b d) f)
      (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (Nat.add (Nat.add b d) f) (Nat.add b (Nat.add d f))
        (add_assoc b d f))
      (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add (Nat.add a (Nat.add c e)) (Nat.add b (Nat.add d f)))))

hints.body: 商里的等式只能由 Quot.sound 得到 —— 把 addRep_comm 作为相关性证明交出去。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: mk (addRep p q) = mk (addRep q p)。

hints.label: 关键件

exercises.title: int_add_assoc

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 与上一题同形；这次交出去的是 addRep_assoc。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: mk (addRep (addRep p q) r) = mk (addRep p (addRep q r))。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Quot.sound（写全宇宙层级）· addRep_assoc。

exercises.template:
theorem int_add_assoc (a b c d e f : Nat) :
    @Quot.mk.{1} (Prod Nat Nat) intRel
        (addRep (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
                (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f)) =
      @Quot.mk.{1} (Prod Nat Nat) intRel
        (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)
                (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f))) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem int_add_assoc (a b c d e f : Nat) :
    @Quot.mk.{1} (Prod Nat Nat) intRel
        (addRep (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
                (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f)) =
      @Quot.mk.{1} (Prod Nat Nat) intRel
        (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)
                (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f))) :=
  @Quot.sound.{1} (Prod Nat Nat) intRel
    (addRep (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
            (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f))
    (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)
            (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f)))

exercises.name: zero_rep
exercises.title: zero_rep

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把两个 +0 分别用 add_zero 消掉（左边 a+0 → a，右边 b+0 → b），中间用 Eq.subst 改写。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: add_zero a · add_zero b · Eq.subst · Eq.symm · Eq.trans。

exercises.template:
theorem zero_rep (a b : Nat) :
    intRel (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat Nat.zero Nat.zero))
           (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem zero_rep (a b : Nat) :
    intRel (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat Nat.zero Nat.zero))
           (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add (Nat.add a Nat.zero) b)
    (Nat.add a b)
    (Nat.add a (Nat.add b Nat.zero))
    (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
      (fun (m : Nat) =>
        Nat.add m b = Nat.add a b)
      (Nat.add a Nat.zero) a (add_zero a)
      (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add (Nat.add a Nat.zero) b)))
    (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (Nat.add a (Nat.add b Nat.zero)) (Nat.add a b)
      (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
        (fun (m : Nat) =>
          Nat.add a m = Nat.add a b)
        (Nat.add b Nat.zero) b (add_zero b)
        (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add a (Nat.add b Nat.zero)))))

hints.label: 目标形态

hints.label: 关键件

exercises.title: negRep_wd

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: negRep 把 (a,b) 换成 (b,a)。目标变成 b+a' = b'+a；先用交换律把两边都翻成 a'+b 与 a+b'，再用 h 的对称接上。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: b+a' = b'+a（h 是 a+b' = a'+b）。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: add_comm b a' · Eq.symm h · Eq.symm (add_comm b' a) · Eq.trans。

exercises.template:
theorem negRep_wd (a b a' b' : Nat)
    (h : intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b')) :
    intRel (negRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)) (negRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b')) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem negRep_wd (a b a' b' : Nat)
    (h : intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b')) :
    intRel (negRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)) (negRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b')) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add b a')
    (Nat.add a' b)
    (Nat.add b' a)
    (add_comm b a')
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat (Nat.add a' b) (Nat.add a b') (Nat.add b' a)
      (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (Nat.add a b') (Nat.add a' b) h)
      (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (Nat.add b' a) (Nat.add a b') (add_comm b' a)))

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: addRep (a,b) (b,a) 的两个分量是 a+b 与 b+a；目标把 (a+b)+0 与 0+(b+a) 接起来，中间用交换律。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: add_zero (a+b) · add_comm a b · Eq.symm (zero_add (b+a)) · Eq.trans。

exercises.template:
theorem add_neg_rep (a b : Nat) :
    intRel (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (negRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)))
           (@prod_mk Nat Nat Nat.zero Nat.zero) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem add_neg_rep (a b : Nat) :
    intRel (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (negRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)))
           (@prod_mk Nat Nat Nat.zero Nat.zero) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add (Nat.add a b) Nat.zero)
    (Nat.add a b)
    (Nat.add Nat.zero (Nat.add b a))
    (add_zero (Nat.add a b))
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat (Nat.add a b) (Nat.add b a) (Nat.add Nat.zero (Nat.add b a))
      (add_comm a b)
      (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (Nat.add Nat.zero (Nat.add b a)) (Nat.add b a)
        (zero_add (Nat.add b a))))

exercises.title: subRep_wd

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: subRep p q 就是 addRep p (negRep q)。目标两边展开成 (a+d)+(b'+c') 与 (a'+d')+(b+c)；用搬运律把 (a+d)+(b'+c') 换成 (a+b')+(d+c')，h1 改写第一个和，h2 把 d+c' 换成 d'+c，最后反用搬运律。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: add_shift a b' d c' · h1 · add_comm d c' · Eq.symm h2 · add_comm c d' · add_shift a' d' b c。

exercises.template:
theorem subRep_wd (a b c d a' b' c' d' : Nat)
    (h1 : intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b'))
    (h2 : intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c' d')) :
    intRel (subRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
           (subRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b') (@prod_mk Nat Nat c' d')) :=  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem subRep_wd (a b c d a' b' c' d' : Nat)
    (h1 : intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b'))
    (h2 : intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c' d')) :
    intRel (subRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
           (subRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b') (@prod_mk Nat Nat c' d')) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add (Nat.add a d) (Nat.add b' c'))
    (Nat.add (Nat.add a b') (Nat.add d c'))
    (Nat.add (Nat.add a' d') (Nat.add b c))
    (add_shift a b' d c')
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (Nat.add (Nat.add a b') (Nat.add d c'))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add a' b) (Nat.add d c'))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add a' d') (Nat.add b c))
      (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
        (fun (m : Nat) => Nat.add (Nat.add a b') (Nat.add d c') = Nat.add m (Nat.add d c'))
        (Nat.add a b') (Nat.add a' b) h1
        (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add (Nat.add a b') (Nat.add d c'))))
      (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add (Nat.add a' b) (Nat.add d c'))
        (Nat.add (Nat.add a' b) (Nat.add d' c))
        (Nat.add (Nat.add a' d') (Nat.add b c))
        (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
          (fun (m : Nat) => Nat.add (Nat.add a' b) (Nat.add d c') = Nat.add (Nat.add a' b) m)
          (Nat.add d c') (Nat.add d' c)
          (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat (Nat.add d c') (Nat.add c' d) (Nat.add d' c)
            (add_comm d c')
            (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat (Nat.add c' d) (Nat.add c d') (Nat.add d' c)
              (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (Nat.add c d') (Nat.add c' d) h2)
              (add_comm c d')))
          (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add (Nat.add a' b) (Nat.add d c'))))
        (add_shift a' d' b c)))

exercises.name: subRep_add_rep
exercises.title: subRep_add_rep

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把 (x-y)+y 展开成 ((a+d)+c, (b+c)+d)。目标 ((a+d)+c)+b = a+((b+c)+d)；结合律把左边折成 (a+d)+(c+b)，交换 c/b，再把 a+d 与 (b+c) 重新结合、交换 d 与 b+c。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: add_assoc (a+d) c b · add_comm c b · Eq.symm (add_assoc a d (b+c)) · add_comm d (b+c)。

exercises.template:
theorem subRep_add_rep (a b c d : Nat) :
    intRel (addRep (subRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
                   (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
           (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) :=  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem subRep_add_rep (a b c d : Nat) :
    intRel (addRep (subRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
                   (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
           (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add (Nat.add (Nat.add a d) c) b)
    (Nat.add (Nat.add a d) (Nat.add c b))
    (Nat.add a (Nat.add (Nat.add b c) d))
    (add_assoc (Nat.add a d) c b)
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (Nat.add (Nat.add a d) (Nat.add c b))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add a d) (Nat.add b c))
      (Nat.add a (Nat.add (Nat.add b c) d))
      (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
        (fun (m : Nat) => Nat.add (Nat.add a d) (Nat.add c b) = Nat.add (Nat.add a d) m)
        (Nat.add c b) (Nat.add b c) (add_comm c b)
        (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add (Nat.add a d) (Nat.add c b))))
      (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add (Nat.add a d) (Nat.add b c))
        (Nat.add a (Nat.add d (Nat.add b c)))
        (Nat.add a (Nat.add (Nat.add b c) d))
        (add_assoc a d (Nat.add b c))
        (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
          (fun (m : Nat) => Nat.add a (Nat.add d (Nat.add b c)) = Nat.add a m)
          (Nat.add d (Nat.add b c)) (Nat.add (Nat.add b c) d) (add_comm d (Nat.add b c))
          (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add a (Nat.add d (Nat.add b c)))))))

exercises.template:

exercises.name: mul_add
exercises.title: 分配律（右）：(a + b) * c = a * c + b * c。
exercises.prompt: 分配律（右）：(a + b) * c = a * c + b * c。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 c 归纳。零情形两边都算成 0；后继情形把左边展开成 (a+b) + myMul (a+b) n，用归纳假设换掉内层，再用 add_shift 把 (a+b)+(X+Y) 与 (a+X)+(b+Y) 对上。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c（ℕ 上对第二个因子归纳）。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Nat.rec（动机 myMul (a+b) n = …）· Eq.subst（谓词 (a+b) + m）· add_shift（取对称）· Eq.trans。

exercises.template:
theorem mul_add (a b c : Nat) :
    myMul (Nat.add a b) c = Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b c) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem mul_add (a b c : Nat) :
    myMul (Nat.add a b) c = Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b c) :=
  Nat.rec
    (fun (n : Nat) => myMul (Nat.add a b) n = Nat.add (myMul a n) (myMul b n))
    (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat Nat.zero)
    (fun (n : Nat) (ih : myMul (Nat.add a b) n = Nat.add (myMul a n) (myMul b n)) =>
      @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (myMul (Nat.add a b) (Nat.succ n))
        (Nat.add (Nat.add a b) (Nat.add (myMul a n) (myMul b n)))
        (Nat.add (Nat.add a (myMul a n)) (Nat.add b (myMul b n)))
        (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
          (fun (m : Nat) => myMul (Nat.add a b) (Nat.succ n) = Nat.add (Nat.add a b) m)
          (myMul (Nat.add a b) n)
          (Nat.add (myMul a n) (myMul b n))
          ih
          (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (myMul (Nat.add a b) (Nat.succ n))))
        (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
          (Nat.add (Nat.add a (myMul a n)) (Nat.add b (myMul b n)))
          (Nat.add (Nat.add a b) (Nat.add (myMul a n) (myMul b n)))
          (add_shift a b (myMul a n) (myMul b n))))
    c

exercises.name: mul_shift_c
exercises.title: h 乘开：a·c + b'·c = a'·c + b·c。
exercises.prompt: h 乘开：a·c + b'·c = a'·c + b·c。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先把 a*c + b'*c 用 mul_add 的对称收回成 (a+b')*c，再用 h 把 (a+b') 换成 (a'+b)，最后用 mul_add 展开。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: a + b' = a' + b ⇒ a*c + b'*c = a'*c + b*c。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: mul_add（两次，一次取对称）· mul_congr · Eq.trans。

exercises.template:
theorem mul_shift_c (a b a' b' c : Nat)
    (h : Nat.add a b' = Nat.add a' b) :
    Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b' c) =
    Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem mul_shift_c (a b a' b' c : Nat)
    (h : Nat.add a b' = Nat.add a' b) :
    Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b' c) =
    Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b' c))
    (myMul (Nat.add a b') c)
    (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c))
    (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
      (myMul (Nat.add a b') c)
      (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b' c))
      (mul_add a b' c))
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (myMul (Nat.add a b') c)
      (myMul (Nat.add a' b) c)
      (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c))
      (mul_congr a b a' b' c h)
      (mul_add a' b c))

exercises.name: mulRep_wd
exercises.title: 良定义性（第二个分量固定）：p ~ p' ⇒ p * q ~ p' * q。
exercises.prompt: 良定义性（第二个分量固定）：p ~ p' ⇒ p * q ~ p' * q。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 全部化到 ℕ 加法。左端 (ac+bd)+(a'd+b'c) 先重排成 (ac+b'c)+(bd+a'd)；用 mul_shift_c 换掉第一项；用 mul_shift_c（d）加交换换掉第二项；最后重排成 (a'c+b'd)+(ad+bc)。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: (ac+bd)+(a'd+b'c) = (a'c+b'd)+(ad+bc)（就是 intRel 展开）。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: mul_shift_c（c 与 d 各一次）· add_shift · add_comm · Eq.subst · Eq.trans（每个中间项都写清）。

exercises.template:
theorem mulRep_wd (a b a' b' c d : Nat)
    (h : intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b')) :
    intRel (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
           (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b') (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem mulRep_wd (a b a' b' c d : Nat)
    (h : intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b')) :
    intRel (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
           (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b') (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d)) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b d))
             (Nat.add (myMul a' d) (myMul b' c)))
    (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b' c))
             (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d)))
    (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b' d))
             (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c)))
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b d))
               (Nat.add (myMul a' d) (myMul b' c)))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b d))
               (Nat.add (myMul b' c) (myMul a' d)))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b' c))
               (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d)))
      (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
        (fun (m : Nat) => Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b d)) (Nat.add (myMul a' d) (myMul b' c)) =
          Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b d)) m)
        (Nat.add (myMul a' d) (myMul b' c))
        (Nat.add (myMul b' c) (myMul a' d))
        (add_comm (myMul a' d) (myMul b' c))
        (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b d)) (Nat.add (myMul a' d) (myMul b' c)))))
      (add_shift (myMul a c) (myMul b' c) (myMul b d) (myMul a' d)))
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b' c))
               (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d)))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c))
               (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d)))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b' d))
               (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c)))
      (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
        (fun (m : Nat) => Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b' c)) (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d)) =
          Nat.add m (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d)))
        (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b' c))
        (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c))
        (mul_shift_c a b a' b' c h)
        (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b' c)) (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d)))))
      (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c))
                 (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d)))
        (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c))
                 (Nat.add (myMul b' d) (myMul a d)))
        (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b' d))
                 (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c)))
        (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
          (fun (m : Nat) => Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c)) (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d)) =
            Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c)) m)
          (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d))
          (Nat.add (myMul b' d) (myMul a d))
          (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
            (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d))
            (Nat.add (myMul a' d) (myMul b d))
            (Nat.add (myMul b' d) (myMul a d))
            (add_comm (myMul b d) (myMul a' d))
            (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
              (Nat.add (myMul a' d) (myMul b d))
              (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b' d))
              (Nat.add (myMul b' d) (myMul a d))
              (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
                (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b' d))
                (Nat.add (myMul a' d) (myMul b d))
                (mul_shift_c a b a' b' d h))
              (add_comm (myMul a d) (myMul b' d))))
          (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c)) (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d)))))
        (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
          (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c))
                   (Nat.add (myMul b' d) (myMul a d)))
          (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b' d))
                   (Nat.add (myMul b c) (myMul a d)))
          (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b' d))
                   (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c)))
          (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
            (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b' d))
                     (Nat.add (myMul b c) (myMul a d)))
            (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c))
                     (Nat.add (myMul b' d) (myMul a d)))
            (add_shift (myMul a' c) (myMul b c) (myMul b' d) (myMul a d)))
          (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
            (fun (m : Nat) => Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b' d)) (Nat.add (myMul b c) (myMul a d)) =
              Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b' d)) m)
            (Nat.add (myMul b c) (myMul a d))
            (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c))
            (add_comm (myMul b c) (myMul a d))
            (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b' d)) (Nat.add (myMul b c) (myMul a d))))))))

exercises.chapter_title: 整数：从 ℕ 到 ℤ
exercises.unit: 单元⑫ 整数序的代表元公式
exercises.name: leRep_mk
exercises.title: leRep_mk

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `leRep` 是定义，把 `prod_mk a b` 与 `prod_mk c d` 代进去就是右边的形状，两边定义性相等。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: leRep (a,b) (c,d) = LeNat (a+d) (c+b)。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Eq.refl（定义性相等，不需要归纳）。

exercises.template:
theorem leRep_mk (a b c d : Nat) :
    leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) =
    LeNat (Nat.add a d) (Nat.add c b) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem leRep_mk (a b c d : Nat) :
    leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) =
    LeNat (Nat.add a d) (Nat.add c b) :=
  Eq.refl (LeNat (Nat.add a d) (Nat.add c b))

exercises.chapter_title: 整数：从 ℕ 到 ℤ
exercises.unit: 单元⑫ 整数序的代表元公式
exercises.name: leRep_refl
exercises.title: leRep_refl

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 任意 p 都是某个序对 prod_mk a b；此时 leRep p p 的两边都是 a+b。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: leRep (a,b) (a,b)，即 LeNat (a+b) (a+b)。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: 对 p 做 match（拆成 prod_mk a b）· le_refl。

exercises.template:
theorem leRep_refl (p : Prod Nat Nat) : leRep p p :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem leRep_refl (p : Prod Nat Nat) : leRep p p :=
  match p with
  | prod_mk a b => le_refl (Nat.add a b)

exercises.chapter_title: 整数：从 ℕ 到 ℤ
exercises.unit: 单元⑫ 整数序的代表元公式
exercises.name: leRep_one_two
exercises.title: leRep_one_two

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: LeNat (Nat.add 1 Nat.zero) (Nat.add 2 Nat.zero)，字面量会算成 LeNat 1 2。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: le_succ 1 1 (le_refl 1)。

exercises.template:
theorem leRep_one_two :
    leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat 1 Nat.zero) (@prod_mk Nat Nat 2 Nat.zero) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem leRep_one_two :
    leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat 1 Nat.zero) (@prod_mk Nat Nat 2 Nat.zero) :=
  le_succ 1 1 (le_refl 1)

exercises.chapter_title: 整数：从 ℕ 到 ℤ
exercises.unit: 单元⑫ 整数序的代表元公式
exercises.name: leRep_to_leNat
exercises.title: leRep_to_leNat

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: leRep 在序对上就是 LeNat，定义直接展开，假设 h 的类型正是目标。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: leRep (a,b) (c,d) ⇒ LeNat (a+d) (c+b)。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: h（类型已定义性相等）。

exercises.template:
theorem leRep_to_leNat (a b c d : Nat)
    (h : leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d)) :
    LeNat (Nat.add a d) (Nat.add c b) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem leRep_to_leNat (a b c d : Nat)
    (h : leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d)) :
    LeNat (Nat.add a d) (Nat.add c b) :=
  h

exercises.chapter_title: 整数：从 ℕ 到 ℤ
exercises.unit: 单元⑫ 整数序的代表元公式
exercises.name: leRep_of_leNat
exercises.title: leRep_of_leNat

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 反方向同理，LeNat 的证明就是 leRep 的证明。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: LeNat (a+d) (c+b) ⇒ leRep (a,b) (c,d)。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: h（定义性相等，直接给）。

exercises.template:
theorem leRep_of_leNat (a b c d : Nat)
    (h : LeNat (Nat.add a d) (Nat.add c b)) :
    leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem leRep_of_leNat (a b c d : Nat)
    (h : LeNat (Nat.add a d) (Nat.add c b)) :
    leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) :=
  h

exercises.chapter_title: 整数：从 ℕ 到 ℤ
exercises.unit: 单元⑫ 整数序的代表元公式
exercises.name: leNat_zero_le
exercises.title: leNat_zero_le

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 n 归纳。零情形用 le_refl；后继情形把归纳假设 ih : LeNat 0 k 用 le_succ 抬一层。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: LeNat Nat.zero n（n = 0 与 n = succ k 两个分支）。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: match n（后继分支自动带 ih）· le_refl · le_succ。

exercises.template:
theorem leNat_zero_le (n : Nat) : LeNat Nat.zero n :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem leNat_zero_le (n : Nat) : LeNat Nat.zero n := by
  match n with
  | Nat.zero => le_refl Nat.zero
  | Nat.succ k => le_succ Nat.zero k ih

exercises.chapter_title: 整数：从 ℕ 到 ℤ
exercises.unit: 单元⑬ ℕ 序的传递性与单调性
exercises.name: leNat_trans
exercises.title: leNat_trans

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 h2 用 LeNat.rec。动机取 `LeNat a m → LeNat a n`，这样归纳假设正好能接上 h1；基例是恒等函数，步例对 ih h1 用一次 le_succ。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: LeNat a c（已知 h1 : LeNat a b、h2 : LeNat b c）。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: @LeNat.rec（两个指标 + 证明都要进 motive）· le_succ。

exercises.template:
theorem leNat_trans (a b c : Nat) (h1 : LeNat a b) (h2 : LeNat b c) : LeNat a c :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem leNat_trans (a b c : Nat) (h1 : LeNat a b) (h2 : LeNat b c) : LeNat a c :=
  @LeNat.rec (fun (m n : Nat) (_ : LeNat m n) => LeNat a m → LeNat a n)
    (fun (n : Nat) => fun (h : LeNat a n) => h)
    (fun (m n : Nat) (h : LeNat m n) (ih : LeNat a m → LeNat a n) =>
       fun (h1 : LeNat a m) => le_succ a n (ih h1))
    b c h2 h1

exercises.chapter_title: 整数：从 ℕ 到 ℤ
exercises.unit: 单元⑬ ℕ 序的传递性与单调性
exercises.name: leNat_succ_succ
exercises.title: leNat_succ_succ

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 h 用 LeNat.rec。动机是 LeNat (succ m) (succ n)；基例是 le_refl (succ n)，步例把 ih 用一次 le_succ 抬到 succ (succ n)。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: LeNat (Nat.succ a) (Nat.succ b)。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: @LeNat.rec · le_refl · le_succ。

exercises.template:
theorem leNat_succ_succ (a b : Nat) (h : LeNat a b) :
    LeNat (Nat.succ a) (Nat.succ b) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem leNat_succ_succ (a b : Nat) (h : LeNat a b) :
    LeNat (Nat.succ a) (Nat.succ b) :=
  @LeNat.rec (fun (m n : Nat) (_ : LeNat m n) => LeNat (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ n))
    (fun (n : Nat) => le_refl (Nat.succ n))
    (fun (m n : Nat) (h : LeNat m n) (ih : LeNat (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ n)) =>
       le_succ (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ n) ih)
    a b h

exercises.chapter_title: 整数：从 ℕ 到 ℤ
exercises.unit: 单元⑬ ℕ 序的传递性与单调性
exercises.name: leNat_add_right
exercises.title: leNat_add_right

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 k 用 Nat.rec（这里只有一个参数，直接归纳）。基例 k = 0 就是 h —— a + 0 定义性等于 a；步例要用 leNat_succ_succ，因为 a + succ k 定义性等于 succ (a + k)。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: LeNat (Nat.add a k) (Nat.add b k)。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Nat.rec · leNat_succ_succ（本单元练习 ②）。

exercises.template:
theorem leNat_add_right (a b k : Nat) (h : LeNat a b) :
    LeNat (Nat.add a k) (Nat.add b k) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem leNat_add_right (a b k : Nat) (h : LeNat a b) :
    LeNat (Nat.add a k) (Nat.add b k) :=
  Nat.rec (fun (k : Nat) => LeNat (Nat.add a k) (Nat.add b k))
    h
    (fun (k : Nat) (ih : LeNat (Nat.add a k) (Nat.add b k)) =>
       leNat_succ_succ (Nat.add a k) (Nat.add b k) ih)
    k

exercises.chapter_title: 整数：从 ℕ 到 ℤ
exercises.unit: 单元⑭ ℕ 序的加法消去律
exercises.name: nat_add_cancel_right
exercises.title: nat_add_cancel_right

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 k 归纳。基例 k = 0 时 `a + 0` 定义性等于 a，假设 h 的类型就是 a = b；步例 k = succ n 时两边各露一层 succ，用 Nat.succ.inj 剥掉后再交给归纳假设。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `a + k = b + k → a = b`（对 k 归纳，动机把两边都带上）。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Nat.rec · Nat.succ.inj（本文件已给）。

exercises.template:
theorem nat_add_cancel_right (a b k : Nat) :
    Nat.add a k = Nat.add b k → a = b :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem nat_add_cancel_right (a b k : Nat) :
    Nat.add a k = Nat.add b k → a = b :=
  Nat.rec
    (fun (n : Nat) => Nat.add a n = Nat.add b n → a = b)
    (fun (h : a = b) => h)
    (fun (n : Nat)
         (ih : Nat.add a n = Nat.add b n → a = b) =>
      fun (h : Nat.succ (Nat.add a n) = Nat.succ (Nat.add b n)) =>
        ih (Nat.succ.inj (Nat.add a n) (Nat.add b n) h))
    k

exercises.chapter_title: 整数：从 ℕ 到 ℤ
exercises.unit: 单元⑭ ℕ 序的加法消去律
exercises.name: leNat_exists_add
exercises.title: leNat_exists_add

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 h 用 LeNat.rec（两个指标 + 证明都要进 motive）。基例 le_refl n：取加数 0，`n + 0` 定义性等于 n；步例 le_succ：把归纳假设给的存在加数 k 抬成 succ k —— `m + succ k` 定义性等于 `succ (m + k)`，再用 congrArg 把等式包一层 succ。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `LeNat m n → ∃ (k : Nat), n = m + k`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: @LeNat.rec · @Exists.intro（隐式位要写全：类型、谓词）· @Exists.elim · congrArg。

exercises.template:
theorem leNat_exists_add (m n : Nat) (h : LeNat m n) :
    ∃ (k : Nat), n = Nat.add m k :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem leNat_exists_add (m n : Nat) (h : LeNat m n) :
    ∃ (k : Nat), n = Nat.add m k :=
  @LeNat.rec
    (fun (m n : Nat) (_ : LeNat m n) =>
      ∃ (k : Nat), n = Nat.add m k)
    (fun (n : Nat) =>
      Exists.intro Nat.zero (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat n))
    (fun (m n : Nat) (h : LeNat m n)
         (ih : ∃ (k : Nat), n = Nat.add m k) =>
      Exists.elim ih (fun (k : Nat) (hk : n = Nat.add m k) =>
          Exists.intro (Nat.succ k) (congrArg.{1} Nat.succ hk)))
    m n h

exercises.chapter_title: 整数：从 ℕ 到 ℤ
exercises.unit: 单元⑭ ℕ 序的加法消去律
exercises.name: leNat_self_add
exercises.title: leNat_self_add

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 k 归纳。基例是 le_refl m（m + 0 定义性等于 m）；步例把归纳假设 `LeNat m (m + k)` 用一次 le_succ 抬到 succ (m + k)，而 `m + succ k` 定义性就是它。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `LeNat m (m + k)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Nat.rec（动机 `fun n => LeNat m (m + n)`）· le_refl · le_succ。

exercises.template:
theorem leNat_self_add (m k : Nat) : LeNat m (Nat.add m k) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem leNat_self_add (m k : Nat) : LeNat m (Nat.add m k) :=
  Nat.rec (fun (n : Nat) => LeNat m (Nat.add m n))
    (le_refl m)
    (fun (n : Nat) (ih : LeNat m (Nat.add m n)) => le_succ m (Nat.add m n) ih)
    k

exercises.chapter_title: 整数：从 ℕ 到 ℤ
exercises.unit: 单元⑭ ℕ 序的加法消去律
exercises.name: leNat_of_exists_add
exercises.title: leNat_of_exists_add

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 从存在假设里取出加数 k 与等式 hk，用 leNat_self_add 得到 `LeNat m (m + k)`，再沿 `m + k = n`（hk 取对称）把目标换掉。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `(∃ (k : Nat), n = m + k) → LeNat m n`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: @Exists.elim · leNat_self_add（练习 ③）· @Eq.subst（谓词 `fun x => LeNat m x`）· @Eq.symm。

exercises.template:
theorem leNat_of_exists_add (m n : Nat)
    (h : ∃ (k : Nat), n = Nat.add m k) :
    LeNat m n :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem leNat_of_exists_add (m n : Nat)
    (h : ∃ (k : Nat), n = Nat.add m k) :
    LeNat m n :=
  Exists.elim h (fun (k : Nat) (hk : n = Nat.add m k) =>
      @Eq.subst.{1} Nat (fun (x : Nat) => LeNat m x) (Nat.add m k) n
        (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat n (Nat.add m k) hk)
        (leNat_self_add m k))

exercises.chapter_title: 整数：从 ℕ 到 ℤ
exercises.unit: 单元⑭ ℕ 序的加法消去律
exercises.name: leNat_add_cancel_right
exercises.title: leNat_add_cancel_right

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先用 leNat_exists_add（练习 ②）把 h 变成 `∃ j, b + k = (a + k) + j`；取出的 j 就是见证。把右边用 add_rotate 转成 `(a + j) + k`，于是 `b + k = (a + j) + k`，交给 nat_add_cancel_right（练习 ①）得 `b = a + j`，最后用 leNat_of_exists_add（练习 ④）收口。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `LeNat (a + k) (b + k) → LeNat a b`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: leNat_exists_add · add_rotate（本文件已给）· nat_add_cancel_right · leNat_of_exists_add · @Eq.trans。

exercises.template:
theorem leNat_add_cancel_right (a b k : Nat)
    (h : LeNat (Nat.add a k) (Nat.add b k)) : LeNat a b :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem leNat_add_cancel_right (a b k : Nat)
    (h : LeNat (Nat.add a k) (Nat.add b k)) : LeNat a b :=
  leNat_of_exists_add a b
    (Exists.elim (leNat_exists_add (Nat.add a k) (Nat.add b k) h) (fun (j : Nat)
           (hj : Nat.add b k = Nat.add (Nat.add a k) j) =>
        Exists.intro j (nat_add_cancel_right b (Nat.add a j) k
            (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat (Nat.add b k) (Nat.add (Nat.add a k) j)
              (Nat.add (Nat.add a j) k)
              hj
              (add_rotate a k j)))))

exercises.chapter_title: 整数：从 ℕ 到 ℤ
exercises.unit: 单元⑮ 整数序的良定义性
exercises.name: intRel_symm
exercises.title: intRel_symm

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `intRel (a1,b1) (a,b)` 展开是 `a1 + b = a + b1`，正是 `intRel (a,b) (a1,b1)`（`a + b1 = a1 + b`）取对称。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: intRel_to_eq（本文件已给）· Eq.symm。

exercises.template:
theorem intRel_symm (a b a1 b1 : Nat)
    (h : intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a1 b1)) :
    intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat a1 b1) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)  :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem intRel_symm (a b a1 b1 : Nat)
    (h : intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a1 b1)) :
    intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat a1 b1) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) :=
  @Eq.symm.{1} Nat (Nat.add a b1) (Nat.add a1 b) (intRel_to_eq a b a1 b1 h)

exercises.chapter_title: 整数：从 ℕ 到 ℤ
exercises.unit: 单元⑮ 整数序的良定义性
exercises.name: leRep_wd_fst
exercises.title: leRep_wd_fst

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先把 h 用 intRel_to_eq 读成 Hp : a + b1 = a1 + b。两边同加 b1（leNat_add_right），左边 `(a+d)+b1` 用 add_rotate 转成 `(a+b1)+d`、用 Hp 换成 `(a1+b)+d`、再 rotate 成 `(a1+d)+b`；右边 rotate 成 `(c+b1)+b`。最后用 leNat_add_cancel_right 消去 b。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `LeNat (a+d) (c+b) → LeNat (a1+d) (c+b1)`（Hp : a + b1 = a1 + b）。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: intRel_to_eq · leNat_add_right · add_rotate · congrArg · Eq.trans · Eq.subst · leNat_add_cancel_right。

exercises.template:
theorem leRep_wd_fst (a b a1 b1 c d : Nat)
    (h : Nat.add a b1 = Nat.add a1 b)
    (hl : leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d)) :
    leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a1 b1) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d)  :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem leRep_wd_fst (a b a1 b1 c d : Nat)
    (h : Nat.add a b1 = Nat.add a1 b)
    (hl : leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d)) :
    leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a1 b1) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) :=
  @leNat_add_cancel_right (Nat.add a1 d) (Nat.add c b1) b
    (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
      (fun (x : Nat) => LeNat x (Nat.add (Nat.add c b1) b))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add a d) b1)
      (Nat.add (Nat.add a1 d) b)
      (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add (Nat.add a d) b1)
        (Nat.add (Nat.add a1 b) d)
        (Nat.add (Nat.add a1 d) b)
        (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
          (Nat.add (Nat.add a d) b1)
          (Nat.add (Nat.add a b1) d)
          (Nat.add (Nat.add a1 b) d)
          (add_rotate a d b1)
          (congrArg.{1} (fun (x : Nat) => Nat.add x d) h))
        (add_rotate a1 b d))
      (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
        (fun (x : Nat) => LeNat (Nat.add (Nat.add a d) b1) x)
        (Nat.add (Nat.add c b) b1)
        (Nat.add (Nat.add c b1) b)
        (add_rotate c b b1)
        (leNat_add_right (Nat.add a d) (Nat.add c b) b1 hl)))

exercises.chapter_title: 整数：从 ℕ 到 ℤ
exercises.unit: 单元⑮ 整数序的良定义性
exercises.name: leRep_wd_snd
exercises.title: leRep_wd_snd

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 结构对偶：先把 h 用 intRel_to_eq 读成 Hq : c + d1 = c1 + d。两边同加 d1，左边 rotate 成 `(a+d1)+d`；右边 `(c+b)+d1` rotate 成 `(c+d1)+b`、用 Hq 换成 `(c1+d)+b`、再 rotate 成 `(c1+b)+d`。最后用 leNat_add_cancel_right 消去 d。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `LeNat (a+d) (c+b) → LeNat (a+d1) (c1+b)`（Hq : c + d1 = c1 + d）。

hints.label: 关键件

theorem leRep_wd_snd (a b c d c1 d1 : Nat)
    (h : Nat.add c d1 = Nat.add c1 d)
    (hl : leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d)) :
    leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c1 d1)  :=

exercises.solution:
theorem leRep_wd_snd (a b c d c1 d1 : Nat)
    (h : Nat.add c d1 = Nat.add c1 d)
    (hl : leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d)) :
    leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c1 d1) :=
  @leNat_add_cancel_right (Nat.add a d1) (Nat.add c1 b) d
    (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
      (fun (x : Nat) => LeNat x (Nat.add (Nat.add c1 b) d))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add a d) d1)
      (Nat.add (Nat.add a d1) d)
      (add_rotate a d d1)
      (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
        (fun (x : Nat) => LeNat (Nat.add (Nat.add a d) d1) x)
        (Nat.add (Nat.add c b) d1)
        (Nat.add (Nat.add c1 b) d)
        (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
          (Nat.add (Nat.add c b) d1)
          (Nat.add (Nat.add c1 d) b)
          (Nat.add (Nat.add c1 b) d)
          (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
            (Nat.add (Nat.add c b) d1)
            (Nat.add (Nat.add c d1) b)
            (Nat.add (Nat.add c1 d) b)
            (add_rotate c b d1)
            (congrArg.{1} (fun (x : Nat) => Nat.add x b) h))
          (add_rotate c1 d b))
        (leNat_add_right (Nat.add a d) (Nat.add c b) d1 hl)))

    (hpp : intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a1 b1))
    (hqq : intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c1 d1)) :
    (leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) →
         leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a1 b1) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c1 d1)) ∧
        (leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a1 b1) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c1 d1) →
         leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))  :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem leRep_wd_iff (a b a1 b1 c d c1 d1 : Nat)
    (hpp : intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a1 b1))
    (hqq : intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c1 d1)) :
    (leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) →
         leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a1 b1) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c1 d1)) ∧
        (leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a1 b1) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c1 d1) →
         leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d)) :=
  And.intro
    (leRep_wd a b a1 b1 c d c1 d1 hpp hqq)

exercises.name: leRep_trans
exercises.title: leRep_trans

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 两条假设在代表元层是 H1 : a+d ≤ c+b、H2 : c+f ≤ e+d。目标是 a+f ≤ e+b。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: H1 两边同加 f 得 (a+d)+f ≤ (c+b)+f，用 add_rotate 两边各转一次变成 (a+f)+d ≤ (c+f)+b；H2 两边同加 b 得 (c+f)+b ≤ (e+d)+b，再把右边转成 (e+b)+d。传递后对 d 用 leNat_add_cancel_right。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: leRep (a,b) (e,f) 即 LeNat (a+f) (e+b)。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: leNat_add_right · add_rotate · Eq.subst · leNat_trans · leNat_add_cancel_right。

exercises.template:
theorem leRep_trans (a b c d e f : Nat)
    (h1 : leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
    (h2 : leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f)) :
    leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem leRep_trans (a b c d e f : Nat)
    (h1 : leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
    (h2 : leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f)) :
    leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f) :=
  leNat_add_cancel_right (Nat.add a f) (Nat.add e b) d
    (leNat_trans (Nat.add (Nat.add a f) d) (Nat.add (Nat.add c f) b)
      (Nat.add (Nat.add e b) d)
      (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
        (fun (x : Nat) => LeNat x (Nat.add (Nat.add c f) b))
        (Nat.add (Nat.add a d) f) (Nat.add (Nat.add a f) d) (add_rotate a d f)
        (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
          (fun (x : Nat) => LeNat (Nat.add (Nat.add a d) f) x)
          (Nat.add (Nat.add c b) f) (Nat.add (Nat.add c f) b) (add_rotate c b f)
          (leNat_add_right (Nat.add a d) (Nat.add c b) f h1)))
      (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
        (fun (x : Nat) => LeNat (Nat.add (Nat.add c f) b) x)
        (Nat.add (Nat.add e d) b) (Nat.add (Nat.add e b) d) (add_rotate e d b)
        (leNat_add_right (Nat.add c f) (Nat.add e d) b h2)))

hints.body: h : a+d ≤ c+b；两边同加 (e+f) 得 (a+d)+(e+f) ≤ (c+b)+(e+f)。用 add4 把左边改成 (a+e)+(d+f)、右边改成 (c+e)+(b+f)，正是 leRep (addRep (a,b) (e,f)) (addRep (c,d) (e,f)) 展开后的两层。

theorem leRep_add_right (a b c d e f : Nat)
    (h : leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d)) :
    leRep (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f))

exercises.solution:
theorem leRep_add_right (a b c d e f : Nat)
    (h : leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d)) :
    leRep (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f))
          (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f)) :=
  @Eq.subst.{1} Nat
    (fun (x : Nat) => LeNat (Nat.add (Nat.add a e) (Nat.add d f)) x)
    (Nat.add (Nat.add c b) (Nat.add e f)) (Nat.add (Nat.add c e) (Nat.add b f))
    (add4 c b e f)
    (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
      (fun (x : Nat) => LeNat x (Nat.add (Nat.add c b) (Nat.add e f)))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add a d) (Nat.add e f)) (Nat.add (Nat.add a e) (Nat.add d f))
      (add4 a d e f)
      (leNat_add_right (Nat.add a d) (Nat.add c b) (Nat.add e f) h))

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 b 归纳。零情形两边都归约成 0；后继情形把左边展开成 (a+1) + myMul (a+1) n，用 ih 把 myMul (a+1) n 换成 a*n + n，再用 succ_add / add_assoc 把两边对到 succ (a + (a*n + n))。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Nat.rec · Eq.subst（把 ih 换进 add (a+1) 的第二个位置）· succ_add · add_assoc · Eq.refl（add x (succ n) 定义性归约）。

exercises.template:
theorem succ_mul (a b : Nat) :
    myMul (Nat.succ a) b = Nat.add (myMul a b) b :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem succ_mul (a b : Nat) :
    myMul (Nat.succ a) b = Nat.add (myMul a b) b :=
  Nat.rec (fun (n : Nat) => myMul (Nat.succ a) n = Nat.add (myMul a n) n)
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat (myMul (Nat.succ a) Nat.zero) Nat.zero (Nat.add (myMul a Nat.zero) Nat.zero)
      (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat Nat.zero)
      (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (Nat.add (myMul a Nat.zero) Nat.zero) Nat.zero (add_zero (myMul a Nat.zero))))
    (fun (n : Nat)
         (ih : myMul (Nat.succ a) n = Nat.add (myMul a n) n) =>
      @Eq.subst.{1} Nat
        (fun (m : Nat) => Nat.add (Nat.succ a) m =
        Nat.add (Nat.add a (myMul a n)) (Nat.succ n))
        (Nat.add (myMul a n) n) (myMul (Nat.succ a) n)
        (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (myMul (Nat.succ a) n) (Nat.add (myMul a n) n) ih)
        (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
          (Nat.add (Nat.succ a) (Nat.add (myMul a n) n))
          (Nat.succ (Nat.add a (Nat.add (myMul a n) n)))
          (Nat.add (Nat.add a (myMul a n)) (Nat.succ n))
          (succ_add a (Nat.add (myMul a n) n))
          (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
            (Nat.succ (Nat.add a (Nat.add (myMul a n) n)))
            (Nat.succ (Nat.add (Nat.add a (myMul a n)) n))
            (Nat.add (Nat.add a (myMul a n)) (Nat.succ n))
            (congrArg.{1} Nat.succ
              (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (Nat.add (Nat.add a (myMul a n)) n)
                (Nat.add a (Nat.add (myMul a n) n)) (add_assoc a (myMul a n) n)))
            (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.succ (Nat.add (Nat.add a (myMul a n)) n))))))
    b

exercises.title: myMul_comm

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 b 归纳。零情形用 zero_mul 把两边都变成 0；后继情形 myMul a (n+1) = a + myMul a n，用 ih 换成 a + myMul n a，再用 add_comm 换成 myMul n a + a，最后用 succ_mul 的对称收口。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: myMul a b = myMul b a。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Nat.rec · congrArg（在 add a 下改写 ih）· add_comm · succ_mul（取对称）。

exercises.template:
theorem myMul_comm (a b : Nat) :
    myMul a b = myMul b a :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem myMul_comm (a b : Nat) :
    myMul a b = myMul b a :=
  Nat.rec (fun (n : Nat) => myMul a n = myMul n a)
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat (myMul a Nat.zero) Nat.zero (myMul Nat.zero a)
      (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat Nat.zero)
      (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (myMul Nat.zero a) Nat.zero (zero_mul a)))
    (fun (n : Nat) (ih : myMul a n = myMul n a) =>
      @Eq.trans.{1} Nat (myMul a (Nat.succ n)) (Nat.add a (myMul a n)) (myMul (Nat.succ n) a)
        (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add a (myMul a n)))
        (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat (Nat.add a (myMul a n)) (Nat.add (myMul n a) a) (myMul (Nat.succ n) a)
          (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat (Nat.add a (myMul a n)) (Nat.add a (myMul n a)) (Nat.add (myMul n a) a)
            (congrArg.{1} (fun (x : Nat) => Nat.add a x) ih)
            (add_comm a (myMul n a)))
          (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (myMul (Nat.succ n) a) (Nat.add (myMul n a) a) (succ_mul n a))))
    b

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 逐分量证明两个 prod_mk 相等。第一个分量用两次 congrArg（myMul_comm a c 与 myMul_comm b d）；第二个分量先把 a*d 与 b*c 对调，再用 add_comm 把两个加数顺序换过来；最后两次 congrArg 把分量相等装回序对。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: congrArg（作用在 fun x => prod_mk x … 与 fun y => prod_mk … y 上）· myMul_comm · add_comm · Eq.trans。

theorem mulRep_comm (a b c d : Nat) :
    mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) =
      mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem mulRep_comm (a b c d : Nat) :
    mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) =
      mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
    (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
    (@prod_mk Nat Nat
      (Nat.add (myMul c a) (myMul d b))
      (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c)))
    (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b))
    (congrArg.{1}
      (fun (x : Nat) => @prod_mk Nat Nat x (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c)))
      (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b d))
        (Nat.add (myMul c a) (myMul b d))
        (Nat.add (myMul c a) (myMul d b))
        (congrArg.{1} (fun (x : Nat) => Nat.add x (myMul b d)) (myMul_comm a c))
        (congrArg.{1} (fun (y : Nat) => Nat.add (myMul c a) y) (myMul_comm b d))))
    (congrArg.{1}
      (fun (y : Nat) => @prod_mk Nat Nat (Nat.add (myMul c a) (myMul d b)) y)
      (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c))
        (Nat.add (myMul d a) (myMul c b))
        (Nat.add (myMul c b) (myMul d a))
        (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
          (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c))
          (Nat.add (myMul d a) (myMul b c))
          (Nat.add (myMul d a) (myMul c b))
          (congrArg.{1} (fun (x : Nat) => Nat.add x (myMul b c)) (myMul_comm a d))
          (congrArg.{1} (fun (y : Nat) => Nat.add (myMul d a) y) (myMul_comm b c)))
        (add_comm (myMul d a) (myMul c b))))

      (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat Nat.zero)
      (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (myMul Nat.zero a) Nat.zero (zero_mul a)))
    (fun (n : Nat) (ih : myMul a n = myMul n a) =>
      @Eq.trans.{1} Nat (myMul a (Nat.succ n)) (Nat.add a (myMul a n)) (myMul (Nat.succ n) a)
        (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add a (myMul a n)))
        (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat (Nat.add a (myMul a n)) (Nat.add (myMul n a) a) (myMul (Nat.succ n) a)
          (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat (Nat.add a (myMul a n)) (Nat.add a (myMul n a)) (Nat.add (myMul n a) a)
            (congrArg.{1} (fun (x : Nat) => Nat.add a x) ih)
            (add_comm a (myMul n a)))
          (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (myMul (Nat.succ n) a) (Nat.add (myMul n a) a) (succ_mul n a))))
    b

exercises.unit: 单元⑱ 整数乘法的第二个因子良定义（代表元层）
exercises.name: mulRep_comm
exercises.title: mulRep_comm

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 逐分量证明两个 prod_mk 相等。第一个分量用两次 congrArg（myMul_comm a c 与 myMul_comm b d）；第二个分量先把 a*d 与 b*c 对调，再用 add_comm 把两个加数顺序换过来；最后两次 congrArg 把分量相等装回序对。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: mulRep (a,b) (c,d) = mulRep (c,d) (a,b)。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: congrArg（作用在 fun x => prod_mk x … 与 fun y => prod_mk … y 上）· myMul_comm · add_comm · Eq.trans。

exercises.template:
theorem mulRep_comm (a b c d : Nat) :
    mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) =
      mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem mulRep_comm (a b c d : Nat) :
    mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) =
      mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
    (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
    (@prod_mk Nat Nat
      (Nat.add (myMul c a) (myMul d b))
      (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c)))
    (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b))
    (congrArg.{1}
      (fun (x : Nat) => @prod_mk Nat Nat x (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c)))
      (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b d))
        (Nat.add (myMul c a) (myMul b d))
        (Nat.add (myMul c a) (myMul d b))
        (congrArg.{1} (fun (x : Nat) => Nat.add x (myMul b d)) (myMul_comm a c))
        (congrArg.{1} (fun (y : Nat) => Nat.add (myMul c a) y) (myMul_comm b d))))
    (congrArg.{1}
      (fun (y : Nat) => @prod_mk Nat Nat (Nat.add (myMul c a) (myMul d b)) y)
      (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c))
        (Nat.add (myMul d a) (myMul c b))
        (Nat.add (myMul c b) (myMul d a))
        (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
          (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c))
          (Nat.add (myMul d a) (myMul b c))
          (Nat.add (myMul d a) (myMul c b))
          (congrArg.{1} (fun (x : Nat) => Nat.add x (myMul b c)) (myMul_comm a d))
          (congrArg.{1} (fun (y : Nat) => Nat.add (myMul d a) y) (myMul_comm b c)))
        (add_comm (myMul d a) (myMul c b))))

exercises.unit: 单元⑱ 整数乘法的第二个因子良定义（代表元层）
exercises.name: mul_add
exercises.title: 分配律（右）：(a + b) * c = a * c + b * c。
exercises.prompt: 分配律（右）：(a + b) * c = a * c + b * c。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 c 归纳。零情形两边都算成 0；后继情形把左边展开成 (a+b) + myMul (a+b) n，用归纳假设换掉内层，再用 add_shift 把 (a+b)+(X+Y) 与 (a+X)+(b+Y) 对上。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c（ℕ 上对第二个因子归纳）。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Nat.rec（动机 myMul (a+b) n = …）· Eq.subst（谓词 (a+b) + m）· add_shift（取对称）· Eq.trans。

exercises.template:
theorem mul_add (a b c : Nat) :
    myMul (Nat.add a b) c = Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b c) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem mul_add (a b c : Nat) :
    myMul (Nat.add a b) c = Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b c) :=
  Nat.rec
    (fun (n : Nat) => myMul (Nat.add a b) n = Nat.add (myMul a n) (myMul b n))
    (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat Nat.zero)
    (fun (n : Nat) (ih : myMul (Nat.add a b) n = Nat.add (myMul a n) (myMul b n)) =>
      @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (myMul (Nat.add a b) (Nat.succ n))
        (Nat.add (Nat.add a b) (Nat.add (myMul a n) (myMul b n)))
        (Nat.add (Nat.add a (myMul a n)) (Nat.add b (myMul b n)))
        (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
          (fun (m : Nat) => myMul (Nat.add a b) (Nat.succ n) = Nat.add (Nat.add a b) m)
          (myMul (Nat.add a b) n)
          (Nat.add (myMul a n) (myMul b n))
          ih
          (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (myMul (Nat.add a b) (Nat.succ n))))
        (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
          (Nat.add (Nat.add a (myMul a n)) (Nat.add b (myMul b n)))
          (Nat.add (Nat.add a b) (Nat.add (myMul a n) (myMul b n)))
          (add_shift a b (myMul a n) (myMul b n))))
    c

exercises.chapter_title: 整数：从 ℕ 到 ℤ
exercises.unit: 单元⑱ 整数乘法的第二个因子良定义（代表元层）
exercises.name: mul_shift_c
exercises.title: h 乘开：a·c + b'·c = a'·c + b·c。
exercises.prompt: h 乘开：a·c + b'·c = a'·c + b·c。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先把 a*c + b'*c 用 mul_add 的对称收回成 (a+b')*c，再用 h 把 (a+b') 换成 (a'+b)，最后用 mul_add 展开。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: a + b' = a' + b ⇒ a*c + b'*c = a'*c + b*c。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: mul_add（两次，一次取对称）· mul_congr · Eq.trans。

exercises.template:
theorem mul_shift_c (a b a' b' c : Nat)
    (h : Nat.add a b' = Nat.add a' b) :
    Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b' c) =
    Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem mul_shift_c (a b a' b' c : Nat)
    (h : Nat.add a b' = Nat.add a' b) :
    Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b' c) =
    Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b' c))
    (myMul (Nat.add a b') c)
    (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c))
    (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
      (myMul (Nat.add a b') c)
      (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b' c))
      (mul_add a b' c))
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (myMul (Nat.add a b') c)
      (myMul (Nat.add a' b) c)
      (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c))
      (mul_congr a b a' b' c h)
      (mul_add a' b c))

exercises.unit: 单元⑱ 整数乘法的第二个因子良定义（代表元层）
exercises.name: mulRep_wd
exercises.title: 良定义性（第二个分量固定）：p ~ p' ⇒ p * q ~ p' * q。
exercises.prompt: 良定义性（第二个分量固定）：p ~ p' ⇒ p * q ~ p' * q。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 全部化到 ℕ 加法。左端 (ac+bd)+(a'd+b'c) 先重排成 (ac+b'c)+(bd+a'd)；用 mul_shift_c 换掉第一项；用 mul_shift_c（d）加交换换掉第二项；最后重排成 (a'c+b'd)+(ad+bc)。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: (ac+bd)+(a'd+b'c) = (a'c+b'd)+(ad+bc)（就是 intRel 展开）。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: mul_shift_c（c 与 d 各一次）· add_shift · add_comm · Eq.subst · Eq.trans（每个中间项都写清）。

exercises.template:
theorem mulRep_wd (a b a' b' c d : Nat)
    (h : intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b')) :
    intRel (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
           (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b') (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem mulRep_wd (a b a' b' c d : Nat)
    (h : intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b')) :
    intRel (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
           (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b') (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d)) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b d))
             (Nat.add (myMul a' d) (myMul b' c)))
    (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b' c))
             (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d)))
    (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b' d))
             (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c)))
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b d))
               (Nat.add (myMul a' d) (myMul b' c)))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b d))
               (Nat.add (myMul b' c) (myMul a' d)))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b' c))
               (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d)))
      (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
        (fun (m : Nat) => Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b d)) (Nat.add (myMul a' d) (myMul b' c)) =
          Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b d)) m)
        (Nat.add (myMul a' d) (myMul b' c))
        (Nat.add (myMul b' c) (myMul a' d))
        (add_comm (myMul a' d) (myMul b' c))
        (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b d)) (Nat.add (myMul a' d) (myMul b' c)))))
      (add_shift (myMul a c) (myMul b' c) (myMul b d) (myMul a' d)))
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b' c))
               (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d)))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c))
               (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d)))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b' d))
               (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c)))
      (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
        (fun (m : Nat) => Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b' c)) (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d)) =
          Nat.add m (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d)))
        (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b' c))
        (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c))
        (mul_shift_c a b a' b' c h)
        (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b' c)) (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d)))))
      (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c))
                 (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d)))
        (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c))
                 (Nat.add (myMul b' d) (myMul a d)))
        (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b' d))
                 (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c)))
        (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
          (fun (m : Nat) => Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c)) (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d)) =
            Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c)) m)
          (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d))
          (Nat.add (myMul b' d) (myMul a d))
          (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
            (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d))
            (Nat.add (myMul a' d) (myMul b d))
            (Nat.add (myMul b' d) (myMul a d))
            (add_comm (myMul b d) (myMul a' d))
            (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
              (Nat.add (myMul a' d) (myMul b d))
              (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b' d))
              (Nat.add (myMul b' d) (myMul a d))
              (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
                (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b' d))
                (Nat.add (myMul a' d) (myMul b d))
                (mul_shift_c a b a' b' d h))
              (add_comm (myMul a d) (myMul b' d))))
          (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c)) (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d)))))
        (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
          (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c))
                   (Nat.add (myMul b' d) (myMul a d)))
          (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b' d))
                   (Nat.add (myMul b c) (myMul a d)))
          (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b' d))
                   (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c)))
          (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
            (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b' d))
                     (Nat.add (myMul b c) (myMul a d)))
            (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c))
                     (Nat.add (myMul b' d) (myMul a d)))
            (add_shift (myMul a' c) (myMul b c) (myMul b' d) (myMul a d)))
          (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
            (fun (m : Nat) => Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b' d)) (Nat.add (myMul b c) (myMul a d)) =
              Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b' d)) m)
            (Nat.add (myMul b c) (myMul a d))
            (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c))
            (add_comm (myMul b c) (myMul a d))
            (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b' d)) (Nat.add (myMul b c) (myMul a d))))))))

exercises.name: intRel_symm
exercises.title: intRel 说的是「交叉和相等」；把那条等式左右对调，就得到对称性。
exercises.prompt: intRel 说的是「交叉和相等」；把那条等式左右对调，就得到对称性。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: intRel 展开就是一条 ℕ 等式，取它的对称即可。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: intRel p q ⇒ intRel q p。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Eq.symm（写全宇宙层级与论域）。

exercises.template:
theorem intRel_symm (a b : Prod Nat Nat)
    (h : intRel a b) : intRel b a :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem intRel_symm (a b : Prod Nat Nat)
    (h : intRel a b) : intRel b a :=
  @Eq.symm.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat a) (Prod.snd Nat Nat b))
    (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat b) (Prod.snd Nat Nat a))
    h

exercises.unit: 单元⑱ 整数乘法的第二个因子良定义（代表元层）
exercises.name: mulRep_wd_snd
exercises.title: 把 q * p 用交换律换成 p * q；对 p' 同理；中间那一步正是单元⑪ 的 mulRep_wd。
exercises.prompt: 把 q * p 用交换律换成 p * q；对 p' 同理；中间那一步正是单元⑪ 的 mulRep_wd。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先用 mulRep_comm 把两边都换成「p 在前、q 在后」，化成 mulRep_wd；再用两次 Eq.subst 沿交换律的等式把结论搬回「q 在前」。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: intRel p p' ⇒ intRel (mulRep q p) (mulRep q p')。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: mulRep_comm（两次，注意方向：q*p = p*q 与 p'*q = q*p'）· mulRep_wd（固定第一个因子）· Eq.subst（一次在 intRel 的第一个位置、一次在第二个位置）。

exercises.template:
theorem mulRep_wd_snd (a b a' b' c d : Nat)
    (h : intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b')) :
    intRel (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b))
           (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b')) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem mulRep_wd_snd (a b a' b' c d : Nat)
    (h : intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b')) :
    intRel (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b))
           (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b')) :=
  @Eq.subst.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
    (fun (y : Prod Nat Nat) =>
      intRel (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)) y)
    (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b') (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
    (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b'))
    (mulRep_comm a' b' c d)
    (@Eq.subst.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
      (fun (x : Prod Nat Nat) =>
        intRel x (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b') (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d)))
      (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
      (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b))
      (@Eq.symm.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
        (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b))
        (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
        (mulRep_comm c d a b))
      (mulRep_wd a b a' b' c d h))

exercises.name: negRep_wd
exercises.title: 目标是一个交叉和等式：b + a' = b' + a，而假设是 a + b' = a' + b。 把两边各交换一次，再把假设取对称就接上了。
exercises.prompt: 目标是一个交叉和等式：b + a' = b' + a，而假设是 a + b' = a' + b。 把两边各交换一次，再把假设取对称就接上了。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 目标展开成 b + a' = b' + a；假设是 a + b' = a' + b。左端先用 add_comm 换成 a' + b，再用 h 的对称换成 a + b'，最后用 add_comm 换成 b' + a。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: intRel (b,a) (b',a')，即 b + a' = b' + a。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: add_comm（两次，作用在最外层）· Eq.symm（h 的方向）· Eq.trans（两个中间项都写清）。

exercises.template:
theorem negRep_wd (p q : Prod Nat Nat)
    (h : intRel p q) :
    intRel (negRep p) (negRep q) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem negRep_wd (p q : Prod Nat Nat)
    (h : intRel p q) :
    intRel (negRep p) (negRep q) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Prod.fst Nat Nat q))
    (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p))
    (Nat.add (Prod.snd Nat Nat q) (Prod.fst Nat Nat p))
    (add_comm (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Prod.fst Nat Nat q))
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p))
      (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q))
      (Nat.add (Prod.snd Nat Nat q) (Prod.fst Nat Nat p))
      (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q))
        (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p)) h)
      (add_comm (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q)))

exercises.unit: 单元⑲ 把取负下降成函数（`Quot.lift`）
exercises.name: intNeg_invol
exercises.title: 取负是对合：`-(-z) = z`。
exercises.prompt: 取负是对合：`-(-z) = z`。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 z 用 Quot.ind（命题层消去），把 z 换成 mk p。两次 ι 归约后左边是 mk (negRep (negRep p))；negRep 翻两次回到 (fst p, snd p)，与 p 的交叉和相等是自反的，用 Quot.sound 交出去。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: intNeg (intNeg z) = z。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Quot.ind（动机写在 Int 上）· Quot.sound（第三项用 Eq.refl）· ι 归约（两处 intNeg 都要真的烧掉）。

exercises.template:
theorem intNeg_invol (z : Int) :
    intNeg (intNeg z) = z :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem intNeg_invol (z : Int) :
    intNeg (intNeg z) = z :=
  @Quot.ind.{1} (Prod Nat Nat) intRel
    (fun (z : Int) => intNeg (intNeg z) = z)
    (fun (p : Prod Nat Nat) =>
      @Quot.sound.{1} (Prod Nat Nat) intRel
        (negRep (negRep p)) p
        (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p))))
    z

exercises.chapter_title: 有理数：从 ℤ 到 ℚ
exercises.unit: 单元㉑ 整数相等的传递性
exercises.name: nat_add_cancel_right
exercises.title: nat_add_cancel_right

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 k 归纳。基例 k = 0 时 `a + 0` 定义性等于 a，假设 h 的类型就是 a = b；步例 k = succ n 时两边各露一层 succ，用 Nat.succ.inj 剥掉后再交给归纳假设。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `a + k = b + k → a = b`（对 k 归纳，动机把两边都带上）。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Nat.rec · Nat.succ.inj（本文件已给）。

exercises.template:
theorem nat_add_cancel_right (a b k : Nat) :
    Nat.add a k = Nat.add b k → a = b :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem nat_add_cancel_right (a b k : Nat) :
    Nat.add a k = Nat.add b k → a = b :=
  Nat.rec
    (fun (n : Nat) => Nat.add a n = Nat.add b n → a = b)
    (fun (h : a = b) => h)
    (fun (n : Nat)
         (ih : Nat.add a n = Nat.add b n → a = b) =>
      fun (h : Nat.succ (Nat.add a n) = Nat.succ (Nat.add b n)) =>
        ih (Nat.succ.inj (Nat.add a n) (Nat.add b n) h))
    k

exercises.chapter_title: 有理数：从 ℤ 到 ℚ
exercises.unit: 单元㉑ 整数相等的传递性
exercises.name: intRel_trans_mid
exercises.title: ㉑.1 把两条假设接到同一条中间式上
exercises.prompt: ㉑.1 把两条假设接到同一条中间式上

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 给 h1 两边同时加 f（congrArg），给 h2 两边同时加 b；中间用 add_rotate c b f 把 (c+b)+f 转成 (c+f)+b，两次 Eq.trans 串起来。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: congrArg（fun x => x + f 与 fun x => x + b）· add_rotate c b f · Eq.trans。

exercises.template:
theorem intRel_trans_mid (a b c d e f : Nat)
    (h1 : Nat.add a d = Nat.add c b)
    (h2 : Nat.add c f = Nat.add e d) :
    Nat.add (Nat.add a d) f = Nat.add (Nat.add e d) b :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem intRel_trans_mid (a b c d e f : Nat)
    (h1 : Nat.add a d = Nat.add c b)
    (h2 : Nat.add c f = Nat.add e d) :
    Nat.add (Nat.add a d) f = Nat.add (Nat.add e d) b :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add (Nat.add a d) f)
    (Nat.add (Nat.add c b) f)
    (Nat.add (Nat.add e d) b)
    (congrArg.{1} (fun (x : Nat) => Nat.add x f) h1)
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (Nat.add (Nat.add c b) f)
      (Nat.add (Nat.add c f) b)
      (Nat.add (Nat.add e d) b)
      (add_rotate c b f)
      (congrArg.{1} (fun (x : Nat) => Nat.add x b) h2))

exercises.chapter_title: 有理数：从 ℤ 到 ℚ
exercises.unit: 单元㉑ 整数相等的传递性
exercises.name: intRel_trans
exercises.title: ㉑.2 整数相等是传递的
exercises.prompt: ㉑.2 整数相等是传递的

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先用 ㉑.1 得到 (a+d)+f = (e+d)+b；再把两边各自的 d 转到最右边（add_rotate 两次，左边取对称）；最后把 d 交给 nat_add_cancel_right 消掉。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: intRel p q ⇒ intRel q r ⇒ intRel p r（展开就是 a+f = e+b）。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: intRel_trans_mid · add_rotate（两次，一次取对称）· nat_add_cancel_right · Eq.trans。

exercises.template:
theorem intRel_trans (p q r : Prod Nat Nat)
    (h1 : intRel p q) (h2 : intRel q r) : intRel p r :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem intRel_trans (p q r : Prod Nat Nat)
    (h1 : intRel p q) (h2 : intRel q r) : intRel p r :=
  nat_add_cancel_right
    (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat r))
    (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat r) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p))
    (Prod.snd Nat Nat q)
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (Nat.add (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat r)) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q)) (Prod.snd Nat Nat r))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat r) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p)) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q))
      (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q)) (Prod.snd Nat Nat r))
        (Nat.add (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat r)) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q))
        (add_rotate (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q) (Prod.snd Nat Nat r)))
      (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q)) (Prod.snd Nat Nat r))
        (Nat.add (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat r) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q)) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p))
        (Nat.add (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat r) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p)) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q))
        (intRel_trans_mid
          (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p)
          (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q)
          (Prod.fst Nat Nat r) (Prod.snd Nat Nat r) h1 h2)
        (add_rotate (Prod.fst Nat Nat r) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p))))

exercises.name: intRel_chain4
exercises.title: ㉑.3 连跳三步：把传递性用两次
exercises.prompt: ㉑.3 连跳三步：把传递性用两次

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先对 p q r 用一次 intRel_trans 得到 intRel p r，再对 p r s 用一次。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: intRel p q ⇒ intRel q r ⇒ intRel r s ⇒ intRel p s。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: intRel_trans（两次）。

exercises.template:
theorem intRel_chain4 (p q r s : Prod Nat Nat)
    (h1 : intRel p q) (h2 : intRel q r) (h3 : intRel r s) : intRel p s :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem intRel_chain4 (p q r s : Prod Nat Nat)
    (h1 : intRel p q) (h2 : intRel q r) (h3 : intRel r s) : intRel p s :=
  intRel_trans p r s (intRel_trans p q r h1 h2) h3
