exercises.title: 5-2 与 4-1 差相同（5+1 = 4+2），4-1 与 3-0 差相同（4+0 = 3+1），所以 5-2 与 3-0 差相同（5+0 = 3+2）。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 直接对具体序对用 intRel_trans；两条小前提都是具体数字等式，用 Eq.refl 即可。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: intRel_trans · Eq.refl（内核会把 5+1 与 4+2 都归约成 6）。

exercises.template:
theorem intRel_trans_demo :
    intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat 5 2) (@prod_mk Nat Nat 3 Nat.zero) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem intRel_trans_demo :
    intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat 5 2) (@prod_mk Nat Nat 3 Nat.zero) :=
  intRel_trans
    (@prod_mk Nat Nat 5 2)
    (@prod_mk Nat Nat 4 1)
    (@prod_mk Nat Nat 3 Nat.zero)
    (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat 6)
    (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat 4)

exercises.chapter_title: 有理数：从 ℤ 到 ℚ
exercises.unit: 单元㉒ ℕ 乘法的分配律与结合律
exercises.name: mul_add
exercises.title: ㉒.2 左分配律：a * (b + c) = a*b + a*c（对 c 归纳）
exercises.prompt: ㉒.2 左分配律：a * (b + c) = a*b + a*c（对 c 归纳）

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 c 归纳。基例 c = 0 时 `b + 0` 定义性等于 b、`a * 0` 定义性等于 0，两边都是 `a*b`，`Eq.refl` 即可；步例把 `a * (b + succ n)` 展开成 `a + a*(b+n)`，用 ih 换成 `a + (a*b + a*n)`，再交给 add_mid 换成 `a*b + (a + a*n)`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: myMul a (b + c) = myMul a b + myMul a c。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Nat.rec · congrArg（在 add a 下改写 ih）· add_mid · Eq.refl（定义性展开）。

exercises.template:
theorem mul_add (a b c : Nat) :
    myMul a (Nat.add b c) = Nat.add (myMul a b) (myMul a c) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem mul_add (a b c : Nat) :
    myMul a (Nat.add b c) = Nat.add (myMul a b) (myMul a c) :=
  Nat.rec (fun (n : Nat) => myMul a (Nat.add b n) = Nat.add (myMul a b) (myMul a n))
    (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (myMul a b))
    (fun (n : Nat)
         (ih : myMul a (Nat.add b n) = Nat.add (myMul a b) (myMul a n)) =>
      @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (myMul a (Nat.add b (Nat.succ n)))
        (Nat.add a (myMul a (Nat.add b n)))
        (Nat.add (myMul a b) (myMul a (Nat.succ n)))
        (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add a (myMul a (Nat.add b n))))
        (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
          (Nat.add a (myMul a (Nat.add b n)))
          (Nat.add a (Nat.add (myMul a b) (myMul a n)))
          (Nat.add (myMul a b) (myMul a (Nat.succ n)))
          (congrArg.{1} (fun (m : Nat) => Nat.add a m) ih)
          (add_mid a (myMul a b) (myMul a n))))
    c

exercises.chapter_title: 有理数：从 ℤ 到 ℚ
exercises.unit: 单元㉒ ℕ 乘法的分配律与结合律
exercises.name: mul_add_right
exercises.title: ㉒.3 右分配律：(a + b) * c = a*c + b*c
exercises.prompt: ㉒.3 右分配律：(a + b) * c = a*c + b*c

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把左边用 myMul_comm 翻成 `c * (a+b)`，交给 mul_add 展开，再用两次 myMul_comm（一次对 c a，一次对 c b）把因子顺序摆回来。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: myMul (a + b) c = myMul a c + myMul b c。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: myMul_comm · mul_add · congrArg（两次，分别改第一个与第二个加数）· Eq.trans。

exercises.template:
theorem mul_add_right (a b c : Nat) :
    myMul (Nat.add a b) c = Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b c) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem mul_add_right (a b c : Nat) :
    myMul (Nat.add a b) c = Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b c) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (myMul (Nat.add a b) c)
    (myMul c (Nat.add a b))
    (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b c))
    (myMul_comm (Nat.add a b) c)
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (myMul c (Nat.add a b))
      (Nat.add (myMul c a) (myMul c b))
      (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b c))
      (mul_add c a b)
      (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add (myMul c a) (myMul c b))
        (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul c b))
        (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b c))
        (congrArg.{1} (fun (m : Nat) => Nat.add m (myMul c b)) (myMul_comm c a))
        (congrArg.{1} (fun (m : Nat) => Nat.add (myMul a c) m) (myMul_comm c b))))

exercises.chapter_title: 有理数：从 ℤ 到 ℚ
exercises.unit: 单元㉒ ℕ 乘法的分配律与结合律
exercises.name: myMul_assoc
exercises.title: ㉒.4 结合律：(a * b) * c = a * (b * c)（对 c 归纳）
exercises.prompt: ㉒.4 结合律：(a * b) * c = a * (b * c)（对 c 归纳）

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 c 归纳。基例两边都归约成 0；步例把左边展开成 `(a*b) + (a*b)*n`，用 ih 把第二个加数换成 `a*(b*n)`，右边展开成 `a * (b + b*n)`，交给 mul_add 的对称收口。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: myMul (myMul a b) c = myMul a (myMul b c)。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Nat.rec · congrArg（在 add (a*b) 下改写 ih）· mul_add（取对称）· Eq.refl（定义性展开）。

exercises.template:
theorem myMul_assoc (a b c : Nat) :
    myMul (myMul a b) c = myMul a (myMul b c) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem myMul_assoc (a b c : Nat) :
    myMul (myMul a b) c = myMul a (myMul b c) :=
  Nat.rec (fun (n : Nat) => myMul (myMul a b) n = myMul a (myMul b n))
    (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat Nat.zero)
    (fun (n : Nat)
         (ih : myMul (myMul a b) n = myMul a (myMul b n)) =>
      @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (myMul (myMul a b) (Nat.succ n))
        (Nat.add (myMul a b) (myMul a (myMul b n)))
        (myMul a (myMul b (Nat.succ n)))
        (congrArg.{1} (fun (m : Nat) => Nat.add (myMul a b) m) ih)
        (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
          (myMul a (Nat.add b (myMul b n)))
          (Nat.add (myMul a b) (myMul a (myMul b n)))
          (mul_add a b (myMul b n))))
    c

exercises.chapter_title: 有理数：从 ℤ 到 ℚ
exercises.unit: 单元㉓ ℤ 乘法的结合律（代表元层）
exercises.name: mulRep_assoc_fst
exercises.title: ㉓.4 两个分量的等式（练习）
exercises.prompt: ㉓.4 两个分量的等式（练习）

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 四步链。先用 fst_expand_left 把左边展开，再用 fst_normalize 换成规范形，用 fst_shift 换一次配对，最后用 fst_expand_right 的对称把右边收回来。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: 左边 ((a*c+b*d)*e + (a*d+b*c)*f) 等于右边 (a*(c*e+d*f) + b*(c*f+d*e))。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Eq.trans（串四步）· fst_expand_left · fst_normalize · fst_shift · Eq.symm (fst_expand_right …)。

exercises.template:
theorem mulRep_assoc_fst (a b c d e f : Nat) :
    Nat.add (myMul (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b d)) e)
               (myMul (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c)) f) =
      Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.add (myMul c e) (myMul d f)))
               (myMul b (Nat.add (myMul c f) (myMul d e))) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem mulRep_assoc_fst (a b c d e f : Nat) :
    Nat.add (myMul (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b d)) e)
               (myMul (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c)) f) =
      Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.add (myMul c e) (myMul d f)))
               (myMul b (Nat.add (myMul c f) (myMul d e))) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add (myMul (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b d)) e)
             (myMul (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c)) f))
    (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul (myMul a c) e) (myMul (myMul b d) e))
             (Nat.add (myMul (myMul a d) f) (myMul (myMul b c) f)))
    (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.add (myMul c e) (myMul d f)))
             (myMul b (Nat.add (myMul c f) (myMul d e))))
    (fst_expand_left a b c d e f)
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul (myMul a c) e) (myMul (myMul b d) e))
               (Nat.add (myMul (myMul a d) f) (myMul (myMul b c) f)))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add (T1 a c e) (T2 b d e))
               (Nat.add (T3 a d f) (T4 b c f)))
      (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.add (myMul c e) (myMul d f)))
               (myMul b (Nat.add (myMul c f) (myMul d e))))
      (fst_normalize a b c d e f)
      (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add (Nat.add (T1 a c e) (T2 b d e))
                 (Nat.add (T3 a d f) (T4 b c f)))
        (Nat.add (Nat.add (T1 a c e) (T3 a d f))
                 (Nat.add (T4 b c f) (T2 b d e)))
        (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.add (myMul c e) (myMul d f)))
                 (myMul b (Nat.add (myMul c f) (myMul d e))))
        (fst_shift a b c d e f)
        (Eq.symm (fst_expand_right a b c d e f))))

hints.body: 与 fst 同形，只是 e 与 f 的角色对调。依次用 snd_expand_left → snd_normalize → snd_shift，最后接 snd_expand_right 的对称。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: 左边 ((a*c+b*d)*f + (a*d+b*c)*e) 等于右边 (a*(c*f+d*e) + b*(c*e+d*f))。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Eq.trans · snd_expand_left · snd_normalize · snd_shift · Eq.symm (snd_expand_right …)。

exercises.template:
theorem mulRep_assoc_snd (a b c d e f : Nat) :
    Nat.add (myMul (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b d)) f)
               (myMul (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c)) e) =
      Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.add (myMul c f) (myMul d e)))
               (myMul b (Nat.add (myMul c e) (myMul d f))) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem mulRep_assoc_snd (a b c d e f : Nat) :
    Nat.add (myMul (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b d)) f)
               (myMul (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c)) e) =
      Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.add (myMul c f) (myMul d e)))
               (myMul b (Nat.add (myMul c e) (myMul d f))) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add (myMul (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b d)) f)
             (myMul (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c)) e))
    (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul (myMul a c) f) (myMul (myMul b d) f))
             (Nat.add (myMul (myMul a d) e) (myMul (myMul b c) e)))
    (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.add (myMul c f) (myMul d e)))
             (myMul b (Nat.add (myMul c e) (myMul d f))))
    (snd_expand_left a b c d e f)
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul (myMul a c) f) (myMul (myMul b d) f))
               (Nat.add (myMul (myMul a d) e) (myMul (myMul b c) e)))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add (T5 a c f) (T8 b d f))
               (Nat.add (T6 a d e) (T7 b c e)))
      (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.add (myMul c f) (myMul d e)))
               (myMul b (Nat.add (myMul c e) (myMul d f))))
      (snd_normalize a b c d e f)
      (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add (Nat.add (T5 a c f) (T8 b d f))
                 (Nat.add (T6 a d e) (T7 b c e)))
        (Nat.add (Nat.add (T5 a c f) (T6 a d e))
                 (Nat.add (T7 b c e) (T8 b d f)))
        (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.add (myMul c f) (myMul d e)))
                 (myMul b (Nat.add (myMul c e) (myMul d f))))
        (snd_shift a b c d e f)
        (Eq.symm (snd_expand_right a b c d e f))))

exercises.template:

    Nat.succ n = Nat.zero → False :=
  fun (h : Nat.succ n = Nat.zero) =>
    @Eq.subst.{1} Nat
      (fun (m : Nat) =>
        Nat.rec (fun (_ : Nat) => Prop) True (fun (k : Nat) (ih : Prop) => False) m)

exercises.name: add_eq_zero_right
exercises.title: add_eq_zero_right

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 b 归纳。b = 0 时目标就是 0 = 0，Eq.refl；b = succ n 时 `a + succ n` 定义性等于 `succ (a+n)`，用 add_succ 把它写成 succ，再交给 succ_ne_zero 得到 False，最后 False.elim。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Nat.rec · add_succ · succ_ne_zero · @False.elim（显式给目标类型）。

exercises.template:
theorem add_eq_zero_right (a b : Nat) :
    Nat.add a b = Nat.zero → b = Nat.zero :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem add_eq_zero_right (a b : Nat) :
    Nat.add a b = Nat.zero → b = Nat.zero :=
  Nat.rec
    (fun (n : Nat) => Nat.add a n = Nat.zero → n = Nat.zero)
    (fun (h : Nat.add a Nat.zero = Nat.zero) => @Eq.refl.{1} Nat Nat.zero)
    (fun (n : Nat)
         (ih : Nat.add a n = Nat.zero → n = Nat.zero) =>
      fun (h : Nat.add a (Nat.succ n) = Nat.zero) =>
        @False.elim (Nat.succ n = Nat.zero)
          (succ_ne_zero (Nat.add a n) (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat (Nat.succ (Nat.add a n)) (Nat.add a (Nat.succ n)) Nat.zero
            (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (Nat.add a (Nat.succ n)) (Nat.succ (Nat.add a n)) (add_succ a n)) h)))
    b

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 b 归纳。b = 0 时两边都是 0，Eq.refl；b = succ n 时用 succ_mul 把 `(b+1)·(n+1)` 展开成 `b·(n+1) + (n+1)`，交给 add_eq_zero_right 得到 `n+1 = 0`，再用 succ_ne_zero 得到 False。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Nat.rec · succ_mul · add_eq_zero_right · succ_ne_zero · @False.elim。

exercises.template:
theorem mul_eq_zero_right (b n : Nat) :
    myMul b (Nat.succ n) = Nat.zero → b = Nat.zero :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem mul_eq_zero_right (b n : Nat) :
    myMul b (Nat.succ n) = Nat.zero → b = Nat.zero :=
  Nat.rec
    (fun (m : Nat) => myMul m (Nat.succ n) = Nat.zero → m = Nat.zero)
    (fun (h : myMul Nat.zero (Nat.succ n) = Nat.zero) => @Eq.refl.{1} Nat Nat.zero)
    (fun (m : Nat)
         (ih : myMul m (Nat.succ n) = Nat.zero → m = Nat.zero) =>
      fun (h : myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ n) = Nat.zero) =>
        @False.elim (Nat.succ m = Nat.zero)
          (succ_ne_zero n
            (add_eq_zero_right (myMul m (Nat.succ n)) (Nat.succ n)
              (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat (Nat.add (myMul m (Nat.succ n)) (Nat.succ n)) (myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ n)) Nat.zero
                (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ n)) (Nat.add (myMul m (Nat.succ n)) (Nat.succ n))
                  (succ_mul m (Nat.succ n)))
                h))))
    b

hints.body: `mulRep p (n+1,0)` 的定义性展开是 `(p1·(n+1) + p2·0, p1·0 + p2·(n+1))`；把 `p2·0` 与 `p1·0` 归约成 0，再用 `zero_add` 把右边第二分量的 `0 + p2·(n+1)` 搬到 `p2·(n+1)`。

hints.body: mulRep p (den n) ~ (p1·(n+1), p2·(n+1))。

exercises.template:
theorem mulRep_den (p : Prod Nat Nat) (n : Nat) :
    intRel (mulRep p (den n))
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n))

exercises.solution:
theorem mulRep_den (p : Prod Nat Nat) (n : Nat) :
    intRel (mulRep p (den n))
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n))
                        (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n))) :=
  congrArg.{1} (fun (x : Nat) =>
      Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n)) x)
    (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (Nat.add Nat.zero (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n)))
      (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n))
      (zero_add (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n))))

theorem mulRep_den_mid (u v : Prod Nat Nat) (n : Nat)
    (h : intRel (mulRep u (den n)) (mulRep v (den n))) :
    Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat u) (Nat.succ n))

exercises.name: mulRep_den_cancel
exercises.title: mulRep_den_cancel
exercises.template:
theorem mulRep_den_cancel (u v : Prod Nat Nat) (n : Nat)
    (h : intRel (mulRep u (den n)) (mulRep v (den n))) :
    intRel u v :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem mulRep_den_cancel (u v : Prod Nat Nat) (n : Nat)
    (h : intRel (mulRep u (den n)) (mulRep v (den n))) :
    intRel u v :=
  mul_cancel_pos n
    (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat u) (Prod.snd Nat Nat v))
    (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat v) (Prod.snd Nat Nat u))
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (myMul (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat u) (Prod.snd Nat Nat v)) (Nat.succ n))
      (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat u) (Nat.succ n))
               (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat v) (Nat.succ n)))
      (myMul (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat v) (Prod.snd Nat Nat u)) (Nat.succ n))
      (mul_add_right (Prod.fst Nat Nat u) (Prod.snd Nat Nat v) (Nat.succ n))
      (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat u) (Nat.succ n))
                 (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat v) (Nat.succ n)))
        (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat v) (Nat.succ n))
                 (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat u) (Nat.succ n)))
        (myMul (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat v) (Prod.snd Nat Nat u)) (Nat.succ n))
        (mulRep_den_mid u v n h)
        (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
          (myMul (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat v) (Prod.snd Nat Nat u)) (Nat.succ n))
          (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat v) (Nat.succ n))
                   (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat u) (Nat.succ n)))
          (mul_add_right (Prod.fst Nat Nat v) (Prod.snd Nat Nat u) (Nat.succ n)))))

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 两边都展开成 `((a+1)(b+1) + 0, 0 + 0)`；把第二个 `0 + 0` 用 `zero_mul` 与 `Nat.add` 的定义性归约收成 0，再用 `Eq.symm` 把方向摆正。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: mulRep (den a) (den b) ~ ((a+1)(b+1), 0)。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Eq.symm · Eq.trans · congrArg · zero_mul。

exercises.template:
theorem mulRep_den_den (a b : Nat) :
    intRel (mulRep (den a) (den b))
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Nat.succ a) (Nat.succ b)) Nat.zero) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem mulRep_den_den (a b : Nat) :
    intRel (mulRep (den a) (den b))
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Nat.succ a) (Nat.succ b)) Nat.zero) :=
  @Eq.symm.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add (myMul (Nat.succ a) (Nat.succ b))
             (Nat.add Nat.zero (myMul Nat.zero (Nat.succ b))))
    (Nat.add (myMul (Nat.succ a) (Nat.succ b)) Nat.zero)
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (Nat.add (myMul (Nat.succ a) (Nat.succ b))
               (Nat.add Nat.zero (myMul Nat.zero (Nat.succ b))))
      (Nat.add (myMul (Nat.succ a) (Nat.succ b))
               (Nat.add Nat.zero Nat.zero))
      (Nat.add (myMul (Nat.succ a) (Nat.succ b)) Nat.zero)
      (congrArg.{1} (fun (y : Nat) =>
          Nat.add (myMul (Nat.succ a) (Nat.succ b)) (Nat.add Nat.zero y))
        (zero_mul (Nat.succ b)))
      (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add (myMul (Nat.succ a) (Nat.succ b)) Nat.zero)))

exercises.prompt: 主定理：ratRel 是传递的。两边各乘一个正分母，把交叉乘积接到同一条链上， 再消去多出来的正分母 (n+1)。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 h1、h2 各乘一个正分母（用 mulRep_wd 的两次），再用 `mulRep_den_swap` 把 `(p·dn)·dk` 与 `(p·dk)·dn` 对齐，得到一条从 `(p·dk)·dn` 到 `(r·dm)·dn` 的五步链；最后交给 `mulRep_den_cancel` 消去多出来的 `dn`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: ratRel x y ⇒ ratRel y z ⇒ ratRel x z。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: mulRep_wd（两次）· mulRep_den_swap（三次）· intRel_trans（四次）· mulRep_den_cancel。

exercises.template:
theorem ratRel_trans (a b c d e f : Nat) (m n k : Nat)
    (h1 : ratRel
      (@prod_mk (Prod Nat Nat) Nat (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) m)
      (@prod_mk (Prod Nat Nat) Nat (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) n))
    (h2 : ratRel
      (@prod_mk (Prod Nat Nat) Nat (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) n)
      (@prod_mk (Prod Nat Nat) Nat (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f) k)) :
    ratRel
      (@prod_mk (Prod Nat Nat) Nat (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) m)
      (@prod_mk (Prod Nat Nat) Nat (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f) k) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratRel_trans (a b c d e f : Nat) (m n k : Nat)
    (h1 : ratRel
      (@prod_mk (Prod Nat Nat) Nat (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) m)
      (@prod_mk (Prod Nat Nat) Nat (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) n))
    (h2 : ratRel
      (@prod_mk (Prod Nat Nat) Nat (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) n)
      (@prod_mk (Prod Nat Nat) Nat (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f) k)) :
    ratRel
      (@prod_mk (Prod Nat Nat) Nat (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) m)
      (@prod_mk (Prod Nat Nat) Nat (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f) k) :=
  mulRep_den_cancel
    (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den k))
    (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f) (den m))
    n
    (intRel_trans
      (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den k)) (den n))
      (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den n)) (den k))
      (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f) (den m)) (den n))
      (mulRep_den_swap a b k n)
      (intRel_trans
        (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den n)) (den k))
        (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den m)) (den k))
        (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f) (den m)) (den n))
        (mulRep_wd
          (Prod.fst Nat Nat (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den n)))
          (Prod.snd Nat Nat (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den n)))
          (Prod.fst Nat Nat (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den m)))
          (Prod.snd Nat Nat (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den m)))
          (Nat.succ k) Nat.zero h1)
        (intRel_trans
          (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den m)) (den k))
          (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den k)) (den m))
          (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f) (den m)) (den n))
          (mulRep_den_swap c d m k)
          (intRel_trans
            (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den k)) (den m))
            (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f) (den n)) (den m))
            (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f) (den m)) (den n))
            (mulRep_wd
              (Prod.fst Nat Nat (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den k)))
              (Prod.snd Nat Nat (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den k)))
              (Prod.fst Nat Nat (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f) (den n)))
              (Prod.snd Nat Nat (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f) (den n)))
              (Nat.succ m) Nat.zero h2)
            (mulRep_den_swap e f n m)))))

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 左边 `succ (m*n + m + n)` 定义性等于 `(m*n + m) + (n+1)`；右边用 `succ_mul` 展开成 `m*(n+1) + (n+1)`，再用 `mul_add` 把 `m*(n+1)` 拆成 `m*n + m*1`（`m*1` 定义性归约成 `m`）。

hints.label: 关键件

exercises.template:
theorem ratDenRep_succ (m n : Nat) :

theorem ratDenRep_succ (m n : Nat) :
    Nat.succ (ratDenRep m n) = myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ n) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.succ (ratDenRep m n))
    (Nat.add (myMul m (Nat.succ n)) (Nat.succ n))
    (myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ n))
    (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
      (Nat.add (myMul m (Nat.succ n)) (Nat.succ n))
      (Nat.succ (ratDenRep m n))
      (congrArg.{1} (fun (x : Nat) => Nat.add x (Nat.succ n))
        (mul_add m n (Nat.succ Nat.zero))))
    (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
      (myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ n))
      (Nat.add (myMul m (Nat.succ n)) (Nat.succ n))
      (succ_mul m (Nat.succ n)))

hints.label: 思路

exercises.template:
theorem ratAdd_cross (a b a' b' : Nat) (m : Nat)
    (h : intRel (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den m))
                (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b') (den m))) :
    Nat.add a b' = Nat.add a' b :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratAdd_cross (a b a' b' : Nat) (m : Nat)
    (h : intRel (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den m))
                (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b') (den m))) :
    Nat.add a b' = Nat.add a' b :=
  mul_cancel_pos m (Nat.add a b') (Nat.add a' b)
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (myMul (Nat.add a b') (Nat.succ m))
      (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ m)) (myMul b' (Nat.succ m)))
      (myMul (Nat.add a' b) (Nat.succ m))
      (mul_add_right a b' (Nat.succ m))
      (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ m)) (myMul b' (Nat.succ m)))
        (Nat.add (myMul a' (Nat.succ m)) (myMul b (Nat.succ m)))
        (myMul (Nat.add a' b) (Nat.succ m))
        (mulRep_den_mid (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b') m h)
        (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
          (myMul (Nat.add a' b) (Nat.succ m))
          (Nat.add (myMul a' (Nat.succ m)) (myMul b (Nat.succ m)))
          (mul_add_right a' b (Nat.succ m)))))

          (@prod_mk Nat Nat

            (Nat.add (myMul b' (Nat.succ n)) (myMul d (Nat.succ m))))

exercises.name: ratAddRep_wd_snd
exercises.title: ㉖.7 加法对第二个因子良定义
exercises.prompt: ㉖.7 加法对第二个因子良定义

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 与 ㉖.6 同构：`ratAdd_cross` 这次作用在 `y ~ y'` 上（分母字段是 `n`），得到 `c + d' = c' + d`，交给 ㉖.5；两端分母仍是同一个 `ratDenRep m n`，`mul_shift_c` + `mulRep_den` + `intRel_trans` 收口。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratAdd_cross · ratAdd_num_wd_snd · mul_shift_c · mulRep_den（两次）· intRel_trans（两次）· intRel_symm。

exercises.template:
theorem ratAddRep_wd_snd (a b c d c' d' m n : Nat)
    (h : ratRel (qrep c d n) (qrep c' d' n)) :
    ratRel (ratAddRep (qrep a b m) (qrep c d n))
           (ratAddRep (qrep a b m) (qrep c' d' n)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratAddRep_wd_snd (a b c d c' d' m n : Nat)
    (h : ratRel (qrep c d n) (qrep c' d' n)) :
    ratRel (ratAddRep (qrep a b m) (qrep c d n))
           (ratAddRep (qrep a b m) (qrep c' d' n)) :=
  intRel_trans
    (mulRep
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat
        (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ n)) (myMul c (Nat.succ m)))
        (Nat.add (myMul b (Nat.succ n)) (myMul d (Nat.succ m))))
      (den (ratDenRep m n)))
    (@prod_mk Nat Nat
      (myMul
        (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ n)) (myMul c (Nat.succ m)))
        (Nat.succ (ratDenRep m n)))
      (myMul
        (Nat.add (myMul b (Nat.succ n)) (myMul d (Nat.succ m)))
        (Nat.succ (ratDenRep m n))))
    (mulRep
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat
        (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ n)) (myMul c' (Nat.succ m)))
        (Nat.add (myMul b (Nat.succ n)) (myMul d' (Nat.succ m))))
      (den (ratDenRep m n)))
    (mulRep_den
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat
        (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ n)) (myMul c (Nat.succ m)))
        (Nat.add (myMul b (Nat.succ n)) (myMul d (Nat.succ m))))
      (ratDenRep m n))
    (intRel_trans
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat
        (myMul
          (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ n)) (myMul c (Nat.succ m)))
          (Nat.succ (ratDenRep m n)))
        (myMul
          (Nat.add (myMul b (Nat.succ n)) (myMul d (Nat.succ m)))
          (Nat.succ (ratDenRep m n))))
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat
        (myMul
          (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ n)) (myMul c' (Nat.succ m)))
          (Nat.succ (ratDenRep m n)))
        (myMul
          (Nat.add (myMul b (Nat.succ n)) (myMul d' (Nat.succ m)))
          (Nat.succ (ratDenRep m n))))
      (mulRep
        (@prod_mk Nat Nat
          (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ n)) (myMul c' (Nat.succ m)))
          (Nat.add (myMul b (Nat.succ n)) (myMul d' (Nat.succ m))))
        (den (ratDenRep m n)))
      (mul_shift_c
        (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ n)) (myMul c (Nat.succ m)))
        (Nat.add (myMul b (Nat.succ n)) (myMul d (Nat.succ m)))
        (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ n)) (myMul c' (Nat.succ m)))
        (Nat.add (myMul b (Nat.succ n)) (myMul d' (Nat.succ m)))
        (Nat.succ (ratDenRep m n))
        (ratAdd_num_wd_snd a b c d c' d' m n
          (ratAdd_cross c d c' d' n h)))
      (intRel_symm
        (mulRep
          (@prod_mk Nat Nat
            (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ n)) (myMul c' (Nat.succ m)))
            (Nat.add (myMul b (Nat.succ n)) (myMul d' (Nat.succ m))))
          (den (ratDenRep m n)))
        (@prod_mk Nat Nat
          (myMul
            (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ n)) (myMul c' (Nat.succ m)))
            (Nat.succ (ratDenRep m n)))
          (myMul
            (Nat.add (myMul b (Nat.succ n)) (myMul d' (Nat.succ m)))
            (Nat.succ (ratDenRep m n))))
        (mulRep_den
          (@prod_mk Nat Nat
            (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ n)) (myMul c' (Nat.succ m)))
            (Nat.add (myMul b (Nat.succ n)) (myMul d' (Nat.succ m))))
          (ratDenRep m n))))

exercises.name: ratMulRep_wd
exercises.title: ㉘.1 乘法对第一个因子良定义
exercises.prompt: ㉘.1 乘法对第一个因子良定义

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `ratAdd_cross` 先把 `x ~ x'` 化成整数代表元的相等 `a + b' = a' + b`；`mulRep_wd` 把它搬到两个乘积分子上；最后再用一次 `mulRep_wd`，把两个分子同时乘上公分母 `(m+1)(n+1)`，正好就是 `ratRel` 的定义。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `x ~ x' ⇒ x*y ~ x'*y`（同分母 `m`、同一个 `y`）。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratAdd_cross · mulRep_wd（两次，第二次的乘数是 `den (ratDenRep m n)`）。

exercises.template:
theorem ratMulRep_wd (a b a' b' c d m n : Nat)
    (h : ratRel (qrep a b m) (qrep a' b' m)) :
    ratRel (ratMulRep (qrep a b m) (qrep c d n))
           (ratMulRep (qrep a' b' m) (qrep c d n)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratMulRep_wd (a b a' b' c d m n : Nat)
    (h : ratRel (qrep a b m) (qrep a' b' m)) :
    ratRel (ratMulRep (qrep a b m) (qrep c d n))
           (ratMulRep (qrep a' b' m) (qrep c d n)) :=
  mulRep_wd
    (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b d))
    (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c))
    (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b' d))
    (Nat.add (myMul a' d) (myMul b' c))
    (Nat.succ (ratDenRep m n)) Nat.zero
    (mulRep_wd a b a' b' c d (rat_cross a b a' b' m h))

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 与 ㉘.1 同构，只是这次把 `ratAdd_cross` 用在 `y ~ y'` 上；整数层的 `mulRep_wd_snd` 把 `c + d' = c' + d` 搬到 `x` 的两个乘积分子上，再乘回公分母。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `y ~ y' ⇒ x*y ~ x*y'`（同分母 `n`、同一个 `x`）。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratAdd_cross（作用在 `y` 上）· mulRep_wd_snd · mulRep_wd。

exercises.template:
theorem ratMulRep_wd_snd (a b c d c' d' m n : Nat)
    (h : ratRel (qrep c d n) (qrep c' d' n)) :
    ratRel (ratMulRep (qrep a b m) (qrep c d n))
           (ratMulRep (qrep a b m) (qrep c' d' n)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratMulRep_wd_snd (a b c d c' d' m n : Nat)
    (h : ratRel (qrep c d n) (qrep c' d' n)) :
    ratRel (ratMulRep (qrep a b m) (qrep c d n))
           (ratMulRep (qrep a b m) (qrep c' d' n)) :=
  mulRep_wd
    (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b d))
    (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c))
    (Nat.add (myMul a c') (myMul b d'))
    (Nat.add (myMul a d') (myMul b c'))
    (Nat.succ (ratDenRep m n)) Nat.zero
    (mulRep_wd_snd c d c' d' a b (rat_cross c d c' d' n h))

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `h : ratRel x y` 就是两个交叉乘积的整数相等；序的良定义性 `leRep_wd_pair` 把 `leRep p p` 搬到 `leRep p q`，其中 `p`、`q` 正是 `ratLeRep` 展开后的两个乘积。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel x y → ratLeRep x y`。

exercises.template:

  sorry

theorem ratLeRep_of_ratRel (x y : ratRep) (h : ratRel x y) : ratLeRep x y :=
  leRep_wd_pair
    (mulRep (numOf y) (den (denOf x)))
    (mulRep (numOf x) (den (denOf y)))
    (mulRep (numOf y) (den (denOf x)))
    (mulRep (numOf y) (den (denOf x)))
    (intRel_symm
      (mulRep (numOf x) (den (denOf y)))
      (mulRep (numOf y) (den (denOf x))) h)
    (intRel_refl (mulRep (numOf y) (den (denOf x))))
    (leRep_refl (mulRep (numOf y) (den (denOf x))))

hints.body: `negRep (mulRep p (den n)) = mulRep (negRep p) (den n)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: zero_add · congrArg · Eq.symm · Eq.trans。

exercises.template:
theorem negRep_mulRep_den (p : Prod Nat Nat) (n : Nat) :
    negRep (mulRep p (den n)) = mulRep (negRep p) (den n) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem negRep_mulRep_den (p : Prod Nat Nat) (n : Nat) :
    negRep (mulRep p (den n)) = mulRep (negRep p) (den n) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
    (negRep (mulRep p (den n)))
    (@prod_mk Nat Nat
      (Nat.add Nat.zero (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n)))
      (Nat.add Nat.zero (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n))))
    (mulRep (negRep p) (den n))
    (@Eq.trans.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
      (negRep (mulRep p (den n)))
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat
        (Nat.add Nat.zero (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n)))
        (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n)))
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat
        (Nat.add Nat.zero (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n)))
        (Nat.add Nat.zero (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n))))
      (Eq.refl (negRep (mulRep p (den n))))
      (@congrArg.{1} Nat (Prod Nat Nat)
        (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n))
        (Nat.add Nat.zero (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n)))
        (fun (y : Nat) =>
          @prod_mk Nat Nat
            (Nat.add Nat.zero (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n))) y)
        (Eq.symm (zero_add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n))))))
    (@Eq.trans.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat
        (Nat.add Nat.zero (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n)))
        (Nat.add Nat.zero (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n))))
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat
        (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n))
        (Nat.add Nat.zero (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n))))
      (mulRep (negRep p) (den n))
      (@congrArg.{1} Nat (Prod Nat Nat)
        (Nat.add Nat.zero (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n)))
        (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n))
        (fun (x : Nat) =>
          @prod_mk Nat Nat x
            (Nat.add Nat.zero (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n))))
        (zero_add (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n))))
      (Eq.refl (mulRep (negRep p) (den n))))

exercises.name: ratNegRep_wd
exercises.title: ㉛.2 负元的良定义性
exercises.prompt: ㉛.2 负元的良定义性

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `h : ratRel x y` 是交叉乘积的整数相等；`negRep_wd` 把它搬到两个 `negRep` 上；㉛.1 说 `negRep (mulRep …)` 与 `mulRep (negRep …) …` 命题相等。用两次 `intRel_trans` 拼成目标。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel x y → ratRel (ratNegRep x) (ratNegRep y)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: negRep_mulRep_den · negRep_wd · intRel_trans · Eq.symm。

exercises.template:
theorem ratNegRep_wd (x y : ratRep) (h : ratRel x y) :
    ratRel (ratNegRep x) (ratNegRep y) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratNegRep_wd (x y : ratRep) (h : ratRel x y) :
    ratRel (ratNegRep x) (ratNegRep y) :=
  intRel_trans
    (mulRep (negRep (numOf x)) (den (denOf y)))
    (negRep (mulRep (numOf x) (den (denOf y))))
    (mulRep (negRep (numOf y)) (den (denOf x)))
    (intRel_of_eq
      (mulRep (negRep (numOf x)) (den (denOf y)))
      (negRep (mulRep (numOf x) (den (denOf y))))
      (@Eq.symm.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
        (negRep (mulRep (numOf x) (den (denOf y))))
        (mulRep (negRep (numOf x)) (den (denOf y)))
        (negRep_mulRep_den (numOf x) (denOf y))))
    (@intRel_trans
      (negRep (mulRep (numOf x) (den (denOf y))))
      (negRep (mulRep (numOf y) (den (denOf x))))
      (mulRep (negRep (numOf y)) (den (denOf x)))
      (negRep_wd (mulRep (numOf x) (den (denOf y)))
                 (mulRep (numOf y) (den (denOf x))) h)
      (intRel_of_eq
        (negRep (mulRep (numOf y) (den (denOf x))))
        (mulRep (negRep (numOf y)) (den (denOf x)))
        (negRep_mulRep_den (numOf y) (denOf x))))

hints.label: 思路

exercises.template:
theorem ratSubRep_mk (a b c d m n : Nat) :
    ratSubRep (qrep a b m) (qrep c d n) =
      qrep
        (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ n)) (myMul d (Nat.succ m)))
        (Nat.add (myMul b (Nat.succ n)) (myMul c (Nat.succ m)))
        (ratDenRep m n) :=

exercises.solution:
theorem ratSubRep_mk (a b c d m n : Nat) :
    ratSubRep (qrep a b m) (qrep c d n) =
      qrep
        (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ n)) (myMul d (Nat.succ m)))
        (Nat.add (myMul b (Nat.succ n)) (myMul c (Nat.succ m)))
        (ratDenRep m n) :=
  Eq.refl (qrep
    (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ n)) (myMul d (Nat.succ m)))
    (Nat.add (myMul b (Nat.succ n)) (myMul c (Nat.succ m)))
    (ratDenRep m n))

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对任意 eps > 0，取 N = 0；`x n = 0` 对一切 n 成立，所以 `close 0 0 eps` 与 n,m 无关，直接用 ㉟.1。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Cauchy (fun _ => ratZeroRep)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.intro（N = 0）· close_zero_zero。

exercises.template:
theorem cauchy_zero : Cauchy (fun (_ : Nat) => ratZeroRep) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem cauchy_zero : Cauchy (fun (_ : Nat) => ratZeroRep) :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (h : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.intro Nat.zero
      (fun (n m : Nat) (hn : LeNat Nat.zero n) (hm : LeNat Nat.zero m) =>
        close_zero_zero eps h)

exercises.prompt: ㊲.1 乘正分母后的规范形

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `mulRep p (den k)` 展开成 `(p₁·(k+1) + p₂·0, p₁·0 + p₂·(k+1))`；第一坐标的 `+0` 用 `add_zero`、第二坐标的 `0+` 用 `zero_add` 消掉。两个坐标各用一次 `@congrArg`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `mulRep p (den k) = (p₁·(k+1), p₂·(k+1))`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: add_zero · zero_add · congrArg · Eq.trans。

exercises.template:
theorem mulRep_den_form (p : Prod Nat Nat) (k : Nat) :
    mulRep p (den k) =
      @prod_mk Nat Nat
        (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))
        (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem mulRep_den_form (p : Prod Nat Nat) (k : Nat) :
    mulRep p (den k) =
      @prod_mk Nat Nat
        (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))
        (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
    (mulRep p (den k))
    (@prod_mk Nat Nat
      (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)) (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) Nat.zero))
      (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) Nat.zero) (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))))
    (@prod_mk Nat Nat
      (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))
      (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)))
    (Eq.refl (mulRep p (den k)))
    (@Eq.trans.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat
        (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)) (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) Nat.zero))
        (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) Nat.zero) (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))))
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat
        (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))
        (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) Nat.zero) (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))))
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat
        (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))
        (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)))
      (@congrArg.{1} Nat (Prod Nat Nat)
        (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)) (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) Nat.zero))
        (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))
        (fun (x : Nat) =>
          @prod_mk Nat Nat x
            (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) Nat.zero) (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))))
        (add_zero (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))))
      (@congrArg.{1} Nat (Prod Nat Nat)
        (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) Nat.zero) (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)))
        (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))
        (fun (y : Nat) =>
          @prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)) y)
        (zero_add (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)))))

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 两边都用 `myMul_assoc` 拆成 `a·(m·k)` 与 `a·(k·m)`，中间用 `myMul_comm` 交换括号里的两个因子。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: myMul_assoc（两次，其中一次取对称）· myMul_comm · congrArg。

exercises.template:
theorem mul_den_swap_nat (a m k : Nat) :
    myMul (myMul a (Nat.succ m)) (Nat.succ k) =
      myMul (myMul a (Nat.succ k)) (Nat.succ m) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem mul_den_swap_nat (a m k : Nat) :
    myMul (myMul a (Nat.succ m)) (Nat.succ k) =
      myMul (myMul a (Nat.succ k)) (Nat.succ m) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (myMul (myMul a (Nat.succ m)) (Nat.succ k))
    (myMul a (myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ k)))
    (myMul (myMul a (Nat.succ k)) (Nat.succ m))
    (myMul_assoc a (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ k))
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (myMul a (myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ k)))
      (myMul a (myMul (Nat.succ k) (Nat.succ m)))
      (myMul (myMul a (Nat.succ k)) (Nat.succ m))
      (@congrArg.{1} Nat Nat
        (myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ k))
        (myMul (Nat.succ k) (Nat.succ m))
        (fun (x : Nat) => myMul a x)
        (myMul_comm (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ k)))
      (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
        (myMul (myMul a (Nat.succ k)) (Nat.succ m))
        (myMul a (myMul (Nat.succ k) (Nat.succ m)))
        (myMul_assoc a (Nat.succ k) (Nat.succ m))))

exercises.title: prod_mk_congr

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先对第二坐标 `Eq.subst`（motive 固定第一坐标），再对第一坐标 `Eq.subst`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Eq.subst（两次）· Eq.refl。

exercises.solution:
theorem prod_mk_congr (a a' b b' : Nat) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :
    @prod_mk Nat Nat a b = @prod_mk Nat Nat a' b' :=
  @Eq.subst.{1} Nat
    (fun (x : Nat) => @prod_mk Nat Nat a b = @prod_mk Nat Nat x b')
    a a' ha
    (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
      (fun (y : Nat) => @prod_mk Nat Nat a b = @prod_mk Nat Nat a y)
      b b' hb
      (@Eq.refl.{1} (Prod Nat Nat) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)))

exercises.title: leRep_mul_den_right

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先用 ㊲.1 把两边的 `mulRep … (den k)` 换成规范形，再用 `leRep_wd_pair` 把目标搬过去；规范形上的 `LeNat` 用 `leNat_mul_right` 乘开，再用 `mul_add_right` 分配到两个坐标。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `leRep p q → leRep (mulRep p (den k)) (mulRep q (den k))`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: mulRep_den_form · leRep_wd_pair · intRel_of_eq · leNat_mul_right · mul_add_right。

exercises.template:
theorem leRep_mul_den_right (p q : Prod Nat Nat) (k : Nat)
    (h : leRep p q) :
    leRep (mulRep p (den k)) (mulRep q (den k)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem leRep_mul_den_right (p q : Prod Nat Nat) (k : Nat)
    (h : leRep p q) :
    leRep (mulRep p (den k)) (mulRep q (den k)) :=
  leRep_wd_pair
    (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))
                      (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)))
    (mulRep p (den k))
    (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k))
                      (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k)))
    (mulRep q (den k))
    (intRel_of_eq
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))
                        (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)))
      (mulRep p (den k))
      (@Eq.symm.{1} (Prod Nat Nat) (mulRep p (den k))
        (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))
                          (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)))
        (mulRep_den_form p k)))
    (intRel_of_eq
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k))
                        (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k)))
      (mulRep q (den k))
      (@Eq.symm.{1} (Prod Nat Nat) (mulRep q (den k))
        (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k))
                          (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k)))
        (mulRep_den_form q k)))
    (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
      (fun (x : Nat) =>
        LeNat x (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k))
                         (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))))
      (myMul (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q)) (Nat.succ k))
      (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))
               (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k)))
      (mul_add_right (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k))
      (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
        (fun (x : Nat) =>
          LeNat (myMul (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q)) (Nat.succ k)) x)
        (myMul (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p)) (Nat.succ k))
        (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k))
                 (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)))
        (mul_add_right (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))
        (leNat_mul_right (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q))
                         (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p))
                         (Nat.succ k) h)))

exercises.title: leRep_cancel_den

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 与 ㊲.4 相反：先把假设搬到 ㊲.1 的规范形，用 `mul_add_right` 的对称把两个和收成 `(p₁+p₂)·(k+1)`，再用 `leNat_mul_cancel` 消去正因子。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `leRep (mulRep p (den k)) (mulRep q (den k)) → leRep p q`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: leRep_wd_pair · mul_add_right（取对称）· leNat_mul_cancel。

exercises.template:
theorem leRep_cancel_den (p q : Prod Nat Nat) (k : Nat)
    (h : leRep (mulRep p (den k)) (mulRep q (den k))) : leRep p q :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem leRep_cancel_den (p q : Prod Nat Nat) (k : Nat)
    (h : leRep (mulRep p (den k)) (mulRep q (den k))) : leRep p q :=
  leNat_mul_cancel
    (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q))
    (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p)) k
    (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
      (fun (x : Nat) =>
        LeNat x (myMul (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p)) (Nat.succ k)))
      (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))
               (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k)))
      (myMul (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q)) (Nat.succ k))
      (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
        (myMul (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q)) (Nat.succ k))
        (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))
                 (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k)))
        (mul_add_right (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k)))
      (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
        (fun (x : Nat) =>
          LeNat (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))
                         (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k))) x)
        (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k))
                 (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)))
        (myMul (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p)) (Nat.succ k))
        (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
          (myMul (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p)) (Nat.succ k))
          (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k))
                   (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)))
          (mul_add_right (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)))
        (leRep_wd_pair
          (mulRep p (den k))
          (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))
                            (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)))
          (mulRep q (den k))
          (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k))
                            (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k)))
          (intRel_of_eq (mulRep p (den k))
            (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))
                              (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)))
            (mulRep_den_form p k))
          (intRel_of_eq (mulRep q (den k))
            (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k))
                              (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k)))
            (mulRep_den_form q k))
          h)))

exercises.name: mulRep_den_perm
exercises.title: 单元㉙ 用交叉相乘定义了 `ratLeRep`，单元㊲ 备好了「乘正分母保序 / 可消去」 的引擎。本单元把它们拼起来，结清序的**传递性**：
exercises.prompt:
单元㉙ 用交叉相乘定义了 `ratLeRep`，单元㊲ 备好了「乘正分母保序 / 可消去」 的引擎。本单元把它们拼起来，结清序的**传递性**：

x ≤ y ∧ y ≤ z ⟹ x ≤ z

证明路线（把两个不等式换到同一个公分母上再比较）：

① 把 `x ≤ y` 两边乘 `z_den`：`x·y_den·z_den ≤ y·x_den·z_den`； ② 把 `y ≤ z` 两边乘 `x_den`：`y·z_den·x_den ≤ z·y_den·x_den`； ③ 中间项 `(y·x_den)·z_den` 与 `(y·z_den)·x_den` 只差分母的换位（㊳.1）， 换位后用 `leRep_trans` 串成 `x·y_den·z_den ≤ z·y_den·x_den`； ④ 两边各换位一次，把 `y_den` 挪到最外层，`leRep_cancel_den` 消去它， 正好得到 `ratLeRep x z` 展开后的形状。

引擎（`leRep_mul_den_right` / `leRep_cancel_den`）已在单元㊲ 判卷，收在 `lib/RatOrder`；本单元的律（㊳.1–㊳.3）留在画布里。

㊳.1 两个正分母可以换位

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 两边各用一次 `mulRep_assoc` 拆成 `p·(den m · den k)` 与 `p·(den k · den m)`，中间用 `mulRep_comm` 交换括号里的两个正分母；`intRel_trans` 把三段串起来（第二段是等式，用 `intRel_of_eq` 读成 `intRel`）。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `intRel (mulRep (mulRep p (den m)) (den k)) (mulRep (mulRep p (den k)) (den m))`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: mulRep_assoc（两次，其中一次取 `intRel_symm`）· mulRep_comm · congrArg · intRel_of_eq · intRel_trans。

exercises.template:
theorem mulRep_den_perm (p : Prod Nat Nat) (m k : Nat) :
    intRel (mulRep (mulRep p (den m)) (den k))
           (mulRep (mulRep p (den k)) (den m)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem mulRep_den_perm (p : Prod Nat Nat) (m k : Nat) :
    intRel (mulRep (mulRep p (den m)) (den k))
           (mulRep (mulRep p (den k)) (den m)) :=
  match p with
  | prod_mk a b =>
    intRel_trans
      (mulRep (mulRep (prod_mk a b) (den m)) (den k))
      (mulRep (prod_mk a b) (mulRep (den m) (den k)))
      (mulRep (mulRep (prod_mk a b) (den k)) (den m))
      (mulRep_assoc a b (Nat.succ m) Nat.zero (Nat.succ k) Nat.zero)
      (intRel_trans
        (mulRep (prod_mk a b) (mulRep (den m) (den k)))
        (mulRep (prod_mk a b) (mulRep (den k) (den m)))
        (mulRep (mulRep (prod_mk a b) (den k)) (den m))
        (intRel_of_eq
          (mulRep (prod_mk a b) (mulRep (den m) (den k)))
          (mulRep (prod_mk a b) (mulRep (den k) (den m)))
          (congrArg
            (fun (x : Prod Nat Nat) => mulRep (prod_mk a b) x)
            (mulRep_comm (Nat.succ m) Nat.zero (Nat.succ k) Nat.zero)))
        (intRel_symm
          (mulRep (mulRep (prod_mk a b) (den k)) (den m))
          (mulRep (prod_mk a b) (mulRep (den k) (den m)))
          (mulRep_assoc a b (Nat.succ k) Nat.zero (Nat.succ m) Nat.zero)))

exercises.name: ratLeRep_trans
exercises.title: ㊳.2 序的传递性
exercises.prompt: ㊳.2 序的传递性

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: h1 两边乘 `den z`、h2 两边乘 `den x`（`leRep_mul_den_right`）；中间项 `(y·x_den)·z_den` 与 `(y·z_den)·x_den` 用 ㊳.1 换位，再用 `leRep_trans` 串成一条；最后两边各用 ㊳.1 把 `y_den` 挪到最外层，`leRep_cancel_den` 消去它。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratLeRep x y → ratLeRep y z → ratLeRep x z`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: leRep_mul_den_right · mulRep_den_perm · leRep_wd_pair · leRep_trans · leRep_cancel_den。

exercises.template:
theorem ratLeRep_trans (x y z : ratRep)
    (h1 : ratLeRep x y) (h2 : ratLeRep y z) : ratLeRep x z :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratLeRep_trans (x y z : ratRep)
    (h1 : ratLeRep x y) (h2 : ratLeRep y z) : ratLeRep x z :=
  leRep_cancel_den
    (leNum x z) (leNum z x) (denOf y)
    (leRep_wd_pair
      (mulRep (leNum x y) (den (denOf z)))
      (mulRep (leNum x z) (den (denOf y)))
      (mulRep (leNum z y) (den (denOf x)))
      (mulRep (leNum z x) (den (denOf y)))
      (mulRep_den_perm (numOf x) (denOf y) (denOf z))
      (mulRep_den_perm (numOf z) (denOf y) (denOf x))
      (leRep_trans
        (Prod.fst Nat Nat (mulRep (leNum x y) (den (denOf z))))
        (Prod.snd Nat Nat (mulRep (leNum x y) (den (denOf z))))
        (Prod.fst Nat Nat (mulRep (leNum y z) (den (denOf x))))
        (Prod.snd Nat Nat (mulRep (leNum y z) (den (denOf x))))
        (Prod.fst Nat Nat (mulRep (leNum z y) (den (denOf x))))
        (Prod.snd Nat Nat (mulRep (leNum z y) (den (denOf x))))
        (leRep_wd_pair
          (mulRep (leNum x y) (den (denOf z)))
          (mulRep (leNum x y) (den (denOf z)))
          (mulRep (leNum y x) (den (denOf z)))
          (mulRep (leNum y z) (den (denOf x)))
          (intRel_refl (mulRep (leNum x y) (den (denOf z))))
          (mulRep_den_perm (numOf y) (denOf x) (denOf z))
          (leRep_mul_den_right (leNum x y) (leNum y x) (denOf z) h1))
        (leRep_mul_den_right (leNum y z) (leNum z y) (denOf x) h2)))

exercises.chapter_title: 有理 Cauchy 序列与实数的载体
exercises.unit: 单元㊴ 有理数的序与相等相容
exercises.name: scale_den
exercises.title: 单元㊴ 有理数的序与相等相容
exercises.prompt:
单元㊴ 有理数的序与相等相容

ℚ 是代表元的商（`Rat := Quot ratRel`）。㉙ 把 `x ≤ y` 定义成 **代表元上的交叉相乘比较**：

ratLeRep x y :⟺ x.num · (y.den) ≤ y.num · (x.den)

既然是商上的关系，它就必须与代表元的选取无关：

x ~ x' 且 y ~ y' ⟹ (x ≤ y ⟺ x' ≤ y')

否则「ℚ 上的序」根本不是一个关系。本单元结清**替换一个因子**的两条腿 （`x` 可换、`y` 可换）；两条腿拼起来就是完整的相容性。

证明路线（全部停在 ℤ 代表元与 ℕ 乘法的层面）：

① 把 `intRel` 的两边同乘一个正分母（㊴.1）——这是唯一的「搬运」工具； ② 要证 `x' ≤ y`：把 `x ≤ y` 两边乘上 `x'.den`；再把 `x ~ x'` 两边乘上 `y.den`，用 ㊴.1 与 `mulRep_den_swap` 把 `x.num·x'.den` 换到公分母上； 最后 `leRep_cancel_den` 消去公共的 `x.den`。 ③ 要证 `x ≤ y'`：对称地，把 `x ≤ y` 两边乘上 `y'.den`，`y ~ y'` 两边 乘上 `y.den`，再消去公共的 `y.den`。

引擎（`mulRep_den_swap` / `leRep_mul_den_right` / `leRep_cancel_den`）已在 ㊲–㊳ 判卷，收在 `lib/RatOrder`；本单元的律留在画布里。

㊴.1 等价的两边同乘一个正分母

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `mulRep_wd` 要求的是**序对字面量** `(a, b)` 之间的 `intRel`，而现在 `p`、`q` 是抽象变量。先用 `Prod.eta` 把 `p` 换成 `(fst p, snd p)`、把 `q` 换成 `(fst q, snd q)`（`Eq.subst` 四次：两次把假设搬进字面量、两次把结论搬回来），再用一次 `mulRep_wd`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `intRel p q → intRel (p·(n+1)) (q·(n+1))`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Prod.eta（两次）· Eq.subst（四次）· mulRep_wd（一次，乘数取 `(n+1, 0)`）。

exercises.template:
theorem scale_den (p q : Prod Nat Nat) (n : Nat) (h : intRel p q) :
    intRel (mulRep p (den n)) (mulRep q (den n)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem scale_den (p q : Prod Nat Nat) (n : Nat) (h : intRel p q) :
    intRel (mulRep p (den n)) (mulRep q (den n)) :=
  @Eq.subst.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
    (fun (y : Prod Nat Nat) =>
      intRel (mulRep p (den n)) (mulRep y (den n)))
    (@prod_mk Nat Nat (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q))
    q
    (Prod.eta Nat Nat q)
    (@Eq.subst.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
      (fun (x : Prod Nat Nat) =>
        intRel (mulRep x (den n))
          (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q)) (den n)))
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p))
      p
      (Prod.eta Nat Nat p)
      (mulRep_wd
        (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p)
        (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q)
        (Nat.succ n) Nat.zero
        (@Eq.subst.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
          (fun (y : Prod Nat Nat) =>
            intRel
              (@prod_mk Nat Nat (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p))
              y)
          q
          (@prod_mk Nat Nat (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q))
          (@Eq.symm.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
            (@prod_mk Nat Nat (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q))
            q
            (Prod.eta Nat Nat q))
          (@Eq.subst.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
            (fun (x : Prod Nat Nat) =>
              intRel x (@prod_mk Nat Nat (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q)))
            p
            (@prod_mk Nat Nat (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p))
            (@Eq.symm.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
              (@prod_mk Nat Nat (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p))
              p
              (Prod.eta Nat Nat p))
            h))))

exercises.unit: 单元㊴ 有理数的序与相等相容
exercises.name: ratLeRep_wd
exercises.title: ㊴.2 相等可替换：第一个因子
exercises.prompt: ㊴.2 相等可替换：第一个因子

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对目标用 `leRep_cancel_den`（消去 `x.den = m`）。内层先用 `leRep_mul_den_right` 把 `h` 两边乘上 `den m'`（`x'` 的分母），得到 `((x·dy)·dm', (y·dx)·dm')`。左端三段：`mulRep_den_swap` 把 `(x·dy)·dm'` 换成 `(x·dm')·dy`，㊴.1 把 `x ~ x'` 搬成 `(x·dm')·dy ~ (x'·dm)·dy`，再 `mulRep_den_swap` 换回 `(x'·dy)·dm`；右端一段：`mulRep_den_swap` 把 `(y·dx)·dm'` 换成 `(y·dm')·dx`。最后 `leRep_wd_pair` 把两条 `intRel` 链贴到 `leRep` 上。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `x ~ x' → x ≤ y → x' ≤ y`（`x`、`x'` 用 `qrep a b m` / `qrep a' b' m'` 展开）。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: leRep_cancel_den（k = m）· leRep_mul_den_right（k = m'）· mulRep_den_swap（三次）· scale_den · leRep_wd_pair。

exercises.template:
theorem ratLeRep_wd (a b a' b' c d m m' n : Nat)
    (hxx' : ratRel (qrep a b m) (qrep a' b' m'))
    (h : ratLeRep (qrep a b m) (qrep c d n)) :
    ratLeRep (qrep a' b' m') (qrep c d n) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratLeRep_wd (a b a' b' c d m m' n : Nat)
    (hxx' : ratRel (qrep a b m) (qrep a' b' m'))
    (h : ratLeRep (qrep a b m) (qrep c d n)) :
    ratLeRep (qrep a' b' m') (qrep c d n) :=
  leRep_cancel_den
    (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b') (den n))
    (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den m'))
    m
    (leRep_wd_pair
      (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den n)) (den m'))
      (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b') (den n)) (den m))
      (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den m)) (den m'))
      (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den m')) (den m))
      (intRel_trans
        (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den n)) (den m'))
        (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den m')) (den n))
        (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b') (den n)) (den m))
        (mulRep_den_swap a b n m')
        (intRel_trans
          (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den m')) (den n))
          (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b') (den m)) (den n))
          (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b') (den n)) (den m))
          (scale_den (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den m'))
                     (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b') (den m)) n hxx')
          (mulRep_den_swap a' b' m n)))
      (mulRep_den_swap c d m m')
      (leRep_mul_den_right
        (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den n))
        (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den m))
        m' h))

exercises.name: ratLeRep_wd_snd
exercises.title: ㊴.3 相等可替换：第二个因子
exercises.prompt: ㊴.3 相等可替换：第二个因子

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 与 ㊴.2 同构，但这次换的是右边那个数。对目标消去 `y.den = n`；`h` 两边乘 `y'.den = n'`。左端：`mulRep_den_swap` 把 `(x·dn)·dn'` 换成 `(x·dn')·dn`。右端三段：`mulRep_den_swap` 把 `(y·dm)·dn'` 换成 `(y·dn')·dm`，㊴.1 把 `y ~ y'`（乘 `m`）搬成 `(y·dn')·dm ~ (y'·dn)·dm`，再 `mulRep_den_swap` 换回 `(y'·dm)·dn`。最后 `leRep_wd_pair`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: leRep_cancel_den（k = n）· leRep_mul_den_right（k = n'）· mulRep_den_swap（三次）· scale_den · leRep_wd_pair。

exercises.template:
theorem ratLeRep_wd_snd (a b c d c' d' m n n' : Nat)
    (hyy' : ratRel (qrep c d n) (qrep c' d' n'))
    (h : ratLeRep (qrep a b m) (qrep c d n)) :
    ratLeRep (qrep a b m) (qrep c' d' n') :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratLeRep_wd_snd (a b c d c' d' m n n' : Nat)
    (hyy' : ratRel (qrep c d n) (qrep c' d' n'))
    (h : ratLeRep (qrep a b m) (qrep c d n)) :
    ratLeRep (qrep a b m) (qrep c' d' n') :=
  leRep_cancel_den
    (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den n'))
    (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c' d') (den m))
    n
    (leRep_wd_pair
      (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den n)) (den n'))
      (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den n')) (den n))
      (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den m)) (den n'))
      (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c' d') (den m)) (den n))
      (mulRep_den_swap a b n n')
      (intRel_trans
        (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den m)) (den n'))
        (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den n')) (den m))
        (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c' d') (den m)) (den n))
        (mulRep_den_swap c d m n')
        (intRel_trans
          (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den n')) (den m))
          (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c' d') (den n)) (den m))
          (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c' d') (den m)) (den n))
          (scale_den (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den n'))
                     (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c' d') (den n)) m hyy')
          (mulRep_den_swap c' d' n m)))
      (leRep_mul_den_right
        (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den n))
        (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den m))
        n' h))

exercises.unit: 单元㊵ 实数的相等：自反性
exercises.name: cauchy_close_self
exercises.title: 单元㊵ 实数的相等：自反性
exercises.prompt:
单元㊵ 实数的相等：自反性

㊱ 把实数定义成 Cauchy 序列的商：

realRel x y :⟺ Cauchy x ∧ Cauchy y ∧ ∀ eps > 0, ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, close (x n) (y n) eps Real := Quot realRel

要让 `Real` 上的相等成为一个**等价关系**，需要三条腿：自反、对称、传递。 本单元结清第一条——**自反性**：

Cauchy x ⟹ realRel x x

关键观察只有一句话：`realRel x x` 的第三分量要求「x 的两项最终任意接近」， 而 `Cauchy x` 给的正是**任意两项**（`∀ n m ≥ N`）都接近；取 `m = n` 就是 对角线情形。所以自反性不需要任何新的算术，只需要把量词用对。

对称性要 `close` 对调（需要 `|x−y| ~ |y−x|` 的引擎），传递性要三角不等式， 都留到后续单元。

㊵.1 Cauchy 序列的对角线

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把 `hx eps h` 消去，得到 `∃ N, ∀ n m ≥ N, close (x n) (x m) eps`；对同一个 `N`，把 `n`、`m` 两个位置都填 `n`（同一个 `hn` 用两次）。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Cauchy x → ∀ eps > 0, ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, close (x n) (x n) eps`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.elim · Exists.intro。

exercises.template:
theorem cauchy_close_self (x : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) :
    ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
      ∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n → close (x n) (x n) eps :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem cauchy_close_self (x : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) :
    ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
      ∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n → close (x n) (x n) eps :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (h : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (hx eps h)
      (fun (N : Nat) (hN : ∀ (n m : Nat), LeNat N n → LeNat N m → close (x n) (x m) eps) =>
        Exists.intro N
          (fun (n : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) => hN n n hn hn))

exercises.name: realRel_refl
exercises.title: ㊵.2 realRel 是自反的
exercises.prompt: ㊵.2 realRel 是自反的

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `realRel` 是三元组；两个 `Cauchy` 分量都是 `hx`，第三分量正是 ㊵.1。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Cauchy x → realRel x x`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: And.intro（两次）· cauchy_close_self。

exercises.template:
theorem realRel_refl (x : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) : realRel x x :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem realRel_refl (x : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) : realRel x x :=
  And.intro hx (And.intro hx (cauchy_close_self x hx))

exercises.prompt:
单元㊶ 取负与序：绝对值的对称性

㉛ 给了 ℚ 的取负 `ratNegRep`（交换分子序对，分母不动），㊴ 给了序对相等代表元的 替换律 `ratLeRep_wd` / `ratLeRep_wd_snd`。本单元把「序」与「取负」接上：

x ≤ y ⟹ -y ≤ -x （㊶.2，序被取负反转） |x| ~ y ⟹ |-x| ~ y （㊶.3，绝对值对取负不变）

这两条是单元㊷「`close` 的对称性」的引擎：`close x y eps` 说的是 「`x - y` 的绝对值小于 eps」，要换成 `close y x eps`，就要把 `y - x` 看成 `-(x - y)`，再用 ㊶.3 把绝对值里的负号去掉。

㊶.1 先把反转律在**字面三元组** `qrep a b m` 上做掉：这时 `ratLeRep` 展开成

LeNat (a·(n+1) + d·(m+1)) (c·(m+1) + b·(n+1))

而 `-y ≤ -x` 展开成 `LeNat (d·(m+1) + a·(n+1)) (b·(n+1) + c·(m+1))`， 差别只是两个加法交换。㊶.2 再把字面形式搬到任意 `ratRep` 上。

本单元不引入新定义；`ratRel_symm` / `ratRel_trans_gen` / `ratNegRep_invol` 的通用形式已收在 `lib/Cauchy`（它们分别是 ㉐ / ㉕ / ㉛ 已判卷事实的包装）。

㊶.1 取负反转序（字面形式）

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先用 `leRep_wd_pair` + `mulRep_den_form` 把 `h` 化成干净序对上的 `LeNat (a(n+1)+d(m+1)) (c(m+1)+b(n+1))`；再用两次 `add_comm` 把它变成 `LeNat (d(m+1)+a(n+1)) (b(n+1)+c(m+1))`（一次换左边、一次换右边）；最后用 `leRep_wd_pair` + `mulRep_den_form` 的对称把干净序对贴回 `mulRep … (den …)`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratLeRep (qrep a b m) (qrep c d n) → ratLeRep (qrep d c n) (qrep b a m)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: mulRep_den_form · leRep_wd_pair · intRel_of_eq · add_comm · Eq.subst。

exercises.template:
theorem ratLeRep_neg_lit (a b c d m n : Nat)
    (h : ratLeRep (qrep a b m) (qrep c d n)) :
    ratLeRep (qrep d c n) (qrep b a m) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratLeRep_neg_lit (a b c d m n : Nat)
    (h : ratLeRep (qrep a b m) (qrep c d n)) :
    ratLeRep (qrep d c n) (qrep b a m) :=
  leRep_wd_pair
    (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul d (Nat.succ m)) (myMul c (Nat.succ m)))
    (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat d c) (den m))
    (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul b (Nat.succ n)) (myMul a (Nat.succ n)))
    (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat b a) (den n))
    (intRel_of_eq
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul d (Nat.succ m)) (myMul c (Nat.succ m)))
      (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat d c) (den m))
      (Eq.symm (mulRep_den_form (@prod_mk Nat Nat d c) m)))
    (intRel_of_eq
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul b (Nat.succ n)) (myMul a (Nat.succ n)))
      (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat b a) (den n))
      (Eq.symm (mulRep_den_form (@prod_mk Nat Nat b a) n)))
    (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
      (fun (x : Nat) =>
        LeNat x (Nat.add (myMul b (Nat.succ n)) (myMul c (Nat.succ m))))
      (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ n)) (myMul d (Nat.succ m)))
      (Nat.add (myMul d (Nat.succ m)) (myMul a (Nat.succ n)))
      (add_comm (myMul a (Nat.succ n)) (myMul d (Nat.succ m)))
      (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
        (fun (x : Nat) =>
          LeNat (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ n)) (myMul d (Nat.succ m))) x)
        (Nat.add (myMul c (Nat.succ m)) (myMul b (Nat.succ n)))
        (Nat.add (myMul b (Nat.succ n)) (myMul c (Nat.succ m)))
        (add_comm (myMul c (Nat.succ m)) (myMul b (Nat.succ n)))
        (leRep_wd_pair
          (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den n))
          (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul a (Nat.succ n)) (myMul b (Nat.succ n)))
          (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den m))
          (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul c (Nat.succ m)) (myMul d (Nat.succ m)))
          (intRel_of_eq
            (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den n))
            (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul a (Nat.succ n)) (myMul b (Nat.succ n)))
            (mulRep_den_form (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) n))
          (intRel_of_eq
            (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den m))
            (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul c (Nat.succ m)) (myMul d (Nat.succ m)))
            (mulRep_den_form (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) m))
          h)))

exercises.unit: 单元㊷ close 的对称性：实数的相等可以换方向
exercises.name: ratSubRep_neg
exercises.title: 单元㊷ `close` 的对称性：实数的相等可以换方向
exercises.prompt:
单元㊷ `close` 的对称性：实数的相等可以换方向

㊱ 把实数的相等定义成

realRel x y :⟺ Cauchy x ∧ Cauchy y ∧ ∀ eps > 0, ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, close (x n) (y n) eps

其中 `close x y eps` 说的是「`x - y` 的绝对值 < eps」：

close x y eps :⟺ ∃ d, |x - y| ~ d ∧ d < eps

㊵ 结清了自反性；要和它凑成等价关系，还差**对称性**：

close x y eps ⟹ close y x eps realRel x y ⟹ realRel y x

直觉上「`y - x` 与 `x - y` 只差一个负号，绝对值一样」，但代表元层要真的搬过去：

① `y - x` 的代表元与 `-(x - y)` 的代表元**不同**：`ratSubRep y x` 的分母字段 是 `ratDenRep n m`，`ratNegRep (ratSubRep x y)` 的是 `ratDenRep m n`。 两者相等靠新收进 `lib/Rat` 的 `ratDenRep_comm`（分母字段换位）。这就是 ㊷.1。 ② 绝对值对取负不变是 ㊶ 的 `ratAbsRel_neg`（通用版本 `ratAbsRel_neg_gen`）；但要把它从 `-(x - y)` 搬到 `y - x`，还需要「`ratAbsRel` 只依赖第一个因子的等价类」：㊷.2。 ③ 把 ①② 拼起来就是 `close` 的对称性（㊷.3）；逐点作用到 `realRel` 上 就是实数相等的对称性（㊷.4）。

本单元不引入新定义。序的通用替换律（㊴ 两条律的任意代表元版本）收在 `lib/RatOrder`：`ratLeRep_congr`（换第一个因子）与 `ratLeRep_congr_snd`（换第二个）。

㊷.1 减法的反交换：`y - x ~ -(x - y)`

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 两边都先用 `ratSubRep_mk` 展开成字面三元组。左边是 `qrep (c(m+1)+b(n+1)) (d(m+1)+a(n+1)) (ratDenRep n m)`；右边的 `ratNegRep` 只是交换分子序对，定义性给出 `qrep (b(n+1)+c(m+1)) (a(n+1)+d(m+1)) (ratDenRep m n)`。于是两边的分子只差两次 `add_comm`、分母只差 `ratDenRep_comm`。先把这两个等式写成 `qrep … = qrep …`（`prod_mk_congr` + `congrArg` + `Eq.trans`），再用 `Eq.subst` 把 `ratRel_refl` 从右边三元组搬到左边。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel (ratSubRep y x) (ratNegRep (ratSubRep x y))`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratSubRep_mk · ratDenRep_comm · add_comm · prod_mk_congr · congrArg · Eq.trans · Eq.subst · ratRel_refl。`ratRep` 是定义别名，最后用 `match` 在 `Prod (Prod Nat Nat) Nat` 上搬到任意代表元。

exercises.template:
theorem ratSubRep_neg (x y : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratSubRep y x) (ratNegRep (ratSubRep x y)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratSubRep_neg (x y : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratSubRep y x) (ratNegRep (ratSubRep x y)) :=
  ratSubRep_neg_aux x y

exercises.name: ratAbsRel_wd_left
exercises.title: ㊷.2 `ratAbsRel` 只依赖第一个因子的等价类
exercises.prompt: ㊷.2 `ratAbsRel` 只依赖第一个因子的等价类

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `ratAbsRel u d` 是两个分支的析取。第一分支 `0 ≤ u ∧ d ~ u` 要落到第一分支：`0 ≤ u` 用 `ratLeRep_congr_snd` 把第二个因子换成 `v`（`0 ≤ v`），`d ~ u` 再用 `ratRel_trans_gen` 沿 `u ~ v` 换成 `d ~ v`。第二分支 `u ≤ 0 ∧ d ~ -u` 要落到第二分支：`u ≤ 0` 用 `ratLeRep_congr` 把**第一个**因子换成 `v`（`v ≤ 0`），`d ~ -v` 由 `d ~ -u` 与 `-u ~ -v`（`ratNegRep_wd`）经 `ratRel_trans_gen` 串起来。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel u v → ratAbsRel u d → ratAbsRel v d`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Or.elim · ratLeRep_congr（换第一个因子）· ratLeRep_congr_snd（换第二个因子）· ratNegRep_wd · ratRel_trans_gen · match（在展开类型上消去 u、v）。

  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratAbsRel_wd_left (u v : ratRep) (d : ratRep)
    (h : ratRel u v) (hab : ratAbsRel u d) : ratAbsRel v d :=
  ratAbsRel_wd_left_aux u v d h hab

exercises.unit: 单元㊷ close 的对称性：实数的相等可以换方向
exercises.name: close_symm
exercises.title: ㊷.3 `close` 的对称性
exercises.prompt: ㊷.3 `close` 的对称性

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把 `close x y eps` 拆成 `∃ d, |x-y| ~ d ∧ d < eps`，用同一个 `d` 造 `close y x eps`。第一分量：㊶ 的 `ratAbsRel_neg`（通用版本 `ratAbsRel_neg_gen`） 把 `|x-y| ~ d` 变成 `|-(x-y)| ~ d`，再用 ㊷.2 沿 `ratRel (-(x-y)) (y-x)`（㊷.1 取对称）搬到 `|y-x| ~ d`；第二分量 `d < eps` 原样。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `close x y eps → close y x eps`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.elim · Exists.intro · ratAbsRel_neg_gen · ratAbsRel_wd_left · ratSubRep_neg · ratRel_symm。

exercises.template:
theorem close_symm (x y eps : ratRep) (h : close x y eps) :
    close y x eps :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem close_symm (x y eps : ratRep) (h : close x y eps) :
    close y x eps :=
  Exists.elim h
    (fun (d : ratRep)
         (hd : ratAbsRel (ratSubRep x y) d ∧ ratLtRep d eps) =>
      Exists.intro d
        (And.intro
          (ratAbsRel_wd_left
            (ratNegRep (ratSubRep x y))
            (ratSubRep y x)
            d
            (ratRel_symm
              (ratSubRep y x)
              (ratNegRep (ratSubRep x y))
              (ratSubRep_neg x y))
            (ratAbsRel_neg_gen (ratSubRep x y) d (And.left hd)))
          (And.right hd)))

exercises.title: ㊷.4 实数相等的对称性
exercises.prompt: ㊷.4 实数相等的对称性

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `realRel x y` 是 `Cauchy x ∧ Cauchy y ∧ 逐点 close`。`realRel y x` 只要把两个 `Cauchy` 分量对调，第三分量在每个 `n` 上调用 ㊷.3 把 `close (x n) (y n) eps` 翻成 `close (y n) (x n) eps`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `realRel x y → realRel y x`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: And.intro · And.left · And.right · Exists.elim · Exists.intro · close_symm。

exercises.template:
theorem realRel_symm (x y : Seq) (h : realRel x y) : realRel y x :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem realRel_symm (x y : Seq) (h : realRel x y) : realRel y x :=
  And.intro
    (And.left (And.right h))
    (And.intro
      (And.left h)
      (realRel_close_symm x y (And.right (And.right h))))

exercises.chapter_title: 有理 Cauchy 序列与实数的载体
exercises.unit: 单元㊸ 有理数加法的代表元律：交换与零元
exercises.name: ratAdd_zero_num
exercises.title: 单元㊸ 有理数加法的代表元律：交换与零元
exercises.prompt:
单元㊸ 有理数加法的代表元律：交换与零元

㉖ 立了 ℚ 加法的代表元公式

(a-b)/(m+1) + (c-d)/(n+1) = [a(n+1)+c(m+1) - (b(n+1)+d(m+1))] / ((m+1)(n+1))

并结清了两条良定义义务；但**运算律**还没证。本单元结清两条：

x + y ~ y + x （㊸.3） x + 0 ~ x （㊸.4） 0 + x ~ x （㊸.5，由交换律与 ㊸.4）

为什么先做这两条：下一单元的「序与加法相容」要把 `x ≤ y` 搬到 `x + z ≤ y + z`， 而**左**加（`z + x ≤ z + y`）靠的是「先交换、用右加、再交换回来」—— 没有 ㊸.3 就无法把右加版本变成左加版本。

证明路线：

㊸.1 / ㊸.2 是加零的**算术小件**：`a·1` 定义性展开成 `a + a*0`，`a*0 = 0` 再 `add_zero` 消掉；分母 `ratDenRep m 0 = (m*0 + m) + 0` 同理退化成 `m`。

㊸.3 在**代表元层**比较：`x + y` 与 `y + x` 的分子只差两次 `add_comm`， 分母只差 `ratDenRep_comm`。所以先把两边都用 `mulRep_den_form` 化成 「分子 × 正分母」的规范形（`ratRel` 的交叉乘积），再用 `prod_mk_congr` + `congrArg` 把两个规范形证成**相等**，最后 `intRel_of_eq`。

㊸.4 先把 `x + 0` 这个**三元组**搬成 `qrep a b m`（㊸.1/㊸.2 消掉零项）， 再用 `ratRel_refl`。

㊸.5 是 `ratRel` 的传递链：`0 + x ~ x + 0`（㊸.3）→ `x`（㊸.4）。

㊸.6 是具体计算：`1/2 + 1/3` 的代表元公式定义性归约成 `5/6 = qrep 5 0 5`。

写法提醒：`ratRep` 是 `Prod (Prod Nat Nat) Nat` 的**定义别名**，`match` 只认 归纳类型本身。所以通用陈述（㊸.3–㊸.5）要先在一个 `_aux`（展开类型上的） 定理里 match 到字面三元组，再把字面结果转发给通用陈述 —— ㊷ 的 `ratSubRep_neg_aux` 就是同一个写法。

㊸.1 加零的分子形状：`a·1 + 0·(m+1) = a`

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `myMul a (succ 0)` 定义性展开成 `a + a*0`；`myMul_zero a` 把 `a*0` 换成 `0`，`add_zero` 消掉 `+0` 得 `a`。第二个加数 `0*(m+1)` 用 `zero_mul` 换成 `0`，再用一次 `add_zero`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ Nat.zero)) (myMul Nat.zero (Nat.succ m)) = a`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: myMul_succ · myMul_zero · zero_mul · add_zero · congrArg · Eq.trans。

exercises.template:
theorem ratAdd_zero_num (a m : Nat) :
    Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ Nat.zero)) (myMul Nat.zero (Nat.succ m)) = a :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratAdd_zero_num (a m : Nat) :
    Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ Nat.zero)) (myMul Nat.zero (Nat.succ m)) = a :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ Nat.zero)) (myMul Nat.zero (Nat.succ m)))
    (Nat.add (Nat.add a Nat.zero) (myMul Nat.zero (Nat.succ m)))
    a
    (congrArg.{1}
      (fun (Z : Nat) => Nat.add Z (myMul Nat.zero (Nat.succ m)))
      (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (myMul a (Nat.succ Nat.zero))
        (Nat.add a (myMul a Nat.zero))
        (Nat.add a Nat.zero)
        (myMul_succ a Nat.zero)
        (congrArg.{1} (fun (Z : Nat) => Nat.add a Z) (myMul_zero a))))
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (Nat.add (Nat.add a Nat.zero) (myMul Nat.zero (Nat.succ m)))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add a Nat.zero) Nat.zero)
      a
      (congrArg.{1}
        (fun (Z : Nat) => Nat.add (Nat.add a Nat.zero) Z)
        (zero_mul (Nat.succ m)))
      (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add (Nat.add a Nat.zero) Nat.zero)
        (Nat.add a Nat.zero)
        a
        (add_zero (Nat.add a Nat.zero))
        (add_zero a)))

exercises.title: ㊸.2 加零的分母形状：`ratDenRep m 0 = m`
exercises.prompt: ㊸.2 加零的分母形状：`ratDenRep m 0 = m`

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `ratDenRep m 0` 定义性展开成 `(m*0 + m) + 0`。`myMul_zero m` 把 `m*0` 换成 `0`，`zero_add m` 把 `0 + m` 换成 `m`，最后 `add_zero m` 消掉尾巴。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratDenRep m Nat.zero = m`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: myMul_zero · zero_add · add_zero · congrArg · Eq.trans。

exercises.template:
theorem ratAdd_zero_den (m : Nat) : ratDenRep m Nat.zero = m :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratAdd_zero_den (m : Nat) : ratDenRep m Nat.zero = m :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (ratDenRep m Nat.zero)
    (Nat.add (Nat.add Nat.zero m) Nat.zero)
    m
    (congrArg.{1}
      (fun (Z : Nat) => Nat.add (Nat.add Z m) Nat.zero)
      (myMul_zero m))
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (Nat.add (Nat.add Nat.zero m) Nat.zero)
      (Nat.add m Nat.zero)
      m
      (congrArg.{1}
        (fun (Z : Nat) => Nat.add Z Nat.zero)
        (zero_add m))
      (add_zero m))

exercises.unit: 单元㊹ 序与加法相容：x ≤ y ⇒ x + z ≤ y + z
exercises.name: mulRep_add
exercises.title: 单元㊳ 结清了序的传递性，㊴ 结清了序与**相等**相容；但要把序用在 Cauchy 的三角不等式上，还差一条**与加法**相容：
exercises.prompt:
单元㊳ 结清了序的传递性，㊴ 结清了序与**相等**相容；但要把序用在 Cauchy 的三角不等式上，还差一条**与加法**相容：

x ≤ y ⟹ x + z ≤ y + z （㊹.4，右加）

证明路线（把两边换到同一个公分母上比较）：

设 x = a/(m+1)、y = c/(n+1)、z = e/(k+1)。`x ≤ y` 交叉相乘后是

a(n+1) + d(m+1) ≤ c(m+1) + b(n+1) （h）

`x + z` 与 `y + z` 的分母分别是 (m+1)(k+1) 与 (n+1)(k+1)；交叉相乘再 乘开，两边都带公共正因子 (k+1) 与同一块 z 的贡献（由加法交换对齐）， 消去后剩下的正是「h 两边同乘 (k+1)」，所以

· ㊹.1 先证 `mulRep` 对 `addRep` 的分配律（分子层面的展开）； · ㊹.2 把 `den (ratDenRep m n)` 换成 `mulRep (den m) (den n)` （分母层面的乘积），两个正分母就能搬到最外层； · ㊹.3 证 `addRep` 保 `intRel`（把两个加数的等价搬运拼起来）； · ㊹.4 主定理：把 `leNum` 层层化到「h 两边乘 (k+1)」，再用 ㊲ 的 `leRep_mul_den_right` / `leRep_add_right` 收口。

写法提醒：`ratRep` 是 `Prod (Prod Nat Nat) Nat` 的定义别名，`match` 只认 归纳类型本身；所以通用包装（`_gen` 系列）都先 match 到字面坐标再转发给 `lib/Rat` 里只有字面坐标版本的引理 —— 与 ㊷/㊸ 的 `_aux` 同一写法。

㊹.1 `mulRep` 对 `addRep` 的分配律

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 在字面坐标 `(a,b)`、`(c,d)`、`(e,f)` 上 match。`mulRep (addRep p q) r` 的两个坐标分别是 `(a+c)e + (b+d)f` 与 `(a+c)f + (b+d)e`；用 `mul_add_right` 各展开成两组乘积之和，再用 `add4` 把配对换成 `addRep (mulRep p r) (mulRep q r)` 的两组和。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `mulRep (addRep p q) r = addRep (mulRep p r) (mulRep q r)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: mul_add_right · add_congr · add4 · prod_mk_congr · Eq.trans。

exercises.template:
theorem mulRep_add (p q r : Prod Nat Nat) :
    mulRep (addRep p q) r = addRep (mulRep p r) (mulRep q r) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem mulRep_add (p q r : Prod Nat Nat) :
    mulRep (addRep p q) r = addRep (mulRep p r) (mulRep q r) :=
  match p with
  | prod_mk a b =>
    match q with
    | prod_mk c d =>
      match r with
      | prod_mk e f =>
        prod_mk_congr
          (Nat.add (myMul (Nat.add a c) e) (myMul (Nat.add b d) f))
          (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a e) (myMul b f))
                   (Nat.add (myMul c e) (myMul d f)))
          (Nat.add (myMul (Nat.add a c) f) (myMul (Nat.add b d) e))
          (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a f) (myMul b e))
                   (Nat.add (myMul c f) (myMul d e)))
          (Eq.trans
            (add_congr (mul_add_right a c e) (mul_add_right b d f))
            (add4 (myMul a e) (myMul c e) (myMul b f) (myMul d f)))
          (Eq.trans
            (add_congr (mul_add_right a c f) (mul_add_right b d e))
            (add4 (myMul a f) (myMul c f) (myMul b e) (myMul d e)))

exercises.name: mulRep_den_den_gen
exercises.title: ㊹.2 分母的乘积：`den (ratDenRep m n)` 与 `mulRep (den m) (den n)`
exercises.prompt: ㊹.2 分母的乘积：`den (ratDenRep m n)` 与 `mulRep (den m) (den n)`

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `mulRep_den_den` 给出 `mulRep (den m) (den n) ~ ((m+1)(n+1), 0)`；`den (ratDenRep m n)` 的两个坐标是 `(succ (ratDenRep m n), 0)`，而 `ratDenRep_succ` 恰好说 `succ (ratDenRep m n) = (m+1)(n+1)`。用 `congrArg` 把第二个序对的坐标换掉，再把两段用 `intRel_trans` 串起来。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `intRel (mulRep (den m) (den n)) (den (ratDenRep m n))`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: mulRep_den_den · ratDenRep_succ · congrArg · intRel_of_eq · intRel_trans。

exercises.template:
theorem mulRep_den_den_gen (m n : Nat) :
    intRel (mulRep (den m) (den n)) (den (ratDenRep m n)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem mulRep_den_den_gen (m n : Nat) :
    intRel (mulRep (den m) (den n)) (den (ratDenRep m n)) :=
  intRel_trans
    (mulRep (den m) (den n))
    (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ n)) Nat.zero)
    (den (ratDenRep m n))
    (mulRep_den_den m n)
    (intRel_of_eq
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ n)) Nat.zero)
      (den (ratDenRep m n))
      (Eq.symm
        (congrArg (fun (x : Nat) => @prod_mk Nat Nat x Nat.zero)
          (ratDenRep_succ m n))))
