exercises.unit: 单元㊹ 序与加法相容：x ≤ y ⇒ x + z ≤ y + z
exercises.name: intRel_add
exercises.title: ㊹.3 `addRep` 保持 `intRel`
exercises.prompt: ㊹.3 `addRep` 保持 `intRel`

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `intRel p p'` 是 `p₁+p'₂ = p'₁+p₂`，`intRel q q'` 是 `q₁+q'₂ = q'₁+q₂`。两条各用 `add_congr` 相加得 `(p₁+p'₂)+(q₁+q'₂) = (p'₁+p₂)+(q'₁+q₂)`，两边各用一次 `add4` 换成 `(p₁+q₁)+(p'₂+q'₂)` 与 `(p'₁+q'₁)+(p₂+q₂)` —— 正是 `intRel (addRep p q) (addRep p' q')` 展开后的两边。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `intRel p p' → intRel q q' → intRel (addRep p q) (addRep p' q')`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: add_congr · add4（两次，其中一次取对称）· Eq.trans。

exercises.template:
theorem intRel_add (p p' q q' : Prod Nat Nat) :
    intRel p p' → intRel q q' → intRel (addRep p q) (addRep p' q') :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem intRel_add (p p' q q' : Prod Nat Nat) :
    intRel p p' → intRel q q' → intRel (addRep p q) (addRep p' q') :=
  match p with
  | prod_mk a b =>
    match p' with
    | prod_mk a' b' =>
      match q with
      | prod_mk c d =>
        match q' with
        | prod_mk c' d' =>
          fun (h1 : Nat.add a b' = Nat.add a' b)
              (h2 : Nat.add c d' = Nat.add c' d) =>
            Eq.trans
              (Eq.symm (add4 a b' c d'))
              (Eq.trans
                (add_congr h1 h2)
                (add4 a' b c' d))

exercises.chapter_title: 有理 Cauchy 序列与实数的载体
exercises.unit: 单元㊹ 序与加法相容：x ≤ y ⇒ x + z ≤ y + z
exercises.name: ratLeRep_add_right
exercises.title: ㊹.4 主定理：序与右加相容
exercises.prompt: ㊹.4 主定理：序与右加相容

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把 `ratLeRep (x+z) (y+z)` 写成 `leRep (leNum …) (leNum …)`。用 ㊹.1 把 `leNum (x+z) (y+z)` 的第一因子拆成两个乘好分母的分子之和（`ratAddRep` 的分子比这个 `addRep` 只多两个 `+0`，用 `zero_add` 消掉），再用 ㊹.2 与 `mulRep_den_swap` 把 x 的项搬成 `(leNum x y)·dz·dz`、y 的项搬成 `(leNum y x)·dz·dz`，z 的两项经分母交换后是**同一块**，交给 `leRep_add_right` 当公共加数。最后 `ratLeRep x y` 两边各乘两次 `den z`（`leRep_mul_den_right`）就是前提。`lib/Rat` 的乘法律只有字面坐标版本，先在展开类型上 match 包装成 `_gen` 通用版（`mulRep_wd_gen` / `mulRep_assoc_gen` / `mulRep_den_swap_gen` / `leRep_add_right_gen`）。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratLeRep x y → ratLeRep (ratAddRep x z) (ratAddRep y z)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: leRep_wd_pair · intRel_of_eq · mulRep_add · numOf_ratAddRep · mulRep_den_ratDenRep · mulRep_den_swap_gen · intRel_add · leRep_add_right_gen · leRep_mul_den_right（两次）。

exercises.template:
theorem ratLeRep_add_right (x y z : ratRep)
    (h : ratLeRep x y) : ratLeRep (ratAddRep x z) (ratAddRep y z) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratLeRep_add_right (x y z : ratRep)
    (h : ratLeRep x y) : ratLeRep (ratAddRep x z) (ratAddRep y z) :=
  leRep_wd_pair
    (addRep
      (mulRep (mulRep (leNum x y) (den (denOf z))) (den (denOf z)))
      (mulRep (leNum z y) (den (denOf (ratAddRep x z)))))
    (leNum (ratAddRep x z) (ratAddRep y z))
    (addRep
      (mulRep (mulRep (leNum y x) (den (denOf z))) (den (denOf z)))
      (mulRep (leNum z y) (den (denOf (ratAddRep x z)))))
    (leNum (ratAddRep y z) (ratAddRep x z))
    (intRel_symm
      (leNum (ratAddRep x z) (ratAddRep y z))
      (addRep
        (mulRep (mulRep (leNum x y) (den (denOf z))) (den (denOf z)))
        (mulRep (leNum z y) (den (denOf (ratAddRep x z)))))
      (intRel_trans
        (leNum (ratAddRep x z) (ratAddRep y z))
      (addRep
        (mulRep (mulRep (numOf x) (den (denOf z)))
                (den (denOf (ratAddRep y z))))
        (mulRep (leNum z x) (den (denOf (ratAddRep y z)))))
      (addRep
        (mulRep (mulRep (leNum x y) (den (denOf z))) (den (denOf z)))
        (mulRep (leNum z y) (den (denOf (ratAddRep x z)))))
      (intRel_of_eq
        (leNum (ratAddRep x z) (ratAddRep y z))
        (addRep
          (mulRep (mulRep (numOf x) (den (denOf z)))
                  (den (denOf (ratAddRep y z))))
          (mulRep (mulRep (numOf z) (den (denOf x)))
                  (den (denOf (ratAddRep y z)))))
        (Eq.trans
          (congrArg
            (fun (p : Prod Nat Nat) =>
              mulRep p (den (denOf (ratAddRep y z))))
            (numOf_ratAddRep x z))
          (mulRep_add
            (mulRep (numOf x) (den (denOf z)))
            (mulRep (numOf z) (den (denOf x)))
            (den (denOf (ratAddRep y z))))))
      (intRel_add
        (mulRep (mulRep (numOf x) (den (denOf z)))
                (den (denOf (ratAddRep y z))))
        (mulRep (mulRep (leNum x y) (den (denOf z))) (den (denOf z)))
        (mulRep (mulRep (numOf z) (den (denOf x)))
                (den (denOf (ratAddRep y z))))
        (mulRep (leNum z y) (den (denOf (ratAddRep x z))))
        (intRel_trans
          (mulRep (mulRep (numOf x) (den (denOf z)))
                  (den (denOf (ratAddRep y z))))
          (mulRep (mulRep (mulRep (numOf x) (den (denOf z)))
                          (den (denOf y)))
                  (den (denOf z)))
          (mulRep (mulRep (leNum x y) (den (denOf z))) (den (denOf z)))
          (mulRep_den_ratDenRep (mulRep (numOf x) (den (denOf z)))
            (denOf y) (denOf z))
          (mulRep_wd_gen
            (mulRep (mulRep (numOf x) (den (denOf z))) (den (denOf y)))
            (mulRep (leNum x y) (den (denOf z)))
            (den (denOf z))
            (mulRep_den_swap_gen (numOf x) (denOf z) (denOf y))))
        (intRel_trans
          (mulRep (mulRep (numOf z) (den (denOf x)))
                  (den (denOf (ratAddRep y z))))
          (mulRep (mulRep (mulRep (numOf z) (den (denOf x)))
                          (den (denOf y)))
                  (den (denOf z)))
          (mulRep (leNum z y) (den (denOf (ratAddRep x z))))
          (mulRep_den_ratDenRep (mulRep (numOf z) (den (denOf x)))
            (denOf y) (denOf z))
          (intRel_trans
            (mulRep (mulRep (mulRep (numOf z) (den (denOf x)))
                            (den (denOf y)))
                    (den (denOf z)))
            (mulRep (mulRep (leNum z y) (den (denOf x))) (den (denOf z)))
            (mulRep (leNum z y) (den (denOf (ratAddRep x z))))
            (mulRep_wd_gen
              (mulRep (mulRep (numOf z) (den (denOf x))) (den (denOf y)))
              (mulRep (leNum z y) (den (denOf x)))
              (den (denOf z))
              (mulRep_den_swap_gen (numOf z) (denOf x) (denOf y)))
            (intRel_symm
              (mulRep (leNum z y) (den (denOf (ratAddRep x z))))
              (mulRep (mulRep (leNum z y) (den (denOf x)))
                      (den (denOf z)))
              (mulRep_den_ratDenRep (leNum z y) (denOf x) (denOf z))))))))
    (intRel_symm
      (leNum (ratAddRep y z) (ratAddRep x z))
      (addRep
        (mulRep (mulRep (leNum y x) (den (denOf z))) (den (denOf z)))
        (mulRep (leNum z y) (den (denOf (ratAddRep x z)))))
      (intRel_trans
        (leNum (ratAddRep y z) (ratAddRep x z))
      (addRep
        (mulRep (mulRep (numOf y) (den (denOf z)))
                (den (denOf (ratAddRep x z))))
        (mulRep (leNum z y) (den (denOf (ratAddRep x z)))))
      (addRep
        (mulRep (mulRep (leNum y x) (den (denOf z))) (den (denOf z)))
        (mulRep (leNum z y) (den (denOf (ratAddRep x z)))))
      (intRel_of_eq
        (leNum (ratAddRep y z) (ratAddRep x z))
        (addRep
          (mulRep (mulRep (numOf y) (den (denOf z)))
                  (den (denOf (ratAddRep x z))))
          (mulRep (mulRep (numOf z) (den (denOf y)))
                  (den (denOf (ratAddRep x z)))))
        (Eq.trans
          (congrArg
            (fun (p : Prod Nat Nat) =>
              mulRep p (den (denOf (ratAddRep x z))))
            (numOf_ratAddRep y z))
          (mulRep_add
            (mulRep (numOf y) (den (denOf z)))
            (mulRep (numOf z) (den (denOf y)))
            (den (denOf (ratAddRep x z))))))
      (intRel_add
        (mulRep (mulRep (numOf y) (den (denOf z)))
                (den (denOf (ratAddRep x z))))
        (mulRep (mulRep (leNum y x) (den (denOf z))) (den (denOf z)))
        (mulRep (leNum z y) (den (denOf (ratAddRep x z))))
        (mulRep (leNum z y) (den (denOf (ratAddRep x z))))
        (intRel_trans
          (mulRep (mulRep (numOf y) (den (denOf z)))
                  (den (denOf (ratAddRep x z))))
          (mulRep (mulRep (mulRep (numOf y) (den (denOf z)))
                          (den (denOf x)))
                  (den (denOf z)))
          (mulRep (mulRep (leNum y x) (den (denOf z))) (den (denOf z)))
          (mulRep_den_ratDenRep (mulRep (numOf y) (den (denOf z)))
            (denOf x) (denOf z))
          (mulRep_wd_gen
            (mulRep (mulRep (numOf y) (den (denOf z))) (den (denOf x)))
            (mulRep (leNum y x) (den (denOf z)))
            (den (denOf z))
            (mulRep_den_swap_gen (numOf y) (denOf z) (denOf x))))
        (intRel_refl
          (mulRep (leNum z y) (den (denOf (ratAddRep x z))))))))
    (leRep_add_right_gen
      (mulRep (mulRep (leNum x y) (den (denOf z))) (den (denOf z)))
      (mulRep (mulRep (leNum y x) (den (denOf z))) (den (denOf z)))
      (mulRep (leNum z y) (den (denOf (ratAddRep x z))))

        (mulRep (leNum x y) (den (denOf z)))
        (mulRep (leNum y x) (den (denOf z)))
        (denOf z)
        (leRep_mul_den_right (leNum x y) (leNum y x) (denOf z) h)))

exercises.unit: 单元㊺ 序的全性：每个有理数都有绝对值
exercises.name: leNat_total
exercises.title: 单元㊺ 序的全性：每个有理数都有绝对值
exercises.prompt:
单元㊺ 序的全性：每个有理数都有绝对值

进入 **II.5：ℝ 的商、代数与序**。第一件事是把 `realRel` 补成**等价关系**： ㊵ 做了自反、㊷ 做了对称，还差**传递性**。传递性的标准证法是三角不等式 + `ε` 折半：

close x y ε/2 ⇒ close y z ε/2 ⇒ close x z ε

而三角不等式要用的第一块地基，正是本单元：**ℚ 的序是全序**。

为什么全序是前提：㉝ 的绝对值是**关系**而不是函数

ratAbsRel x d :⟺ (0 ≤ x ∧ d ~ x) ∨ (x ≤ 0 ∧ d ~ -x)

要证「`|x-y|` 存在」就得先知道 `x-y` 落在哪一边；没有全序，这个析取连 一个居民都拿不出来（㉟ 的 `close` 里那个 `∃ d` 就会是空的）。本单元结清：

· ㊺.1 `leNat_total`：ℕ 的 `≤` 是全序（对第二个变量归纳）； · ㊺.2 `ratLeRep_total`：ℚ 的 `≤` 是全序（`ratLeRep` 就是交叉相乘后的 `LeNat`，把 ㊺.1 直接用上）； · ㊺.3 `ratAbsRel_total`：每个有理数都有绝对值（两种情况分别取 `x` 与 `-x`）； · ㊺.4 `ratAbsRel_nonneg`：绝对值非负（`ratLeRep_congr_snd` 把 `x` 换成 `d`， 第二支再把 `0 ≤ -x` 用 ㊶ 的 `ratLeRep_neg_gen` 搬过来）； · ㊺.5 具体：`|-1/2| = 1/2`。

写法提醒：`ratRep` 是 `Prod (Prod Nat Nat) Nat` 的**定义别名**，`match` 只认 归纳类型本身；通用包装要把参数写成展开类型、并**在 match 之后**再引入假设 （㊷ 的 `ratSubRep_neg_aux` / `ratAbsRel_wd_left_aux` 是同一个写法）。

本单元不引入新定义；ℚ 的算术与序的引擎来自 `lib/Rat` / `lib/RatOrder`。

㊺.1 ℕ 的序是全序

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对第二个变量 `n` 归纳。`n = 0` 时 `LeNat 0 m` 由 `leNat_zero_le` 给出（走右边）。`n = succ k` 时看归纳假设：若 `LeNat m k`，用 `le_succ` 得到 `LeNat m (succ k)`；若 `LeNat k m`，再分「`k = m`」与「`LeNat (succ k) m`」——前者把 `LeNat m (succ k)` 化成 `LeNat k (succ k)`（`le_succ` + `le_refl`），后者直接就是右边的目标。这个二分用一条小引理 `leNat_eq_or_succ` 表述（对 `LeNat k m` 本身做 match）。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `LeNat m n ∨ LeNat n m`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Nat.rec · leNat_zero_le · le_succ · le_refl · leNat_succ_succ · Eq.subst · Or.inl · Or.inr · Or.elim。

exercises.template:
theorem leNat_total (m n : Nat) : LeNat m n ∨ LeNat n m :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem leNat_total (m n : Nat) : LeNat m n ∨ LeNat n m :=
  Nat.rec (fun (n : Nat) => LeNat m n ∨ LeNat n m)
    (Or.inr (leNat_zero_le m))
    (fun (k : Nat) (ih : LeNat m k ∨ LeNat k m) =>
      Or.elim
        (fun (h : LeNat m k) => Or.inl (le_succ m k h))
        (fun (h : LeNat k m) =>
          Or.elim
            (fun (heq : k = m) =>
              Or.inl
                (le_succ m k
                  (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat (fun (z : Nat) => LeNat z k) k m heq
                    (le_refl k))))
            (fun (hlt : LeNat (Nat.succ k) m) => Or.inr hlt)
            (leNat_eq_or_succ k m h))
        ih)
    n

exercises.title: ㊺.2 ℚ 的序是全序
exercises.prompt: ㊺.2 ℚ 的序是全序

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `ratLeRep x y` 展开就是 `leRep (leNum x y) (leNum y x)`，而 `leRep p q` 是 `LeNat (p₁+q₂) (q₁+p₂)`；两个方向上只是把两个 `Nat.add` 的加数互换，所以把 ㊺.1 直接用在两个具体的 `Nat` 表达式上即可（两边定义性相等，不需要额外的改写）。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratLeRep x y ∨ ratLeRep y x`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: leNat_total。

exercises.template:
theorem ratLeRep_total (x y : ratRep) : ratLeRep x y ∨ ratLeRep y x :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratLeRep_total (x y : ratRep) : ratLeRep x y ∨ ratLeRep y x :=
  leNat_total (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat (leNum x y)) (Prod.snd Nat Nat (leNum y x)))
              (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat (leNum y x)) (Prod.snd Nat Nat (leNum x y)))

exercises.unit: 单元㊺ 序的全性：每个有理数都有绝对值
exercises.name: ratAbsRel_total
exercises.title: ㊺.3 每个有理数都有绝对值
exercises.prompt: ㊺.3 每个有理数都有绝对值

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 `0 ≤ x` 与 `x ≤ 0` 两分（㊺.2）。第一支取 `d := x`，`ratAbsRel x x` 的左支要 `0 ≤ x` 与 `x ~ x`（`ratRel_refl`）；第二支取 `d := -x`，右支要 `x ≤ 0` 与 `-x ~ -x`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `∃ (d : ratRep), ratAbsRel x d`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLeRep_total · Exists.intro · Or.inl · Or.inr · And.intro · ratRel_refl。

exercises.template:
theorem ratAbsRel_total (x : ratRep) : ∃ (d : ratRep), ratAbsRel x d :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratAbsRel_total (x : ratRep) : ∃ (d : ratRep), ratAbsRel x d :=
  Or.elim
    (fun (h : ratLeRep ratZeroRep x) =>
      Exists.intro x (Or.inl (And.intro h (ratRel_refl x))))
    (fun (h : ratLeRep x ratZeroRep) =>
      Exists.intro (ratNegRep x)
        (Or.inr (And.intro h (ratRel_refl (ratNegRep x)))))
    (ratLeRep_total ratZeroRep x)

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 `h : ratAbsRel x d` 两分。两支都是「已知 `0 ≤ 某个 z`，且 `d ~ z`，要 `0 ≤ d`」：用 ㊴ 的 `ratLeRep_congr_snd` 把第二个因子从 `z` 换成 `d`（它的前提是 `z ~ d`，由 `ratRel_symm` 调向）。第一支 `z = x`；第二支 `z = -x`，`0 ≤ -x` 由 ㊶ 的 `ratLeRep_neg_gen` 从 `x ≤ 0` 得到。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratAbsRel x d → ratLeRep ratZeroRep d`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Or.elim · ratLeRep_congr_snd · ratRel_symm · ratLeRep_neg_gen · And.left · And.right。`ratRep` 是定义别名：先在展开类型 `Prod (Prod Nat Nat) Nat` 上 match，再引假设，最后转发。

exercises.template:
theorem ratAbsRel_nonneg (x d : ratRep) (h : ratAbsRel x d) :
    ratLeRep ratZeroRep d :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratAbsRel_nonneg (x d : ratRep) (h : ratAbsRel x d) :
    ratLeRep ratZeroRep d :=
  ratAbsRel_nonneg_aux x d h

exercises.unit: 单元㊻ 序的反对称性：两边夹出相等
exercises.name: leNat_succ_not_self
exercises.title: 单元㊻ 序的反对称性：两边夹出相等
exercises.prompt:
单元㊻ 序的反对称性：两边夹出相等

㊺ 结清了「ℚ 的序是全序」，但要把序用在绝对值上还差一条**反对称性**：

x ≤ y ∧ y ≤ x ⟹ x ~ y

为什么它挡在三角不等式前面：㉝ 的绝对值是**关系**而不是函数，

ratAbsRel x d :⟺ (0 ≤ x ∧ d ~ x) ∨ (x ≤ 0 ∧ d ~ -x)

同一个 `x` 的两个绝对值的见证 `d`、`d'` 可能落在不同分支上（一个取 `x`、 一个取 `-x`）。要把它们认成同一个，必须先知道「`0 ≤ x` 与 `x ≤ 0` 同时 成立时 `x ~ 0`」——这正是反对称性。本单元结清：

· ㊻.1 `leNat_succ_not_self`：`n + 1 ≤ n` 不成立（没有数严格大于自己）； · ㊻.2 `leNat_antisymm`：ℕ 的 `≤` 反对称（`a ≤ b ≤ a ⇒ a = b`）； · ㊻.3 `ratLeRep_antisymm`：ℚ 的 `≤` 反对称（交叉相乘后交给 ㊻.2）； · ㊻.4 具体：`1/2` 与 `2/4` 互相 ≤，所以相等。

证明路线：㊻.1 先把 `n+1 ≤ n` 化成 `n = (n+1) + k`（`leNat_exists_add`）， 再用 `succ_add` / `add_succ` 把它搬成 `n = n + (k+1)`，交给一条辅助引理 `nat_add_succ_ne_self`（对 `n` 归纳：零情形 `succ_ne_zero`，后继情形 `Nat.succ.inj` 剥掉一层）。㊻.2 用 ㊺ 的 `leNat_eq_or_succ` 把 `a ≤ b` 拆成 「`a = b`」与「`a+1 ≤ b`」；后者与 `b ≤ a` 串起来就是 ㊻.1 的矛盾。

写法提醒：`ratLeRep` 是一个**返回 `Prop` 的定义**，展开后是 `leRep (leNum x y) (leNum y x)`。这里只让它在**头部**展开一次、把这对乘积 交给一条 `leRep_antisymm`（解答里的辅助引理）；**不要**把 `leNum` 再展开 （`Prod.fst (leNum …)` 会卡在定义上，内核不归约）。

本单元不引入新定义；序的引擎来自 `lib/RatOrder`，`leNat_eq_or_succ` 与 ㊹ 的加法相容已收在 `lib/RatAbs`。

㊻.1 `n + 1 ≤ n` 不成立

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把 `h : n+1 ≤ n` 交给 `leNat_exists_add`，得到 `k` 与 `n = (n+1) + k`；用 `succ_add` 把 `(n+1)+k` 化成 `succ (n+k)`，再用 `add_succ` 的对称把它写成 `n + (k+1)`。于是 `n = n + (k+1)`，交给辅助引理 `nat_add_succ_ne_self`（对 `n` 归纳；零情形 `succ_ne_zero`，后继情形 `Nat.succ.inj` 剥一层）。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `LeNat (Nat.succ n) n → False`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: leNat_exists_add · Exists.elim · succ_add · add_succ（取对称）· nat_add_succ_ne_self。

exercises.template:
theorem leNat_succ_not_self (n : Nat) (h : LeNat (Nat.succ n) n) : False :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem leNat_succ_not_self (n : Nat) (h : LeNat (Nat.succ n) n) : False :=
  Exists.elim
    (leNat_exists_add (Nat.succ n) n h)
    (fun (k : Nat) (hk : n = Nat.add (Nat.succ n) k) =>
      nat_add_succ_ne_self n k
        (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
          n
          (Nat.add n (Nat.succ k))
          (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
            n
            (Nat.add (Nat.succ n) k)
            (Nat.add n (Nat.succ k))
            hk
            (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
              (Nat.add (Nat.succ n) k)
              (Nat.succ (Nat.add n k))
              (Nat.add n (Nat.succ k))
              (succ_add n k)
              (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
                (Nat.add n (Nat.succ k))
                (Nat.succ (Nat.add n k))
                (add_succ n k))))))

exercises.unit: 单元㊻ 序的反对称性：两边夹出相等
exercises.name: leNat_antisymm
exercises.title: ㊻.2 ℕ 的序反对称
exercises.prompt: ㊻.2 ℕ 的序反对称

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 用 ㊺ 的 `leNat_eq_or_succ` 把 `h1 : a ≤ b` 拆成两支。第一支 `a = b` 就是答案；第二支 `a+1 ≤ b`，与 `h2 : b ≤ a` 用 `leNat_trans` 串成 `a+1 ≤ a`，交给 ㊻.1 得到 `False`，再 `False.elim`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `LeNat a b → LeNat b a → a = b`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: leNat_eq_or_succ · leNat_trans · leNat_succ_not_self · @False.elim（显式给目标类型）· Or.elim。

exercises.template:
theorem leNat_antisymm (a b : Nat) (h1 : LeNat a b) (h2 : LeNat b a) : a = b :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem leNat_antisymm (a b : Nat) (h1 : LeNat a b) (h2 : LeNat b a) : a = b :=
  Or.elim
    (fun (heq : a = b) => heq)
    (fun (hlt : LeNat (Nat.succ a) b) =>
      @False.elim (a = b)
        (leNat_succ_not_self a (leNat_trans (Nat.succ a) b a hlt h2)))
    (leNat_eq_or_succ a b h1)

exercises.unit: 单元㊻ 序的反对称性：两边夹出相等
exercises.name: ratLeRep_antisymm
exercises.title: ㊻.3 ℚ 的序反对称
exercises.prompt: ㊻.3 ℚ 的序反对称

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `ratLeRep x y` 展开是 `leRep (leNum x y) (leNum y x)`，`ratLeRep y x` 展开是 `leRep (leNum y x) (leNum x y)`；把这对乘积交给解答里的辅助引理 `leRep_antisymm`（它就是 ㊻.2 的 `leRep` 版本），得到的 `intRel (leNum x y) (leNum y x)` 正是 `ratRel x y`。不要试图把 `leNum` 再展开（`Prod.fst` 会卡在定义上）。

hints.label: 目标形态

exercises.unit: 单元㊼ 绝对值的唯一性：同一个数的两个见证相等
exercises.name: ratAbsRel_left_right
exercises.title: 单元㊼ 绝对值的唯一性：同一个数的两个见证相等
exercises.prompt:
单元㊼ 绝对值的唯一性：同一个数的两个见证相等

㊺ 证了「每个有理数都有绝对值」（`∃ d, ratAbsRel x d`），㊻ 证了序的反对称性。 两者合起来就能回答绝对值是**函数**的那个问题：

ratAbsRel x d ∧ ratAbsRel x d' ⟹ d ~ d'

为什么它不是一句废话：`ratAbsRel` 是**关系**，定义是两个析取的并

(0 ≤ x ∧ d ~ x) ∨ (x ≤ 0 ∧ d ~ -x)

同一个 `x` 的两个见证可能落在**不同分支**（一个取 `x`、一个取 `-x`）。 ㊻ 的 `ratLeRep_antisymm` 正好把「`0 ≤ x` 与 `x ≤ 0` 同时成立」压成 `x ~ 0`，于是 `x ~ 0 ~ -x`，两个分支的见证就接上了。本单元结清：

· ㊼.1 `ratAbsRel_left_right`：**异号**两支（`d ~ x` 与 `d' ~ -x`）相等； · ㊼.2 `ratAbsRel_unique`：绝对值的唯一性（四个分支两两配对）； · ㊼.3 具体：`|-1/2|` 的两个见证 `1/2` 与 `2/4` 相等。

证明路线：「同号」两支只是 `ratRel` 的传递；异号两支先用 ㊻ 把 `0 ≤ x ≤ 0` 压成 `0 ~ x`，再用 `ratNegRep_wd` 把 `0 ~ x` 搬到 `0 ~ -x` （或反向），最后用 `ratRel_trans_gen` 把四段串起来。右/左那支把 ㊼.1 的 两个见证对调后再 `ratRel_symm`。

`ratLeRep` / `leRep` 只做头部展开；`-0` 是闭项，定义性归约回 `0`。

㊼.1 异号两支：`d ~ x`、`d' ~ -x` 时 `d ~ d'`

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `h1` 给 `d ~ x`，`h2` 给 `d' ~ -x`；先用 ㊻ 的 `ratLeRep_antisymm 0 x`（前提是 `0 ≤ x` 与 `x ≤ 0`）得到 `0 ~ x`，反转得 `x ~ 0`，再用 `ratNegRep_wd` 得 `0 ~ -x`，最后把「`d ~ x`」「`x ~ 0`」「`0 ~ -x`」「`-x ~ d'`」四段用 `ratRel_trans_gen` 串起来。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `(0 ≤ x ∧ d ~ x) → (x ≤ 0 ∧ d' ~ -x) → ratRel d d'`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLeRep_antisymm · ratNegRep_wd · ratRel_symm · ratRel_trans_gen · And.left · And.right。

exercises.template:
theorem ratAbsRel_left_right (x d d' : ratRep)
    (hl : ratLeRep ratZeroRep x ∧ ratRel d x)
    (hr : ratLeRep x ratZeroRep ∧ ratRel d' (ratNegRep x)) :
    ratRel d d' :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratAbsRel_left_right (x d d' : ratRep)
    (hl : ratLeRep ratZeroRep x ∧ ratRel d x)
    (hr : ratLeRep x ratZeroRep ∧ ratRel d' (ratNegRep x)) :
    ratRel d d' :=
  ratRel_trans_gen d x d'
    (And.right hl)
    (ratRel_trans_gen x (ratNegRep x) d'
      (ratRel_trans_gen x ratZeroRep (ratNegRep x)
        (ratRel_symm ratZeroRep x
          (ratLeRep_antisymm ratZeroRep x (And.left hl) (And.left hr)))
        (ratNegRep_wd ratZeroRep x
          (ratLeRep_antisymm ratZeroRep x (And.left hl) (And.left hr))))
      (ratRel_symm d' (ratNegRep x) (And.right hr)))

exercises.title: ㊼.2 绝对值的唯一性
exercises.prompt: ㊼.2 绝对值的唯一性

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 `h1`、`h2` 各做一次 `Or.elim`，四支。「同号」两支只是 `ratRel` 的传递（`ratRel_trans_gen` + `ratRel_symm`）；「左/右」交给 ㊼.1；「右/左」把 ㊼.1 的两个见证对调后再 `ratRel_symm`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratAbsRel x d → ratAbsRel x d' → ratRel d d'`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Or.elim · ratRel_trans_gen · ratRel_symm · ratAbsRel_left_right。

exercises.template:
theorem ratAbsRel_unique (x d d' : ratRep)
    (h1 : ratAbsRel x d) (h2 : ratAbsRel x d') : ratRel d d' :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratAbsRel_unique (x d d' : ratRep)
    (h1 : ratAbsRel x d) (h2 : ratAbsRel x d') : ratRel d d' :=
  @Or.elim
    (ratLeRep ratZeroRep x ∧ ratRel d x)
    (ratLeRep x ratZeroRep ∧ ratRel d (ratNegRep x))
    (ratRel d d')
    (fun (h1l : ratLeRep ratZeroRep x ∧ ratRel d x) =>
      @Or.elim
        (ratLeRep ratZeroRep x ∧ ratRel d' x)
        (ratLeRep x ratZeroRep ∧ ratRel d' (ratNegRep x))
        (ratRel d d')
        (fun (h2l : ratLeRep ratZeroRep x ∧ ratRel d' x) =>
          ratRel_trans_gen d x d'
            (And.right h1l)
            (ratRel_symm d' x (And.right h2l)))
        (fun (h2r : ratLeRep x ratZeroRep ∧ ratRel d' (ratNegRep x)) =>
          ratAbsRel_left_right x d d' h1l h2r)
        h2)
    (fun (h1r : ratLeRep x ratZeroRep ∧ ratRel d (ratNegRep x)) =>
      @Or.elim
        (ratLeRep ratZeroRep x ∧ ratRel d' x)
        (ratLeRep x ratZeroRep ∧ ratRel d' (ratNegRep x))
        (ratRel d d')
        (fun (h2l : ratLeRep ratZeroRep x ∧ ratRel d' x) =>
          ratRel_symm d' d (ratAbsRel_left_right x d' d h2l h1r))
        (fun (h2r : ratLeRep x ratZeroRep ∧ ratRel d' (ratNegRep x)) =>
          ratRel_trans_gen d (ratNegRep x) d'
            (And.right h1r)
            (ratRel_symm d' (ratNegRep x) (And.right h2r)))
        h2)
    h1

hints.body: `-1/2` 是 `qrep 0 1 1`，`1/2` 是 `qrep 1 0 1`、`2/4` 是 `qrep 2 0 3`。两个见证都走右支：`qrep 0 1 1 ≤ 0` 是 `LeNat 0 1`（`le_succ 0 0 (le_refl 0)`）；`-(-1/2)` 定义性归约成 `1/2`，所以第二个分量分别是 `ratRel_refl` 与 `intRel_of_eq`（交叉相乘两边都是 `(4,0)`，`Eq.refl` 即可）。最后交给 ㊼.2。

exercises.template:

    ratRel (qrep 1 Nat.zero 1) (qrep 2 Nat.zero 3) :=
  ratAbsRel_unique (qrep Nat.zero 1 1) (qrep 1 Nat.zero 1) (qrep 2 Nat.zero 3)
    (Or.inr
      (And.intro
        (le_succ Nat.zero Nat.zero (le_refl Nat.zero))
        (ratRel_refl (qrep 1 Nat.zero 1))))
    (Or.inr
      (And.intro
        (le_succ Nat.zero Nat.zero (le_refl Nat.zero))
        (intRel_of_eq
          (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat 2 Nat.zero) (den 1))
          (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat 1 Nat.zero) (den 3))
          (Eq.refl (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat 2 Nat.zero) (den 1))))))

exercises.unit: 单元㊽ 三角不等式：|u + v| ≤ |u| + |v|
exercises.name: ratLeRep_add
exercises.title: 单元㊽ 三角不等式：|u + v| ≤ |u| + |v|
exercises.prompt:
单元㊽ 三角不等式：|u + v| ≤ |u| + |v|

㊼ 给了绝对值的唯一性，现在可以把「同一个数的两个见证」当成一个来用。 本单元证明 **ℚ 的三角不等式**——它是 `close` 传递性（`ε` 折半）唯一的 数学内容：

ratAbsRel x dx ∧ ratAbsRel y dy ∧ ratAbsRel (x + y) d ⟹ d ≤ dx + dy

为什么不能直接「把两个见证相加」：`ratAbsRel` 是关系而不是函数， `dx + dy` 一般**不是** `|x + y|` 的见证（1 + (-1/2) 的见证是 1/2， 而 1 + 1/2 = 3/2）。三角不等式说的是**不等号**，不是等号。

证明路线（把两边都化成「对 `x`、`y` 的四个界」）：

· ㊽.1 `ratLeRep_add`：序对两个因子都单调（右加用 ㊹ 的 `ratLeRep_add_right`，左加靠交换律转成右加）； · ㊽.2 `ratAbsRel_le`：`x ≤ d`（第一支 `x ≤ x ~ d`，第二支 `x ≤ 0 ≤ -x ~ d`）； · ㊽.3 `ratAbsRel_neg_le`：`-x ≤ d`（第一支 `-x ≤ 0 ≤ x ~ d`， 第二支 `-x ~ d`）； · ㊽.4 `ratNegRep_add`：`-(x + y) ~ (-x) + (-y)`（两边在代表元上 **定义性相等**：交换两个分子后 `addRep` 的两个坐标恰好对调）； · ㊽.5 `ratLeRep_abs_add`：主定理。对 `d` 落在哪一支分两种情形： 非负支 `d ~ x+y ≤ dx+dy`；非正支 `d ~ -(x+y) ~ (-x)+(-y) ≤ dx+dy`； · ㊽.6 具体：`|1/2 + 1/2| = 1 ≤ 1/2 + 1/2`。

`ratLeRep` 只做头部展开；本单元不引入新定义，序与加法的引擎来自 `lib/RatAbs`。

㊽.1 序对两个因子都单调

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先对 `h1` 用右加（`ratLeRep_add_right a b c`）得 `a+c ≤ b+c`；再把 `c+b ≤ d+b`（对 `h2` 用右加、以 `b` 为加数）经两次交换律搬成 `b+c ≤ b+d`；最后 `ratLeRep_trans` 串起来。交换律给的是 `ratRel`，用 `ratLeRep_of_ratRel` 读成序。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratLeRep a b → ratLeRep c d → ratLeRep (ratAddRep a c) (ratAddRep b d)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLeRep_add_right · ratAdd_comm · ratLeRep_of_ratRel · ratLeRep_trans。

exercises.template:
theorem ratLeRep_add (a b c d : ratRep)
    (h1 : ratLeRep a b) (h2 : ratLeRep c d) :
    ratLeRep (ratAddRep a c) (ratAddRep b d) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratLeRep_add (a b c d : ratRep)
    (h1 : ratLeRep a b) (h2 : ratLeRep c d) :
    ratLeRep (ratAddRep a c) (ratAddRep b d) :=
  ratLeRep_trans (ratAddRep a c) (ratAddRep b c) (ratAddRep b d)
    (ratLeRep_add_right a b c h1)
    (ratLeRep_trans (ratAddRep b c) (ratAddRep c b) (ratAddRep b d)
      (ratLeRep_of_ratRel (ratAddRep b c) (ratAddRep c b) (ratAdd_comm b c))
      (ratLeRep_trans (ratAddRep c b) (ratAddRep d b) (ratAddRep b d)
        (ratLeRep_add_right c d b h2)
        (ratLeRep_of_ratRel (ratAddRep d b) (ratAddRep b d) (ratAdd_comm d b))))

exercises.unit: 单元㊽ 三角不等式：|u + v| ≤ |u| + |v|
exercises.name: ratLeRep_abs_add
exercises.title: ㊽.5 主定理：三角不等式
exercises.prompt: ㊽.5 主定理：三角不等式

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先备好四个界：`x ≤ dx`、`-x ≤ dx`（㊽.2/㊽.3 对 `hx`），`y ≤ dy`、`-y ≤ dy`（对 `hy`）。对 `h` 分两支：非负支里 `d ~ x+y`，而 `x+y ≤ dx+dy` 由 ㊽.1 给出；非正支里 `d ~ -(x+y)`，用 ㊽.4 把 `-(x+y)` 换成 `(-x)+(-y)`，再由 ㊽.1 得 `(-x)+(-y) ≤ dx+dy`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratAbsRel x dx → ratAbsRel y dy → ratAbsRel (ratAddRep x y) d → ratLeRep d (ratAddRep dx dy)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratAbsRel_le · ratAbsRel_neg_le · ratLeRep_add · ratNegRep_add · ratLeRep_of_ratRel · ratLeRep_trans · Or.elim。

exercises.template:
theorem ratLeRep_abs_add (x y dx dy d : ratRep)
    (hx : ratAbsRel x dx) (hy : ratAbsRel y dy)
    (h : ratAbsRel (ratAddRep x y) d) :
    ratLeRep d (ratAddRep dx dy) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratLeRep_abs_add (x y dx dy d : ratRep)
    (hx : ratAbsRel x dx) (hy : ratAbsRel y dy)
    (h : ratAbsRel (ratAddRep x y) d) :
    ratLeRep d (ratAddRep dx dy) :=
  Or.elim
    (fun (h1 : ratLeRep ratZeroRep (ratAddRep x y) ∧
               ratRel d (ratAddRep x y)) =>
      ratLeRep_trans d (ratAddRep x y) (ratAddRep dx dy)
        (ratLeRep_of_ratRel d (ratAddRep x y) (And.right h1))
        (ratLeRep_add x dx y dy (ratAbsRel_le x dx hx) (ratAbsRel_le y dy hy)))
    (fun (h2 : ratLeRep (ratAddRep x y) ratZeroRep ∧
               ratRel d (ratNegRep (ratAddRep x y))) =>
      ratLeRep_trans d (ratNegRep (ratAddRep x y)) (ratAddRep dx dy)
        (ratLeRep_of_ratRel d (ratNegRep (ratAddRep x y)) (And.right h2))
        (ratLeRep_trans (ratNegRep (ratAddRep x y))
          (ratAddRep (ratNegRep x) (ratNegRep y))
          (ratAddRep dx dy)
          (ratLeRep_of_ratRel (ratNegRep (ratAddRep x y))
            (ratAddRep (ratNegRep x) (ratNegRep y)) (ratNegRep_add x y))
          (ratLeRep_add (ratNegRep x) dx (ratNegRep y) dy
            (ratAbsRel_neg_le x dx hx) (ratAbsRel_neg_le y dy hy))))
    h

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 取 `x = y = dx = dy = 1/2`，`d = 1`。`hx` 是 `Or.inl`：`0 ≤ 1/2`（交叉相乘是 `LeNat 0 1`）与 `1/2 ~ 1/2`；`h` 同形：`1/2 + 1/2` 定义性归约成 `4/4`，`0 ≤ 4/4` 用 `leNat_zero_le`，`1 ~ 4/4` 两边交叉相乘都是 `(4,0)`。结论 `1 ≤ 1/2+1/2` 两边交叉相乘都是 `(4,0)`，是自反的 `LeNat`。

exercises.template:

    ratLeRep (qrep 1 Nat.zero Nat.zero)
             (ratAddRep (qrep 1 Nat.zero 1) (qrep 1 Nat.zero 1)) :=

exercises.solution:
theorem demo_triangle :
    ratLeRep (qrep 1 Nat.zero Nat.zero)
             (ratAddRep (qrep 1 Nat.zero 1) (qrep 1 Nat.zero 1)) :=
  ratLeRep_abs_add
    (qrep 1 Nat.zero 1) (qrep 1 Nat.zero 1)
    (qrep 1 Nat.zero 1) (qrep 1 Nat.zero 1)
    (qrep 1 Nat.zero Nat.zero)
    (Or.inl
      (And.intro
        (le_succ Nat.zero Nat.zero (le_refl Nat.zero))
        (ratRel_refl (qrep 1 Nat.zero 1))))
    (Or.inl
      (And.intro
        (le_succ Nat.zero Nat.zero (le_refl Nat.zero))
        (ratRel_refl (qrep 1 Nat.zero 1))))
    (Or.inl
      (And.intro
        (leNat_zero_le 4)
        (intRel_of_eq
          (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat 1 Nat.zero) (den 3))
          (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat 4 Nat.zero) (den Nat.zero))
          (Eq.refl (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat 1 Nat.zero) (den 3))))))

exercises.unit: 单元㊾ 严格序的传递与 close 对 ε 的单调性
exercises.name: ratLtRep_le
exercises.title: 单元㊾ 严格序的传递与 `close` 对 `ε` 的单调性
exercises.prompt:
单元㊾ 严格序的传递与 `close` 对 `ε` 的单调性

㊽ 给了三角不等式，`close` 的传递性还差两件工程件：

· `ε` 一旦定下来，往**大**走不改变 `close`（本单元 ㊾.3）； · 严格序 `a < b < c` 可以**串**起来（本单元 ㊾.2）——折半之后 `0 < ε/2`、`ε/2 < ε` 这类链条都要靠它。

两条都不需要新的算术，只是把 ㉚ 的定义、㊻ 的反对称性与 ㊳ 的传递性 拼起来：

ratLtRep a b := ratLeRep a b ∧ ¬ ratRel a b

严格序的传递性唯一的「不相等」义务是：若 `a ~ c`，则 `c ≤ a`，与 `a ≤ b ≤ c` 一起把 `b` 夹成 `b ~ c`，正好撞上 `b < c` 的第二分量。

`close` 对 `ε` 的单调性同理：`d < ε ≤ ε'` 的「不相等」义务是 「`d ~ ε'` 会把 `ε'` 与 `ε` 夹成相等，从而 `d ~ ε`」。本单元结清：

· ㊾.1 `ratLtRep_le`：严格序给出弱序（第二分量的投影）； · ㊾.2 `ratLtRep_trans`：严格序的传递性； · ㊾.3 `close_mono_eps`：`close x y ε → ε ≤ ε' → close x y ε'`； · ㊾.4 具体：`close 0 0 1` 放大成 `close 0 0 2`。

本单元不引入新定义；`ratLtRep` 来自 `lib/Cauchy`，序的引擎来自 `lib/RatAbs` 与 `lib/RatAbsOrder`。

㊾.1 严格序给出弱序

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `ratLtRep a b` 就是 `ratLeRep a b ∧ ¬ ratRel a b`，取第一个分量即可（`And.left`）。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratLtRep a b → ratLeRep a b`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: And.left。

exercises.template:
theorem ratLtRep_le (a b : ratRep) (h : ratLtRep a b) : ratLeRep a b :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratLtRep_le (a b : ratRep) (h : ratLtRep a b) : ratLeRep a b :=
  And.left h

exercises.unit: 单元㊾ 严格序的传递与 close 对 ε 的单调性
exercises.name: ratLtRep_trans
exercises.title: ㊾.2 严格序的传递性
exercises.prompt: ㊾.2 严格序的传递性

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 弱序部分用 ㊳ 的 `ratLeRep_trans` 直接串。不相等部分：假设 `a ~ c`，则 `c ≤ a`（`ratLeRep_of_ratRel` + 对称），与 `b ≤ c`、`a ≤ b` 得 `c ≤ b`；再用 ㊻ 的 `ratLeRep_antisymm b c` 把 `b ≤ c ≤ b` 压成 `b ~ c`，与 `h2` 的第二分量矛盾。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratLtRep a b → ratLtRep b c → ratLtRep a c`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLeRep_trans · ratLeRep_of_ratRel · ratRel_symm · ratLeRep_antisymm · And.intro。

exercises.template:
theorem ratLtRep_trans (a b c : ratRep)
    (h1 : ratLtRep a b) (h2 : ratLtRep b c) : ratLtRep a c :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratLtRep_trans (a b c : ratRep)
    (h1 : ratLtRep a b) (h2 : ratLtRep b c) : ratLtRep a c :=
  And.intro
    (ratLeRep_trans a b c (And.left h1) (And.left h2))
    (fun (hac : ratRel a c) =>
      And.right h2
        (ratLeRep_antisymm b c (And.left h2)
          (ratLeRep_trans c a b
            (ratLeRep_of_ratRel c a (ratRel_symm a c hac))
            (And.left h1))))

exercises.unit: 单元㊾ 严格序的传递与 close 对 ε 的单调性
exercises.name: close_mono_eps
exercises.title: ㊾.3 `close` 对 `ε` 单调：把 `ε` 放大不破坏 `close`
exercises.prompt: ㊾.3 `close` 对 `ε` 单调：把 `ε` 放大不破坏 `close`

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 展开 `h`，取出见证 `d` 与 `d < ε`。新的 `d < ε'`：弱序用 `ratLeRep_trans d ε ε'`；不相等部分假设 `d ~ ε'`，则 `ε' ≤ d`，与 `d ≤ ε`、`ε ≤ ε'` 用 `ratLeRep_antisymm ε ε'` 得 `ε ~ ε'`，于是 `d ~ ε`，撞上 `d < ε` 的第二分量。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `close x y ε → ratLeRep ε ε' → close x y ε'`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.elim · Exists.intro · ratLeRep_trans · ratLeRep_of_ratRel · ratRel_symm · ratLeRep_antisymm · ratRel_trans_gen。

exercises.template:
theorem close_mono_eps (x y eps eps' : ratRep)
    (h : close x y eps) (hle : ratLeRep eps eps') :
    close x y eps' :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem close_mono_eps (x y eps eps' : ratRep)
    (h : close x y eps) (hle : ratLeRep eps eps') :
    close x y eps' :=
  Exists.elim h
    (fun (d : ratRep) (hd : ratAbsRel (ratSubRep x y) d ∧ ratLtRep d eps) =>
      Exists.intro d
        (And.intro (And.left hd)
          (And.intro
            (ratLeRep_trans d eps eps' (And.left (And.right hd)) hle)
            (fun (hde : ratRel d eps') =>
              And.right (And.right hd)
                (ratRel_trans_gen d eps' eps hde
                  (ratRel_symm eps eps'
                    (ratLeRep_antisymm eps eps' hle
                      (ratLeRep_trans eps' d eps
                        (ratLeRep_of_ratRel eps' d (ratRel_symm d eps' hde))
                        (And.left (And.right hd))))))))))

exercises.unit: 单元㊾ 严格序的传递与 close 对 ε 的单调性
exercises.name: demo_close_mono
exercises.title: ㊾.4 具体：`close 0 0 1` 放大成 `close 0 0 2`
exercises.prompt: ㊾.4 具体：`close 0 0 1` 放大成 `close 0 0 2`

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `close 0 0 1` 由库里的 `close_zero_zero` 给出，前提 `0 < 1`：弱序是 `LeNat 0 1`（`le_succ` + `le_refl`），不相等把 `0 ~ 1` 化成 `0 = 1` 后交给 `succ_ne_zero`。放大用的 `1 ≤ 2` 交叉相乘后是 `LeNat 1 2`，同样 `le_succ` 一步。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `close ratZeroRep ratZeroRep (qrep 2 Nat.zero Nat.zero)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: close_mono_eps · close_zero_zero · le_succ · le_refl · succ_ne_zero · Eq.symm。

exercises.template:
theorem demo_close_mono :
    close ratZeroRep ratZeroRep (qrep 2 Nat.zero Nat.zero) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem demo_close_mono :
    close ratZeroRep ratZeroRep (qrep 2 Nat.zero Nat.zero) :=
  close_mono_eps ratZeroRep ratZeroRep
    (qrep 1 Nat.zero Nat.zero) (qrep 2 Nat.zero Nat.zero)
    (close_zero_zero (qrep 1 Nat.zero Nat.zero)
      (And.intro
        (le_succ Nat.zero Nat.zero (le_refl Nat.zero))
        (fun (h : ratRel ratZeroRep (qrep 1 Nat.zero Nat.zero)) =>
          succ_ne_zero Nat.zero
            (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat Nat.zero (Nat.succ Nat.zero) h))))
    (le_succ 1 1 (le_refl 1))

exercises.unit: 单元㊿ 严格序与加法相容：加法消去
exercises.name: ratLeRep_add_addends
exercises.title: 单元㊿ 严格序与加法相容：加法消去与 `a < b ⇒ a + c < b + c`
exercises.prompt:
单元㊿ 严格序与加法相容：加法消去与 `a < b ⇒ a + c < b + c`

㊹ 证明了 `x ≤ y ⇒ x + z ≤ y + z`；严格序还差**反方向**的工程件： 从 `x + z ~ y + z` 要能推回 `x ~ y`。这就是**加法消去**：

ratLeRep (x + z) (y + z) ⇒ ratLeRep x y

证明把 ㊹.4 的换形倒过来走：`leNum (x+z) (y+z)` 经那两条换形 （本单元起由库里的 `leNum_ratAddRep_left/right` 提供）变成 「x、y 各乘两次 `den z`，再加同一块 z」；`leRep_add_cancel_right` 消掉 公共加数，`leRep_cancel_den` 再把两层 `den z` 各消一次。

有了消去，严格序的加法相容只需要两条： · 弱序：㊹ 的 `ratLeRep_add_right`； · 不相等：若 `x + z ~ y + z`，消去得 `x ~ y`，与 `<` 的第二分量矛盾。

本单元结清： · ㊿.1 `ratLeRep_add_addends`：把 ㊹.4 的两个换形拼成「加同一块 z」； · ㊿.2 `ratLeRep_add_cancel`：加法消去（弱序）； · ㊿.3 `ratRel_add_cancel`：加法消去（相等）； · ㊿.4 `ratLtRep_add_right`：`x < y ⇒ x + z < y + z`； · ㊿.5 具体：`0 + 1/2 < 1 + 1/2`。

㊿.1 把 ㊹.4 的两个换形拼成「加同一块 z」

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `ratLeRep (x+z) (y+z)` 展开是 `leRep (leNum (x+z) (y+z)) (leNum (y+z) (x+z))`。用 `leRep_wd_pair` 把两个 `leNum` 换成 ㊹.4 的中间形状——两个中间形状恰好加的是**同一块** `mulRep (leNum z y) (den (denOf (ratAddRep x z)))`。换形由库里的 `leNum_ratAddRep_left/right` 给出，注意 `leRep_wd_pair` 要的是 `intRel` 从 `leNum` 出发的方向，所以取 `intRel_symm`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `leRep (addRep A Z) (addRep B Z)`，其中 `A = leNum x y · dz · dz`、`B = leNum y x · dz · dz`、`Z = leNum z y · den (x+z)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: leRep_wd_pair · intRel_symm · leNum_ratAddRep_left · leNum_ratAddRep_right。

exercises.template:
theorem ratLeRep_add_addends (x y z : ratRep)
    (h : ratLeRep (ratAddRep x z) (ratAddRep y z)) :
    leRep
      (addRep
        (mulRep (mulRep (leNum x y) (den (denOf z))) (den (denOf z)))
        (mulRep (leNum z y) (den (denOf (ratAddRep x z)))))
      (addRep
        (mulRep (mulRep (leNum y x) (den (denOf z))) (den (denOf z)))
        (mulRep (leNum z y) (den (denOf (ratAddRep x z))))) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratLeRep_add_addends (x y z : ratRep)
    (h : ratLeRep (ratAddRep x z) (ratAddRep y z)) :
    leRep
      (addRep
        (mulRep (mulRep (leNum x y) (den (denOf z))) (den (denOf z)))
        (mulRep (leNum z y) (den (denOf (ratAddRep x z)))))
      (addRep
        (mulRep (mulRep (leNum y x) (den (denOf z))) (den (denOf z)))
        (mulRep (leNum z y) (den (denOf (ratAddRep x z))))) :=
  leRep_wd_pair
    (leNum (ratAddRep x z) (ratAddRep y z))
    (addRep
      (mulRep (mulRep (leNum x y) (den (denOf z))) (den (denOf z)))
      (mulRep (leNum z y) (den (denOf (ratAddRep x z)))))
    (leNum (ratAddRep y z) (ratAddRep x z))
    (addRep
      (mulRep (mulRep (leNum y x) (den (denOf z))) (den (denOf z)))
      (mulRep (leNum z y) (den (denOf (ratAddRep x z)))))
    (intRel_symm
      (addRep
        (mulRep (mulRep (leNum x y) (den (denOf z))) (den (denOf z)))
        (mulRep (leNum z y) (den (denOf (ratAddRep x z)))))
      (leNum (ratAddRep x z) (ratAddRep y z))
      (leNum_ratAddRep_left x y z))
    (intRel_symm
      (addRep
        (mulRep (mulRep (leNum y x) (den (denOf z))) (den (denOf z)))
        (mulRep (leNum z y) (den (denOf (ratAddRep x z)))))
      (leNum (ratAddRep y z) (ratAddRep x z))
      (leNum_ratAddRep_right x y z))
    h

exercises.unit: 单元㊿ 严格序与加法相容：加法消去
exercises.name: ratLeRep_add_cancel
exercises.title: ㊿.2 加法消去（弱序）
exercises.prompt: ㊿.2 加法消去（弱序）

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 从 ㊿.1 得到「加同一块 z」的 `leRep`，用 `leRep_add_cancel_right` 消掉公共加数；剩下的是 `leRep (A·dz) (B·dz)`，用 `leRep_cancel_den` 消一次 `den z` 得 `leRep A B`，再消一次得 `leRep (leNum x y) (leNum y x)`，正是 `ratLeRep x y`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratLeRep (ratAddRep x z) (ratAddRep y z) → ratLeRep x y`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLeRep_add_addends · leRep_add_cancel_right · leRep_cancel_den（两次）。

exercises.template:
theorem ratLeRep_add_cancel (x y z : ratRep)
    (h : ratLeRep (ratAddRep x z) (ratAddRep y z)) : ratLeRep x y :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratLeRep_add_cancel (x y z : ratRep)
    (h : ratLeRep (ratAddRep x z) (ratAddRep y z)) : ratLeRep x y :=
  leRep_cancel_den (leNum x y) (leNum y x) (denOf z)
    (leRep_cancel_den
      (mulRep (leNum x y) (den (denOf z)))
      (mulRep (leNum y x) (den (denOf z)))
      (denOf z)
      (leRep_add_cancel_right
        (mulRep (mulRep (leNum x y) (den (denOf z))) (den (denOf z)))
        (mulRep (mulRep (leNum y x) (den (denOf z))) (den (denOf z)))
        (mulRep (leNum z y) (den (denOf (ratAddRep x z))))
        (ratLeRep_add_addends x y z h)))

exercises.unit: 单元㊿ 严格序与加法相容：加法消去
exercises.name: ratRel_add_cancel
exercises.title: ㊿.3 加法消去（相等）
exercises.prompt: ㊿.3 加法消去（相等）

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `ratRel (x+z) (y+z)` 同时给出两个方向的弱序（`ratLeRep_of_ratRel`，反方向先 `ratRel_symm`）；各用 ㊿.2 消去 `z` 得 `x ≤ y` 与 `y ≤ x`，再交给 ㊻ 的 `ratLeRep_antisymm`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel (ratAddRep x z) (ratAddRep y z) → ratRel x y`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLeRep_add_cancel（两次）· ratLeRep_of_ratRel · ratRel_symm · ratLeRep_antisymm。

exercises.template:
theorem ratRel_add_cancel (x y z : ratRep)
    (h : ratRel (ratAddRep x z) (ratAddRep y z)) : ratRel x y :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratRel_add_cancel (x y z : ratRep)
    (h : ratRel (ratAddRep x z) (ratAddRep y z)) : ratRel x y :=
  ratLeRep_antisymm x y
    (ratLeRep_add_cancel x y z
      (ratLeRep_of_ratRel (ratAddRep x z) (ratAddRep y z) h))
    (ratLeRep_add_cancel y x z
      (ratLeRep_of_ratRel (ratAddRep y z) (ratAddRep x z)
        (ratRel_symm (ratAddRep x z) (ratAddRep y z) h)))

exercises.title: ㊿.4 严格序与右加相容
exercises.prompt: ㊿.4 严格序与右加相容

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `ratLtRep x y` 是 `ratLeRep x y ∧ ¬ ratRel x y`。弱序用 ㊹ 的 `ratLeRep_add_right`；不相等用 ㊿.3 的消去——若 `x+z ~ y+z`，消去得 `x ~ y`，撞上第二分量。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratLtRep x y → ratLtRep (ratAddRep x z) (ratAddRep y z)`。

hints.label: 关键件

exercises.template:
theorem ratLtRep_add_right (x y z : ratRep)
    (h : ratLtRep x y) : ratLtRep (ratAddRep x z) (ratAddRep y z) :=

theorem ratLtRep_add_right (x y z : ratRep)

exercises.unit: 单元51 严格序的传递与加法相容
exercises.name: ratLtRep_of_le_lt
exercises.title: 51.2 弱序 + 严格序 ⇒ 严格序（左弱右严）
exercises.prompt: 51.2 弱序 + 严格序 ⇒ 严格序（左弱右严）

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 弱序部分 `a ≤ b ≤ c` 用 `ratLeRep_trans`。不相等部分假设 `a ~ c`，则 `c ≤ a`（`ratLeRep_of_ratRel` + `ratRel_symm`），与 `a ≤ b`、`b ≤ c` 把 `b` 与 `c` 夹成 `b ~ c`（`ratLeRep_antisymm b c`），撞上 `b < c` 的第二分量。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratLeRep a b → ratLtRep b c → ratLtRep a c`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: And.intro · And.left · And.right · ratLeRep_trans · ratLeRep_of_ratRel · ratRel_symm · ratLeRep_antisymm。

exercises.template:
theorem ratLtRep_of_le_lt (a b c : ratRep)
    (h1 : ratLeRep a b) (h2 : ratLtRep b c) : ratLtRep a c :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratLtRep_of_le_lt (a b c : ratRep)
    (h1 : ratLeRep a b) (h2 : ratLtRep b c) : ratLtRep a c :=
  And.intro
    (ratLeRep_trans a b c h1 (And.left h2))
    (fun (hac : ratRel a c) =>
      And.right h2
        (ratLeRep_antisymm b c (And.left h2)
          (ratLeRep_trans c a b
            (ratLeRep_of_ratRel c a (ratRel_symm a c hac))
            h1)))

exercises.unit: 单元51 严格序的传递与加法相容
exercises.name: ratLtRep_of_lt_le
exercises.title: 51.3 严格序 + 弱序 ⇒ 严格序（左严右弱）
exercises.prompt: 51.3 严格序 + 弱序 ⇒ 严格序（左严右弱）

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 弱序部分 `a ≤ b ≤ c` 用 `ratLeRep_trans`。不相等部分假设 `a ~ c`，则 `c ≤ a`，与 `b ≤ c` 得 `b ≤ a`；再与 `a ≤ b` 用 `ratLeRep_antisymm a b` 夹成 `a ~ b`，撞上 `a < b` 的第二分量。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratLtRep a b → ratLeRep b c → ratLtRep a c`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: And.intro · And.left · And.right · ratLeRep_trans · ratLeRep_of_ratRel · ratRel_symm · ratLeRep_antisymm。

exercises.template:
theorem ratLtRep_of_lt_le (a b c : ratRep)
    (h1 : ratLtRep a b) (h2 : ratLeRep b c) : ratLtRep a c :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratLtRep_of_lt_le (a b c : ratRep)
    (h1 : ratLtRep a b) (h2 : ratLeRep b c) : ratLtRep a c :=
  And.intro
    (ratLeRep_trans a b c (And.left h1) h2)
    (fun (hac : ratRel a c) =>
      And.right h1
        (ratLeRep_antisymm a b (And.left h1)
          (ratLeRep_trans b c a h2
            (ratLeRep_of_ratRel c a (ratRel_symm a c hac)))))

exercises.unit: 单元51 严格序的传递与加法相容
exercises.name: ratLtRep_add
exercises.title: 51.4 两个严格序可以相加
exercises.prompt: 51.4 两个严格序可以相加

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 弱序是两段——`a+c ≤ b+c` 用 ㊹/㊿ 的 `ratLeRep_add_right`，`b+c ≤ b+d` 用 51.1 的 `ratLeRep_add_left`，再 `ratLeRep_trans`。不相等部分假设 `a+c ~ b+d`：由 `b+c ≤ b+d` 与 `b+d ~ a+c` 得 `b+c ≤ a+c`，与 `a+c ≤ b+c` 用反对称性夹成 `b+c ~ a+c`，再用库里的 `ratRel_add_cancel_gen` 消去 `c` 得 `b ~ a`；取对称后撞上 `a < b`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratLtRep a b → ratLtRep c d → ratLtRep (a+c) (b+d)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: And.intro · ratLeRep_trans · ratLeRep_add_right · ratLeRep_add_left · ratLeRep_of_ratRel · ratRel_symm · ratLeRep_antisymm · ratRel_add_cancel_gen。

exercises.template:
theorem ratLtRep_add (a b c d : ratRep)
    (h1 : ratLtRep a b) (h2 : ratLtRep c d) :
    ratLtRep (ratAddRep a c) (ratAddRep b d) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratLtRep_add (a b c d : ratRep)
    (h1 : ratLtRep a b) (h2 : ratLtRep c d) :
    ratLtRep (ratAddRep a c) (ratAddRep b d) :=
  And.intro
    (ratLeRep_trans (ratAddRep a c) (ratAddRep b c) (ratAddRep b d)
      (ratLeRep_add_right a b c (And.left h1))
      (ratLeRep_add_left c d b (And.left h2)))
    (fun (h : ratRel (ratAddRep a c) (ratAddRep b d)) =>
      And.right h1
        (ratRel_symm b a
          (ratRel_add_cancel_gen b a c
            (ratLeRep_antisymm (ratAddRep b c) (ratAddRep a c)
              (ratLeRep_trans (ratAddRep b c) (ratAddRep b d) (ratAddRep a c)
                (ratLeRep_add_left c d b (And.left h2))
                (ratLeRep_of_ratRel (ratAddRep b d) (ratAddRep a c)
                  (ratRel_symm (ratAddRep a c) (ratAddRep b d) h)))
              (ratLeRep_add_right a b c (And.left h1))))))

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把 ㉚ 的 `0 < 1` 用两次，交给 51.4。`0 < 1` 的弱序是 `LeNat 0 1`（`le_succ` + `le_refl`），不相等把 `0 ~ 1` 化成 `0 = 1` 后交给 `succ_ne_zero`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratLtRep (ratAddRep 0 0) (ratAddRep 1 1)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLtRep_add · le_succ · le_refl · succ_ne_zero · Eq.symm。

exercises.template:
theorem demo_add_lt_add :
    ratLtRep
      (ratAddRep (qrep Nat.zero Nat.zero Nat.zero) (qrep Nat.zero Nat.zero Nat.zero))
      (ratAddRep (qrep 1 Nat.zero Nat.zero) (qrep 1 Nat.zero Nat.zero)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem demo_add_lt_add :
    ratLtRep
      (ratAddRep (qrep Nat.zero Nat.zero Nat.zero) (qrep Nat.zero Nat.zero Nat.zero))
      (ratAddRep (qrep 1 Nat.zero Nat.zero) (qrep 1 Nat.zero Nat.zero)) :=
  ratLtRep_add
    (qrep Nat.zero Nat.zero Nat.zero)
    (qrep 1 Nat.zero Nat.zero)
    (qrep Nat.zero Nat.zero Nat.zero)
    (qrep 1 Nat.zero Nat.zero)
    (And.intro
      (le_succ Nat.zero Nat.zero (le_refl Nat.zero))
      (fun (h : ratRel (qrep Nat.zero Nat.zero Nat.zero) (qrep 1 Nat.zero Nat.zero)) =>
        succ_ne_zero Nat.zero (Eq.symm h)))
    (And.intro
      (le_succ Nat.zero Nat.zero (le_refl Nat.zero))
      (fun (h : ratRel (qrep Nat.zero Nat.zero Nat.zero) (qrep 1 Nat.zero Nat.zero)) =>
        succ_ne_zero Nat.zero (Eq.symm h)))

exercises.unit: 单元52 ε 折半：半数的存在与加倍
exercises.name: half_den_two
exercises.title: 52.1 两倍的分母就是 `(m+1)+(m+1)`

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `Nat.add` 对第二个参数递归，所以 `(m+1)+(m+1)` 要用 `succ_add` 提出一个 `succ`，再把 `m+(m+1)` 用 `add_succ` 收成 `succ (m+m)`；最后取对称（目标写的是 `twoDen` 在左边）。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `twoDen m = (m+1)+(m+1)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: succ_add · add_succ · congrArg · Eq.symm。

exercises.template:
theorem half_den_two (m : Nat) :
    twoDen m = Nat.add (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ m) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem half_den_two (m : Nat) :
    twoDen m = Nat.add (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ m) :=
  @Eq.symm.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ m))
    (Nat.succ (Nat.succ (Nat.add m m)))
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (Nat.add (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ m))
      (Nat.succ (Nat.add m (Nat.succ m)))
      (Nat.succ (Nat.succ (Nat.add m m)))
      (succ_add m (Nat.succ m))
      (@congrArg.{1} Nat Nat
        (Nat.add m (Nat.succ m))
        (Nat.succ (Nat.add m m))
        Nat.succ
        (add_succ m m)))

exercises.unit: 单元52 ε 折半：半数的存在与加倍
exercises.name: den_two_mul
exercises.title: 52.2 两倍分母乘一个正分母：`D·(m+1) + D·(m+1) = D·D`
exercises.prompt: 52.2 两倍分母乘一个正分母：`D·(m+1) + D·(m+1) = D·D`

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `D = (m+1)+(m+1)`（52.1），所以 `D·D = D·((m+1)+(m+1))`；用 `mul_add` 把右边拆开，正好是 `D·(m+1) + D·(m+1)`。链是：`mul_add`（取对称）→ 在 `D·_` 下改写 52.1（取对称）→ 取对称把方向对上。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: mul_add · congrArg · half_den_two（取对称）· Eq.symm · Eq.trans。

exercises.template:
theorem den_two_mul (m : Nat) :
    Nat.add
      (myMul (twoDen m) (Nat.succ m))
      (myMul (twoDen m) (Nat.succ m)) =
    myMul (twoDen m) (twoDen m) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem den_two_mul (m : Nat) :
    Nat.add
      (myMul (twoDen m) (Nat.succ m))
      (myMul (twoDen m) (Nat.succ m)) =
    myMul (twoDen m) (twoDen m) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add
      (myMul (twoDen m) (Nat.succ m))
      (myMul (twoDen m) (Nat.succ m)))
    (myMul (twoDen m)
      (Nat.add (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ m)))
    (myMul (twoDen m) (twoDen m))
    (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
      (myMul (twoDen m)
        (Nat.add (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ m)))
      (Nat.add
        (myMul (twoDen m) (Nat.succ m))
        (myMul (twoDen m) (Nat.succ m)))
      (mul_add (twoDen m) (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ m)))
    (@congrArg.{1} Nat Nat
      (Nat.add (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ m))
      (twoDen m)
      (fun (z : Nat) => myMul (twoDen m) z)
      (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
        (twoDen m)
        (Nat.add (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ m))
        (half_den_two m)))

exercises.unit: 单元52 ε 折半：半数的存在与加倍
exercises.name: half_num_mul
exercises.title: 52.3 分子乘开：`(x·D + x·D)·(m+1) = x·(D·D)`

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 四步链。① `mul_add_right` 把 `(x·D + x·D)·(m+1)` 拆成两个 `(x·D)·(m+1)`；② `myMul_assoc`（取对称）把两个都换成 `x·(D·(m+1))`，用 `congrArg (fun z => z + z)` 一次改两个；③ `mul_add`（取对称）把两个 `x·…` 收回 `x·(D·(m+1) + D·(m+1))`；④ 在 `x·_` 下用 52.2。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: mul_add_right · myMul_assoc（取对称）· congrArg · mul_add（取对称）· den_two_mul · Eq.trans。

exercises.template:
theorem half_num_mul (x m : Nat) :
    myMul
      (Nat.add (myMul x (twoDen m)) (myMul x (twoDen m)))
      (Nat.succ m) =
    myMul x (myMul (twoDen m) (twoDen m)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem half_num_mul (x m : Nat) :
    myMul
      (Nat.add (myMul x (twoDen m)) (myMul x (twoDen m)))
      (Nat.succ m) =
    myMul x (myMul (twoDen m) (twoDen m)) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (myMul
      (Nat.add (myMul x (twoDen m)) (myMul x (twoDen m)))
      (Nat.succ m))
    (Nat.add
      (myMul (myMul x (twoDen m)) (Nat.succ m))
      (myMul (myMul x (twoDen m)) (Nat.succ m)))
    (myMul x (myMul (twoDen m) (twoDen m)))
    (mul_add_right (myMul x (twoDen m)) (myMul x (twoDen m)) (Nat.succ m))
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (Nat.add
        (myMul (myMul x (twoDen m)) (Nat.succ m))
        (myMul (myMul x (twoDen m)) (Nat.succ m)))
      (Nat.add
        (myMul x (myMul (twoDen m) (Nat.succ m)))
        (myMul x (myMul (twoDen m) (Nat.succ m))))
      (myMul x (myMul (twoDen m) (twoDen m)))
      (@congrArg.{1} Nat Nat
        (myMul (myMul x (twoDen m)) (Nat.succ m))
        (myMul x (myMul (twoDen m) (Nat.succ m)))
        (fun (z : Nat) => Nat.add z z)
        (myMul_assoc x (twoDen m) (Nat.succ m)))
      (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add
          (myMul x (myMul (twoDen m) (Nat.succ m)))
          (myMul x (myMul (twoDen m) (Nat.succ m))))
        (myMul x
          (Nat.add
            (myMul (twoDen m) (Nat.succ m))
            (myMul (twoDen m) (Nat.succ m))))
        (myMul x (myMul (twoDen m) (twoDen m)))
        (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
          (myMul x
            (Nat.add
              (myMul (twoDen m) (Nat.succ m))
              (myMul (twoDen m) (Nat.succ m))))
          (Nat.add
            (myMul x (myMul (twoDen m) (Nat.succ m)))
            (myMul x (myMul (twoDen m) (Nat.succ m))))
          (mul_add x
            (myMul (twoDen m) (Nat.succ m))
            (myMul (twoDen m) (Nat.succ m))))
        (@congrArg.{1} Nat Nat
          (Nat.add
            (myMul (twoDen m) (Nat.succ m))
            (myMul (twoDen m) (Nat.succ m)))
          (myMul (twoDen m) (twoDen m))
          (fun (z : Nat) => myMul x z)
          (den_two_mul m))))

exercises.name: ratHalf_add_self_mk
exercises.title: 52.4 字面三元组上的加倍：`x/2 + x/2 ~ x`
exercises.prompt: 52.4 字面三元组上的加倍：`x/2 + x/2 ~ x`

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 两边各用 `mulRep_den_form` 化成序对，目标变成序对相等。左坐标与右坐标分别是 52.3（两次：`x = a`、`x = b`）；另一边还要把 `succ (ratDenRep M M)` 用 `ratDenRep_succ` 换成 `D·D`（在 `a·_`、`b·_` 下各改写一次）。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel (ratHalf (qrep a b m) + ratHalf (qrep a b m)) (qrep a b m)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: intRel_of_eq · mulRep_den_form（两次）· prod_mk_congr · half_num_mul（两次）· ratDenRep_succ（两次）· congrArg · Eq.symm · Eq.trans。

exercises.template:
theorem ratHalf_add_self_mk (a b m : Nat) :
    ratRel (ratAddRep (ratHalf (qrep a b m)) (ratHalf (qrep a b m))) (qrep a b m) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratHalf_add_self_mk (a b m : Nat) :
    ratRel (ratAddRep (ratHalf (qrep a b m)) (ratHalf (qrep a b m))) (qrep a b m) :=
  intRel_of_eq
    (mulRep
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat
        (Nat.add (myMul a (twoDen m)) (myMul a (twoDen m)))
        (Nat.add (myMul b (twoDen m)) (myMul b (twoDen m))))
      (den m))
    (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)
      (den (ratDenRep (halfDen m) (halfDen m))))
    (@Eq.trans.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
      (mulRep
        (@prod_mk Nat Nat
          (Nat.add (myMul a (twoDen m)) (myMul a (twoDen m)))
          (Nat.add (myMul b (twoDen m)) (myMul b (twoDen m))))
        (den m))
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat
        (myMul (Nat.add (myMul a (twoDen m)) (myMul a (twoDen m))) (Nat.succ m))
        (myMul (Nat.add (myMul b (twoDen m)) (myMul b (twoDen m))) (Nat.succ m)))
      (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)
        (den (ratDenRep (halfDen m) (halfDen m))))
      (mulRep_den_form
        (@prod_mk Nat Nat
          (Nat.add (myMul a (twoDen m)) (myMul a (twoDen m)))
          (Nat.add (myMul b (twoDen m)) (myMul b (twoDen m))))
        m)
      (@Eq.trans.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
        (@prod_mk Nat Nat
          (myMul (Nat.add (myMul a (twoDen m)) (myMul a (twoDen m))) (Nat.succ m))
          (myMul (Nat.add (myMul b (twoDen m)) (myMul b (twoDen m))) (Nat.succ m)))
        (@prod_mk Nat Nat
          (myMul a (myMul (twoDen m) (twoDen m)))
          (myMul b (myMul (twoDen m) (twoDen m))))
        (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)
          (den (ratDenRep (halfDen m) (halfDen m))))
        (prod_mk_congr
          (myMul (Nat.add (myMul a (twoDen m)) (myMul a (twoDen m))) (Nat.succ m))
          (myMul a (myMul (twoDen m) (twoDen m)))
          (myMul (Nat.add (myMul b (twoDen m)) (myMul b (twoDen m))) (Nat.succ m))
          (myMul b (myMul (twoDen m) (twoDen m)))
          (half_num_mul a m)
          (half_num_mul b m))
        (@Eq.symm.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
          (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)
            (den (ratDenRep (halfDen m) (halfDen m))))
          (@prod_mk Nat Nat
            (myMul a (myMul (twoDen m) (twoDen m)))
            (myMul b (myMul (twoDen m) (twoDen m))))
          (@Eq.trans.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
            (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)
              (den (ratDenRep (halfDen m) (halfDen m))))
            (@prod_mk Nat Nat
              (myMul a (Nat.succ (ratDenRep (halfDen m) (halfDen m))))
              (myMul b (Nat.succ (ratDenRep (halfDen m) (halfDen m)))))
            (@prod_mk Nat Nat
              (myMul a (myMul (twoDen m) (twoDen m)))
              (myMul b (myMul (twoDen m) (twoDen m))))
            (mulRep_den_form (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)
              (ratDenRep (halfDen m) (halfDen m)))
            (prod_mk_congr
              (myMul a (Nat.succ (ratDenRep (halfDen m) (halfDen m))))
              (myMul a (myMul (twoDen m) (twoDen m)))
              (myMul b (Nat.succ (ratDenRep (halfDen m) (halfDen m))))
              (myMul b (myMul (twoDen m) (twoDen m)))
              (@congrArg.{1} Nat Nat
                (Nat.succ (ratDenRep (halfDen m) (halfDen m)))
                (myMul (twoDen m) (twoDen m))
                (fun (z : Nat) => myMul a z)
                (ratDenRep_succ (halfDen m) (halfDen m)))
              (@congrArg.{1} Nat Nat
                (Nat.succ (ratDenRep (halfDen m) (halfDen m)))
                (myMul (twoDen m) (twoDen m))
                (fun (z : Nat) => myMul b z)
                (ratDenRep_succ (halfDen m) (halfDen m))))))))

exercises.name: ratLeRep_half_of_lt
exercises.title: 53.1 `0 < ε` ⇒ `0 ≤ ε/2`

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 用 `ratLeRep_total` 把目标 `0 ≤ ε/2` 与 `ε/2 ≤ 0` 两支切开，右支导出矛盾（`False.elim`）。矛盾链：`ε/2 ≤ 0` 经 `ratLeRep_add_right` 得 `ε/2+ε/2 ≤ 0+ε/2`，`ε/2 ≤ 0` 再经 `ratLeRep_add_left`（`z = 0`）得 `0+ε/2 ≤ 0+0`，`ratLeRep_trans` 串起来；再用 `ratAdd_zero 0` 把右端换成 `0`（`ratLeRep_congr_gen`），用 `ratHalf_add_self` 把左端换成 `ε`，得到 `ε ≤ 0`；与 `And.left h` 用 `ratLeRep_antisymm` 夹出 `0 ~ ε`，撞上 `And.right h`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratLtRep 0 eps → ratLeRep 0 (ratHalf eps)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLeRep_total · ratLeRep_add_right · ratLeRep_add_left · ratLeRep_trans · ratLeRep_congr_gen · ratAdd_zero · ratHalf_add_self · ratLeRep_antisymm · False.elim。

exercises.template:
theorem ratLeRep_half_of_lt (eps : ratRep) (h : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) :
    ratLeRep ratZeroRep (ratHalf eps) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratLeRep_half_of_lt (eps : ratRep) (h : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) :
    ratLeRep ratZeroRep (ratHalf eps) :=
  Or.elim
    (fun (hh : ratLeRep ratZeroRep (ratHalf eps)) => hh)
    (fun (hh : ratLeRep (ratHalf eps) ratZeroRep) =>
      False.elim
        (And.right h
          (ratLeRep_antisymm ratZeroRep eps
            (And.left h)
            (ratLeRep_congr_gen
              (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps)) eps
              ratZeroRep ratZeroRep
              (ratHalf_add_self eps) (ratRel_refl ratZeroRep)
              (ratLeRep_congr_gen
                (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps))
                (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps))
                (ratAddRep ratZeroRep ratZeroRep) ratZeroRep
                (ratRel_refl (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps)))
                (ratAdd_zero ratZeroRep)
                (ratLeRep_trans
                  (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps))
                  (ratAddRep ratZeroRep (ratHalf eps))
                  (ratAddRep ratZeroRep ratZeroRep)
                  (ratLeRep_add_right (ratHalf eps) ratZeroRep (ratHalf eps) hh)
                  (ratLeRep_add_left (ratHalf eps) ratZeroRep ratZeroRep hh)))))))
    (ratLeRep_total ratZeroRep (ratHalf eps))

exercises.unit: 单元53 半数的正性：0 < ε ⇒ 0 < ε/2
exercises.name: ratRel_half_zero
exercises.title: 53.2 `ε/2 ~ 0` ⇒ `ε ~ 0`

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `h0 : ε/2 ~ 0` 的两个方向各用 `ratLeRep_of_ratRel` 读成弱序。`ε/2+ε/2 ≤ 0+0` 由「右加 `ε/2 ≤ 0`、再左加 `0 ≤ 0`（`z = 0`）」串联；`0+0 ≤ ε/2+ε/2` 由「左加 `0 ≤ ε/2`（`z = 0`）、再右加同一个」串联；`ratLeRep_antisymm` 得到 `ε/2+ε/2 ~ 0+0`，串 `ratAdd_zero 0` 得 `ε/2+ε/2 ~ 0`，最后从 `ε ~ ε/2+ε/2`（`ratHalf_add_self` 取对称）过去。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel (ratHalf eps) 0 → ratRel eps 0`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLeRep_of_ratRel · ratRel_symm · ratLeRep_add_right · ratLeRep_add_left · ratLeRep_trans · ratLeRep_antisymm · ratRel_trans_gen · ratAdd_zero · ratHalf_add_self。

exercises.template:
theorem ratRel_half_zero (eps : ratRep)
    (h0 : ratRel (ratHalf eps) ratZeroRep) : ratRel eps ratZeroRep :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratRel_half_zero (eps : ratRep)
    (h0 : ratRel (ratHalf eps) ratZeroRep) : ratRel eps ratZeroRep :=
  ratRel_trans_gen eps (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps)) ratZeroRep
    (ratRel_symm (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps)) eps (ratHalf_add_self eps))
    (ratRel_trans_gen
      (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps))
      (ratAddRep ratZeroRep ratZeroRep) ratZeroRep
      (ratLeRep_antisymm
        (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps))
        (ratAddRep ratZeroRep ratZeroRep)
        (ratLeRep_trans
          (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps))
          (ratAddRep ratZeroRep (ratHalf eps))
          (ratAddRep ratZeroRep ratZeroRep)
          (ratLeRep_add_right (ratHalf eps) ratZeroRep (ratHalf eps)
            (ratLeRep_of_ratRel (ratHalf eps) ratZeroRep h0))
          (ratLeRep_add_left (ratHalf eps) ratZeroRep ratZeroRep
            (ratLeRep_of_ratRel (ratHalf eps) ratZeroRep h0)))
        (ratLeRep_trans
          (ratAddRep ratZeroRep ratZeroRep)
          (ratAddRep ratZeroRep (ratHalf eps))
          (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps))
          (ratLeRep_add_left ratZeroRep (ratHalf eps) ratZeroRep
            (ratLeRep_of_ratRel ratZeroRep (ratHalf eps)
              (ratRel_symm (ratHalf eps) ratZeroRep h0)))
          (ratLeRep_add_right ratZeroRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps)
            (ratLeRep_of_ratRel ratZeroRep (ratHalf eps)
              (ratRel_symm (ratHalf eps) ratZeroRep h0)))))
      (ratAdd_zero ratZeroRep))

exercises.name: ratLtRep_half
exercises.title: ratLtRep_half

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 弱序是 53.1；不相等假设 `0 ~ ε/2`，取对称后交给 53.2 得 `ε ~ 0`，再对称一次撞上 53.3 的前一条投影。

hints.label: 关键件

exercises.template:

theorem ratLtRep_half (eps : ratRep) (h : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) :

exercises.unit: 单元54 有理数加法的结合律：公分母的三层嵌套
exercises.name: den_assoc
exercises.title: 54.1 分母的结合律：`ratDenRep (ratDenRep m n) k = ratDenRep m (ratDenRep n k)`
exercises.prompt: 54.1 分母的结合律：`ratDenRep (ratDenRep m n) k = ratDenRep m (ratDenRep n k)`

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 两边各用 `ratDenRep_succ` 把 `succ` 提到 `(m+1)(n+1)` 的形状；再用 `myMul_assoc` 把 `(AB)C` 与 `A(BC)` 对齐；最后 `Nat.succ.inj` 剥掉最外层的 `succ`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratDenRep (ratDenRep m n) k = ratDenRep m (ratDenRep n k)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratDenRep_succ · myMul_assoc · congrArg · Nat.succ.inj · Eq.trans · Eq.symm。

exercises.template:
theorem den_assoc (m n k : Nat) :
    ratDenRep (ratDenRep m n) k = ratDenRep m (ratDenRep n k) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem den_assoc (m n k : Nat) :
    ratDenRep (ratDenRep m n) k = ratDenRep m (ratDenRep n k) :=
  Nat.succ.inj
    (ratDenRep (ratDenRep m n) k)
    (ratDenRep m (ratDenRep n k))
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (Nat.succ (ratDenRep (ratDenRep m n) k))
      (myMul (myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ n)) (Nat.succ k))
      (Nat.succ (ratDenRep m (ratDenRep n k)))
      (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (Nat.succ (ratDenRep (ratDenRep m n) k))
        (myMul (Nat.succ (ratDenRep m n)) (Nat.succ k))
        (myMul (myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ n)) (Nat.succ k))
        (ratDenRep_succ (ratDenRep m n) k)
        (@congrArg.{1} Nat Nat
          (Nat.succ (ratDenRep m n))
          (myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ n))
          (fun (x : Nat) => myMul x (Nat.succ k))
          (ratDenRep_succ m n)))
      (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
        (Nat.succ (ratDenRep m (ratDenRep n k)))
        (myMul (myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ n)) (Nat.succ k))
        (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
          (Nat.succ (ratDenRep m (ratDenRep n k)))
          (myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ (ratDenRep n k)))
          (myMul (myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ n)) (Nat.succ k))
          (ratDenRep_succ m (ratDenRep n k))
          (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
            (myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ (ratDenRep n k)))
            (myMul (Nat.succ m) (myMul (Nat.succ n) (Nat.succ k)))
            (myMul (myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ n)) (Nat.succ k))
            (@congrArg.{1} Nat Nat
              (Nat.succ (ratDenRep n k))
              (myMul (Nat.succ n) (Nat.succ k))
              (fun (x : Nat) => myMul (Nat.succ m) x)
              (ratDenRep_succ n k))
            (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
              (myMul (myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ n)) (Nat.succ k))
              (myMul (Nat.succ m) (myMul (Nat.succ n) (Nat.succ k)))
              (myMul_assoc (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ n) (Nat.succ k)))))))

exercises.name: assoc_num1
exercises.title: 54.2 分子的结合律（上分量）
exercises.prompt: 54.2 分子的结合律（上分量）

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 左式先用 `mul_add_right` 展开成 `(aB)C + (cA)C`，两个乘积各用一次 `myMul_assoc` 归一到 `a(BC)`、`c(AC)`，再用 `add_assoc` 把括号右结合。右式反向走同一条链（`mul_add_right` + `myMul_assoc` + `add_assoc` 的对称）。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `((aB + cA)C + e(AB)) = a(BC) + (c(AC) + e(AB))`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: mul_add_right · myMul_assoc · add_assoc · congrArg · Eq.trans · Eq.symm。

exercises.template:
theorem assoc_num1 (a b c d e f m n k : Nat) :
    Nat.add
      (myMul (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ n)) (myMul c (Nat.succ m))) (Nat.succ k))
      (myMul e (myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ n))) =
    Nat.add
      (myMul a (myMul (Nat.succ n) (Nat.succ k)))
      (Nat.add
        (myMul c (myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ k)))
        (myMul e (myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ n)))) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem assoc_num1 (a b c d e f m n k : Nat) :
    Nat.add
      (myMul (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ n)) (myMul c (Nat.succ m))) (Nat.succ k))
      (myMul e (myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ n))) =
    Nat.add
      (myMul a (myMul (Nat.succ n) (Nat.succ k)))
      (myMul (Nat.add (myMul c (Nat.succ k)) (myMul e (Nat.succ n))) (Nat.succ m)) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add
      (myMul (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ n)) (myMul c (Nat.succ m))) (Nat.succ k))
      (myMul e (myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ n))))
    (Nat.add
      (myMul a (myMul (Nat.succ n) (Nat.succ k)))
      (Nat.add
        (myMul c (myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ k)))
        (myMul e (myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ n)))))
    (Nat.add
      (myMul a (myMul (Nat.succ n) (Nat.succ k)))
      (myMul (Nat.add (myMul c (Nat.succ k)) (myMul e (Nat.succ n))) (Nat.succ m)))
    (assoc_lhs a b c d e f m n k)
    (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
      (Nat.add
        (myMul a (myMul (Nat.succ n) (Nat.succ k)))
        (myMul (Nat.add (myMul c (Nat.succ k)) (myMul e (Nat.succ n))) (Nat.succ m)))
      (Nat.add
        (myMul a (myMul (Nat.succ n) (Nat.succ k)))
        (Nat.add
          (myMul c (myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ k)))
          (myMul e (myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ n)))))
      (assoc_rhs a b c d e f m n k))

exercises.prompt: 54.3 字面三元组上的结合律

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 嵌套的 `ratAddRep` 在字面 `qrep` 上可以定义性化成显式 `qrep`（`ratAddRep_mk` 一步，甚至 `ratRel_refl` 直接认）。两边化开后，分母用 54.1、分子用 54.2 的两条等式对齐；`qrep_congr`（`prod_mk_congr` + `congrArg`）把两个 `qrep` 收成同一个，再用 `ratRel_refl`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel ((X + Y) + Z) (X + (Y + Z))`，其中 `X = qrep a b m` 等。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratAddRep_mk · den_assoc · assoc_num1 · qrep_congr · prod_mk_congr · ratRel_refl · Eq.subst · ratRel_trans_gen。

exercises.template:
theorem ratAdd_assoc_mk (a b c d e f m n k : Nat) :
    ratRel
      (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (qrep a b m) (qrep c d n)) (qrep e f k))
      (ratAddRep (qrep a b m) (ratAddRep (qrep c d n) (qrep e f k))) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratAdd_assoc_mk (a b c d e f m n k : Nat) :
    ratRel
      (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (qrep a b m) (qrep c d n)) (qrep e f k))
      (ratAddRep (qrep a b m) (ratAddRep (qrep c d n) (qrep e f k))) :=
  @ratRel_trans_gen
    (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (qrep a b m) (qrep c d n)) (qrep e f k))
    (qR a b c d e f m n k)
    (ratAddRep (qrep a b m) (ratAddRep (qrep c d n) (qrep e f k)))
    (@Eq.subst.{1} ratRep
      (fun (w : ratRep) =>
        ratRel
          (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (qrep a b m) (qrep c d n)) (qrep e f k)) w)
      (qL a b c d e f m n k)
      (qR a b c d e f m n k)
      (@Eq.trans.{1} ratRep
        (qL a b c d e f m n k)
        (qrep
          (Nat.add
            (myMul a (Nat.succ (ratDenRep n k)))
            (myMul (Nat.add (myMul c (Nat.succ k)) (myMul e (Nat.succ n))) (Nat.succ m)))
          (Nat.add
            (myMul b (Nat.succ (ratDenRep n k)))
            (myMul (Nat.add (myMul d (Nat.succ k)) (myMul f (Nat.succ n))) (Nat.succ m)))
          (ratDenRep (ratDenRep m n) k))
        (qR a b c d e f m n k)
        (qrep_congr
          (Nat.add
            (myMul (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ n)) (myMul c (Nat.succ m))) (Nat.succ k))
            (myMul e (Nat.succ (ratDenRep m n))))
          (Nat.add
            (myMul a (Nat.succ (ratDenRep n k)))
            (myMul (Nat.add (myMul c (Nat.succ k)) (myMul e (Nat.succ n))) (Nat.succ m)))
          (Nat.add
            (myMul (Nat.add (myMul b (Nat.succ n)) (myMul d (Nat.succ m))) (Nat.succ k))
            (myMul f (Nat.succ (ratDenRep m n))))
          (Nat.add
            (myMul b (Nat.succ (ratDenRep n k)))
            (myMul (Nat.add (myMul d (Nat.succ k)) (myMul f (Nat.succ n))) (Nat.succ m)))
          (ratDenRep (ratDenRep m n) k)
          (ratDenRep (ratDenRep m n) k)
          (assoc_num1_lit a b c d e f m n k)
          (assoc_num2_lit a b c d e f m n k)
          (Eq.refl (ratDenRep (ratDenRep m n) k)))
        (@congrArg.{1} Nat ratRep
          (ratDenRep (ratDenRep m n) k)
          (ratDenRep m (ratDenRep n k))
          (fun (x : Nat) =>
            qrep
              (Nat.add
                (myMul a (Nat.succ (ratDenRep n k)))
                (myMul (Nat.add (myMul c (Nat.succ k)) (myMul e (Nat.succ n))) (Nat.succ m)))
              (Nat.add
                (myMul b (Nat.succ (ratDenRep n k)))
                (myMul (Nat.add (myMul d (Nat.succ k)) (myMul f (Nat.succ n))) (Nat.succ m)))
              x)
          (den_assoc m n k)))
      (ratRel_refl
        (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (qrep a b m) (qrep c d n)) (qrep e f k))))
    (ratRel_refl
      (ratAddRep (qrep a b m) (ratAddRep (qrep c d n) (qrep e f k))))

exercises.name: ratAdd_neg_mk
exercises.title: 55.1 字面三元组：`qrep a b m + -(qrep a b m) ~ 0`
exercises.prompt: 55.1 字面三元组：`qrep a b m + -(qrep a b m) ~ 0`

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先展开。`ratAddRep (qrep a b m) (ratNegRep (qrep a b m))` 的分子是 `(A, B)`，其中 `A = a·(m+1) + b·(m+1)`、`B = b·(m+1) + a·(m+1)`，分母字段是 `ratDenRep m m`。`ratRel` 的交叉乘积把 `den 0 = (1,0)` 与 `den (ratDenRep m m)` 带进来，于是左边多出 `(x+0)+0` 的尾巴、右边多出 `myMul 0 (succ D)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: `zero_mul`（把 `myMul Nat.zero (Nat.succ D)` 换成 `0`；`Eq.subst` 的方向要写成 `0 = z`）· `zero_add` / `add_zero`（收掉零尾巴）· `add_comm`（两个分子坐标交换）· `Eq.trans`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel (ratAddRep (qrep a b m) (ratNegRep (qrep a b m))) ratZeroRep`。

exercises.template:
theorem ratAdd_neg_mk (a b m : Nat) :
    ratRel (ratAddRep (qrep a b m) (ratNegRep (qrep a b m))) ratZeroRep :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratAdd_neg_mk (a b m : Nat) :
    ratRel (ratAddRep (qrep a b m) (ratNegRep (qrep a b m))) ratZeroRep :=
  @Eq.subst.{1} Nat
    (fun (z : Nat) =>
      Nat.add
        (Nat.add
          (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ m)) (myMul b (Nat.succ m))) Nat.zero)
          Nat.zero)
        (Nat.add Nat.zero z) =
      Nat.add
        (Nat.add z Nat.zero)
        (Nat.add Nat.zero
          (Nat.add
            (Nat.add (myMul b (Nat.succ m)) (myMul a (Nat.succ m)))
            Nat.zero)))
    Nat.zero
    (myMul Nat.zero (Nat.succ (ratDenRep m m)))
    (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (myMul Nat.zero (Nat.succ (ratDenRep m m))) Nat.zero (zero_mul (Nat.succ (ratDenRep m m))))
    (neg_zero_case a b m)

exercises.unit: 单元56 两次减法的相加：中间项消去
exercises.name: ratAddRep_wd_gen
exercises.title: 56.1 `ratAddRep` 对第一个变元的通用同余
exercises.prompt: 56.1 `ratAddRep` 对第一个变元的通用同余

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `ratRel x x'` 给两个方向的弱序（㉙ 的 `ratLeRep_of_ratRel`）；各加同一个 `z`（㊹ 的 `ratLeRep_add_right`），再用 ㊻ 的 `ratLeRep_antisymm` 把两条弱序夹成 `ratRel`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel x x' → ratRel (ratAddRep x z) (ratAddRep x' z)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLeRep_of_ratRel · ratLeRep_add_right · ratLeRep_antisymm · ratRel_symm。

exercises.template:
theorem ratAddRep_wd_gen (x x' z : ratRep) (h : ratRel x x') :
    ratRel (ratAddRep x z) (ratAddRep x' z) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratAddRep_wd_gen (x x' z : ratRep) (h : ratRel x x') :
    ratRel (ratAddRep x z) (ratAddRep x' z) :=
  ratLeRep_antisymm (ratAddRep x z) (ratAddRep x' z)
    (ratLeRep_add_right x x' z (ratLeRep_of_ratRel x x' h))
    (ratLeRep_add_right x' x z
      (ratLeRep_of_ratRel x' x (ratRel_symm x x' h)))

hints.label: 目标形态

    (ratLeRep_add_left z z' x (ratLeRep_of_ratRel z z' h))

      (ratLeRep_of_ratRel z' z (ratRel_symm z z' h)))

exercises.unit: 单元56 两次减法的相加：中间项消去
exercises.name: ratSubRep_add
exercises.title: 56.4 主定理：`(x - y) + (y - z) ~ x - z`

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 四步链。① 54 的结合律把 `(x + -y) + (y + -z)` 收成 `x + (-y + (y + -z))`；② 结合律**反向**把中间的 `-y + (y + -z)` 改写成 `(-y + y) + -z`；③ 56.3 把 `-y + y` 换成 `0`（同余 56.2）；④ ㊸ 的 `ratAdd_zero_left` 收掉 `0 + -z`。每一步都用 `ratRel_trans_gen` 串，同余用 56.1/56.2。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x y) (ratSubRep y z)) (ratSubRep x z)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratAdd_assoc（两次，一次取对称）· ratAddRep_wd_gen · ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen · ratNegRep_add_self · ratAdd_zero_left · ratRel_trans_gen。

exercises.template:
theorem ratSubRep_add (x y z : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x y) (ratSubRep y z)) (ratSubRep x z) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratSubRep_add (x y z : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x y) (ratSubRep y z)) (ratSubRep x z) :=
  ratRel_trans_gen
    (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x y) (ratSubRep y z))
    (ratAddRep x (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) (ratAddRep y (ratNegRep z))))
    (ratSubRep x z)
    (ratAdd_assoc x (ratNegRep y) (ratAddRep y (ratNegRep z)))
    (ratRel_trans_gen
      (ratAddRep x (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) (ratAddRep y (ratNegRep z))))
      (ratAddRep x (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) y) (ratNegRep z)))
      (ratSubRep x z)
      (ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen x
        (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) (ratAddRep y (ratNegRep z)))
        (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) y) (ratNegRep z))
        (ratRel_symm
          (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) y) (ratNegRep z))
          (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) (ratAddRep y (ratNegRep z)))
          (ratAdd_assoc (ratNegRep y) y (ratNegRep z))))
      (ratRel_trans_gen
        (ratAddRep x (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) y) (ratNegRep z)))
        (ratAddRep x (ratAddRep ratZeroRep (ratNegRep z)))
        (ratSubRep x z)
        (ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen x
          (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) y) (ratNegRep z))
          (ratAddRep ratZeroRep (ratNegRep z))
          (ratAddRep_wd_gen
            (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) y) ratZeroRep (ratNegRep z)
            (ratNegRep_add_self y)))
        (ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen x
          (ratAddRep ratZeroRep (ratNegRep z))
          (ratNegRep z)
          (ratAdd_zero_left (ratNegRep z)))))

exercises.unit: 单元57 close 的传递性：两个 ε/2 的界加起来
exercises.name: ratLtRep_congr_snd
exercises.title: 57.1 严格序在右端沿 `ratRel` 搬运
exercises.prompt: 57.1 严格序在右端沿 `ratRel` 搬运

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `ratLtRep a b` 是 `ratLeRep a b ∧ ¬ ratRel a b`。弱序沿 `b ~ c` 用 ㊴ 的 `ratLeRep_congr_gen` 搬过去（第一个因子取 `ratRel_refl a`）；不相等部分假设 `a ~ c`，与 `c ~ b` 串成 `a ~ b`，撞上第二分量。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratLtRep a b → ratRel b c → ratLtRep a c`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: And.intro · ratLeRep_congr_gen · ratRel_trans_gen · ratRel_symm · And.right。

exercises.template:
theorem ratLtRep_congr_snd (a b c : ratRep)
    (h : ratLtRep a b) (hbc : ratRel b c) : ratLtRep a c :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratLtRep_congr_snd (a b c : ratRep)
    (h : ratLtRep a b) (hbc : ratRel b c) : ratLtRep a c :=
  And.intro
    (ratLeRep_congr_gen a a b c (ratRel_refl a) hbc (And.left h))
    (fun (hac : ratRel a c) =>
      And.right h
        (ratRel_trans_gen a c b hac (ratRel_symm b c hbc)))

exercises.template:
theorem ratAdd_lt_half (dx dy eps : ratRep)

  ratLtRep_congr_snd
    (ratAddRep dx dy)

exercises.unit: 单元57 close 的传递性：两个 ε/2 的界加起来
exercises.name: close_trans
exercises.title: 57.3 主定理：`close` 的传递性
exercises.prompt: 57.3 主定理：`close` 的传递性

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 两个 `Exists.elim` 取出见证 `dx`、`dy`；用 ㊺ 的 `ratAbsRel_total` 给 `(x - y) + (y - z)` 取见证 `d`；三角不等式（㊽ 的 `ratLeRep_abs_add`）给 `d ≤ dx + dy`；57.2 给 `dx + dy < ε`；`d < ε` 由 51 的 `ratLtRep_of_le_lt` 夹出来。绝对值的第一分量沿 56 的 `ratSubRep_add` 用 ㊷ 的 `ratAbsRel_wd_left` 搬到 `x - z`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `close x y (ratHalf eps) → close y z (ratHalf eps) → close x z eps`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.elim · Exists.intro · ratAbsRel_total · ratSubRep_add · ratAbsRel_wd_left · ratLeRep_abs_add · ratLtRep_of_le_lt · ratAdd_lt_half。

exercises.template:
theorem close_trans (x y z eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps)
    (hxy : close x y (ratHalf eps)) (hyz : close y z (ratHalf eps)) :
    close x z eps :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem close_trans (x y z eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps)
    (hxy : close x y (ratHalf eps)) (hyz : close y z (ratHalf eps)) :
    close x z eps :=
  Exists.elim hxy
    (fun (dx : ratRep)
        (hdx : ratAbsRel (ratSubRep x y) dx ∧ ratLtRep dx (ratHalf eps)) =>
      Exists.elim hyz
        (fun (dy : ratRep)
            (hdy : ratAbsRel (ratSubRep y z) dy ∧ ratLtRep dy (ratHalf eps)) =>
          Exists.elim
            (ratAbsRel_total
              (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x y) (ratSubRep y z)))
            (fun (d : ratRep)
                (hd : ratAbsRel
                  (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x y) (ratSubRep y z)) d) =>
              Exists.intro d
                (And.intro
                  (ratAbsRel_wd_left
                    (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x y) (ratSubRep y z))
                    (ratSubRep x z)
                    d
                    (ratSubRep_add x y z)
                    hd)
                  (ratLtRep_of_le_lt d (ratAddRep dx dy) eps
                    (ratLeRep_abs_add
                      (ratSubRep x y) (ratSubRep y z) dx dy d
                      (And.left hdx) (And.left hdy) hd)
                    (ratAdd_lt_half dx dy eps
                      (And.right hdx) (And.right hdy)))))))

hints.label: 思路

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `close ratZeroRep ratZeroRep (qrep 2 0 0)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: close_trans · close_zero_zero · ratLtRep_half · leNat_zero_le · succ_ne_zero · Eq.symm。

exercises.template:
theorem demo_close_trans :
    close ratZeroRep ratZeroRep (qrep 2 Nat.zero Nat.zero) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem demo_close_trans :
    close ratZeroRep ratZeroRep (qrep 2 Nat.zero Nat.zero) :=
  close_trans ratZeroRep ratZeroRep ratZeroRep (qrep 2 Nat.zero Nat.zero)
    (And.intro
      (leNat_zero_le 2)
      (fun (h : ratRel ratZeroRep (qrep 2 Nat.zero Nat.zero)) =>
        succ_ne_zero 1
          (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat Nat.zero (Nat.succ (Nat.succ Nat.zero)) h)))
    (close_zero_zero (ratHalf (qrep 2 Nat.zero Nat.zero))
      (ratLtRep_half (qrep 2 Nat.zero Nat.zero)
        (And.intro
          (leNat_zero_le 2)
          (fun (h : ratRel ratZeroRep (qrep 2 Nat.zero Nat.zero)) =>
            succ_ne_zero 1
              (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat Nat.zero (Nat.succ (Nat.succ Nat.zero)) h)))))
    (close_zero_zero (ratHalf (qrep 2 Nat.zero Nat.zero))
      (ratLtRep_half (qrep 2 Nat.zero Nat.zero)
        (And.intro
          (leNat_zero_le 2)
          (fun (h : ratRel ratZeroRep (qrep 2 Nat.zero Nat.zero)) =>
            succ_ne_zero 1
              (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat Nat.zero (Nat.succ (Nat.succ Nat.zero)) h)))))

exercises.unit: 单元58 实数的相等：传递性
exercises.name: leNat_max
exercises.title: 58.1 两个 ℕ 阈值的合并
exercises.prompt: 58.1 两个 ℕ 阈值的合并

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 用 ㊺ 的 `leNat_total` 把 `m ≤ n` 与 `n ≤ m` 分成两支。第一支取 `N = n`：`m ≤ n` 就是假设，`n ≤ n` 用构造子 `LeNat.le_refl n`；第二支取 `N = m`：`m ≤ m` 是 `LeNat.le_refl m`，`n ≤ m` 就是假设（注意两个分量的顺序：第一个是 `m ≤ N`，第二个是 `n ≤ N`）。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `∃ N, LeNat m N ∧ LeNat n N`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: leNat_total · LeNat.le_refl · Exists.intro · And.intro（`Or.elim` 的两个分支在前，`Or` 的证明在最后）。

exercises.template:
theorem leNat_max (m n : Nat) : ∃ (N : Nat), LeNat m N ∧ LeNat n N :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem leNat_max (m n : Nat) : ∃ (N : Nat), LeNat m N ∧ LeNat n N :=
  Or.elim
    (fun (h : LeNat m n) =>
      Exists.intro n (And.intro h (LeNat.le_refl n)))
    (fun (h : LeNat n m) =>
      Exists.intro m (And.intro (LeNat.le_refl m) h))
    (leNat_total m n)

exercises.name: realRel_close_trans
