exercises.prompt: 58.2 逐点 `close` 的传递

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先对 `ε/2` 取两个阈值（`ratLtRep_half eps heps` 给 `0 < ε/2`），用 58.1 合并成 `N`；对 `n ≥ N`，两个前提各自用 `leNat_trans` 把 `n ≥ N ≥ N1`、`n ≥ N ≥ N2` 落到 `n`，再交给 `close_trans (x n) (y n) (z n) eps heps`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: 两个「逐点 close」前提 ⇒ `∀ eps > 0, ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, close (x n) (z n) eps`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.elim · Exists.intro · ratLtRep_half · leNat_max · leNat_trans · close_trans。

exercises.template:
theorem realRel_close_trans (x y z : Seq)
    (hxy : ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
      ∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n → close (x n) (y n) eps)
    (hyz : ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
      ∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n → close (y n) (z n) eps) :
    ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
      ∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n → close (x n) (z n) eps :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem realRel_close_trans (x y z : Seq)
    (hxy : ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
      ∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n → close (x n) (y n) eps)
    (hyz : ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
      ∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n → close (y n) (z n) eps) :
    ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
      ∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n → close (x n) (z n) eps :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (hxy (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
      (fun (N1 : Nat)
          (h1 : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N1 n → close (x n) (y n) (ratHalf eps)) =>
        Exists.elim (hyz (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
          (fun (N2 : Nat)
              (h2 : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N2 n → close (y n) (z n) (ratHalf eps)) =>
            Exists.elim (leNat_max N1 N2)
              (fun (N : Nat) (hN : LeNat N1 N ∧ LeNat N2 N) =>
                Exists.intro N
                  (fun (n : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) =>
                    close_trans (x n) (y n) (z n) eps heps
                      (h1 n (leNat_trans N1 N n (And.left hN) hn))
                      (h2 n (leNat_trans N2 N n (And.right hN) hn))))))

exercises.unit: 单元58 实数的相等：传递性
exercises.name: realRel_trans
exercises.title: 58.3 主定理：`realRel` 的传递性
exercises.prompt: 58.3 主定理：`realRel` 的传递性

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `realRel x z` 是 `Cauchy x ∧ Cauchy z ∧ 逐点 close`。第一分量取 `And.left hxy`；第二分量是 `hyz` 的第二个分量 `And.left (And.right hyz)`（小心 `hxy` / `hyz` 里第一个 `Cauchy` 是哪个序列）；第三分量交给 58.2，两个前提分别是 `And.right (And.right hxy)` 与 `And.right (And.right hyz)`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `realRel x y → realRel y z → realRel x z`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: And.intro（两次）· And.left · And.right · realRel_close_trans。

exercises.template:
theorem realRel_trans (x y z : Seq) (hxy : realRel x y) (hyz : realRel y z) :
    realRel x z :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem realRel_trans (x y z : Seq) (hxy : realRel x y) (hyz : realRel y z) :
    realRel x z :=
  And.intro
    (And.left hxy)
    (And.intro
      (And.left (And.right hyz))
      (realRel_close_trans x y z
        (And.right (And.right hxy))
        (And.right (And.right hyz))))

exercises.name: ratSubRep_neg_neg
exercises.title: 59.1 代表元层：`(-x) - (-y) ~ -(x - y)`

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `(-x) - (-y)` 是 `-x + -(-y)`。用 ㉛ 的对合 `ratNegRep_invol` 把 `-(-y)` 换成 `y`（`ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen`），再用 ㊸ 的 `ratAdd_comm` 把 `-x + y` 换成 `y + -x`（即 `y - x`），最后接上 ㊷ 的 `ratSubRep_neg`。两次 `ratRel_trans_gen` 串起来。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel (ratSubRep (-x) (-y)) (ratNegRep (ratSubRep x y))`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratNegRep_invol · ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen · ratAdd_comm · ratSubRep_neg · ratRel_trans_gen（两次）。

exercises.template:
theorem ratSubRep_neg_neg (x y : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratSubRep (ratNegRep x) (ratNegRep y))
           (ratNegRep (ratSubRep x y)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratSubRep_neg_neg (x y : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratSubRep (ratNegRep x) (ratNegRep y))
           (ratNegRep (ratSubRep x y)) :=
  ratRel_trans_gen
    (ratSubRep (ratNegRep x) (ratNegRep y))
    (ratSubRep y x)
    (ratNegRep (ratSubRep x y))
    (ratRel_trans_gen
      (ratAddRep (ratNegRep x) (ratNegRep (ratNegRep y)))
      (ratAddRep (ratNegRep x) y)
      (ratAddRep y (ratNegRep x))
      (ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen (ratNegRep x) (ratNegRep (ratNegRep y)) y
        (ratNegRep_invol y))
      (ratAdd_comm (ratNegRep x) y))
    (ratSubRep_neg x y)

exercises.unit: 单元59 实数的取负：第一次把运算下降到商上
exercises.name: close_neg
exercises.title: 59.2 `close` 在取负下不变
exercises.prompt: 59.2 `close` 在取负下不变

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 取出 `|x - y| ~ d` 的见证 `d`。先用 ㊶ 的 `ratAbsRel_neg_gen` 把绝对值搬到 `|-(x - y)|`；59.1 的方向是 `|(-x)-(-y)| ~ |-(x-y)|`，取对称后用 ㊷ 的 `ratAbsRel_wd_left` 从 `|-(x-y)|` 搬到 `|(-x)-(-y)|`；`d < eps` 原样交出去。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `close x y eps → close (-x) (-y) eps`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.elim · Exists.intro · And.intro · ratAbsRel_neg_gen · ratRel_symm · ratAbsRel_wd_left · ratSubRep_neg_neg。

exercises.template:
theorem close_neg (x y eps : ratRep) (h : close x y eps) :
    close (ratNegRep x) (ratNegRep y) eps :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem close_neg (x y eps : ratRep) (h : close x y eps) :
    close (ratNegRep x) (ratNegRep y) eps :=
  Exists.elim h
    (fun (d : ratRep) (hd : ratAbsRel (ratSubRep x y) d ∧ ratLtRep d eps) =>
      Exists.intro d
        (And.intro
          (ratAbsRel_wd_left
            (ratNegRep (ratSubRep x y))
            (ratSubRep (ratNegRep x) (ratNegRep y))
            d
            (ratRel_symm
              (ratSubRep (ratNegRep x) (ratNegRep y))
              (ratNegRep (ratSubRep x y))
              (ratSubRep_neg_neg x y))
            (ratAbsRel_neg_gen (ratSubRep x y) d (And.left hd)))
          (And.right hd)))

hints.label: 思路

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Cauchy x → Cauchy (negSeq x)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.elim · Exists.intro · close_neg。

exercises.template:
theorem cauchy_neg (x : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) : Cauchy (negSeq x) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem cauchy_neg (x : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) : Cauchy (negSeq x) :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (hx eps heps)
      (fun (N : Nat)
           (hN : ∀ (n m : Nat), LeNat N n → LeNat N m → close (x n) (x m) eps) =>

exercises.name: realRel_neg
exercises.title: 59.4 取负与 `realRel` 相容
exercises.prompt: 59.4 取负与 `realRel` 相容

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `realRel (negSeq x) (negSeq y)` 是三元组。两个 `Cauchy` 分量是 59.3（分别对 `x`、`y`；`Cauchy y` 是 `h` 的第二个分量）；第三分量逐点用 59.2。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `realRel x y → realRel (negSeq x) (negSeq y)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: And.intro（两次）· And.left · And.right · cauchy_neg · close_neg。

exercises.template:
theorem realRel_neg (x y : Seq) (h : realRel x y) :
    realRel (negSeq x) (negSeq y) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem realRel_neg (x y : Seq) (h : realRel x y) :
    realRel (negSeq x) (negSeq y) :=
  And.intro
    (cauchy_neg x (And.left h))
    (And.intro
      (cauchy_neg y (And.left (And.right h)))
      (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
        Exists.elim (realRel_close x y h eps heps)
          (fun (N : Nat)
               (hN : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n → close (x n) (y n) eps) =>
            Exists.intro N
              (fun (n : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) =>
                close_neg (x n) (y n) eps (hN n hn)))))

exercises.unit: 单元60 实数的加法：下降之前的两条义务
exercises.name: ratSubRep_add_sub
exercises.title: 60.1 代表元层：`(x + y) - (x' + y') ~ (x - x') + (y - y')`

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 五步链。① `-(x'+y') ~ -x' + -y'`（㊽.4 的 `ratNegRep_add`，把右端同余进去）；② 结合律反向，把 `(x+y) + (-x' + -y')` 拆成 `((x+y) + -x') + -y'`；③ 内层结合律把 `(x+y) + -x'` 换成 `x + (y + -x')`；④ 交换 `y + -x'` 成 `-x' + y`，再结合成 `(x + -x') + y`；⑤ 最后一步结合律收成 `(x + -x') + (y + -y')`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel (ratSubRep (ratAddRep x y) (ratAddRep x' y')) (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x x') (ratSubRep y y'))`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratNegRep_add · ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen · ratAddRep_wd_gen · ratAdd_assoc（三次，其中两次取对称）· ratAdd_comm · ratRel_symm · ratRel_trans_gen（四次）。

exercises.template:
theorem ratSubRep_add_sub (x x' y y' : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratSubRep (ratAddRep x y) (ratAddRep x' y'))
           (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x x') (ratSubRep y y')) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratSubRep_add_sub (x x' y y' : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratSubRep (ratAddRep x y) (ratAddRep x' y'))
           (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x x') (ratSubRep y y')) :=
  ratRel_trans_gen
    (ratSubRep (ratAddRep x y) (ratAddRep x' y'))
    (ratAddRep (ratAddRep x y) (ratAddRep (ratNegRep x') (ratNegRep y')))
    (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x x') (ratSubRep y y'))
    (ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen
      (ratAddRep x y)
      (ratNegRep (ratAddRep x' y'))
      (ratAddRep (ratNegRep x') (ratNegRep y'))
      (ratNegRep_add x' y'))
    (ratRel_trans_gen
      (ratAddRep (ratAddRep x y) (ratAddRep (ratNegRep x') (ratNegRep y')))
      (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (ratAddRep x y) (ratNegRep x'))
                 (ratNegRep y'))
      (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x x') (ratSubRep y y'))
      (ratRel_symm
        (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (ratAddRep x y) (ratNegRep x'))
                   (ratNegRep y'))
        (ratAddRep (ratAddRep x y)
                   (ratAddRep (ratNegRep x') (ratNegRep y')))
        (ratAdd_assoc (ratAddRep x y) (ratNegRep x') (ratNegRep y')))
      (ratRel_trans_gen
        (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (ratAddRep x y) (ratNegRep x'))
                   (ratNegRep y'))
        (ratAddRep (ratAddRep x (ratAddRep y (ratNegRep x')))
                   (ratNegRep y'))
        (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x x') (ratSubRep y y'))
        (ratAddRep_wd_gen
          (ratAddRep (ratAddRep x y) (ratNegRep x'))
          (ratAddRep x (ratAddRep y (ratNegRep x')))
          (ratNegRep y')
          (ratAdd_assoc x y (ratNegRep x')))
        (ratRel_trans_gen
          (ratAddRep (ratAddRep x (ratAddRep y (ratNegRep x')))
                     (ratNegRep y'))
          (ratAddRep (ratAddRep x (ratAddRep (ratNegRep x') y))
                     (ratNegRep y'))
          (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x x') (ratSubRep y y'))
          (ratAddRep_wd_gen
            (ratAddRep x (ratAddRep y (ratNegRep x')))
            (ratAddRep x (ratAddRep (ratNegRep x') y))
            (ratNegRep y')
            (ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen
              x
              (ratAddRep y (ratNegRep x'))
              (ratAddRep (ratNegRep x') y)
              (ratAdd_comm y (ratNegRep x'))))
          (ratRel_trans_gen
            (ratAddRep (ratAddRep x (ratAddRep (ratNegRep x') y))
                       (ratNegRep y'))
            (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (ratAddRep x (ratNegRep x')) y)
                       (ratNegRep y'))
            (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x x') (ratSubRep y y'))
            (ratAddRep_wd_gen
              (ratAddRep x (ratAddRep (ratNegRep x') y))
              (ratAddRep (ratAddRep x (ratNegRep x')) y)
              (ratNegRep y')
              (ratRel_symm
                (ratAddRep (ratAddRep x (ratNegRep x')) y)
                (ratAddRep x (ratAddRep (ratNegRep x') y))
                (ratAdd_assoc x (ratNegRep x') y)))
            (ratAdd_assoc (ratAddRep x (ratNegRep x')) y
              (ratNegRep y'))))))

exercises.unit: 单元60 实数的加法：下降之前的两条义务
exercises.name: close_add
exercises.title: 60.2 逐点 `close` 对加法同余
exercises.prompt: 60.2 逐点 `close` 对加法同余

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 两个 `ε/2` 的界 `(x - x')`、`(y - y')` 各取见证 `dx`、`dy`；用 ㊺ 的 `ratAbsRel_total` 给 `(x-x') + (y-y')` 取见证 `d`；60.1 把 `d` 的绝对值搬到 `(x+y) - (x'+y')`（㊷ 的 `ratAbsRel_wd_left`，注意方向取 `ratRel_symm`）；㊽ 的三角不等式给 `d ≤ dx + dy`，57 的 `ratAdd_lt_half` 收到 `d < ε`，最后 `ratLtRep_of_le_lt`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `close x x' (ε/2) → close y y' (ε/2) → close (x+y) (x'+y') ε`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.elim · Exists.intro · ratAbsRel_total · ratAbsRel_wd_left · ratRel_symm · ratLeRep_abs_add · ratAdd_lt_half · ratLtRep_of_le_lt。

exercises.template:
theorem close_add (x x' y y' eps : ratRep)
    (hx : close x x' (ratHalf eps)) (hy : close y y' (ratHalf eps)) :
    close (ratAddRep x y) (ratAddRep x' y') eps :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem close_add (x x' y y' eps : ratRep)
    (hx : close x x' (ratHalf eps)) (hy : close y y' (ratHalf eps)) :
    close (ratAddRep x y) (ratAddRep x' y') eps :=
  Exists.elim hx
    (fun (dx : ratRep)
        (hdx : ratAbsRel (ratSubRep x x') dx ∧
               ratLtRep dx (ratHalf eps)) =>
      Exists.elim hy
        (fun (dy : ratRep)
            (hdy : ratAbsRel (ratSubRep y y') dy ∧
                   ratLtRep dy (ratHalf eps)) =>
          Exists.elim
            (ratAbsRel_total
              (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x x') (ratSubRep y y')))
            (fun (d : ratRep)
                (hd : ratAbsRel
                  (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x x') (ratSubRep y y')) d) =>
              Exists.intro d
                (And.intro
                  (ratAbsRel_wd_left
                    (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x x') (ratSubRep y y'))
                    (ratSubRep (ratAddRep x y) (ratAddRep x' y'))
                    d
                    (ratRel_symm
                      (ratSubRep (ratAddRep x y) (ratAddRep x' y'))
                      (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x x') (ratSubRep y y'))
                      (ratSubRep_add_sub x x' y y'))
                    hd)
                  (ratLtRep_of_le_lt d (ratAddRep dx dy) eps
                    (ratLeRep_abs_add
                      (ratSubRep x x') (ratSubRep y y') dx dy d
                      (And.left hdx) (And.left hdy) hd)
                    (ratAdd_lt_half dx dy eps
                      (And.right hdx) (And.right hdy)))))))

exercises.unit: 单元60 实数的加法：下降之前的两条义务
exercises.name: cauchy_add
exercises.title: 60.3 加法保持 Cauchy
exercises.prompt: 60.3 加法保持 Cauchy

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 量词结构照抄 `neg`，只是要在 `ε/2` 上同时取两个阈值：`hx` 给 `N1`、`hy` 给 `N2`，用 58 的 `leNat_max` 合成 `N`；对 `n m ≥ N`，两个 `leNat_trans` 把界落到同一对下标，再交给 60.2（注意 `addSeq x y n` 定义性就是 `ratAddRep (x n) (y n)`）。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Cauchy x → Cauchy y → Cauchy (addSeq x y)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLtRep_half · leNat_max · leNat_trans · close_add · Exists.elim（两次）· Exists.intro。

exercises.template:
theorem cauchy_add (x y : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) (hy : Cauchy y) :
    Cauchy (addSeq x y) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem cauchy_add (x y : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) (hy : Cauchy y) :
    Cauchy (addSeq x y) :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (hx (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
      (fun (N1 : Nat)
          (h1 : ∀ (n m : Nat), LeNat N1 n → LeNat N1 m →
            close (x n) (x m) (ratHalf eps)) =>
        Exists.elim (hy (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
          (fun (N2 : Nat)
              (h2 : ∀ (n m : Nat), LeNat N2 n → LeNat N2 m →
                close (y n) (y m) (ratHalf eps)) =>
            Exists.elim (leNat_max N1 N2)
              (fun (N : Nat) (hN : LeNat N1 N ∧ LeNat N2 N) =>
                Exists.intro N
                  (fun (n m : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) (hm : LeNat N m) =>
                    close_add (x n) (x m) (y n) (y m) eps
                      (h1 n m
                        (leNat_trans N1 N n (And.left hN) hn)
                        (leNat_trans N1 N m (And.left hN) hm))
                      (h2 n m
                        (leNat_trans N2 N n (And.right hN) hn)
                        (leNat_trans N2 N m (And.right hN) hm))))))

exercises.unit: 单元60 实数的加法：下降之前的两条义务
exercises.name: realRel_add
exercises.title: 60.4 加法与 `realRel` 相容
exercises.prompt: 60.4 加法与 `realRel` 相容

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `realRel (addSeq x y) (addSeq x' y')` 是三元组：两个 `Cauchy` 分量是 60.3（`Cauchy x`/`Cauchy x'` 来自 `hx`，`Cauchy y`/`Cauchy y'` 来自 `hy`）；第三分量对 `ε/2` 取两组阈值，用 `leNat_max` 合并后逐点用 60.2。`realRel` 的第三分量可以用 `lib/RealEq` 的 `realRel_close` 投影取出来。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `realRel x x' → realRel y y' → realRel (addSeq x y) (addSeq x' y')`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: And.intro（两次）· And.left · And.right · cauchy_add · realRel_close · leNat_max · leNat_trans · close_add。

exercises.template:
theorem realRel_add (x x' y y' : Seq)
    (hx : realRel x x') (hy : realRel y y') :
    realRel (addSeq x y) (addSeq x' y') :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem realRel_add (x x' y y' : Seq)
    (hx : realRel x x') (hy : realRel y y') :
    realRel (addSeq x y) (addSeq x' y') :=
  And.intro
    (cauchy_add x y (And.left hx) (And.left hy))
    (And.intro
      (cauchy_add x' y'
        (And.left (And.right hx)) (And.left (And.right hy)))
      (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
        Exists.elim
          (realRel_close x x' hx (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
          (fun (N1 : Nat)
              (h1 : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N1 n →
                close (x n) (x' n) (ratHalf eps)) =>
            Exists.elim
              (realRel_close y y' hy (ratHalf eps)
                (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
              (fun (N2 : Nat)
                  (h2 : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N2 n →
                    close (y n) (y' n) (ratHalf eps)) =>
                Exists.elim (leNat_max N1 N2)
                  (fun (N : Nat) (hN : LeNat N1 N ∧ LeNat N2 N) =>
                    Exists.intro N
                      (fun (n : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) =>
                        close_add (x n) (x' n) (y n) (y' n) eps
                          (h1 n (leNat_trans N1 N n (And.left hN) hn))
                          (h2 n
                            (leNat_trans N2 N n (And.right hN) hn))))))))

exercises.name: addRel_unique
exercises.title: 61.4 唯一性：关系的两个输出相等
exercises.prompt: 61.4 唯一性：关系的两个输出相等

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 `a` 做一次 `Quot.ind`（动机是「对一切 b c c'，两个输出相等」），进入 `mk x` 后对 `b` 再做一次 `Quot.ind`（动机把 c、c' 一起量化）。两次 ι 归约把 `h`、`h'` 都变成 `c = mk (x+y)` 与 `c' = mk (x+y)`，用 `Eq.trans` 与 `Eq.symm` 接起来。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `addRel a b c → addRel a b c' → c = c'`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Quot.ind（两次，动机都写在 Real 上）· ι 归约 · Eq.trans · Eq.symm · And.right。

exercises.template:
theorem addRel_unique (a b c c' : Real)
    (h : addRel a b c) (h' : addRel a b c') :
    c = c' :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem addRel_unique (a b c c' : Real)
    (h : addRel a b c) (h' : addRel a b c') :
    c = c' :=
  @Quot.ind.{1} Seq realRel
    (fun (a : Real) =>
      ∀ (b c c' : Real), addRel a b c → addRel a b c' → c = c')
    (fun (x : Seq) =>
      fun (b c c' : Real)
          (h : addRel (Real.mk x) b c)
          (h' : addRel (Real.mk x) b c') =>
        @Quot.ind.{1} Seq realRel
          (fun (b : Real) =>
            ∀ (c c' : Real),
              addRel (Real.mk x) b c → addRel (Real.mk x) b c' → c = c')
          (fun (y : Seq) =>
            fun (c c' : Real)
                (hc : addRel (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y) c)
                (hc' : addRel (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y) c') =>
              Eq.trans
                (And.right (And.right hc))
                (Eq.symm (And.right (And.right hc'))))
          b c c' h h')
    a b c c' h h'

hints.label: 思路

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `∃ c, addRel (mk x) (mk y) c ∧ ∀ c', addRel (mk x) (mk y) c' → c' = c`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.intro · And.intro · addRel_intro · addRel_unique。

exercises.template:
theorem addRel_exists_unique (x y : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) (hy : Cauchy y) :
    ∃ (c : Real),
      addRel (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y) c ∧
        ∀ (c' : Real), addRel (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y) c' → c' = c :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem addRel_exists_unique (x y : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) (hy : Cauchy y) :
    ∃ (c : Real),
      addRel (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y) c ∧
        ∀ (c' : Real), addRel (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y) c' → c' = c :=
  Exists.intro (Real.mk (addSeq x y))
    (And.intro
      (addRel_intro x y hx hy)
      (fun (c' : Real) (hc' : addRel (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y) c') =>
        addRel_unique (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y) c' (Real.mk (addSeq x y))
          hc' (addRel_intro x y hx hy)))

exercises.name: ratAbsRel_zero_of_ratRel
exercises.title: 62.2 绝对值：`x ~ y ⇒ |x - y| ~ 0`

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 见证取 `0`。按㊺的 `ratLeRep_total` 把 `0 ≤ x-y` 与 `x-y ≤ 0` 二分：非负支走左支（62.1 调向），非正支走右支——62.1 经 `ratNegRep_wd` 得到 `-(x-y) ~ -0`，而 `-0` 与 `0` 定义性相等，`ratRel_refl ratZeroRep` 收口。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratAbsRel (ratSubRep x y) ratZeroRep`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Or.elim · ratLeRep_total · Or.inl/Or.inr · ratRel_symm · ratRel_trans_gen · ratNegRep_wd · ratRel_refl。

exercises.template:
theorem ratAbsRel_zero_of_ratRel (x y : ratRep) (h : ratRel x y) :
    ratAbsRel (ratSubRep x y) ratZeroRep :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratAbsRel_zero_of_ratRel (x y : ratRep) (h : ratRel x y) :
    ratAbsRel (ratSubRep x y) ratZeroRep :=
  Or.elim
    (fun (hle : ratLeRep ratZeroRep (ratSubRep x y)) =>
      Or.inl (And.intro hle
        (ratRel_symm (ratSubRep x y) ratZeroRep
          (ratSubRep_ratRel_zero x y h))))
    (fun (hle : ratLeRep (ratSubRep x y) ratZeroRep) =>
      Or.inr (And.intro hle
        (ratRel_symm (ratNegRep (ratSubRep x y)) ratZeroRep
          (ratRel_trans_gen
            (ratNegRep (ratSubRep x y))
            (ratNegRep ratZeroRep)
            ratZeroRep
            (ratNegRep_wd (ratSubRep x y) ratZeroRep
              (ratSubRep_ratRel_zero x y h))
            (ratRel_refl ratZeroRep)))))
    (ratLeRep_total ratZeroRep (ratSubRep x y))

exercises.name: addRel_comm
exercises.title: 62.5 三元关系的交换律
exercises.prompt: 62.5 三元关系的交换律

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 `a`、`b` 各做一次 `Quot.ind`（动机都写在 `Real` 上）。进入 `mk x`、`mk y` 后，`h` 的三次 ι 归约给出两个 `Cauchy` 分量与 `c = mk (x+y)`；目标只需把两个 `Cauchy` 分量对调，第三个用 `c = mk (x+y)`、62.4 经 `Real.sound` 的 `mk (x+y) = mk (y+x)` 传递。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `addRel a b c → addRel b a c`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Quot.ind（两次，动机写明）· ι 归约 · And.intro · Eq.trans · Real.sound。

exercises.template:
theorem addRel_comm (a b c : Real) (h : addRel a b c) : addRel b a c :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem addRel_comm (a b c : Real) (h : addRel a b c) : addRel b a c :=
  @Quot.ind.{1} Seq realRel
    (fun (a : Real) => ∀ (b c : Real), addRel a b c → addRel b a c)
    (fun (x : Seq) =>
      fun (b c : Real) (hxbc : addRel (Real.mk x) b c) =>
        @Quot.ind.{1} Seq realRel
          (fun (b : Real) => ∀ (c : Real),
            addRel (Real.mk x) b c → addRel b (Real.mk x) c)
          (fun (y : Seq) =>
            fun (c : Real) (hxy : addRel (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y) c) =>
              And.intro
                (And.left (And.right hxy))
                (And.intro
                  (And.left hxy)
                  (Eq.trans
                    (And.right (And.right hxy))
                    (Real.sound (addSeq x y) (addSeq y x)
                      (realRel_add_comm x y (And.left hxy)
                        (And.left (And.right hxy)))))))
          b c hxbc)
    a b c h

exercises.template:

theorem realRel_add_zero (x : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) :
    realRel (addSeq x zeroSeq) x :=
  And.intro
    (cauchy_add x zeroSeq hx cauchy_zero)
    (And.intro hx
      (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
        Exists.intro Nat.zero
          (fun (n : Nat) (_hn : LeNat Nat.zero n) =>
            close_of_ratRel (addSeq x zeroSeq n) (x n)
              (ratAdd_zero (x n)) eps heps)))

exercises.prompt: 62.7 右零元：`mk x + 0 = mk x`

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: ι 归约后目标是 `Cauchy x ∧ Cauchy zeroSeq ∧ mk x = mk (x+0)`；前两个是 `hx` 与 `cauchy_zero`，第三个是 62.6 经 `Real.sound` 再 `Eq.symm`。

hints.label: 目标形态

hints.label: 关键件

exercises.template:
theorem addRel_zero_right (x : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) :

exercises.name: realRel_add_assoc
exercises.title: 63.1 代表元层：`(x + y) + z ~ x + (y + z)`

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 两个 `Cauchy` 分量各是两次 60 的 `cauchy_add`；第三分量取 `N := 0`，逐点用㉔的 `ratAdd_assoc` 加 62 的 `close_of_ratRel`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `realRel (addSeq (addSeq x y) z) (addSeq x (addSeq y z))`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: And.intro · cauchy_add（两次）· Exists.intro Nat.zero · ratAdd_assoc · close_of_ratRel。

exercises.template:
theorem realRel_add_assoc (x y z : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) (hy : Cauchy y)
    (hz : Cauchy z) :
    realRel (addSeq (addSeq x y) z) (addSeq x (addSeq y z)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem realRel_add_assoc (x y z : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) (hy : Cauchy y)
    (hz : Cauchy z) :
    realRel (addSeq (addSeq x y) z) (addSeq x (addSeq y z)) :=
  And.intro
    (cauchy_add (addSeq x y) z (cauchy_add x y hx hy) hz)
    (And.intro
      (cauchy_add x (addSeq y z) hx (cauchy_add y z hy hz))
      (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
        Exists.intro Nat.zero
          (fun (n : Nat) (_hn : LeNat Nat.zero n) =>
            close_of_ratRel (addSeq (addSeq x y) z n)
              (addSeq x (addSeq y z) n)
              (ratAdd_assoc (x n) (y n) (z n)) eps heps)))

exercises.unit: 单元63 实数的加法：结合律（三元关系版）
exercises.name: addRel_assoc_mk
exercises.title: 63.2 `mk` 层：`(x + y) + z = t ⇒ ∃ u, y + z = u ∧ x + u = t`

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 见证取 `u := mk (y+z)`。第一个 `addRel` 用 61 的 `addRel_intro`（`Cauchy y` 是假设，`Cauchy z` 从 `h` 的第二个守卫取）；第二个要 `Cauchy x`、`cauchy_add y z`，以及 `t = mk (x+(y+z))`——用 `Eq.trans` 把 `h` 给出的 `t = mk ((x+y)+z)` 与 63.1 经 `Real.sound` 的等式接起来。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `∃ u, addRel (mk y) (mk z) u ∧ addRel (mk x) u t`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.intro · addRel_intro · cauchy_add · Eq.trans · Real.sound · realRel_add_assoc。

exercises.template:
theorem addRel_assoc_mk (x y z : Seq) (t : Real)
    (hx : Cauchy x) (hy : Cauchy y)
    (h : addRel (Real.mk (addSeq x y)) (Real.mk z) t) :
    ∃ (u : Real), addRel (Real.mk y) (Real.mk z) u ∧
      addRel (Real.mk x) u t :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem addRel_assoc_mk (x y z : Seq) (t : Real)
    (hx : Cauchy x) (hy : Cauchy y)
    (h : addRel (Real.mk (addSeq x y)) (Real.mk z) t) :
    ∃ (u : Real), addRel (Real.mk y) (Real.mk z) u ∧
      addRel (Real.mk x) u t :=
  Exists.intro (Real.mk (addSeq y z))
    (And.intro
      (addRel_intro y z hy (And.left (And.right h)))
      (And.intro
        hx
        (And.intro
          (cauchy_add y z hy (And.left (And.right h)))
          (Eq.trans
            (And.right (And.right h))
            (Real.sound (addSeq (addSeq x y) z) (addSeq x (addSeq y z))
              (realRel_add_assoc x y z hx hy
                (And.left (And.right h))))))))

exercises.unit: 单元63 实数的加法：结合律（三元关系版）
exercises.name: addRel_assoc
exercises.title: 63.3 商层：三元关系的结合律
exercises.prompt: 63.3 商层：三元关系的结合律

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 `a`、`b`、`c` 各做一次 `Quot.ind`（动机依次写在 `Real` 上）。进入 `mk x`、`mk y`、`mk z` 后，`h1` 的 ι 归约给出 `s = mk (x+y)`；用 `Eq.subst` 把它代进 `h2`，得到 `addRel (mk (x+y)) (mk z) t`，正好交给 63.2。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `addRel a b s → addRel s c t → ∃ u, addRel b c u ∧ addRel a u t`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Quot.ind（三次，动机写明）· ι 归约 · Eq.subst · addRel_assoc_mk。

exercises.template:
theorem addRel_assoc (a b c s t : Real)
    (h1 : addRel a b s) (h2 : addRel s c t) :
    ∃ (u : Real), addRel b c u ∧ addRel a u t :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem addRel_assoc (a b c s t : Real)
    (h1 : addRel a b s) (h2 : addRel s c t) :
    ∃ (u : Real), addRel b c u ∧ addRel a u t :=
  @Quot.ind.{1} Seq realRel
    (fun (a : Real) =>
      ∀ (b c s t : Real), addRel a b s → addRel s c t →
        ∃ (u : Real), addRel b c u ∧ addRel a u t)
    (fun (x : Seq) =>
      fun (b c s t : Real)
          (h1 : addRel (Real.mk x) b s) (h2 : addRel s c t) =>
        @Quot.ind.{1} Seq realRel
          (fun (b : Real) =>
            ∀ (c s t : Real), addRel (Real.mk x) b s → addRel s c t →
              ∃ (u : Real), addRel b c u ∧ addRel (Real.mk x) u t)
          (fun (y : Seq) =>
            fun (c s t : Real)
                (h1 : addRel (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y) s) (h2 : addRel s c t) =>
              @Quot.ind.{1} Seq realRel
                (fun (c : Real) =>
                  ∀ (s t : Real), addRel (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y) s →
                    addRel s c t →
                    ∃ (u : Real), addRel (Real.mk y) c u ∧ addRel (Real.mk x) u t)
                (fun (z : Seq) =>
                  fun (s t : Real)
                      (h1 : addRel (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y) s)
                      (h2 : addRel s (Real.mk z) t) =>
                    (fun (h2' : addRel (Real.mk (addSeq x y)) (Real.mk z) t) =>
                      addRel_assoc_mk x y z t
                        (And.left h1) (And.left (And.right h1)) h2')
                    (@Eq.subst.{1} Real
                      (fun (s' : Real) => addRel s' (Real.mk z) t)
                      s (Real.mk (addSeq x y))
                      (And.right (And.right h1)) h2))
                c s t h1 h2)
          b c s t h1 h2)
    a b c s t h1 h2

exercises.unit: 单元64 实数的序：代表元关系与自反性
exercises.name: realLeRep_refl
exercises.title: 64.1 自反性：`x` ≤ `x`

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 前两个分量都是 `hx`；第三分量取 `N := 0`，逐点把 `x n - x n` 认成 0（55 的 `ratAdd_neg_gen`，`ratSubRep` 就是 `x + (-x)`），再用 `ratLtRep_le` 把 `0 < eps` 投成 `0 ≤ eps`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Cauchy x ∧ Cauchy x ∧ ∀ eps > 0, ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, ratLeRep (ratSubRep (x n) (x n)) eps`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: And.intro · Exists.intro Nat.zero · ratAdd_neg_gen · ratLeRep_of_ratRel · ratLtRep_le · ratLeRep_trans。

exercises.template:
theorem realLeRep_refl (x : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) : realLeRep x x :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem realLeRep_refl (x : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) : realLeRep x x :=
  And.intro hx
    (And.intro hx
      (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
        Exists.intro Nat.zero
          (fun (n : Nat) (_hn : LeNat Nat.zero n) =>
            ratLeRep_trans (ratSubRep (x n) (x n)) ratZeroRep eps
              (ratLeRep_of_ratRel (ratSubRep (x n) (x n)) ratZeroRep
                (ratAdd_neg_gen (x n)))
              (ratLtRep_le ratZeroRep eps heps))))

exercises.unit: 单元64 实数的序：代表元关系与自反性
exercises.name: realLeRep_of_realRel
exercises.title: 64.2 相等 ⇒ 序：`realRel x y → x ≤ y`
exercises.prompt: 64.2 相等 ⇒ 序：`realRel x y → x ≤ y`

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 两个 `Cauchy` 分量直接取 `h`。第三分量对 `eps` 直接用 `realRel` 的接近性（不必折半）：它给见证 `d` 使 `|x n - y n| ~ d` 且 `d < eps`；`ratAbsRel_le` 把绝对值压成 `x n - y n ≤ d`，`ratLtRep_le` 把 `d < eps` 投成 `d ≤ eps`，再传递。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `realLeRep x y`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: realRel_close · ratAbsRel_le · ratLtRep_le · ratLeRep_trans。

exercises.template:
theorem realLeRep_of_realRel (x y : Seq) (h : realRel x y) : realLeRep x y :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem realLeRep_of_realRel (x y : Seq) (h : realRel x y) : realLeRep x y :=
  And.intro (And.left h)
    (And.intro (And.left (And.right h))
      (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
        Exists.elim (realRel_close x y h eps heps)
          (fun (N : Nat)
              (hN : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n → close (x n) (y n) eps) =>
            Exists.intro N
              (fun (n : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) =>
                Exists.elim (hN n hn)
                  (fun (d : ratRep)
                      (hd : ratAbsRel (ratSubRep (x n) (y n)) d ∧
                            ratLtRep d eps) =>
                    ratLeRep_trans (ratSubRep (x n) (y n)) d eps
                      (ratAbsRel_le (ratSubRep (x n) (y n)) d (And.left hd))
                      (ratLtRep_le d eps (And.right hd)))))))

exercises.unit: 单元65 实数的序：传递性
exercises.name: ratLeRep_sub_add
exercises.title: 65.1 代表元层：两个 eps 的减法界相加
exercises.prompt: 65.1 代表元层：两个 eps 的减法界相加

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `ratLeRep_add` 先把两个界加成 `(x-y)+(y-z) ≤ eps+eps`；左边用 56 的 `ratSubRep_add` 换成 `x-z`，右边不动（`ratRel_refl`），交给 `ratLeRep_congr_gen`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratLeRep (ratSubRep x y) eps → ratLeRep (ratSubRep y z) eps → ratLeRep (ratSubRep x z) (ratAddRep eps eps)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLeRep_add · ratSubRep_add · ratRel_refl · ratLeRep_congr_gen。

exercises.template:
theorem ratLeRep_sub_add (x y z eps : ratRep)
    (h1 : ratLeRep (ratSubRep x y) eps)
    (h2 : ratLeRep (ratSubRep y z) eps) :
    ratLeRep (ratSubRep x z) (ratAddRep eps eps) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratLeRep_sub_add (x y z eps : ratRep)
    (h1 : ratLeRep (ratSubRep x y) eps)
    (h2 : ratLeRep (ratSubRep y z) eps) :
    ratLeRep (ratSubRep x z) (ratAddRep eps eps) :=
  ratLeRep_congr_gen
    (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x y) (ratSubRep y z))
    (ratSubRep x z)
    (ratAddRep eps eps) (ratAddRep eps eps)
    (ratSubRep_add x y z)
    (ratRel_refl (ratAddRep eps eps))
    (ratLeRep_add (ratSubRep x y) eps (ratSubRep y z) eps h1 h2)

exercises.unit: 单元65 实数的序：传递性
exercises.name: realLeRep_trans
exercises.title: 65.2 序的传递性
exercises.prompt: 65.2 序的传递性

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 两个 `Cauchy` 守卫直接取 `h1`、`h2` 的第一/第三分量。对 `eps` 用 `ratLtRep_half` 得到 `0 < eps/2`，两个前提各取阈值 `N1`、`N2`，用 `leNat_max` 合成 `N`；在 `n ≥ N` 上用 65.1 得 `x n - z n ≤ eps/2 + eps/2`，再沿 `ratHalf_add_self` 搬到 `eps`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `realLeRep x z`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: realLeRep_close（第三分量的命名投影）· ratLtRep_half · leNat_max · leNat_trans · ratLeRep_sub_add · ratHalf_add_self · ratLeRep_congr_gen。

exercises.template:
theorem realLeRep_trans (x y z : Seq)
    (h1 : realLeRep x y) (h2 : realLeRep y z) : realLeRep x z :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem realLeRep_trans (x y z : Seq)
    (h1 : realLeRep x y) (h2 : realLeRep y z) : realLeRep x z :=
  And.intro (And.left h1)
    (And.intro (And.left (And.right h2))
      (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
        Exists.elim
          (realLeRep_close x y h1 (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
          (fun (N1 : Nat)
              (hN1 : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N1 n →
                ratLeRep (ratSubRep (x n) (y n)) (ratHalf eps)) =>
            Exists.elim
              (realLeRep_close y z h2 (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
              (fun (N2 : Nat)
                  (hN2 : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N2 n →
                    ratLeRep (ratSubRep (y n) (z n)) (ratHalf eps)) =>
                Exists.elim (leNat_max N1 N2)
                  (fun (N : Nat) (hN : LeNat N1 N ∧ LeNat N2 N) =>
                    Exists.intro N
                      (fun (n : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) =>
                        ratLeRep_congr_gen
                          (ratSubRep (x n) (z n))
                          (ratSubRep (x n) (z n))
                          (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps)) eps
                          (ratRel_refl (ratSubRep (x n) (z n)))
                          (ratHalf_add_self eps)
                          (ratLeRep_sub_add (x n) (y n) (z n) (ratHalf eps)
                            (hN1 n (leNat_trans N1 N n (And.left hN) hn))
                            (hN2 n (leNat_trans N2 N n (And.right hN) hn)))))))))

exercises.prompt: 66.0 换左因子：`realRel x x' → (x ≤ y ↔ x' ≤ y)`

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 两个方向都是「相等 ⇒ 序」加传递。正向：`x' ≤ x`（`realRel_symm` 把 `hx` 反过来，交给 64.2）再与 `x ≤ y` 传递；反向：`x ≤ x'`（`hx` 直接交给 64.2）再与 `x' ≤ y` 传递。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `realLeRep x y ↔ realLeRep x' y`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: realRel_symm · realLeRep_of_realRel · realLeRep_trans · Iff.intro。

exercises.template:
theorem realLeRep_wd (x x' y : Seq) (hx : realRel x x') :
    realLeRep x y ↔ realLeRep x' y :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem realLeRep_wd (x x' y : Seq) (hx : realRel x x') :
    realLeRep x y ↔ realLeRep x' y :=
  @Iff.intro (realLeRep x y) (realLeRep x' y)
    (fun (h : realLeRep x y) =>
      realLeRep_trans x' x y
        (realLeRep_of_realRel x' x (realRel_symm x x' hx))
        h)
    (fun (h : realLeRep x' y) =>
      realLeRep_trans x x' y
        (realLeRep_of_realRel x x' hx)
        h)

exercises.prompt: 66.1 换右因子：`realRel y y' → (x ≤ y ↔ x ≤ y')`

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 与 66.0 同形，只是传递的中间项换成右因子。正向：`x ≤ y` 与 `y ≤ y'`（`hy` 交给 64.2）传递；反向：`x ≤ y'` 与 `y' ≤ y`（`realRel_symm` 后交给 64.2）传递。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `realLeRep x y ↔ realLeRep x y'`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: realLeRep_of_realRel · realRel_symm · realLeRep_trans · Iff.intro。

exercises.template:
theorem realLeRep_wd_snd (x y y' : Seq) (hy : realRel y y') :
    realLeRep x y ↔ realLeRep x y' :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem realLeRep_wd_snd (x y y' : Seq) (hy : realRel y y') :
    realLeRep x y ↔ realLeRep x y' :=
  @Iff.intro (realLeRep x y) (realLeRep x y')
    (fun (h : realLeRep x y) =>
      realLeRep_trans x y y' h
        (realLeRep_of_realRel y y' hy))

exercises.unit: 单元67 实数的序：自反、传递、反对称
exercises.name: ratHalf_lt_self
exercises.title: 67.0 半数严格小于自身
exercises.prompt: 67.0 半数严格小于自身

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先证 `eps/2 ≤ eps`：把 53 的 `ratLeRep_half_of_lt` 右加 `eps/2`，左边用 `ratAdd_zero_left`、右边用 52 的 `ratHalf_add_self` 认成 `eps`。再证 `¬ eps/2 ~ eps`：若相等，两边同加 `eps/2`，左边是 `eps/2+eps/2 ~ eps`，右边用交换律，于是 `eps ~ eps + eps/2`；与 `eps ~ eps + 0` 一起交给 ㊿ 的 `ratRel_add_cancel_gen` 消去 `eps`，得 `0 ~ eps/2`，撞上 53 的 `ratLtRep_half`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratLtRep (ratHalf eps) eps`（即 `eps/2 < eps`）。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLeRep_congr_gen · ratAdd_zero_left · ratHalf_add_self · ratLeRep_add_right · ratRel_add_cancel_gen · ratAddRep_wd_gen · ratAdd_comm · ratLtRep_half。

exercises.template:
theorem ratHalf_lt_self (eps : ratRep) (h : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) :
    ratLtRep (ratHalf eps) eps :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratHalf_lt_self (eps : ratRep) (h : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) :
    ratLtRep (ratHalf eps) eps :=
  And.intro
    (ratLeRep_congr_gen
      (ratAddRep ratZeroRep (ratHalf eps)) (ratHalf eps)
      (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps)) eps
      (ratAdd_zero_left (ratHalf eps))
      (ratHalf_add_self eps)
      (ratLeRep_add_right ratZeroRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps)
        (ratLeRep_half_of_lt eps h)))
    (fun (heq : ratRel (ratHalf eps) eps) =>
      (ratLtRep_right ratZeroRep (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps h))
        (ratRel_add_cancel_gen ratZeroRep (ratHalf eps) eps
          (ratRel_trans_gen
            (ratAddRep ratZeroRep eps)
            (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps))
            (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) eps)
            (ratRel_trans_gen
              (ratAddRep ratZeroRep eps) eps
              (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps))
              (ratAdd_zero_left eps)
              (ratRel_symm
                (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps)) eps
                (ratHalf_add_self eps)))
            (ratRel_trans_gen
              (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps))
              (ratAddRep eps (ratHalf eps))
              (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) eps)
              (ratAddRep_wd_gen (ratHalf eps) eps (ratHalf eps) heq)
              (ratAdd_comm eps (ratHalf eps))))))

exercises.unit: 单元67 实数的序：自反、传递、反对称
exercises.name: ratAbsRel_lt_of_bounds
exercises.title: 67.1 两侧界给出绝对值严格小于
exercises.prompt: 67.1 两侧界给出绝对值严格小于

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `ratAbsRel z d` 分两支。正支有 `d ~ z`，负支有 `d ~ -z`；把 `d` 沿 `ratLeRep_of_ratRel` 换成对应见证，再用 `ratLeRep_trans` 接到 `b`，最后 `ratLtRep_of_le_lt` 与 `hb : b < eps` 夹出 `d < eps`。`Or.elim` 要写全三个显式命题（`ratAbsRel` 是定义别名，推断不会替你展开）。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratAbsRel z d → z ≤ b → -z ≤ b → b < eps → d < eps`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Or.elim · ratLeRep_of_ratRel · ratLeRep_trans · ratLtRep_of_le_lt。

exercises.template:
theorem ratAbsRel_lt_of_bounds (z d b eps : ratRep)
    (hd : ratAbsRel z d)
    (h1 : ratLeRep z b) (h2 : ratLeRep (ratNegRep z) b)
    (hb : ratLtRep b eps) : ratLtRep d eps :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratAbsRel_lt_of_bounds (z d b eps : ratRep)
    (hd : ratAbsRel z d)
    (h1 : ratLeRep z b) (h2 : ratLeRep (ratNegRep z) b)
    (hb : ratLtRep b eps) : ratLtRep d eps :=
  @Or.elim
    (ratLeRep ratZeroRep z ∧ ratRel d z)
    (ratLeRep z ratZeroRep ∧ ratRel d (ratNegRep z))
    (ratLtRep d eps)
    (fun (hl : ratLeRep ratZeroRep z ∧ ratRel d z) =>
      ratLtRep_of_le_lt d b eps
        (ratLeRep_trans d z b
          (ratLeRep_of_ratRel d z (And.right hl)) h1) hb)
    (fun (hr : ratLeRep z ratZeroRep ∧ ratRel d (ratNegRep z)) =>
      ratLtRep_of_le_lt d b eps
        (ratLeRep_trans d (ratNegRep z) b
          (ratLeRep_of_ratRel d (ratNegRep z) (And.right hr)) h2) hb)
    hd

exercises.unit: 单元67 实数的序：自反、传递、反对称
exercises.name: realLe_trans
exercises.title: 67.3 传递

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 `a`、`b`、`c` 各做一次 `Quot.ind`，把三个实数烧成 `mk x`、`mk y`、`mk z`；两个前提经 66.4 的 ι 规则回到 `realLeRep x y` / `realLeRep y z`，结论用 65.2 的 `realLeRep_trans` 接起来，再经 ι 规则送回 `realLe`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `realLe a b → realLe b c → realLe a c`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Quot.ind（三次）· realLe_mk · Iff.mp · Iff.mpr · realLeRep_trans。

exercises.template:
theorem realLe_trans (a b c : Real)
    (h1 : realLe a b) (h2 : realLe b c) : realLe a c :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem realLe_trans (a b c : Real)
    (h1 : realLe a b) (h2 : realLe b c) : realLe a c :=
  @Quot.ind.{1} Seq realRel
    (fun (a : Real) => realLe a b → realLe b c → realLe a c)
    (fun (x : Seq) =>
      @Quot.ind.{1} Seq realRel
        (fun (b : Real) => realLe (Real.mk x) b → realLe b c → realLe (Real.mk x) c)
        (fun (y : Seq) =>
          @Quot.ind.{1} Seq realRel
            (fun (c : Real) => realLe (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y) → realLe (Real.mk y) c → realLe (Real.mk x) c)
            (fun (z : Seq) (hxy : realLe (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y))
                           (hyz : realLe (Real.mk y) (Real.mk z)) =>
              Iff.mpr (realLe_mk x z)
                (realLeRep_trans x y z
                  (Iff.mp (realLe_mk x y) hxy)
                  (Iff.mp (realLe_mk y z) hyz)))
            c)
        b)
    a h1 h2

exercises.unit: 单元67 实数的序：自反、传递、反对称
exercises.name: realLe_antisymm_mk
exercises.title: 67.4 反对称（代表元层）
exercises.prompt: 67.4 反对称（代表元层）

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `realRel x y` 的前两个分量直接来自 `h1` 与 `h2`（注意 `h2 : realLeRep y x` 的第一个分量是 `Cauchy y`，不是第二个）。第三分量对 `eps > 0` 取两个 `eps/2` 的界（53 的 `ratLtRep_half`），用 58 的 `leNat_max` 合并阈值；逐点用 ㊺ 的 `ratAbsRel_total` 取出 `d`，把 `y n - x n` 沿 ㊷ 的 `ratSubRep_neg` 认成 `-(x n - y n)`，交给 67.1 与 67.0 得 `d < eps`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `realLeRep x y → realLeRep y x → realRel x y`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: realLeRep_close · ratLtRep_half · leNat_max · ratAbsRel_total · ratSubRep_neg · ratAbsRel_lt_of_bounds · ratHalf_lt_self。

exercises.template:
theorem realLe_antisymm_mk (x y : Seq)
    (h1 : realLeRep x y) (h2 : realLeRep y x) : realRel x y :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem realLe_antisymm_mk (x y : Seq)
    (h1 : realLeRep x y) (h2 : realLeRep y x) : realRel x y :=
  And.intro (And.left h1)
    (And.intro (And.left h2)
      (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
        Exists.elim
          (realLeRep_close x y h1 (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
          (fun (N1 : Nat)
              (hN1 : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N1 n →
                ratLeRep (ratSubRep (x n) (y n)) (ratHalf eps)) =>
            Exists.elim
              (realLeRep_close y x h2 (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
              (fun (N2 : Nat)
                  (hN2 : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N2 n →
                    ratLeRep (ratSubRep (y n) (x n)) (ratHalf eps)) =>
                Exists.elim (leNat_max N1 N2)
                  (fun (N : Nat) (hN : LeNat N1 N ∧ LeNat N2 N) =>
                    Exists.intro N
                      (fun (n : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) =>
                        Exists.elim
                          (ratAbsRel_total (ratSubRep (x n) (y n)))
                          (fun (d : ratRep) (hd : ratAbsRel (ratSubRep (x n) (y n)) d) =>
                            Exists.intro d
                              (And.intro hd
                                (ratAbsRel_lt_of_bounds
                                  (ratSubRep (x n) (y n)) d (ratHalf eps) eps hd
                                  (hN1 n (leNat_trans N1 N n (And.left hN) hn))
                                  (ratLeRep_congr_gen
                                    (ratSubRep (y n) (x n))
                                    (ratNegRep (ratSubRep (x n) (y n)))
                                    (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps)
                                    (ratSubRep_neg (x n) (y n))
                                    (ratRel_refl (ratHalf eps))
                                    (hN2 n (leNat_trans N2 N n (And.right hN) hn)))
                                  (ratHalf_lt_self eps heps))))))))))

exercises.unit: 单元67 实数的序：自反、传递、反对称
exercises.name: realLe_antisymm
exercises.title: 67.5 反对称（商上）
exercises.prompt: 67.5 反对称（商上）

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 `a`、`b` 各做一次 `Quot.ind`，把两个前提经 66.4 搬回代表元层，交给 67.4 得 `realRel x y`，再用 ㊱.2 的 `Real.sound` 得到 `mk x = mk y`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `realLe a b → realLe b a → a = b`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Quot.ind（两次）· realLe_mk · Iff.mp · realLe_antisymm_mk · Real.sound。

exercises.template:
theorem realLe_antisymm (a b : Real)
    (h1 : realLe a b) (h2 : realLe b a) : a = b :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem realLe_antisymm (a b : Real)
    (h1 : realLe a b) (h2 : realLe b a) : a = b :=
  @Quot.ind.{1} Seq realRel
    (fun (a : Real) => realLe a b → realLe b a → a = b)
    (fun (x : Seq) =>
      @Quot.ind.{1} Seq realRel
        (fun (b : Real) => realLe (Real.mk x) b → realLe b (Real.mk x) → Real.mk x = b)
        (fun (y : Seq) (hxy : realLe (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y))
                       (hyx : realLe (Real.mk y) (Real.mk x)) =>
          Real.sound x y
            (realLe_antisymm_mk x y
              (Iff.mp (realLe_mk x y) hxy)
              (Iff.mp (realLe_mk y x) hyx)))
        b)
    a h1 h2

exercises.unit: 单元68 完备性：有理 Cauchy 序列在 ℝ 中收敛到自己的类
exercises.name: cauchy_const
exercises.title: 68.1 常序列是 Cauchy 的
exercises.prompt: 68.1 常序列是 Cauchy 的

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 任意两个位置都相等，取见证 `d := 0`。`x n - x n` 就是 `x + (-x)`，用 55 的 `ratAdd_neg_gen` 收成 0；`ratAbsRel_wd_left` 把 `|0|` 的见证搬到 `|x - x|` 上（注意方向：先把 `0` 换成 `x - x` 再喂给 `ratAbsRel_zero`），严格性直接用 `heps`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Cauchy (constSeq q)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.intro ratZeroRep · ratAdd_neg_gen · ratRel_symm · ratAbsRel_wd_left · ratAbsRel_zero。

exercises.template:
theorem cauchy_const (q : ratRep) : Cauchy (constSeq q) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem cauchy_const (q : ratRep) : Cauchy (constSeq q) :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.intro Nat.zero
      (fun (n m : Nat) (_hn : LeNat Nat.zero n) (_hm : LeNat Nat.zero m) =>
        Exists.intro ratZeroRep
          (And.intro
            (ratAbsRel_wd_left ratZeroRep (ratSubRep q q) ratZeroRep
              (ratRel_symm (ratSubRep q q) ratZeroRep (ratAdd_neg_gen q))
              ratAbsRel_zero)
            heps))

exercises.title: 68.4 `close` 给减法界
exercises.prompt: 68.4 `close` 给减法界

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `close` 给见证 `d`：`|a - b| ~ d` 且 `d < eps`。`ratAbsRel_le` 把绝对值压成 `a - b ≤ d`，`ratLtRep_le` 把 `d < eps` 投成 `d ≤ eps`，再用 `ratLeRep_trans` 传递。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `close a b eps → ratLeRep (ratSubRep a b) eps`。

hints.label: 关键件

exercises.template:
theorem close_sub_le (a b eps : ratRep) (h : close a b eps) :
    ratLeRep (ratSubRep a b) eps :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem close_sub_le (a b eps : ratRep) (h : close a b eps) :
    ratLeRep (ratSubRep a b) eps :=
  Exists.elim h
    (fun (d : ratRep)
        (hd : ratAbsRel (ratSubRep a b) d ∧ ratLtRep d eps) =>

        (ratLtRep_le d eps (And.right hd)))

exercises.name: ratLeRep_sub_add_right
exercises.title: 68.5 减去 `eps` 之后落到 0 以下
exercises.prompt: 68.5 减去 `eps` 之后落到 0 以下

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 分两段。① **代数**：`a - (b + eps) ~ (a - b) - eps`——`ratNegRep_add` 把 `-(b+eps)` 换成 `-b + -eps`，`ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen` 搬进 `a + ...`，`ratAdd_assoc` 反向收成 `(a + -b) + -eps`。② **序**：`h` 右加 `-eps` 得 `(a-b) + -eps ≤ eps + -eps`，`ratAdd_neg_gen` 把右端收成 0，再用 `he : 0 ≤ e` 传递；最后用 `ratLeRep_congr_gen` 沿 ① 的等式把结论搬回 `a - (b + eps)`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `a - b ≤ eps → 0 ≤ e → a - (b + eps) ≤ e`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratNegRep_add · ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen · ratAdd_assoc · ratLeRep_add_right · ratAdd_neg_gen · ratLeRep_of_ratRel · ratLeRep_trans · ratLeRep_congr_gen · ratRel_symm · ratRel_refl。

exercises.template:
theorem ratLeRep_sub_add_right (a b eps e : ratRep)
    (h : ratLeRep (ratSubRep a b) eps)
    (he : ratLeRep ratZeroRep e) :
    ratLeRep (ratSubRep a (ratAddRep b eps)) e :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratLeRep_sub_add_right (a b eps e : ratRep)
    (h : ratLeRep (ratSubRep a b) eps)
    (he : ratLeRep ratZeroRep e) :
    ratLeRep (ratSubRep a (ratAddRep b eps)) e :=
  ratLeRep_congr_gen
    (ratAddRep (ratSubRep a b) (ratNegRep eps))
    (ratSubRep a (ratAddRep b eps))
    e e
    (ratRel_symm
      (ratSubRep a (ratAddRep b eps))
      (ratAddRep (ratSubRep a b) (ratNegRep eps))
      (ratRel_trans_gen
        (ratSubRep a (ratAddRep b eps))
        (ratAddRep a (ratAddRep (ratNegRep b) (ratNegRep eps)))
        (ratAddRep (ratSubRep a b) (ratNegRep eps))
        (ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen a
          (ratNegRep (ratAddRep b eps))
          (ratAddRep (ratNegRep b) (ratNegRep eps))
          (ratNegRep_add b eps))
        (ratRel_symm
          (ratAddRep (ratAddRep a (ratNegRep b)) (ratNegRep eps))
          (ratAddRep a (ratAddRep (ratNegRep b) (ratNegRep eps)))
          (ratAdd_assoc a (ratNegRep b) (ratNegRep eps)))))
    (ratRel_refl e)
    (ratLeRep_trans
      (ratAddRep (ratSubRep a b) (ratNegRep eps))
      ratZeroRep e
      (ratLeRep_trans
        (ratAddRep (ratSubRep a b) (ratNegRep eps))
        (ratAddRep eps (ratNegRep eps))
        ratZeroRep
        (ratLeRep_add_right (ratSubRep a b) eps (ratNegRep eps) h)
        (ratLeRep_of_ratRel
          (ratAddRep eps (ratNegRep eps)) ratZeroRep
          (ratAdd_neg_gen eps)))
      he)

exercises.unit: 单元68 完备性：有理 Cauchy 序列在 ℝ 中收敛到自己的类
exercises.name: cauchy_tends_to_class
exercises.title: 68.7 主定理：有理 Cauchy 序列收敛到自己的类
exercises.prompt: 68.7 主定理：有理 Cauchy 序列收敛到自己的类

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 `eps > 0` 取 Cauchy 性的阈值 `N`。固定 `n ≥ N` 后，对每个 `e > 0`：上界用 `hN n k` 得 `x n - x k ≤ eps`，68.5 给 `x n - (x k + eps) ≤ e`；下界用 `hN k n` 得 `x k - x n ≤ eps`，68.5 给 `x k - (x n + eps) ≤ e`。两条 `realLeRep` 的 Cauchy 守卫分别由 68.1/68.3 付清，再经 66.4 的 `realLe_mk` 送回 `realLe`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Cauchy x → TendsTo x x`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: hx · close_sub_le · ratLeRep_sub_add_right · ratLtRep_le · cauchy_const · cauchy_add_const · realLe_mk · Iff.mpr。

exercises.template:
theorem cauchy_tends_to_class (x : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) :
    TendsTo x x :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem cauchy_tends_to_class (x : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) :
    TendsTo x x :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (hx eps heps)
      (fun (N : Nat)
          (hN : ∀ (n m : Nat), LeNat N n → LeNat N m →
            close (x n) (x m) eps) =>
        Exists.intro N
          (fun (n : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) =>
            And.intro
              (Iff.mpr (realLe_mk (constSeq (x n)) (addConst x eps))
                (And.intro (cauchy_const (x n))
                  (And.intro (cauchy_add_const x eps hx)
                    (fun (e : ratRep) (he : ratLtRep ratZeroRep e) =>
                      Exists.intro N
                        (fun (k : Nat) (hk : LeNat N k) =>
                          ratLeRep_sub_add_right (x n) (x k) eps e
                            (close_sub_le (x n) (x k) eps (hN n k hn hk))
                            (ratLtRep_le ratZeroRep e he))))))
              (Iff.mpr (realLe_mk x (addConst (constSeq (x n)) eps))
                (And.intro hx
                  (And.intro
                    (cauchy_add_const (constSeq (x n)) eps
                      (cauchy_const (x n)))
                    (fun (e : ratRep) (he : ratLtRep ratZeroRep e) =>
                      Exists.intro N
                        (fun (k : Nat) (hk : LeNat N k) =>
                          ratLeRep_sub_add_right (x k) (x n) eps e
                            (close_sub_le (x k) (x n) eps (hN k n hk hn))
                            (ratLtRep_le ratZeroRep e he))))))))

exercises.name: cauchy_has_limit
exercises.title: 68.8 存在极限代表元
exercises.prompt: 68.8 存在极限代表元

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 极限代表元取 `x` 自己；Cauchy 分量是 `hx`，收敛性用 68.7。实数层面的极限就是 `Real.mk x`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `∃ L, Cauchy L ∧ TendsTo x L`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.intro · cauchy_tends_to_class。

exercises.template:
theorem cauchy_has_limit (x : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) :
    ∃ (L : Seq), Cauchy L ∧ TendsTo x L :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem cauchy_has_limit (x : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) :
    ∃ (L : Seq), Cauchy L ∧ TendsTo x L :=
  Exists.intro x (And.intro hx (cauchy_tends_to_class x hx))

exercises.unit: 单元69 数系链：从 ℕ 到 ℝ 的保序嵌入
exercises.name: intToRat_mk
exercises.title: 69.4 ι 规则
exercises.prompt: 69.4 ι 规则

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `Quot.lift` 作用在 `Quot.mk p` 上按 ι 归约成 `f p`，两条边是**定义性相等**——直接 `Eq.refl`，不要试图用 `Quot.sound` 或 `congrArg`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `intToRat (mk (a,b)) = ratOf (a,b) 0`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Eq.refl（类型要写成归约后的右边）。

exercises.template:
theorem intToRat_mk (a b : Nat) :
    intToRat (@Quot.mk.{1} (Prod Nat Nat) intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)) =
    ratOf (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) Nat.zero :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem intToRat_mk (a b : Nat) :
    intToRat (@Quot.mk.{1} (Prod Nat Nat) intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)) =
    ratOf (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) Nat.zero :=
  @Eq.refl.{1} Rat (ratOf (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) Nat.zero)

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `ratLeRep (p/1) (q/1)` 是交叉相乘后的 `leRep`；「乘正分母保序」`leRep_mul_den_right` 把 `leRep p q` 搬到 `den 0 = (1,0)` 上，分母参数取 `0`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `leRep p q → ratLeRep (intToRatRep p) (intToRatRep q)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: leRep_mul_den_right（第三个参数 `Nat.zero`）。

exercises.template:
theorem intToRat_le (p q : Prod Nat Nat) (h : leRep p q) :

exercises.solution:
theorem intToRat_le (p q : Prod Nat Nat) (h : leRep p q) :
    ratLeRep (intToRatRep p) (intToRatRep q) :=
  leRep_mul_den_right p q Nat.zero h

exercises.unit: 单元69 数系链：从 ℕ 到 ℝ 的保序嵌入
exercises.name: ratLeRep_sub_nonpos
exercises.title: 69.7 `x ≤ y ⇒ x - y ≤ 0`

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把 `x ≤ y` 两边同加 `-y`（㊹ 的 `ratLeRep_add_right`），右边 `y + -y` 用 55 的 `ratAdd_neg_gen` 收成 0，再用 `ratLeRep_trans` 传递。`ratSubRep x y` 就是 `x + -y` 的定义。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratLeRep x y → ratLeRep (ratSubRep x y) ratZeroRep`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLeRep_add_right · ratAdd_neg_gen · ratLeRep_of_ratRel · ratLeRep_trans。

exercises.template:
theorem ratLeRep_sub_nonpos (x y : ratRep) (h : ratLeRep x y) :
    ratLeRep (ratSubRep x y) ratZeroRep :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratLeRep_sub_nonpos (x y : ratRep) (h : ratLeRep x y) :
    ratLeRep (ratSubRep x y) ratZeroRep :=
  ratLeRep_trans (ratAddRep x (ratNegRep y)) (ratAddRep y (ratNegRep y)) ratZeroRep
    (ratLeRep_add_right x y (ratNegRep y) h)
    (ratLeRep_of_ratRel (ratAddRep y (ratNegRep y)) ratZeroRep (ratAdd_neg_gen y))

exercises.unit: 单元69 数系链：从 ℕ 到 ℝ 的保序嵌入
exercises.name: ratToReal_le
exercises.title: 69.8 ℚ 序嵌入 ℝ（常序列）
exercises.prompt: 69.8 ℚ 序嵌入 ℝ（常序列）

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 66 的 `realLe_mk` 把商上的 `realLe` 化回代表元层的 `realLeRep`。三个分量：两个常序列的 Cauchy 性（68.1），以及逐点把 `x - y ≤ 0` 接到 `0 ≤ eps`（`ratLtRep_le`）上。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratLeRep x y → realLe (mk (constSeq x)) (mk (constSeq y))`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Iff.mpr · realLe_mk · cauchy_const · ratLeRep_sub_nonpos · ratLtRep_le · ratLeRep_trans。

exercises.template:
theorem ratToReal_le (x y : ratRep) (h : ratLeRep x y) :
    realLe (Real.mk (constSeq x)) (Real.mk (constSeq y)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratToReal_le (x y : ratRep) (h : ratLeRep x y) :
    realLe (Real.mk (constSeq x)) (Real.mk (constSeq y)) :=
  Iff.mpr (realLe_mk (constSeq x) (constSeq y))
    (And.intro (cauchy_const x)
      (And.intro (cauchy_const y)
        (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
          Exists.intro Nat.zero
            (fun (n : Nat) (_hn : LeNat Nat.zero n) =>
              ratLeRep_trans (ratSubRep (constSeq x n) (constSeq y n)) ratZeroRep eps
                (ratLeRep_sub_nonpos (constSeq x n) (constSeq y n) h)
                (ratLtRep_le ratZeroRep eps heps)))))

exercises.unit: 单元69 数系链：从 ℕ 到 ℝ 的保序嵌入
exercises.name: natToReal_le
exercises.title: 69.10 整条链保序
exercises.prompt: 69.10 整条链保序

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先 `natToInt_le` 把 ℕ 的序送进 ℤ 的代表元，再 `intToRat_le` 送进 ℚ 的代表元，最后把这两个代表元交给 69.8 `ratToReal_le`。这是 69.5 → 69.6 → 69.8 的合成，不需要新的算术。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `LeNat n m → realLe (natToReal n) (natToReal m)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratToReal_le · intToRat_le · natToInt_le。

exercises.template:
theorem natToReal_le (n m : Nat) (h : LeNat n m) :
    realLe (natToReal n) (natToReal m) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem natToReal_le (n m : Nat) (h : LeNat n m) :
    realLe (natToReal n) (natToReal m) :=
  ratToReal_le (intToRatRep (natToIntRep n)) (intToRatRep (natToIntRep m))
    (intToRat_le (natToIntRep n) (natToIntRep m) (natToInt_le n m h))

hints.label: 思路

exercises.unit: 单元71 数系综合：商的代价——一座桥与两座桥
exercises.name: quot_lift_unique
exercises.title: 71.1 两个 lift 相等：逐点相等就够了（funext）
exercises.prompt:
71.1 两个 lift 相等：逐点相等就够了（funext）

外层 lift 的返回值是函数；要证两个 lift 相等，先 `funext` 化成 「对每个商点相等」，再 `Quot.ind` 把商点烧成 `mk a`，两次 ι 归约后 目标就是 `f a = g a`，交给逐点假设。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `funext f g h` 三件都要显式给（两个被比的函数 + 逐点证明）；逐点证明里对商点做 `Quot.ind`，基例经两次 ι 归约就是 `h a`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `lift f hf = lift g hg`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: funext（显式两个函数）· Quot.ind · ι 归约。

exercises.template:
theorem quot_lift_unique (α β : Type) (r : α → α → Prop)
    (f g : α → β)
    (hf : ∀ (a b : α), r a b → f a = f b)
    (hg : ∀ (a b : α), r a b → g a = g b)
    (h : ∀ (a : α), f a = g a) :
    @Quot.lift.{1, 1} α r β f hf = @Quot.lift.{1, 1} α r β g hg :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem quot_lift_unique (α β : Type) (r : α → α → Prop)
    (f g : α → β)
    (hf : ∀ (a b : α), r a b → f a = f b)
    (hg : ∀ (a b : α), r a b → g a = g b)
    (h : ∀ (a : α), f a = g a) :
    @Quot.lift.{1, 1} α r β f hf = @Quot.lift.{1, 1} α r β g hg :=
  funext
    (@Quot.lift.{1, 1} α r β f hf)
    (@Quot.lift.{1, 1} α r β g hg)
    (fun (q : @Quot.{1} α r) =>
      @Quot.ind.{1} α r
        (fun (q : @Quot.{1} α r) =>
          @Quot.lift.{1, 1} α r β f hf q =
          @Quot.lift.{1, 1} α r β g hg q)
        (fun (a : α) => h a)
        q)

exercises.unit: 单元71 数系综合：商的代价——一座桥与两座桥
exercises.name: addRel_congr
exercises.title: 71.3 两座桥的代价：关系可以沿三个位置搬运
exercises.prompt:
71.3 两座桥的代价：关系可以沿三个位置搬运

`addRel` 不是函数，不能 `congrArg`；但它的三个参数都是相等可替换的。 依次沿 `c`、`b`、`a` 做三次 `Eq.subst`，就把关系搬到新的三元组上。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `h : addRel a b c`。先沿 `hc : c = c'` 搬第三个位置（motive `fun x => addRel a b x`），再沿 `hb` 搬第二个，最后沿 `ha` 搬第一个；`Eq.subst` 的参数是 motive、等式、旧证明。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `addRel a b c → a = a' → b = b' → c = c' → addRel a' b' c'`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Eq.subst（三次，位置从右到左）· 每次的 motive 只挖一个洞。

exercises.template:
theorem addRel_congr (a a' b b' c c' : Real)
    (h : addRel a b c) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') (hc : c = c') :
    addRel a' b' c' :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem addRel_congr (a a' b b' c c' : Real)
    (h : addRel a b c) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') (hc : c = c') :
    addRel a' b' c' :=
  @Eq.subst.{1} Real (fun (x : Real) => addRel a' b' x) c c' hc
    (@Eq.subst.{1} Real (fun (x : Real) => addRel a' x c) b b' hb
      (@Eq.subst.{1} Real (fun (x : Real) => addRel x b c) a a' ha h))

exercises.name: eventually_mono
exercises.title: 73.1 终究性对更强的性质封闭
exercises.prompt: 73.1 终究性对更强的性质封闭

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `Eventually P` 拆出阈值 `N` 与「从 N 起 P」；对同一个 `N` 把每个 `P n` 用 `hpq n` 换成 `Q n`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Eventually Q`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.elim · Exists.intro · 逐点假设 `hpq`。

exercises.template:
theorem eventually_mono (P Q : Nat → Prop) (h : Eventually P)
    (hpq : ∀ (n : Nat), P n → Q n) : Eventually Q :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem eventually_mono (P Q : Nat → Prop) (h : Eventually P)
    (hpq : ∀ (n : Nat), P n → Q n) : Eventually Q :=
  Exists.elim h
    (fun (N : Nat) (hN : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n → P n) =>
      Exists.intro N (fun (n : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) => hpq n (hN n hn)))

exercises.unit: 单元73 序列与极限：ε-N 的定义形状
exercises.name: eventually_and
exercises.title: 73.2 两条终究性可以合并（阈值取 max）
exercises.prompt: 73.2 两条终究性可以合并（阈值取 max）

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 两条假设各给一个阈值 `Np`、`Nq`；用 58 的 `leNat_max` 取一个同时 ≥ 两者的 `N`，再对 `n ≥ N` 用 `leNat_trans` 落回两个旧阈值。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Eventually (fun n => P n ∧ Q n)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: leNat_max · leNat_trans · And.intro · 两次 Exists.elim。

exercises.template:
theorem eventually_and (P Q : Nat → Prop) (hp : Eventually P) (hq : Eventually Q) :
    Eventually (fun (n : Nat) => P n ∧ Q n) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem eventually_and (P Q : Nat → Prop) (hp : Eventually P) (hq : Eventually Q) :
    Eventually (fun (n : Nat) => P n ∧ Q n) :=
  Exists.elim hp
    (fun (Np : Nat) (hNp : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat Np n → P n) =>
      Exists.elim hq
        (fun (Nq : Nat) (hNq : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat Nq n → Q n) =>
          Exists.elim (leNat_max Np Nq)
            (fun (N : Nat) (hN : LeNat Np N ∧ LeNat Nq N) =>
              Exists.intro N
                (fun (n : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) =>
                  And.intro
                    (hNp n (leNat_trans Np N n (And.left hN) hn))
                    (hNq n (leNat_trans Nq N n (And.right hN) hn))))))

exercises.prompt: 73.3 定义的展开形式

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `Converges` 与 `Eventually` 都是 `def`；把两边展开后是**同一个**命题，两个方向都取恒等函数。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Converges x L ↔ ∀ eps, 0 < eps → ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, close (x n) L eps`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Iff.intro · 定义性展开（`fun h => h`）。

exercises.template:
theorem converges_iff (x : Seq) (L : ratRep) :
    Converges x L ↔
      ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
        ∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n → close (x n) L eps :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem converges_iff (x : Seq) (L : ratRep) :
    Converges x L ↔
      ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
        ∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n → close (x n) L eps :=
  Iff.intro
    (fun (h : Converges x L) => h)
    (fun (h : ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
        ∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n → close (x n) L eps) => h)

exercises.unit: 单元73 序列与极限：ε-N 的定义形状
exercises.name: close_of_ratRel
exercises.title: 73.4 相等 ⇒ 任意 ε 内接近
exercises.prompt:
73.4 相等 ⇒ 任意 ε 内接近

见证取 `0`：`x ~ y` 时 `x - y ~ 0`，绝对值那一支由 `ratAbsRel_zero` 经 ㊷ 的 `ratAbsRel_wd_left` 搬过去；`0 < eps` 直接用假设。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `close` 是 `∃ d, ratAbsRel (x - y) d ∧ d < eps`；取 `d := 0`。先由 `x ~ y` 得 `x - y ~ 0`（55 的逆元律 + 加法同余），再用 ㊷ 的 `ratAbsRel_wd_left` 把 `ratAbsRel 0 0` 搬成 `ratAbsRel (x - y) 0`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `close x y eps`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.intro ratZeroRep · ratAddRep_wd_gen · ratAdd_neg_gen · ratAbsRel_wd_left · ratAbsRel_zero。

exercises.template:
theorem close_of_ratRel (x y : ratRep) (h : ratRel x y) (eps : ratRep)
    (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) : close x y eps :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem close_of_ratRel (x y : ratRep) (h : ratRel x y) (eps : ratRep)
    (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) : close x y eps :=
  Exists.intro ratZeroRep
    (And.intro
      (ratAbsRel_wd_left ratZeroRep (ratSubRep x y) ratZeroRep
        (ratRel_symm (ratSubRep x y) ratZeroRep
          (ratRel_trans_gen (ratSubRep x y) (ratSubRep y y) ratZeroRep
            (ratAddRep_wd_gen x y (ratNegRep y) h)
            (ratAdd_neg_gen y)))
        ratAbsRel_zero)
      heps)

exercises.prompt: 73.5 常序列收敛到自己的值

hints.label: 思路

hints.label: 目标形态

exercises.template:
theorem converges_const (q : ratRep) : Converges (constSeq q) q :=
  sorry

theorem converges_const (q : ratRep) : Converges (constSeq q) q :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>

exercises.unit: 单元74 极限的唯一性
exercises.name: ratSubRep_add_self
exercises.title: 74.1 `(x - y) + y ~ x`

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把 `x - y` 展开成 `x + (-y)`；54 的结合律把括号挪成 `x + ((-y) + y)`，55 的逆元律把 `(-y) + y` 收成 `0`，最后用加零律。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x y) y) x`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratAdd_assoc · ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen · ratNegRep_add_self · ratAdd_zero · ratRel_trans_gen。

exercises.template:
theorem ratSubRep_add_self (x y : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x y) y) x :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratSubRep_add_self (x y : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x y) y) x :=
  ratRel_trans_gen
    (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x y) y)
    (ratAddRep x (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) y))
    x
    (ratAdd_assoc x (ratNegRep y) y)
    (ratRel_trans_gen
      (ratAddRep x (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) y))
      (ratAddRep x ratZeroRep)
      x
      (ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen x (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) y) ratZeroRep
        (ratNegRep_add_self y))
      (ratAdd_zero x))

exercises.unit: 单元74 极限的唯一性
exercises.name: ratRel_of_sub_zero
exercises.title: 74.2 差为零 ⇒ 相等
exercises.prompt: 74.2 差为零 ⇒ 相等

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel 0 (x - y) → ratRel x y`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratSubRep_add_self · ratAddRep_wd_gen · ratAdd_zero_left · ratRel_trans_gen · ratRel_symm。

exercises.template:
theorem ratRel_of_sub_zero (x y : ratRep)
    (h : ratRel ratZeroRep (ratSubRep x y)) : ratRel x y :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratRel_of_sub_zero (x y : ratRep)
    (h : ratRel ratZeroRep (ratSubRep x y)) : ratRel x y :=
  ratRel_trans_gen x (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x y) y) y
    (ratRel_symm (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x y) y) x (ratSubRep_add_self x y))
    (ratRel_trans_gen
      (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x y) y)
      (ratAddRep ratZeroRep y)
      y
      (ratAddRep_wd_gen (ratSubRep x y) ratZeroRep y
        (ratRel_symm ratZeroRep (ratSubRep x y) h))
      (ratAdd_zero_left y))

exercises.unit: 单元74 极限的唯一性
exercises.name: ratLtRep_sub_pos
exercises.title: 74.3 `y < x` ⇒ `0 < x - y`

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 弱序一侧——`y ≤ x` 两边加 `-y`（54 的加法单调），左边 `y + (-y) ~ 0`，再沿同余把结论搬到 `x - y`。严格一侧——若 `0 ~ x - y`，用 74.2 得 `x ~ y`，撞上 `y < x` 的第二分量。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratLtRep ratZeroRep (ratSubRep x y)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLeRep_add_right · ratAdd_neg_gen · ratLeRep_congr_gen · ratLtRep_le · ratRel_of_sub_zero · And.right。

exercises.template:
theorem ratLtRep_sub_pos (x y : ratRep) (h : ratLtRep y x) :
    ratLtRep ratZeroRep (ratSubRep x y) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratLtRep_sub_pos (x y : ratRep) (h : ratLtRep y x) :
    ratLtRep ratZeroRep (ratSubRep x y) :=
  And.intro
    (ratLeRep_congr_gen
      (ratAddRep y (ratNegRep y)) ratZeroRep
      (ratSubRep x y) (ratAddRep x (ratNegRep y))
      (ratAdd_neg_gen y)
      (ratRel_refl (ratSubRep x y))
      (ratLeRep_add_right y x (ratNegRep y) (ratLtRep_le y x h)))
    (fun (h0 : ratRel ratZeroRep (ratSubRep x y)) =>
      ratLtRep_right y x h (ratRel_symm x y (ratRel_of_sub_zero x y h0)))

exercises.unit: 单元74 极限的唯一性
exercises.name: ratLeRep_eq_or_lt
exercises.title: 74.4 `≤` 是「相等」或「严格小」
exercises.prompt:
74.4 `≤` 是「相等」或「严格小」

`ratLeRep x y` 的展开是 `LeNat (A.fst + B.snd) (B.fst + A.snd)`， 其中 `A = leNum x y`、`B = leNum y x`。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把 `ratLeRep` 的头部展开成 `LeNat k m`（不要展开 `leNum` 里的 `Prod.fst`），交给 ㊺ 的 `leNat_eq_or_succ`：相等那支的等式正是 `ratRel x y`；严格小那支假设 `ratRel x y`，用 `ratLeRep_of_ratRel y x` 反着给出 `LeNat m k`，与 `leNat_succ_not_self` 撞矛盾。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel x y ∨ ratLtRep x y`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: leNat_eq_or_succ · leNat_succ_not_self · leNat_trans · ratLeRep_of_ratRel · ratRel_symm · And.intro。

exercises.template:
theorem ratLeRep_eq_or_lt (x y : ratRep) (h : ratLeRep x y) :
    ratRel x y ∨ ratLtRep x y :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratLeRep_eq_or_lt (x y : ratRep) (h : ratLeRep x y) :
    ratRel x y ∨ ratLtRep x y :=
  Or.elim
    (fun (heq : Nat.add (leNumFst x y) (leNumSnd y x) =
                Nat.add (leNumFst y x) (leNumSnd x y)) =>
      Or.inl heq)
    (fun (hlt : LeNat (Nat.succ (Nat.add (leNumFst x y) (leNumSnd y x)))
                     (Nat.add (leNumFst y x) (leNumSnd x y))) =>
      Or.inr
        ((fun (hp : ratLeRep x y ∧ ¬ ratRel x y) => hp)
          (And.intro h
            (fun (hxy : ratRel x y) =>
            leNat_succ_not_self
              (Nat.add (leNumFst x y) (leNumSnd y x))
              (leNat_trans
                (Nat.succ (Nat.add (leNumFst x y) (leNumSnd y x)))
                (Nat.add (leNumFst y x) (leNumSnd x y))
                (Nat.add (leNumFst x y) (leNumSnd y x))
                hlt
                (ratLeRep_of_ratRel y x (ratRel_symm x y hxy)))))))
    (leNat_eq_or_succ
      (Nat.add (leNumFst x y) (leNumSnd y x))
      (Nat.add (leNumFst y x) (leNumSnd x y))
      h)

exercises.unit: 单元74 极限的唯一性
exercises.name: ratHalf_lt_self
exercises.title: 74.5 半数严格小于自身
exercises.prompt: 74.5 半数严格小于自身

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 弱序 `eps/2 ≤ eps` 由 53 的半数正性出发，两边同加 `eps/2`，右边经 52 的 `ratHalf_add_self` 认成 `eps`。严格性用加法消去：若 `eps/2 ~ eps`，两边同加 `eps/2` 得 `eps ~ eps + eps/2`，与 `eps ~ eps + 0` 消去 `eps` 后落到 `0 ~ eps/2`，撞上 53 的 `0 < eps/2`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratLtRep (ratHalf eps) eps`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLeRep_half_of_lt · ratHalf_add_self · ratLeRep_congr_gen · ratRel_add_cancel_gen · ratLtRep_half · ratLtRep_right。

exercises.template:
theorem ratHalf_lt_self (eps : ratRep) (h : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) :
    ratLtRep (ratHalf eps) eps :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratHalf_lt_self (eps : ratRep) (h : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) :
    ratLtRep (ratHalf eps) eps :=
  And.intro
    (ratLeRep_congr_gen
      (ratAddRep ratZeroRep (ratHalf eps)) (ratHalf eps)
      (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps)) eps
      (ratAdd_zero_left (ratHalf eps))
      (ratHalf_add_self eps)
      (ratLeRep_add_right ratZeroRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps)
        (ratLeRep_half_of_lt eps h)))
    (fun (heq : ratRel (ratHalf eps) eps) =>
      (ratLtRep_right ratZeroRep (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps h))
        (ratRel_add_cancel_gen ratZeroRep (ratHalf eps) eps
          (ratRel_trans_gen
            (ratAddRep ratZeroRep eps)
            (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps))
            (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) eps)
            (ratRel_trans_gen
              (ratAddRep ratZeroRep eps) eps
              (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps))
              (ratAdd_zero_left eps)
              (ratRel_symm
                (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps)) eps
                (ratHalf_add_self eps)))
            (ratRel_trans_gen
              (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps))
              (ratAddRep eps (ratHalf eps))
              (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) eps)
              (ratAddRep_wd_gen (ratHalf eps) eps (ratHalf eps) heq)
              (ratAdd_comm eps (ratHalf eps))))))

exercises.unit: 单元74 极限的唯一性
exercises.name: ratLeRep_of_close_all
exercises.title: 74.6 任意 ε 内接近 ⇒ `≤`
exercises.prompt: 74.6 任意 ε 内接近 ⇒ `≤`

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先用 ㊺ 的全性分两支：`x ≤ y` 直接收；`y ≤ x` 时再用 74.4 分「y ~ x」与「y < x」。前者经对称性转成 `x ≤ y`；后者令 `d := x - y`（74.3 给 `0 < d`），取 `eps := d/2`：`close x y (d/2)` 经 68.4 的 `close_sub_le` 给 `d ≤ d/2`，74.5 给 `d/2 ≤ d`，反对称性夹出 `d/2 ~ d`，撞上 74.5 的严格性。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `(∀ eps > 0, close x y eps) → ratLeRep x y`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLeRep_total · ratLeRep_eq_or_lt · ratLtRep_sub_pos · ratLtRep_half · close_sub_le · ratHalf_lt_self · ratLeRep_antisymm · False.elim。

exercises.template:
theorem ratLeRep_of_close_all (x y : ratRep)
    (h : ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps → close x y eps) :
    ratLeRep x y :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratLeRep_of_close_all (x y : ratRep)
    (h : ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps → close x y eps) :
    ratLeRep x y :=
  Or.elim
    (fun (hxy : ratLeRep x y) => hxy)
    (fun (hyx : ratLeRep y x) => ratLeRep_of_le_or_lt x y hyx h)
    (ratLeRep_total x y)

exercises.unit: 单元74 极限的唯一性
exercises.name: converges_unique
exercises.title: 74.7 极限唯一（ℚ 层）
exercises.prompt: 74.7 极限唯一（ℚ 层）

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对任意 `eps > 0`，用 74.5 得 `0 < eps/2`；两个极限各取阈值，73.2 的 `eventually_and` 合并到同一个 `N`。在 `n := N` 上一条用 `close_symm` 反向，与另一条一起交给 57 的 `close_trans`，得 `close L L' eps`。最后对 `∀ eps > 0, close L L' eps` 用 74.6 两次（反向那次套 `close_symm`）与 ㊻ 的 `ratLeRep_antisymm`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel L L'`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLtRep_half · eventually_and · close_symm · close_trans · ratLeRep_of_close_all · ratLeRep_antisymm。

exercises.template:
theorem converges_unique (x : Seq) (L L' : ratRep)
    (hL : Converges x L) (hL' : Converges x L') : ratRel L L' :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem converges_unique (x : Seq) (L L' : ratRep)
    (hL : Converges x L) (hL' : Converges x L') : ratRel L L' :=
  ratRel_of_close_all L L'
    (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
      Exists.elim
        (eventually_and (fun (n : Nat) => close (x n) L (ratHalf eps))
          (fun (n : Nat) => close (x n) L' (ratHalf eps))
          (hL (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
          (hL' (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps)))
        (fun (N : Nat)
            (hN : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n →
              close (x n) L (ratHalf eps) ∧ close (x n) L' (ratHalf eps)) =>
          close_trans L (x N) L' eps heps
            (close_symm (x N) L (ratHalf eps) (And.left (hN N (LeNat.le_refl N))))
            (And.right (hN N (LeNat.le_refl N)))))

exercises.unit: 单元74 极限的唯一性
exercises.name: converges_unique_class
exercises.title: 74.8 极限唯一（ℝ 层：两个类相等）
exercises.prompt: 74.8 极限唯一（ℝ 层：两个类相等）

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把 74.7 的 `ratRel L L'` 经 73.4 的 `close_of_ratRel` 变成常序列的逐点接近；连同两条 `cauchy_const` 正好是 `realRel (constSeq L) (constSeq L')` 的三个分量，最后交给 `Real.sound`。外层是 `realRel` 这个定义别名，内部的 `And.intro` 要把命题写全。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Real.mk (constSeq L) = Real.mk (constSeq L')`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Real.sound · cauchy_const · close_of_ratRel · converges_unique · Exists.intro Nat.zero。

exercises.template:
theorem converges_unique_class (x : Seq) (L L' : ratRep)
    (hL : Converges x L) (hL' : Converges x L') :
    Real.mk (constSeq L) = Real.mk (constSeq L') :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem converges_unique_class (x : Seq) (L L' : ratRep)
    (hL : Converges x L) (hL' : Converges x L') :
    Real.mk (constSeq L) = Real.mk (constSeq L') :=
  Real.sound (constSeq L) (constSeq L')
    (realRel_const_intro L L' (converges_unique x L L' hL hL'))

exercises.unit: 单元75 极限与序
exercises.name: ratLeRep_of_sub_le_all
exercises.title: 75.1 单侧界：任意 ε 内 `x - y ≤ ε` ⇒ `x ≤ y`
exercises.prompt: 75.1 单侧界：任意 ε 内 `x - y ≤ ε` ⇒ `x ≤ y`

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先用 ㊺ 的全性分两支：`x ≤ y` 直接收；`y ≤ x` 时再用 74.4 分「y ~ x」与「y < x」。前者经对称性转成 `x ≤ y`；后者令 `d := x - y`（74.3 给 `0 < d`），取 `eps := d/2`：假设给 `d ≤ d/2`，74.5 给 `d/2 ≤ d`，反对称性夹出 `d/2 ~ d`，撞上 74.5 的严格性。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `(∀ eps > 0, (x - y) ≤ eps) → ratLeRep x y`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLeRep_total · ratLeRep_eq_or_lt · ratLtRep_sub_pos · ratHalf_lt_self · ratLtRep_half_irrel · ratLeRep_antisymm · False.elim。

exercises.template:
theorem ratLeRep_of_sub_le_all (x y : ratRep)
    (h : ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
      ratLeRep (ratSubRep x y) eps) :
    ratLeRep x y :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratLeRep_of_sub_le_all (x y : ratRep)
    (h : ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
      ratLeRep (ratSubRep x y) eps) :
    ratLeRep x y :=
  Or.elim
    (fun (hxy : ratLeRep x y) => hxy)
    (fun (hyx : ratLeRep y x) =>
      Or.elim
        (fun (hyx_eq : ratRel y x) =>
          ratLeRep_of_ratRel x y (ratRel_symm y x hyx_eq))
        (fun (hyx_lt : ratLtRep y x) =>
          @False.elim (ratLeRep x y)
            (ratLtRep_half_irrel (ratSubRep x y) (ratLtRep_sub_pos x y hyx_lt)
              (ratRel_symm (ratSubRep x y) (ratHalf (ratSubRep x y))
                (ratLeRep_antisymm (ratSubRep x y) (ratHalf (ratSubRep x y))
                  (h (ratHalf (ratSubRep x y))
                    (ratLtRep_half (ratSubRep x y)
                      (ratLtRep_sub_pos x y hyx_lt)))
                  (ratLtRep_le (ratHalf (ratSubRep x y)) (ratSubRep x y)
                    (ratHalf_lt_self (ratSubRep x y)
                      (ratLtRep_sub_pos x y hyx_lt)))))))
        (ratLeRep_eq_or_lt y x hyx))
    (ratLeRep_total x y)

exercises.unit: 单元75 极限与序
exercises.name: converges_le_of_eventually
exercises.title: 75.2 极限保持非严格不等式
exercises.prompt: 75.2 极限保持非严格不等式

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对任意 `eps > 0` 用 75.1。取阈值：`eventually_and` 先把「x n ≤ y n」与「两条 `eps/2` 接近性」并到同一个 `N`，在 `n := N` 上把 `L - M` 拆成 `(L - x N) + (x N - M)`：第一项由 `close_symm` + `close_sub_le` 给 `eps/2`，第二项先由 `x N ≤ y N` 单调右加 `-M`、再由 `y N` 的接近性给 `eps/2`；`ratLeRep_add` 相加，`ratSubRep_add` 与 `ratHalf_add_self` 两边换形。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratLeRep L M`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLeRep_of_sub_le_all · eventually_and · close_symm · close_sub_le · ratLeRep_add_right · ratLeRep_trans · ratLeRep_add · ratSubRep_add · ratHalf_add_self · ratLeRep_congr_gen。

exercises.template:
theorem converges_le_of_eventually (x y : Seq) (L M : ratRep)
    (hx : Converges x L) (hy : Converges y M)
    (hxy : Eventually (fun (n : Nat) => ratLeRep (x n) (y n))) :
    ratLeRep L M :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem converges_le_of_eventually (x y : Seq) (L M : ratRep)
    (hx : Converges x L) (hy : Converges y M)
    (hxy : Eventually (fun (n : Nat) => ratLeRep (x n) (y n))) :
    ratLeRep L M :=
  ratLeRep_of_sub_le_all L M
    (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
      Exists.elim
        (eventually_and
          (fun (n : Nat) => ratLeRep (x n) (y n))
          (fun (n : Nat) => close (x n) L (ratHalf eps) ∧
                            close (y n) M (ratHalf eps))
          hxy
          (eventually_and
            (fun (n : Nat) => close (x n) L (ratHalf eps))
            (fun (n : Nat) => close (y n) M (ratHalf eps))
            (hx (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
            (hy (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps))))
        (fun (N : Nat)
            (hN : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n →
              ratLeRep (x n) (y n) ∧
                (close (x n) L (ratHalf eps) ∧
                 close (y n) M (ratHalf eps))) =>
          ratLeRep_congr_gen
            (ratAddRep (ratSubRep L (x N)) (ratSubRep (x N) M))
            (ratSubRep L M)
            (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps))
            eps
            (ratSubRep_add L (x N) M)
            (ratHalf_add_self eps)
            (ratLeRep_add
              (ratSubRep L (x N)) (ratHalf eps)
              (ratSubRep (x N) M) (ratHalf eps)
              (close_sub_le L (x N) (ratHalf eps)
                (close_symm (x N) L (ratHalf eps)
                  (And.left (And.right (hN N (LeNat.le_refl N))))))
              (ratLeRep_trans
                (ratSubRep (x N) M) (ratSubRep (y N) M) (ratHalf eps)
                (ratLeRep_add_right (x N) (y N) (ratNegRep M)
                  (And.left (hN N (LeNat.le_refl N))))
                (close_sub_le (y N) M (ratHalf eps)
                  (And.right (And.right (hN N (LeNat.le_refl N)))))))))

theorem converges_congr_limit (x : Seq) (L L' : ratRep)
    (h : Converges x L) (hLL' : ratRel L L') : Converges x L' :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    eventually_mono
      (fun (n : Nat) => close (x n) L (ratHalf eps))
      (fun (n : Nat) => close (x n) L' eps)
