exercises.unit: 单元101 Cauchy 序列有界
exercises.name: bounded_add_const
exercises.title: 101.3 加一个常数保持有界
exercises.prompt:
101.3 加一个常数保持有界

若 |x n| ≤ B，则 `x n + q ≤ B + q`、`-(x n + q) ≤ B + (-q)`。 两条界再用 `exists_upper_of_two` 合成。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 从 `Bounded x` 拆出逐点的 B。正侧用 `ratLeRep_add_right`；负侧先用 `ratNegRep_add` 把 `-(x n + q)` 认成 `(-x n) + (-q)`，再用 `ratLeRep_congr_gen` 与同一条加法单调搬过去。两个上界 `B + q`、`B + (-q)` 交给 `exists_upper_of_two`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Bounded (fun (n : Nat) => ratAddRep (x n) q)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: exists_upper_of_two · ratLeRep_add_right · ratNegRep_add · ratLeRep_congr_gen · ratLeRep_trans · ratRel_refl。

exercises.template:
theorem bounded_add_const (x : Seq) (q : ratRep) (h : Bounded x) :
    Bounded (fun (n : Nat) => ratAddRep (x n) q) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem bounded_add_const (x : Seq) (q : ratRep) (h : Bounded x) :
    Bounded (fun (n : Nat) => ratAddRep (x n) q) :=
  Exists.elim h
    (fun (B : ratRep)
        (hB : ∀ (n : Nat),
          ratLeRep (x n) B ∧ ratLeRep (ratNegRep (x n)) B) =>
      Exists.elim
        (exists_upper_of_two (ratAddRep B q) (ratAddRep B (ratNegRep q)))
        (fun (C : ratRep)
            (hC : ratLeRep (ratAddRep B q) C ∧
                  ratLeRep (ratAddRep B (ratNegRep q)) C) =>
          Exists.intro C
            (fun (n : Nat) =>
              And.intro
                (ratLeRep_trans (ratAddRep (x n) q) (ratAddRep B q) C
                  (ratLeRep_add_right (x n) B q (And.left (hB n)))
                  (And.left hC))
                (ratLeRep_trans (ratNegRep (ratAddRep (x n) q))
                  (ratAddRep B (ratNegRep q)) C
                  (ratLeRep_congr_gen
                    (ratNegRep (ratAddRep (x n) q))
                    (ratAddRep (ratNegRep (x n)) (ratNegRep q))
                    (ratAddRep B (ratNegRep q))
                    (ratAddRep B (ratNegRep q))
                    (ratNegRep_add (x n) q)
                    (ratRel_refl (ratAddRep B (ratNegRep q)))
                    (ratLeRep_add_right (ratNegRep (x n)) B (ratNegRep q)
                      (And.right (hB n))))
                  (And.right hC)))))

exercises.unit: 单元102 Cauchy 性的等价写法
exercises.name: cauchy_oriented
exercises.title: 102.0 定向形式：只比较 n ≤ m 的一侧
exercises.prompt:
102.0 定向形式：只比较 n ≤ m 的一侧

原定义对 n、m 对称；定向形式保留 n ≤ m 的一支。正向是直接削弱： Cauchy 本来就对任意一对下标给接近性，多出来的 `n ≤ m` 用不上。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 拆开 `h eps heps` 得阈值 N；对 n、m ≥ N，先用 `leNat_trans N n m hn hnm` 得到 `N ≤ m`，再把两条界交给 `hN n m`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (n m : Nat), LeNat N n → LeNat n m → close (x n) (x m) eps`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.elim · Exists.intro。

exercises.template:
theorem cauchy_oriented (x : Seq) (h : Cauchy x) :
    ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
      ∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (n m : Nat), LeNat N n → LeNat n m →
        close (x n) (x m) eps :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem cauchy_oriented (x : Seq) (h : Cauchy x) :
    ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
      ∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (n m : Nat), LeNat N n → LeNat n m →
        close (x n) (x m) eps :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (h eps heps)
      (fun (N : Nat)
          (hN : ∀ (n m : Nat), LeNat N n → LeNat N m →
            close (x n) (x m) eps) =>
        Exists.intro N
          (fun (n m : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) (hnm : LeNat n m) =>
            hN n m hn (leNat_trans N n m hn hnm)))

exercises.unit: 单元102 Cauchy 性的等价写法
exercises.name: cauchy_of_oriented
exercises.title: 102.1 从定向形式回到原定义
exercises.prompt:
102.1 从定向形式回到原定义

任意一对 n、m 由全性分成 `n ≤ m` 与 `m ≤ n` 两支。前一支直接用定向假设； 后一支把 `m ≤ n` 的那条接近性翻向。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 给定 ε 先取定向假设的阈值 N。对 n、m ≥ N，用 `leNat_total n m` 分两支：`n ≤ m` 交给定向假设，`m ≤ n` 则由 `close_symm` 把 `close (x m) (x n) ε` 翻成 `close (x n) (x m) ε`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Cauchy x`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: leNat_total · close_symm · Or.elim · Exists.elim · Exists.intro。

exercises.template:
theorem cauchy_of_oriented (x : Seq)
    (h : ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
      ∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (n m : Nat), LeNat N n → LeNat n m →
        close (x n) (x m) eps) :
    Cauchy x :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem cauchy_of_oriented (x : Seq)
    (h : ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
      ∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (n m : Nat), LeNat N n → LeNat n m →
        close (x n) (x m) eps) :
    Cauchy x :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (h eps heps)
      (fun (N : Nat)
          (hN : ∀ (n m : Nat), LeNat N n → LeNat n m →
            close (x n) (x m) eps) =>
        Exists.intro N
          (fun (n m : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) (hm : LeNat N m) =>
            Or.elim
              (fun (hnm : LeNat n m) => hN n m hn hnm)
              (fun (hmn : LeNat m n) =>
                close_symm (x m) (x n) eps (hN m n hm hmn))
              (leNat_total n m)))

exercises.unit: 单元102 Cauchy 性的等价写法
exercises.name: cauchy_tail_jump
exercises.title: 102.3 尾部跳跃：固定 n，让 k 任意跑
exercises.prompt:
102.3 尾部跳跃：固定 n，让 k 任意跑

取原定义的阈值 N。对 n ≥ N，`n ≤ n + k` 由 `leNat_self_add` 给出， 于是 `x (n + k)` 也在尾巴上，两项比较直接可用。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `h eps heps` 给 N。对 n ≥ N 与任意 k，用 `leNat_self_add n k` 得 `n ≤ n + k`，再把 `hn` 与它一起交给 `hN`。注意 `hN` 要的是 `N ≤ n + k`：由 `leNat_trans N n (n+k) hn (leNat_self_add n k)` 得到。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n → ∀ (k : Nat), close (x n) (x (Nat.add n k)) eps`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: leNat_self_add · leNat_trans · Exists.elim · Exists.intro。

exercises.template:
theorem cauchy_tail_jump (x : Seq) (h : Cauchy x) :
    ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
      ∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n →
        ∀ (k : Nat), close (x n) (x (Nat.add n k)) eps :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem cauchy_tail_jump (x : Seq) (h : Cauchy x) :
    ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
      ∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n →
        ∀ (k : Nat), close (x n) (x (Nat.add n k)) eps :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (h eps heps)
      (fun (N : Nat)
          (hN : ∀ (n m : Nat), LeNat N n → LeNat N m →
            close (x n) (x m) eps) =>
        Exists.intro N
          (fun (n : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) (k : Nat) =>
            hN n (Nat.add n k) hn
              (leNat_trans N n (Nat.add n k) hn (leNat_self_add n k))))

exercises.unit: 单元102 Cauchy 性的等价写法
exercises.name: cauchy_of_tail_jump
exercises.title: 102.4 从跳跃形式回到原定义
exercises.prompt:
102.4 从跳跃形式回到原定义

先走 102.1 的定向形式。对 n ≤ m，`leNat_exists_add` 给出 m = n + k； 把等式代进目标，跳跃假设正好给 `close (x n) (x (n + k)) ε`。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 102.1 的定向形式逐条构造：给 ε 取跳跃假设的 N；对 n ≤ m，用 `leNat_exists_add n m hnm` 得 `m = n + k`；再用 `@Eq.subst` 沿 `Eq.symm hk` 把 `close (x n) (x (n+k)) ε` 搬到 `close (x n) (x m) ε`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Cauchy x`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: cauchy_of_oriented · leNat_exists_add · Eq.subst · Eq.symm · Exists.elim · Exists.intro。

exercises.template:
theorem cauchy_of_tail_jump (x : Seq)
    (h : ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
      ∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n →
        ∀ (k : Nat), close (x n) (x (Nat.add n k)) eps) :
    Cauchy x :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem cauchy_of_tail_jump (x : Seq)
    (h : ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
      ∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n →
        ∀ (k : Nat), close (x n) (x (Nat.add n k)) eps) :
    Cauchy x :=
  cauchy_of_oriented x
    (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
      Exists.elim (h eps heps)
        (fun (N : Nat)
            (hN : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n → ∀ (k : Nat),
              close (x n) (x (Nat.add n k)) eps) =>
          Exists.intro N
            (fun (n m : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) (hnm : LeNat n m) =>
              Exists.elim (leNat_exists_add n m hnm)
                (fun (k : Nat) (hk : m = Nat.add n k) =>
                  @Eq.subst.{1} Nat
                    (fun (z : Nat) => close (x n) (x z) eps)
                    (Nat.add n k) m
                    (Eq.symm hk)
                    (hN n hn k)))))

exercises.unit: 单元103 实数相等与差趋于零
exercises.name: close_sub_zero
exercises.title: 103.0 接近性只差一个零
exercises.prompt:
103.0 接近性只差一个零

`close a b ε` 的见证是 `|a - b| ~ d`。把 `a - b` 看成 `(a - b) - 0`： 两者沿 `ratAdd_zero` 等价，绝对值不变。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 两个方向都用同一个见证 d。正向把 `ratAdd_zero (a-b)` 交给 `ratAbsRel_wd_left`，反向则先用 `ratAbsRel_wd_left` 把 `|(a-b)-0|` 搬回 `|a-b|`；注意 `ratSubRep z ratZeroRep` 展开后正是 `z + 0`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `close a b eps ↔ close (ratSubRep a b) ratZeroRep eps`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratAdd_zero · ratAbsRel_wd_left · Iff.intro · Exists.elim · Exists.intro · And.intro。

exercises.template:
theorem close_sub_zero (a b eps : ratRep) :
    close a b eps ↔ close (ratSubRep a b) ratZeroRep eps :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem close_sub_zero (a b eps : ratRep) :
    close a b eps ↔ close (ratSubRep a b) ratZeroRep eps :=
  Iff.intro
    (fun (h : close a b eps) =>
      Exists.elim h
        (fun (d : ratRep)
            (hd : ratAbsRel (ratSubRep a b) d ∧ ratLtRep d eps) =>
          Exists.intro d
            (And.intro
              (ratAbsRel_wd_left (ratSubRep a b)
                (ratSubRep (ratSubRep a b) ratZeroRep) d
                (ratRel_symm (ratSubRep (ratSubRep a b) ratZeroRep)
                  (ratSubRep a b) (ratAdd_zero (ratSubRep a b)))
                (And.left hd))
              (And.right hd))))
    (fun (h : close (ratSubRep a b) ratZeroRep eps) =>
      Exists.elim h
        (fun (d : ratRep)
            (hd : ratAbsRel (ratSubRep (ratSubRep a b) ratZeroRep) d ∧
                  ratLtRep d eps) =>
          Exists.intro d
            (And.intro
              (ratAbsRel_wd_left (ratSubRep (ratSubRep a b) ratZeroRep)
                (ratSubRep a b) d
                (ratAdd_zero (ratSubRep a b))
                (And.left hd))
              (And.right hd))))

exercises.unit: 单元103 实数相等与差趋于零
exercises.name: tends_zero_of_realRel
exercises.title: 103.1 实数相等推出差趋于零
exercises.prompt:
103.1 实数相等推出差趋于零

`realRel x y` 的第三项对每个 ε 给阈值与 `close (x n) (y n) ε`。 逐点把它换成 `close (x n - y n) 0 ε`，就得到 `diffSeq` 的 ε-N 陈述。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 拆开 `h` 得 Cauchy 性与逐点接近性。对 ε > 0 取第三项给的 N；对 n ≥ N，用 103.0 的正向把 `close (x n) (y n) ε` 换成 `close (x n - y n) 0 ε`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Converges (diffSeq x y) ratZeroRep`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: close_sub_zero · And.left · And.right · Exists.elim · Exists.intro。

exercises.template:
theorem tends_zero_of_realRel (x y : Seq) (h : realRel x y) :
    Converges (diffSeq x y) ratZeroRep :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem tends_zero_of_realRel (x y : Seq) (h : realRel x y) :
    Converges (diffSeq x y) ratZeroRep :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (realRel_close x y h eps heps)
      (fun (N : Nat)
          (hN : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n → close (x n) (y n) eps) =>
        Exists.intro N
          (fun (n : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) =>
            Iff.mp (close_sub_zero (x n) (y n) eps) (hN n hn)))

exercises.unit: 单元103 实数相等与差趋于零
exercises.name: realRel_of_tends_zero
exercises.title: 103.2 差趋于零推出实数相等
exercises.prompt:
103.2 差趋于零推出实数相等

两个 Cauchy 前提直接由假设给出。逐点接近性从 `diffSeq` 的收敛陈述 经 103.0 的反向搬回来。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 用 `And.intro` 拼三件：`hx`、`hy`、以及逐点接近性。逐点那条对 ε > 0 取 `h` 给的 N，再用 103.0 的反向把 `close (x n - y n) 0 ε` 搬成 `close (x n) (y n) ε`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `realRel x y`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: close_sub_zero · And.intro · Exists.elim · Exists.intro。

exercises.template:
theorem realRel_of_tends_zero (x y : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) (hy : Cauchy y)
    (h : Converges (diffSeq x y) ratZeroRep) : realRel x y :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem realRel_of_tends_zero (x y : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) (hy : Cauchy y)
    (h : Converges (diffSeq x y) ratZeroRep) : realRel x y :=
  And.intro hx
    (And.intro hy
      (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
        Exists.elim (h eps heps)
          (fun (N : Nat)
              (hN : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n →
                close (diffSeq x y n) ratZeroRep eps) =>
            Exists.intro N
              (fun (n : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) =>
                Iff.mpr (close_sub_zero (x n) (y n) eps) (hN n hn)))))

exercises.unit: 单元103 实数相等与差趋于零
exercises.name: realRel_iff_tends_zero
exercises.title: 103.3 两种说法的等价
exercises.prompt:
103.3 两种说法的等价

正向拆开 `realRel` 后交 103.1；反向把三件假设按 `realRel` 的形状拼好， 再交 103.2。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `Iff.intro`。正向：`And.left h` 是第一个 Cauchy，`And.left (And.right h)` 是第二个，第三件交给 103.1。反向：把 `h : Cauchy x ∧ Cauchy y ∧ Converges ...` 的三层 `And` 拆开，交给 103.2。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `realRel x y ↔ Cauchy x ∧ Cauchy y ∧ Converges (diffSeq x y) ratZeroRep`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Iff.intro · tends_zero_of_realRel · realRel_of_tends_zero · And.left · And.right · And.intro。

exercises.template:
theorem realRel_iff_tends_zero (x y : Seq) :
    realRel x y ↔
      Cauchy x ∧ Cauchy y ∧ Converges (diffSeq x y) ratZeroRep :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem realRel_iff_tends_zero (x y : Seq) :
    realRel x y ↔
      Cauchy x ∧ Cauchy y ∧ Converges (diffSeq x y) ratZeroRep :=
  Iff.intro
    (fun (h : realRel x y) =>
      And.intro (And.left h)
        (And.intro (And.left (And.right h)) (tends_zero_of_realRel x y h)))
    (fun (h : Cauchy x ∧ Cauchy y ∧ Converges (diffSeq x y) ratZeroRep) =>
      realRel_of_tends_zero x y
        (And.left h) (And.left (And.right h)) (And.right (And.right h)))

exercises.unit: 单元103 实数相等与差趋于零
exercises.name: demo_diff_self_tends_zero
exercises.title: 103.4 自差趋于零
exercises.prompt:
103.4 自差趋于零

收敛到自身：`close (x n) (x n) ε` 由 `close_of_ratRel` 与自反性给出， 再用 103.1 换成差的形式。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先构造 `realRel x x`：两个 Cauchy 前提都是 `h`，逐点接近性用 `close_of_ratRel (x n) (x n) (ratRel_refl (x n))`。再交给 103.1。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Converges (diffSeq x x) ratZeroRep`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: realRel · close_of_ratRel · ratRel_refl · tends_zero_of_realRel。

exercises.template:
theorem demo_diff_self_tends_zero (x : Seq) (h : Cauchy x) :
    Converges (diffSeq x x) ratZeroRep :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem demo_diff_self_tends_zero (x : Seq) (h : Cauchy x) :
    Converges (diffSeq x x) ratZeroRep :=
  tends_zero_of_realRel x x
    (And.intro h
      (And.intro h
        (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
          Exists.intro Nat.zero
            (fun (n : Nat) (_hn : LeNat Nat.zero n) =>
              close_of_ratRel (x n) (x n) (ratRel_refl (x n)) eps heps))))

exercises.unit: 单元104 极限类的唯一性
exercises.name: ratSubRep_add_self_sub
exercises.title: 104.0 `(b + e) - b ~ e`
exercises.prompt:
104.0 `(b + e) - b ~ e`

减法加回被减数给 `((b + e) - b) + b ~ b + e`，交换律给 `e + b ~ b + e`。 两边都加同一个 `b`，就能把 `b` 消掉。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先用 `ratSubRep_add_self (ratAddRep b e) b` 得 `((b+e)-b)+b ~ b+e`，再用 `ratAdd_comm b e` 把 `b+e` 换成 `e+b`；两条接起来后交给 `ratRel_add_cancel_gen`，它消去末尾的 `b`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel (ratSubRep (ratAddRep b e) b) e`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratSubRep_add_self · ratAdd_comm · ratRel_trans_gen · ratRel_add_cancel_gen。

exercises.template:
theorem ratSubRep_add_self_sub (b e : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratSubRep (ratAddRep b e) b) e :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratSubRep_add_self_sub (b e : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratSubRep (ratAddRep b e) b) e :=
  ratRel_add_cancel_gen (ratSubRep (ratAddRep b e) b) e b
    (ratRel_trans_gen
      (ratAddRep (ratSubRep (ratAddRep b e) b) b)
      (ratAddRep b e)
      (ratAddRep e b)
      (ratSubRep_add_self (ratAddRep b e) b)
      (ratAdd_comm b e))

exercises.unit: 单元104 极限类的唯一性
exercises.name: ratSubRep_add_le_two
exercises.title: 104.1 把常数并进误差
exercises.prompt:
104.1 把常数并进误差

若 `a - (b + e) ≤ e`，把 `a - b` 看成 `(a - (b + e)) + ((b + e) - b)`。 第一块不超过 `e`，第二块由 104.0 也压成 `e`。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把 104.0 的等式经 `ratLeRep_of_ratRel` 投成 `(b+e)-b ≤ e`，再与假设 h 一起交给 `ratLeRep_sub_add a (b+e) b e`；它把两段 `≤ e` 相加成 `≤ e + e`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratLeRep (ratSubRep a b) (ratAddRep e e)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLeRep_sub_add · ratLeRep_of_ratRel · ratSubRep_add_self_sub。

exercises.template:
theorem ratSubRep_add_le_two (a b e : ratRep)
    (h : ratLeRep (ratSubRep a (ratAddRep b e)) e) :
    ratLeRep (ratSubRep a b) (ratAddRep e e) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratSubRep_add_le_two (a b e : ratRep)
    (h : ratLeRep (ratSubRep a (ratAddRep b e)) e) :
    ratLeRep (ratSubRep a b) (ratAddRep e e) :=
  ratLeRep_sub_add a (ratAddRep b e) b e h
    (ratLeRep_of_ratRel (ratSubRep (ratAddRep b e) b) e
      (ratSubRep_add_self_sub b e))

exercises.unit: 单元104 极限类的唯一性
exercises.name: ratHalf_four
exercises.title: 104.2 四个四分之一是一个整体
exercises.prompt:
104.2 四个四分之一是一个整体

把 `(e+e)+(e+e)` 里的两个 `e+e` 分别换成 `eps/2`，最后再把 `eps/2 + eps/2` 收成 `eps`。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 两次 `ratHalf_add_self (ratHalf eps)` 把两个 `e+e` 都换成 `eps/2`：第一次用 `ratAddRep_wd_gen`（换左边），第二次用 `ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen`（换右边）；最后接上 `ratHalf_add_self eps`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel (ratAddRep (ratAddRep e e) (ratAddRep e e)) eps`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratHalf_add_self · ratAddRep_wd_gen · ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen · ratRel_trans_gen。

exercises.template:
theorem ratHalf_four (eps : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (eps4 eps) (eps4 eps))
                     (ratAddRep (eps4 eps) (eps4 eps)))
           eps :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratHalf_four (eps : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (eps4 eps) (eps4 eps))
                     (ratAddRep (eps4 eps) (eps4 eps)))
           eps :=
  ratRel_trans_gen
    (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (eps4 eps) (eps4 eps))
               (ratAddRep (eps4 eps) (eps4 eps)))
    (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps))
    eps
    (ratRel_trans_gen
      (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (eps4 eps) (eps4 eps))
                 (ratAddRep (eps4 eps) (eps4 eps)))
      (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) (ratAddRep (eps4 eps) (eps4 eps)))
      (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps))
      (ratAddRep_wd_gen
        (ratAddRep (eps4 eps) (eps4 eps))
        (ratHalf eps)
        (ratAddRep (eps4 eps) (eps4 eps))
        (ratHalf_add_self (ratHalf eps)))
      (ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen
        (ratHalf eps)
        (ratAddRep (eps4 eps) (eps4 eps))
        (ratHalf eps)
        (ratHalf_add_self (ratHalf eps))))
    (ratHalf_add_self eps)

exercises.unit: 单元104 极限类的唯一性
exercises.name: tendsTo_tail_le
exercises.title: 104.3 固定一个下标后的尾部估计
exercises.prompt:
104.3 固定一个下标后的尾部估计

两条 `realLeRep` 给两条尾部估计：`L(n) - (x(n₀) + e) ≤ e` 与 `x(n₀) - (L'(n) + e) ≤ e`。各自用 104.1 把常数并进误差，得到两条 `a - b ≤ e + e`，再用 `ratLeRep_sub_add` 相加。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先 `realLeRep_close` 两条假设拿到阈值 M1、M2，用 `leNat_max` 合并成 N；对 n ≥ N，`ratSubRep_add_le_two` 各给一条 `≤ e+e`，`ratLeRep_sub_add` 把它俩加成 `≤ (e+e)+(e+e)`，最后用 `ratLeRep_congr_gen` 沿 104.2 换成 `eps`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, ratLeRep (ratSubRep (L n) (L' n)) eps`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: realLeRep_close · leNat_max · ratSubRep_add_le_two · ratLeRep_sub_add · ratHalf_four。

exercises.template:
theorem tendsTo_tail_le (x L L' : Seq) (n0 : Nat) (e eps : ratRep)
    (hLrep : realLeRep L (addConst (constSeq (x n0)) e))
    (hL'rep : realLeRep (constSeq (x n0)) (addConst L' e))
    (he : ratLtRep ratZeroRep e)
    (hfour : ratRel (ratAddRep (ratAddRep e e) (ratAddRep e e)) eps) :
    ∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n →
      ratLeRep (ratSubRep (L n) (L' n)) eps :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem tendsTo_tail_le (x L L' : Seq) (n0 : Nat) (e eps : ratRep)
    (hLrep : realLeRep L (addConst (constSeq (x n0)) e))
    (hL'rep : realLeRep (constSeq (x n0)) (addConst L' e))
    (he : ratLtRep ratZeroRep e)
    (hfour : ratRel (ratAddRep (ratAddRep e e) (ratAddRep e e)) eps) :
    ∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n →
      ratLeRep (ratSubRep (L n) (L' n)) eps :=
  Exists.elim
    (realLeRep_close L (addConst (constSeq (x n0)) e) hLrep e he)
    (fun (M1 : Nat)
        (hM1 : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat M1 n →
          ratLeRep (ratSubRep (L n) (addConst (constSeq (x n0)) e n)) e) =>
      Exists.elim
        (realLeRep_close (constSeq (x n0)) (addConst L' e) hL'rep e he)
        (fun (M2 : Nat)
            (hM2 : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat M2 n →
              ratLeRep (ratSubRep ((constSeq (x n0)) n) (addConst L' e n)) e) =>
          Exists.elim (leNat_max M1 M2)
            (fun (N : Nat) (hN : LeNat M1 N ∧ LeNat M2 N) =>
              Exists.intro N
                (fun (n : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) =>
                  ratLeRep_congr_gen
                    (ratSubRep (L n) (L' n))
                    (ratSubRep (L n) (L' n))
                    (ratAddRep (ratAddRep e e) (ratAddRep e e))
                    eps
                    (ratRel_refl (ratSubRep (L n) (L' n)))
                    hfour
                    (ratLeRep_sub_add (L n) (x n0) (L' n) (ratAddRep e e)
                      (ratSubRep_add_le_two (L n) (x n0) e
                        (hM1 n (leNat_trans M1 N n (And.left hN) hn)))
                      (ratSubRep_add_le_two (x n0) (L' n) e
                        (hM2 n (leNat_trans M2 N n (And.right hN) hn))))))))

exercises.unit: 单元104 极限类的唯一性
exercises.name: tendsTo_le_class
exercises.title: 104.4 一个方向的类序
exercises.prompt:
104.4 一个方向的类序

两条 `TendsTo` 各给一个阈值 `N₁`、`N₂`，合并到 `n₀`。固定 `n₀` 后， `L ≤ x(n₀) + e` 与 `x(n₀) ≤ L' + e` 就是 104.3 需要的两条代表元估计。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 取 `e = eps4 eps`。两条 `TendsTo` 在 `e` 上各给 N1、N2，`leNat_max` 合成 n0；把 `realLe` 经 `realLe_mk` 拆成 `realLeRep`，正好是 104.3 的两条前提，末了把 `e+e+e+e` 用 104.2 收成 `eps`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `realLe (Real.mk L) (Real.mk L')`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: realLe_mk · TendsTo · leNat_max · tendsTo_tail_le · ratHalf_four。

exercises.template:
theorem tendsTo_le_class (x L L' : Seq) (hLc : Cauchy L) (hL'c : Cauchy L')
    (hL : TendsTo x L) (hL' : TendsTo x L') :
    realLe (Real.mk L) (Real.mk L') :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem tendsTo_le_class (x L L' : Seq) (hLc : Cauchy L) (hL'c : Cauchy L')
    (hL : TendsTo x L) (hL' : TendsTo x L') :
    realLe (Real.mk L) (Real.mk L') :=
  Iff.mpr (realLe_mk L L')
    (And.intro hLc
      (And.intro hL'c
        (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
          Exists.elim
            (hL (eps4 eps)
              (ratLtRep_half (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps)))
            (fun (N1 : Nat)
                (hN1 : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N1 n →
                  realLe (Real.mk (constSeq (x n))) (Real.mk (addConst L (eps4 eps))) ∧
                  realLe (Real.mk L) (Real.mk (addConst (constSeq (x n)) (eps4 eps)))) =>
              Exists.elim
                (hL' (eps4 eps)
                  (ratLtRep_half (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps)))
                (fun (N2 : Nat)
                    (hN2 : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N2 n →
                      realLe (Real.mk (constSeq (x n))) (Real.mk (addConst L' (eps4 eps))) ∧
                      realLe (Real.mk L') (Real.mk (addConst (constSeq (x n)) (eps4 eps)))) =>
                  Exists.elim (leNat_max N1 N2)
                    (fun (n0 : Nat) (hn0 : LeNat N1 n0 ∧ LeNat N2 n0) =>
                      tendsTo_tail_le x L L' n0 (eps4 eps) eps
                        (Iff.mp (realLe_mk L (addConst (constSeq (x n0)) (eps4 eps)))
                          (And.right (hN1 n0 (And.left hn0))))
                        (Iff.mp (realLe_mk (constSeq (x n0)) (addConst L' (eps4 eps)))
                          (And.left (hN2 n0 (And.right hn0))))
                        (ratLtRep_half (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
                        (ratHalf_four eps)))))))

exercises.unit: 单元104 极限类的唯一性
exercises.name: tendsTo_unique_class
exercises.title: 104.5 极限类相等
exercises.prompt:
104.5 极限类相等

两个方向各用 104.4 一次，再交给 `realLe_antisymm`。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `tendsTo_le_class x L L'` 给 `[L] ≤ [L']`，把 L 与 L' 对调再给 `[L'] ≤ [L]`，两条一起交给 `realLe_antisymm`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Real.mk L = Real.mk L'`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: tendsTo_le_class · realLe_antisymm。

exercises.template:
theorem tendsTo_unique_class (x L L' : Seq) (hLc : Cauchy L) (hL'c : Cauchy L')
    (hL : TendsTo x L) (hL' : TendsTo x L') :
    Real.mk L = Real.mk L' :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem tendsTo_unique_class (x L L' : Seq) (hLc : Cauchy L) (hL'c : Cauchy L')
    (hL : TendsTo x L) (hL' : TendsTo x L') :
    Real.mk L = Real.mk L' :=
  realLe_antisymm (Real.mk L) (Real.mk L')
    (tendsTo_le_class x L L' hLc hL'c hL hL')
    (tendsTo_le_class x L' L hL'c hLc hL' hL)

exercises.unit: 单元104 极限类的唯一性
exercises.name: limitClass_unique
exercises.title: 两个极限类由 104.5 相等；把 `a = [L]`、`b = [L']` 接上即可。
exercises.prompt: 两个极限类由 104.5 相等；把 `a = [L]`、`b = [L']` 接上即可。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 拆开两条 `LimitClass` 得代表元 L、L'；104.5 给 `[L] = [L']`。目标是 `a = b`，用 `Eq.trans` 串 `a = [L]`、`[L] = [L']`、`[L'] = b`，最后一步取 `Eq.symm`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.elim · tendsTo_unique_class · Eq.trans · Eq.symm。

exercises.template:
theorem limitClass_unique (x : Seq) (a b : Real)
    (ha : LimitClass x a) (hb : LimitClass x b) : a = b :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem limitClass_unique (x : Seq) (a b : Real)
    (ha : LimitClass x a) (hb : LimitClass x b) : a = b :=
  Exists.elim ha
    (fun (L : Seq) (hL : Cauchy L ∧ TendsTo x L ∧ a = Real.mk L) =>
      Exists.elim hb
        (fun (L' : Seq) (hL' : Cauchy L' ∧ TendsTo x L' ∧ b = Real.mk L') =>
          Eq.trans (And.right (And.right hL))
            (Eq.trans
              (tendsTo_unique_class x L L' (And.left hL) (And.left hL')
                (And.left (And.right hL)) (And.left (And.right hL')))
              (Eq.symm (And.right (And.right hL'))))))

exercises.unit: 单元105 极限加法的估计：两个 ε/2 界相加
exercises.name: ratSubRep_wd_snd
exercises.title: 105.0 减法对第二个因子同余
exercises.prompt:
105.0 减法对第二个因子同余

`x - y` 展开是 `x + (-y)`。要把它换成 `x - y'`，只需要取负保持等价， 再用加法对第二个因子的同余。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `ratSubRep` 就是 `ratAddRep x (ratNegRep y)`；先用 `ratNegRep_wd` 把 `y ~ y'` 搬到负元上，再交给加法第二个因子的同余。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel y y' → ratRel (x - y) (x - y')`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratNegRep_wd · ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen。

exercises.template:
theorem ratSubRep_wd_snd (x y y' : ratRep) (h : ratRel y y') :
    ratRel (ratSubRep x y) (ratSubRep x y') :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratSubRep_wd_snd (x y y' : ratRep) (h : ratRel y y') :
    ratRel (ratSubRep x y) (ratSubRep x y') :=
  ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen x (ratNegRep y) (ratNegRep y') (ratNegRep_wd y y' h)

exercises.unit: 单元105 极限加法的估计：两个 ε/2 界相加
exercises.name: ratAddRep_shift
exercises.title: 105.1 四个加数重新配对
exercises.prompt:
105.1 四个加数重新配对

`(a + g) + (b + g)` 与 `(a + b) + (g + g)` 只差括号与中间两项的次序。 先把外层的结合律拆开，把 `g + (b + g)` 重排成 `b + (g + g)`，最后 再把 `a + (b + (g + g))` 收回成 `(a + b) + (g + g)`。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 三段链。第一段用 `ratAdd_assoc a g (b+g)` 拆外层；第二段在 `a + …` 的第二项上用结合律、交换律把 `g + (b+g)` 换成 `b + (g+g)`；第三段用结合律的对称收回。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratAdd_assoc（正反两次）· ratAdd_comm · ratAddRep_wd_gen · ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen · ratRel_trans_gen · ratRel_symm。

exercises.template:
theorem ratAddRep_shift (a b g : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratAddRep (ratAddRep a g) (ratAddRep b g))
           (ratAddRep (ratAddRep a b) (ratAddRep g g)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratAddRep_shift (a b g : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratAddRep (ratAddRep a g) (ratAddRep b g))
           (ratAddRep (ratAddRep a b) (ratAddRep g g)) :=
  ratRel_trans_gen
    (ratAddRep (ratAddRep a g) (ratAddRep b g))
    (ratAddRep a (ratAddRep g (ratAddRep b g)))
    (ratAddRep (ratAddRep a b) (ratAddRep g g))
    (ratAdd_assoc a g (ratAddRep b g))
    (ratRel_trans_gen
      (ratAddRep a (ratAddRep g (ratAddRep b g)))
      (ratAddRep a (ratAddRep b (ratAddRep g g)))
      (ratAddRep (ratAddRep a b) (ratAddRep g g))
      (ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen a
        (ratAddRep g (ratAddRep b g))
        (ratAddRep b (ratAddRep g g))
        (ratRel_trans_gen
          (ratAddRep g (ratAddRep b g))
          (ratAddRep (ratAddRep g b) g)
          (ratAddRep b (ratAddRep g g))
          (ratRel_symm (ratAddRep (ratAddRep g b) g)
            (ratAddRep g (ratAddRep b g))
            (ratAdd_assoc g b g))
          (ratRel_trans_gen
            (ratAddRep (ratAddRep g b) g)
            (ratAddRep (ratAddRep b g) g)
            (ratAddRep b (ratAddRep g g))
            (ratAddRep_wd_gen (ratAddRep g b) (ratAddRep b g) g
              (ratAdd_comm g b))
            (ratAdd_assoc b g g))))
      (ratRel_symm
        (ratAddRep (ratAddRep a b) (ratAddRep g g))
        (ratAddRep a (ratAddRep b (ratAddRep g g)))
        (ratAdd_assoc a b (ratAddRep g g))))

exercises.unit: 单元105 极限加法的估计：两个 ε/2 界相加
exercises.name: ratLeRep_sub_pair
exercises.title: 105.2 两条差界相加
exercises.prompt:
105.2 两条差界相加

`(a + b) - ((A + g) + (B + g))` 拆成 `(a - (A + g)) + (b - (B + g))`， 两条 `≤ g'` 的界相加就是 `≤ g' + g'`。拆开这一步是 60.1 的 `ratSubRep_add_sub`，两边再沿对称的等价搬回。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `ratSubRep_add_sub a (A+g) b (B+g)` 给出差的和；两条假设用 `ratLeRep_add` 相加；目标与和之间差一个对称的 `ratRel`，用 `ratLeRep_congr_gen` 搬过去。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratSubRep_add_sub · ratLeRep_add · ratLeRep_congr_gen · ratRel_symm · ratRel_refl。

exercises.template:
theorem ratLeRep_sub_pair (a b A B g g' : ratRep)
    (h1 : ratLeRep (ratSubRep a (ratAddRep A g)) g')
    (h2 : ratLeRep (ratSubRep b (ratAddRep B g)) g') :
    ratLeRep (ratSubRep (ratAddRep a b) (ratAddRep (ratAddRep A g) (ratAddRep B g)))
              (ratAddRep g' g') :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratLeRep_sub_pair (a b A B g g' : ratRep)
    (h1 : ratLeRep (ratSubRep a (ratAddRep A g)) g')
    (h2 : ratLeRep (ratSubRep b (ratAddRep B g)) g') :
    ratLeRep (ratSubRep (ratAddRep a b) (ratAddRep (ratAddRep A g) (ratAddRep B g)))
              (ratAddRep g' g') :=
  ratLeRep_congr_gen
    (ratAddRep (ratSubRep a (ratAddRep A g)) (ratSubRep b (ratAddRep B g)))
    (ratSubRep (ratAddRep a b) (ratAddRep (ratAddRep A g) (ratAddRep B g)))
    (ratAddRep g' g') (ratAddRep g' g')
    (ratRel_symm
      (ratSubRep (ratAddRep a b) (ratAddRep (ratAddRep A g) (ratAddRep B g)))
      (ratAddRep (ratSubRep a (ratAddRep A g)) (ratSubRep b (ratAddRep B g)))
      (ratSubRep_add_sub a (ratAddRep A g) b (ratAddRep B g)))
    (ratRel_refl (ratAddRep g' g'))
    (ratLeRep_add (ratSubRep a (ratAddRep A g)) g'
                  (ratSubRep b (ratAddRep B g)) g' h1 h2)

exercises.unit: 单元105 极限加法的估计：两个 ε/2 界相加
exercises.name: ratLeRep_sub_pair_eps
exercises.title: 105.2 给出的减法右端是 `(A + g) + (B + g)`，目标要的是 `(A + B) + eps`。 105.1 把前者换成 `(A + B) + (g + g)`，`g + g ~ eps` 再把右边对齐； 减法对第二个因子
exercises.prompt: 105.2 给出的减法右端是 `(A + g) + (B + g)`，目标要的是 `(A + B) + eps`。 105.1 把前者换成 `(A + B) + (g + g)`，`g + g ~ eps` 再把右边对齐； 减法对第二个因子同余，最后把两条界接起来。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先 `ratAddRep_shift A B g`，再沿 `hg` 用 `ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen` 把 `(A+B)+(g+g)` 换成 `(A+B)+eps`，两段用 `ratRel_trans_gen` 串起来；减法用 105.0 搬到目标，最后交 105.2。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratAddRep_shift · ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen · ratSubRep_wd_snd · ratRel_trans_gen · ratLeRep_sub_pair · ratLeRep_congr_gen。

exercises.template:
theorem ratLeRep_sub_pair_eps (a b A B g eps g' : ratRep)
    (h1 : ratLeRep (ratSubRep a (ratAddRep A g)) g')
    (h2 : ratLeRep (ratSubRep b (ratAddRep B g)) g')
    (hg : ratRel (ratAddRep g g) eps) :
    ratLeRep (ratSubRep (ratAddRep a b) (ratAddRep (ratAddRep A B) eps))
              (ratAddRep g' g') :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratLeRep_sub_pair_eps (a b A B g eps g' : ratRep)
    (h1 : ratLeRep (ratSubRep a (ratAddRep A g)) g')
    (h2 : ratLeRep (ratSubRep b (ratAddRep B g)) g')
    (hg : ratRel (ratAddRep g g) eps) :
    ratLeRep (ratSubRep (ratAddRep a b) (ratAddRep (ratAddRep A B) eps))
              (ratAddRep g' g') :=
  ratLeRep_congr_gen
    (ratSubRep (ratAddRep a b) (ratAddRep (ratAddRep A g) (ratAddRep B g)))
    (ratSubRep (ratAddRep a b) (ratAddRep (ratAddRep A B) eps))
    (ratAddRep g' g') (ratAddRep g' g')
    (ratSubRep_wd_snd (ratAddRep a b)
      (ratAddRep (ratAddRep A g) (ratAddRep B g))
      (ratAddRep (ratAddRep A B) eps)
      (ratRel_trans_gen
        (ratAddRep (ratAddRep A g) (ratAddRep B g))
        (ratAddRep (ratAddRep A B) (ratAddRep g g))
        (ratAddRep (ratAddRep A B) eps)
        (ratAddRep_shift A B g)
        (ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen (ratAddRep A B) (ratAddRep g g) eps hg)))
    (ratRel_refl (ratAddRep g' g'))
    (ratLeRep_sub_pair a b A B g g' h1 h2)

exercises.unit: 单元105 极限加法的估计：两个 ε/2 界相加
exercises.name: ratLeRep_sub_pair_half
exercises.title: 105.4 折半的界合成一条
exercises.prompt:
105.4 折半的界合成一条

后面两条 `TendsTo` 的估计都取 `d/2`：105.3 给出 `(d/2) + (d/2)`， `ratHalf_add_self` 再把它认成 `d`。这一步之后，调用点只需要关心一条 整数界。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把 105.3 在 `g' := ratHalf d` 上的结论沿 `ratHalf_add_self d` 搬到 `d`。左边和右边都不变，只换不等式的右端。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLeRep_sub_pair_eps · ratHalf_add_self · ratLeRep_congr_gen · ratRel_refl。

exercises.template:
theorem ratLeRep_sub_pair_half (a b A B e eps d : ratRep)
    (h1 : ratLeRep (ratSubRep a (ratAddRep A e)) (ratHalf d))
    (h2 : ratLeRep (ratSubRep b (ratAddRep B e)) (ratHalf d))
    (he : ratRel (ratAddRep e e) eps) :
    ratLeRep (ratSubRep (ratAddRep a b) (ratAddRep (ratAddRep A B) eps)) d :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratLeRep_sub_pair_half (a b A B e eps d : ratRep)
    (h1 : ratLeRep (ratSubRep a (ratAddRep A e)) (ratHalf d))
    (h2 : ratLeRep (ratSubRep b (ratAddRep B e)) (ratHalf d))
    (he : ratRel (ratAddRep e e) eps) :
    ratLeRep (ratSubRep (ratAddRep a b) (ratAddRep (ratAddRep A B) eps)) d :=
  ratLeRep_congr_gen
    (ratSubRep (ratAddRep a b) (ratAddRep (ratAddRep A B) eps))
    (ratSubRep (ratAddRep a b) (ratAddRep (ratAddRep A B) eps))
    (ratAddRep (ratHalf d) (ratHalf d)) d
    (ratRel_refl (ratSubRep (ratAddRep a b) (ratAddRep (ratAddRep A B) eps)))
    (ratHalf_add_self d)
    (ratLeRep_sub_pair_eps a b A B e eps (ratHalf d) h1 h2 he)

exercises.unit: 单元105 极限加法的估计：两个 ε/2 界相加
exercises.name: demo_add_shift
exercises.title: 105.5 具体实例
exercises.prompt:
105.5 具体实例

把 `g` 取成零：105.1 的左边退化成 `a + b`，右边也退化成 `a + b`。 这条实例只用来检查 105.1 的方向与参数顺序。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 直接引用 105.1，把 `g` 实例成 `ratZeroRep`；两边再用 `ratRel_refl` 收掉定义性相同的部分。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratAddRep_shift。

exercises.template:
theorem demo_add_shift (a b : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratAddRep (ratAddRep a ratZeroRep) (ratAddRep b ratZeroRep))
           (ratAddRep (ratAddRep a b) (ratAddRep ratZeroRep ratZeroRep)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem demo_add_shift (a b : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratAddRep (ratAddRep a ratZeroRep) (ratAddRep b ratZeroRep))
           (ratAddRep (ratAddRep a b) (ratAddRep ratZeroRep ratZeroRep)) :=
  ratAddRep_shift a b ratZeroRep

exercises.unit: 单元106 极限类的加法
exercises.name: tendsTo_add
exercises.title: 106.0 和的收敛
exercises.prompt:
106.0 和的收敛

对 eps 折半得到 g。两条 `TendsTo` 在 g 上各给一个阈值，用 `leNat_max` 合并；对 n 超过合并阈值，第一半把「x n 靠近 L + g」与「y n 靠近 M + g」各取 d/2，交给 105 的左半；第二半把两个位置对调，交给 105 的 右半。两个 `realLe` 最后由 `realLe_mk` 送回商。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `g := ratHalf eps`，正性由 `ratLtRep_half`。两条 TendsTo 给 N1、N2，`leNat_max` 合成 N。两个方向各调用一次 `realLeRep_add_side` / `_right`；逐点界由 `realLeRep_close` 在 `ratHalf d` 上读出，最后经 `realLe_mk` 送回商。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `TendsTo (addSeq x y) (addSeq L M)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLtRep_half · leNat_max · leNat_trans · realLeRep_close · realLeRep_add_side · realLeRep_add_side_right · realLe_mk · cauchy_add · cauchy_add_const。

exercises.template:
theorem tendsTo_add (x y L M : Seq) (hLc : Cauchy L) (hMc : Cauchy M)
    (hx : TendsTo x L) (hy : TendsTo y M) :
    TendsTo (addSeq x y) (addSeq L M) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem tendsTo_add (x y L M : Seq) (hLc : Cauchy L) (hMc : Cauchy M)
    (hx : TendsTo x L) (hy : TendsTo y M) :
    TendsTo (addSeq x y) (addSeq L M) :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (hx (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
      (fun (N1 : Nat)
          (hN1 : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N1 n →
            realLe (Real.mk (constSeq (x n))) (Real.mk (addConst L (ratHalf eps))) ∧
            realLe (Real.mk L) (Real.mk (addConst (constSeq (x n)) (ratHalf eps)))) =>
        Exists.elim (hy (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
          (fun (N2 : Nat)
              (hN2 : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N2 n →
                realLe (Real.mk (constSeq (y n))) (Real.mk (addConst M (ratHalf eps))) ∧
                realLe (Real.mk M) (Real.mk (addConst (constSeq (y n)) (ratHalf eps)))) =>
            Exists.elim (leNat_max N1 N2)
              (fun (N : Nat) (hN : LeNat N1 N ∧ LeNat N2 N) =>
                Exists.intro N
                  (fun (n : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) =>
                    And.intro
                      (Iff.mpr (realLe_mk (constSeq (ratAddRep (x n) (y n)))
                                          (addConst (addSeq L M) eps))
                        (realLeRep_add_side (x n) (y n) L M eps hLc hMc
                          (fun (d : ratRep) (hd : ratLtRep ratZeroRep d) =>
                            realLeRep_close (constSeq (x n)) (addConst L (ratHalf eps))
                              (Iff.mp (realLe_mk (constSeq (x n)) (addConst L (ratHalf eps)))
                                (And.left (hN1 n (leNat_trans N1 N n (And.left hN) hn))))
                              d hd)
                          (fun (d : ratRep) (hd : ratLtRep ratZeroRep d) =>
                            realLeRep_close (constSeq (y n)) (addConst M (ratHalf eps))
                              (Iff.mp (realLe_mk (constSeq (y n)) (addConst M (ratHalf eps)))
                                (And.left (hN2 n (leNat_trans N2 N n (And.right hN) hn))))
                              d hd)))
                      (Iff.mpr (realLe_mk (addSeq L M)
                                          (addConst (constSeq (ratAddRep (x n) (y n))) eps))
                        (realLeRep_add_side_right L M (x n) (y n) eps hLc hMc
                          (fun (d : ratRep) (hd : ratLtRep ratZeroRep d) =>
                            realLeRep_close L (addConst (constSeq (x n)) (ratHalf eps))
                              (Iff.mp (realLe_mk L (addConst (constSeq (x n)) (ratHalf eps)))
                                (And.right (hN1 n (leNat_trans N1 N n (And.left hN) hn))))
                              d hd)
                          (fun (d : ratRep) (hd : ratLtRep ratZeroRep d) =>
                            realLeRep_close M (addConst (constSeq (y n)) (ratHalf eps))
                              (Iff.mp (realLe_mk M (addConst (constSeq (y n)) (ratHalf eps)))
                                (And.right (hN2 n (leNat_trans N2 N n (And.right hN) hn))))
                              d hd)))))))

exercises.unit: 单元106 极限类的加法
exercises.name: addRel_limit
exercises.title: 106.1 关系的搬运
exercises.prompt:
106.1 关系的搬运

`addRel L M [L + M]` 由 `addRel_mk` 的 ι 规则直接给出，只需要两个 `Cauchy` 守卫。把 `a = [L]`、`b = [M]` 代回去要两次 `Eq.subst`： 注意显式类型参数的顺序是「动机、起点、终点、等式、证明」。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先构造 `addRel (mk L) (mk M) (mk (addSeq L M))`：`addRel_mk` 的反向要 `Cauchy L ∧ Cauchy M ∧ mk (addSeq L M) = mk (addSeq L M)`。再用 `Eq.symm ha`、`Eq.symm hb` 做两次替换，把 `mk L`、`mk M` 换成 `a`、`b`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `addRel a b (Real.mk (addSeq L M))`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: addRel_mk · Iff.mpr · And.intro · Eq.subst（全显式）· Eq.symm · Eq.refl。

exercises.template:
theorem addRel_limit (L M : Seq) (a b : Real)
    (hLc : Cauchy L) (hMc : Cauchy M)
    (ha : a = Real.mk L) (hb : b = Real.mk M) :
    addRel a b (Real.mk (addSeq L M)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem addRel_limit (L M : Seq) (a b : Real)
    (hLc : Cauchy L) (hMc : Cauchy M)
    (ha : a = Real.mk L) (hb : b = Real.mk M) :
    addRel a b (Real.mk (addSeq L M)) :=
  @Eq.subst.{1} Real
    (fun (z : Real) => addRel z b (Real.mk (addSeq L M)))
    (Real.mk L) a (Eq.symm ha)
    (@Eq.subst.{1} Real
      (fun (z : Real) => addRel (Real.mk L) z (Real.mk (addSeq L M)))
      (Real.mk M) b (Eq.symm hb)
      (Iff.mpr (addRel_mk L M (Real.mk (addSeq L M)))
        (And.intro hLc (And.intro hMc (Eq.refl (Real.mk (addSeq L M)))))))

exercises.unit: 单元106 极限类的加法
exercises.name: limitClass_add
exercises.title: 106.2 极限类对加法封闭
exercises.prompt:
106.2 极限类对加法封闭

拆开两个 `LimitClass`：得到代表元 L、M，两个 `Cauchy`，两条 `TendsTo` 与 `a = [L]`、`b = [M]`。和类取 `[L + M]`：106.1 给三元关系，106.0 给 和的收敛，`cauchy_add` 说明 `L + M` 仍是 Cauchy 序列。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 hx、hy 各做一次 `Exists.elim`；`Exists.intro (mk (addSeq L M))` 装三件——`addRel_limit`、`cauchy_add`、`tendsTo_add`，最后一件的类相等用 `Eq.refl`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `∃ c, addRel a b c ∧ LimitClass (addSeq x y) c`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.elim · Exists.intro · addRel_limit · cauchy_add · tendsTo_add · And.intro · Eq.refl。

exercises.template:
theorem limitClass_add (x y : Seq) (a b : Real)
    (hx : LimitClass x a) (hy : LimitClass y b) :
    ∃ (c : Real), addRel a b c ∧ LimitClass (addSeq x y) c :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem limitClass_add (x y : Seq) (a b : Real)
    (hx : LimitClass x a) (hy : LimitClass y b) :
    ∃ (c : Real), addRel a b c ∧ LimitClass (addSeq x y) c :=
  Exists.elim hx
    (fun (L : Seq) (hL : Cauchy L ∧ TendsTo x L ∧ a = Real.mk L) =>
      Exists.elim hy
        (fun (M : Seq) (hM : Cauchy M ∧ TendsTo y M ∧ b = Real.mk M) =>
          Exists.intro (Real.mk (addSeq L M))
            (And.intro
              (addRel_limit L M a b (And.left hL) (And.left hM)
                (And.right (And.right hL)) (And.right (And.right hM)))
              (Exists.intro (addSeq L M)
                (And.intro
                  (cauchy_add L M (And.left hL) (And.left hM))
                  (And.intro
                    (tendsTo_add x y L M (And.left hL) (And.left hM)
                      (And.left (And.right hL)) (And.left (And.right hM)))
                    (Eq.refl (Real.mk (addSeq L M)))))))))

exercises.unit: 单元106 极限类的加法
exercises.name: demo_limitClass_add_const
exercises.title: 106.3 常序列的实例
exercises.prompt:
106.3 常序列的实例

常序列的和逐点就是 `p + q`，两条常序列都收敛到自己的类。取代表元 `addSeq (constSeq p) (constSeq q)`，两个 `Cauchy` 由 `cauchy_add` 付清， 收敛由 106.0 与 `cauchy_tends_to_class` 付清。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `Exists.intro (addSeq (constSeq p) (constSeq q))`；`Cauchy` 分量是 `cauchy_add` 作用在两条 `cauchy_const` 上；收敛分量是 106.0 作用在两条 `cauchy_tends_to_class` 上；类相等取 `Eq.refl`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `LimitClass (addSeq (constSeq p) (constSeq q)) (mk (addSeq (constSeq p) (constSeq q)))`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: cauchy_const · cauchy_add · cauchy_tends_to_class · tendsTo_add · Exists.intro · Eq.refl。

exercises.template:
theorem demo_limitClass_add_const (p q : ratRep) :
    LimitClass (addSeq (constSeq p) (constSeq q))
      (Real.mk (addSeq (constSeq p) (constSeq q))) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem demo_limitClass_add_const (p q : ratRep) :
    LimitClass (addSeq (constSeq p) (constSeq q))
      (Real.mk (addSeq (constSeq p) (constSeq q))) :=
  Exists.intro (addSeq (constSeq p) (constSeq q))
    (And.intro
      (cauchy_add (constSeq p) (constSeq q)
        (cauchy_const p) (cauchy_const q))
      (And.intro
        (tendsTo_add (constSeq p) (constSeq q) (constSeq p) (constSeq q)
          (cauchy_const p) (cauchy_const q)
          (cauchy_tends_to_class (constSeq p) (cauchy_const p))
          (cauchy_tends_to_class (constSeq q) (cauchy_const q)))
        (Eq.refl (Real.mk (addSeq (constSeq p) (constSeq q))))))

exercises.unit: 单元107 极限类的取负
exercises.name: ratSubRep_neg_shift
exercises.title: 107.0 取负之后的差
exercises.prompt:
107.0 取负之后的差

两边都是 `x - y - eps` 的变体：左边先把 `-((-x) + eps)` 拆成 `-(-x) + -eps`，把 `-(-x)` 认成 `x`；右边用 `-(y + eps)` 的定义。 中间差一次结合律与一次交换律。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `ratNegRep_add` 把 `-((-x) + eps)` 拆开，`ratNegRep_invol` 把 `-(-x)` 认成 x，再用结合律与交换律把 `-y + (x + -eps)` 重排成 `x + (-y + -eps)`，最后反向用一次 `ratNegRep_add`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel ((-y) - ((-x) + eps)) (x - (y + eps))`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratNegRep_add · ratNegRep_invol · ratAdd_assoc · ratAdd_comm · ratAddRep_wd_gen · ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen · ratRel_trans_gen · ratRel_symm。

exercises.template:
theorem ratSubRep_neg_shift (x y eps : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratSubRep (ratNegRep y) (ratAddRep (ratNegRep x) eps))
           (ratSubRep x (ratAddRep y eps)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratSubRep_neg_shift (x y eps : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratSubRep (ratNegRep y) (ratAddRep (ratNegRep x) eps))
           (ratSubRep x (ratAddRep y eps)) :=
  ratRel_trans_gen
    (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) (ratNegRep (ratAddRep (ratNegRep x) eps)))
    (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) (ratAddRep (ratNegRep (ratNegRep x)) (ratNegRep eps)))
    (ratSubRep x (ratAddRep y eps))
    (ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen (ratNegRep y)
      (ratNegRep (ratAddRep (ratNegRep x) eps))
      (ratAddRep (ratNegRep (ratNegRep x)) (ratNegRep eps))
      (ratNegRep_add (ratNegRep x) eps))
    (ratRel_trans_gen
      (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) (ratAddRep (ratNegRep (ratNegRep x)) (ratNegRep eps)))
      (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) (ratAddRep x (ratNegRep eps)))
      (ratSubRep x (ratAddRep y eps))
      (ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen (ratNegRep y)
        (ratAddRep (ratNegRep (ratNegRep x)) (ratNegRep eps))
        (ratAddRep x (ratNegRep eps))
        (ratAddRep_wd_gen (ratNegRep (ratNegRep x)) x (ratNegRep eps)
          (ratNegRep_invol x)))
      (ratRel_trans_gen
        (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) (ratAddRep x (ratNegRep eps)))
        (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) x) (ratNegRep eps))
        (ratSubRep x (ratAddRep y eps))
        (ratRel_symm
          (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) x) (ratNegRep eps))
          (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) (ratAddRep x (ratNegRep eps)))
          (ratAdd_assoc (ratNegRep y) x (ratNegRep eps)))
        (ratRel_trans_gen
          (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) x) (ratNegRep eps))
          (ratAddRep (ratAddRep x (ratNegRep y)) (ratNegRep eps))
          (ratSubRep x (ratAddRep y eps))
          (ratAddRep_wd_gen (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) x) (ratAddRep x (ratNegRep y))
            (ratNegRep eps) (ratAdd_comm (ratNegRep y) x))
          (ratRel_trans_gen
            (ratAddRep (ratAddRep x (ratNegRep y)) (ratNegRep eps))
            (ratAddRep x (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) (ratNegRep eps)))
            (ratSubRep x (ratAddRep y eps))
            (ratAdd_assoc x (ratNegRep y) (ratNegRep eps))
            (ratRel_symm
              (ratSubRep x (ratAddRep y eps))
              (ratAddRep x (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) (ratNegRep eps)))
              (ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen x
                (ratNegRep (ratAddRep y eps))
                (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) (ratNegRep eps))
                (ratNegRep_add y eps)))))))

exercises.unit: 单元107 极限类的取负
exercises.name: neg_tail_le
exercises.title: 107.1 把差界搬到取负之后
exercises.prompt:
107.1 把差界搬到取负之后

`x n - ((addConst y eps) n) ≤ d` 是 `realLeRep` 的第三分量。107.0 的 等价取对称后，`ratLeRep_congr_gen` 把这条界搬到取负的差上；阈值原样 沿用，因为两个差是等价的。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `realLeRep_close` 取出阈值 N 与界；对每个 n 把 107.0 的对称版本交给 `ratLeRep_congr_gen`，第二个等价用 `ratRel_refl d`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, ratLeRep ((-y n) - ((-x n) + eps)) d`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: realLeRep_close · ratLeRep_congr_gen · ratRel_symm · ratRel_refl · ratSubRep_neg_shift。

exercises.template:
theorem neg_tail_le (x y : Seq) (eps d : ratRep)
    (h : realLeRep x (addConst y eps))
    (hd : ratLtRep ratZeroRep d) :
    ∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n →
      ratLeRep (ratSubRep (negSeq y n) ((addConst (negSeq x) eps) n)) d :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem neg_tail_le (x y : Seq) (eps d : ratRep)
    (h : realLeRep x (addConst y eps))
    (hd : ratLtRep ratZeroRep d) :
    ∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n →
      ratLeRep (ratSubRep (negSeq y n) ((addConst (negSeq x) eps) n)) d :=
  Exists.elim (realLeRep_close x (addConst y eps) h d hd)
    (fun (N : Nat)
        (hN : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n →
          ratLeRep (ratSubRep (x n) ((addConst y eps) n)) d) =>
      Exists.intro N
        (fun (n : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) =>
          ratLeRep_congr_gen
            (ratSubRep (x n) ((addConst y eps) n))
            (ratSubRep (negSeq y n) ((addConst (negSeq x) eps) n))
            d d
            (ratRel_symm
              (ratSubRep (negSeq y n) ((addConst (negSeq x) eps) n))
              (ratSubRep (x n) ((addConst y eps) n))
              (ratSubRep_neg_shift (x n) (y n) eps))
            (ratRel_refl d)
            (hN n hn)))

exercises.unit: 单元107 极限类的取负
exercises.name: realLeRep_neg_add
exercises.title: 107.2 序在取负下翻向
exercises.prompt:
107.2 序在取负下翻向

三个分量分开交：`cauchy_neg` 给两端的 Cauchy 见证，第三分量就是 107.1 的 λ。注意 `addConst (negSeq x) eps` 的 Cauchy 见证要用 `cauchy_add_const` 作用在 `cauchy_neg x` 上。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `And.intro` 三层——`cauchy_neg y hy`、`cauchy_add_const (negSeq x) eps (cauchy_neg x hx)`、然后 `fun d hd => neg_tail_le x y eps d h hd`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `realLeRep (-y) ((-x) + eps)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: cauchy_neg · cauchy_add_const · neg_tail_le · And.intro。

exercises.template:
theorem realLeRep_neg_add (x y : Seq) (eps : ratRep)
    (hx : Cauchy x) (hy : Cauchy y)
    (h : realLeRep x (addConst y eps)) :
    realLeRep (negSeq y) (addConst (negSeq x) eps) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem realLeRep_neg_add (x y : Seq) (eps : ratRep)
    (hx : Cauchy x) (hy : Cauchy y)
    (h : realLeRep x (addConst y eps)) :
    realLeRep (negSeq y) (addConst (negSeq x) eps) :=
  And.intro (cauchy_neg y hy)
    (And.intro (cauchy_add_const (negSeq x) eps (cauchy_neg x hx))
      (fun (d : ratRep) (hd : ratLtRep ratZeroRep d) =>
        neg_tail_le x y eps d h hd))

exercises.unit: 单元107 极限类的取负
exercises.name: tendsTo_neg
exercises.title: 107.3 `TendsTo` 在取负下保持
exercises.prompt:
107.3 `TendsTo` 在取负下保持

对 `eps > 0` 取 `TendsTo x L` 的阈值。取负后原来的下界 `L ≤ x n + eps` 变成新的上界 `-x n ≤ -L + eps`，原来的上界变成新的 下界；两条都用 107.2 与 `realLe_mk` 的 `mp`/`mpr` 互换。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `Exists.elim` 取 N；每个 n 交两个 `Iff.mpr (realLe_mk …)`，里面的 `realLeRep` 分别由 107.2 作用在 `Iff.mp (realLe_mk …)` 得到的旧界上——旧下界供新上界，旧上界供新下界。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `TendsTo (-x) (-L)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: realLe_mk · realLeRep_neg_add · And.left · And.right · Iff.mp · Iff.mpr · Exists.elim · Exists.intro。

exercises.template:
theorem tendsTo_neg (x L : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) (hL : Cauchy L)
    (h : TendsTo x L) : TendsTo (negSeq x) (negSeq L) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem tendsTo_neg (x L : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) (hL : Cauchy L)
    (h : TendsTo x L) : TendsTo (negSeq x) (negSeq L) :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (h eps heps)
      (fun (N : Nat)
          (hN : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n →
            realLe (Real.mk (constSeq (x n))) (Real.mk (addConst L eps)) ∧
            realLe (Real.mk L) (Real.mk (addConst (constSeq (x n)) eps))) =>
        Exists.intro N
          (fun (n : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) =>
            And.intro
              (Iff.mpr
                (realLe_mk (constSeq (ratNegRep (x n))) (addConst (negSeq L) eps))
                (realLeRep_neg_add L (constSeq (x n)) eps hL (cauchy_const (x n))
                  (Iff.mp (realLe_mk L (addConst (constSeq (x n)) eps))
                    (And.right (hN n hn)))))
              (Iff.mpr
                (realLe_mk (negSeq L) (addConst (constSeq (ratNegRep (x n))) eps))
                (realLeRep_neg_add (constSeq (x n)) L eps
                  (cauchy_const (x n)) hL
                  (Iff.mp (realLe_mk (constSeq (x n)) (addConst L eps))
                    (And.left (hN n hn)))))))

exercises.unit: 单元107 极限类的取负
exercises.name: limitClass_neg_mk
exercises.title: 107.4 取负后的极限类
exercises.prompt:
107.4 取负后的极限类

代表元取 `-L`：`cauchy_neg` 付清第一分量，107.3 付清第二分量， 第三分量是 `Eq.refl`。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `Exists.intro (negSeq L)`，三件用 `cauchy_neg`、107.3、`Eq.refl`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `LimitClass (-x) [(-L)]`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: cauchy_neg · tendsTo_neg · Eq.refl · And.intro · Exists.intro。

exercises.template:
theorem limitClass_neg_mk (x L : Seq)
    (hx : Cauchy x) (hL : Cauchy L) (hT : TendsTo x L) :
    LimitClass (negSeq x) (Real.mk (negSeq L)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem limitClass_neg_mk (x L : Seq)
    (hx : Cauchy x) (hL : Cauchy L) (hT : TendsTo x L) :
    LimitClass (negSeq x) (Real.mk (negSeq L)) :=
  Exists.intro (negSeq L)
    (And.intro (cauchy_neg L hL)

exercises.prompt: 拆开 `LimitClass` 的存在量词，把 107.4 装回去。`a = [L]` 这个分量 在这里用不上：结论只要求某个极限类存在，不要求它与 a 有运算关系。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `Exists.elim` 拆 h，取 L；`Exists.intro (Real.mk (negSeq L))`，里面直接引用 107.4，Cauchy 见证与收敛见证从 `hL` 的两个分量取。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.elim · Exists.intro · limitClass_neg_mk · And.left · And.right。

exercises.template:
theorem limitClass_neg (x : Seq) (a : Real)
    (hx : Cauchy x) (h : LimitClass x a) :
    ∃ (b : Real), LimitClass (negSeq x) b :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem limitClass_neg (x : Seq) (a : Real)
    (hx : Cauchy x) (h : LimitClass x a) :
    ∃ (b : Real), LimitClass (negSeq x) b :=
  Exists.elim h
    (fun (L : Seq) (hL : Cauchy L ∧ TendsTo x L ∧ a = Real.mk L) =>
      Exists.intro (Real.mk (negSeq L))
        (limitClass_neg_mk x L hx (And.left hL) (And.left (And.right hL))))

exercises.title: 108.1 差的收敛
exercises.prompt:
108.1 差的收敛

把 `y` 换成 `negSeq y`：106 的和收敛给出 `TendsTo (addSeq x (negSeq y)) (addSeq L (negSeq M))`，107 的取负给出 `TendsTo (negSeq y) (negSeq M)`；`addSeq x (negSeq y)` 与 `subSeq x y` 是同一个 λ，直接交出去。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `tendsTo_add x (negSeq y) L (negSeq M)` 与 `tendsTo_neg y M` 拼起来；两个 `Cauchy` 分量分别由 `hLc` 与 `cauchy_neg M hMc` 付清。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `TendsTo (subSeq x y) (subSeq L M)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: tendsTo_add · tendsTo_neg · cauchy_neg。

exercises.template:
theorem tendsTo_sub (x y L M : Seq) (hLc : Cauchy L) (hMc : Cauchy M)
    (hxc : Cauchy x) (hyc : Cauchy y)
    (hx : TendsTo x L) (hy : TendsTo y M) :
    TendsTo (subSeq x y) (subSeq L M) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem tendsTo_sub (x y L M : Seq) (hLc : Cauchy L) (hMc : Cauchy M)
    (hxc : Cauchy x) (hyc : Cauchy y)
    (hx : TendsTo x L) (hy : TendsTo y M) :
    TendsTo (subSeq x y) (subSeq L M) :=
  tendsTo_add x (negSeq y) L (negSeq M) hLc (cauchy_neg M hMc) hx
    (tendsTo_neg y M hyc hMc hy)

exercises.unit: 单元108 极限类的减法
exercises.name: limitClass_sub
exercises.title: 108.4 两个极限类的差
exercises.prompt:
108.4 两个极限类的差

拆开 `hb` 得到代表元 `M`。107.4 把 `y` 的极限类搬到 `negSeq y` 上， 106.2 的 `limitClass_add` 再把 `x` 与 `negSeq y` 的类加起来；结论里 多出的 `addRel` 分量在这里用不上，只取右半边。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 `hb` 与 `limitClass_add` 的结果各做一次 `Exists.elim`；因为目标与中间结论都是 `Exists`，隐式动机用 `@Exists.elim` 写全（A、p、Q 三个位）。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `∃ c, LimitClass (subSeq x y) c`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: limitClass_add · limitClass_neg_mk · Exists.elim（@ 全显式）· And.right · Exists.intro。

exercises.template:
theorem limitClass_sub (x y : Seq) (a b : Real)
    (hxc : Cauchy x) (hyc : Cauchy y)
    (ha : LimitClass x a) (hb : LimitClass y b) :
    ∃ (c : Real), LimitClass (subSeq x y) c :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem limitClass_sub (x y : Seq) (a b : Real)
    (hxc : Cauchy x) (hyc : Cauchy y)
    (ha : LimitClass x a) (hb : LimitClass y b) :
    ∃ (c : Real), LimitClass (subSeq x y) c :=
  @Exists.elim Seq
    (fun (M : Seq) => Cauchy M ∧ TendsTo y M ∧ b = Real.mk M)
    (∃ (c : Real), LimitClass (subSeq x y) c)
    hb
    (fun (M : Seq) (hM : Cauchy M ∧ TendsTo y M ∧ b = Real.mk M) =>
      @Exists.elim Real
        (fun (c : Real) => addRel a (Real.mk (negSeq M)) c ∧
          LimitClass (addSeq x (negSeq y)) c)
        (∃ (c : Real), LimitClass (subSeq x y) c)
        (limitClass_add x (negSeq y) a (Real.mk (negSeq M)) ha
          (limitClass_neg_mk y M hyc (And.left hM) (And.left (And.right hM))))
        (fun (c : Real)
            (hc : addRel a (Real.mk (negSeq M)) c ∧
                  LimitClass (addSeq x (negSeq y)) c) =>
          Exists.intro c (And.right hc)))

      (Real.mk (subSeq (constSeq p) (constSeq q))) :=
  limitClass_sub_mk (constSeq p) (constSeq q) (constSeq p) (constSeq q)
    (cauchy_const p) (cauchy_const q) (cauchy_const p) (cauchy_const q)
    (cauchy_tends_to_class (constSeq p) (cauchy_const p))
    (cauchy_tends_to_class (constSeq q) (cauchy_const q))

exercises.unit: 单元109 完备性收口：Cauchy 序列的极限类
exercises.name: le_sub_add_eps
exercises.title: 109.1 把并进减数的误差提出来
exercises.prompt:
109.1 把并进减数的误差提出来

前提是 `a - (b + e) ≤ d`。把左边加上 `e`，109.0 的恒等式把它认成 `a - b`；右边同时加 `e`，得到 `a - b ≤ d + e`。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 109.0 的恒等式用 `ratLeRep_congr_gen`，序的右端同时换成 `d + e`；中间那步用 `ratLeRep_add_right` 给两边各加 `e`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratLeRep (ratSubRep a b) (ratAddRep d e)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratSubRep_add_eps · ratLeRep_add_right · ratLeRep_congr_gen。

exercises.template:
theorem le_sub_add_eps (a b e d : ratRep)
    (h : ratLeRep (ratSubRep a (ratAddRep b e)) d) :
    ratLeRep (ratSubRep a b) (ratAddRep d e) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem le_sub_add_eps (a b e d : ratRep)
    (h : ratLeRep (ratSubRep a (ratAddRep b e)) d) :
    ratLeRep (ratSubRep a b) (ratAddRep d e) :=
  ratLeRep_congr_gen
    (ratAddRep (ratSubRep a (ratAddRep b e)) e)
    (ratSubRep a b)
    (ratAddRep d e) (ratAddRep d e)
    (ratSubRep_add_eps a b e)
    (ratRel_refl (ratAddRep d e))
    (ratLeRep_add_right (ratSubRep a (ratAddRep b e)) d e h)

exercises.unit: 单元109 完备性收口：Cauchy 序列的极限类
exercises.name: close_of_half_bounds
exercises.title: 109.3 两条半个 eps 的界合成 `close`
exercises.prompt:
109.3 两条半个 eps 的界合成 `close`

`close a b eps` 要一个严格小于 `eps` 的绝对值的见证。全性先给出一个 见证 `d`；两条半个 eps 的界把 `d` 压到 `eps/2`，再由 `eps/2 < eps` 收紧。两条界分别是差本身与它的相反数。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `ratAbsRel_total` 给出见证 `d`；`ratAbsRel_le_of_bounds` 用两条界把 `d` 压到 `eps/2`；`ratLtRep_of_le_lt` 与 `ratHalf_lt_self` 把 `d` 收到 `eps` 以下。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `close a b eps`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratAbsRel_total · ratAbsRel_le_of_bounds · ratLtRep_of_le_lt · ratHalf_lt_self。

exercises.template:
theorem close_of_half_bounds (a b eps : ratRep)
    (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps)
    (h1 : ratLeRep (ratSubRep a b) (ratHalf eps))
    (h2 : ratLeRep (ratNegRep (ratSubRep a b)) (ratHalf eps)) :
    close a b eps :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem close_of_half_bounds (a b eps : ratRep)
    (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps)
    (h1 : ratLeRep (ratSubRep a b) (ratHalf eps))
    (h2 : ratLeRep (ratNegRep (ratSubRep a b)) (ratHalf eps)) :
    close a b eps :=
  Exists.elim (ratAbsRel_total (ratSubRep a b))
    (fun (d : ratRep) (hd : ratAbsRel (ratSubRep a b) d) =>
      Exists.intro d
        (And.intro hd
          (ratLtRep_of_le_lt d (ratHalf eps) eps
            (ratAbsRel_le_of_bounds (ratSubRep a b) (ratHalf eps) d hd h1 h2)
            (ratHalf_lt_self eps heps))))

exercises.unit: 单元109 完备性收口：Cauchy 序列的极限类
exercises.name: tendsTo_cauchy
exercises.title: 109.4 有极限类 ⇒ Cauchy
exercises.prompt:
109.4 有极限类 ⇒ Cauchy

对 `eps > 0`，以 `eps8 eps` 调用收敛性，得到阈值 `N`。对 `n, m ≥ N` 抽出四个见证：`x n` 与 `x m` 各自的两条界。四个阈值用 `leNat_max` 并成同一个下标 `K`，在 `K` 上：

· `x n - L K ≤ e + e`，`L K - x m ≤ e + e`，相加得 `x n - x m` 不超过 `eps/2`； · 交换 `n` 与 `m` 得另一支，`x m - x n` 也不超过 `eps/2`。

两支交给 109.3。中间项消去用的是 `ratLeRep_sub_add`，`(e+e)+(e+e)` 与 `eps/2` 的换算就是 `ratHalf_four` 在 `ratHalf eps` 上的实例。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `hT (eps8 eps)` 给阈值与每条 `x n` 的两条 `realLe`；对 `n`、`m` 各取两条界（四条），`leNat_max` 合并后交给 `bound_pair`；反向那一支把 `n` 与 `m` 对调，再用 `ratNegRep_sub` 把 `x m - x n` 认成 `-(x n - x m)`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Cauchy x`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: realLeRep_close · Iff.mp (realLe_mk) · leNat_max · leNat_trans · bound_pair · ratHalf_four · ratNegRep_sub · close_of_half_bounds。

exercises.template:
theorem tendsTo_cauchy (x L : Seq) (hL : Cauchy L) (hT : TendsTo x L) :
    Cauchy x :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem tendsTo_cauchy (x L : Seq) (hL : Cauchy L) (hT : TendsTo x L) :
    Cauchy x :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (hT (eps8 eps) (eps8_pos eps heps))
      (fun (N : Nat)
          (hN : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n →
            realLe (Real.mk (constSeq (x n))) (Real.mk (addConst L (eps8 eps))) ∧
            realLe (Real.mk L) (Real.mk (addConst (constSeq (x n)) (eps8 eps)))) =>
        Exists.intro N
          (fun (n m : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) (hm : LeNat N m) =>
            Exists.elim
              (realLeRep_close (constSeq (x n)) (addConst L (eps8 eps))
                (Iff.mp (realLe_mk (constSeq (x n)) (addConst L (eps8 eps)))
                  (And.left (hN n hn)))
                (eps8 eps) (eps8_pos eps heps))
              (fun (K1 : Nat)
                  (hK1 : ∀ (k : Nat), LeNat K1 k →
                    ratLeRep (ratSubRep (x n) (ratAddRep (L k) (eps8 eps))) (eps8 eps)) =>
                Exists.elim
                  (realLeRep_close L (addConst (constSeq (x m)) (eps8 eps))
                    (Iff.mp (realLe_mk L (addConst (constSeq (x m)) (eps8 eps)))
                      (And.right (hN m hm)))
                    (eps8 eps) (eps8_pos eps heps))
                  (fun (K2 : Nat)
                      (hK2 : ∀ (k : Nat), LeNat K2 k →
                        ratLeRep (ratSubRep (L k) (ratAddRep (x m) (eps8 eps))) (eps8 eps)) =>
                    Exists.elim
                      (realLeRep_close (constSeq (x m)) (addConst L (eps8 eps))
                        (Iff.mp (realLe_mk (constSeq (x m)) (addConst L (eps8 eps)))
                          (And.left (hN m hm)))
                        (eps8 eps) (eps8_pos eps heps))
                      (fun (K3 : Nat)
                          (hK3 : ∀ (k : Nat), LeNat K3 k →
                            ratLeRep (ratSubRep (x m) (ratAddRep (L k) (eps8 eps))) (eps8 eps)) =>
                        Exists.elim
                          (realLeRep_close L (addConst (constSeq (x n)) (eps8 eps))
                            (Iff.mp (realLe_mk L (addConst (constSeq (x n)) (eps8 eps)))
                              (And.right (hN n hn)))
                            (eps8 eps) (eps8_pos eps heps))
                          (fun (K4 : Nat)
                              (hK4 : ∀ (k : Nat), LeNat K4 k →
                                ratLeRep (ratSubRep (L k) (ratAddRep (x n) (eps8 eps))) (eps8 eps)) =>
                            Exists.elim (leNat_max K1 K2)
                              (fun (Kf : Nat) (hKf : LeNat K1 Kf ∧ LeNat K2 Kf) =>
                                Exists.elim (leNat_max K3 K4)
                                  (fun (Kb : Nat) (hKb : LeNat K3 Kb ∧ LeNat K4 Kb) =>
                                    Exists.elim (leNat_max Kf Kb)
                                      (fun (K : Nat) (hK : LeNat Kf K ∧ LeNat Kb K) =>
                                        close_of_half_bounds (x n) (x m) eps heps
                                          (bound_pair (x n) (x m) L (eps8 eps) (ratHalf eps) K
                                            (fun (k : Nat) (hk : LeNat K k) =>
                                              hK1 k (leNat_trans K1 Kf k (And.left hKf)
                                                (leNat_trans Kf K k (And.left hK) hk)))
                                            (fun (k : Nat) (hk : LeNat K k) =>
                                              hK2 k (leNat_trans K2 Kf k (And.right hKf)
                                                (leNat_trans Kf K k (And.left hK) hk)))
                                            (ratHalf_four (ratHalf eps)))
                                          (ratLeRep_congr_gen
                                            (ratSubRep (x m) (x n))
                                            (ratNegRep (ratSubRep (x n) (x m)))
                                            (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps)
                                            (ratRel_symm (ratNegRep (ratSubRep (x n) (x m)))
                                              (ratSubRep (x m) (x n))
                                              (ratNegRep_sub (x n) (x m)))
                                            (ratRel_refl (ratHalf eps))
                                            (bound_pair (x m) (x n) L (eps8 eps) (ratHalf eps) K
                                              (fun (k : Nat) (hk : LeNat K k) =>
                                                hK3 k (leNat_trans K3 Kb k (And.left hKb)
                                                  (leNat_trans Kb K k (And.right hK) hk)))
                                              (fun (k : Nat) (hk : LeNat K k) =>
                                                hK4 k (leNat_trans K4 Kb k (And.right hKb)
                                                  (leNat_trans Kb K k (And.right hK) hk)))
                                              (ratHalf_four (ratHalf eps)))))))))))))

exercises.name: limitClass_intro
exercises.title: 109.5 极限类的引入
exercises.prompt:
109.5 极限类的引入

`LimitClass x a` 是三段：代表元 `L` 是 Cauchy 的，`x` 收敛到 `L`， 且 `a` 正是 `L` 的类。给定前两段，第三段用自反性付清。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `Exists.intro L`；三个分量依次是 `cauchy`、`tends`、`Eq.refl (Real.mk L)`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `LimitClass x (Real.mk L)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.intro · And.intro · Eq.refl。

exercises.template:
theorem limitClass_intro (x L : Seq) (hL : Cauchy L) (hT : TendsTo x L) :
    LimitClass x (Real.mk L) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem limitClass_intro (x L : Seq) (hL : Cauchy L) (hT : TendsTo x L) :
    LimitClass x (Real.mk L) :=
  Exists.intro L
    (And.intro hL (And.intro hT (Eq.refl (Real.mk L))))

exercises.unit: 单元109 完备性收口：Cauchy 序列的极限类
exercises.name: cauchy_limitClass
exercises.title: 109.6 Cauchy 序列有极限类
exercises.prompt:
109.6 Cauchy 序列有极限类

68 已经有 `cauchy_has_limit`：Cauchy 序列有代表的极限与收敛性。把这份 见证交给 109.5，就得到极限类本身。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `Exists.elim (cauchy_has_limit x hx)` 得到 `L`、`Cauchy L` 与 `TendsTo x L`，再交 109.5。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `∃ (a : Real), LimitClass x a`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: cauchy_has_limit · limitClass_intro · Exists.elim · Exists.intro。

exercises.template:
theorem cauchy_limitClass (x : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) :
    ∃ (a : Real), LimitClass x a :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem cauchy_limitClass (x : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) :
    ∃ (a : Real), LimitClass x a :=
  Exists.elim (cauchy_has_limit x hx)
    (fun (L : Seq) (hL : Cauchy L ∧ TendsTo x L) =>
      Exists.intro (Real.mk L)
        (limitClass_intro x L (And.left hL) (And.right hL)))

exercises.unit: 单元109 完备性收口：Cauchy 序列的极限类
exercises.name: cauchy_iff_limitClass
exercises.title: 109.7 Cauchy 与有极限类等价
exercises.prompt:
109.7 Cauchy 与有极限类等价

正向就是 109.6。反向拆开极限类得到代表元 `L`，由 109.4 把收敛性退回 序列自己的 Cauchy 性。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `Iff.intro`；正向 `cauchy_limitClass`；反向对 `∃ a, LimitClass x a` 做 `Exists.elim`，再拆 `LimitClass` 的三段，把 `Cauchy L` 与 `TendsTo x L` 交 `tendsTo_cauchy`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Cauchy x ↔ ∃ (a : Real), LimitClass x a`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Iff.intro · cauchy_limitClass · tendsTo_cauchy · Exists.elim。

exercises.template:
theorem cauchy_iff_limitClass (x : Seq) :
    Cauchy x ↔ ∃ (a : Real), LimitClass x a :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem cauchy_iff_limitClass (x : Seq) :
    Cauchy x ↔ ∃ (a : Real), LimitClass x a :=
  Iff.intro
    (fun (hx : Cauchy x) => cauchy_limitClass x hx)
    (fun (h : ∃ (a : Real), LimitClass x a) =>
      Exists.elim h
        (fun (a : Real) (ha : LimitClass x a) =>
          Exists.elim ha
            (fun (L : Seq) (hL : Cauchy L ∧ TendsTo x L ∧ a = Real.mk L) =>
              tendsTo_cauchy x L (And.left hL) (And.left (And.right hL)))))

exercises.name: limitClass_exists_unique
exercises.title: 109.8 极限类存在且唯一
exercises.prompt:
109.8 极限类存在且唯一

存在由 109.6 给。唯一性把两个候选取出来，交给 104 的 `limitClass_unique`。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `Exists.elim (cauchy_limitClass x hx)` 得到 `a` 与 `ha`；`Exists.intro a`，唯一性分量写成 `fun b hb => limitClass_unique x a b ha hb`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `∃ (a : Real), LimitClass x a ∧ ∀ (b : Real), LimitClass x b → b = a`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: cauchy_limitClass · limitClass_unique · Exists.elim · Exists.intro · And.intro。

exercises.template:
theorem limitClass_exists_unique (x : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) :
    ∃ (a : Real), LimitClass x a ∧ ∀ (b : Real), LimitClass x b → b = a :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem limitClass_exists_unique (x : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) :
    ∃ (a : Real), LimitClass x a ∧ ∀ (b : Real), LimitClass x b → b = a :=
  Exists.elim (cauchy_limitClass x hx)
    (fun (a : Real) (ha : LimitClass x a) =>
      Exists.intro a
        (And.intro ha (fun (b : Real) (hb : LimitClass x b) =>
          Eq.symm (limitClass_unique x a b ha hb))))

        (ratNegRep (ratAddRep (sumTo f n) (f n)))

exercises.prompt: 110.6 交换后两个加数

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把 `(a+b)+c` 结合成 `a+(b+c)`，在括号里把 `b` 与 `c` 交换，再把 `a+(c+b)` 结合回 `(a+c)+b`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel (ratAddRep (ratAddRep a b) c) (ratAddRep (ratAddRep a c) b)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratAdd_assoc · ratAdd_comm · ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen · ratRel_symm。

exercises.template:
theorem ratAdd_swap_mid (a b c : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratAddRep (ratAddRep a b) c) (ratAddRep (ratAddRep a c) b) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratAdd_swap_mid (a b c : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratAddRep (ratAddRep a b) c) (ratAddRep (ratAddRep a c) b) :=
  ratRel_trans_gen
    (ratAddRep (ratAddRep a b) c)
    (ratAddRep a (ratAddRep b c))
    (ratAddRep (ratAddRep a c) b)
    (ratAdd_assoc a b c)
    (ratRel_trans_gen
      (ratAddRep a (ratAddRep b c))
      (ratAddRep a (ratAddRep c b))
      (ratAddRep (ratAddRep a c) b)
      (ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen a (ratAddRep b c) (ratAddRep c b) (ratAdd_comm b c))
      (ratRel_symm
        (ratAddRep (ratAddRep a c) b)
        (ratAddRep a (ratAddRep c b))
        (ratAdd_assoc a c b)))

exercises.unit: 单元110 有限和：递归定义与基本律
exercises.name: ratAdd_pair_regroup
exercises.title: 110.7 两对加数重新配对
exercises.prompt: 110.7 两对加数重新配对

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先把 `(F+G)+(f+g)` 右结合成 `((F+G)+f)+g`，再用 110.6 把中间两项换成 `(F+f)+G`，最后把 `((F+f)+G)+g` 结合成 `(F+f)+(G+g)`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel (ratAddRep (ratAddRep F G) (ratAddRep f g)) (ratAddRep (ratAddRep F f) (ratAddRep G g))`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratAdd_assoc · ratAdd_swap_mid · ratAddRep_wd_gen · ratRel_symm。

exercises.template:
theorem ratAdd_pair_regroup (F G f g : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratAddRep (ratAddRep F G) (ratAddRep f g))
      (ratAddRep (ratAddRep F f) (ratAddRep G g)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratAdd_pair_regroup (F G f g : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratAddRep (ratAddRep F G) (ratAddRep f g))
      (ratAddRep (ratAddRep F f) (ratAddRep G g)) :=
  ratRel_trans_gen
    (ratAddRep (ratAddRep F G) (ratAddRep f g))
    (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (ratAddRep F G) f) g)
    (ratAddRep (ratAddRep F f) (ratAddRep G g))
    (ratRel_symm
      (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (ratAddRep F G) f) g)
      (ratAddRep (ratAddRep F G) (ratAddRep f g))
      (ratAdd_assoc (ratAddRep F G) f g))
    (ratRel_trans_gen
      (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (ratAddRep F G) f) g)
      (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (ratAddRep F f) G) g)
      (ratAddRep (ratAddRep F f) (ratAddRep G g))
      (ratAddRep_wd_gen
        (ratAddRep (ratAddRep F G) f)
        (ratAddRep (ratAddRep F f) G)
        g
        (ratAdd_swap_mid F G f))
      (ratAdd_assoc (ratAddRep F f) G g))

exercises.name: sumTo_add
exercises.title: 110.8 和保持逐项加法
exercises.prompt: 110.8 和保持逐项加法

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对项数归纳。后继步把 `(f+g)` 的和拆成 `A + (f n + g n)`，用归纳假设换掉 `A`，再用 110.7 重新配对成两边的后继形状。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel (sumTo (fun k => f k + g k) n) (sumTo f n + sumTo g n)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Nat.rec · ratAddRep_wd_gen · ratAdd_pair_regroup。

exercises.template:
theorem sumTo_add (f g : Nat → ratRep) (n : Nat) :
    ratRel (sumTo (fun (k : Nat) => ratAddRep (f k) (g k)) n)
      (ratAddRep (sumTo f n) (sumTo g n)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem sumTo_add (f g : Nat → ratRep) (n : Nat) :
    ratRel (sumTo (fun (k : Nat) => ratAddRep (f k) (g k)) n)
      (ratAddRep (sumTo f n) (sumTo g n)) :=
  Nat.rec
    (fun (n : Nat) => ratRel (sumTo (fun (k : Nat) => ratAddRep (f k) (g k)) n)
      (ratAddRep (sumTo f n) (sumTo g n)))
    (ratRel_symm (ratAddRep ratZeroRep ratZeroRep) ratZeroRep
      (ratAdd_zero ratZeroRep))
    (fun (n : Nat)
      (ih : ratRel (sumTo (fun (k : Nat) => ratAddRep (f k) (g k)) n)
        (ratAddRep (sumTo f n) (sumTo g n))) =>
      ratRel_trans_gen
        (ratAddRep (sumTo (fun (k : Nat) => ratAddRep (f k) (g k)) n)
          (ratAddRep (f n) (g n)))
        (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (sumTo f n) (sumTo g n))
          (ratAddRep (f n) (g n)))
        (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (sumTo f n) (f n))
          (ratAddRep (sumTo g n) (g n)))
        (ratAddRep_wd_gen
          (sumTo (fun (k : Nat) => ratAddRep (f k) (g k)) n)
          (ratAddRep (sumTo f n) (sumTo g n))
          (ratAddRep (f n) (g n)) ih)
        (ratAdd_pair_regroup (sumTo f n) (sumTo g n) (f n) (g n)))
    n

exercises.title: 111.0 把和切成两段
exercises.prompt: 111.0 把和切成两段

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对第二段的长度 `n` 归纳。`n = 0` 时第二段是零项和，用加零律；后继步把 `sumTo f (m + n)` 的最后一项接上，用归纳假设换掉前半，再右结合。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel (sumTo f (m + n)) (sumTo f m + sumTo (fun k => f (m + k)) n)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Nat.rec · ratAdd_zero · ratAddRep_wd_gen · ratAdd_assoc。

exercises.template:
theorem sumTo_shift (f : Nat → ratRep) (m n : Nat) :
    ratRel (sumTo f (Nat.add m n))
      (ratAddRep (sumTo f m) (sumTo (fun (k : Nat) => f (Nat.add m k)) n)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem sumTo_shift (f : Nat → ratRep) (m n : Nat) :
    ratRel (sumTo f (Nat.add m n))
      (ratAddRep (sumTo f m) (sumTo (fun (k : Nat) => f (Nat.add m k)) n)) :=
  Nat.rec
    (fun (n : Nat) => ratRel (sumTo f (Nat.add m n))
      (ratAddRep (sumTo f m) (sumTo (fun (k : Nat) => f (Nat.add m k)) n)))
    (ratRel_symm (ratAddRep (sumTo f m) ratZeroRep) (sumTo f m)
      (ratAdd_zero (sumTo f m)))
    (fun (n : Nat)
      (ih : ratRel (sumTo f (Nat.add m n))
        (ratAddRep (sumTo f m) (sumTo (fun (k : Nat) => f (Nat.add m k)) n))) =>
      ratRel_trans_gen
        (ratAddRep (sumTo f (Nat.add m n)) (f (Nat.add m n)))
        (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (sumTo f m) (sumTo (fun (k : Nat) => f (Nat.add m k)) n)) (f (Nat.add m n)))
        (ratAddRep (sumTo f m) (ratAddRep (sumTo (fun (k : Nat) => f (Nat.add m k)) n) (f (Nat.add m n))))
        (ratAddRep_wd_gen (sumTo f (Nat.add m n))
          (ratAddRep (sumTo f m) (sumTo (fun (k : Nat) => f (Nat.add m k)) n))
          (f (Nat.add m n)) ih)
        (ratAdd_assoc (sumTo f m) (sumTo (fun (k : Nat) => f (Nat.add m k)) n) (f (Nat.add m n))))
    n

exercises.title: 111.1 望远镜：相邻差的和
exercises.prompt: 111.1 望远镜：相邻差的和

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 `n` 归纳。零项时两边都是 `b 0 - b 0`，用逆元律；后继步把最后一项 `b (n+1) - b n` 接在前面，交换两项差的位置，再用 `(x - y) + (y - z) ~ x - z` 消去中间项。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel (sumTo (fun k => b (k+1) - b k) n) (b n - b 0)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Nat.rec · ratAdd_neg_gen · ratAdd_comm · ratSubRep_add · ratAddRep_wd_gen。

exercises.template:
theorem sumTo_telescope (b : Nat → ratRep) (n : Nat) :
    ratRel (sumTo (fun (k : Nat) => ratSubRep (b (Nat.succ k)) (b k)) n)
      (ratSubRep (b n) (b Nat.zero)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem sumTo_telescope (b : Nat → ratRep) (n : Nat) :
    ratRel (sumTo (fun (k : Nat) => ratSubRep (b (Nat.succ k)) (b k)) n)
      (ratSubRep (b n) (b Nat.zero)) :=
  Nat.rec
    (fun (n : Nat) => ratRel (sumTo (fun (k : Nat) => ratSubRep (b (Nat.succ k)) (b k)) n)
      (ratSubRep (b n) (b Nat.zero)))
    (ratRel_symm (ratSubRep (b Nat.zero) (b Nat.zero)) ratZeroRep
      (ratAdd_neg_gen (b Nat.zero)))
    (fun (n : Nat)
      (ih : ratRel (sumTo (fun (k : Nat) => ratSubRep (b (Nat.succ k)) (b k)) n)
        (ratSubRep (b n) (b Nat.zero))) =>
      ratRel_trans_gen
        (ratAddRep (sumTo (fun (k : Nat) => ratSubRep (b (Nat.succ k)) (b k)) n)
          (ratSubRep (b (Nat.succ n)) (b n)))
        (ratAddRep (ratSubRep (b n) (b Nat.zero))
          (ratSubRep (b (Nat.succ n)) (b n)))
        (ratSubRep (b (Nat.succ n)) (b Nat.zero))
        (ratAddRep_wd_gen
          (sumTo (fun (k : Nat) => ratSubRep (b (Nat.succ k)) (b k)) n)
          (ratSubRep (b n) (b Nat.zero))
          (ratSubRep (b (Nat.succ n)) (b n)) ih)
        (ratRel_trans_gen
          (ratAddRep (ratSubRep (b n) (b Nat.zero))
            (ratSubRep (b (Nat.succ n)) (b n)))
          (ratAddRep (ratSubRep (b (Nat.succ n)) (b n))
            (ratSubRep (b n) (b Nat.zero)))
          (ratSubRep (b (Nat.succ n)) (b Nat.zero))
          (ratAdd_comm (ratSubRep (b n) (b Nat.zero))
            (ratSubRep (b (Nat.succ n)) (b n)))
          (ratSubRep_add (b (Nat.succ n)) (b n) (b Nat.zero))))
    n

hints.label: 思路

exercises.unit: 单元113 收敛级数的通项趋于零
exercises.name: summable_terms_tend_zero
exercises.title: 113.1 可和级数的通项趋于零
exercises.prompt: 113.1 可和级数的通项趋于零

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对每个 eps > 0，Cauchy 性给出阈值 N。对 n ≥ N，`Series f n` 与 `Series f (n+1)` 的差在 eps 内；把这条接近性翻向，左边正好是 `Series f n + f n`，再交 113.0。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Eventually (fun n => close (f n) ratZeroRep eps)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Cauchy 的定义 · close_symm · close_step_zero · series_succ · leNat_self_add · Exists.intro。

exercises.template:
theorem summable_terms_tend_zero (f : Nat → ratRep) (h : Summable f) :
    ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
      Eventually (fun (n : Nat) => close (f n) ratZeroRep eps) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem summable_terms_tend_zero (f : Nat → ratRep) (h : Summable f) :
    ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
      Eventually (fun (n : Nat) => close (f n) ratZeroRep eps) :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (h eps heps)
      (fun (N : Nat)
          (hN : ∀ (m n : Nat), LeNat N m → LeNat N n →
            close (Series f m) (Series f n) eps) =>
        Exists.intro N
          (fun (n : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) =>
            close_step_zero (Series f n) (f n) eps
              (close_symm (Series f n) (Series f (Nat.succ n)) eps
                (hN n (Nat.succ n) hn
                  (leNat_trans N n (Nat.succ n) hn
                    (leNat_self_add n 1))))))

exercises.unit: 单元113 收敛级数的通项趋于零
exercises.name: not_summable_const
exercises.title: 113.2 常数非零的级数不可和
exercises.prompt: 113.2 常数非零的级数不可和

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 若常级数可和，113.1 说 `q` 在任意正 eps 内靠近零；每一项都等于 q，所以 74.6 的 `ratRel_of_close_all` 直接给出 `q ~ 0`，与 hq 矛盾。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `False`（从 `Summable (fun _ => q)` 与 `¬ ratRel q ratZeroRep`）。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: summable_terms_tend_zero · ratRel_of_close_all · Exists.elim · LeNat.le_refl。

exercises.template:
theorem not_summable_const (q : ratRep) (hq : ¬ ratRel q ratZeroRep) :
    ¬ Summable (fun (_ : Nat) => q) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem not_summable_const (q : ratRep) (hq : ¬ ratRel q ratZeroRep) :
    ¬ Summable (fun (_ : Nat) => q) :=
  fun (hsum : Summable (fun (_ : Nat) => q)) =>
    hq (ratRel_of_close_all q ratZeroRep
      (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
        @Exists.elim Nat
          (fun (N : Nat) => ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n →
            close ((fun (_ : Nat) => q) n) ratZeroRep eps)
          (close q ratZeroRep eps)
          (summable_terms_tend_zero (fun (_ : Nat) => q) hsum eps heps)
          (fun (N : Nat) (hN : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n →
              close ((fun (_ : Nat) => q) n) ratZeroRep eps) =>
            hN N (LeNat.le_refl N))))

hints.label: 目标形态

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: series_split · ratSubRep_wd_fst · ratSubRep_add_self_sub · ratRel_symm · ratRel_trans_gen。

exercises.template:
theorem tail_eq_sub (f : Nat → ratRep) (m k : Nat) :

theorem tail_eq_sub (f : Nat → ratRep) (m k : Nat) :
    ratRel (TailSum f m k)
      (ratSubRep (Series f (Nat.add m k)) (Series f m)) :=
  ratRel_symm
    (ratSubRep (Series f (Nat.add m k)) (Series f m))
    (TailSum f m k)
