      (ratSubRep (Series f (Nat.add m k)) (Series f m))
      (ratSubRep (ratAddRep (Series f m) (TailSum f m k)) (Series f m))
      (TailSum f m k)
      (ratSubRep_wd_fst (Series f (Nat.add m k))

exercises.unit: 单元114 级数的尾巴与 Cauchy 判别
exercises.name: tail_close_iff
exercises.title: 114.6 部分和接近当且仅当尾块小
exercises.prompt: 114.6 部分和接近当且仅当尾块小

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 两个方向都把 114.5 的差关系搬到 `close` 的见证上。正向先用 `close_symm` 把两条部分和的顺序翻过来，`close_sub_zero` 给出「差靠近零」，再把差换成尾块。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `close (Series f m) (Series f (m+k)) eps ↔ close (TailSum f m k) ratZeroRep eps`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: tail_eq_sub · close_sub_zero · close_symm · ratAbsRel_wd_left。

exercises.template:
theorem tail_close_iff (f : Nat → ratRep) (m k : Nat) (eps : ratRep) :
    close (Series f m) (Series f (Nat.add m k)) eps ↔
      close (TailSum f m k) ratZeroRep eps :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem tail_close_iff (f : Nat → ratRep) (m k : Nat) (eps : ratRep) :
    close (Series f m) (Series f (Nat.add m k)) eps ↔
      close (TailSum f m k) ratZeroRep eps :=
  Iff.intro
    (fun (h : close (Series f m) (Series f (Nat.add m k)) eps) =>
      Exists.elim
        (Iff.mp (close_sub_zero (Series f (Nat.add m k)) (Series f m) eps)
          (close_symm (Series f m) (Series f (Nat.add m k)) eps h))
        (fun (d : ratRep)
            (hd : ratAbsRel
              (ratSubRep
                (ratSubRep (Series f (Nat.add m k)) (Series f m))
                ratZeroRep) d ∧
              ratLtRep d eps) =>
          Exists.intro d
            (And.intro
              (ratAbsRel_wd_left
                (ratSubRep
                  (ratSubRep (Series f (Nat.add m k)) (Series f m))
                  ratZeroRep)
                (ratSubRep (TailSum f m k) ratZeroRep)
                d
                (ratSubRep_wd_fst
                  (ratSubRep (Series f (Nat.add m k)) (Series f m))
                  (TailSum f m k)
                  ratZeroRep
                  (ratRel_symm (TailSum f m k)
                    (ratSubRep (Series f (Nat.add m k)) (Series f m))
                    (tail_eq_sub f m k)))
                (And.left hd))
              (And.right hd))))
    (fun (h : close (TailSum f m k) ratZeroRep eps) =>
      close_symm (Series f (Nat.add m k)) (Series f m) eps
        (Iff.mpr (close_sub_zero (Series f (Nat.add m k)) (Series f m) eps)
          (Exists.elim h
            (fun (d : ratRep)
                (hd : ratAbsRel
                  (ratSubRep (TailSum f m k) ratZeroRep) d ∧
                  ratLtRep d eps) =>
              Exists.intro d
                (And.intro
                  (ratAbsRel_wd_left
                    (ratSubRep (TailSum f m k) ratZeroRep)
                    (ratSubRep
                      (ratSubRep (Series f (Nat.add m k)) (Series f m))
                      ratZeroRep)
                    d
                    (ratSubRep_wd_fst
                      (TailSum f m k)
                      (ratSubRep (Series f (Nat.add m k)) (Series f m))
                      ratZeroRep
                      (tail_eq_sub f m k))
                    (And.left hd))
                  (And.right hd))))))

exercises.name: summable_iff_tail
exercises.title: 114.7 可和当且仅当尾块一致地小
exercises.prompt: 114.7 可和当且仅当尾块一致地小

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 可和是 `Cauchy (Series f)`；102.3 与 102.4 已经把它换成跳跃形式 `close (Series f m) (Series f (m+k)) eps`。逐个 k 用 114.6 把跳跃形式里的两条部分和换成尾块。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Summable f ↔ ∀ eps > 0, ∃ N, ∀ m ≥ N, ∀ k, close (TailSum f m k) ratZeroRep eps`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: cauchy_tail_jump · cauchy_of_tail_jump · tail_close_iff · Iff.mp · Iff.mpr。

exercises.template:
theorem summable_iff_tail (f : Nat → ratRep) :
    Summable f ↔
      ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
        ∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (m : Nat), LeNat N m →
          ∀ (k : Nat), close (TailSum f m k) ratZeroRep eps :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem summable_iff_tail (f : Nat → ratRep) :
    Summable f ↔
      ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
        ∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (m : Nat), LeNat N m →
          ∀ (k : Nat), close (TailSum f m k) ratZeroRep eps :=
  Iff.intro
    (fun (h : Summable f) =>
      fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
        Exists.elim (cauchy_tail_jump (Series f) h eps heps)
          (fun (N : Nat)
              (hN : ∀ (m : Nat), LeNat N m → ∀ (k : Nat),
                close (Series f m) (Series f (Nat.add m k)) eps) =>
            Exists.intro N
              (fun (m : Nat) (hm : LeNat N m) (k : Nat) =>
                Iff.mp (tail_close_iff f m k eps) (hN m hm k))))
    (fun (h : ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
        ∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (m : Nat), LeNat N m →
          ∀ (k : Nat), close (TailSum f m k) ratZeroRep eps) =>
      cauchy_of_tail_jump (Series f)
        (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
          Exists.elim (h eps heps)
            (fun (N : Nat)
                (hN : ∀ (m : Nat), LeNat N m → ∀ (k : Nat),
                  close (TailSum f m k) ratZeroRep eps) =>
              Exists.intro N
                (fun (m : Nat) (hm : LeNat N m) (k : Nat) =>
                  Iff.mpr (tail_close_iff f m k eps) (hN m hm k)))))

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 取 `Cauchy x` 的阈值 N。对 n、m ≥ N，先用 `close_symm` 与 `close_wd_left` 把第一个点从 `x n` 换到 `y n`，再把第二个点从 `x m` 换到 `y m`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Cauchy y`（已知 `∀ n, ratRel (x n) (y n)` 与 `Cauchy x`）。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: close_wd_left · close_symm · ratRel 的定义。

exercises.template:
theorem cauchy_congr (x y : Seq)
    (hxy : ∀ (n : Nat), ratRel (x n) (y n)) (hx : Cauchy x) : Cauchy y :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem cauchy_congr (x y : Seq)
    (hxy : ∀ (n : Nat), ratRel (x n) (y n)) (hx : Cauchy x) : Cauchy y :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (hx eps heps)
      (fun (N : Nat)
          (hN : ∀ (n m : Nat), LeNat N n → LeNat N m →
            close (x n) (x m) eps) =>
        Exists.intro N
          (fun (n m : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) (hm : LeNat N m) =>
            close_wd_left (x n) (y n) (y m) eps (hxy n)
              (close_symm (y m) (x n) eps
                (close_wd_left (x m) (y m) (x n) eps (hxy m)
                  (close_symm (x n) (x m) eps (hN n m hn hm))))))

exercises.template:
theorem sumTo_nonneg (f : Nat → ratRep) (h : ∀ (k : Nat), ratLeRep ratZeroRep (f k))
    (n : Nat) : ratLeRep ratZeroRep (sumTo f n) :=

theorem sumTo_nonneg (f : Nat → ratRep) (h : ∀ (k : Nat), ratLeRep ratZeroRep (f k))
    (n : Nat) : ratLeRep ratZeroRep (sumTo f n) :=
  Nat.rec
    (fun (n : Nat) => ratLeRep ratZeroRep (sumTo f n))
    (ratLeRep_refl ratZeroRep)

exercises.prompt: 116.1 非负项的部分和不降

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `leNat_exists_add` 把 n 写成 m + k，`sumTo_shift` 把 S_{m+k} 拆成 S_m 与尾块。尾块非负，所以 S_m ≤ S_m + 尾块；再用 `ratLeRep_congr_gen` 把右端换回 S_n。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `LeNat m n → ratLeRep (sumTo f m) (sumTo f n)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: leNat_exists_add · sumTo_shift · sumTo_nonneg · ratLeRep_add · ratLeRep_congr_gen · Eq.subst。

exercises.template:
theorem sumTo_mono (f : Nat → ratRep) (h : ∀ (k : Nat), ratLeRep ratZeroRep (f k))
    (m n : Nat) (hmn : LeNat m n) : ratLeRep (sumTo f m) (sumTo f n) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem sumTo_mono (f : Nat → ratRep) (h : ∀ (k : Nat), ratLeRep ratZeroRep (f k))
    (m n : Nat) (hmn : LeNat m n) : ratLeRep (sumTo f m) (sumTo f n) :=
  Exists.elim (leNat_exists_add m n hmn)
    (fun (k : Nat) (hk : n = Nat.add m k) =>
      @Eq.subst.{1} Nat (fun (x : Nat) => ratLeRep (sumTo f m) (sumTo f x))
        (Nat.add m k) n (Eq.symm hk)
        (ratLeRep_congr_gen (sumTo f m) (sumTo f m)
          (ratAddRep (sumTo f m) (TailSum f m k)) (sumTo f (Nat.add m k))
          (ratRel_refl (sumTo f m))
          (ratRel_symm (sumTo f (Nat.add m k))
            (ratAddRep (sumTo f m) (TailSum f m k))
            (sumTo_shift f m k))
          (ratLeRep_trans (sumTo f m) (ratAddRep (sumTo f m) ratZeroRep)
            (ratAddRep (sumTo f m) (TailSum f m k))
            (ratLeRep_of_ratRel (sumTo f m) (ratAddRep (sumTo f m) ratZeroRep)
              (ratRel_symm (ratAddRep (sumTo f m) ratZeroRep) (sumTo f m)
                (ratAdd_zero (sumTo f m))))
            (ratLeRep_add (sumTo f m) (sumTo f m) ratZeroRep (TailSum f m k)
              (ratLeRep_refl (sumTo f m))
              (sumTo_nonneg (fun (j : Nat) => f (Nat.add m j))
                (fun (j : Nat) => h (Nat.add m j)) k)))))

exercises.solution:
theorem sumTo_abs_le (f g : Nat → ratRep) (n : Nat)
    (h : ∀ (k : Nat), ratAbsRel (f k) (g k)) :
    ∃ (d : ratRep), ratAbsRel (sumTo f n) d ∧ ratLeRep d (sumTo g n) :=
  Nat.rec
    (fun (n : Nat) => ∃ (d : ratRep),
      ratAbsRel (sumTo f n) d ∧ ratLeRep d (sumTo g n))
    (Exists.intro ratZeroRep
      (And.intro ratAbsRel_zero
        (ratLeRep_of_ratRel ratZeroRep (sumTo g Nat.zero)
          (ratRel_symm (sumTo g Nat.zero) ratZeroRep (sumTo_zero g)))))
    (fun (n : Nat)
        (ih : ∃ (d : ratRep), ratAbsRel (sumTo f n) d ∧ ratLeRep d (sumTo g n)) =>
      Exists.elim ih
        (fun (d : ratRep)
            (hd : ratAbsRel (sumTo f n) d ∧ ratLeRep d (sumTo g n)) =>
          Exists.elim (ratAbsRel_total (ratAddRep (sumTo f n) (f n)))
            (fun (d' : ratRep)
                (hd' : ratAbsRel (ratAddRep (sumTo f n) (f n)) d') =>
              Exists.intro d'
                (And.intro hd'
                  (ratLeRep_trans d' (ratAddRep d (g n))
                    (ratAddRep (sumTo g n) (g n))
                    (ratLeRep_abs_add (sumTo f n) (f n) d (g n) d'
                      (And.left hd) (h n) hd')
                    (ratLeRep_add d (sumTo g n) (g n) (g n)
                      (And.right hd) (ratLeRep_refl (g n))))))))
    n

exercises.unit: 单元117 有限和的绝对值
exercises.name: sumTo_abs_self

exercises.prompt: 117.1 非负序列的部分和是自己的绝对值见证

theorem sumTo_abs_self (f : Nat → ratRep) (h : ∀ (k : Nat), ratLeRep ratZeroRep (f k))

exercises.unit: 单元118 比较判别法
exercises.name: tailSum_le
exercises.title: 118.0 尾块也逐项比较
exercises.prompt:
118.0 尾块也逐项比较

尾块是平移序列的部分和，111.2 的逐项比较原样搬过来。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把 `TailSum f m k` 展开成平移序列 `j ↦ f (m + j)` 的部分和，对两条平移序列用 `sumTo_le`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratLeRep (TailSum f m k) (TailSum g m k)`（已知逐项 `f j ≤ g j`）。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: TailSum · sumTo_le。

exercises.template:
theorem tailSum_le (f g : Nat → ratRep) (m k : Nat)
    (h : ∀ (j : Nat), ratLeRep (f j) (g j)) :
    ratLeRep (TailSum f m k) (TailSum g m k) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem tailSum_le (f g : Nat → ratRep) (m k : Nat)
    (h : ∀ (j : Nat), ratLeRep (f j) (g j)) :
    ratLeRep (TailSum f m k) (TailSum g m k) :=
  sumTo_le (fun (j : Nat) => f (Nat.add m j))
    (fun (j : Nat) => g (Nat.add m j)) k
    (fun (j : Nat) => h (Nat.add m j))

exercises.unit: 单元118 比较判别法
exercises.name: tail_close_of_le
exercises.title: 118.1 被压住的尾块也小
exercises.prompt:
118.1 被压住的尾块也小

f 的尾块非负，绝对值见证取它自己。它不超过 g 的尾块，而 g 的尾块在 ε 内靠近零，于是这个见证也小于 ε。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先用 114 的 `close` 展开，得到 g 的尾块的一个见证 `d < ε`。f 的尾块非负（116.2），见证可以取它自己；它不超过 g 的尾块（118.0），而 g 的尾块不超过 `d`，所以它小于 ε。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `close (TailSum f m k) ratZeroRep eps`（已知 f 非负、f ≤ g 逐项、g 的尾块在 ε 内接近零）。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: tailSum_nonneg · tailSum_le · ratAbsRel_le · ratAbsRel_wd_left · ratAdd_zero · ratLtRep_of_le_lt。

exercises.template:
theorem tail_close_of_le (f g : Nat → ratRep) (m k : Nat) (eps : ratRep)
    (hf : ∀ (j : Nat), ratLeRep ratZeroRep (f j))
    (hfg : ∀ (j : Nat), ratLeRep (f j) (g j))
    (h : close (TailSum g m k) ratZeroRep eps) :
    close (TailSum f m k) ratZeroRep eps :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem tail_close_of_le (f g : Nat → ratRep) (m k : Nat) (eps : ratRep)
    (hf : ∀ (j : Nat), ratLeRep ratZeroRep (f j))
    (hfg : ∀ (j : Nat), ratLeRep (f j) (g j))
    (h : close (TailSum g m k) ratZeroRep eps) :
    close (TailSum f m k) ratZeroRep eps :=
  Exists.elim h
    (fun (d : ratRep)
        (hd : ratAbsRel (ratSubRep (TailSum g m k) ratZeroRep) d ∧
          ratLtRep d eps) =>
      Exists.intro (TailSum f m k)
        (And.intro
          (ratAbsRel_wd_left (TailSum f m k)
            (ratSubRep (TailSum f m k) ratZeroRep) (TailSum f m k)
            (ratRel_symm (ratAddRep (TailSum f m k) ratZeroRep)
              (TailSum f m k) (ratAdd_zero (TailSum f m k)))
            (Or.inl
              (And.intro (tailSum_nonneg f hf m k)
                (ratRel_refl (TailSum f m k)))))
          (ratLtRep_of_le_lt (TailSum f m k) d eps
            (ratLeRep_trans (TailSum f m k) (TailSum g m k) d
              (tailSum_le f g m k hfg)
              (ratAbsRel_le (TailSum g m k) d
                (ratAbsRel_wd_left
                  (ratSubRep (TailSum g m k) ratZeroRep)
                  (TailSum g m k) d
                  (ratAdd_zero (TailSum g m k))
                  (And.left hd))))
            (And.right hd))))

exercises.unit: 单元118 比较判别法
exercises.name: summable_of_le
exercises.title: 118.2 比较判别法
exercises.prompt:
118.2 比较判别法

对 ε 从 g 的尾块判别取阈值 N；118.1 把 f 的每个尾块都收进 ε。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 用 114 的 `summable_iff_tail` 两次。对 ε 先从 g 取 N，使 m ≥ N 时每个 `TailSum g m k` 在 ε 内接近零；再把每个 `TailSum f m k` 交给 118.1。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Summable f`（已知 f 非负、f ≤ g 逐项、g 可和）。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: summable_iff_tail · tail_close_of_le。

exercises.template:
theorem summable_of_le (f g : Nat → ratRep)
    (hf : ∀ (k : Nat), ratLeRep ratZeroRep (f k))
    (hfg : ∀ (k : Nat), ratLeRep (f k) (g k))
    (hg : Summable g) : Summable f :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem summable_of_le (f g : Nat → ratRep)
    (hf : ∀ (k : Nat), ratLeRep ratZeroRep (f k))
    (hfg : ∀ (k : Nat), ratLeRep (f k) (g k))
    (hg : Summable g) : Summable f :=
  Iff.mpr (summable_iff_tail f)
    (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
      Exists.elim ((Iff.mp (summable_iff_tail g) hg) eps heps)
        (fun (N : Nat)
            (hN : ∀ (m : Nat), LeNat N m → ∀ (k : Nat),
              close (TailSum g m k) ratZeroRep eps) =>
          Exists.intro N
            (fun (m : Nat) (hm : LeNat N m) (k : Nat) =>
              tail_close_of_le f g m k eps hf hfg (hN m hm k))))

exercises.unit: 单元119 绝对收敛推出收敛
exercises.name: ratLtRep_of_le_close
exercises.title: 119.0 不超过一个小量的数也小
exercises.prompt:
119.0 不超过一个小量的数也小

若 y 在 ε 内靠近零，则它的绝对值见证 e 小于 ε；任何不超过 y 的 d 也就不超过 e，于是 d < ε。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先从 `close y 0 ε` 取见证 e 与 `e < ε`；`ratAbsRel_le` 给出 `y ≤ e`，`d ≤ y` 与它传递，再用 `ratLtRep_of_le_lt` 收口。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratLtRep d eps`（已知 `d ≤ y` 且 `y` 在 ε 内接近零）。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratAbsRel_le · ratAbsRel_wd_left · ratAdd_zero · ratLeRep_trans · ratLtRep_of_le_lt。

exercises.template:
theorem ratLtRep_of_le_close (d y eps : ratRep)
    (hdy : ratLeRep d y) (h : close y ratZeroRep eps) :
    ratLtRep d eps :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratLtRep_of_le_close (d y eps : ratRep)
    (hdy : ratLeRep d y) (h : close y ratZeroRep eps) :
    ratLtRep d eps :=
  Exists.elim h
    (fun (e : ratRep)
        (he : ratAbsRel (ratSubRep y ratZeroRep) e ∧ ratLtRep e eps) =>
      ratLtRep_of_le_lt d e eps
        (ratLeRep_trans d y e hdy
          (ratAbsRel_le y e
            (ratAbsRel_wd_left (ratSubRep y ratZeroRep) y e
              (ratAdd_zero y) (And.left he))))
        (And.right he))

exercises.unit: 单元119 绝对收敛推出收敛
exercises.name: summable_of_abs
exercises.title: 119.1 绝对收敛推出收敛
exercises.prompt:
119.1 绝对收敛推出收敛

对 ε 从 g 的尾块判别取 N。f 的尾块有一个见证 d，d 不超过 g 的尾块 （117.0），所以 119.0 给出 d < ε。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 用 114 的 `summable_iff_tail`。对 ε 先从 g 取 N；对每个尾块用 117.0 取见证 d，d 不超过 g 的尾块，再由 119.0 得 `d < ε`。`close` 的见证取 d，先用 `ratAbsRel_wd_left` 把 `TailSum f m k` 搬到 `TailSum f m k - 0`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Summable f`（已知逐项 `ratAbsRel (f k) (g k)`、g 可和）。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: summable_iff_tail · sumTo_abs_le · ratLtRep_of_le_close · ratAbsRel_wd_left · ratAdd_zero。

exercises.template:
theorem summable_of_abs (f g : Nat → ratRep)
    (h : ∀ (k : Nat), ratAbsRel (f k) (g k))
    (hg : Summable g) : Summable f :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem summable_of_abs (f g : Nat → ratRep)
    (h : ∀ (k : Nat), ratAbsRel (f k) (g k))
    (hg : Summable g) : Summable f :=
  Iff.mpr (summable_iff_tail f)
    (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
      Exists.elim ((Iff.mp (summable_iff_tail g) hg) eps heps)
        (fun (N : Nat)
            (hN : ∀ (m : Nat), LeNat N m → ∀ (k : Nat),
              close (TailSum g m k) ratZeroRep eps) =>
          Exists.intro N
            (fun (m : Nat) (hm : LeNat N m) (k : Nat) =>
              Exists.elim
                (sumTo_abs_le (fun (j : Nat) => f (Nat.add m j))
                  (fun (j : Nat) => g (Nat.add m j)) k
                  (fun (j : Nat) => h (Nat.add m j)))
                (fun (d : ratRep)
                    (hd : ratAbsRel (TailSum f m k) d ∧
                      ratLeRep d (TailSum g m k)) =>
                  Exists.intro d
                    (And.intro
                      (ratAbsRel_wd_left (TailSum f m k)
                        (ratSubRep (TailSum f m k) ratZeroRep) d
                        (ratRel_symm (ratAddRep (TailSum f m k) ratZeroRep)
                          (TailSum f m k) (ratAdd_zero (TailSum f m k)))
                        (And.left hd))
                      (ratLtRep_of_le_close d (TailSum g m k) eps
                        (And.right hd) (hN m hm k)))))))

exercises.unit: 单元120 望远镜级数
exercises.name: series_telescope
exercises.title: 120.0 相邻差的部分和只剩首尾
exercises.prompt:
120.0 相邻差的部分和只剩首尾

部分和按定义就是 `sumTo`，111.1 的有限望远镜逐项抵消，只剩 `b n - b 0`。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 部分和按定义展开成 `sumTo`，直接引用 111.1 的 `sumTo_telescope`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel (Series f n) (ratSubRep (b n) (b Nat.zero))`，其中 `f k = b (k+1) - b k`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: sumTo_telescope · Series 的定义。

exercises.template:
theorem series_telescope (b : Nat → ratRep) (n : Nat) :
    ratRel (Series (fun (k : Nat) => ratSubRep (b (Nat.succ k)) (b k)) n)
      (ratSubRep (b n) (b Nat.zero)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem series_telescope (b : Nat → ratRep) (n : Nat) :
    ratRel (Series (fun (k : Nat) => ratSubRep (b (Nat.succ k)) (b k)) n)
      (ratSubRep (b n) (b Nat.zero)) :=
  sumTo_telescope b n

exercises.unit: 单元120 望远镜级数
exercises.name: summable_telescope
exercises.title: 120.1 端点 Cauchy，差分级数可和
exercises.prompt:
120.1 端点 Cauchy，差分级数可和

逐点等式 120.0 把部分和与 `b n - b 0` 接上，而后者是 `b` 加一个常数。 端点序列 Cauchy，加常数后仍 Cauchy，搬运律把可和性交还差分级数。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 用 `cauchy_congr` 把可和性从 `addConst b (-(b 0))` 搬到差分级数；逐点等式用 120.0，Cauchy 性用 `cauchy_add_const`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Summable (fun (k : Nat) => ratSubRep (b (Nat.succ k)) (b k))`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: cauchy_congr · cauchy_add_const · ratRel_symm · series_telescope。

exercises.template:
theorem summable_telescope (b : Nat → ratRep) (hb : Cauchy b) :
    Summable (fun (k : Nat) => ratSubRep (b (Nat.succ k)) (b k)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem summable_telescope (b : Nat → ratRep) (hb : Cauchy b) :
    Summable (fun (k : Nat) => ratSubRep (b (Nat.succ k)) (b k)) :=
  cauchy_congr (addConst b (ratNegRep (b Nat.zero)))
    (Series (fun (k : Nat) => ratSubRep (b (Nat.succ k)) (b k)))
    (fun (n : Nat) =>
      ratRel_symm
        (Series (fun (k : Nat) => ratSubRep (b (Nat.succ k)) (b k)) n)
        (ratSubRep (b n) (b Nat.zero))
        (series_telescope b n))
    (cauchy_add_const b (ratNegRep (b Nat.zero)) hb)

exercises.unit: 单元120 望远镜级数
exercises.name: cauchy_of_telescope_summable
exercises.title: 120.2 差分级数可和，端点 Cauchy
exercises.prompt:
120.2 差分级数可和，端点 Cauchy

反方向：差分级数可和说明 `b n - b 0` Cauchy；把 `b 0` 加回去，再与 `b` 逐点比较，就得到端点序列的 Cauchy 性。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先用 120.0 把差分级数的部分和读到 `b n - b 0`，得 `Cauchy (fun n => b n - b 0)`；再加回 `b 0`，最后与 `b` 逐点比较。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Cauchy b`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: cauchy_congr · cauchy_add_const · ratSubRep_add_self · series_telescope。

exercises.template:
theorem cauchy_of_telescope_summable (b : Nat → ratRep)
    (h : Summable (fun (k : Nat) => ratSubRep (b (Nat.succ k)) (b k))) :
    Cauchy b :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem cauchy_of_telescope_summable (b : Nat → ratRep)
    (h : Summable (fun (k : Nat) => ratSubRep (b (Nat.succ k)) (b k))) :
    Cauchy b :=
  cauchy_congr
    (addConst (fun (n : Nat) => ratSubRep (b n) (b Nat.zero)) (b Nat.zero))
    b
    (fun (n : Nat) => ratSubRep_add_self (b n) (b Nat.zero))
    (cauchy_add_const (fun (n : Nat) => ratSubRep (b n) (b Nat.zero))
      (b Nat.zero)
      (cauchy_congr
        (Series (fun (k : Nat) => ratSubRep (b (Nat.succ k)) (b k)))
        (fun (n : Nat) => ratSubRep (b n) (b Nat.zero))
        (fun (n : Nat) => series_telescope b n)
        h))

exercises.unit: 单元121 级数的尾块
exercises.name: cauchy_shift_left
exercises.title: 121.0 向左平移仍 Cauchy
exercises.prompt:
121.0 向左平移仍 Cauchy

`cauchy_shift` 给的是 `x (n + k)`；尾块要的是 `x (k + n)`。两条下标只差 ℕ 加法的交换律，把阈值用 `Eq.subst` 搬过去即可。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先取 `h` 的阈值 N；对每个 `n ≥ N`，把 `leNat_self_add n k`（`n ≤ n + k`）用 `add_comm n k` 搬到 `n ≤ k + n`，再与 `N ≤ n` 传递。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Cauchy (fun (n : Nat) => x (Nat.add k n))`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: cauchy_shift 的阈值结构 · leNat_self_add · add_comm · Eq.subst · leNat_trans。

exercises.template:
theorem cauchy_shift_left (x : Seq) (k : Nat) (h : Cauchy x) :
    Cauchy (fun (n : Nat) => x (Nat.add k n)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem cauchy_shift_left (x : Seq) (k : Nat) (h : Cauchy x) :
    Cauchy (fun (n : Nat) => x (Nat.add k n)) :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (h eps heps)
      (fun (N : Nat)
          (hN : ∀ (n m : Nat), LeNat N n → LeNat N m →
            close (x n) (x m) eps) =>
        Exists.intro N
          (fun (n m : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) (hm : LeNat N m) =>
            hN (Nat.add k n) (Nat.add k m)
              (leNat_trans N n (Nat.add k n) hn
                (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
                  (fun (t : Nat) => LeNat n t)
                  (Nat.add n k) (Nat.add k n) (add_comm n k)
                  (leNat_self_add n k)))
              (leNat_trans N m (Nat.add k m) hm
                (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
                  (fun (t : Nat) => LeNat m t)
                  (Nat.add m k) (Nat.add k m) (add_comm m k)
                  (leNat_self_add m k)))))

exercises.unit: 单元121 级数的尾块
exercises.name: summable_tail
exercises.title: 121.2 可和级数的尾块仍可和
exercises.prompt:
121.2 可和级数的尾块仍可和

尾块级数的部分和由 121.1 认成 `TailSum f m n`，再由 114.5 读成 `S (m + n) - S m`。`S` 向左平移仍 Cauchy，加常数 `-S m` 后仍 Cauchy； 搬运律把它换成尾块级数的可和性。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 用 `cauchy_congr` 把可和性从 `addConst (fun n => Series f (m + n)) (-(Series f m))` 搬到尾块级数；逐点等式是 121.1 接 114.5，Cauchy 性用 121.0 与 `cauchy_add_const`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Summable (fun (k : Nat) => f (Nat.add m k))`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: cauchy_congr · cauchy_shift_left · cauchy_add_const · tail_eq_sub · ratRel_symm。

exercises.template:
theorem summable_tail (f : Nat → ratRep) (m : Nat) (h : Summable f) :
    Summable (fun (k : Nat) => f (Nat.add m k)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem summable_tail (f : Nat → ratRep) (m : Nat) (h : Summable f) :
    Summable (fun (k : Nat) => f (Nat.add m k)) :=
  cauchy_congr
    (addConst (fun (n : Nat) => Series f (Nat.add m n))
      (ratNegRep (Series f m)))
    (Series (fun (k : Nat) => f (Nat.add m k)))
    (fun (n : Nat) =>
      ratRel_symm
        (TailSum f m n)
        (ratSubRep (Series f (Nat.add m n)) (Series f m))
        (tail_eq_sub f m n))
    (cauchy_add_const (fun (n : Nat) => Series f (Nat.add m n))
      (ratNegRep (Series f m))
      (cauchy_shift_left (Series f) m h))

exercises.unit: 单元122 尾块判别（反方向）
exercises.name: tailSum_shift
exercises.title: 122.0 尾块平移后的部分和
exercises.prompt:
122.0 尾块平移后的部分和

尾块 `TailSum f (m+a) k` 与「先平移再取尾块」是同一串项。两个下标只差 ℕ 加法的结合律，逐项用 `Eq.subst` 把 `(m+a)+j` 认成 `m+(a+j)`。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把两边都展开成 `sumTo`，对每一项用 `add_assoc m a j` 把下标对齐，再交给 `sumTo_congr`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel (TailSum f (m + a) k) (TailSum (fun j => f (m + j)) a k)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: TailSum 的定义 · sumTo_congr · add_assoc · Eq.subst · ratRel_refl。

exercises.template:
theorem tailSum_shift (f : Nat → ratRep) (m a k : Nat) :
    ratRel (TailSum f (Nat.add m a) k)
      (TailSum (fun (j : Nat) => f (Nat.add m j)) a k) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem tailSum_shift (f : Nat → ratRep) (m a k : Nat) :
    ratRel (TailSum f (Nat.add m a) k)
      (TailSum (fun (j : Nat) => f (Nat.add m j)) a k) :=
  sumTo_congr
    (fun (j : Nat) => f (Nat.add (Nat.add m a) j))
    (fun (j : Nat) => f (Nat.add m (Nat.add a j)))
    k
    (fun (j : Nat) =>
      @Eq.subst.{1} Nat
        (fun (t : Nat) => ratRel (f (Nat.add (Nat.add m a) j)) (f t))
        (Nat.add (Nat.add m a) j) (Nat.add m (Nat.add a j))
        (add_assoc m a j)
        (ratRel_refl (f (Nat.add (Nat.add m a) j))))

exercises.unit: 单元122 尾块判别（反方向）
exercises.name: summable_of_tail
exercises.title: 122.1 尾块可和推出原级数可和
exercises.prompt:
122.1 尾块可和推出原级数可和

`summable_iff_tail` 把可和性写成「所有足够靠后的尾块都一致地小」。尾块 可和时，同一个判据作用在平移后的级数上；把下标从 `m+a` 读回 `p`，就得到 原级数的尾块估计。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 ε 从尾块级数的 `summable_iff_tail` 取阈值 N'。原级数取阈值 m + N'；对 p ≥ m + N'，把 p 写成 m + a，则 a ≥ N'，再用 122.0 把 `TailSum f p k` 换成平移后的尾块。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Summable f`（已知 `Summable (fun k => f (m + k))`）。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: summable_iff_tail · leNat_exists_add · leNat_add_cancel_right · tailSum_shift · close_wd_left。

exercises.template:
theorem summable_of_tail (f : Nat → ratRep) (m : Nat)
    (h : Summable (fun (k : Nat) => f (Nat.add m k))) :
    Summable f :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem summable_of_tail (f : Nat → ratRep) (m : Nat)
    (h : Summable (fun (k : Nat) => f (Nat.add m k))) :
    Summable f :=
  Iff.mpr (summable_iff_tail f)
    (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
      Exists.elim
        (@Iff.mp
          (Summable (fun (k : Nat) => f (Nat.add m k)))
          (∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
            ∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (a : Nat), LeNat N a → ∀ (k : Nat),
              close (TailSum (fun (j : Nat) => f (Nat.add m j)) a k)
                ratZeroRep eps)
          (summable_iff_tail (fun (k : Nat) => f (Nat.add m k))) h eps heps)
        (fun (N : Nat)
            (hN : ∀ (a : Nat), LeNat N a → ∀ (k : Nat),
              close (TailSum (fun (j : Nat) => f (Nat.add m j)) a k)
                ratZeroRep eps) =>
          Exists.intro (Nat.add m N)
            (fun (p : Nat) (hp : LeNat (Nat.add m N) p) (k : Nat) =>
              Exists.elim
                (leNat_exists_add m p
                  (leNat_trans m (Nat.add m N) p (leNat_self_add m N) hp))
                (fun (a : Nat) (ha : p = Nat.add m a) =>
                  close_wd_left
                    (TailSum (fun (j : Nat) => f (Nat.add m j)) a k)
                    (TailSum f p k)
                    ratZeroRep eps
                    (ratRel_symm
                      (TailSum f p k)
                      (TailSum (fun (j : Nat) => f (Nat.add m j)) a k)
                      (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
                        (fun (t : Nat) => ratRel (TailSum f t k)
                          (TailSum (fun (j : Nat) => f (Nat.add m j)) a k))
                        (Nat.add m a) p
                        (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat p (Nat.add m a) ha)
                        (tailSum_shift f m a k)))
                    (hN a
                      (leNat_add_cancel_right N a m
                        (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
                          (fun (t : Nat) => LeNat t (Nat.add a m))
                          (Nat.add m N) (Nat.add N m) (add_comm m N)
                          (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
                            (fun (t : Nat) => LeNat (Nat.add m N) t)
                            (Nat.add m a) (Nat.add a m) (add_comm m a)
                            (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
                              (fun (t : Nat) => LeNat (Nat.add m N) t)
                              p (Nat.add m a) ha hp))))
                      k)))))

exercises.unit: 单元123 级数的重排：交换前两项
exercises.name: swapFirst_eq_of_two_le
exercises.title: 123.1 从第三项起交换不改变项
exercises.prompt:
123.1 从第三项起交换不改变项

`leNat_exists_add` 把 `2 ≤ n` 写成 `n = 2 + j`；再用 `2 + j = succ (succ j)` 把下标化成第三个分支。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 用 `leNat_exists_add 2 n h` 取 j 使 n = 2 + j；证明 `2 + j = succ (succ j)` 后把下标换成 `succ (succ j)`，`swapFirst` 的第三个分支就是原项。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `swapFirst f n = f n`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: leNat_exists_add · succ_add · zero_add · congrArg · Eq.trans · Eq.subst。

exercises.template:
theorem swapFirst_eq_of_two_le (f : Nat → ratRep) (n : Nat)
    (h : LeNat 2 n) : swapFirst f n = f n :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem swapFirst_eq_of_two_le (f : Nat → ratRep) (n : Nat)
    (h : LeNat 2 n) : swapFirst f n = f n :=
  Exists.elim (leNat_exists_add 2 n h)
    (fun (j : Nat) (hj : n = Nat.add 2 j) =>
      @Eq.subst.{1} Nat
        (fun (t : Nat) => swapFirst f t = f t)
        (Nat.succ (Nat.succ j)) n
        (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat n (Nat.succ (Nat.succ j))
          (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat n (Nat.add 2 j) (Nat.succ (Nat.succ j))
            hj (two_add_eq_succ_succ j)))
        (Eq.refl (f (Nat.succ (Nat.succ j)))))

exercises.unit: 单元123 级数的重排：交换前两项
exercises.name: tailSum_swapFirst
exercises.title: 123.2 从第二项起的尾块不变
exercises.prompt:
123.2 从第二项起的尾块不变

尾块从下标 m ≥ 2 开始，逐项都与原序列相同，`sumTo_congr` 把这条逐项 相等抬成尾块相等。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对每个 j，用 123.1 与 `leNat_trans 2 m (m + j)` 得 `swapFirst f (m + j) = f (m + j)`，再交给 `sumTo_congr`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel (TailSum (swapFirst f) m k) (TailSum f m k)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: sumTo_congr · swapFirst_eq_of_two_le · leNat_self_add · leNat_trans · ratRel_refl。

exercises.template:
theorem tailSum_swapFirst (f : Nat → ratRep) (m k : Nat)
    (hm : LeNat 2 m) :
    ratRel (TailSum (swapFirst f) m k) (TailSum f m k) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem tailSum_swapFirst (f : Nat → ratRep) (m k : Nat)
    (hm : LeNat 2 m) :
    ratRel (TailSum (swapFirst f) m k) (TailSum f m k) :=
  sumTo_congr
    (fun (j : Nat) => swapFirst f (Nat.add m j))
    (fun (j : Nat) => f (Nat.add m j))
    k
    (fun (j : Nat) =>
      @Eq.subst.{1} ratRep
        (fun (x : ratRep) => ratRel x (f (Nat.add m j)))
        (f (Nat.add m j)) (swapFirst f (Nat.add m j))
        (@Eq.symm.{1} ratRep (swapFirst f (Nat.add m j)) (f (Nat.add m j))
          (swapFirst_eq_of_two_le f (Nat.add m j)
            (leNat_trans 2 m (Nat.add m j) hm (leNat_self_add m j))))
        (ratRel_refl (f (Nat.add m j))))

exercises.unit: 单元124 函数极限：ε-δ 定义
exercises.name: tendsToAt_congr_off
exercises.title: 在一点之外相等，极限相同
exercises.prompt: 在一点之外相等，极限相同

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 两个方向都沿用对方的 δ。落在邻域里的 x 满足 `¬ ratRel x a`，于是 `f x` 与 `g x` 相等，把 `close` 沿这个等式搬过去；反方向先交换相等。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `TendsToAt f a L ↔ TendsToAt g a L`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: close_wd_left · ratRel_symm · 逐点假设 `h`。

exercises.template:
theorem tendsToAt_congr_off (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (a L : ratRep)
    (h : ∀ (x : ratRep), ¬ ratRel x a → ratRel (f x) (g x)) :
    TendsToAt f a L ↔ TendsToAt g a L :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem tendsToAt_congr_off (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (a L : ratRep)
    (h : ∀ (x : ratRep), ¬ ratRel x a → ratRel (f x) (g x)) :
    TendsToAt f a L ↔ TendsToAt g a L :=
  Iff.intro
    (fun (hf : TendsToAt f a L) =>
      fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
        Exists.elim (hf eps heps)
          (fun (delta : ratRep)
              (hd : ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
                ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a delta → ¬ ratRel x a →
                  close (f x) L eps) =>
            Exists.intro delta
              (And.intro (And.left hd)
                (fun (x : ratRep) (hx : close x a delta)
                    (hne : ¬ ratRel x a) =>
                  close_wd_left (f x) (g x) L eps (h x hne)
                    ((And.right hd) x hx hne)))))
    (fun (hg : TendsToAt g a L) =>
      fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
        Exists.elim (hg eps heps)
          (fun (delta : ratRep)
              (hd : ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
                ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a delta → ¬ ratRel x a →
                  close (g x) L eps) =>
            Exists.intro delta
              (And.intro (And.left hd)
                (fun (x : ratRep) (hx : close x a delta)
                    (hne : ¬ ratRel x a) =>
                  close_wd_left (g x) (f x) L eps
                    (ratRel_symm (f x) (g x) (h x hne))
                    ((And.right hd) x hx hne)))))

theorem tendsToAt_of_continuousAt (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a : ratRep)
    (h : ContinuousAt f a) : TendsToAt f a (f a) :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>

exercises.template:
theorem continuousAt_comp (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (a : ratRep)
    (hg : ContinuousAt g (f a)) (hf : ContinuousAt f a) :
    ContinuousAt (fun (x : ratRep) => g (f x)) a :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem continuousAt_comp (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (a : ratRep)
    (hg : ContinuousAt g (f a)) (hf : ContinuousAt f a) :
    ContinuousAt (fun (x : ratRep) => g (f x)) a :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (hg eps heps)
      (fun (deltaG : ratRep)
          (hdg : ratLtRep ratZeroRep deltaG ∧
            ∀ (y : ratRep), close y (f a) deltaG →
              close (g y) (g (f a)) eps) =>
        Exists.elim (hf deltaG (And.left hdg))
          (fun (deltaF : ratRep)
              (hdf : ratLtRep ratZeroRep deltaF ∧
                ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a deltaF →
                  close (f x) (f a) deltaG) =>
            Exists.intro deltaF
              (And.intro (And.left hdf)
                (fun (x : ratRep) (hx : close x a deltaF) =>
                  (And.right hdg) (f x) ((And.right hdf) x hx)))))

exercises.unit: 单元126 函数极限与序列：顺序判据
exercises.name: converges_apply_of_tendsToAt
exercises.title: 单元126 函数极限与序列：顺序判据
exercises.prompt:
单元126 函数极限与序列：顺序判据

函数极限盯住 a 的一个邻域，序列只给出可数的无穷多个点。如果每一个走到 a 的序列（各项不取 a）都被 f 送到 L，能不能反过来断定 f 在 a 处趋于 L？ 这是函数极限的序列判据。其中从函数极限到序列极限的一半是直接的：δ 邻域 里的每个点都满足结论，序列迟早落进这个邻域。

这一半把 ε-δ 的结论翻译成 ε-N，连续的序列刻画也由它给出。连续的定义不 排掉 a，所以不需要「各项不取 a」；函数极限排掉 a，所以那条前提要跟着 序列一起传下去，两个阈值取较大者。把结论用在恒等函数与零序列上，就是 一次具体核对。

反方向需要从每个 ε 挑一个见证点，把挑出的点排成序列；课程库没有选择函数， 这一步留作边界。已经能说的是：只要找到一条走到 a 的序列而 f 的像不趋于 L， f 在 a 处就没有极限。

边界：函数取 `ratRep → ratRep`，序列取 `Nat → ratRep`，两边都停在有理 代表元层。不新增公理。

函数极限送到序列极限

给定 ε，函数极限给出 δ；序列极限把这个 δ 当自己的 ε，给出阈值 N；「各项 不取 a」给出阈值 M。取 K 同时超过 N 与 M，第 n 项就同时落进 δ 邻域并且 不等于 a，函数极限的结论随即落到 `f (x n)` 上。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把 ε 交给函数极限得到 δ；把 δ 交给序列极限得到 N；再把「终究不等于 a」的阈值 M 并进来，K = max N M 之后逐项落进 δ 邻域。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Converges (fun n => f (x n)) L`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: TendsToAt 的展开 · leNat_max · leNat_trans · Exists.elim。

exercises.template:
theorem converges_apply_of_tendsToAt (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a L : ratRep)
    (x : Seq) (hf : TendsToAt f a L) (hx : Converges x a)
    (hne : Eventually (fun (n : Nat) => ¬ ratRel (x n) a)) :
    Converges (fun (n : Nat) => f (x n)) L :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem converges_apply_of_tendsToAt (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a L : ratRep)
    (x : Seq) (hf : TendsToAt f a L) (hx : Converges x a)
    (hne : Eventually (fun (n : Nat) => ¬ ratRel (x n) a)) :
    Converges (fun (n : Nat) => f (x n)) L :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (hf eps heps)
      (fun (delta : ratRep)
          (hd : ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
            ∀ (y : ratRep), close y a delta → ¬ ratRel y a →
              close (f y) L eps) =>
        Exists.elim (hx delta (And.left hd))
          (fun (N : Nat) (hN : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n → close (x n) a delta) =>
            Exists.elim hne
              (fun (M : Nat) (hM : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat M n → ¬ ratRel (x n) a) =>
                Exists.elim (leNat_max N M)
                  (fun (K : Nat) (hK : LeNat N K ∧ LeNat M K) =>
                    Exists.intro K
                      (fun (n : Nat) (hn : LeNat K n) =>
                        (And.right hd) (x n)
                          (hN n (leNat_trans N K n (And.left hK) hn))
                          (hM n (leNat_trans M K n (And.right hK) hn)))))))

exercises.name: converges_apply_of_tail
exercises.title: 序列换成从某项起逐项相等的 y。收敛性由 `converges_congr_tail` 搬过去； 「各项不取 a」要重新论证：x n 与 y n 相等，x n 又不是 a，所以 y n 也不是 a。
exercises.prompt: 序列换成从某项起逐项相等的 y。收敛性由 `converges_congr_tail` 搬过去； 「各项不取 a」要重新论证：x n 与 y n 相等，x n 又不是 a，所以 y n 也不是 a。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先用 `converges_congr_tail` 把序列极限从 x 搬到 y；再把「x n ~ y n」与「x n 不是 a」并成同一个阈值，推出 y n 不是 a。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Converges (fun n => f (y n)) L`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: converges_congr_tail · eventually_and · eventually_mono · ratRel_trans_gen。

exercises.template:
theorem converges_apply_of_tail (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a L : ratRep)
    (x y : Seq) (hf : TendsToAt f a L) (hx : Converges x a)
    (ht : TailEq x y) (hne : Eventually (fun (n : Nat) => ¬ ratRel (x n) a)) :
    Converges (fun (n : Nat) => f (y n)) L :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem converges_apply_of_tail (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a L : ratRep)
    (x y : Seq) (hf : TendsToAt f a L) (hx : Converges x a)
    (ht : TailEq x y) (hne : Eventually (fun (n : Nat) => ¬ ratRel (x n) a)) :
    Converges (fun (n : Nat) => f (y n)) L :=
  converges_apply_of_tendsToAt f a L y hf
    (converges_congr_tail x y a hx ht)
    (eventually_mono
      (fun (n : Nat) => ratRel (x n) (y n) ∧ ¬ ratRel (x n) a)
      (fun (n : Nat) => ¬ ratRel (y n) a)
      (eventually_and (fun (n : Nat) => ratRel (x n) (y n))
        (fun (n : Nat) => ¬ ratRel (x n) a) ht hne)
      (fun (n : Nat) (h : ratRel (x n) (y n) ∧ ¬ ratRel (x n) a) =>
        fun (hy : ratRel (y n) a) =>
          (And.right h) (ratRel_trans_gen (x n) (y n) a (And.left h) hy)))

exercises.unit: 单元127 函数极限的代数：和、差与取负
exercises.name: close_mono_eps
exercises.title: 单元127 函数极限的代数：和、差与取负
exercises.prompt:
单元127 函数极限的代数：和、差与取负

两个函数各自趋近于 L 与 M，它们的和是否趋近于 L + M？把两个 ε-δ 定义并排， 会看到两块 δ 只能选一个：ε 折半之后，和的误差被三角不等式拆成两半，两个 半径取较小的那个就够了。取负不改变误差，只把方向翻过来；减法接在加法与 取负后面。

这里唯一的工程件是半径的比较。有理数的序是全的，所以两个正半径里总有一个 不超过另一个；把小的那个交出去，再用「放大 ε 不破坏 close」把另一个函数 也纳入同一个半径。两条结论合起来，线性组合的极限就是极限的线性组合。

边界：乘积与商需要先有「函数在 a 附近有界」与乘法对序的相容性，那两件事 留到后面的单元；这里只做加法群这一半。不新增公理。

放大 ε 不破坏接近性

`close x y ε` 的见证是某个 `d < ε`；只要 `ε ≤ ε'`，同一个 `d` 也满足 `d < ε'`。这是后面把两个不同半径统一到一个半径的桥。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 展开 `close` 取出见证 d 与 `d < ε`；`ε ≤ ε'` 与 `d < ε` 用严格序的传递得到 `d < ε'`，见证不变。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `close x y ε'`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.elim · ratLtRep_of_lt_le · And.left / And.right。

exercises.template:
theorem close_mono_eps (x y eps eps' : ratRep)
    (h : close x y eps) (hle : ratLeRep eps eps') :
    close x y eps' :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem close_mono_eps (x y eps eps' : ratRep)
    (h : close x y eps) (hle : ratLeRep eps eps') :
    close x y eps' :=
  Exists.elim h
    (fun (d : ratRep)
        (hd : ratAbsRel (ratSubRep x y) d ∧ ratLtRep d eps) =>
      Exists.intro d
        (And.intro (And.left hd)
          (ratLtRep_of_lt_le d eps eps' (And.right hd) hle)))

exercises.template:
theorem tendsToAt_add (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (a L M : ratRep)
    (hf : TendsToAt f a L) (hg : TendsToAt g a M) :
    TendsToAt (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) (g x)) a
      (ratAddRep L M) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem tendsToAt_add (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (a L M : ratRep)
    (hf : TendsToAt f a L) (hg : TendsToAt g a M) :
    TendsToAt (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) (g x)) a
      (ratAddRep L M) :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (hf (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
      (fun (df : ratRep)
          (hdf : ratLtRep ratZeroRep df ∧
            ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a df → ¬ ratRel x a →
              close (f x) L (ratHalf eps)) =>
        Exists.elim (hg (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
          (fun (dg : ratRep)
              (hdg : ratLtRep ratZeroRep dg ∧
                ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a dg → ¬ ratRel x a →
                  close (g x) M (ratHalf eps)) =>
            Or.elim
              (fun (hle : ratLeRep df dg) =>
                Exists.intro df
                  (And.intro (And.left hdf)
                    (fun (x : ratRep) (hx : close x a df)
                        (hne : ¬ ratRel x a) =>
                      close_add (f x) L (g x) M eps
                        ((And.right hdf) x hx hne)
                        ((And.right hdg) x
                          (close_mono_eps x a df dg hx hle) hne))))
              (fun (hle : ratLeRep dg df) =>
                Exists.intro dg
                  (And.intro (And.left hdg)
                    (fun (x : ratRep) (hx : close x a dg)
                        (hne : ¬ ratRel x a) =>
                      close_add (f x) L (g x) M eps
                        ((And.right hdf) x
                          (close_mono_eps x a dg df hx hle) hne)
                        ((And.right hdg) x hx hne))))
              (ratLeRep_total df dg)))

exercises.title: 单元128 连续函数的代数：和、差与取负
exercises.prompt:
单元128 连续函数的代数：和、差与取负

两个在 a 处连续的函数，相加之后还在 a 处连续吗？函数极限的和律已经回答过 类似的问题：ε 折半，两块正半径取小者，误差由三角不等式合成。连续是「极限 值就是函数值」的极限，所以同一套估计应该照搬；真正要检查的是连续的定义 没有把 a 排除在外，邻域里每一点都要照顾到。

这件事反而让证明变短。函数极限的和律要单独处理「x 不是 a」，连续不需要： 给定 ε，两个函数各交出 ε 的一半作半径，序的全性保证其中一个不超过另一个， 把小的那个当公共半径，大的那个用放大律收进来，邻域里的每一点都直接交给 `close_add`。取负只翻方向不动误差，减法接在加法与取负之后。

逐点版本成立之后，全局版本只是把 a 换成全称量词。乘积与商会多出一层 「函数在 a 附近有界」的估计，那件事留到后面的单元；这里先把加法群这一半 做完。证明只用到两条已经判过的引擎：半径放大律与 `close_add`。

边界：函数取 `ratRep → ratRep`，连续停在有理代表元层。不新增公理。

和保持连续

ε 折半，两个函数各给一个正半径。序的全性把两个半径分成「δf ≤ δg」与 「δg ≤ δf」两支，两支都取较小的那个当公共半径，较大的那个用放大律收进 同一个半径，再交给 `close_add`。

    (hf : ContinuousAt f a) (hg : ContinuousAt g a) :
    ContinuousAt (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) (g x)) a :=

exercises.solution:
theorem continuousAt_add (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (a : ratRep)
    (hf : ContinuousAt f a) (hg : ContinuousAt g a) :
    ContinuousAt (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) (g x)) a :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (hf (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
      (fun (df : ratRep)
          (hdf : ratLtRep ratZeroRep df ∧
            ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a df →
              close (f x) (f a) (ratHalf eps)) =>
        Exists.elim (hg (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
          (fun (dg : ratRep)
              (hdg : ratLtRep ratZeroRep dg ∧
                ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a dg →
                  close (g x) (g a) (ratHalf eps)) =>
            Or.elim
              (fun (hle : ratLeRep df dg) =>
                Exists.intro df
                  (And.intro (And.left hdf)
                    (fun (x : ratRep) (hx : close x a df) =>
                      close_add (f x) (f a) (g x) (g a) eps
                        ((And.right hdf) x hx)
                        ((And.right hdg) x
                          (close_mono_eps x a df dg hx hle)))))
              (fun (hle : ratLeRep dg df) =>
                Exists.intro dg
                  (And.intro (And.left hdg)
                    (fun (x : ratRep) (hx : close x a dg) =>
                      close_add (f x) (f a) (g x) (g a) eps
                        ((And.right hdf) x
                          (close_mono_eps x a dg df hx hle))
                        ((And.right hdg) x hx))))
              (ratLeRep_total df dg)))

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 半径取 ε 本身，邻域前提就是结论，方向条件用不上。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `TendsToAtRight (fun x => x) a a`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.intro · And.intro · 假设 `close x a eps`。

exercises.template:
theorem tendsToAtRight_id (a : ratRep) :
    TendsToAtRight (fun (x : ratRep) => x) a a :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem tendsToAtRight_id (a : ratRep) :
    TendsToAtRight (fun (x : ratRep) => x) a a :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.intro eps
      (And.intro heps
        (fun (x : ratRep) (_hlt : ratLtRep a x)
            (hx : close x a eps) => hx))

exercises.unit: 单元129 单侧极限：只看一边
exercises.name: tendsToAtRight_of_tendsToAt
exercises.title: 函数极限的 δ 对邻域里的每一点给结论，只多要一条「x 不是 a」。右极限的 方向条件 `a < x` 正好推出它不是 a，于是这条前提被消掉。
exercises.prompt: 函数极限的 δ 对邻域里的每一点给结论，只多要一条「x 不是 a」。右极限的 方向条件 `a < x` 正好推出它不是 a，于是这条前提被消掉。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 沿用双侧极限的 δ；方向条件 `a < x` 与「x 不是 a」只差一次对称，用 `ratLtRep_right` 把方向条件翻成 `¬ ratRel a x`，再对称过去。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `TendsToAtRight f a L`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: TendsToAt 的展开 · ratLtRep_right · ratRel_symm。

exercises.template:
theorem tendsToAtRight_of_tendsToAt (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a L : ratRep)
    (h : TendsToAt f a L) : TendsToAtRight f a L :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem tendsToAtRight_of_tendsToAt (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a L : ratRep)
    (h : TendsToAt f a L) : TendsToAtRight f a L :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (h eps heps)
      (fun (delta : ratRep)
          (hd : ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
            ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a delta → ¬ ratRel x a →
              close (f x) L eps) =>
        Exists.intro delta
          (And.intro (And.left hd)
            (fun (x : ratRep) (hlt : ratLtRep a x)
                (hx : close x a delta) =>
              (And.right hd) x hx
                (fun (hrel : ratRel x a) =>
                  (ratLtRep_right a x hlt) (ratRel_symm x a hrel)))))

exercises.unit: 单元129 单侧极限：只看一边
exercises.name: continuousAt_of_right_left
exercises.title: 邻域里的点按序的全性分成两支：不大于 a 的一支交给左极限，不小于 a 的一支 交给右极限。每一支再用「相等或严格小」二分一次：相等时函数值只差一次等价 搬运，严格小时才是单侧极限的用武之地。两块半径也要先取小者。
exercises.prompt: 邻域里的点按序的全性分成两支：不大于 a 的一支交给左极限，不小于 a 的一支 交给右极限。每一支再用「相等或严格小」二分一次：相等时函数值只差一次等价 搬运，严格小时才是单侧极限的用武之地。两块半径也要先取小者。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 两个单侧极限各给一条半径，用 `ratLeRep_total` 取小者当公共半径；对邻域里的 x 先用 `ratLeRep_total x a` 分左右，再用 `ratLeRep_eq_or_lt` 分出相等的情形；相等用 `hcong` 搬到 `close_of_ratRel`，严格小用对应的单侧极限。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ContinuousAt f a`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLeRep_total · ratLeRep_eq_or_lt · close_mono_eps · close_of_ratRel。

exercises.template:
theorem continuousAt_of_right_left (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a : ratRep)
    (hcong : ∀ (x : ratRep), ratRel x a → ratRel (f x) (f a))
    (hr : TendsToAtRight f a (f a)) (hl : TendsToAtLeft f a (f a)) :
    ContinuousAt f a :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem continuousAt_of_right_left (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a : ratRep)
    (hcong : ∀ (x : ratRep), ratRel x a → ratRel (f x) (f a))
    (hr : TendsToAtRight f a (f a)) (hl : TendsToAtLeft f a (f a)) :
    ContinuousAt f a :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (hr eps heps)
      (fun (dr : ratRep)
          (hdr : ratLtRep ratZeroRep dr ∧
            ∀ (x : ratRep), ratLtRep a x → close x a dr →
              close (f x) (f a) eps) =>
        Exists.elim (hl eps heps)
          (fun (dl : ratRep)
              (hdl : ratLtRep ratZeroRep dl ∧
                ∀ (x : ratRep), ratLtRep x a → close x a dl →
                  close (f x) (f a) eps) =>
            @Or.elim (ratLeRep dr dl) (ratLeRep dl dr)
              (∃ (delta : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
                ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a delta → close (f x) (f a) eps)
              (fun (hle : ratLeRep dr dl) =>
                Exists.intro dr
                  (And.intro (And.left hdr)
                    (fun (x : ratRep) (hx : close x a dr) =>
                      @Or.elim (ratLeRep x a) (ratLeRep a x)
                        (close (f x) (f a) eps)
                        (fun (hxa : ratLeRep x a) =>
                          @Or.elim (ratRel x a) (ratLtRep x a)
                            (close (f x) (f a) eps)
                            (fun (heq : ratRel x a) =>
                              close_of_ratRel (f x) (f a)
                                (hcong x heq) eps heps)
                            (fun (hlt : ratLtRep x a) =>
                              (And.right hdl) x hlt
                                (close_mono_eps x a dr dl hx hle))
                            (ratLeRep_eq_or_lt x a hxa))
                        (fun (hax : ratLeRep a x) =>
                          @Or.elim (ratRel a x) (ratLtRep a x)
                            (close (f x) (f a) eps)
                            (fun (heq : ratRel a x) =>
                              close_of_ratRel (f x) (f a)
                                (hcong x (ratRel_symm a x heq)) eps heps)
                            (fun (hlt : ratLtRep a x) =>
                              (And.right hdr) x hlt hx)
                            (ratLeRep_eq_or_lt a x hax))
                        (ratLeRep_total x a))))
              (fun (hle : ratLeRep dl dr) =>
                Exists.intro dl
                  (And.intro (And.left hdl)
                    (fun (x : ratRep) (hx : close x a dl) =>
                      @Or.elim (ratLeRep x a) (ratLeRep a x)
                        (close (f x) (f a) eps)
                        (fun (hxa : ratLeRep x a) =>
                          @Or.elim (ratRel x a) (ratLtRep x a)
                            (close (f x) (f a) eps)
                            (fun (heq : ratRel x a) =>
                              close_of_ratRel (f x) (f a)
                                (hcong x heq) eps heps)
                            (fun (hlt : ratLtRep x a) =>
                              (And.right hdl) x hlt hx)
                            (ratLeRep_eq_or_lt x a hxa))
                        (fun (hax : ratLeRep a x) =>
                          @Or.elim (ratRel a x) (ratLtRep a x)
                            (close (f x) (f a) eps)
                            (fun (heq : ratRel a x) =>
                              close_of_ratRel (f x) (f a)
                                (hcong x (ratRel_symm a x heq)) eps heps)
                            (fun (hlt : ratLtRep a x) =>
                              (And.right hdr) x hlt
                                (close_mono_eps x a dl dr hx hle))
                            (ratLeRep_eq_or_lt a x hax))
                        (ratLeRep_total x a))))
              (ratLeRep_total dr dl)))

hints.label: 思路

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `UniformlyContinuous f ↔ ∀ eps > 0, ∃ delta > 0, ∀ x y, close x y delta → close (f x) (f y) eps`。

hints.body: Iff.intro · 定义性展开。

exercises.template:
theorem uniformlyContinuous_iff (f : ratRep → ratRep) :
    UniformlyContinuous f ↔
      ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
        ∃ (delta : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
          ∀ (x y : ratRep), close x y delta → close (f x) (f y) eps :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem uniformlyContinuous_iff (f : ratRep → ratRep) :
    UniformlyContinuous f ↔
      ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
        ∃ (delta : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
          ∀ (x y : ratRep), close x y delta → close (f x) (f y) eps :=
  Iff.intro
    (fun (h : UniformlyContinuous f) => h)
    (fun (h : ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
        ∃ (delta : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
          ∀ (x y : ratRep), close x y delta → close (f x) (f y) eps) => h)

exercises.prompt: 复合封闭

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: ε 交给外层 g 得 δg，δg 交给内层 f 得 δf；对相距小于 δf 的 x、y，内层先给 `close (f x) (f y) δg`，外层再给 ε 的界。

hints.label: 目标形态

hints.label: 关键件

exercises.template:
theorem uniformlyContinuous_comp (f g : ratRep → ratRep)
    (hg : UniformlyContinuous g) (hf : UniformlyContinuous f) :
    UniformlyContinuous (fun (x : ratRep) => g (f x)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem uniformlyContinuous_comp (f g : ratRep → ratRep)
    (hg : UniformlyContinuous g) (hf : UniformlyContinuous f) :
    UniformlyContinuous (fun (x : ratRep) => g (f x)) :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (hg eps heps)
      (fun (deltaG : ratRep)
          (hdg : ratLtRep ratZeroRep deltaG ∧
            ∀ (y z : ratRep), close y z deltaG → close (g y) (g z) eps) =>
        Exists.elim (hf deltaG (And.left hdg))
          (fun (deltaF : ratRep)
              (hdf : ratLtRep ratZeroRep deltaF ∧
                ∀ (x y : ratRep), close x y deltaF →
                  close (f x) (f y) deltaG) =>
            Exists.intro deltaF
              (And.intro (And.left hdf)
                (fun (x y : ratRep) (hxy : close x y deltaF) =>
                  (And.right hdg) (f x) (f y)
                    ((And.right hdf) x y hxy)))))

exercises.unit: 单元131 一致连续与序列：Cauchy 序列的像
exercises.name: uniformlyContinuous_cauchy
exercises.title: 单元131 一致连续与序列：Cauchy 序列的像
exercises.prompt:
单元131 一致连续与序列：Cauchy 序列的像

Cauchy 序列的项彼此越来越近，却不一定知道它们往哪里去。要把这种「彼此 接近」推过函数，需要的那条半径不能依赖项的位置：逐点连续的 δ 随基点变， 项一走动就失效；一致连续的 δ 对整片定义域通用，于是可以直接把 Cauchy 条件里的 ε 换成 δ，再把函数逐项作用上去。

结论是：一致连续把 Cauchy 序列送到 Cauchy 序列。证明只有一次量词交换： 给定 ε，先向一致连续要 δ；这个 δ 交给原序列的 Cauchy 条件，换回一个 阈值 N；N 之后的任意两项都落在 δ 邻域里，于是它们的像落在 ε 界内。

收敛序列是同一件事的特例：极限点给出阈值，一致连续把「项靠近极限」 换成「像靠近 f L」。这两条合起来说明，一致连续不仅逐点连续，而且把 整条序列的渐近行为原样送过去；把平移用进来，就是一次具体核对。

边界：反方向（像总是 Cauchy 就断定原函数一致连续）要从每个失败的 δ 挑见证点列，课程库没有选择函数；这里只做正方向。不新增公理。

Cauchy 序列的像

给定 ε，一致连续给出 δ；原序列在 δ 处的 Cauchy 条件给出阈值 N。 N 之后的任意两项相距小于 δ，函数把它们送到 ε 界内。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先向一致连续要 δ，再把 δ 当半径交给原序列的 Cauchy 条件；阈值不变，逐项用一致连续的结论。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Cauchy (fun n => f (x n))`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: UniformlyContinuous 的展开 · Cauchy 的展开 · And.left / And.right。

exercises.template:

    (hf : UniformlyContinuous f) (x : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) :
    Cauchy (fun (n : Nat) => f (x n)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem uniformlyContinuous_cauchy (f : ratRep → ratRep)
    (hf : UniformlyContinuous f) (x : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) :
    Cauchy (fun (n : Nat) => f (x n)) :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (hf eps heps)
      (fun (delta : ratRep)
          (hd : ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
            ∀ (y z : ratRep), close y z delta → close (f y) (f z) eps) =>
        Exists.elim (hx delta (And.left hd))
          (fun (N : Nat)
              (hN : ∀ (n m : Nat), LeNat N n → LeNat N m →
                close (x n) (x m) delta) =>
            Exists.intro N
              (fun (n m : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) (hm : LeNat N m) =>
                (And.right hd) (x n) (x m) (hN n m hn hm))))

hints.label: 思路

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `LocallyBoundedPunct f a`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.elim · And.left / And.right · 两次 Exists.intro。

exercises.template:
theorem locallyBoundedPunct_of_locallyBoundedAt (f : ratRep → ratRep)
    (a : ratRep) (h : LocallyBoundedAt f a) : LocallyBoundedPunct f a :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem locallyBoundedPunct_of_locallyBoundedAt (f : ratRep → ratRep)
    (a : ratRep) (h : LocallyBoundedAt f a) : LocallyBoundedPunct f a :=
  Exists.elim h
    (fun (delta : ratRep)
        (hd : ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
          ∃ (B : ratRep), ratLeRep ratZeroRep B ∧
            ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a delta →
              ∃ (d : ratRep), ratAbsRel (f x) d ∧ ratLeRep d B) =>
      Exists.intro delta
        (And.intro (And.left hd)
          (Exists.elim (And.right hd)
            (fun (B : ratRep)
                (hB : ratLeRep ratZeroRep B ∧
                  ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a delta →
                    ∃ (d : ratRep), ratAbsRel (f x) d ∧ ratLeRep d B) =>
              Exists.intro B
                (And.intro (And.left hB)
                  (fun (x : ratRep) (hx : close x a delta)
                      (_hne : ¬ ratRel x a) =>
                    (And.right hB) x hx))))))

exercises.unit: 单元132 局部有界：极限给出的第一个盒子
exercises.name: locallyBoundedAt_of_continuousAt
exercises.title: 连续给出整邻域的盒子
exercises.prompt: 连续给出整邻域的盒子

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 取 ε = 1；连续给 δ 与 |f x - f a| < 1，再用三角不等式 |f x| ≤ |f x - f a| + |f a| ≤ 1 + |f a|，界取 |f a| 的见证加 1。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `LocallyBoundedAt f a`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratAbsRel_total · ratLeRep_abs_add · ratSubRep_add_self · ratLeRep_zero_add_nonneg · ratAbsRel_nonneg。

exercises.template:
theorem locallyBoundedAt_of_continuousAt (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a : ratRep)
    (hf : ContinuousAt f a) : LocallyBoundedAt f a :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem locallyBoundedAt_of_continuousAt (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a : ratRep)
    (hf : ContinuousAt f a) : LocallyBoundedAt f a :=
  Exists.elim (hf ratOneRep ratLtRep_zero_one)
    (fun (delta : ratRep)
        (hd : ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
          ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a delta → close (f x) (f a) ratOneRep) =>
      Exists.elim (ratAbsRel_total (f a))
        (fun (da : ratRep) (hda : ratAbsRel (f a) da) =>
          Exists.intro delta
            (And.intro (And.left hd)
              (Exists.intro (ratAddRep da ratOneRep)
                (And.intro
                  (ratLeRep_zero_add_nonneg da ratOneRep
                    (ratAbsRel_nonneg (f a) da hda)
                    (ratLtRep_le ratZeroRep ratOneRep ratLtRep_zero_one))
                  (fun (x : ratRep) (hx : close x a delta) =>
                    Exists.elim ((And.right hd) x hx)
                      (fun (d : ratRep)
                          (hd2 : ratAbsRel (ratSubRep (f x) (f a)) d ∧
                            ratLtRep d ratOneRep) =>
                        Exists.elim
                          (ratAbsRel_total
                            (ratAddRep (ratSubRep (f x) (f a)) (f a)))
                          (fun (dsum : ratRep)
                              (hsum : ratAbsRel
                                (ratAddRep (ratSubRep (f x) (f a)) (f a)) dsum) =>
                            Exists.intro dsum
                              (And.intro
                                (ratAbsRel_wd_left
                                  (ratAddRep (ratSubRep (f x) (f a)) (f a))
                                  (f x) dsum
                                  (ratSubRep_add_self (f x) (f a)) hsum)
                                (ratLeRep_trans dsum
                                  (ratAddRep d da)
                                  (ratAddRep da ratOneRep)
                                  (ratLeRep_abs_add (ratSubRep (f x) (f a))
                                    (f a) d da dsum (And.left hd2) hda hsum)
                                  (ratLeRep_trans (ratAddRep d da)
                                    (ratAddRep ratOneRep da)
                                    (ratAddRep da ratOneRep)
                                    (ratLeRep_add d ratOneRep da da
                                      (ratLtRep_le d ratOneRep (And.right hd2))
                                      (ratLeRep_refl da))
                                    (ratLeRep_of_ratRel (ratAddRep ratOneRep da)
                                      (ratAddRep da ratOneRep)
                                      (ratAdd_comm ratOneRep da)))))))))))))

hints.label: 思路

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `LocallyBoundedPunct f a`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratAbsRel_total · ratLeRep_abs_add · ratSubRep_add_self · ratLeRep_zero_add_nonneg。

exercises.template:
theorem locallyBoundedPunct_of_tendsToAt (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a L : ratRep)
    (hf : TendsToAt f a L) : LocallyBoundedPunct f a :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem locallyBoundedPunct_of_tendsToAt (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a L : ratRep)
    (hf : TendsToAt f a L) : LocallyBoundedPunct f a :=
  Exists.elim (hf ratOneRep ratLtRep_zero_one)
    (fun (delta : ratRep)
        (hd : ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
          ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a delta → ¬ ratRel x a →
            close (f x) L ratOneRep) =>
      Exists.elim (ratAbsRel_total L)
        (fun (dL : ratRep) (hdL : ratAbsRel L dL) =>
          Exists.intro delta
            (And.intro (And.left hd)
              (Exists.intro (ratAddRep dL ratOneRep)
                (And.intro
                  (ratLeRep_zero_add_nonneg dL ratOneRep
                    (ratAbsRel_nonneg L dL hdL)
                    (ratLtRep_le ratZeroRep ratOneRep ratLtRep_zero_one))
                  (fun (x : ratRep) (hx : close x a delta)
                      (hne : ¬ ratRel x a) =>
                    Exists.elim ((And.right hd) x hx hne)
                      (fun (d : ratRep)
                          (hd2 : ratAbsRel (ratSubRep (f x) L) d ∧
                            ratLtRep d ratOneRep) =>
                        Exists.elim
                          (ratAbsRel_total (ratAddRep (ratSubRep (f x) L) L))
                          (fun (dsum : ratRep)
                              (hsum : ratAbsRel
                                (ratAddRep (ratSubRep (f x) L) L) dsum) =>
                            Exists.intro dsum
                              (And.intro
                                (ratAbsRel_wd_left
                                  (ratAddRep (ratSubRep (f x) L) L)
                                  (f x) dsum
                                  (ratSubRep_add_self (f x) L) hsum)
                                (ratLeRep_trans dsum
                                  (ratAddRep d dL)
                                  (ratAddRep dL ratOneRep)
                                  (ratLeRep_abs_add (ratSubRep (f x) L) L
                                    d dL dsum (And.left hd2) hdL hsum)
                                  (ratLeRep_trans (ratAddRep d dL)
                                    (ratAddRep ratOneRep dL)
                                    (ratAddRep dL ratOneRep)
                                    (ratLeRep_add d ratOneRep dL dL
                                      (ratLtRep_le d ratOneRep (And.right hd2))
                                      (ratLeRep_refl dL))
                                    (ratLeRep_of_ratRel (ratAddRep ratOneRep dL)
                                      (ratAddRep dL ratOneRep)
                                      (ratAdd_comm ratOneRep dL)))))))))))))

exercises.prompt: 连续给出邻域里的正号

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 取 ε = f a；负侧严格界给出 f a - f x < f a，两边加 f x 得 f a < f a + f x，再把左端收回 f x。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `PositiveNear f a`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: close_neg_lt · ratLtRep_add_right · ratLtRep_congr_fst · ratLtRep_sub_pos · ratAdd_sub_self。

exercises.template:
theorem positiveNear_of_continuousAt (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a : ratRep)
    (hf : ContinuousAt f a) (h : ratLtRep ratZeroRep (f a)) :
    PositiveNear f a :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem positiveNear_of_continuousAt (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a : ratRep)
    (hf : ContinuousAt f a) (h : ratLtRep ratZeroRep (f a)) :
    PositiveNear f a :=
  Exists.elim (hf (f a) h)
    (fun (delta : ratRep)
        (hd : ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
          ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a delta → close (f x) (f a) (f a)) =>
      Exists.intro delta
        (And.intro (And.left hd)
          (fun (x : ratRep) (hx : close x a delta) =>
            ratLtRep_congr_snd ratZeroRep
              (ratSubRep (ratAddRep (f a) (f x)) (f a)) (f x)
              (ratLtRep_sub_pos (ratAddRep (f a) (f x)) (f a)
                (ratLtRep_congr_fst
                  (f a)
                  (ratAddRep (ratSubRep (f a) (f x)) (f x))
                  (ratAddRep (f a) (f x))
                  (ratLtRep_add_right (ratSubRep (f a) (f x)) (f a) (f x)
                    (close_neg_lt (f x) (f a) (f a) ((And.right hd) x hx)))
                  (ratRel_symm (ratAddRep (ratSubRep (f a) (f x)) (f x))
                    (f a) (ratSubRep_add_self (f a) (f x)))))
              (ratAdd_sub_self (f a) (f x)))))

exercises.prompt: 连续给出邻域里的负号

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 取 ε = -f a；这次走正侧 `ratAbsRel_le`，f x - f a < -f a，两边加 f a 后左端收回 f x、右端收成 0。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `∃ delta > 0, ∀ x, close x a delta → f x < 0`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLtRep_pos_of_neg · ratAbsRel_le · ratLtRep_add_right · ratAdd_neg_gen。

exercises.template:
theorem negativeNear_of_continuousAt (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a : ratRep)
    (hf : ContinuousAt f a) (h : ratLtRep (f a) ratZeroRep) :
    ∃ (delta : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
      ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a delta → ratLtRep (f x) ratZeroRep :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem negativeNear_of_continuousAt (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a : ratRep)
    (hf : ContinuousAt f a) (h : ratLtRep (f a) ratZeroRep) :
    ∃ (delta : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
      ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a delta → ratLtRep (f x) ratZeroRep :=
  Exists.elim (hf (ratNegRep (f a)) (ratLtRep_pos_of_neg (f a) h))
    (fun (delta : ratRep)
        (hd : ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
          ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a delta → close (f x) (f a) (ratNegRep (f a))) =>
      Exists.intro delta
        (And.intro (And.left hd)
          (fun (x : ratRep) (hx : close x a delta) =>
            ratLtRep_congr_snd (f x) (ratAddRep (ratNegRep (f a)) (f a))
              ratZeroRep
              (ratLtRep_congr_fst
                (f x)
                (ratAddRep (ratSubRep (f x) (f a)) (f a))
                (ratAddRep (ratNegRep (f a)) (f a))
                (ratLtRep_add_right (ratSubRep (f x) (f a)) (ratNegRep (f a)) (f a)
                  (Exists.elim ((And.right hd) x hx)
                    (fun (d : ratRep)
                        (hd2 : ratAbsRel (ratSubRep (f x) (f a)) d ∧
                          ratLtRep d (ratNegRep (f a))) =>
                      ratLtRep_of_le_lt (ratSubRep (f x) (f a)) d
                        (ratNegRep (f a))
                        (ratAbsRel_le (ratSubRep (f x) (f a)) d (And.left hd2))
                        (And.right hd2))))
                (ratRel_symm (ratAddRep (ratSubRep (f x) (f a)) (f a))
                  (f x) (ratSubRep_add_self (f x) (f a))))
              (ratRel_trans_gen (ratAddRep (ratNegRep (f a)) (f a))
                (ratAddRep (f a) (ratNegRep (f a))) ratZeroRep
                (ratAdd_comm (ratNegRep (f a)) (f a))
                (ratAdd_neg_gen (f a))))))

hints.body: `¬ f a ~ 0 → ∃ delta > 0, ∀ x, close x a delta → ¬ f x ~ 0`。

hints.label: 关键件

    (hf : ContinuousAt f a) (h : ¬ ratRel (f a) ratZeroRep) :

exercises.solution:
theorem neZeroNear_of_continuousAt (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a : ratRep)
    (hf : ContinuousAt f a) (h : ¬ ratRel (f a) ratZeroRep) :
    ∃ (delta : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
      ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a delta → ¬ ratRel (f x) ratZeroRep :=
  Or.elim
    (fun (h0 : ratLeRep ratZeroRep (f a)) =>
      Exists.elim
        (positiveNear_of_continuousAt f a hf
          (And.intro h0
            (fun (h0a : ratRel ratZeroRep (f a)) =>
              h (ratRel_symm ratZeroRep (f a) h0a))))
        (fun (delta : ratRep)
            (hd : ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
              ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a delta →
                ratLtRep ratZeroRep (f x)) =>
          Exists.intro delta
            (And.intro (And.left hd)
              (fun (x : ratRep) (hx : close x a delta) =>
                (fun (hx0 : ratRel (f x) ratZeroRep) =>
                  (ratLtRep_right ratZeroRep (f x) ((And.right hd) x hx))
                    (ratRel_symm (f x) ratZeroRep hx0))))))
    (fun (h0 : ratLeRep (f a) ratZeroRep) =>
      Exists.elim
        (negativeNear_of_continuousAt f a hf (And.intro h0 h))
        (fun (delta : ratRep)
            (hd : ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
              ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a delta →
                ratLtRep (f x) ratZeroRep) =>
          Exists.intro delta
            (And.intro (And.left hd)
              (fun (x : ratRep) (hx : close x a delta) =>
                (ratLtRep_right (f x) ratZeroRep ((And.right hd) x hx))))))
    (ratLeRep_total ratZeroRep (f a))

theorem maxOn_upperBound (f : ratRep → ratRep) (A : ratRep → Prop)
    (M : ratRep) (h : IsMaxOn f A M) :
    UpperBound ratRep ratLeRep (ImageOn f A) M :=

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 上界取上一条；最小性取最大值点 c，任何上界都要压住像里的 f c，而 f c 与 M 等价。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `IsSup ratRep ratLeRep (ImageOn f A) M`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: maxOn_upperBound · And.left h · ratRel_symm · ratLeRep_trans。

theorem maxOn_isSup (f : ratRep → ratRep) (A : ratRep → Prop)
    (M : ratRep) (h : IsMaxOn f A M) :
    IsSup ratRep ratLeRep (ImageOn f A) M :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem maxOn_isSup (f : ratRep → ratRep) (A : ratRep → Prop)
    (M : ratRep) (h : IsMaxOn f A M) :
    IsSup ratRep ratLeRep (ImageOn f A) M :=
  And.intro
    (maxOn_upperBound f A M h)
    (fun (C : ratRep) (hC : UpperBound ratRep ratLeRep (ImageOn f A) C) =>
      Exists.elim (And.left h)
        (fun (c : ratRep) (hc : A c ∧ ratRel (f c) M) =>
          ratLeRep_trans M (f c) C
            (ratLeRep_of_ratRel M (f c)
              (ratRel_symm (f c) M (And.right hc)))
            (hC (f c)

                (And.intro (And.left hc) (ratRel_refl (f c)))))))

    (∃ (M : ratRep), IsMaxOn f A M) ↔
      (∃ (M : ratRep), IsSup ratRep ratLeRep (ImageOn f A) M ∧
        (∃ (c : ratRep), A c ∧ ratRel (f c) M)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem maxOn_iff_isSup (f : ratRep → ratRep) (A : ratRep → Prop) :
    (∃ (M : ratRep), IsMaxOn f A M) ↔
      (∃ (M : ratRep), IsSup ratRep ratLeRep (ImageOn f A) M ∧
        (∃ (c : ratRep), A c ∧ ratRel (f c) M)) :=
  Iff.intro
    (exists_isSup_of_maxOn f A)
    (exists_maxOn_of_isSup f A)

exercises.unit: 单元134 闭区间上的最值：上确界与达到
exercises.name: maxValue_unique
exercises.title: 最大值的值唯一
exercises.prompt: 最大值的值唯一

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: M 压住 hM' 的见证点、M' 压住 hM 的见证点，两个方向各得一条弱序，再反对称。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `IsMaxOn f A M → IsMaxOn f A M' → M ~ M'`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: 两次 Exists.elim · ratRel_symm · ratLeRep_trans · ratLeRep_antisymm。

exercises.template:
theorem maxValue_unique (f : ratRep → ratRep) (A : ratRep → Prop)
    (M M' : ratRep) (hM : IsMaxOn f A M) (hM' : IsMaxOn f A M') :
    ratRel M M' :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem maxValue_unique (f : ratRep → ratRep) (A : ratRep → Prop)
    (M M' : ratRep) (hM : IsMaxOn f A M) (hM' : IsMaxOn f A M') :
    ratRel M M' :=
  Exists.elim (And.left hM)
    (fun (c : ratRep) (hc : A c ∧ ratRel (f c) M) =>
      Exists.elim (And.left hM')
        (fun (d : ratRep) (hd : A d ∧ ratRel (f d) M') =>
          ratLeRep_antisymm M M'
            (ratLeRep_trans M (f c) M'
              (ratLeRep_of_ratRel M (f c)
                (ratRel_symm (f c) M (And.right hc)))
              ((And.right hM') c (And.left hc)))
            (ratLeRep_trans M' (f d) M
              (ratLeRep_of_ratRel M' (f d)
                (ratRel_symm (f d) M' (And.right hd)))
              ((And.right hM) d (And.left hd)))))

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `AttainsMaxOn f (InClosed a b)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.intro · And.intro · ratLeRep_refl · inClosed_right · h。

exercises.template:
theorem attMax_of_monotone (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b : ratRep)
    (hab : ratLeRep a b) (h : NondecreasingOn f a b) :

theorem attMax_of_monotone (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b : ratRep)
    (hab : ratLeRep a b) (h : NondecreasingOn f a b) :

    (And.intro (And.intro hab (ratLeRep_refl b))

hints.label: 目标形态

hints.body: Exists.intro · ratLeRep_refl · inClosed_left · h。

exercises.template:
theorem attMin_of_monotone (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b : ratRep)
    (hab : ratLeRep a b) (h : NondecreasingOn f a b) :
    ∃ (c : ratRep), InClosed a b c ∧
      ∀ (x : ratRep), InClosed a b x → ratLeRep (f c) (f x) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem attMin_of_monotone (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b : ratRep)
    (hab : ratLeRep a b) (h : NondecreasingOn f a b) :
    ∃ (c : ratRep), InClosed a b c ∧
      ∀ (x : ratRep), InClosed a b x → ratLeRep (f c) (f x) :=
  Exists.intro a
    (And.intro (And.intro (ratLeRep_refl a) hab)

        h a x (And.intro (ratLeRep_refl a) hab) hx

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLtRep_add_right · ratLtRep_congr_snd · ratAdd_comm · ratLtRep_of_le_lt · ratAdd_zero_left。

exercises.template:

exercises.solution:
theorem ratLtRep_self_add_pos (x h : ratRep) (hh : ratLtRep ratZeroRep h) :
    ratLtRep x (ratAddRep x h) :=
  ratLtRep_of_le_lt x (ratAddRep ratZeroRep x) (ratAddRep x h)
    (ratLeRep_of_ratRel x (ratAddRep ratZeroRep x)
      (ratRel_symm (ratAddRep ratZeroRep x) x (ratAdd_zero_left x)))
    (ratLtRep_congr_snd (ratAddRep ratZeroRep x) (ratAddRep h x)

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 半数 < b-c，两边同加 c；把 (b-c)+c 收回 b，再把 h+c 交换成 c+h，左端用弱序接上交换。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratHalf_lt_self · ratLtRep_add_right · ratSubRep_add_self · ratAdd_comm · ratLeRep_of_ratRel · ratLtRep_of_le_lt。

exercises.template:
theorem add_mid_lt_right (b c : ratRep) (h : ratLtRep c b) :
    ratLtRep (ratAddRep c (ratHalf (ratSubRep b c))) b :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem add_mid_lt_right (b c : ratRep) (h : ratLtRep c b) :
    ratLtRep (ratAddRep c (ratHalf (ratSubRep b c))) b :=
  ratLtRep_of_le_lt
    (ratAddRep c (ratHalf (ratSubRep b c)))
    (ratAddRep (ratHalf (ratSubRep b c)) c)
    b
    (ratLeRep_of_ratRel (ratAddRep c (ratHalf (ratSubRep b c)))
      (ratAddRep (ratHalf (ratSubRep b c)) c)
      (ratAdd_comm c (ratHalf (ratSubRep b c))))
    (ratLtRep_congr_snd
      (ratAddRep (ratHalf (ratSubRep b c)) c)
      (ratAddRep (ratSubRep b c) c)
      b
      (ratLtRep_add_right (ratHalf (ratSubRep b c)) (ratSubRep b c) c
        (ratHalf_lt_self (ratSubRep b c) (ratLtRep_sub_pos b c h)))
      (ratSubRep_add_self b c))

exercises.name: not_attMax_id_open
exercises.title: not_attMax_id_open

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 假设有最大值点 c，取 x = c + (1-c)/2：它比 c 大（`lt_add_mid`）且仍在 (0,1)（`add_mid_lt_right` 与传递），与 c 压住所有值矛盾。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `¬ AttainsMaxOn (fun x => x) (fun x => 0 < x ∧ x < 1)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.elim · lt_add_mid · add_mid_lt_right · ratLeRep_antisymm · ratLtRep_right。

exercises.template:
theorem not_attMax_id_open :
    ¬ AttainsMaxOn (fun (x : ratRep) => x)
      (fun (x : ratRep) => ratLtRep ratZeroRep x ∧ ratLtRep x ratOneRep) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem not_attMax_id_open :
    ¬ AttainsMaxOn (fun (x : ratRep) => x)
      (fun (x : ratRep) => ratLtRep ratZeroRep x ∧ ratLtRep x ratOneRep) :=
  fun (h : AttainsMaxOn (fun (x : ratRep) => x)
      (fun (x : ratRep) => ratLtRep ratZeroRep x ∧ ratLtRep x ratOneRep)) =>
    Exists.elim h
      (fun (c : ratRep)
          (hc : (ratLtRep ratZeroRep c ∧ ratLtRep c ratOneRep) ∧
            ∀ (x : ratRep),
              (ratLtRep ratZeroRep x ∧ ratLtRep x ratOneRep) →
                ratLeRep x c) =>
        ratLtRep_right c
          (ratAddRep c (ratHalf (ratSubRep ratOneRep c)))
          (lt_add_mid ratOneRep c (And.right (And.left hc)))
          (ratRel_symm
            (ratAddRep c (ratHalf (ratSubRep ratOneRep c))) c
            (ratLeRep_antisymm
              (ratAddRep c (ratHalf (ratSubRep ratOneRep c))) c
              ((And.right hc)
                (ratAddRep c (ratHalf (ratSubRep ratOneRep c)))
                (And.intro
                  (ratLtRep_trans ratZeroRep c
                    (ratAddRep c (ratHalf (ratSubRep ratOneRep c)))
                    (And.left (And.left hc))
                    (lt_add_mid ratOneRep c (And.right (And.left hc))))
                  (add_mid_lt_right ratOneRep c (And.right (And.left hc)))))
              (ratLtRep_le c
                (ratAddRep c (ratHalf (ratSubRep ratOneRep c)))
                (lt_add_mid ratOneRep c (And.right (And.left hc)))))))
