exercises.name: close_add_right
exercises.title: 从 m 向右迈一步仍在 delta 邻域里
exercises.prompt: 从 m 向右迈一步仍在 delta 邻域里

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 落脚点取 `m + d`；距离 `(m + d) - m` 与 d 等价，绝对值见证取 d，剩下只要 d < eps。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `0 < d → d < eps → close (m + d) m eps`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.intro · Or.inl · ratLtRep_sub_pos · ratAdd_sub_self。

exercises.template:
theorem close_add_right (m d eps : ratRep) (hd : ratLtRep ratZeroRep d)
    (hde : ratLtRep d eps) : close (ratAddRep m d) m eps :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem close_add_right (m d eps : ratRep) (hd : ratLtRep ratZeroRep d)
    (hde : ratLtRep d eps) : close (ratAddRep m d) m eps :=
  Exists.intro d
    (And.intro
      (Or.inl
        (And.intro
          (ratLtRep_le ratZeroRep (ratSubRep (ratAddRep m d) m)
            (ratLtRep_sub_pos (ratAddRep m d) m
              (ratLtRep_self_add_pos m d hd)))
          (ratRel_symm (ratSubRep (ratAddRep m d) m) d
            (ratAdd_sub_self m d))))
      hde)

exercises.unit: 单元135 最后一个负点：保号性把负点往右推一步
exercises.name: half_sub_lt_delta
exercises.title: half_sub_lt_delta

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `(b-m)/2 < b-m`（半数小于自身）；`b-m ≤ delta/2` 由 hble 减 m 得到；再 `delta/2 < delta`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `m < b → b ≤ m + delta/2 → 0 < delta → (b-m)/2 < delta`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratHalf_lt_self · ratLtRep_sub_pos · ratLeRep_sub_right · ratAdd_sub_self · ratLtRep_of_le_lt · ratLtRep_trans。

exercises.template:
theorem half_sub_lt_delta (b m delta : ratRep) (hmb : ratLtRep m b)
    (hble : ratLeRep b (ratAddRep m (ratHalf delta)))
    (hdelta : ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta) :
    ratLtRep (ratHalf (ratSubRep b m)) delta :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem half_sub_lt_delta (b m delta : ratRep) (hmb : ratLtRep m b)
    (hble : ratLeRep b (ratAddRep m (ratHalf delta)))
    (hdelta : ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta) :
    ratLtRep (ratHalf (ratSubRep b m)) delta :=
  ratLtRep_trans (ratHalf (ratSubRep b m)) (ratSubRep b m) delta
    (ratHalf_lt_self (ratSubRep b m) (ratLtRep_sub_pos b m hmb))
    (ratLtRep_of_le_lt (ratSubRep b m) (ratHalf delta) delta
      (ratLeRep_trans (ratSubRep b m)
        (ratSubRep (ratAddRep m (ratHalf delta)) m) (ratHalf delta)
        (ratLeRep_sub_right b (ratAddRep m (ratHalf delta)) m hble)
        (ratLeRep_of_ratRel
          (ratSubRep (ratAddRep m (ratHalf delta)) m) (ratHalf delta)
          (ratAdd_sub_self m (ratHalf delta))))
      (ratHalf_lt_self delta hdelta))

exercises.unit: 单元135 最后一个负点：保号性把负点往右推一步
exercises.name: exists_negative_right
exercises.title: 保号性把负点往右推一步
exercises.prompt: 保号性把负点往右推一步

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先用 `negativeNear_of_continuousAt` 取保号半径 delta；分 `m + delta/2 ≤ b` 与 `b ≤ m + delta/2` 两支，各自用 `close_add_right` 与中点构造落脚点。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: negativeNear_of_continuousAt · ratLeRep_total · close_add_right · lt_add_mid · add_mid_lt_right · half_sub_lt_delta。

exercises.template:
theorem exists_negative_right (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b m : ratRep)
    (hmem : InClosed a b m) (hmb : ratLtRep m b)
    (hf : ContinuousAt f m) (hneg : ratLtRep (f m) ratZeroRep) :
    ∃ (y : ratRep), InClosed a b y ∧ ratLtRep m y ∧
      ratLtRep (f y) ratZeroRep :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem exists_negative_right (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b m : ratRep)
    (hmem : InClosed a b m) (hmb : ratLtRep m b)
    (hf : ContinuousAt f m) (hneg : ratLtRep (f m) ratZeroRep) :
    ∃ (y : ratRep), InClosed a b y ∧ ratLtRep m y ∧
      ratLtRep (f y) ratZeroRep :=
  Exists.elim (negativeNear_of_continuousAt f m hf hneg)
    (fun (delta : ratRep)
        (hd : ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
          ∀ (x : ratRep), close x m delta →
            ratLtRep (f x) ratZeroRep) =>
      Or.elim
        (fun (hle : ratLeRep (ratAddRep m (ratHalf delta)) b) =>
          Exists.intro (ratAddRep m (ratHalf delta))
            (And.intro
              (And.intro
                (ratLeRep_trans a m (ratAddRep m (ratHalf delta))
                  (inClosed_left a b m hmem)
                  (ratLtRep_le m (ratAddRep m (ratHalf delta))
                    (ratLtRep_self_add_pos m (ratHalf delta)
                      (ratLtRep_half delta (And.left hd)))))
                hle)
              (And.intro
                (ratLtRep_self_add_pos m (ratHalf delta)
                  (ratLtRep_half delta (And.left hd)))
                ((fun (x : ratRep) (hx : close x m delta) =>
                    (And.right hd) x hx)
                  (ratAddRep m (ratHalf delta))
                  (close_add_right m (ratHalf delta) delta
                    (ratLtRep_half delta (And.left hd))
                    (ratHalf_lt_self delta (And.left hd)))))))
        (fun (hble : ratLeRep b (ratAddRep m (ratHalf delta))) =>
          Exists.intro (ratAddRep m (ratHalf (ratSubRep b m)))
            (And.intro
              (And.intro
                (ratLeRep_trans a m (ratAddRep m (ratHalf (ratSubRep b m)))
                  (inClosed_left a b m hmem)
                  (ratLtRep_le m (ratAddRep m (ratHalf (ratSubRep b m)))
                    (lt_add_mid b m hmb)))
                (ratLtRep_le (ratAddRep m (ratHalf (ratSubRep b m))) b
                  (add_mid_lt_right b m hmb)))
              (And.intro
                (lt_add_mid b m hmb)
                ((fun (x : ratRep) (hx : close x m delta) =>
                    (And.right hd) x hx)
                  (ratAddRep m (ratHalf (ratSubRep b m)))
                  (close_add_right m (ratHalf (ratSubRep b m)) delta
                    (ratLtRep_half (ratSubRep b m)
                      (ratLtRep_sub_pos b m hmb))
                    (half_sub_lt_delta b m delta hmb hble (And.left hd)))))))
        (ratLeRep_total (ratAddRep m (ratHalf delta)) b))

exercises.unit: 单元135 最后一个负点：保号性把负点往右推一步
exercises.name: no_greatest_negative_at
exercises.title: 严格负点集没有最大元
exercises.prompt: 严格负点集没有最大元

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 上一条给出更靠右的严格负点 y；它属于集合，最大性给 y ≤ m，与 m < y 反对称冲突。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `HasGreatest (NegativePoints f a b) m → m < b → ContinuousAt f m → False`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: exists_negative_right · hasGreatest_upper · negativePoints_mem/value · ratLeRep_antisymm · ratLtRep_right。

exercises.template:
theorem no_greatest_negative_at (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b m : ratRep)
    (hgreat : HasGreatest (NegativePoints f a b) m)
    (hmb : ratLtRep m b) (hf : ContinuousAt f m) : False :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem no_greatest_negative_at (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b m : ratRep)
    (hgreat : HasGreatest (NegativePoints f a b) m)
    (hmb : ratLtRep m b) (hf : ContinuousAt f m) : False :=
  @Exists.elim ratRep
    (fun (y : ratRep) => InClosed a b y ∧ ratLtRep m y ∧
      ratLtRep (f y) ratZeroRep)
    False
    (exists_negative_right f a b m
      (negativePoints_mem f a b m
        (hasGreatest_mem (NegativePoints f a b) m hgreat))
      hmb hf
      (negativePoints_value f a b m
        (hasGreatest_mem (NegativePoints f a b) m hgreat)))
    (fun (y : ratRep)
        (hy : InClosed a b y ∧ ratLtRep m y ∧
          ratLtRep (f y) ratZeroRep) =>
      ratLtRep_right m y (And.left (And.right hy))
        (ratRel_symm y m
          (ratLeRep_antisymm y m
            (hasGreatest_upper (NegativePoints f a b) m hgreat y
              (And.intro (And.left hy) (And.right (And.right hy))))
            (ratLtRep_le m y (And.left (And.right hy))))))

exercises.unit: 单元135 最后一个负点：保号性把负点往右推一步
exercises.name: no_last_negative
exercises.title: 打包：严格负点集根本没有最大元
exercises.prompt: 打包：严格负点集根本没有最大元

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 反设取出 m 与它的最大性、以及 m < b；连续性由 hcont m 配 m 的区间成员得到，再交给上一条。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `¬ ∃ m, HasGreatest (NegativePoints f a b) m ∧ m < b`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.elim · no_greatest_negative_at · negativePoints_mem · hasGreatest_mem。

exercises.template:
theorem no_last_negative (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b : ratRep)
    (hcont : ∀ (x : ratRep), InClosed a b x → ContinuousAt f x) :
    ¬ (∃ (m : ratRep), HasGreatest (NegativePoints f a b) m ∧
      ratLtRep m b) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem no_last_negative (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b : ratRep)
    (hcont : ∀ (x : ratRep), InClosed a b x → ContinuousAt f x) :
    ¬ (∃ (m : ratRep), HasGreatest (NegativePoints f a b) m ∧
      ratLtRep m b) :=
  fun (h : ∃ (m : ratRep), HasGreatest (NegativePoints f a b) m ∧
      ratLtRep m b) =>
    @Exists.elim ratRep
      (fun (m : ratRep) => HasGreatest (NegativePoints f a b) m ∧
        ratLtRep m b)
      False h
      (fun (m : ratRep)
          (hm : HasGreatest (NegativePoints f a b) m ∧ ratLtRep m b) =>
        no_greatest_negative_at f a b m (And.left hm) (And.right hm)
          (hcont m
            (negativePoints_mem f a b m
              (hasGreatest_mem (NegativePoints f a b) m (And.left hm)))))

exercises.unit: 单元136 介值定理：最后一个非正点
exercises.name: nonpositivePoints_iff
exercises.title: 定义的展开形式与投影
exercises.prompt: 定义的展开形式与投影

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 定义展开后就是同一个合取，两个方向都直接返回假设。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `NonpositivePoints f a b x ↔ InClosed a b x ∧ f x ≤ 0`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Iff.intro。

exercises.template:
theorem nonpositivePoints_iff (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b x : ratRep) :
    NonpositivePoints f a b x ↔ InClosed a b x ∧ ratLeRep (f x) ratZeroRep :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem nonpositivePoints_iff (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b x : ratRep) :
    NonpositivePoints f a b x ↔ InClosed a b x ∧ ratLeRep (f x) ratZeroRep :=
  Iff.intro
    (fun (h : NonpositivePoints f a b x) => h)
    (fun (h : InClosed a b x ∧ ratLeRep (f x) ratZeroRep) => h)

exercises.unit: 单元136 介值定理：最后一个非正点
exercises.name: nonpositive_of_negative
exercises.title: nonpositive_of_negative

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 区间成员原样搬；严格负用 `ratLtRep_le` 弱化成非正。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `NegativePoints f a b x → NonpositivePoints f a b x`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: And.intro · ratLtRep_le。

exercises.template:
theorem nonpositive_of_negative (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b x : ratRep)
    (h : NegativePoints f a b x) : NonpositivePoints f a b x :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem nonpositive_of_negative (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b x : ratRep)
    (h : NegativePoints f a b x) : NonpositivePoints f a b x :=
  And.intro (And.left h)
    (ratLtRep_le (f x) ratZeroRep (And.right h))

exercises.unit: 单元136 介值定理：最后一个非正点
exercises.name: nonpositivePoints_mem
exercises.title: nonpositivePoints_mem

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先沿 `nonpositivePoints_iff` 展开成合取，再取第一分量。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `NonpositivePoints f a b x → InClosed a b x`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Iff.mp · And.left。

exercises.template:
theorem nonpositivePoints_mem (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b x : ratRep)
    (h : NonpositivePoints f a b x) : InClosed a b x :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem nonpositivePoints_mem (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b x : ratRep)
    (h : NonpositivePoints f a b x) : InClosed a b x :=
  And.left (Iff.mp (nonpositivePoints_iff f a b x) h)

exercises.unit: 单元136 介值定理：最后一个非正点
exercises.name: nonpositivePoints_value
exercises.title: nonpositivePoints_value

exercises.title: hasGreatest_nonpositive_mem

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `HasGreatest (NonpositivePoints f a b) m → InClosed a b m`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: hasGreatest_mem · nonpositivePoints_mem。

theorem hasGreatest_nonpositive_mem (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b m : ratRep)

    (hasGreatest_mem (NonpositivePoints f a b) m h)

exercises.unit: 单元136 介值定理：最后一个非正点
exercises.name: not_rel_left_of_negative
exercises.title: 端点不在切点上
exercises.prompt: 端点不在切点上

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 若 a ~ m，则 f a ~ f m ~ 0；用传递性把 f a ~ 0 交给 `f a < 0` 的第二分量。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: hwf · ratRel_trans_gen · ratLtRep_right。

exercises.template:
theorem not_rel_left_of_negative (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a m : ratRep)
    (hwf : RespectsRel f) (hfa : ratLtRep (f a) ratZeroRep)
    (hzero : ratRel (f m) ratZeroRep) : ¬ ratRel a m :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem not_rel_left_of_negative (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a m : ratRep)
    (hwf : RespectsRel f) (hfa : ratLtRep (f a) ratZeroRep)
    (hzero : ratRel (f m) ratZeroRep) : ¬ ratRel a m :=
  fun (h : ratRel a m) =>
    ratLtRep_right (f a) ratZeroRep hfa
      (ratRel_trans_gen (f a) (f m) ratZeroRep
        (hwf a m h) hzero)

exercises.unit: 单元136 介值定理：最后一个非正点
exercises.name: not_rel_right_of_positive
exercises.title: not_rel_right_of_positive

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 若 m ~ b，则 f m ~ f b；由 0 < f b 得 0 < f m，再与 f m ≤ 0 夹出 0 < 0。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: hwf · ratLtRep_congr_snd · ratLtRep_of_lt_le · ratLtRep_right · ratRel_refl。

exercises.template:
theorem not_rel_right_of_positive (f : ratRep → ratRep) (b m : ratRep)
    (hwf : RespectsRel f) (hfb : ratLtRep ratZeroRep (f b))
    (hle : ratLeRep (f m) ratZeroRep) : ¬ ratRel m b :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem not_rel_right_of_positive (f : ratRep → ratRep) (b m : ratRep)
    (hwf : RespectsRel f) (hfb : ratLtRep ratZeroRep (f b))
    (hle : ratLeRep (f m) ratZeroRep) : ¬ ratRel m b :=
  fun (h : ratRel m b) =>
    ratLtRep_right ratZeroRep ratZeroRep
      (ratLtRep_of_lt_le ratZeroRep (f m) ratZeroRep
        (ratLtRep_congr_snd ratZeroRep (f b) (f m) hfb
          (ratRel_symm (f m) (f b) (hwf m b h)))
        hle)
      (ratRel_refl ratZeroRep)

exercises.unit: 单元136 介值定理：最后一个非正点
exercises.name: zero_of_greatest_nonpositive
exercises.title: 非正点集的最大元是零点
exercises.prompt: 非正点集的最大元是零点

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `f m ≤ 0` 分「等于零」与「严格小于零」两支。后一支把 m 看成严格负点集的最大元（严格负都非正），交给库里的 `no_greatest_negative_at`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `HasGreatest 非正点集 m → m < b → ContinuousAt f m → f m ~ 0`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLeRep_eq_or_lt · no_greatest_negative_at · nonpositive_of_negative · hasGreatest_upper。

exercises.template:
theorem zero_of_greatest_nonpositive (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b m : ratRep)
    (hgreat : HasGreatest (NonpositivePoints f a b) m)
    (hmb : ratLtRep m b) (hf : ContinuousAt f m) :
    ratRel (f m) ratZeroRep :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem zero_of_greatest_nonpositive (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b m : ratRep)
    (hgreat : HasGreatest (NonpositivePoints f a b) m)
    (hmb : ratLtRep m b) (hf : ContinuousAt f m) :
    ratRel (f m) ratZeroRep :=
  Or.elim
    (fun (heq : ratRel (f m) ratZeroRep) => heq)
    (fun (hlt : ratLtRep (f m) ratZeroRep) =>
      False.elim
        (no_greatest_negative_at f a b m
          (And.intro
            (And.intro
              (hasGreatest_nonpositive_mem f a b m hgreat)
              hlt)
            (fun (x : ratRep) (hx : NegativePoints f a b x) =>
              hasGreatest_upper (NonpositivePoints f a b) m hgreat x
                (nonpositive_of_negative f a b x hx)))
          hmb hf))
    (ratLeRep_eq_or_lt (f m) ratZeroRep
      (hasGreatest_nonpositive_value f a b m hgreat))

exercises.unit: 单元136 介值定理：最后一个非正点
exercises.name: interior_of_zero
exercises.title: 介值定理：零点落在区间内部
exercises.prompt: 介值定理：零点落在区间内部

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 见证取 m；区间成员来自最大元，a < m 由 `not_rel_left_of_negative` 排除左端点，m < b 直接是前提。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.intro · hasGreatest_upper · not_rel_left_of_negative · nonpositive_of_negative。

exercises.template:
theorem interior_of_zero (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b m : ratRep)
    (hwf : RespectsRel f)
    (hfa : ratLtRep (f a) ratZeroRep)
    (hgreat : HasGreatest (NonpositivePoints f a b) m)
    (hzero : ratRel (f m) ratZeroRep)
    (hmb : ratLtRep m b) :
    ∃ (c : ratRep), InClosed a b c ∧ ratLtRep a c ∧ ratLtRep c b ∧
      ratRel (f c) ratZeroRep :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem interior_of_zero (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b m : ratRep)
    (hwf : RespectsRel f)
    (hfa : ratLtRep (f a) ratZeroRep)
    (hgreat : HasGreatest (NonpositivePoints f a b) m)
    (hzero : ratRel (f m) ratZeroRep)
    (hmb : ratLtRep m b) :
    ∃ (c : ratRep), InClosed a b c ∧ ratLtRep a c ∧ ratLtRep c b ∧
      ratRel (f c) ratZeroRep :=
  Exists.intro m
    (And.intro
      (hasGreatest_nonpositive_mem f a b m hgreat)
      (And.intro
        (And.intro
          (hasGreatest_upper (NonpositivePoints f a b) m hgreat a
            (And.intro
              (And.intro
                (ratLeRep_refl a)
                (ratLeRep_trans a m b
                  (inClosed_left a b m
                    (hasGreatest_nonpositive_mem f a b m hgreat))
                  (inClosed_right a b m
                    (hasGreatest_nonpositive_mem f a b m hgreat))))
              (ratLtRep_le (f a) ratZeroRep hfa)))
          (not_rel_left_of_negative f a m hwf hfa hzero))
        (And.intro hmb hzero)))

exercises.name: ivt_of_greatest_nonpositive
exercises.title: ivt_of_greatest_nonpositive

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先由 `not_rel_right_of_positive` 排除 m ~ b，得到 m < b；再用 `zero_of_greatest_nonpositive` 得零点；最后交给 `interior_of_zero`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `连续 + f a < 0 < f b + 最大元 → ∃ 内部零点`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: not_rel_right_of_positive · zero_of_greatest_nonpositive · interior_of_zero · hasGreatest_nonpositive_mem/value。

exercises.template:
theorem ivt_of_greatest_nonpositive (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b m : ratRep)
    (hcont : ∀ (x : ratRep), InClosed a b x → ContinuousAt f x)
    (hwf : RespectsRel f)
    (hfa : ratLtRep (f a) ratZeroRep)
    (hfb : ratLtRep ratZeroRep (f b))
    (hgreat : HasGreatest (NonpositivePoints f a b) m) :
    ∃ (c : ratRep), InClosed a b c ∧ ratLtRep a c ∧ ratLtRep c b ∧
      ratRel (f c) ratZeroRep :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ivt_of_greatest_nonpositive (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b m : ratRep)
    (hcont : ∀ (x : ratRep), InClosed a b x → ContinuousAt f x)
    (hwf : RespectsRel f)
    (hfa : ratLtRep (f a) ratZeroRep)
    (hfb : ratLtRep ratZeroRep (f b))
    (hgreat : HasGreatest (NonpositivePoints f a b) m) :
    ∃ (c : ratRep), InClosed a b c ∧ ratLtRep a c ∧ ratLtRep c b ∧
      ratRel (f c) ratZeroRep :=
  interior_of_zero f a b m hwf hfa hgreat
    (zero_of_greatest_nonpositive f a b m hgreat
      (And.intro
        (inClosed_right a b m
          (hasGreatest_nonpositive_mem f a b m hgreat))
        (not_rel_right_of_positive f b m hwf hfb
          (hasGreatest_nonpositive_value f a b m hgreat)))
      (hcont m (hasGreatest_nonpositive_mem f a b m hgreat)))
    (And.intro
      (inClosed_right a b m
        (hasGreatest_nonpositive_mem f a b m hgreat))
      (not_rel_right_of_positive f b m hwf hfb
        (hasGreatest_nonpositive_value f a b m hgreat)))

exercises.prompt: 和律要把两条分界线并成一条。全性只给「a ≤ b 或 b ≤ a」两支；两支 各自挑较大的那个当 M，另一条弱序由传递性补上。

hints.label: 思路

hints.body: `∃ M, ratLeRep a M ∧ ratLeRep b M`。

hints.label: 关键件

exercises.template:
theorem exists_ge_both (a b : ratRep) :
    ∃ (M : ratRep), ratLeRep a M ∧ ratLeRep b M :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem exists_ge_both (a b : ratRep) :
    ∃ (M : ratRep), ratLeRep a M ∧ ratLeRep b M :=
  Or.elim
    (fun (hab : ratLeRep a b) =>
      Exists.intro b (And.intro hab (ratLeRep_refl b)))
    (fun (hba : ratLeRep b a) =>
      Exists.intro a (And.intro (ratLeRep_refl a) hba))

exercises.name: tendsToAtInfinity_shift
exercises.title: 若 f 在 M 之后靠近 L，那么 x + c 在 M - c 之后靠近 L。分界线往前挪 一个 c：`x ≥ M - c` 两边加 c，左端用 `(M - c) + c ~ M` 收回。
exercises.prompt: 若 f 在 M 之后靠近 L，那么 x + c 在 M - c 之后靠近 L。分界线往前挪 一个 c：`x ≥ M - c` 两边加 c，左端用 `(M - c) + c ~ M` 收回。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 给定 ε，向 f 的极限要 M；新分界线取 M - c，两边加 c 后用 `(M - c) + c ~ M` 搬回。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `TendsToAtInfinity (fun x => f (x + c)) L`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratSubRep_add_self · ratLeRep_add_right · ratLeRep_congr_gen。

exercises.template:
theorem tendsToAtInfinity_shift (f : ratRep → ratRep) (c L : ratRep)
    (h : TendsToAtInfinity f L) :
    TendsToAtInfinity (fun (x : ratRep) => f (ratAddRep x c)) L :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem tendsToAtInfinity_shift (f : ratRep → ratRep) (c L : ratRep)
    (h : TendsToAtInfinity f L) :
    TendsToAtInfinity (fun (x : ratRep) => f (ratAddRep x c)) L :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (h eps heps)
      (fun (M : ratRep)
          (hM : ∀ (x : ratRep), ratLeRep M x → close (f x) L eps) =>
        Exists.intro (ratSubRep M c)
          (fun (x : ratRep) (hx : ratLeRep (ratSubRep M c) x) =>
            hM (ratAddRep x c)
              (ratLeRep_congr_gen
                (ratAddRep (ratSubRep M c) c) M
                (ratAddRep x c) (ratAddRep x c)
                (ratSubRep_add_self M c)
                (ratRel_refl (ratAddRep x c))
                (ratLeRep_add_right (ratSubRep M c) x c hx))))

exercises.unit: 单元137 无穷远处的极限：越过分界线之后靠近 L
exercises.name: tendsToAtInfinity_congr
exercises.title: 两个阈值 Mf 与 M0 用 `exists_ge_both` 并成 M；越过 M 的点同时越过两者， 于是 f x 与 g x 相等，`close` 沿这个等式搬到 g 那一边。
exercises.prompt: 两个阈值 Mf 与 M0 用 `exists_ge_both` 并成 M；越过 M 的点同时越过两者， 于是 f x 与 g x 相等，`close` 沿这个等式搬到 g 那一边。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把 f 的分界线与「从 M0 起相等」的分界线并成一条 M；越过 M 的点同时越过两条，逐点用 `close_wd_left` 搬运。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `TendsToAtInfinity f L → (∀ x, M0 ≤ x → f x ~ g x) → TendsToAtInfinity g L`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: exists_ge_both · ratLeRep_trans · close_wd_left · Exists.elim。

exercises.template:
theorem tendsToAtInfinity_congr (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (L M0 : ratRep)
    (h : ∀ (x : ratRep), ratLeRep M0 x → ratRel (f x) (g x))
    (hf : TendsToAtInfinity f L) :
    TendsToAtInfinity g L :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem tendsToAtInfinity_congr (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (L M0 : ratRep)
    (h : ∀ (x : ratRep), ratLeRep M0 x → ratRel (f x) (g x))
    (hf : TendsToAtInfinity f L) :
    TendsToAtInfinity g L :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (hf eps heps)
      (fun (Mf : ratRep)
          (hMf : ∀ (x : ratRep), ratLeRep Mf x → close (f x) L eps) =>
        @Exists.elim ratRep
          (fun (M : ratRep) => ratLeRep Mf M ∧ ratLeRep M0 M)
          (∃ (M : ratRep), ∀ (x : ratRep), ratLeRep M x →
            close (g x) L eps)
          (exists_ge_both Mf M0)
          (fun (M : ratRep) (hM : ratLeRep Mf M ∧ ratLeRep M0 M) =>
            Exists.intro M
              (fun (x : ratRep) (hx : ratLeRep M x) =>
                close_wd_left (f x) (g x) L eps
                  (h x (ratLeRep_trans M0 M x (And.right hM) hx))
                  (hMf x (ratLeRep_trans Mf M x (And.left hM) hx)))))

exercises.unit: 单元137 无穷远处的极限：越过分界线之后靠近 L
exercises.name: close_lt_add_right
exercises.title: 恒等函数的反例要用到：`close x L ε` 说明 x 不可能达到 L + ε。 把接近性翻向，负侧给出 `x - L < ε`；两边加 L，左端用 `(x - L) + L ~ x` 收回，右端交换成 L + ε。
exercises.prompt: 恒等函数的反例要用到：`close x L ε` 说明 x 不可能达到 L + ε。 把接近性翻向，负侧给出 `x - L < ε`；两边加 L，左端用 `(x - L) + L ~ x` 收回，右端交换成 L + ε。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先 `close_symm`，再用 `close_neg_lt` 得 `x - L < ε`；两边加 L，左端用 `(x - L) + L ~ x` 收回，右端用交换律。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `close x L ε → x < L + ε`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: close_symm · close_neg_lt · ratLtRep_add_right · ratSubRep_add_self · ratAdd_comm。

exercises.template:
theorem close_lt_add_right (x L eps : ratRep) (h : close x L eps) :
    ratLtRep x (ratAddRep L eps) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem close_lt_add_right (x L eps : ratRep) (h : close x L eps) :
    ratLtRep x (ratAddRep L eps) :=
  ratLtRep_congr_snd x
    (ratAddRep eps L)
    (ratAddRep L eps)
    (ratLtRep_congr_fst x
      (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x L) L)
      (ratAddRep eps L)
      (ratLtRep_add_right (ratSubRep x L) eps L
        (close_neg_lt L x eps (close_symm x L eps h)))
      (ratRel_symm (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x L) L) x
        (ratSubRep_add_self x L)))
    (ratAdd_comm eps L)

exercises.unit: 单元137 无穷远处的极限：越过分界线之后靠近 L
exercises.name: not_tendsToAtInfinity_id
exercises.title: 反证：若恒等函数在无穷远处靠近 L，取 ε = 1，分界线 M。再取一个同时 越过 M 与 L + 1 的 x。上一条给出 x < L + 1，而 x ≥ L + 1，两条序相撞。
exercises.prompt: 反证：若恒等函数在无穷远处靠近 L，取 ε = 1，分界线 M。再取一个同时 越过 M 与 L + 1 的 x。上一条给出 x < L + 1，而 x ≥ L + 1，两条序相撞。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 反证。取 ε = 1 得 M，再用 `exists_ge_both` 取同时越过 M 与 L + 1 的 x；上一条给 x < L + 1，与 x ≥ L + 1 夹出矛盾。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `¬ TendsToAtInfinity (fun x => x) L`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: exists_ge_both · close_lt_add_right · ratLeRep_antisymm · ratLtRep_right。

exercises.template:
theorem not_tendsToAtInfinity_id (L : ratRep) :
    ¬ TendsToAtInfinity (fun (x : ratRep) => x) L :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem not_tendsToAtInfinity_id (L : ratRep) :
    ¬ TendsToAtInfinity (fun (x : ratRep) => x) L :=
  fun (h : TendsToAtInfinity (fun (x : ratRep) => x) L) =>
    @Exists.elim ratRep
      (fun (M : ratRep) => ∀ (x : ratRep), ratLeRep M x →
        close x L ratOneRep)
      False
      (h ratOneRep ratLtRep_zero_one)
      (fun (M : ratRep)
          (hM : ∀ (x : ratRep), ratLeRep M x → close x L ratOneRep) =>
        @Exists.elim ratRep
          (fun (x : ratRep) => ratLeRep M x ∧
            ratLeRep (ratAddRep L ratOneRep) x)
          False
          (exists_ge_both M (ratAddRep L ratOneRep))
          (fun (x : ratRep)
              (hx : ratLeRep M x ∧ ratLeRep (ratAddRep L ratOneRep) x) =>
            ratLtRep_right x (ratAddRep L ratOneRep)
              (close_lt_add_right x L ratOneRep (hM x (And.left hx)))
              (ratRel_symm (ratAddRep L ratOneRep) x
                (ratLeRep_antisymm (ratAddRep L ratOneRep) x
                  (And.right hx)
                  (ratLtRep_le x (ratAddRep L ratOneRep)
                    (close_lt_add_right x L ratOneRep
                      (hM x (And.left hx))))))))

exercises.unit: 单元138 无穷远处极限的代数与序列判据
exercises.name: tendsToAtInfinity_add
exercises.title: 两个 ε/2 的界分别由 f 与 g 给出；两条分界线并成 K，越过 K 的点同时 越过两条原线。`close_add` 把两个一半的误差合成 ε。
exercises.prompt: 两个 ε/2 的界分别由 f 与 g 给出；两条分界线并成 K，越过 K 的点同时 越过两条原线。`close_add` 把两个一半的误差合成 ε。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 ε 取半数，分别向 f、g 的极限要分界线；用 `exists_ge_both` 并成 K，越过 K 的点同时越过两条原线，最后 `close_add` 合成。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `TendsToAtInfinity f L → TendsToAtInfinity g M → TendsToAtInfinity (fun x => f x + g x) (L + M)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLtRep_half · exists_ge_both · ratLeRep_trans · close_add。

exercises.template:
theorem tendsToAtInfinity_add (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (L M : ratRep)
    (hf : TendsToAtInfinity f L) (hg : TendsToAtInfinity g M) :
    TendsToAtInfinity (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) (g x))
      (ratAddRep L M) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem tendsToAtInfinity_add (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (L M : ratRep)
    (hf : TendsToAtInfinity f L) (hg : TendsToAtInfinity g M) :
    TendsToAtInfinity (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) (g x))
      (ratAddRep L M) :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    @Exists.elim ratRep
      (fun (Mf : ratRep) => ∀ (x : ratRep), ratLeRep Mf x →
        close (f x) L (ratHalf eps))
      (∃ (K : ratRep), ∀ (x : ratRep), ratLeRep K x →
        close (ratAddRep (f x) (g x)) (ratAddRep L M) eps)
      (hf (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
      (fun (Mf : ratRep)
          (hMf : ∀ (x : ratRep), ratLeRep Mf x →
            close (f x) L (ratHalf eps)) =>
        @Exists.elim ratRep
          (fun (Mg : ratRep) => ∀ (x : ratRep), ratLeRep Mg x →
            close (g x) M (ratHalf eps))
          (∃ (K : ratRep), ∀ (x : ratRep), ratLeRep K x →
            close (ratAddRep (f x) (g x)) (ratAddRep L M) eps)
          (hg (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
          (fun (Mg : ratRep)
              (hMg : ∀ (x : ratRep), ratLeRep Mg x →
                close (g x) M (ratHalf eps)) =>
            @Exists.elim ratRep
              (fun (K : ratRep) => ratLeRep Mf K ∧ ratLeRep Mg K)
              (∃ (K : ratRep), ∀ (x : ratRep), ratLeRep K x →
                close (ratAddRep (f x) (g x)) (ratAddRep L M) eps)
              (exists_ge_both Mf Mg)
              (fun (K : ratRep)
                  (hK : ratLeRep Mf K ∧ ratLeRep Mg K) =>
                Exists.intro K
                  (fun (x : ratRep) (hx : ratLeRep K x) =>
                    close_add (f x) L (g x) M eps
                      (hMf x (ratLeRep_trans Mf K x (And.left hK) hx))
                      (hMg x (ratLeRep_trans Mg K x (And.right hK) hx))))))

hints.body: 把 `f - g` 读成 `f + (-g)`，先对 g 用取负律，再交给和律。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `TendsToAtInfinity (fun x => f x - g x) (L - M)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: tendsToAtInfinity_add · tendsToAtInfinity_neg。

exercises.template:
theorem tendsToAtInfinity_sub (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (L M : ratRep)
    (hf : TendsToAtInfinity f L) (hg : TendsToAtInfinity g M) :
    TendsToAtInfinity (fun (x : ratRep) => ratSubRep (f x) (g x))
      (ratSubRep L M) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem tendsToAtInfinity_sub (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (L M : ratRep)
    (hf : TendsToAtInfinity f L) (hg : TendsToAtInfinity g M) :
    TendsToAtInfinity (fun (x : ratRep) => ratSubRep (f x) (g x))
      (ratSubRep L M) :=
  tendsToAtInfinity_add f (fun (x : ratRep) => ratNegRep (g x)) L
    (ratNegRep M) hf (tendsToAtInfinity_neg g M hg)

exercises.unit: 单元138 无穷远处极限的代数与序列判据
exercises.name: tendsToAtInfinity_comp
exercises.title: 给定 ε，f 的极限给出一条分界线 M；序列的假设对同一条 M 给出阈值 N。 N 之后每个 x n 都越过 M，于是 f (x n) 落在 ε 界内。
exercises.prompt: 给定 ε，f 的极限给出一条分界线 M；序列的假设对同一条 M 给出阈值 N。 N 之后每个 x n 都越过 M，于是 f (x n) 落在 ε 界内。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 给定 ε 得 M；把 M 交给序列假设得阈值 N；N 之后逐项用 f 的极限。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `TendsToAtInfinity f L → TendsToInfinity x → Converges (fun n => f (x n)) L`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: TendsToInfinity 的展开 · Converges 的展开 · Exists.elim。

exercises.template:
theorem tendsToAtInfinity_comp (f : ratRep → ratRep) (L : ratRep)
    (x : Seq) (hf : TendsToAtInfinity f L) (hx : TendsToInfinity x) :
    Converges (fun (n : Nat) => f (x n)) L :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem tendsToAtInfinity_comp (f : ratRep → ratRep) (L : ratRep)
    (x : Seq) (hf : TendsToAtInfinity f L) (hx : TendsToInfinity x) :
    Converges (fun (n : Nat) => f (x n)) L :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    @Exists.elim ratRep
      (fun (M : ratRep) => ∀ (y : ratRep), ratLeRep M y →
        close (f y) L eps)
      (∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n → close (f (x n)) L eps)
      (hf eps heps)
      (fun (M : ratRep)
          (hM : ∀ (y : ratRep), ratLeRep M y → close (f y) L eps) =>
        @Exists.elim Nat
          (fun (N : Nat) => ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n → ratLeRep M (x n))
          (∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n → close (f (x n)) L eps)
          (hx M)
          (fun (N : Nat)
              (hN : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n → ratLeRep M (x n)) =>
            Exists.intro N
              (fun (n : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) =>
                hM (x n) (hN n hn))))

exercises.template:
theorem demo_comp_add_const (f : ratRep → ratRep) (c L : ratRep) (x : Seq)
    (hf : TendsToAtInfinity f L) (hx : TendsToInfinity x) :
    Converges (fun (n : Nat) => ratAddRep (f (x n)) c)

exercises.solution:
theorem demo_comp_add_const (f : ratRep → ratRep) (c L : ratRep) (x : Seq)

exercises.unit: 单元139 单调函数：介值性反过来给出连续
exercises.name: strictlyIncreasing_injective
exercises.title: 严格递增把不同的点推开：f x 与 f y 等价时，x 与 y 必须等价。证明按序的 全性分左右两支；每支再用「弱序或者相等、或者严格小」拆开，严格小的那一支 与已知的等价直接冲突。
exercises.prompt: 严格递增把不同的点推开：f x 与 f y 等价时，x 与 y 必须等价。证明按序的 全性分左右两支；每支再用「弱序或者相等、或者严格小」拆开，严格小的那一支 与已知的等价直接冲突。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 `ratLeRep_total x y` 分两支；每支用 `ratLeRep_eq_or_lt` 拆成相等或严格小，严格小的一支把 `hf` 给出的严格不等式与 `h` 摆在一起，用 `ratLtRep_right` 收尾。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `StrictlyIncreasing f → ratRel (f x) (f y) → ratRel x y`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLeRep_total · ratLeRep_eq_or_lt · ratLtRep_right · False.elim · ratRel_symm。

exercises.template:
theorem strictlyIncreasing_injective (f : ratRep → ratRep)
    (hf : StrictlyIncreasing f) (x y : ratRep) (h : ratRel (f x) (f y)) :
    ratRel x y :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem strictlyIncreasing_injective (f : ratRep → ratRep)
    (hf : StrictlyIncreasing f) (x y : ratRep) (h : ratRel (f x) (f y)) :
    ratRel x y :=
  @Or.elim (ratLeRep x y) (ratLeRep y x) (ratRel x y)
    (fun (hxy : ratLeRep x y) =>
      @Or.elim (ratRel x y) (ratLtRep x y) (ratRel x y)
        (fun (heq : ratRel x y) => heq)
        (fun (hlt : ratLtRep x y) =>
          False.elim (ratLtRep_right (f x) (f y) (hf x y hlt) h))
        (ratLeRep_eq_or_lt x y hxy))
    (fun (hyx : ratLeRep y x) =>
      @Or.elim (ratRel y x) (ratLtRep y x) (ratRel x y)
        (fun (heq : ratRel y x) => ratRel_symm y x heq)
        (fun (hlt : ratLtRep y x) =>
          False.elim (ratLtRep_right (f y) (f x) (hf y x hlt)
            (ratRel_symm (f x) (f y) h)))
        (ratLeRep_eq_or_lt y x hyx))
    (ratLeRep_total x y)

exercises.unit: 单元139 单调函数：介值性反过来给出连续
exercises.name: right_bound_flat
exercises.title: 右端点的值已经在阈值以下时，右端点本身就是分界点：区间里任何 x ≤ b 都有 f x ≤ f b ≤ f c + h。
exercises.prompt: 右端点的值已经在阈值以下时，右端点本身就是分界点：区间里任何 x ≤ b 都有 f x ≤ f b ≤ f c + h。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 取 u = b；对 x ≤ b 用单调性把 f x 压到 f b 之下，再接上 `f b ≤ f c + h`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `∃ u, c < u ∧ u ≤ b ∧ ∀ x ∈ [a,b], c ≤ x → x ≤ u → f x ≤ f c + h`，取 u = b。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.intro · And.intro · ratLeRep_trans · ratLeRep_refl · `NondecreasingOn` 的展开。

exercises.template:
theorem right_bound_flat (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b c h : ratRep)
    (hmono : NondecreasingOn f a b)
    (hac : ratLtRep a c) (hcb : ratLtRep c b)
    (hfb : ratLeRep (f b) (ratAddRep (f c) h)) :
    ∃ (u : ratRep), ratLtRep c u ∧ ratLeRep u b ∧
      ∀ (x : ratRep), InClosed a b x → ratLeRep c x → ratLeRep x u →
        ratLeRep (f x) (ratAddRep (f c) h) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem right_bound_flat (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b c h : ratRep)
    (hmono : NondecreasingOn f a b)
    (hac : ratLtRep a c) (hcb : ratLtRep c b)
    (hfb : ratLeRep (f b) (ratAddRep (f c) h)) :
    ∃ (u : ratRep), ratLtRep c u ∧ ratLeRep u b ∧
      ∀ (x : ratRep), InClosed a b x → ratLeRep c x → ratLeRep x u →
        ratLeRep (f x) (ratAddRep (f c) h) :=
  Exists.intro b
    (And.intro hcb
      (And.intro (ratLeRep_refl b)
        (fun (x : ratRep) (hIn : InClosed a b x) (_hcx : ratLeRep c x)
            (hxb : ratLeRep x b) =>
          ratLeRep_trans (f x) (f b) (ratAddRep (f c) h)
            (hmono x b hIn
              (And.intro
                (ratLtRep_le a b (ratLtRep_trans a c b hac hcb))
                (ratLeRep_refl b))
              hxb)
            hfb)))

exercises.unit: 单元139 单调函数：介值性反过来给出连续
exercises.name: right_bound_of_lt
exercises.title: 右端点的值超过阈值时，介值性在 c 与 b 之间给出一个点 u，它的值恰好是 阈值。u 严格在 c 的右边（阈值严格大于 f c），也严格在 b 的左边（阈值 严格小于 f b），于是 c 到 u 之间的函数值都被阈值压住。
exercises.prompt: 右端点的值超过阈值时，介值性在 c 与 b 之间给出一个点 u，它的值恰好是 阈值。u 严格在 c 的右边（阈值严格大于 f c），也严格在 b 的左边（阈值 严格小于 f b），于是 c 到 u 之间的函数值都被阈值压住。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把 x = c、y = b、v = f c + h 交给介值性；它给出 c < u < b 且 f u ~ f c + h，再对 x ≤ u 用单调性。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: 与 `right_bound_flat` 相同的存在句。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: hivp · ratLtRep_self_add_pos · ratLtRep_le · ratLeRep_of_ratRel · ratLeRep_trans。

exercises.template:
theorem right_bound_of_lt (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b c h : ratRep)
    (hmono : NondecreasingOn f a b)
    (hivp : HasIntermediateValue f a b)
    (hac : ratLtRep a c) (hcb : ratLtRep c b)
    (hh : ratLtRep ratZeroRep h)
    (hlt : ratLtRep (ratAddRep (f c) h) (f b)) :
    ∃ (u : ratRep), ratLtRep c u ∧ ratLeRep u b ∧
      ∀ (x : ratRep), InClosed a b x → ratLeRep c x → ratLeRep x u →
        ratLeRep (f x) (ratAddRep (f c) h) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem right_bound_of_lt (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b c h : ratRep)
    (hmono : NondecreasingOn f a b)
    (hivp : HasIntermediateValue f a b)
    (hac : ratLtRep a c) (hcb : ratLtRep c b)
    (hh : ratLtRep ratZeroRep h)
    (hlt : ratLtRep (ratAddRep (f c) h) (f b)) :
    ∃ (u : ratRep), ratLtRep c u ∧ ratLeRep u b ∧
      ∀ (x : ratRep), InClosed a b x → ratLeRep c x → ratLeRep x u →
        ratLeRep (f x) (ratAddRep (f c) h) :=
  @Exists.elim ratRep
    (fun (v : ratRep) => ratLtRep c v ∧ ratLtRep v b ∧
      ratRel (f v) (ratAddRep (f c) h))
    (∃ (u : ratRep), ratLtRep c u ∧ ratLeRep u b ∧
      ∀ (x : ratRep), InClosed a b x → ratLeRep c x → ratLeRep x u →
        ratLeRep (f x) (ratAddRep (f c) h))
    (hivp c b
      (And.intro (ratLtRep_le a c hac) (ratLtRep_le c b hcb))
      (And.intro (ratLtRep_le a b (ratLtRep_trans a c b hac hcb))
        (ratLeRep_refl b))
      hcb (ratAddRep (f c) h)
      (ratLtRep_self_add_pos (f c) h hh) hlt)
    (fun (u : ratRep)
        (hu : ratLtRep c u ∧ ratLtRep u b ∧
          ratRel (f u) (ratAddRep (f c) h)) =>
      Exists.intro u
        (And.intro (And.left hu)
          (And.intro (ratLtRep_le u b (And.left (And.right hu)))
            (fun (x : ratRep) (hIn : InClosed a b x) (hcx : ratLeRep c x)
                (hxu : ratLeRep x u) =>
              ratLeRep_trans (f x) (f u) (ratAddRep (f c) h)
                (hmono x u hIn
                  (And.intro
                    (ratLeRep_trans a c u (ratLtRep_le a c hac)
                      (ratLtRep_le c u (And.left hu)))
                    (ratLtRep_le u b (And.left (And.right hu))))
                  hxu)
                (ratLeRep_of_ratRel (f u) (ratAddRep (f c) h)
                  (And.right (And.right hu)))))))

exercises.unit: 单元139 单调函数：介值性反过来给出连续
exercises.name: exists_right_bound
exercises.title: 两支接起来。按 f b 与 f c + h 的序分；第二支里还要用「弱序或者相等、 或者严格小」把相等的边界并入平的那一支。
exercises.prompt: 两支接起来。按 f b 与 f c + h 的序分；第二支里还要用「弱序或者相等、 或者严格小」把相等的边界并入平的那一支。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 `ratLeRep (f b) (f c + h)` 分两支；第二支再用 `ratLeRep_eq_or_lt` 拆相等或严格小，相等交给 `right_bound_flat`，严格小交给 `right_bound_of_lt`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: 与 `right_bound_flat` 相同的存在句。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLeRep_total · ratLeRep_eq_or_lt · ratLeRep_of_ratRel · ratRel_symm。

exercises.template:
theorem exists_right_bound (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b c h : ratRep)
    (hmono : NondecreasingOn f a b)
    (hivp : HasIntermediateValue f a b)
    (hac : ratLtRep a c) (hcb : ratLtRep c b)
    (hh : ratLtRep ratZeroRep h) :
    ∃ (u : ratRep), ratLtRep c u ∧ ratLeRep u b ∧
      ∀ (x : ratRep), InClosed a b x → ratLeRep c x → ratLeRep x u →
        ratLeRep (f x) (ratAddRep (f c) h) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem exists_right_bound (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b c h : ratRep)
    (hmono : NondecreasingOn f a b)
    (hivp : HasIntermediateValue f a b)
    (hac : ratLtRep a c) (hcb : ratLtRep c b)
    (hh : ratLtRep ratZeroRep h) :
    ∃ (u : ratRep), ratLtRep c u ∧ ratLeRep u b ∧
      ∀ (x : ratRep), InClosed a b x → ratLeRep c x → ratLeRep x u →
        ratLeRep (f x) (ratAddRep (f c) h) :=
  @Or.elim (ratLeRep (f b) (ratAddRep (f c) h))
    (ratLeRep (ratAddRep (f c) h) (f b))
    (∃ (u : ratRep), ratLtRep c u ∧ ratLeRep u b ∧
      ∀ (x : ratRep), InClosed a b x → ratLeRep c x → ratLeRep x u →
        ratLeRep (f x) (ratAddRep (f c) h))
    (fun (hle : ratLeRep (f b) (ratAddRep (f c) h)) =>
      right_bound_flat f a b c h hmono hac hcb hle)
    (fun (hge : ratLeRep (ratAddRep (f c) h) (f b)) =>
      @Or.elim (ratRel (ratAddRep (f c) h) (f b))
        (ratLtRep (ratAddRep (f c) h) (f b))
        (∃ (u : ratRep), ratLtRep c u ∧ ratLeRep u b ∧
          ∀ (x : ratRep), InClosed a b x → ratLeRep c x → ratLeRep x u →
            ratLeRep (f x) (ratAddRep (f c) h))
        (fun (heq : ratRel (ratAddRep (f c) h) (f b)) =>
          right_bound_flat f a b c h hmono hac hcb
            (ratLeRep_of_ratRel (f b) (ratAddRep (f c) h)
              (ratRel_symm (ratAddRep (f c) h) (f b) heq)))
        (fun (hlt : ratLtRep (ratAddRep (f c) h) (f b)) =>
          right_bound_of_lt f a b c h hmono hivp hac hcb hh hlt)
        (ratLeRep_eq_or_lt (ratAddRep (f c) h) (f b) hge))
    (ratLeRep_total (f b) (ratAddRep (f c) h))

exercises.unit: 单元139 单调函数：介值性反过来给出连续
exercises.name: left_bound_flat
exercises.title: 左端点已经在阈值以上时，取 l = a：区间里 x ≥ a 有 f x ≥ f a ≥ f c - h， 于是 f c ≤ f x + h。
exercises.prompt: 左端点已经在阈值以上时，取 l = a：区间里 x ≥ a 有 f x ≥ f a ≥ f c - h， 于是 f c ≤ f x + h。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 取 l = a；对 x ≥ a 用单调性把 f a 抬到 f x 之下，再用 `le_add_of_sub_le` 把 f c - h ≤ f x 换成 f c ≤ h + f x，最后交换加数。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `∃ l, l < c ∧ a ≤ l ∧ ∀ x ∈ [a,b], l ≤ x → x ≤ c → f c ≤ f x + h`，取 l = a。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.intro · le_add_of_sub_le · ratAdd_comm · ratLeRep_congr_gen。

exercises.template:
theorem left_bound_flat (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b c h : ratRep)
    (hmono : NondecreasingOn f a b)
    (hac : ratLtRep a c) (hcb : ratLtRep c b)
    (hfa : ratLeRep (ratSubRep (f c) h) (f a)) :
    ∃ (l : ratRep), ratLtRep l c ∧ ratLeRep a l ∧
      ∀ (x : ratRep), InClosed a b x → ratLeRep l x → ratLeRep x c →
        ratLeRep (f c) (ratAddRep (f x) h) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem left_bound_flat (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b c h : ratRep)
    (hmono : NondecreasingOn f a b)
    (hac : ratLtRep a c) (hcb : ratLtRep c b)
    (hfa : ratLeRep (ratSubRep (f c) h) (f a)) :
    ∃ (l : ratRep), ratLtRep l c ∧ ratLeRep a l ∧
      ∀ (x : ratRep), InClosed a b x → ratLeRep l x → ratLeRep x c →
        ratLeRep (f c) (ratAddRep (f x) h) :=
  Exists.intro a
    (And.intro hac
      (And.intro (ratLeRep_refl a)
        (fun (x : ratRep) (hIn : InClosed a b x) (hax : ratLeRep a x)
            (hxc : ratLeRep x c) =>
          ratLeRep_congr_gen (f c) (f c)
            (ratAddRep h (f x)) (ratAddRep (f x) h)
            (ratRel_refl (f c)) (ratAdd_comm h (f x))
            (le_add_of_sub_le (f c) h (f x)
              (ratLeRep_trans (ratSubRep (f c) h) (f a) (f x) hfa
                (hmono a x
                  (And.intro (ratLeRep_refl a)
                    (ratLeRep_trans a c b (ratLtRep_le a c hac)
                      (ratLtRep_le c b hcb)))
                  hIn hax))))))

exercises.unit: 单元139 单调函数：介值性反过来给出连续
exercises.name: left_bound_of_lt
exercises.title: 左端点的值低于阈值时，介值性在 a 与 c 之间给出 l，它的值恰好是阈值。 l 严格在 a 的右边、严格在 c 的左边（阈值严格小于 f c），于是 l 到 c 之间的函数值都在阈值以上。
exercises.prompt: 左端点的值低于阈值时，介值性在 a 与 c 之间给出 l，它的值恰好是阈值。 l 严格在 a 的右边、严格在 c 的左边（阈值严格小于 f c），于是 l 到 c 之间的函数值都在阈值以上。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把 x = a、y = c、v = f c - h 交给介值性；它给出 a < l < c 且 f l ~ f c - h，再对 x ≥ l 用单调性得到 f l ≤ f x。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: 与 `left_bound_flat` 相同的存在句。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: hivp · ratLtRep_self_sub_pos · ratLtRep_le · ratLeRep_of_ratRel · le_add_of_sub_le。

exercises.template:
theorem left_bound_of_lt (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b c h : ratRep)
    (hmono : NondecreasingOn f a b)
    (hivp : HasIntermediateValue f a b)
    (hac : ratLtRep a c) (hcb : ratLtRep c b)
    (hh : ratLtRep ratZeroRep h)
    (hlt : ratLtRep (f a) (ratSubRep (f c) h)) :
    ∃ (l : ratRep), ratLtRep l c ∧ ratLeRep a l ∧
      ∀ (x : ratRep), InClosed a b x → ratLeRep l x → ratLeRep x c →
        ratLeRep (f c) (ratAddRep (f x) h) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem left_bound_of_lt (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b c h : ratRep)
    (hmono : NondecreasingOn f a b)
    (hivp : HasIntermediateValue f a b)
    (hac : ratLtRep a c) (hcb : ratLtRep c b)
    (hh : ratLtRep ratZeroRep h)
    (hlt : ratLtRep (f a) (ratSubRep (f c) h)) :
    ∃ (l : ratRep), ratLtRep l c ∧ ratLeRep a l ∧
      ∀ (x : ratRep), InClosed a b x → ratLeRep l x → ratLeRep x c →
        ratLeRep (f c) (ratAddRep (f x) h) :=
  @Exists.elim ratRep
    (fun (v : ratRep) => ratLtRep a v ∧ ratLtRep v c ∧
      ratRel (f v) (ratSubRep (f c) h))
    (∃ (l : ratRep), ratLtRep l c ∧ ratLeRep a l ∧
      ∀ (x : ratRep), InClosed a b x → ratLeRep l x → ratLeRep x c →
        ratLeRep (f c) (ratAddRep (f x) h))
    (hivp a c
      (And.intro (ratLeRep_refl a)
        (ratLtRep_le a b (ratLtRep_trans a c b hac hcb)))
      (And.intro (ratLtRep_le a c hac) (ratLtRep_le c b hcb))
      hac (ratSubRep (f c) h) hlt (ratLtRep_self_sub_pos (f c) h hh))
    (fun (l : ratRep)
        (hl : ratLtRep a l ∧ ratLtRep l c ∧
          ratRel (f l) (ratSubRep (f c) h)) =>
      Exists.intro l
        (And.intro (And.left (And.right hl))
          (And.intro (ratLtRep_le a l (And.left hl))
            (fun (x : ratRep) (hIn : InClosed a b x) (hlx : ratLeRep l x)
                (hxc : ratLeRep x c) =>
              ratLeRep_congr_gen (f c) (f c)
                (ratAddRep h (f x)) (ratAddRep (f x) h)
                (ratRel_refl (f c)) (ratAdd_comm h (f x))
                (le_add_of_sub_le (f c) h (f x)
                  (ratLeRep_trans (ratSubRep (f c) h) (f l) (f x)
                    (ratLeRep_of_ratRel (ratSubRep (f c) h) (f l)
                      (ratRel_symm (f l) (ratSubRep (f c) h)
                        (And.right (And.right hl))))
                    (hmono l x
                      (And.intro (ratLtRep_le a l (And.left hl))
                        (ratLeRep_trans l c b
                          (ratLtRep_le l c (And.left (And.right hl)))
                          (ratLtRep_le c b hcb)))
                      hIn hlx)))))))

exercises.unit: 单元139 单调函数：介值性反过来给出连续
exercises.name: exists_left_bound
exercises.title: 与右边对称地把两支接起来。
exercises.prompt: 与右边对称地把两支接起来。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 `ratLeRep (f c - h) (f a)` 分两支；第二支再用 `ratLeRep_eq_or_lt` 拆相等或严格小。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: 与 `left_bound_flat` 相同的存在句。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLeRep_total · ratLeRep_eq_or_lt · ratLeRep_of_ratRel · ratRel_symm。

exercises.template:
theorem exists_left_bound (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b c h : ratRep)
    (hmono : NondecreasingOn f a b)
    (hivp : HasIntermediateValue f a b)
    (hac : ratLtRep a c) (hcb : ratLtRep c b)
    (hh : ratLtRep ratZeroRep h) :
    ∃ (l : ratRep), ratLtRep l c ∧ ratLeRep a l ∧
      ∀ (x : ratRep), InClosed a b x → ratLeRep l x → ratLeRep x c →
        ratLeRep (f c) (ratAddRep (f x) h) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem exists_left_bound (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b c h : ratRep)
    (hmono : NondecreasingOn f a b)
    (hivp : HasIntermediateValue f a b)
    (hac : ratLtRep a c) (hcb : ratLtRep c b)
    (hh : ratLtRep ratZeroRep h) :
    ∃ (l : ratRep), ratLtRep l c ∧ ratLeRep a l ∧
      ∀ (x : ratRep), InClosed a b x → ratLeRep l x → ratLeRep x c →
        ratLeRep (f c) (ratAddRep (f x) h) :=
  @Or.elim (ratLeRep (ratSubRep (f c) h) (f a))
    (ratLeRep (f a) (ratSubRep (f c) h))
    (∃ (l : ratRep), ratLtRep l c ∧ ratLeRep a l ∧
      ∀ (x : ratRep), InClosed a b x → ratLeRep l x → ratLeRep x c →
        ratLeRep (f c) (ratAddRep (f x) h))
    (fun (hfa : ratLeRep (ratSubRep (f c) h) (f a)) =>
      left_bound_flat f a b c h hmono hac hcb hfa)
    (fun (haf : ratLeRep (f a) (ratSubRep (f c) h)) =>
      @Or.elim (ratRel (f a) (ratSubRep (f c) h))
        (ratLtRep (f a) (ratSubRep (f c) h))
        (∃ (l : ratRep), ratLtRep l c ∧ ratLeRep a l ∧
          ∀ (x : ratRep), InClosed a b x → ratLeRep l x → ratLeRep x c →
            ratLeRep (f c) (ratAddRep (f x) h))
        (fun (heq : ratRel (f a) (ratSubRep (f c) h)) =>
          left_bound_flat f a b c h hmono hac hcb
            (ratLeRep_of_ratRel (ratSubRep (f c) h) (f a)
              (ratRel_symm (f a) (ratSubRep (f c) h) heq)))
        (fun (hlt : ratLtRep (f a) (ratSubRep (f c) h)) =>
          left_bound_of_lt f a b c h hmono hivp hac hcb hh hlt)
        (ratLeRep_eq_or_lt (f a) (ratSubRep (f c) h) haf))
    (ratLeRep_total (ratSubRep (f c) h) (f a))

exercises.name: right_close_of_delta
exercises.title: 右半邻域上的收口：x 在 c 的右边、且 |x - c| < δ ≤ u - c 时，x 落在 [c, u] 里，于是 f c ≤ f x ≤ f c + h < f c + eps。
exercises.prompt: 右半邻域上的收口：x 在 c 的右边、且 |x - c| < δ ≤ u - c 时，x 落在 [c, u] 里，于是 f c ≤ f x ≤ f c + h < f c + eps。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 从 `close_two_bounds` 取出 x - c ≤ δ，用 `le_add_of_sub_le` 得 x ≤ c + δ，再经 δ ≤ u - c 把右边认成 u；最后交给 `close_of_le_ub`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `close x c δ → c ≤ x → close (f x) (f c) eps`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: close_two_bounds · le_add_of_sub_le · ratLeRep_add_left · ratSubRep_add_self · close_of_le_ub。

exercises.template:
theorem right_close_of_delta (f : ratRep → ratRep)
    (a b c u h eps delta : ratRep)
    (hmono : NondecreasingOn f a b)
    (hac : ratLtRep a c) (hcb : ratLtRep c b)
    (hub : ratLeRep u b)
    (hbound : ∀ (x : ratRep), InClosed a b x → ratLeRep c x →
      ratLeRep x u → ratLeRep (f x) (ratAddRep (f c) h))
    (hdu : ratLeRep delta (ratSubRep u c))
    (hhe : ratLtRep h eps)
    (x : ratRep) (hx : close x c delta) (hcx : ratLeRep c x) :
    close (f x) (f c) eps :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem right_close_of_delta (f : ratRep → ratRep)
    (a b c u h eps delta : ratRep)
    (hmono : NondecreasingOn f a b)
    (hac : ratLtRep a c) (hcb : ratLtRep c b)
    (hub : ratLeRep u b)
    (hbound : ∀ (x : ratRep), InClosed a b x → ratLeRep c x →
      ratLeRep x u → ratLeRep (f x) (ratAddRep (f c) h))
    (hdu : ratLeRep delta (ratSubRep u c))
    (hhe : ratLtRep h eps)
    (x : ratRep) (hx : close x c delta) (hcx : ratLeRep c x) :
    close (f x) (f c) eps :=
  close_of_le_ub (f x) (f c) eps h
    (hmono c x
      (And.intro (ratLtRep_le a c hac) (ratLtRep_le c b hcb))
      (And.intro (ratLeRep_trans a c x (ratLtRep_le a c hac) hcx)
        (ratLeRep_trans x u b
          (ratLeRep_trans x (ratAddRep c delta) u
            (le_add_of_sub_le x c delta
              (And.left (close_two_bounds x c delta hx)))
            (ratLeRep_trans (ratAddRep c delta)
              (ratAddRep c (ratSubRep u c)) u
              (ratLeRep_add_left delta (ratSubRep u c) c hdu)
              (ratLeRep_of_ratRel (ratAddRep c (ratSubRep u c)) u
                (ratRel_trans_gen (ratAddRep c (ratSubRep u c))
                  (ratAddRep (ratSubRep u c) c) u
                  (ratAdd_comm c (ratSubRep u c))
                  (ratSubRep_add_self u c)))))
          hub))
      hcx)
    (hbound x
      (And.intro (ratLeRep_trans a c x (ratLtRep_le a c hac) hcx)
        (ratLeRep_trans x u b
          (ratLeRep_trans x (ratAddRep c delta) u
            (le_add_of_sub_le x c delta
              (And.left (close_two_bounds x c delta hx)))
            (ratLeRep_trans (ratAddRep c delta)
              (ratAddRep c (ratSubRep u c)) u
              (ratLeRep_add_left delta (ratSubRep u c) c hdu)
              (ratLeRep_of_ratRel (ratAddRep c (ratSubRep u c)) u
                (ratRel_trans_gen (ratAddRep c (ratSubRep u c))
                  (ratAddRep (ratSubRep u c) c) u
                  (ratAdd_comm c (ratSubRep u c))
                  (ratSubRep_add_self u c)))))
          hub))
      hcx
      (ratLeRep_trans x (ratAddRep c delta) u
        (le_add_of_sub_le x c delta
          (And.left (close_two_bounds x c delta hx)))
        (ratLeRep_trans (ratAddRep c delta)
          (ratAddRep c (ratSubRep u c)) u
          (ratLeRep_add_left delta (ratSubRep u c) c hdu)
          (ratLeRep_of_ratRel (ratAddRep c (ratSubRep u c)) u
            (ratRel_trans_gen (ratAddRep c (ratSubRep u c))
              (ratAddRep (ratSubRep u c) c) u
              (ratAdd_comm c (ratSubRep u c))
              (ratSubRep_add_self u c))))))
    hhe

exercises.unit: 单元139 单调函数：介值性反过来给出连续
exercises.name: left_close_of_delta
exercises.title: 左半邻域上的收口：|x - c| < δ ≤ c - l 时 x 落在 [l, c] 里，于是 f x ≤ f c ≤ f x + h < f x + eps。
exercises.prompt: 左半邻域上的收口：|x - c| < δ ≤ c - l 时 x 落在 [l, c] 里，于是 f x ≤ f c ≤ f x + h < f x + eps。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 从 `close_two_bounds` 取出 c - x ≤ δ，与 δ ≤ c - l 合成 c - x ≤ c - l，用 `le_of_sub_right_le` 得 l ≤ x；再交给 `close_of_le_lb`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `close x c δ → x ≤ c → close (f x) (f c) eps`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: close_two_bounds · ratLeRep_congr_gen · le_of_sub_right_le · close_of_le_lb。

exercises.template:
theorem left_close_of_delta (f : ratRep → ratRep)
    (a b c l h eps delta : ratRep)
    (hmono : NondecreasingOn f a b)
    (hac : ratLtRep a c) (hcb : ratLtRep c b)
    (hal : ratLeRep a l)
    (hbound : ∀ (x : ratRep), InClosed a b x → ratLeRep l x →
      ratLeRep x c → ratLeRep (f c) (ratAddRep (f x) h))
    (hdl : ratLeRep delta (ratSubRep c l))
    (hhe : ratLtRep h eps)
    (x : ratRep) (hx : close x c delta) (hxc : ratLeRep x c) :
    close (f x) (f c) eps :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem left_close_of_delta (f : ratRep → ratRep)
    (a b c l h eps delta : ratRep)
    (hmono : NondecreasingOn f a b)
    (hac : ratLtRep a c) (hcb : ratLtRep c b)
    (hal : ratLeRep a l)
    (hbound : ∀ (x : ratRep), InClosed a b x → ratLeRep l x →
      ratLeRep x c → ratLeRep (f c) (ratAddRep (f x) h))
    (hdl : ratLeRep delta (ratSubRep c l))
    (hhe : ratLtRep h eps)
    (x : ratRep) (hx : close x c delta) (hxc : ratLeRep x c) :
    close (f x) (f c) eps :=
  close_of_le_lb (f x) (f c) eps h
    (hmono x c
      (And.intro
        (ratLeRep_trans a l x hal
          (le_of_sub_right_le c x l
            (ratLeRep_trans (ratSubRep c x) delta (ratSubRep c l)
              (ratLeRep_congr_gen (ratAddRep (ratNegRep x) c)
                (ratSubRep c x) delta delta
                (ratAdd_comm (ratNegRep x) c) (ratRel_refl delta)
                (And.right (close_two_bounds x c delta hx)))
              hdl)))
      (ratLeRep_trans x c b hxc (ratLtRep_le c b hcb)))
      (And.intro (ratLtRep_le a c hac) (ratLtRep_le c b hcb))
      hxc)
    (hbound x
      (And.intro
        (ratLeRep_trans a l x hal
          (le_of_sub_right_le c x l
            (ratLeRep_trans (ratSubRep c x) delta (ratSubRep c l)
              (ratLeRep_congr_gen (ratAddRep (ratNegRep x) c)
                (ratSubRep c x) delta delta
                (ratAdd_comm (ratNegRep x) c) (ratRel_refl delta)
                (And.right (close_two_bounds x c delta hx)))
              hdl)))
      (ratLeRep_trans x c b hxc (ratLtRep_le c b hcb)))
      (le_of_sub_right_le c x l
        (ratLeRep_trans (ratSubRep c x) delta (ratSubRep c l)
          (ratLeRep_congr_gen (ratAddRep (ratNegRep x) c)
            (ratSubRep c x) delta delta
            (ratAdd_comm (ratNegRep x) c) (ratRel_refl delta)
            (And.right (close_two_bounds x c delta hx)))
          hdl))
      hxc)
    hhe

exercises.name: continuousAt_of_monotone_ivp
exercises.title: 主定理。对每个 eps 取 h = eps/2，左右各得一个分界点；δ 取 u - c 与 c - l 中较小的正数，于是 c 的 δ 邻域落在 [l, u] 里。x 在 c 的哪一边 由序的全性决定，两边分别交给上面的收口。
exercises.prompt: 主定理。对每个 eps 取 h = eps/2，左右各得一个分界点；δ 取 u - c 与 c - l 中较小的正数，于是 c 的 δ 邻域落在 [l, u] 里。x 在 c 的哪一边 由序的全性决定，两边分别交给上面的收口。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: eps 取半；`exists_right_bound` 与 `exists_left_bound` 给出 u 与 l；`exists_min_pos` 取 δ；对 x 用 `ratLeRep_total x c` 分左右，分别调用 `right_close_of_delta` 与 `left_close_of_delta`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `NondecreasingOn f a b → HasIntermediateValue f a b → a < c → c < b → ContinuousAt f c`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLtRep_half · exists_right_bound · exists_left_bound · exists_min_pos · ratLeRep_total · right_close_of_delta · left_close_of_delta。

exercises.template:
theorem continuousAt_of_monotone_ivp (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b c : ratRep)
    (hmono : NondecreasingOn f a b)
    (hivp : HasIntermediateValue f a b)
    (hac : ratLtRep a c) (hcb : ratLtRep c b) :
    ContinuousAt f c :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem continuousAt_of_monotone_ivp (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b c : ratRep)
    (hmono : NondecreasingOn f a b)
    (hivp : HasIntermediateValue f a b)
    (hac : ratLtRep a c) (hcb : ratLtRep c b) :
    ContinuousAt f c :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    @Exists.elim ratRep
      (fun (u : ratRep) => ratLtRep c u ∧ ratLeRep u b ∧
        ∀ (x : ratRep), InClosed a b x → ratLeRep c x → ratLeRep x u →
          ratLeRep (f x) (ratAddRep (f c) (ratHalf eps)))
      (∃ (delta : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
        ∀ (x : ratRep), close x c delta → close (f x) (f c) eps)
      (exists_right_bound f a b c (ratHalf eps) hmono hivp hac hcb
        (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
      (fun (u : ratRep)
          (hu : ratLtRep c u ∧ ratLeRep u b ∧
            ∀ (x : ratRep), InClosed a b x → ratLeRep c x → ratLeRep x u →
              ratLeRep (f x) (ratAddRep (f c) (ratHalf eps))) =>
        @Exists.elim ratRep
          (fun (l : ratRep) => ratLtRep l c ∧ ratLeRep a l ∧
            ∀ (x : ratRep), InClosed a b x → ratLeRep l x → ratLeRep x c →
              ratLeRep (f c) (ratAddRep (f x) (ratHalf eps)))
          (∃ (delta : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
            ∀ (x : ratRep), close x c delta → close (f x) (f c) eps)
          (exists_left_bound f a b c (ratHalf eps) hmono hivp hac hcb
            (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
          (fun (l : ratRep)
              (hl : ratLtRep l c ∧ ratLeRep a l ∧
                ∀ (x : ratRep), InClosed a b x → ratLeRep l x →
                  ratLeRep x c → ratLeRep (f c) (ratAddRep (f x) (ratHalf eps))) =>
            @Exists.elim ratRep
              (fun (delta : ratRep) => ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
                ratLeRep delta (ratSubRep u c) ∧
                ratLeRep delta (ratSubRep c l))
              (∃ (delta : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
                ∀ (x : ratRep), close x c delta → close (f x) (f c) eps)
              (exists_min_pos (ratSubRep u c) (ratSubRep c l)
                (ratLtRep_sub_pos u c (And.left hu))
                (ratLtRep_sub_pos c l (And.left hl)))
              (fun (delta : ratRep)
                  (hd : ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
                    ratLeRep delta (ratSubRep u c) ∧
                    ratLeRep delta (ratSubRep c l)) =>
                Exists.intro delta
                  (And.intro (And.left hd)
                    (fun (x : ratRep) (hx : close x c delta) =>
                      @Or.elim (ratLeRep x c) (ratLeRep c x)
                        (close (f x) (f c) eps)
                        (fun (hxc : ratLeRep x c) =>
                          left_close_of_delta f a b c l (ratHalf eps) eps delta
                            hmono hac hcb (And.left (And.right hl))
                            (And.right (And.right hl))
                            (And.right (And.right hd))
                            (ratHalf_lt_self eps heps) x hx hxc)
                        (fun (hcx : ratLeRep c x) =>
                          right_close_of_delta f a b c u (ratHalf eps) eps delta
                            hmono hac hcb (And.left (And.right hu))
                            (And.right (And.right hu))
                            (And.left (And.right hd))
                            (ratHalf_lt_self eps heps) x hx hcx)
                        (ratLeRep_total x c))))))

exercises.name: continuousOn_open_of_monotone_ivp
exercises.title: 把主定理打包成「开区间上处处连续」。
exercises.prompt: 把主定理打包成「开区间上处处连续」。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把 c 与两个严格不等式原样交给主定理。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `NondecreasingOn f a b → HasIntermediateValue f a b → ∀ c, a < c → c < b → ContinuousAt f c`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: continuousAt_of_monotone_ivp。

exercises.template:
theorem continuousOn_open_of_monotone_ivp (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b : ratRep)
    (hmono : NondecreasingOn f a b) (hivp : HasIntermediateValue f a b) :
    ∀ (c : ratRep), ratLtRep a c → ratLtRep c b → ContinuousAt f c :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem continuousOn_open_of_monotone_ivp (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a b : ratRep)
    (hmono : NondecreasingOn f a b) (hivp : HasIntermediateValue f a b) :
    ∀ (c : ratRep), ratLtRep a c → ratLtRep c b → ContinuousAt f c :=
  fun (c : ratRep) (hac : ratLtRep a c) (hcb : ratLtRep c b) =>
    continuousAt_of_monotone_ivp f a b c hmono hivp hac hcb

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.intro · ratRel_refl。

exercises.template:
theorem demo_ivp_id (a b : ratRep) :
    HasIntermediateValue (fun (x : ratRep) => x) a b :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem demo_ivp_id (a b : ratRep) :
    HasIntermediateValue (fun (x : ratRep) => x) a b :=
  fun (x y : ratRep) (_hx : InClosed a b x) (_hy : InClosed a b y)
      (_hxy : ratLtRep x y) (v : ratRep) (hxv : ratLtRep x v)
      (hvy : ratLtRep v y) =>
    Exists.intro v (And.intro hxv (And.intro hvy (ratRel_refl v)))

exercises.template:
theorem isSlope_iff (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a : ratRep)
    (q : ratRep → ratRep) :
    IsSlope f a q ↔
      ∀ (x : ratRep), ¬ ratRel x a →
        ratRel (ratMulRep (ratSubRep x a) (q x)) (ratSubRep (f x) (f a)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem isSlope_iff (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a : ratRep)
    (q : ratRep → ratRep) :
    IsSlope f a q ↔
      ∀ (x : ratRep), ¬ ratRel x a →
        ratRel (ratMulRep (ratSubRep x a) (q x)) (ratSubRep (f x) (f a)) :=
  Iff.intro
    (fun (h : IsSlope f a q) => h)
    (fun (h : ∀ (x : ratRep), ¬ ratRel x a →
        ratRel (ratMulRep (ratSubRep x a) (q x)) (ratSubRep (f x) (f a))) => h)

hints.label: 思路

exercises.unit: 单元141 导数的代数：垂直平移与取负
exercises.name: ratSubRep_add_cancel
exercises.title: 单元141 导数的代数：垂直平移与取负
exercises.prompt:
单元141 导数的代数：垂直平移与取负

导数的定义只看一点附近：曲线在那里最像哪一条直线，直线的斜率就是导数。 既然如此，对整条曲线做两种最简单的整体操作——沿 y 轴抬高一段、关于 x 轴 翻过来——斜率应当怎样变？抬高的图像与原来的图像只差一个常数，每一处的 倾斜都没有变；翻过来的图像把上升改成下降，斜率应当整体变号。这两条直觉 都容易说出口，却要回到 ε-δ 的定义里才能落实：差商是一个分式，分子的变化 才是关键。

设 f 在 a 处有斜率函数 q，也就是在 a 之外逐点满足 `q x * (x - a) ~ f x - f a`。把 f 抬高 c，分子成为 `(f x + c) - (f a + c)`，c 在减法里抵消，仍然等价于 `f x - f a`；于是 同一个 q 就是抬高后函数的斜率函数。把 f 取负，分子成为 `(-f x) - (-f a)`，它等于 `-(f x - f a)`；斜率函数整体取负，乘积等式 的两边同时变号就够了。最后，斜率函数的极限也照旧或取负：常函数的极限 与取负律都已经在函数极限的加群里。

证明停在代表元层。这里没有除法，斜率是乘积等式而不是商，所以「分子抵消」 必须写成有理数的等式：减去同一个加数、乘一个负数、取负过减法。三条都不 长，却正好是把图像操作翻译成差商操作的桥。

边界：函数取 `ratRep → ratRep`，停在有理代表元层；和、差与常数倍要让 乘法对加法分配，留到后面的单元。不新增公理，也不碰 kernel/front。

减去同一个加数

平移要证明的第一件事：两个差 `x - y` 与 `(x + c) - (y + c)` 相等。 直接摊开括号会得到一长串加数；把它们各自加上 `y + c` 反而更省—— `(u - v) + v` 回到 u，两条都回到 `x + c`，公共的加数一消就完了。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把要证的两边都加上 `y + c`，分别用 `(u - v) + v ~ u` 收回 `x + c`，再用加法消去律去掉公共加数。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratSubRep_add_self · ratRel_add_cancel_gen · ratAddAssoc 方向 · ratAddRep_wd_gen。

exercises.template:
theorem ratSubRep_add_cancel (x y c : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratSubRep (ratAddRep x c) (ratAddRep y c)) (ratSubRep x y) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratSubRep_add_cancel (x y c : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratSubRep (ratAddRep x c) (ratAddRep y c)) (ratSubRep x y) :=
  ratRel_add_cancel_gen
    (ratSubRep (ratAddRep x c) (ratAddRep y c))
    (ratSubRep x y)
    (ratAddRep y c)
    (ratRel_trans_gen
      (ratAddRep (ratSubRep (ratAddRep x c) (ratAddRep y c)) (ratAddRep y c))
      (ratAddRep x c)
      (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x y) (ratAddRep y c))
      (ratSubRep_add_self (ratAddRep x c) (ratAddRep y c))
      (ratRel_symm (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x y) (ratAddRep y c))
        (ratAddRep x c)
        (ratRel_trans_gen
          (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x y) (ratAddRep y c))
          (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x y) y) c)
          (ratAddRep x c)
          (ratRel_symm (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x y) y) c)
            (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x y) (ratAddRep y c))
            (ratAdd_assoc (ratSubRep x y) y c))
          (ratAddRep_wd_gen (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x y) y) x c
            (ratSubRep_add_self x y)))))

exercises.title: 斜率函数原样保留。给定 x 与 `x ≠ a`，把假设里的 `f x - f a` 换成 `(f x + c) - (f a + c)`；这一步正是上一条减法等式，方向取反。
exercises.prompt: 斜率函数原样保留。给定 x 与 `x ≠ a`，把假设里的 `f x - f a` 换成 `(f x + c) - (f a + c)`；这一步正是上一条减法等式，方向取反。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 逐点把 `f x - f a` 换成 `(f x + c) - (f a + c)`，前一条减法等式反向用即可。

hints.label: 目标形态

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratSubRep_add_cancel · ratRel_symm · ratRel_trans_gen。

exercises.template:
theorem isSlope_add_const (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a : ratRep)
    (q : ratRep → ratRep) (c : ratRep) (h : IsSlope f a q) :
    IsSlope (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) c) a q :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem isSlope_add_const (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a : ratRep)
    (q : ratRep → ratRep) (c : ratRep) (h : IsSlope f a q) :
    IsSlope (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) c) a q :=
  fun (x : ratRep) (hne : ¬ ratRel x a) =>

      (ratSubRep (f x) (f a))

exercises.unit: 单元142 极限唯一：一条曲线不能同时逼近两个值
exercises.name: exists_close_ne
exercises.title: 单元142 极限唯一：一条曲线不能同时逼近两个值
exercises.prompt:
单元142 极限唯一：一条曲线不能同时逼近两个值

一条曲线在一点附近最像哪一条直线？如果两条不同的直线都「最像」，导数就 没有确定的值。极限的定义只写「存在一个 L，使得……」：它保证至少有一个， 没有直接说至多有一个。要把「那个极限」当成一个对象来用，先得把这件事 补上。

证明的想法很朴素：如果 L 与 M 都是 f 在 a 处的极限，那么 a 附近总可以 找到一点 x（不等于 a），让 f x 同时靠近 L 与 M。L 与 M 之间的距离不超过 两段距离之和；每段都能压到 ε/2 以内，合起来就压到 ε 以内。ε 任意，两个 数就只能相等。

两个细节需要落地。第一，两份 ε/2 的接近性各自带一个半径，必须把 x 取在 两个半径都管得到的地方；序是全的，取较小的那个半径即可。第二，邻域里 必须真的有一点不等于 a：取 a + δ/2，它离 a 不到 δ，而「等于 a」会逼出 δ/2 = 0，与 δ/2 > 0 冲突。

有了唯一性，极限值就可以沿等价替换：若 f 在 a 处以 L 为极限，而 L 与 M 相等，那么 M 也是极限。常函数与恒等函数是两个可以逐字读出的样本：它们的 极限只能是自己。最后给一个反例式的读数：常函数零不可能以 1 为极限。

边界：函数取 ratRep → ratRep，停在有理代表元层。这里证明的是极限值的 唯一性；同一个函数的两条斜率函数是否逐点相同，要从 (x-a)·q x ~ (x-a)·r x 里消去非零因子，那是另一件事。不新增公理，也不碰 kernel/front。

邻域里有异于中心的一点

取 a + δ/2。它离 a 的距离是 δ/2，比 δ 小；若它等于 a，两边同时减去 a 就得到 δ/2 = 0，而 δ/2 是正的。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 用 `a + δ/2` 作见证。接近性交给 `close_add_right`（距离取 δ/2），非相等交给 `ratLtRep_right`：若它等于 a，减去 a 后 δ/2 与 0 等价，撞上 δ/2 > 0。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `∃ x, close x a δ ∧ ¬ ratRel x a`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: close_add_right · ratLtRep_half · ratHalf_lt_self · ratAdd_sub_self · ratSubRep_wd · ratSubRep_self · ratLtRep_right。

exercises.template:
theorem exists_close_ne (a delta : ratRep)
    (hd : ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta) :
    ∃ (x : ratRep), close x a delta ∧ ¬ ratRel x a :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem exists_close_ne (a delta : ratRep)
    (hd : ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta) :
    ∃ (x : ratRep), close x a delta ∧ ¬ ratRel x a :=
  Exists.intro (ratAddRep a (ratHalf delta))
    (And.intro
      (close_add_right a (ratHalf delta) delta
        (ratLtRep_half delta hd)
        (ratHalf_lt_self delta hd))
      (fun (h : ratRel (ratAddRep a (ratHalf delta)) a) =>
        ratLtRep_right ratZeroRep (ratHalf delta)
          (ratLtRep_half delta hd)
          (ratRel_symm (ratHalf delta) ratZeroRep
            (ratRel_trans_gen (ratHalf delta)
              (ratSubRep (ratAddRep a (ratHalf delta)) a)
              ratZeroRep
              (ratRel_symm (ratSubRep (ratAddRep a (ratHalf delta)) a)
                (ratHalf delta)
                (ratAdd_sub_self a (ratHalf delta)))
              (ratRel_trans_gen
                (ratSubRep (ratAddRep a (ratHalf delta)) a)
                (ratSubRep a a)
                ratZeroRep
                (ratSubRep_wd (ratAddRep a (ratHalf delta)) a a a h
                  (ratRel_refl a))
                (ratSubRep_self a))))))

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 取出 `close u L ε` 的见证 d；用 `ratSubRep_wd` 把 `u - L` 换成 `u - M`，再让 `ratAbsRel_wd_left` 把绝对值见证搬过去。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `close u L ε → L ~ M → close u M ε`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratSubRep_wd · ratRel_refl · ratAbsRel_wd_left。

exercises.template:
theorem close_of_ratRel_right (u L M eps : ratRep)
    (h : close u L eps) (hLM : ratRel L M) : close u M eps :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem close_of_ratRel_right (u L M eps : ratRep)
    (h : close u L eps) (hLM : ratRel L M) : close u M eps :=
  Exists.elim h
    (fun (d : ratRep)
        (hd : ratAbsRel (ratSubRep u L) d ∧ ratLtRep d eps) =>
      Exists.intro d
        (And.intro
          (ratAbsRel_wd_left (ratSubRep u L) (ratSubRep u M) d
            (ratSubRep_wd u u L M (ratRel_refl u) hLM)
            (And.left hd))
          (And.right hd)))

exercises.unit: 单元142 极限唯一：一条曲线不能同时逼近两个值
exercises.name: tendsToAt_congr_value
exercises.title: 极限值也能这样换：对每个 ε，原来的半径照用，只是把终点的名字从 L 换成 M。
exercises.prompt: 极限值也能这样换：对每个 ε，原来的半径照用，只是把终点的名字从 L 换成 M。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 逐字沿用原来的 δ；唯一的改动是把 `close (f x) L ε` 换成 `close (f x) M ε`，用上一条。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `TendsToAt f a L → L ~ M → TendsToAt f a M`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.elim · Exists.intro · close_of_ratRel_right。

exercises.template:
theorem tendsToAt_congr_value (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a L M : ratRep)
    (h : TendsToAt f a L) (hLM : ratRel L M) : TendsToAt f a M :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem tendsToAt_congr_value (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a L M : ratRep)
    (h : TendsToAt f a L) (hLM : ratRel L M) : TendsToAt f a M :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (h eps heps)
      (fun (d : ratRep)
          (hd : ratLtRep ratZeroRep d ∧
            ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a d → ¬ ratRel x a →
              close (f x) L eps) =>
        Exists.intro d
          (And.intro (And.left hd)
            (fun (x : ratRep) (hx : close x a d)
                (hne : ¬ ratRel x a) =>
              close_of_ratRel_right (f x) L M eps
                ((And.right hd) x hx hne) hLM)))

exercises.unit: 单元142 极限唯一：一条曲线不能同时逼近两个值
exercises.name: close_of_two_limits
exercises.title: 两条极限各给一个半径。把 x 取在两份半径都管得到的地方：若 d ≤ d'，就取 d；否则取 d'。接近性各给 ε/2，`close_trans` 合成 ε。
exercises.prompt: 两条极限各给一个半径。把 x 取在两份半径都管得到的地方：若 d ≤ d'，就取 d；否则取 d'。接近性各给 ε/2，`close_trans` 合成 ε。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 `d ≤ d'` 与 `d' ≤ d` 两支分别取较小的半径；x 由 `exists_close_ne` 给出，较大半径那一侧的接近性用 `close_mono_eps` 放大到较小半径，最后两条 ε/2 交给 `close_trans`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: 两条 ε/2 的接近性 + 两个正半径 ⇒ `close L M ε`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLeRep_total · Or.elim · exists_close_ne · close_mono_eps · close_symm · close_trans。

exercises.template:
theorem close_of_two_limits (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a L M eps dL dM : ratRep)
    (hdL : ratLtRep ratZeroRep dL)
    (hdM : ratLtRep ratZeroRep dM)
    (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps)
    (hL : ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a dL → ¬ ratRel x a →
      close (f x) L (ratHalf eps))
    (hM : ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a dM → ¬ ratRel x a →
      close (f x) M (ratHalf eps)) :
    close L M eps :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem close_of_two_limits (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a L M eps dL dM : ratRep)
    (hdL : ratLtRep ratZeroRep dL)
    (hdM : ratLtRep ratZeroRep dM)
    (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps)
    (hL : ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a dL → ¬ ratRel x a →
      close (f x) L (ratHalf eps))
    (hM : ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a dM → ¬ ratRel x a →
      close (f x) M (ratHalf eps)) :
    close L M eps :=
  @Or.elim (ratLeRep dL dM) (ratLeRep dM dL) (close L M eps)
    (fun (hle : ratLeRep dL dM) =>
      @Exists.elim ratRep (fun (x : ratRep) => close x a dL ∧ ¬ ratRel x a)
        (close L M eps)
        (exists_close_ne a dL hdL)
        (fun (x : ratRep) (hx : close x a dL ∧ ¬ ratRel x a) =>
          close_trans L (f x) M eps heps
            (close_symm (f x) L (ratHalf eps)
              (hL x (And.left hx) (And.right hx)))
            (hM x (close_mono_eps x a dL dM (And.left hx) hle)
              (And.right hx))))
    (fun (hle : ratLeRep dM dL) =>
      @Exists.elim ratRep (fun (x : ratRep) => close x a dM ∧ ¬ ratRel x a)
        (close L M eps)
        (exists_close_ne a dM hdM)
        (fun (x : ratRep) (hx : close x a dM ∧ ¬ ratRel x a) =>
          close_trans L (f x) M eps heps
            (close_symm (f x) L (ratHalf eps)
              (hL x (close_mono_eps x a dM dL (And.left hx) hle)
                (And.right hx)))
            (hM x (And.left hx) (And.right hx))))
    (ratLeRep_total dL dM)

exercises.unit: 单元142 极限唯一：一条曲线不能同时逼近两个值
exercises.name: tendsToAt_unique
exercises.title: 对每个 ε > 0，两条极限各把 ε 折半，取小半径，在 a + δ/2 上接起来， 得到 L 与 M 在 ε 内接近。ε 任意，`ratRel_of_close_all` 把它收成 L = M。
exercises.prompt: 对每个 ε > 0，两条极限各把 ε 折半，取小半径，在 a + δ/2 上接起来， 得到 L 与 M 在 ε 内接近。ε 任意，`ratRel_of_close_all` 把它收成 L = M。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对任意 ε，把 `hL` 与 `hM` 各用在 ε/2 上；把两个 δ 交给上一条；最后用 `ratRel_of_close_all` 收口。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `TendsToAt f a L → TendsToAt f a M → L ~ M`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLtRep_half · ratRel_of_close_all · close_of_two_limits。

exercises.template:
theorem tendsToAt_unique (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a L M : ratRep)
    (hL : TendsToAt f a L) (hM : TendsToAt f a M) : ratRel L M :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem tendsToAt_unique (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a L M : ratRep)
    (hL : TendsToAt f a L) (hM : TendsToAt f a M) : ratRel L M :=
  ratRel_of_close_all L M
    (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
      @Exists.elim ratRep
        (fun (dL : ratRep) => ratLtRep ratZeroRep dL ∧
          ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a dL → ¬ ratRel x a →
            close (f x) L (ratHalf eps))
        (close L M eps)
        (hL (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
        (fun (dL : ratRep)
            (hdL : ratLtRep ratZeroRep dL ∧
              ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a dL → ¬ ratRel x a →
                close (f x) L (ratHalf eps)) =>
          @Exists.elim ratRep
            (fun (dM : ratRep) => ratLtRep ratZeroRep dM ∧
              ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a dM → ¬ ratRel x a →
                close (f x) M (ratHalf eps))
            (close L M eps)
            (hM (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
            (fun (dM : ratRep)
                (hdM : ratLtRep ratZeroRep dM ∧
                  ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a dM → ¬ ratRel x a →
                    close (f x) M (ratHalf eps)) =>
              close_of_two_limits f a L M eps dL dM
                (And.left hdL) (And.left hdM) heps
                (And.right hdL) (And.right hdM))))

exercises.template:

theorem agreeNear_symm (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (a : ratRep)

exercises.unit: 单元143 极限只看邻域：换掉远处的函数值
exercises.name: close_transport
exercises.title: 若 u 在 ε 内接近 L，而 u 与 v 相等，那么 v 也在 ε 内接近 L。见证 d 不变： u - L 与 v - L 只差一个等价，绝对值沿这条等价搬过去。
exercises.prompt: 若 u 在 ε 内接近 L，而 u 与 v 相等，那么 v 也在 ε 内接近 L。见证 d 不变： u - L 与 v - L 只差一个等价，绝对值沿这条等价搬过去。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 取出 `close u L ε` 的见证 d；用 `ratSubRep_wd` 把 `u - L` 换成 `v - L`，再用 `ratAbsRel_wd_left`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `close u L ε → u ~ v → close v L ε`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratSubRep_wd · ratRel_refl · ratAbsRel_wd_left。

exercises.template:
theorem close_transport (u v L eps : ratRep)
    (h : close u L eps) (huv : ratRel u v) : close v L eps :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem close_transport (u v L eps : ratRep)
    (h : close u L eps) (huv : ratRel u v) : close v L eps :=
  Exists.elim h
    (fun (d : ratRep)
        (hd : ratAbsRel (ratSubRep u L) d ∧ ratLtRep d eps) =>
      Exists.intro d
        (And.intro
          (ratAbsRel_wd_left (ratSubRep u L) (ratSubRep v L) d
            (ratSubRep_wd u v L L huv (ratRel_refl L))
            (And.left hd))
          (And.right hd)))

exercises.name: tendsToAt_same_radius
exercises.title: 极限给一个半径 d，局部相等给一个半径 d₀。把 x 取在较小的那个半径里， 两边的条件就同时成立：接近性用 `close_mono_eps` 放大到较小半径，函数值 的相等把 `f x - L` 换成 `g x - L`。
exercises.prompt: 极限给一个半径 d，局部相等给一个半径 d₀。把 x 取在较小的那个半径里， 两边的条件就同时成立：接近性用 `close_mono_eps` 放大到较小半径，函数值 的相等把 `f x - L` 换成 `g x - L`。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 `d ≤ d₀` 与 `d₀ ≤ d` 两支分别取较小的半径；较大半径那一侧的接近性用 `close_mono_eps` 放大，最后用 `close_transport` 把函数值换掉。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `∃ δ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x, close x a δ → x ≠ a → close (g x) L ε`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLeRep_total · Or.elim · close_mono_eps · close_transport。

exercises.template:
theorem tendsToAt_same_radius (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (a L eps d d0 : ratRep)
    (hd : ratLtRep ratZeroRep d)
    (hd0 : ratLtRep ratZeroRep d0)
    (hclose : ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a d → ¬ ratRel x a →
      close (f x) L eps)
    (hagree : ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a d0 → ¬ ratRel x a →
      ratRel (f x) (g x)) :
    ∃ (delta : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
      ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a delta → ¬ ratRel x a →
        close (g x) L eps :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem tendsToAt_same_radius (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (a L eps d d0 : ratRep)
    (hd : ratLtRep ratZeroRep d)
    (hd0 : ratLtRep ratZeroRep d0)
    (hclose : ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a d → ¬ ratRel x a →
      close (f x) L eps)
    (hagree : ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a d0 → ¬ ratRel x a →
      ratRel (f x) (g x)) :
    ∃ (delta : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
      ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a delta → ¬ ratRel x a →
        close (g x) L eps :=
  @Or.elim (ratLeRep d d0) (ratLeRep d0 d)
    (∃ (delta : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
      ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a delta → ¬ ratRel x a →
        close (g x) L eps)
    (fun (hle : ratLeRep d d0) =>
      Exists.intro d
        (And.intro hd
          (fun (x : ratRep) (hx : close x a d)
              (hne : ¬ ratRel x a) =>
            close_transport (f x) (g x) L eps
              (hclose x hx hne)
              (hagree x (close_mono_eps x a d d0 hx hle) hne))))
    (fun (hle : ratLeRep d0 d) =>
      Exists.intro d0
        (And.intro hd0
          (fun (x : ratRep) (hx : close x a d0)
              (hne : ¬ ratRel x a) =>
            close_transport (f x) (g x) L eps
              (hclose x (close_mono_eps x a d0 d hx hle) hne)
              (hagree x hx hne))))
    (ratLeRep_total d d0)

exercises.unit: 单元143 极限只看邻域：换掉远处的函数值
exercises.name: tendsToAt_congr
exercises.title: 对每个 ε，从 f 的极限取出 δ，从局部相等取出 δ₀，把两者交给上一条。 得到的半径就是 g 的极限所需的半径。
exercises.prompt: 对每个 ε，从 f 的极限取出 δ，从局部相等取出 δ₀，把两者交给上一条。 得到的半径就是 g 的极限所需的半径。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 逐 ε 取出极限的 δ 与局部相等的 δ₀，直接调用 `tendsToAt_same_radius`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `TendsToAt f a L → AgreeNear f g a → TendsToAt g a L`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.elim · tendsToAt_same_radius。

exercises.template:
theorem tendsToAt_congr (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (a L : ratRep)
    (h : TendsToAt f a L) (hfg : AgreeNear f g a) :
    TendsToAt g a L :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem tendsToAt_congr (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (a L : ratRep)
    (h : TendsToAt f a L) (hfg : AgreeNear f g a) :
    TendsToAt g a L :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    @Exists.elim ratRep
      (fun (d : ratRep) => ratLtRep ratZeroRep d ∧
        ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a d → ¬ ratRel x a →
          close (f x) L eps)
      (∃ (delta : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
        ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a delta → ¬ ratRel x a →
          close (g x) L eps)
      (h eps heps)
      (fun (d : ratRep)
          (hd : ratLtRep ratZeroRep d ∧
            ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a d → ¬ ratRel x a →
              close (f x) L eps) =>
        @Exists.elim ratRep
          (fun (d0 : ratRep) => ratLtRep ratZeroRep d0 ∧
            ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a d0 → ¬ ratRel x a →
              ratRel (f x) (g x))
          (∃ (delta : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
            ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a delta → ¬ ratRel x a →
              close (g x) L eps)
          hfg
          (fun (d0 : ratRep)
              (hd0 : ratLtRep ratZeroRep d0 ∧
                ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a d0 → ¬ ratRel x a →
                  ratRel (f x) (g x)) =>
            tendsToAt_same_radius f g a L eps d d0
              (And.left hd) (And.left hd0)
              (And.right hd) (And.right hd0)))

exercises.unit: 单元143 极限只看邻域：换掉远处的函数值
exercises.name: tendsToAt_congr_iff
exercises.title: 两个方向各用一次：局部相等是对称的。
exercises.prompt: 两个方向各用一次：局部相等是对称的。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 正向用上一条；反向先用 `agreeNear_symm` 把假设翻过来，再用上一条。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `AgreeNear f g a → (TendsToAt f a L ↔ TendsToAt g a L)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Iff.intro · tendsToAt_congr · agreeNear_symm。

exercises.template:
theorem tendsToAt_congr_iff (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (a L : ratRep)
    (hfg : AgreeNear f g a) :
    TendsToAt f a L ↔ TendsToAt g a L :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem tendsToAt_congr_iff (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (a L : ratRep)
    (hfg : AgreeNear f g a) :
    TendsToAt f a L ↔ TendsToAt g a L :=
  Iff.intro
    (fun (h : TendsToAt f a L) => tendsToAt_congr f g a L h hfg)
    (fun (h : TendsToAt g a L) =>
      tendsToAt_congr g f a L h (agreeNear_symm f g a hfg))

exercises.name: tendsToAt_congr_const
exercises.title: 若 f 在 a 附近等于常数 c，那么 f 的极限只能是 c：先把极限搬到常函数上， 再用常函数极限的唯一性。
exercises.prompt: 若 f 在 a 附近等于常数 c，那么 f 的极限只能是 c：先把极限搬到常函数上， 再用常函数极限的唯一性。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 用 `tendsToAt_congr` 把 f 的极限搬到常函数上，得到常函数以 L 为极限；再与常函数以 c 为极限一起交给唯一性。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `TendsToAt f a L → AgreeNear f (fun _ => c) a → L ~ c`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: tendsToAt_congr · tendsToAt_const · tendsToAt_unique。

exercises.template:
theorem tendsToAt_congr_const (f : ratRep → ratRep) (c a L : ratRep)
    (h : TendsToAt f a L) (hfc : AgreeNear f (fun (_ : ratRep) => c) a) :
    ratRel L c :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem tendsToAt_congr_const (f : ratRep → ratRep) (c a L : ratRep)
    (h : TendsToAt f a L) (hfc : AgreeNear f (fun (_ : ratRep) => c) a) :
    ratRel L c :=
  tendsToAt_unique (fun (_ : ratRep) => c) a L c
    (tendsToAt_congr f (fun (_ : ratRep) => c) a L h hfc)
    (tendsToAt_const c a)
