exercises.title: 若 f 在 a 附近等于恒等函数，而 f 以 L 为极限，那么 L 与 a 相等。这是 局部性把问题搬到恒等函数上，再用恒等函数的唯一性收口。
exercises.prompt: 若 f 在 a 附近等于恒等函数，而 f 以 L 为极限，那么 L 与 a 相等。这是 局部性把问题搬到恒等函数上，再用恒等函数的唯一性收口。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `TendsToAt f a L → AgreeNear f (fun x => x) a → L ~ a`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: tendsToAt_congr · tendsToAt_unique_id · ratRel_symm。

exercises.template:
theorem demo_congr_id (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a L : ratRep)
    (h : TendsToAt f a L)
    (hid : AgreeNear f (fun (x : ratRep) => x) a) :
    ratRel L a :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem demo_congr_id (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a L : ratRep)
    (h : TendsToAt f a L)
    (hid : AgreeNear f (fun (x : ratRep) => x) a) :
    ratRel L a :=
  ratRel_symm a L
    (tendsToAt_unique_id a L
      (tendsToAt_congr f (fun (x : ratRep) => x) a L h hid))

exercises.unit: 单元144 非零因子消去：导数为什么只有一个值
exercises.name: intRel_zero_of_eq
exercises.title: 单元144 非零因子消去：导数为什么只有一个值
exercises.prompt:
单元144 非零因子消去：导数为什么只有一个值

导数的定义把「曲线在一点附近最像哪条直线」交给两个存在量词：存在一个 斜率函数，存在一个极限值。可导只保证这样的值至少有一个。要把「函数在 这一点的导数」当成确定的数来用，还得说明至多有一个。极限值的唯一性已经 补上了；斜率函数本身的唯一性还欠着。

同一个函数的两条斜率函数在 a 之外都满足同一个乘积等式， (x - a) · q x ~ f x - f a 与 (x - a) · r x ~ f x - f a。把右边接起来， 就得到 (x - a) · q x ~ (x - a) · r x。只要 x ≠ a，因子 x - a 就不为零； 从乘积等式里约掉它，q x 与 r x 就相等。

于是问题归结为一道纯代数题：在 ℚ 里，若 u ≠ 0 且 u · v ~ u · w，能不能 断言 v ~ w？答案是能，但证明并不只是「两边除以 u」——课程还没有构造 有理数的倒数。得回到代表元：有理数写成 (p - q)/(m+1)，乘法是整数代表元 的乘法。消去非零因子就变成从整数等式里约掉一个非零代表元。

整数层的钥匙是 ℕ 的正因子消去律。若 (p - q) ≠ 0，则 p 与 q 有一边更大； 把大的写成小的加上 k+1，等式两边就出现公共因子 (k+1)，约掉之后剩下的 正是两个分子的相等。两支只差一个符号：差为正时公共因子是 k+1，差为负 时是 -(k+1)，交换律把负号挪到另一侧。

得到消去律之后，导数值的唯一性是几步直接的搬运：两条斜率函数在 a 附近 相等，极限只读邻域，于是两个极限相等。常函数与恒等函数是两个可以逐字 读出的样本：它们的导数只能是零与一。

边界：函数取 ratRep → ratRep，停在有理代表元层；不构造倒数，不新增公理， 也不碰 kernel/front。

零的判别

整数代表元 (p, q) 与零相等，条件是 p + 0 = 0 + q，也就是 p = q。 先取一个方向：若 p 与 q 相等，两个交叉和就相同。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把 `intRel` 展开成 `p + 0 = 0 + q`；用假设把 q 换成 p，再用 `add_zero` 与 `zero_add` 收拢。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `p = q → intRel (p, q) (0, 0)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: add_zero · zero_add · Eq.symm · Eq.trans。

exercises.template:
theorem intRel_zero_of_eq (p q : Nat) (h : p = q) :
    intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat p q) (@prod_mk Nat Nat Nat.zero Nat.zero) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem intRel_zero_of_eq (p q : Nat) (h : p = q) :
    intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat p q) (@prod_mk Nat Nat Nat.zero Nat.zero) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add p Nat.zero)
    p
    (Nat.add Nat.zero q)
    (add_zero p)
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat p q (Nat.add Nat.zero q) h
      (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (Nat.add Nat.zero q) q (zero_add q)))

exercises.unit: 单元144 非零因子消去：导数为什么只有一个值
exercises.name: ratRel_zero_of_num_zero
exercises.title: 有理数的分母是正的，乘上它不会把非零的分子变成零。反过来，分子为零时， 整个有理数也为零：把 `ratRel` 展开成交叉相乘，左边只剩分子，右边是零 乘上 x 的分母。
exercises.prompt: 有理数的分母是正的，乘上它不会把非零的分子变成零。反过来，分子为零时， 整个有理数也为零：把 `ratRel` 展开成交叉相乘，左边只剩分子，右边是零 乘上 x 的分母。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把 `ratRel x 0` 展开成交叉相乘：左边是 `numOf x` 乘零的分母 `(1,0)`，右边是零乘 x 的分母。左边用 `mulRep_den` 收回 `numOf x`，右边用零乘收成零，再把假设接上去。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `intRel (numOf x) (0, 0) → ratRel x ratZeroRep`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: mulRep_den · 零乘 · intRel_symm · intRel_trans · intRel_of_eq。

exercises.template:
theorem ratRel_zero_of_num_zero (x : ratRep)
    (h : intRel (numOf x) (@prod_mk Nat Nat Nat.zero Nat.zero)) :
    ratRel x ratZeroRep :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratRel_zero_of_num_zero (x : ratRep)
    (h : intRel (numOf x) (@prod_mk Nat Nat Nat.zero Nat.zero)) :
    ratRel x ratZeroRep :=
  intRel_trans
    (mulRep (numOf x) (den (denOf ratZeroRep)))
    (numOf x)
    (mulRep (numOf ratZeroRep) (den (denOf x)))
    (mulRep_den_zero (Prod.fst Nat Nat (numOf x)) (Prod.snd Nat Nat (numOf x)))
    (intRel_trans
      (numOf x)
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat Nat.zero Nat.zero)
      (mulRep (numOf ratZeroRep) (den (denOf x)))
      h
      (intRel_symm
        (mulRep (numOf ratZeroRep) (den (denOf x)))
        (@prod_mk Nat Nat Nat.zero Nat.zero)
        (intRel_of_eq
          (mulRep (numOf ratZeroRep) (den (denOf x)))
          (@prod_mk Nat Nat Nat.zero Nat.zero)
          (mulRep_zero_pair (Nat.succ (denOf x)) Nat.zero))))

exercises.unit: 单元144 非零因子消去：导数为什么只有一个值
exercises.name: ratRel_zero_iff_num_zero
exercises.title: 反方向同样成立。若 x 与零相等，把交叉相乘的等式左边约掉零的分母 `den 0`， 剩下的就是分子；右边是零乘 x 的分母，仍是零。
exercises.prompt: 反方向同样成立。若 x 与零相等，把交叉相乘的等式左边约掉零的分母 `den 0`， 剩下的就是分子；右边是零乘 x 的分母，仍是零。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把 `ratRel` 展开成交叉相乘；左边约掉零的分母 `den 0` 后就是分子，右边零乘 x 的分母仍是零，两个方向都沿这条等式接起来。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel (qrep p q m) ratZeroRep ↔ intRel (p, q) (0, 0)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: mulRep_den · 零乘 · intRel_of_eq · intRel_symm · intRel_trans · Iff.intro。

exercises.template:
theorem ratRel_zero_iff_num_zero (p q m : Nat) :
    ratRel (qrep p q m) ratZeroRep ↔
      intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat p q) (@prod_mk Nat Nat Nat.zero Nat.zero) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratRel_zero_iff_num_zero (p q m : Nat) :
    ratRel (qrep p q m) ratZeroRep ↔
      intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat p q) (@prod_mk Nat Nat Nat.zero Nat.zero) :=
  Iff.intro
    (fun (h : ratRel (qrep p q m) ratZeroRep) =>
      intRel_trans
        (@prod_mk Nat Nat p q)
        (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat p q) (den Nat.zero))
        (@prod_mk Nat Nat Nat.zero Nat.zero)
        (intRel_symm
          (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat p q) (den Nat.zero))
          (@prod_mk Nat Nat p q)
          (mulRep_den_zero p q))
        (intRel_trans
          (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat p q) (den Nat.zero))
          (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat Nat.zero Nat.zero) (den m))
          (@prod_mk Nat Nat Nat.zero Nat.zero)
          h
          (intRel_of_eq
            (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat Nat.zero Nat.zero) (den m))
            (@prod_mk Nat Nat Nat.zero Nat.zero)
            (mulRep_zero_pair (Nat.succ m) Nat.zero))))
    (fun (h : intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat p q)
        (@prod_mk Nat Nat Nat.zero Nat.zero)) =>
      ratRel_zero_of_num_zero (qrep p q m) h)

exercises.unit: 单元144 非零因子消去：导数为什么只有一个值
exercises.name: intRel_cancel_nonzero
exercises.title: 若代表元 (p, q) 不为零，而它与两个分子的乘积相等，就可以约掉它。 p 与 q 有一边更大，把大的写成小的加 k+1，等式两边出现公共因子 k+1； 正因子消去律把它约掉，剩下的正是 (c, d) 与 (e, f) 的交叉和。
exercises.prompt: 若代表元 (p, q) 不为零，而它与两个分子的乘积相等，就可以约掉它。 p 与 q 有一边更大，把大的写成小的加 k+1，等式两边出现公共因子 k+1； 正因子消去律把它约掉，剩下的正是 (c, d) 与 (e, f) 的交叉和。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 序是全的，对 `p ≤ q` 与 `q ≤ p` 分两支；非零假设先排掉 `p = q`，剩下的一支把大的写成小的加 `k+1`，两边约掉公共的正因子，再换回交叉和。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: leNat_total · leNat_eq_or_succ · Or.elim · mul_cancel_pos。

exercises.template:
theorem intRel_cancel_nonzero (p q c d e f : Nat)
    (hne : ¬ intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat p q)
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat Nat.zero Nat.zero))
    (h : intRel (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat p q) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
                (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat p q) (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f))) :
    intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem intRel_cancel_nonzero (p q c d e f : Nat)
    (hne : ¬ intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat p q)
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat Nat.zero Nat.zero))
    (h : intRel (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat p q) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
                (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat p q) (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f))) :
    intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f) :=
  @Or.elim (LeNat p q) (LeNat q p)
    (intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f))
    (fun (hpq : LeNat p q) => intRel_cancel_nonzero_pos p q c d e f hpq hne h)
    (fun (hqp : LeNat q p) => intRel_cancel_nonzero_neg p q c d e f hqp hne h)
    (leNat_total p q)

exercises.unit: 单元144 非零因子消去：导数为什么只有一个值
exercises.name: ratMul_cancel
exercises.title: 有理数层的同一件事。把 u 拆成 (p - q)/(m+1)，把 v 与 w 拆成各自的 分子与分母；多出来的公共分母先对齐，再交给整数层的消去。u 不为零 翻译成 (p, q) 不为零，这正是上一条的入口。
exercises.prompt: 有理数层的同一件事。把 u 拆成 (p - q)/(m+1)，把 v 与 w 拆成各自的 分子与分母；多出来的公共分母先对齐，再交给整数层的消去。u 不为零 翻译成 (p, q) 不为零，这正是上一条的入口。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 u、v、w 依次拆成 `qrep`；用 `ratRel_zero_iff_num_zero` 把 `u ≠ 0` 翻成分子序对不为零；把两侧的公共分母对齐，再约掉非零的分子。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratRel_zero_iff_num_zero · Iff.mpr · mulRep_den_swap_gen · mul_cancel_pos。

exercises.template:
theorem ratMul_cancel (u v w : Prod (Prod Nat Nat) Nat) :
    ¬ ratRel u ratZeroRep →
    ratRel (ratMulRep u v) (ratMulRep u w) → ratRel v w :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratMul_cancel (u v w : Prod (Prod Nat Nat) Nat) :
    ¬ ratRel u ratZeroRep →
    ratRel (ratMulRep u v) (ratMulRep u w) → ratRel v w :=
  match u with
  | prod_mk (prod_mk p q) m =>
    match v with
    | prod_mk (prod_mk c d) n =>
      match w with
      | prod_mk (prod_mk e f) k =>
        fun (hu : ¬ ratRel (qrep p q m) ratZeroRep)
            (h : ratRel (ratMulRep (qrep p q m) (qrep c d n))
                       (ratMulRep (qrep p q m) (qrep e f k))) =>
          ratMul_cancel_aux p q m c d n e f k
            (fun (hz : intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat p q)
                (@prod_mk Nat Nat Nat.zero Nat.zero)) =>
              hu (Iff.mpr (ratRel_zero_iff_num_zero p q m) hz))
            h

exercises.unit: 单元144 非零因子消去：导数为什么只有一个值
exercises.name: ratSubRep_ne_zero
exercises.title: 差 x - a 不为零，等价于 x 与 a 不相等。若差为零，两边同时加上 a， 左边收回 x，右边是 0 + a，于是 x 与 a 相等，与假设冲突。
exercises.prompt: 差 x - a 不为零，等价于 x 与 a 不相等。若差为零，两边同时加上 a， 左边收回 x，右边是 0 + a，于是 x 与 a 相等，与假设冲突。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 若 `x - a ~ 0`，两边同加 a；左边用 `ratSubRep_add_self` 收回 x，右边用 `ratAdd_zero_left` 收回 a，再用 `ratRel_trans` 得到 `x ~ a`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratSubRep_add_self · ratAdd_zero_left · ratAddRep_wd_gen · ratRel_trans_gen。

exercises.template:
theorem ratSubRep_ne_zero (x a : ratRep) (h : ¬ ratRel x a) :
    ¬ ratRel (ratSubRep x a) ratZeroRep :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratSubRep_ne_zero (x a : ratRep) (h : ¬ ratRel x a) :
    ¬ ratRel (ratSubRep x a) ratZeroRep :=
  fun (hz : ratRel (ratSubRep x a) ratZeroRep) =>
    h (ratRel_trans_gen x (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x a) a) a
      (ratRel_symm (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x a) a) x
        (ratSubRep_add_self x a))
      (ratRel_trans_gen (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x a) a)
        (ratAddRep ratZeroRep a) a
        (ratAddRep_wd_gen (ratSubRep x a) ratZeroRep a hz)
        (ratAdd_zero_left a)))

exercises.unit: 单元144 非零因子消去：导数为什么只有一个值
exercises.name: isSlope_agree
exercises.title: 两条斜率函数在 a 之外逐点相等。把两条乘积等式的右边接起来，左边就是 (x - a) · q x ~ (x - a) · r x；x - a 不为零，消去它即可。
exercises.prompt: 两条斜率函数在 a 之外逐点相等。把两条乘积等式的右边接起来，左边就是 (x - a) · q x ~ (x - a) · r x；x - a 不为零，消去它即可。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把 `hq x hx` 与 `hr x hx` 的右边接起来，得到 `(x-a)*q x ~ (x-a)*r x`；再用 `ratMul_cancel` 与 `ratSubRep_ne_zero` 约掉 `x-a`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `IsSlope f a q → IsSlope f a r → x ≠ a → q x ~ r x`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: IsSlope · ratRel_trans_gen · ratRel_symm · ratMul_cancel · ratSubRep_ne_zero。

exercises.template:
theorem isSlope_agree (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a : ratRep)
    (q r : ratRep → ratRep) (hq : IsSlope f a q) (hr : IsSlope f a r)
    (x : ratRep) (hx : ¬ ratRel x a) : ratRel (q x) (r x) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem isSlope_agree (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a : ratRep)
    (q r : ratRep → ratRep) (hq : IsSlope f a q) (hr : IsSlope f a r)
    (x : ratRep) (hx : ¬ ratRel x a) : ratRel (q x) (r x) :=
  ratMul_cancel (ratSubRep x a) (q x) (r x)
    (ratSubRep_ne_zero x a hx)
    (ratRel_trans_gen
      (ratMulRep (ratSubRep x a) (q x))
      (ratSubRep (f x) (f a))
      (ratMulRep (ratSubRep x a) (r x))
      (hq x hx)
      (ratRel_symm (ratMulRep (ratSubRep x a) (r x))
        (ratSubRep (f x) (f a)) (hr x hx)))

exercises.unit: 单元144 非零因子消去：导数为什么只有一个值
exercises.name: slope_agree_near
exercises.title: 逐点相等可以升成邻域里的相等：半径取 1 就够，因为逐点相等在每一点都成立。
exercises.prompt: 逐点相等可以升成邻域里的相等：半径取 1 就够，因为逐点相等在每一点都成立。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 取 δ = 1，把 `ratLtRep_zero_one` 与逐点的 `isSlope_agree` 装进 `AgreeNear`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `IsSlope f a q → IsSlope f a r → AgreeNear q r a`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: AgreeNear · ratOneRep · ratLtRep_zero_one · isSlope_agree。

exercises.template:
theorem slope_agree_near (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a : ratRep)
    (q r : ratRep → ratRep) (hq : IsSlope f a q) (hr : IsSlope f a r) :
    AgreeNear q r a :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem slope_agree_near (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a : ratRep)
    (q r : ratRep → ratRep) (hq : IsSlope f a q) (hr : IsSlope f a r) :
    AgreeNear q r a :=
  Exists.intro ratOneRep
    (And.intro ratLtRep_zero_one
      (fun (x : ratRep) (_hx : close x a ratOneRep)
          (hne : ¬ ratRel x a) =>
        isSlope_agree f a q r hq hr x hne))

exercises.unit: 单元144 非零因子消去：导数为什么只有一个值
exercises.name: hasDerivAt_unique
exercises.title: 导数值的唯一性。两条导数各给一个斜率函数与一个极限；两个斜率函数在 a 附近相等，极限只读邻域，所以第二条极限也是第一条的极限值；再交给极限 值的唯一性。
exercises.prompt: 导数值的唯一性。两条导数各给一个斜率函数与一个极限；两个斜率函数在 a 附近相等，极限只读邻域，所以第二条极限也是第一条的极限值；再交给极限 值的唯一性。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 拆开 hL 与 hM，得到 q、r 及两条极限；用 `slope_agree_near` 与 `tendsToAt_congr` 把 L 搬到 r 上；最后用 `tendsToAt_unique` 收口。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `HasDerivAt f a L → HasDerivAt f a M → L ~ M`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.elim · slope_agree_near · tendsToAt_congr · tendsToAt_unique。

exercises.template:
theorem hasDerivAt_unique (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a L M : ratRep)
    (hL : HasDerivAt f a L) (hM : HasDerivAt f a M) : ratRel L M :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem hasDerivAt_unique (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a L M : ratRep)
    (hL : HasDerivAt f a L) (hM : HasDerivAt f a M) : ratRel L M :=
  Exists.elim hL
    (fun (q : ratRep → ratRep)
        (hq : IsSlope f a q ∧ TendsToAt q a L) =>
      Exists.elim hM
        (fun (r : ratRep → ratRep)
            (hr : IsSlope f a r ∧ TendsToAt r a M) =>
          tendsToAt_unique r a L M
            (tendsToAt_congr q r a L (And.right hq)
              (slope_agree_near f a q r (And.left hq) (And.left hr)))
            (And.right hr)))

exercises.template:

exercises.solution:
theorem demo_deriv_id_unique (a L : ratRep)

exercises.unit: 单元145 导数的和与差：先让乘法对加法分配
exercises.name: ratMul_add
exercises.title: 单元145 导数的和与差：先让乘法对加法分配
exercises.prompt:
单元145 导数的和与差：先让乘法对加法分配

两条曲线在 a 点各有导数 L 与 M，把纵坐标逐点相加，新曲线在这一点的 导数是不是 L + M？差商的形状几乎是现成的：两条乘积等式 `(x - a) · q x ~ f x - f a` 与 `(x - a) · r x ~ g x - g a` 相加，右边 正好是 `(f x + g x) - (f a + g a)`。挡路的只有左边一步：要把 `(x - a) · q x + (x - a) · r x` 收成 `(x - a) · (q x + r x)`。

课程的 ℚ 是整数对的商，乘法与加法各自先通分再运算。乘法对加法分配在 代表元层不是定义性相等：两边的分母相差一个因子，交叉相乘之后要比较 四个单项式的次序。前面的单元没用到这条分配律，它一直空着；导数的和 第一次需要它。

证明把两边约到同一个分母。约掉公共因子之后，剩下的等式只关于四个 单项式：左边按 `ac`、`ae`、`bd`、`bf` 排列，右边按 `ac`、`bd`、`ae`、 `bf` 排列，只差中间两项。ℕ 的乘法交换、结合与分配负责对齐每一项， `add_shift` 负责交换中间两项。

边界：函数取 ratRep → ratRep，停在有理代表元层；不构造倒数，不新增 公理，也不碰 kernel/front。常数倍还要一条乘法对第二个因子的同余， 留到后面的单元。

乘法对加法分配

把 x、y、z 依次写成 `(a - b)/(m + 1)`、`(c - d)/(n + 1)`、 `(e - f)/(k + 1)`。左边的分母是 `(m + 1)(n + 1)(k + 1)`，右边的分母是 `(m + 1)²(n + 1)(k + 1)`，多出一个 `m + 1`。交叉相乘并约掉公共因子 之后，要证的是四个单项式的重排：`ac(k+1) + ae(n+1) + bd(k+1) + bf(n+1)` 与 `ac(k+1) + bd(k+1) + ae(n+1) + bf(n+1)` 相等。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把 x、y、z 拆成字面三元组；两边分别用 `mulRep_den_form` 化成同一形状的交叉乘积；约掉公共因子 `(m+1)(n+1)(k+1)` 后，用 ℕ 的交换、结合、分配把四个单项式逐项对齐，再用 `add_shift` 交换中间两项。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel (ratMulRep x (ratAddRep y z)) (ratAddRep (ratMulRep x y) (ratMulRep x z))`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: mulRep_den_form · mul_cancel_pos · myMul_assoc · myMul_comm · mul_add · mul_add_right · add_shift · intRel_trans。

exercises.template:
theorem ratMul_add (x y z : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratMulRep x (ratAddRep y z))
      (ratAddRep (ratMulRep x y) (ratMulRep x z)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratMul_add (x y z : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratMulRep x (ratAddRep y z))
      (ratAddRep (ratMulRep x y) (ratMulRep x z)) :=
  ratMul_add_pack x y z

exercises.unit: 单元145 导数的和与差：先让乘法对加法分配
exercises.name: ratMul_sub
exercises.title: `x · (y - z)` 里的减法按定义是 `y + (-z)`。分配之后第二项是 `x · (-z)`， 它等于 `-(x · z)`：两边按 `qrep` 展开后，第一格都是 `a·d + b·c` 取负， 第二格都是 `a·c +
exercises.prompt: `x · (y - z)` 里的减法按定义是 `y + (-z)`。分配之后第二项是 `x · (-z)`， 它等于 `-(x · z)`：两边按 `qrep` 展开后，第一格都是 `a·d + b·c` 取负， 第二格都是 `a·c + b·d` 取负，只是两项的次序不同。把这一项换掉， `x · (y - z)` 就收成 `x · y - x · z`。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把 `y - z` 展开成 `y + (-z)`；用 `ratMul_add` 分配；再用 `ratMul_neg` 把 `x·(-z)` 换成 `-(x·z)`；最后按减法的定义把 `x·y + -(x·z)` 收回 `x·y - x·z`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel (ratMulRep x (ratSubRep y z)) (ratSubRep (ratMulRep x y) (ratMulRep x z))`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratMul_add · ratMul_neg · ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen · ratRel_trans_gen。

exercises.template:
theorem ratMul_sub (x y z : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratMulRep x (ratSubRep y z))
      (ratSubRep (ratMulRep x y) (ratMulRep x z)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratMul_sub (x y z : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratMulRep x (ratSubRep y z))
      (ratSubRep (ratMulRep x y) (ratMulRep x z)) :=
  ratRel_trans_gen
    (ratMulRep x (ratSubRep y z))
    (ratAddRep (ratMulRep x y) (ratMulRep x (ratNegRep z)))
    (ratSubRep (ratMulRep x y) (ratMulRep x z))
    (ratMul_add x y (ratNegRep z))
    (ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen (ratMulRep x y) (ratMulRep x (ratNegRep z))
      (ratNegRep (ratMulRep x z)) (ratMul_neg x z))

exercises.unit: 单元145 导数的和与差：先让乘法对加法分配
exercises.name: ratAdd_sub_sub
exercises.title: `(p - q) + (r - s)` 可以并成一个差 `(p + r) - (q + s)`。四个项不直接 混在一起：先把两个差各补一个中间项，`p - q` 与 `(p + r) - (r + q)` 相等，`r - s` 与 `(r
exercises.prompt: `(p - q) + (r - s)` 可以并成一个差 `(p + r) - (q + s)`。四个项不直接 混在一起：先把两个差各补一个中间项，`p - q` 与 `(p + r) - (r + q)` 相等，`r - s` 与 `(r + q) - (s + q)` 相等。补好之后两个差共享中间项 `r + q`，`ratSubRep_add` 把它消掉，剩下的正是 `(p + r) - (q + s)`。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把第一个差 `p - q` 换成 `(p+r) - (r+q)`（减去同一个加数），把第二个差 `r - s` 换成 `(r+q) - (s+q)`；两个补好的差共享中间项 `r+q`，交给 `ratSubRep_add` 消去，再把 `s+q` 换成 `q+s`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel ((p - q) + (r - s)) ((p + r) - (q + s))`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratSubRep_add_cancel · ratSubRep_add · ratSubRep_wd · ratAdd_comm · ratAddRep_wd_gen · ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen。

exercises.template:
theorem ratAdd_sub_sub (p q r s : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratAddRep (ratSubRep p q) (ratSubRep r s))
      (ratSubRep (ratAddRep p r) (ratAddRep q s)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratAdd_sub_sub (p q r s : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratAddRep (ratSubRep p q) (ratSubRep r s))
      (ratSubRep (ratAddRep p r) (ratAddRep q s)) :=
  ratRel_trans_gen
    (ratAddRep (ratSubRep p q) (ratSubRep r s))
    (ratAddRep (ratSubRep (ratAddRep p r) (ratAddRep r q))
               (ratSubRep r s))
    (ratSubRep (ratAddRep p r) (ratAddRep q s))
    (ratAddRep_wd_gen
      (ratSubRep p q) (ratSubRep (ratAddRep p r) (ratAddRep r q))
      (ratSubRep r s)
      (ratRel_trans_gen
        (ratSubRep p q)
        (ratSubRep (ratAddRep p r) (ratAddRep q r))
        (ratSubRep (ratAddRep p r) (ratAddRep r q))
        (ratRel_symm (ratSubRep (ratAddRep p r) (ratAddRep q r))
          (ratSubRep p q) (ratSubRep_add_cancel p q r))
        (ratSubRep_wd (ratAddRep p r) (ratAddRep p r)
          (ratAddRep q r) (ratAddRep r q)
          (ratRel_refl (ratAddRep p r)) (ratAdd_comm q r))))
    (ratRel_trans_gen
      (ratAddRep (ratSubRep (ratAddRep p r) (ratAddRep r q))
                 (ratSubRep r s))
      (ratAddRep (ratSubRep (ratAddRep p r) (ratAddRep r q))
                 (ratSubRep (ratAddRep r q) (ratAddRep s q)))
      (ratSubRep (ratAddRep p r) (ratAddRep q s))
      (ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen
        (ratSubRep (ratAddRep p r) (ratAddRep r q))
        (ratSubRep r s)
        (ratSubRep (ratAddRep r q) (ratAddRep s q))
        (ratRel_symm (ratSubRep (ratAddRep r q) (ratAddRep s q))
          (ratSubRep r s) (ratSubRep_add_cancel r s q)))
      (ratRel_trans_gen
        (ratAddRep (ratSubRep (ratAddRep p r) (ratAddRep r q))
                   (ratSubRep (ratAddRep r q) (ratAddRep s q)))
        (ratSubRep (ratAddRep p r) (ratAddRep s q))
        (ratSubRep (ratAddRep p r) (ratAddRep q s))
        (ratSubRep_add (ratAddRep p r) (ratAddRep r q) (ratAddRep s q))
        (ratSubRep_wd (ratAddRep p r) (ratAddRep p r)
          (ratAddRep s q) (ratAddRep q s)
          (ratRel_refl (ratAddRep p r)) (ratAdd_comm s q))))

exercises.unit: 单元145 导数的和与差：先让乘法对加法分配
exercises.name: isSlope_add
exercises.title: f 与 g 的斜率函数分别是 q 与 r。逐点把 `(x - a) · (q x + r x)` 用 `ratMul_add` 拆成两份乘积，两条乘积等式分别换成 `f x - f a` 与 `g x - g a`，最后用 `ratAdd_
exercises.prompt: f 与 g 的斜率函数分别是 q 与 r。逐点把 `(x - a) · (q x + r x)` 用 `ratMul_add` 拆成两份乘积，两条乘积等式分别换成 `f x - f a` 与 `g x - g a`，最后用 `ratAdd_sub_sub` 并成 `(f x + g x) - (f a + g a)`。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 固定 x 与 `x ≠ a`；把 `(x-a)·(q x + r x)` 分配成两份乘积；每一份用对应的斜率等式换成函数值之差；再用 `ratAdd_sub_sub` 把两个差并成一个差。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `IsSlope (fun x => f x + g x) a (fun x => q x + r x)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratMul_add · ratAddRep_wd_gen · ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen · ratAdd_sub_sub · ratRel_trans_gen。

exercises.template:
theorem isSlope_add (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (a : ratRep)
    (q r : ratRep → ratRep) (hq : IsSlope f a q) (hr : IsSlope g a r) :
    IsSlope (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) (g x)) a
      (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (q x) (r x)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem isSlope_add (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (a : ratRep)
    (q r : ratRep → ratRep) (hq : IsSlope f a q) (hr : IsSlope g a r) :
    IsSlope (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) (g x)) a
      (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (q x) (r x)) :=
  fun (x : ratRep) (hx : ¬ ratRel x a) =>
    ratRel_trans_gen
      (ratMulRep (ratSubRep x a) (ratAddRep (q x) (r x)))
      (ratAddRep (ratMulRep (ratSubRep x a) (q x))
                 (ratMulRep (ratSubRep x a) (r x)))
      (ratSubRep (ratAddRep (f x) (g x)) (ratAddRep (f a) (g a)))
      (ratMul_add (ratSubRep x a) (q x) (r x))
      (ratRel_trans_gen
        (ratAddRep (ratMulRep (ratSubRep x a) (q x))
                   (ratMulRep (ratSubRep x a) (r x)))
        (ratAddRep (ratSubRep (f x) (f a))
                   (ratSubRep (g x) (g a)))
        (ratSubRep (ratAddRep (f x) (g x)) (ratAddRep (f a) (g a)))
        (ratRel_trans_gen
          (ratAddRep (ratMulRep (ratSubRep x a) (q x))
                     (ratMulRep (ratSubRep x a) (r x)))
          (ratAddRep (ratSubRep (f x) (f a))
                     (ratMulRep (ratSubRep x a) (r x)))
          (ratAddRep (ratSubRep (f x) (f a))
                     (ratSubRep (g x) (g a)))
          (ratAddRep_wd_gen
            (ratMulRep (ratSubRep x a) (q x))
            (ratSubRep (f x) (f a))
            (ratMulRep (ratSubRep x a) (r x))
            (hq x hx))
          (ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen
            (ratSubRep (f x) (f a))
            (ratMulRep (ratSubRep x a) (r x))
            (ratSubRep (g x) (g a))
            (hr x hx)))
        (ratAdd_sub_sub (f x) (f a) (g x) (g a)))

exercises.name: hasDerivAt_add
exercises.title: 两个导数各给一个斜率函数与一个极限值。和的斜率函数取 `q + r`，和的 极限值取 `L + M`：前半交给上一条，后半交给函数极限的加法律。
exercises.prompt: 两个导数各给一个斜率函数与一个极限值。和的斜率函数取 `q + r`，和的 极限值取 `L + M`：前半交给上一条，后半交给函数极限的加法律。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 拆开两条导数，各得一个斜率函数与一条极限；把两个斜率函数逐点相加，用 `isSlope_add` 与前一半拼起来；极限交给 `tendsToAt_add`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `HasDerivAt (fun x => f x + g x) a (L + M)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.elim · isSlope_add · tendsToAt_add · And.left · And.right。

exercises.template:
theorem hasDerivAt_add (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (a L M : ratRep)
    (hf : HasDerivAt f a L) (hg : HasDerivAt g a M) :
    HasDerivAt (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) (g x)) a
      (ratAddRep L M) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem hasDerivAt_add (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (a L M : ratRep)
    (hf : HasDerivAt f a L) (hg : HasDerivAt g a M) :
    HasDerivAt (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) (g x)) a
      (ratAddRep L M) :=
  Exists.elim hf
    (fun (q : ratRep → ratRep)
        (hq : IsSlope f a q ∧ TendsToAt q a L) =>
      Exists.elim hg
        (fun (r : ratRep → ratRep)
            (hr : IsSlope g a r ∧ TendsToAt r a M) =>
          Exists.intro (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (q x) (r x))
            (And.intro
              (isSlope_add f g a q r (And.left hq) (And.left hr))
              (tendsToAt_add q r a L M (And.right hq) (And.right hr)))))

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 拆开两个可导假设，各取一个导数值；把两个值相加作为和的导数，交给 `hasDerivAt_add`。

hints.label: 关键件

exercises.template:
theorem differentiableAt_add (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (a : ratRep)
    (hf : DifferentiableAt f a) (hg : DifferentiableAt g a) :
    DifferentiableAt (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) (g x)) a :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem differentiableAt_add (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (a : ratRep)
    (hf : DifferentiableAt f a) (hg : DifferentiableAt g a) :
    DifferentiableAt (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) (g x)) a :=
  Exists.elim hf
    (fun (L : ratRep) (hL : HasDerivAt f a L) =>
      Exists.elim hg
        (fun (M : ratRep) (hM : HasDerivAt g a M) =>
          Exists.intro (ratAddRep L M)
            (hasDerivAt_add f g a L M hL hM)))

exercises.name: isSlope_sub
exercises.title: 取负已经备好：`isSlope_neg` 把斜率函数整体取负。把 `f - g` 读成 `f + (-g)`，它的斜率函数就是 `q + (-r)`，也就是 `q - r`。
exercises.prompt: 取负已经备好：`isSlope_neg` 把斜率函数整体取负。把 `f - g` 读成 `f + (-g)`，它的斜率函数就是 `q + (-r)`，也就是 `q - r`。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把 `f - g` 写成 `f + (-g)`；对 `-g` 用 `isSlope_neg` 把斜率函数取负；再把两个斜率函数交给 `isSlope_add`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `IsSlope (fun x => f x - g x) a (fun x => q x - r x)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: isSlope_neg · isSlope_add。

exercises.template:
theorem isSlope_sub (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (a : ratRep)
    (q r : ratRep → ratRep) (hq : IsSlope f a q) (hr : IsSlope g a r) :
    IsSlope (fun (x : ratRep) => ratSubRep (f x) (g x)) a
      (fun (x : ratRep) => ratSubRep (q x) (r x)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem isSlope_sub (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (a : ratRep)
    (q r : ratRep → ratRep) (hq : IsSlope f a q) (hr : IsSlope g a r) :
    IsSlope (fun (x : ratRep) => ratSubRep (f x) (g x)) a
      (fun (x : ratRep) => ratSubRep (q x) (r x)) :=
  isSlope_add f (fun (x : ratRep) => ratNegRep (g x)) a q
    (fun (x : ratRep) => ratNegRep (r x)) hq (isSlope_neg g a r hr)

exercises.unit: 单元146 乘法的保序性：正因子不改变不等号
exercises.name: ratLeRep_mul_pos_right
exercises.title: 单元146 乘法的保序性：正因子不改变不等号
exercises.prompt:
单元146 乘法的保序性：正因子不改变不等号

导数要回答的一个问题是：曲线整体乘上一个常数，斜率会怎么变？把逐点 相乘写成差商，绕不开一条关于乘法的常识——正数乘在不等式两边，不等号 的方向不变。这条常识在 ℚ 上不是免费的：乘法先通分再运算，正因子在 分母里留下的因子要靠约分消掉，而约分本身要用乘法的交换、结合与分配。

证明把 `x ≤ y` 与 `0 < z` 都拆到整数代表元。`x ≤ y` 是交叉相乘之后两个 ℕ 的和的大小比较；`0 < z` 说明 z 的分子两格一严一宽（`f ≤ e`），并且两 格不相等，于是第二格可以写成第一格加上一个正数 `t`。把 `e = f + t` 代进 目标，交叉乘积的两边都长出相同的四项，相消之后剩下的是 `x ≤ y` 两边同乘 `t`。ℕ 的乘法保序（`leNat_mul_right`）负责这一步，分配律负责把多出来的项 摆回原位。

严格版本多一步：若乘完之后两边相等，就用非零因子消去律把 z 约掉，得到 `x ~ y`，与严格小矛盾。两个正数的积为正，是把 `0 < y` 乘上正数 x，得到 `x·0 < x·y`，再把左边收回零。

边界：只做正因子。负因子要把不等号翻过来，需要先接上取负与乘法的交换； 常数倍的导数还要一条更细的估计，都留到后面的单元。不新增公理。

正因子乘在右边

变量写成展开后的序对类型，`match` 才能在证明里拆开三个代表元；结论里的 `ratRep` 只是它的定义别名，调用处照旧传有理数。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 依次拆开 x、y、z；`x ≤ y` 用 `mulRep_den_form` 化成两个 ℕ 和的大小比较；`0 < z` 给出 `f ≤ e` 与「两格不相等」，由此把 e 写成 `f + t`。两边交叉相乘、约掉公共因子 `(k+1)` 之后，剩下的正是 `x ≤ y` 两边同乘 t。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratLeRep x y → 0 < z → ratLeRep (x*z) (y*z)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: mulRep_den_form · ratDenRep_succ · leNat_mul_right · mul_add_right · leNat_mul_cancel。

exercises.template:
theorem ratLeRep_mul_pos_right (x y z : Prod (Prod Nat Nat) Nat) :
    ratLeRep x y → ratLtRep ratZeroRep z →
      ratLeRep (ratMulRep x z) (ratMulRep y z) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratLeRep_mul_pos_right (x y z : Prod (Prod Nat Nat) Nat) :
    ratLeRep x y → ratLtRep ratZeroRep z →
      ratLeRep (ratMulRep x z) (ratMulRep y z) :=
  match x with
  | prod_mk (prod_mk a b) m =>
    match y with
    | prod_mk (prod_mk c d) n =>
      match z with
      | prod_mk (prod_mk e f) k =>
        fun (hxy : ratLeRep (qrep a b m) (qrep c d n))
            (hz : ratLtRep ratZeroRep (qrep e f k)) =>
          ratLeRep_mul_pos_lit a b m c d n e f k hxy hz

exercises.prompt: 严格版本

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 弱序那一半直接搬。若乘完之后两边相等，把 z 移到前面来用 `ratMul_cancel` 约掉（z 不为零来自 `0 < z`），得到 `x ~ y`，与严格小矛盾。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratLtRep (ratMulRep x z) (ratMulRep y z)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLtRep_le · ratLeRep_mul_pos_right · ratMul_cancel · ratMul_comm · ratRel_trans_gen。

exercises.template:
theorem ratLtRep_mul_pos_right (x y z : ratRep) (hxy : ratLtRep x y)
    (hz : ratLtRep ratZeroRep z) :
    ratLtRep (ratMulRep x z) (ratMulRep y z) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratLtRep_mul_pos_right (x y z : ratRep) (hxy : ratLtRep x y)
    (hz : ratLtRep ratZeroRep z) :
    ratLtRep (ratMulRep x z) (ratMulRep y z) :=
  And.intro
    (ratLeRep_mul_pos_right x y z (ratLtRep_le x y hxy) hz)
    (fun (heq : ratRel (ratMulRep x z) (ratMulRep y z)) =>
      (And.right hxy)
        (ratMul_cancel z x y
          (fun (h0 : ratRel z ratZeroRep) =>
            (And.right hz) (ratRel_symm z ratZeroRep h0))
          (ratRel_trans_gen
            (ratMulRep z x) (ratMulRep y z) (ratMulRep z y)
            (ratRel_trans_gen
              (ratMulRep z x) (ratMulRep x z) (ratMulRep y z)
              (ratMul_comm z x) heq)
            (ratMul_comm y z))))

exercises.title: 单元147 乘法的符号：负因子把不等号翻过来
exercises.prompt:
单元147 乘法的符号：负因子把不等号翻过来

曲线在一点取极大值，意味着往左往右走，函数值都不再增加。把这句话翻译成 斜率，最后要判断两个量相乘的符号：自变量的改变是正还是负，函数值的改变 又跟着谁走。正正得正、正负得负、负负得正，这条关于乘法的常识在 ℚ 上要 回到代表元才能落地。

证明的骨架是单元141 的 `ratMul_neg`：`x·(-y) ~ -(x·y)`。把 `(-x)·y` 先交换成 `y·(-x)`，再用这条等式收成 `-(x·y)`；于是「负数乘正数」化归为 「正数乘正数的积取负」。单元146 的 `ratMul_pos` 给出正积， `ratLtRep_neg_of_pos` 与 `ratLtRep_pos_of_neg` 负责把积的符号翻回去。 两个负因子相乘则连翻两次，回到正积。

边界：只做符号的乘法表（同号得正、异号得负），不反过来从积的符号反推 因子的符号；那一步要用「积为零则因子为零」，留到后面的单元。函数仍取 `ratRep → ratRep`，不新增公理，也不碰 kernel/front。

取负把严格序翻回去

theorem positiveNearPunct_of_tendsToAt (q : ratRep → ratRep) (a L : ratRep)
    (hL : ratLtRep ratZeroRep L) (h : TendsToAt q a L) :
    PositiveNearPunct q a :=
  Exists.elim (h L hL)
    (fun (delta : ratRep)
        (hd : ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
          ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a delta → ¬ ratRel x a →
            close (q x) L L) =>
      Exists.intro delta
        (And.intro (And.left hd)
          (fun (x : ratRep) (hx : close x a delta) (hne : ¬ ratRel x a) =>
            ratLtRep_congr_snd ratZeroRep
              (ratAddRep (ratAddRep L (q x)) (ratNegRep L)) (q x)
              (ratLtRep_congr_fst ratZeroRep
                (ratAddRep L (ratNegRep L))
                (ratAddRep (ratAddRep L (q x)) (ratNegRep L))
                (ratLtRep_add_right L (ratAddRep L (q x)) (ratNegRep L)
                  (ratLtRep_congr_fst L
                    (ratAddRep (ratSubRep L (q x)) (q x))
                    (ratAddRep L (q x))
                    (ratLtRep_add_right (ratSubRep L (q x)) L (q x)
                      (close_neg_lt (q x) L L ((And.right hd) x hx hne)))
                    (ratRel_symm
                      (ratAddRep (ratSubRep L (q x)) (q x)) L
                      (ratSubRep_add_self L (q x)))))
                (ratRel_symm (ratAddRep L (ratNegRep L)) ratZeroRep
                  (ratAdd_neg_gen L)))
              (ratRel_trans_gen
                (ratAddRep (ratAddRep L (q x)) (ratNegRep L))
                (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (q x) L) (ratNegRep L))
                (q x)
                (ratAddRep_wd_gen (ratAddRep L (q x))
                  (ratAddRep (q x) L) (ratNegRep L)
                  (ratAdd_comm L (q x)))
                (ratRel_trans_gen
                  (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (q x) L) (ratNegRep L))
                  (ratAddRep (q x) (ratAddRep L (ratNegRep L)))
                  (q x)
                  (ratAdd_assoc (q x) L (ratNegRep L))
                  (ratRel_trans_gen
                    (ratAddRep (q x) (ratAddRep L (ratNegRep L)))
                    (ratAddRep (q x) ratZeroRep)
                    (q x)
                    (ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen (q x)
                      (ratAddRep L (ratNegRep L)) ratZeroRep
                      (ratAdd_neg_gen L))
                    (ratAdd_zero (q x))))))))

exercises.solution:
theorem risesRight_of_deriv_pos (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a L : ratRep)
    (h : HasDerivAt f a L) (hL : ratLtRep ratZeroRep L) :
    RisesRight f a :=
  Exists.elim h
    (fun (q : ratRep → ratRep)
        (hq : IsSlope f a q ∧ TendsToAt q a L) =>
      Exists.elim (Iff.mp (positiveNearPunct_iff q a)
          (positiveNearPunct_of_tendsToAt q a L hL (And.right hq)))
        (fun (delta : ratRep)
            (hd : ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
              ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a delta → ¬ ratRel x a →
                ratLtRep ratZeroRep (q x)) =>
          Exists.intro delta
            (And.intro (And.left hd)
              (fun (x : ratRep) (hax : ratLtRep a x)
                  (hx : close x a delta) =>
                ratLtRep_of_sub_pos (f x) (f a)
                  (ratLtRep_congr_snd ratZeroRep
                    (ratMulRep (q x) (ratSubRep x a))
                    (ratSubRep (f x) (f a))
                    (ratMul_pos (q x) (ratSubRep x a)
                      (posAt_apply q a delta hd x hx (not_ratRel_symm a x (ratLtRep_right a x hax)))
                      (ratLtRep_sub_pos x a hax))
                    (ratRel_trans_gen
                      (ratMulRep (q x) (ratSubRep x a))
                      (ratMulRep (ratSubRep x a) (q x))
                      (ratSubRep (f x) (f a))
                      (ratMul_comm (q x) (ratSubRep x a))
                      (isSlope_apply f a q (And.left hq) x (not_ratRel_symm a x (ratLtRep_right a x hax)))))))))

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把 `-q` 看成斜率函数的极限 `-L`：它是正的，符号引理给出 `-(q x) > 0`，也就是 `q x < 0`。x 在 a 左侧时 `x - a < 0`，两个负数相乘为正，再沿斜率等式搬到 `f x - f a`。

hints.label: 目标形态

exercises.template:
theorem risesLeft_of_deriv_neg (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a L : ratRep)
    (h : HasDerivAt f a L) (hL : ratLtRep L ratZeroRep) :

exercises.solution:
theorem risesLeft_of_deriv_neg (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a L : ratRep)
    (h : HasDerivAt f a L) (hL : ratLtRep L ratZeroRep) :
    RisesLeft f a :=
  Exists.elim h
    (fun (q : ratRep → ratRep)
        (hq : IsSlope f a q ∧ TendsToAt q a L) =>
      Exists.elim
        (Iff.mp (positiveNearPunct_iff (fun (x : ratRep) => ratNegRep (q x)) a)
          (positiveNearPunct_of_tendsToAt
            (fun (x : ratRep) => ratNegRep (q x)) a (ratNegRep L)
            (ratLtRep_pos_of_neg L hL) (tendsToAt_neg q a L (And.right hq))))
        (fun (delta : ratRep)
            (hd : ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
              ∀ (x : ratRep), close x a delta → ¬ ratRel x a →
                ratLtRep ratZeroRep (ratNegRep (q x))) =>
          Exists.intro delta
            (And.intro (And.left hd)
              (fun (x : ratRep) (hxa : ratLtRep x a)
                  (hx : close x a delta) =>
                ratLtRep_of_sub_pos (f x) (f a)
                  (ratLtRep_congr_snd ratZeroRep
                    (ratMulRep (q x) (ratSubRep x a))
                    (ratSubRep (f x) (f a))
                    (ratMul_neg_neg (q x) (ratSubRep x a)
                      (ratLtRep_of_neg_pos (q x)
                        (posAt_apply (fun (x : ratRep) => ratNegRep (q x)) a delta hd x hx
                          (ratLtRep_right x a hxa)))
                      (ratLtRep_congr_fst (ratSubRep x a)
                        (ratNegRep (ratSubRep a x)) ratZeroRep
                        (ratLtRep_neg_of_pos (ratSubRep a x)
                          (ratLtRep_sub_pos a x hxa))
                        (ratRel_symm (ratNegRep (ratSubRep a x)) (ratSubRep x a)
                          (ratNeg_sub_swap a x))))
                    (ratRel_trans_gen
                      (ratMulRep (q x) (ratSubRep x a))
                      (ratMulRep (ratSubRep x a) (q x))
                      (ratSubRep (f x) (f a))
                      (ratMul_comm (q x) (ratSubRep x a))
                      (isSlope_apply f a q (And.left hq) x (ratLtRep_right x a hxa))))))))

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 若 0 < L，右侧抬高与上一条的「不抬高」冲突；若 L < 0，左侧抬高同样冲突。于是 ¬ 0 < L 与 ¬ L < 0。序全性给 0 ≤ L 或 L ≤ 0，每支再用 `ratLeRep_eq_or_lt` 拆成相等或严格小，严格小那一支撞上刚得到的否定，相等那一支就是目标（必要时把等式两端对调）。

hints.body: `HasDerivAt f a L → LocalMaxAt f a → L ~ 0`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: risesRight_of_deriv_pos · risesLeft_of_deriv_neg · ratLeRep_total · ratLeRep_eq_or_lt · ratRel_symm · False.elim。

exercises.solution:
theorem deriv_zero_of_localMax (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a L : ratRep)
    (h : HasDerivAt f a L) (hmax : LocalMaxAt f a) :
    ratRel L ratZeroRep :=
  @Or.elim (ratLeRep ratZeroRep L) (ratLeRep L ratZeroRep) (ratRel L ratZeroRep)
    (fun (hge : ratLeRep ratZeroRep L) =>
      @Or.elim (ratRel ratZeroRep L) (ratLtRep ratZeroRep L) (ratRel L ratZeroRep)
        (fun (heq : ratRel ratZeroRep L) => ratRel_symm ratZeroRep L heq)
        (fun (hlt : ratLtRep ratZeroRep L) =>
          False.elim (not_risesRight_of_localMax f a hmax
            (risesRight_of_deriv_pos f a L h hlt)))
        (ratLeRep_eq_or_lt ratZeroRep L hge))
    (fun (hle : ratLeRep L ratZeroRep) =>
      @Or.elim (ratRel L ratZeroRep) (ratLtRep L ratZeroRep) (ratRel L ratZeroRep)
        (fun (heq : ratRel L ratZeroRep) => heq)
        (fun (hlt : ratLtRep L ratZeroRep) =>
          False.elim (not_risesLeft_of_localMax f a hmax
            (risesLeft_of_deriv_neg f a L h hlt)))
        (ratLeRep_eq_or_lt L ratZeroRep hle))
    (ratLeRep_total ratZeroRep L)

hints.body: 定义就是右边那串量词，两个方向都直接返回假设。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `NondecreasingNear f a ↔ ∃ delta, 0 < delta ∧ （左侧条件）∧（右侧条件）`。

exercises.template:
theorem nondecreasingNear_iff (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a : ratRep) :
    NondecreasingNear f a ↔
      ∃ (delta : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
        (∀ (x : ratRep), close x a delta → ratLeRep x a →
          ratLeRep (f x) (f a)) ∧
        (∀ (x : ratRep), close x a delta → ratLeRep a x →
          ratLeRep (f a) (f x)) :=
  sorry

          ratLeRep (f a) (f x)) :=
  Iff.intro
    (fun (h : NondecreasingNear f a) => h)
    (fun (h : ∃ (delta : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧

          ratLeRep (f x) (f a)) ∧
        (∀ (x : ratRep), close x a delta → ratLeRep a x →

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 反证。取单调邻域与抬高邻域的较小半径 d，在 a 左侧取 x = a - d/2。单调给出 `f x ≤ f a`，抬高给出 `f a < f x`；反对称性把两条合成等式，与严格小的第二分量冲突。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `NondecreasingNear f a → ¬ RisesLeft f a`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: exists_min_pos · close_sub_half · close_mono_eps · ratLtRep_self_sub_pos · ratLeRep_antisymm · And.right。

exercises.template:
theorem not_risesLeft_of_nondecreasingNear (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a : ratRep)
    (h : NondecreasingNear f a) : ¬ RisesLeft f a :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem not_risesLeft_of_nondecreasingNear (f : ratRep → ratRep) (a : ratRep)
    (h : NondecreasingNear f a) : ¬ RisesLeft f a :=
  fun (hr : RisesLeft f a) =>
    Exists.elim h
      (fun (dm : ratRep)
          (hdm : ratLtRep ratZeroRep dm ∧
            (∀ (x : ratRep), close x a dm → ratLeRep x a →
              ratLeRep (f x) (f a)) ∧
            (∀ (x : ratRep), close x a dm → ratLeRep a x →
              ratLeRep (f a) (f x))) =>
        Exists.elim hr
          (fun (dr : ratRep)
              (hdr : ratLtRep ratZeroRep dr ∧
                ∀ (x : ratRep), ratLtRep x a → close x a dr →
                  ratLtRep (f a) (f x)) =>
            risesLeft_conflict_mono f a dm dr (And.left hdm)
              (And.left (And.right hdm)) (And.left hdr) (And.right hdr)))

exercises.name: demo_id_not_nonincreasing
exercises.title: demo_id_not_nonincreasing

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 任取非增邻域的半径 delta，右侧点 0 + delta/2 落在邻域里。非增要求它 ≤ 0，而它严格大于 0；反对称性把两条合成 `0 ~ (0 + delta/2)`，与严格小的第二分量冲突。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `¬ NonincreasingNear (fun x => x) 0`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: close_add_right · ratLtRep_self_add_pos · ratLeRep_antisymm · And.right。

exercises.template:
theorem demo_id_not_nonincreasing :
    ¬ NonincreasingNear (fun (x : ratRep) => x) ratZeroRep :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem demo_id_not_nonincreasing :
    ¬ NonincreasingNear (fun (x : ratRep) => x) ratZeroRep :=
  fun (h : NonincreasingNear (fun (x : ratRep) => x) ratZeroRep) =>
    Exists.elim h
      (fun (delta : ratRep)
          (hd : ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
            (∀ (x : ratRep), close x ratZeroRep delta →
              ratLeRep x ratZeroRep → ratLeRep ratZeroRep x) ∧
            (∀ (x : ratRep), close x ratZeroRep delta →
              ratLeRep ratZeroRep x → ratLeRep x ratZeroRep)) =>
        (And.right (ratLtRep_self_add_pos ratZeroRep (ratHalf delta)
          (ratLtRep_half delta (And.left hd))))
          (ratLeRep_antisymm ratZeroRep (ratAddRep ratZeroRep (ratHalf delta))
            (ratLtRep_le ratZeroRep (ratAddRep ratZeroRep (ratHalf delta))
              (ratLtRep_self_add_pos ratZeroRep (ratHalf delta)
                (ratLtRep_half delta (And.left hd))))
            ((And.right (And.right hd))
              (ratAddRep ratZeroRep (ratHalf delta))
              (close_add_right ratZeroRep (ratHalf delta) delta
                (ratLtRep_half delta (And.left hd))
                (ratHalf_lt_self delta (And.left hd)))
              (ratLtRep_le ratZeroRep (ratAddRep ratZeroRep (ratHalf delta))
                (ratLtRep_self_add_pos ratZeroRep (ratHalf delta)
                  (ratLtRep_half delta (And.left hd)))))))

exercises.title: 两个切点的分割合格，前提是 a 严格小于 b。上升条件只查下标 0：其余下标 已经越过了段数，前提本身不成立。
exercises.prompt: 两个切点的分割合格，前提是 a 严格小于 b。上升条件只查下标 0：其余下标 已经越过了段数，前提本身不成立。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对下标归纳。0 时前提 `1 ≤ 1` 成立，结论就是 h；后继下标要满足 `j+2 ≤ 1`，交给 `leNat_pred` 化成 `j+1 ≤ 0`，再由 `leNat_succ_zero_absurd` 排除。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `∀ i, LeNat (succ i) 1 → ratLtRep (partPoint (twoPoint a b) i) (partPoint (twoPoint a b) (succ i))`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: leNat_pred · leNat_succ_zero_absurd · Nat.rec。

exercises.template:
theorem twoPoint_step (a b : ratRep) (h : ratLtRep a b) :
    ∀ (i : Nat), LeNat (Nat.succ i) (partCount (twoPoint a b)) →
      ratLtRep (partPoint (twoPoint a b) i)
        (partPoint (twoPoint a b) (Nat.succ i)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem twoPoint_step (a b : ratRep) (h : ratLtRep a b) :
    ∀ (i : Nat), LeNat (Nat.succ i) (partCount (twoPoint a b)) →
      ratLtRep (partPoint (twoPoint a b) i)
        (partPoint (twoPoint a b) (Nat.succ i)) :=
  fun (i : Nat) =>
    Nat.rec
      (fun (i : Nat) =>
        LeNat (Nat.succ i) (partCount (twoPoint a b)) →
          ratLtRep (partPoint (twoPoint a b) i)
            (partPoint (twoPoint a b) (Nat.succ i)))
      (fun (_hi : LeNat (Nat.succ Nat.zero) (partCount (twoPoint a b))) => h)
      (fun (j : Nat)
          (_ih : LeNat (Nat.succ j) (partCount (twoPoint a b)) →
            ratLtRep (partPoint (twoPoint a b) j)
              (partPoint (twoPoint a b) (Nat.succ j)))
          (hbad : LeNat (Nat.succ (Nat.succ j))
            (partCount (twoPoint a b))) =>
        False.elim
          (leNat_succ_zero_absurd j
            (leNat_pred (Nat.succ j) Nat.zero hbad)))
      i

exercises.prompt: 对 k 归纳。k = 0 时下标不动，用自反性。k + 1 时先把前 k 段的弱序拿到， 再接上第 k 段到第 k+1 段的严格上升；严格上升投成弱序，两条用传递性串起来。 前提 `i + k ≤ n` 在两处都要用：归纳假设要它，上升条件也要它。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 k 归纳。零情形下标 `i + 0` 定义性地等于 i，返回 `ratLeRep_refl`。后继情形先用 `leNat_trans` 把 `i + k ≤ i + (k+1)` 与已知的 `i + (k+1) ≤ n` 接起来，喂给归纳假设；再把 `isPartition_step` 用在 `i + k` 上，经 `ratLtRep_le` 投成弱序，最后 `ratLeRep_trans`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `LeNat (i + k) (partCount p) → ratLeRep (partPoint p i) (partPoint p (i + k))`。

hints.label: 关键件

    (i k : Nat) (h : LeNat (Nat.add i k) (partCount p)) :

exercises.solution:
theorem point_le_add (a b : ratRep) (p : Partition) (hp : IsPartition a b p)
    (i k : Nat) (h : LeNat (Nat.add i k) (partCount p)) :
    ratLeRep (partPoint p i) (partPoint p (Nat.add i k)) :=
  Nat.rec
    (fun (k : Nat) =>
      LeNat (Nat.add i k) (partCount p) →
        ratLeRep (partPoint p i) (partPoint p (Nat.add i k)))
    (fun (_h : LeNat (Nat.add i Nat.zero) (partCount p)) =>
      ratLeRep_refl (partPoint p i))
    (fun (k : Nat)
        (ih : LeNat (Nat.add i k) (partCount p) →
          ratLeRep (partPoint p i) (partPoint p (Nat.add i k)))
        (hsk : LeNat (Nat.add i (Nat.succ k)) (partCount p)) =>
      ratLeRep_trans
        (partPoint p i)
        (partPoint p (Nat.add i k))
        (partPoint p (Nat.succ (Nat.add i k)))
        (ih (leNat_trans (Nat.add i k) (Nat.succ (Nat.add i k))
          (partCount p)
          (le_succ (Nat.add i k) (Nat.add i k) (le_refl (Nat.add i k))) hsk))
        (ratLtRep_le (partPoint p (Nat.add i k))
          (partPoint p (Nat.succ (Nat.add i k)))
          (isPartition_step a b p hp (Nat.add i k) hsk)))
    k h

exercises.name: point_mono
exercises.title: `i ≤ j` 时把 j 写成 i + k，再把上一条的结论沿这个等式搬到 j 上。两个 `Eq.subst` 分别处理结论里的下标与前提里的下标。
exercises.prompt: `i ≤ j` 时把 j 写成 i + k，再把上一条的结论沿这个等式搬到 j 上。两个 `Eq.subst` 分别处理结论里的下标与前提里的下标。

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 用 `leNat_exists_add i j hij` 取 k 使 `j = i + k`。前提 `j ≤ n` 沿这个等式搬成 `i + k ≤ n`；结论 `point i ≤ point (i+k)` 再沿等式搬回 `point j`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `LeNat i j → LeNat j (partCount p) → ratLeRep (partPoint p i) (partPoint p j)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: leNat_exists_add · point_le_add · Eq.subst。

exercises.template:
theorem point_mono (a b : ratRep) (p : Partition) (hp : IsPartition a b p)
    (i j : Nat) (hij : LeNat i j) (hj : LeNat j (partCount p)) :
    ratLeRep (partPoint p i) (partPoint p j) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem point_mono (a b : ratRep) (p : Partition) (hp : IsPartition a b p)
    (i j : Nat) (hij : LeNat i j) (hj : LeNat j (partCount p)) :
    ratLeRep (partPoint p i) (partPoint p j) :=
  Exists.elim (leNat_exists_add i j hij)
    (fun (k : Nat) (hk : j = Nat.add i k) =>
      @Eq.subst.{1} Nat
        (fun (z : Nat) => ratLeRep (partPoint p i) (partPoint p z))
        (Nat.add i k) j (Eq.symm hk)
        (point_le_add a b p hp i k
          (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
            (fun (z : Nat) => LeNat z (partCount p))
            j (Nat.add i k) hk hj)))

exercises.title: 左边：`0 ≤ i`，`point_mono` 给出 `point 0 ≤ point i`，再把 `point 0 = a` 沿等式换掉。右边：`i ≤ n`，得到 `point i ≤ point n`，再把 `point n = b`

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 左半边用 `leNat_zero_le i` 与 `point_mono` 得 `point 0 ≤ point i`，沿 `isPartition_left` 把左端换成 a；右半边用 `point_mono` 得 `point i ≤ point n`，沿 `isPartition_right` 把右端换成 b。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `InClosed a b (partPoint p i)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: leNat_zero_le · point_mono · isPartition_left · isPartition_right · Eq.subst · And.intro。

exercises.template:
theorem point_in_closed (a b : ratRep) (p : Partition) (hp : IsPartition a b p)
    (i : Nat) (hi : LeNat i (partCount p)) :
    InClosed a b (partPoint p i) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem point_in_closed (a b : ratRep) (p : Partition) (hp : IsPartition a b p)
    (i : Nat) (hi : LeNat i (partCount p)) :
    InClosed a b (partPoint p i) :=
  And.intro
    (@Eq.subst.{1} ratRep
      (fun (z : ratRep) => ratLeRep z (partPoint p i))
      (partPoint p Nat.zero) a
      (isPartition_left a b p hp)
      (point_mono a b p hp Nat.zero i (leNat_zero_le i) hi))
    (@Eq.subst.{1} ratRep
      (fun (z : ratRep) => ratLeRep (partPoint p i) z)
      (partPoint p (partCount p)) b
      (isPartition_right a b p hp)
      (point_mono a b p hp i (partCount p) hi (le_refl (partCount p))))

    (hmb : ratLtRep m b) :

      ratLtRep (partPoint (threePoint a m b) i)
        (partPoint (threePoint a m b) (Nat.succ i)) :=

    Nat.rec
      (fun (i : Nat) =>
        LeNat (Nat.succ i) (partCount (threePoint a m b)) →
          ratLtRep (partPoint (threePoint a m b) i)
            (partPoint (threePoint a m b) (Nat.succ i)))
      (fun (_hi : LeNat (Nat.succ Nat.zero) (partCount (threePoint a m b))) =>
        ham)
      (fun (j : Nat)
          (_ih : LeNat (Nat.succ j) (partCount (threePoint a m b)) →
            ratLtRep (partPoint (threePoint a m b) j)
              (partPoint (threePoint a m b) (Nat.succ j))) =>

            LeNat (Nat.succ (Nat.succ j)) (partCount (threePoint a m b)) →

                (partPoint (threePoint a m b) (Nat.succ (Nat.succ j))))
          (fun (_h : LeNat (Nat.succ (Nat.succ Nat.zero))

exercises.name: sumTo_nonneg_upto
exercises.title: 只看前 n 项
exercises.prompt: 只看前 n 项

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对 n 归纳。零项和是零，用自反性。后继时和是「前 n 项」加第 n 项；归纳假设拿到前 n 项非负（它的前提是「k+1 ≤ n」，由 `k+1 ≤ n+1` 沿 `le_succ` 与传递性缩小），第 n 项由假设直接给（`n+1 ≤ n+1`），两条用加法保序加起来，再把 `0 + 0` 收成 0。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `0 ≤ sumTo f n`，前提是 `∀ k, k+1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ f k`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Nat.rec · ratLeRep_refl · leNat_trans · le_succ · ratLeRep_add · ratAdd_zero_left · ratLeRep_congr_gen。

exercises.template:
theorem sumTo_nonneg_upto (f : Nat → ratRep) (n : Nat)
    (h : ∀ (k : Nat), LeNat (Nat.succ k) n → ratLeRep ratZeroRep (f k)) :
    ratLeRep ratZeroRep (sumTo f n) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem sumTo_nonneg_upto (f : Nat → ratRep) (n : Nat)
    (h : ∀ (k : Nat), LeNat (Nat.succ k) n → ratLeRep ratZeroRep (f k)) :
    ratLeRep ratZeroRep (sumTo f n) :=
  Nat.rec
    (fun (n : Nat) =>
      (∀ (k : Nat), LeNat (Nat.succ k) n → ratLeRep ratZeroRep (f k)) →
        ratLeRep ratZeroRep (sumTo f n))
    (fun (_h : ∀ (k : Nat), LeNat (Nat.succ k) Nat.zero →
        ratLeRep ratZeroRep (f k)) =>
      ratLeRep_refl ratZeroRep)
    (fun (n : Nat)
        (ih : (∀ (k : Nat), LeNat (Nat.succ k) n → ratLeRep ratZeroRep (f k)) →
          ratLeRep ratZeroRep (sumTo f n))
        (h : ∀ (k : Nat), LeNat (Nat.succ k) (Nat.succ n) →
          ratLeRep ratZeroRep (f k)) =>
      ratLeRep_congr_gen
        (ratAddRep ratZeroRep ratZeroRep) ratZeroRep
        (ratAddRep (sumTo f n) (f n)) (ratAddRep (sumTo f n) (f n))
        (ratAdd_zero_left ratZeroRep)
        (ratRel_refl (ratAddRep (sumTo f n) (f n)))
        (ratLeRep_add ratZeroRep (sumTo f n) ratZeroRep (f n)
          (ih (fun (k : Nat) (hk : LeNat (Nat.succ k) n) =>
            h k (leNat_trans (Nat.succ k) n (Nat.succ n) hk
              (le_succ n n (le_refl n)))))
          (h n (le_refl (Nat.succ n)))))
    n h

exercises.name: sumTo_le_upto
exercises.title: sumTo_le_upto

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 与上一条同一条归纳，只是把「非负」换成「逐项 ≤」：后继时前 n 项用归纳假设，第 n 项用假设，两条用 `ratLeRep_add` 加起来。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `sumTo f n ≤ sumTo g n`，前提是 `∀ k, k+1 ≤ n → f k ≤ g k`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Nat.rec · ratLeRep_refl · leNat_trans · le_succ · ratLeRep_add。

exercises.template:
theorem sumTo_le_upto (f g : Nat → ratRep) (n : Nat)
    (h : ∀ (k : Nat), LeNat (Nat.succ k) n → ratLeRep (f k) (g k)) :
    ratLeRep (sumTo f n) (sumTo g n) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem sumTo_le_upto (f g : Nat → ratRep) (n : Nat)
    (h : ∀ (k : Nat), LeNat (Nat.succ k) n → ratLeRep (f k) (g k)) :
    ratLeRep (sumTo f n) (sumTo g n) :=
  Nat.rec
    (fun (n : Nat) =>
      (∀ (k : Nat), LeNat (Nat.succ k) n → ratLeRep (f k) (g k)) →
        ratLeRep (sumTo f n) (sumTo g n))
    (fun (_h : ∀ (k : Nat), LeNat (Nat.succ k) Nat.zero →
        ratLeRep (f k) (g k)) =>
      ratLeRep_refl ratZeroRep)
    (fun (n : Nat)
        (ih : (∀ (k : Nat), LeNat (Nat.succ k) n → ratLeRep (f k) (g k)) →
          ratLeRep (sumTo f n) (sumTo g n))
        (h : ∀ (k : Nat), LeNat (Nat.succ k) (Nat.succ n) →
          ratLeRep (f k) (g k)) =>
      ratLeRep_add (sumTo f n) (sumTo g n) (f n) (g n)
        (ih (fun (k : Nat) (hk : LeNat (Nat.succ k) n) =>
          h k (leNat_trans (Nat.succ k) n (Nat.succ n) hk
            (le_succ n n (le_refl n)))))
        (h n (le_refl (Nat.succ n))))
    n h

exercises.title: 面积保号与保序
exercises.prompt: 面积保号与保序

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 每一项是「高度乘宽」，高度非负、宽为正，乘积非负；再用「前 n 项和非负」把逐项结论收成整条和。乘积非负要把 `0 · 宽 ≤ c i · 宽` 的左端沿 `0 · 宽 ~ 0` 换掉。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `0 ≤ stepSum p c`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: sumTo_nonneg_upto · ratLeRep_mul_pos_right · segLen_pos · ratMul_zero_left · ratLeRep_congr_gen。

exercises.template:
theorem stepSum_nonneg (a b : ratRep) (p : Partition) (hp : IsPartition a b p)
    (c : Nat → ratRep)
    (hc : ∀ (i : Nat), LeNat (Nat.succ i) (partCount p) →
      ratLeRep ratZeroRep (c i)) :
    ratLeRep ratZeroRep (stepSum p c) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem stepSum_nonneg (a b : ratRep) (p : Partition) (hp : IsPartition a b p)
    (c : Nat → ratRep)
    (hc : ∀ (i : Nat), LeNat (Nat.succ i) (partCount p) →
      ratLeRep ratZeroRep (c i)) :
    ratLeRep ratZeroRep (stepSum p c) :=
  sumTo_nonneg_upto (fun (i : Nat) => ratMulRep (c i) (segLen p i))
    (partCount p)
    (fun (i : Nat) (hi : LeNat (Nat.succ i) (partCount p)) =>
      ratLeRep_congr_gen
        (ratMulRep ratZeroRep (segLen p i)) ratZeroRep
        (ratMulRep (c i) (segLen p i)) (ratMulRep (c i) (segLen p i))
        (ratMul_zero_left (segLen p i))
        (ratRel_refl (ratMulRep (c i) (segLen p i)))
        (ratLeRep_mul_pos_right ratZeroRep (c i) (segLen p i)
          (hc i hi) (segLen_pos a b p hp i hi)))

exercises.solution:
theorem stepSum_mono (a b : ratRep) (p : Partition) (hp : IsPartition a b p)
    (c d : Nat → ratRep)
    (hcd : ∀ (i : Nat), LeNat (Nat.succ i) (partCount p) →

        (ratMulRep (d i) (segLen p i))) :=
  ratRel_trans_gen
    (ratMulRep (ratAddRep (c i) (d i)) (segLen p i))
    (ratMulRep (segLen p i) (ratAddRep (c i) (d i)))
    (ratAddRep (ratMulRep (c i) (segLen p i))
      (ratMulRep (d i) (segLen p i)))
    (ratMul_comm (ratAddRep (c i) (d i)) (segLen p i))
    (ratRel_trans_gen

      (ratAddRep (ratMulRep (segLen p i) (c i))
        (ratMulRep (segLen p i) (d i)))
      (ratAddRep (ratMulRep (c i) (segLen p i))
        (ratMulRep (d i) (segLen p i)))

          (ratMulRep (segLen p i) (d i)))
        (ratAddRep (ratMulRep (c i) (segLen p i))

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把上一条逐项用一次，再用有限和的加法律把整条和按段分开。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel (stepSum p (fun i => c i + d i)) (stepSum p c + stepSum p d)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: sumTo_congr · segLen_mul_add · sumTo_add · ratRel_trans_gen。

exercises.template:
theorem stepSum_add (p : Partition) (c d : Nat → ratRep) :
    ratRel (stepSum p (fun (i : Nat) => ratAddRep (c i) (d i)))
      (ratAddRep (stepSum p c) (stepSum p d)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem stepSum_add (p : Partition) (c d : Nat → ratRep) :
    ratRel (stepSum p (fun (i : Nat) => ratAddRep (c i) (d i)))
      (ratAddRep (stepSum p c) (stepSum p d)) :=
  ratRel_trans_gen
    (stepSum p (fun (i : Nat) => ratAddRep (c i) (d i)))
    (sumTo (fun (i : Nat) => ratAddRep (ratMulRep (c i) (segLen p i))
      (ratMulRep (d i) (segLen p i))) (partCount p))
    (ratAddRep (stepSum p c) (stepSum p d))
    (sumTo_congr
      (fun (i : Nat) => ratMulRep (ratAddRep (c i) (d i)) (segLen p i))
      (fun (i : Nat) => ratAddRep (ratMulRep (c i) (segLen p i))
        (ratMulRep (d i) (segLen p i)))
      (partCount p) (fun (i : Nat) => segLen_mul_add p c d i))
    (sumTo_add (fun (i : Nat) => ratMulRep (c i) (segLen p i))
      (fun (i : Nat) => ratMulRep (d i) (segLen p i)) (partCount p))

exercises.name: stepSum_sub
exercises.title: 差是加法的特例
exercises.prompt: 差是加法的特例

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 减法按定义是加上取负，于是 `stepSum (c - d)` 就是 `stepSum (c + (-d))`；加法律给出 `stepSum c + stepSum (-d)`，再把第二项沿取负律换成 `-stepSum d`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel (stepSum p (fun i => c i - d i)) (stepSum p c - stepSum p d)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: stepSum_add · stepSum_neg · ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen · ratRel_trans_gen。

exercises.template:
theorem stepSum_sub (p : Partition) (c d : Nat → ratRep) :
    ratRel (stepSum p (fun (i : Nat) => ratSubRep (c i) (d i)))
      (ratSubRep (stepSum p c) (stepSum p d)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem stepSum_sub (p : Partition) (c d : Nat → ratRep) :
    ratRel (stepSum p (fun (i : Nat) => ratSubRep (c i) (d i)))
      (ratSubRep (stepSum p c) (stepSum p d)) :=
  ratRel_trans_gen
    (stepSum p (fun (i : Nat) => ratSubRep (c i) (d i)))
    (ratAddRep (stepSum p c) (stepSum p (fun (i : Nat) => ratNegRep (d i))))
    (ratSubRep (stepSum p c) (stepSum p d))

exercises.title: 常数乘宽的和
exercises.prompt: 常数乘宽的和

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对项数归纳。零项和是零，右边是 `k · (x 0 - x 0)`，由减法自反与右零元收成零。后继时把和拆成前 n 项与第 n 项：前 n 项用归纳假设；第 n 项 `k · (x(n+1) - x n)` 用乘法对减法的分配律换成 `k·x(n+1) - k·x n`。三项再按 `(A-C)+(B-A) ~ B-C` 重排：先用 `ratAdd_sub_sub` 并成 `(A+B)-(C+A)`，交换第一项，用减去同一个加数把 A 消掉，最后把 `k·x(n+1) - k·x 0` 换回 `k · (x(n+1) - x 0)`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel (sumTo (fun i => k · (x(i+1) - x i)) n) (k · (x n - x 0))`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Nat.rec · ratMul_sub · ratAdd_sub_sub · ratAdd_comm · ratSubRep_wd · ratSubRep_add_cancel · ratSubRep_self · ratRel_symm · ratRel_trans_gen。

exercises.template:
theorem sumTo_const_len (x : Nat → ratRep) (k : ratRep) (n : Nat) :
    ratRel (sumTo (fun (i : Nat) => ratMulRep k
      (ratSubRep (x (Nat.succ i)) (x i))) n)
      (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep (x n) (x Nat.zero))) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem sumTo_const_len (x : Nat → ratRep) (k : ratRep) (n : Nat) :
    ratRel (sumTo (fun (i : Nat) => ratMulRep k
      (ratSubRep (x (Nat.succ i)) (x i))) n)
      (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep (x n) (x Nat.zero))) :=
  Nat.rec
    (fun (n : Nat) =>
      ratRel (sumTo (fun (i : Nat) => ratMulRep k
        (ratSubRep (x (Nat.succ i)) (x i))) n)
        (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep (x n) (x Nat.zero))))
    (ratRel_symm
      (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep (x Nat.zero) (x Nat.zero)))
      ratZeroRep
      (ratRel_trans_gen
        (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep (x Nat.zero) (x Nat.zero)))
        (ratSubRep (ratMulRep k (x Nat.zero)) (ratMulRep k (x Nat.zero)))
        ratZeroRep
        (ratMul_sub k (x Nat.zero) (x Nat.zero))
        (ratSubRep_self (ratMulRep k (x Nat.zero)))))
    (fun (n : Nat)
        (ih : ratRel
          (sumTo (fun (i : Nat) => ratMulRep k
            (ratSubRep (x (Nat.succ i)) (x i))) n)
          (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep (x n) (x Nat.zero)))) =>
      ratRel_trans_gen
        (ratAddRep
          (sumTo (fun (i : Nat) => ratMulRep k
            (ratSubRep (x (Nat.succ i)) (x i))) n)
          (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep (x (Nat.succ n)) (x n))))
        (ratAddRep
          (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep (x n) (x Nat.zero)))
          (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep (x (Nat.succ n)) (x n))))
        (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep (x (Nat.succ n)) (x Nat.zero)))
        (ratAddRep_wd_gen
          (sumTo (fun (i : Nat) => ratMulRep k
            (ratSubRep (x (Nat.succ i)) (x i))) n)
          (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep (x n) (x Nat.zero)))
          (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep (x (Nat.succ n)) (x n)))
          ih)
        (ratRel_trans_gen
          (ratAddRep
            (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep (x n) (x Nat.zero)))
            (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep (x (Nat.succ n)) (x n))))
          (ratAddRep
            (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep (x n) (x Nat.zero)))
            (ratSubRep (ratMulRep k (x (Nat.succ n)))
              (ratMulRep k (x n))))
          (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep (x (Nat.succ n)) (x Nat.zero)))
          (ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen
            (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep (x n) (x Nat.zero)))
            (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep (x (Nat.succ n)) (x n)))
            (ratSubRep (ratMulRep k (x (Nat.succ n)))
              (ratMulRep k (x n)))
            (ratMul_sub k (x (Nat.succ n)) (x n)))
          (ratRel_trans_gen
            (ratAddRep
              (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep (x n) (x Nat.zero)))
              (ratSubRep (ratMulRep k (x (Nat.succ n)))
                (ratMulRep k (x n))))
            (ratAddRep
              (ratSubRep (ratMulRep k (x n)) (ratMulRep k (x Nat.zero)))
              (ratSubRep (ratMulRep k (x (Nat.succ n)))
                (ratMulRep k (x n))))
            (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep (x (Nat.succ n)) (x Nat.zero)))
            (ratAddRep_wd_gen
              (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep (x n) (x Nat.zero)))
              (ratSubRep (ratMulRep k (x n)) (ratMulRep k (x Nat.zero)))
              (ratSubRep (ratMulRep k (x (Nat.succ n)))
                (ratMulRep k (x n)))
              (ratMul_sub k (x n) (x Nat.zero)))
            (ratRel_trans_gen
              (ratAddRep
                (ratSubRep (ratMulRep k (x n))
                  (ratMulRep k (x Nat.zero)))
                (ratSubRep (ratMulRep k (x (Nat.succ n)))
                  (ratMulRep k (x n))))
              (ratSubRep
                (ratAddRep (ratMulRep k (x n))
                  (ratMulRep k (x (Nat.succ n))))
                (ratAddRep (ratMulRep k (x Nat.zero))
                  (ratMulRep k (x n))))
              (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep (x (Nat.succ n)) (x Nat.zero)))
              (ratAdd_sub_sub
                (ratMulRep k (x n))
                (ratMulRep k (x Nat.zero))
                (ratMulRep k (x (Nat.succ n)))
                (ratMulRep k (x n)))
              (ratRel_trans_gen
                (ratSubRep
                  (ratAddRep (ratMulRep k (x n))
                    (ratMulRep k (x (Nat.succ n))))
                  (ratAddRep (ratMulRep k (x Nat.zero))
                    (ratMulRep k (x n))))
                (ratSubRep
                  (ratAddRep (ratMulRep k (x (Nat.succ n)))
                    (ratMulRep k (x n)))
                  (ratAddRep (ratMulRep k (x Nat.zero))
                    (ratMulRep k (x n))))
                (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep (x (Nat.succ n)) (x Nat.zero)))
                (ratSubRep_wd
                  (ratAddRep (ratMulRep k (x n))
                    (ratMulRep k (x (Nat.succ n))))
                  (ratAddRep (ratMulRep k (x (Nat.succ n)))
                    (ratMulRep k (x n)))
                  (ratAddRep (ratMulRep k (x Nat.zero))
                    (ratMulRep k (x n)))
                  (ratAddRep (ratMulRep k (x Nat.zero))
                    (ratMulRep k (x n)))
                  (ratAdd_comm (ratMulRep k (x n))
                    (ratMulRep k (x (Nat.succ n))))
                  (ratRel_refl
                    (ratAddRep (ratMulRep k (x Nat.zero))
                      (ratMulRep k (x n)))))
                (ratRel_trans_gen
                  (ratSubRep
                    (ratAddRep (ratMulRep k (x (Nat.succ n)))
                      (ratMulRep k (x n)))
                    (ratAddRep (ratMulRep k (x Nat.zero))
                      (ratMulRep k (x n))))
                  (ratSubRep (ratMulRep k (x (Nat.succ n)))
                    (ratMulRep k (x Nat.zero)))
                  (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep (x (Nat.succ n)) (x Nat.zero)))
                  (ratSubRep_add_cancel
                    (ratMulRep k (x (Nat.succ n)))
                    (ratMulRep k (x Nat.zero))
                    (ratMulRep k (x n)))
                  (ratRel_symm
                    (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep (x (Nat.succ n)) (x Nat.zero)))
                    (ratSubRep (ratMulRep k (x (Nat.succ n)))
                      (ratMulRep k (x Nat.zero)))
                    (ratMul_sub k (x (Nat.succ n)) (x Nat.zero)))))))))
    n

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 常值高度的矩形和是 `sumTo (fun i => k · 宽 i)`，交给上一条，得到 `k · (p_n - p_0)`；再用分割的两个端点等式把 p_n 换成 b、p_0 换成 a。这两条都是等式，沿 `Eq.subst` 改写即可。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel (stepSum p (fun _ => k)) (k · (b - a))`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: sumTo_const_len · isPartition_left · isPartition_right · Eq.subst。

exercises.template:
theorem stepSum_const (a b : ratRep) (p : Partition) (hp : IsPartition a b p)
    (k : ratRep) :
    ratRel (stepSum p (fun (_ : Nat) => k))
      (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem stepSum_const (a b : ratRep) (p : Partition) (hp : IsPartition a b p)
    (k : ratRep) :
    ratRel (stepSum p (fun (_ : Nat) => k))
      (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a)) :=
  @Eq.subst.{1} ratRep
    (fun (z : ratRep) => ratRel (stepSum p (fun (_ : Nat) => k))
      (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep z a)))
    (partPoint p (partCount p)) b
    (isPartition_right a b p hp)
    (@Eq.subst.{1} ratRep
      (fun (z : ratRep) => ratRel (stepSum p (fun (_ : Nat) => k))
        (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep (partPoint p (partCount p)) z)))
      (partPoint p Nat.zero) a
      (isPartition_left a b p hp)
      (sumTo_const_len (fun (i : Nat) => partPoint p i) k (partCount p)))

hints.label: 思路

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: stepSum_mono · lowerStep_le_upperStep · ratLeRep_congr_gen · ratRel_symm · Exists.elim。

exercises.template:
theorem lowerSum_le_upperSum (a b : ratRep) (p : Partition)
    (f : ratRep → ratRep) (L U : ratRep) (hp : IsPartition a b p)
    (hL : LowerSum a b p f L) (hU : UpperSum a b p f U) :
    ratLeRep L U :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem lowerSum_le_upperSum (a b : ratRep) (p : Partition)
    (f : ratRep → ratRep) (L U : ratRep) (hp : IsPartition a b p)
    (hL : LowerSum a b p f L) (hU : UpperSum a b p f U) :
    ratLeRep L U :=
  @Exists.elim (Nat → ratRep)
    (fun (l : Nat → ratRep) => LowerStep a b p f l ∧ ratRel L (stepSum p l))
    (ratLeRep L U) hL
    (fun (l : Nat → ratRep)
        (hl : LowerStep a b p f l ∧ ratRel L (stepSum p l)) =>
      @Exists.elim (Nat → ratRep)
        (fun (u : Nat → ratRep) => UpperStep a b p f u ∧ ratRel U (stepSum p u))
        (ratLeRep L U) hU
        (fun (u : Nat → ratRep)
            (hu : UpperStep a b p f u ∧ ratRel U (stepSum p u)) =>
          ratLeRep_congr_gen (stepSum p l) L (stepSum p u) U
            (ratRel_symm L (stepSum p l) (And.right hl))
            (ratRel_symm U (stepSum p u) (And.right hu))
            (stepSum_mono a b p hp l u
              (fun (i : Nat) (hi : LeNat (Nat.succ i) (partCount p)) =>
                lowerStep_le_upperStep a b p f l u hp
                  (And.left hl) (And.left hu) i hi))))

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 分割取两切点，下和与上和都取 `k · (b - a)`；它们相减等于零，而零小于任意正 ε，于是这条 ε 判据对每个正 ε 都有见证。

hints.body: `Integrable a b (fun _ => k)`。

  sorry

theorem integrable_const (a b k : ratRep) (hab : ratLtRep a b) :
    Integrable a b (fun (_ : ratRep) => k) :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.intro (twoPoint a b)
      (And.intro (twoPoint_isPartition a b hab)
        (Exists.intro (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a))
          (Exists.intro (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a))
            (And.intro (lowerSum_twoPoint_const a b k)
              (And.intro (upperSum_twoPoint_const a b k)
                (ratLtRep_congr_fst
                  (ratSubRep (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a))
                    (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a)))
                  ratZeroRep eps heps
                  (ratSubRep_self (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a)))))))))

单元159 可积性的直接判据：把上下和搬到台阶上

可积的定义先取两个数，一个来自上界那摞台阶，一个来自下界那摞台阶，再要求 这两个数之差小于 ε。做估计时，这两层存在量词总要一次走完：给定 ε，先取 分割，再从上和与下和里各自取出产生它们的台阶。把这两步合成一条判据，估 计就只谈台阶本身，不必每回都先把两个数拆开。

判据的两个方向各是一段搬动。从可积到台阶：已知 `U - L < ε`，而上和 `U` 与上界的矩形和只差一次等价，下和同理；把两条等价送进减法，就得到两摞台 阶的矩形和之差小于 ε。从台阶到可积：把下界的矩形和直接当作下和、上界的 矩形和直接当作上和，它们与自己的等价关系是自反的。

这条判据还带来两个小读数。差已经小于 ε 时，把 ε 放大仍然成立；上界与下 界取同一摞高度时，两个矩形和是同一个数，差为零。常值函数的可积性可以直接 引用库里已经判过的结论，这里只把它作为判据的一个例子。

边界：只改写可积性的陈述，不证明新的函数可积，也不定义积分值。函数取 `ratRep → ratRep`，停在有理代表元层。不新增公理，也不碰 kernel/front。

同一个分割上的两个和

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 逐段用下界不超过上界，乘上同一个正宽；矩形和的保序把每段的不等式收成整条和。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratLeRep (stepSum p l) (stepSum p u)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: stepSum_mono · lowerStep_le_upperStep。

exercises.template:
theorem stepGap_nonneg (a b : ratRep) (p : Partition) (f : ratRep → ratRep)
    (l u : Nat → ratRep) (hp : IsPartition a b p)
    (hl : LowerStep a b p f l) (hu : UpperStep a b p f u) :
    ratLeRep (stepSum p l) (stepSum p u) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem stepGap_nonneg (a b : ratRep) (p : Partition) (f : ratRep → ratRep)
    (l u : Nat → ratRep) (hp : IsPartition a b p)
    (hl : LowerStep a b p f l) (hu : UpperStep a b p f u) :
    ratLeRep (stepSum p l) (stepSum p u) :=
  stepSum_mono a b p hp l u
    (fun (i : Nat) (hi : LeNat (Nat.succ i) (partCount p)) =>
      lowerStep_le_upperStep a b p f l u hp hl hu i hi)

exercises.unit: 单元159 可积性的直接判据：把上下和搬到台阶上
exercises.name: gap_of_sums
exercises.title: 从可积到两摞台阶
exercises.prompt: 从可积到两摞台阶

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先把上和与下和换成台阶；`stepSum u - stepSum l` 沿减法等价于 `U - L`，再把「差小于 ε」搬过去。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `∃ l, ∃ u, LowerStep … ∧ UpperStep … ∧ stepSum u - stepSum l < ε`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: lowerSum_witness · upperSum_witness · ratSubRep_wd · ratLtRep_congr_fst。

exercises.template:
theorem gap_of_sums (a b : ratRep) (p : Partition) (f : ratRep → ratRep)
    (L U eps : ratRep) (hL : LowerSum a b p f L) (hU : UpperSum a b p f U)
    (hgap : ratLtRep (ratSubRep U L) eps) :
    ∃ (l : Nat → ratRep), ∃ (u : Nat → ratRep),
      LowerStep a b p f l ∧ UpperStep a b p f u ∧
        ratLtRep (ratSubRep (stepSum p u) (stepSum p l)) eps :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem gap_of_sums (a b : ratRep) (p : Partition) (f : ratRep → ratRep)
    (L U eps : ratRep) (hL : LowerSum a b p f L) (hU : UpperSum a b p f U)
    (hgap : ratLtRep (ratSubRep U L) eps) :
    ∃ (l : Nat → ratRep), ∃ (u : Nat → ratRep),
      LowerStep a b p f l ∧ UpperStep a b p f u ∧
        ratLtRep (ratSubRep (stepSum p u) (stepSum p l)) eps :=
  Exists.elim (lowerSum_witness a b p f L hL)
    (fun (l : Nat → ratRep)
        (hl : LowerStep a b p f l ∧ ratRel L (stepSum p l)) =>
      Exists.elim (upperSum_witness a b p f U hU)
        (fun (u : Nat → ratRep)
            (hu : UpperStep a b p f u ∧ ratRel U (stepSum p u)) =>
          Exists.intro l
            (Exists.intro u
              (And.intro (And.left hl)
                (And.intro (And.left hu)
                  (ratLtRep_congr_fst
                    (ratSubRep (stepSum p u) (stepSum p l))
                    (ratSubRep U L) eps hgap
                    (ratSubRep_wd (stepSum p u) U (stepSum p l) L
                      (ratRel_symm U (stepSum p u) (And.right hu))
                      (ratRel_symm L (stepSum p l) (And.right hl)))))))))

exercises.title: gap_of_integrable

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把 `Integrable` 给出的分割与两个和依次拆开，每一步只消一层存在量词；最后交给上一条。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `∀ ε > 0, ∃ p, IsPartition … ∧ ∃ l u, …`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Exists.elim · And.left · gap_of_sums。

exercises.template:
theorem gap_of_integrable (a b : ratRep) (f : ratRep → ratRep)
    (h : Integrable a b f) :
    ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
      ∃ (p : Partition), IsPartition a b p ∧
        ∃ (l : Nat → ratRep), ∃ (u : Nat → ratRep),
          LowerStep a b p f l ∧ UpperStep a b p f u ∧
            ratLtRep (ratSubRep (stepSum p u) (stepSum p l)) eps :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem gap_of_integrable (a b : ratRep) (f : ratRep → ratRep)
    (h : Integrable a b f) :
    ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
      ∃ (p : Partition), IsPartition a b p ∧
        ∃ (l : Nat → ratRep), ∃ (u : Nat → ratRep),
          LowerStep a b p f l ∧ UpperStep a b p f u ∧
            ratLtRep (ratSubRep (stepSum p u) (stepSum p l)) eps :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (h eps heps)
      (fun (p : Partition)
          (hp : IsPartition a b p ∧
            ∃ (L : ratRep), ∃ (U : ratRep),
              LowerSum a b p f L ∧ UpperSum a b p f U ∧
                ratLtRep (ratSubRep U L) eps) =>
        Exists.elim (And.right hp)
          (fun (L : ratRep)
              (hLex : ∃ (U : ratRep),
                LowerSum a b p f L ∧ UpperSum a b p f U ∧
                  ratLtRep (ratSubRep U L) eps) =>
            Exists.elim hLex
              (fun (U : ratRep)
                  (hTriple : LowerSum a b p f L ∧ UpperSum a b p f U ∧
                    ratLtRep (ratSubRep U L) eps) =>
                Exists.intro p
                  (And.intro (And.left hp)
                    (gap_of_sums a b p f L U eps
                      (And.left hTriple)
                      (And.left (And.right hTriple))
                      (And.right (And.right hTriple)))))))

hints.body: Exists.intro · ratRel_refl · And.left · And.right。

theorem integrable_of_gap (a b : ratRep) (f : ratRep → ratRep)
    (h : ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
      ∃ (p : Partition), IsPartition a b p ∧
        ∃ (l : Nat → ratRep), ∃ (u : Nat → ratRep),
          LowerStep a b p f l ∧ UpperStep a b p f u ∧
            ratLtRep (ratSubRep (stepSum p u) (stepSum p l)) eps) :
    Integrable a b f :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem integrable_of_gap (a b : ratRep) (f : ratRep → ratRep)
    (h : ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
      ∃ (p : Partition), IsPartition a b p ∧
        ∃ (l : Nat → ratRep), ∃ (u : Nat → ratRep),
          LowerStep a b p f l ∧ UpperStep a b p f u ∧
            ratLtRep (ratSubRep (stepSum p u) (stepSum p l)) eps) :
    Integrable a b f :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (h eps heps)
      (fun (p : Partition)
          (hp : IsPartition a b p ∧
            ∃ (l : Nat → ratRep), ∃ (u : Nat → ratRep),
              LowerStep a b p f l ∧ UpperStep a b p f u ∧
                ratLtRep (ratSubRep (stepSum p u) (stepSum p l)) eps) =>
        Exists.elim (And.right hp)
          (fun (l : Nat → ratRep)
              (hlu : ∃ (u : Nat → ratRep),
                LowerStep a b p f l ∧ UpperStep a b p f u ∧
                  ratLtRep (ratSubRep (stepSum p u) (stepSum p l)) eps) =>
            Exists.elim hlu
              (fun (u : Nat → ratRep)
                  (hu : LowerStep a b p f l ∧ UpperStep a b p f u ∧
                    ratLtRep (ratSubRep (stepSum p u) (stepSum p l)) eps) =>
                Exists.intro p
                  (And.intro (And.left hp)
                    (Exists.intro (stepSum p l)
                      (Exists.intro (stepSum p u)
                        (And.intro
                          (Exists.intro l
                            (And.intro (And.left hu)
                              (ratRel_refl (stepSum p l))))
                          (And.intro
                            (Exists.intro u
                              (And.intro (And.left (And.right hu))
                                (ratRel_refl (stepSum p u))))
                            (And.right (And.right hu))))))))))

exercises.name: upperStep_congr_fun
exercises.title: 单元160 取负与逐点等价：可积性只看函数值
exercises.prompt:
单元160 取负与逐点等价：可积性只看函数值

上和与下和由每一段上的函数值定出，所以两个逐点相等的函数应当有同一套台 阶、同一个可积性。把这条搬运写成等价关系，取负就能直接作用在可积性上： 曲线在上界下面，取负之后它就在下界的上面，上和与下和互换，差却仍是原来 那个数。

搬运从上下界开始。上界压住 `f`，而 `f x` 与 `g x` 只差一次等价，于是同一个上界 也压住 `g`；下界的方向相反，函数值换到不等式的右边。上和与下和各自沿着 这一步换过去，可积性的见证于是整条搬完：分割不动，两个和换成新函数的和， 严格界仍是原来那条。

取负时两摞台阶互换：上界 `u` 变成下界 `-u`，下界 `l` 变成上界 `-l`。矩形 和也跟着取负，两个差 `(-l) - (-u)` 与 `u - l` 只差一个负号，所以「差小于 ε」原样成立。反方向把取负用两次，`-(-f)` 与 `f` 逐点相等，先沿点式等价 换回 `f`，再用一次取负。

边界：只做逐点等价与取负，不做加法、乘法或常数倍。函数取 `ratRep → ratRep`，停在有理代表元层。不新增公理，也不碰 kernel/front。

上下界沿点式等价搬运

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: `f x ~ g x`，把 `g x` 送到上界不等式的左边，右端 `u i` 不动；反方向交换等价的方向。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `UpperStep a b p f u ↔ UpperStep a b p g u`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: Iff.intro · ratLeRep_congr_gen · ratRel_symm · ratRel_refl。

exercises.template:
theorem upperStep_congr_fun (a b : ratRep) (p : Partition)
    (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (u : Nat → ratRep)
    (hfg : ∀ (x : ratRep), ratRel (f x) (g x)) :
    UpperStep a b p f u ↔ UpperStep a b p g u :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem upperStep_congr_fun (a b : ratRep) (p : Partition)
    (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (u : Nat → ratRep)
    (hfg : ∀ (x : ratRep), ratRel (f x) (g x)) :
    UpperStep a b p f u ↔ UpperStep a b p g u :=
  Iff.intro
    (fun (h : UpperStep a b p f u) =>
      fun (i : Nat) (hi : LeNat (Nat.succ i) (partCount p))
          (x : ratRep)
          (hx : InClosed (partPoint p i) (partPoint p (Nat.succ i)) x) =>
        ratLeRep_congr_gen (f x) (g x) (u i) (u i)
          (hfg x) (ratRel_refl (u i)) (h i hi x hx))
    (fun (h : UpperStep a b p g u) =>
      fun (i : Nat) (hi : LeNat (Nat.succ i) (partCount p))
          (x : ratRep)
          (hx : InClosed (partPoint p i) (partPoint p (Nat.succ i)) x) =>
        ratLeRep_congr_gen (g x) (f x) (u i) (u i)
          (ratRel_symm (f x) (g x) (hfg x)) (ratRel_refl (u i))
          (h i hi x hx))

theorem lowerStep_congr_fun (a b : ratRep) (p : Partition)
    (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (l : Nat → ratRep)
    (hfg : ∀ (x : ratRep), ratRel (f x) (g x)) :
    LowerStep a b p f l ↔ LowerStep a b p g l :=

    (fun (h : LowerStep a b p f l) =>

        ratLeRep_congr_gen (l i) (l i) (f x) (g x)

    (fun (h : LowerStep a b p g l) =>
      fun (i : Nat) (hi : LeNat (Nat.succ i) (partCount p))
          (x : ratRep)
          (hx : InClosed (partPoint p i) (partPoint p (Nat.succ i)) x) =>
        ratLeRep_congr_gen (l i) (l i) (g x) (f x)
          (ratRel_refl (l i)) (ratRel_symm (f x) (g x) (hfg x))
          (h i hi x hx))

exercises.prompt: 两个和沿点式等价搬运

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把上和展开成一摞上界，上界沿上一条换到 `g`，矩形和与 `U` 的关系原样保留。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `UpperSum a b p f U ↔ UpperSum a b p g U`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: upperSum_witness · upperStep_congr_fun · Iff.mp · Iff.mpr。

exercises.template:
theorem upperSum_congr_fun (a b : ratRep) (p : Partition)
    (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (U : ratRep)
    (hfg : ∀ (x : ratRep), ratRel (f x) (g x)) :
    UpperSum a b p f U ↔ UpperSum a b p g U :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem upperSum_congr_fun (a b : ratRep) (p : Partition)
    (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (U : ratRep)
    (hfg : ∀ (x : ratRep), ratRel (f x) (g x)) :
    UpperSum a b p f U ↔ UpperSum a b p g U :=
  Iff.intro
    (fun (h : UpperSum a b p f U) =>
      Exists.elim (upperSum_witness a b p f U h)
        (fun (u : Nat → ratRep)
            (hu : UpperStep a b p f u ∧ ratRel U (stepSum p u)) =>
          Exists.intro u
            (And.intro
              (Iff.mp (upperStep_congr_fun a b p f g u hfg) (And.left hu))
              (And.right hu))))
    (fun (h : UpperSum a b p g U) =>
      Exists.elim (upperSum_witness a b p g U h)
        (fun (u : Nat → ratRep)
