hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 可积性的见证是分割、两个和与严格界；两个和各自沿上面的等价换到 `g`，分割与差不动。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Integrable a b f ↔ Integrable a b g`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: upperSum_congr_fun · lowerSum_congr_fun · Iff.mp · Iff.mpr · Exists.elim。

exercises.template:
theorem integrable_congr_fun (a b : ratRep) (f g : ratRep → ratRep)
    (hfg : ∀ (x : ratRep), ratRel (f x) (g x)) :
    Integrable a b f ↔ Integrable a b g :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem integrable_congr_fun (a b : ratRep) (f g : ratRep → ratRep)
    (hfg : ∀ (x : ratRep), ratRel (f x) (g x)) :
    Integrable a b f ↔ Integrable a b g :=
  Iff.intro
    (fun (h : Integrable a b f) =>
      fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
        Exists.elim (h eps heps)
          (fun (p : Partition)
              (hp : IsPartition a b p ∧
                ∃ (L : ratRep), ∃ (U : ratRep),
                  LowerSum a b p f L ∧ UpperSum a b p f U ∧
                    ratLtRep (ratSubRep U L) eps) =>
            Exists.elim (And.right hp)
              (fun (L : ratRep)
                  (hLex : ∃ (U : ratRep),
                    LowerSum a b p f L ∧ UpperSum a b p f U ∧
                      ratLtRep (ratSubRep U L) eps) =>
                Exists.elim hLex
                  (fun (U : ratRep)
                      (hTriple : LowerSum a b p f L ∧ UpperSum a b p f U ∧
                        ratLtRep (ratSubRep U L) eps) =>
                    Exists.intro p
                      (And.intro (And.left hp)
                        (Exists.intro L
                          (Exists.intro U
                            (And.intro
                              (Iff.mp (lowerSum_congr_fun a b p f g L hfg)
                                (And.left hTriple))
                              (And.intro
                                (Iff.mp (upperSum_congr_fun a b p f g U hfg)
                                  (And.left (And.right hTriple)))
                                (And.right (And.right hTriple)))))))))))
    (fun (h : Integrable a b g) =>
      fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
        Exists.elim (h eps heps)
          (fun (p : Partition)
              (hp : IsPartition a b p ∧
                ∃ (L : ratRep), ∃ (U : ratRep),
                  LowerSum a b p g L ∧ UpperSum a b p g U ∧
                    ratLtRep (ratSubRep U L) eps) =>
            Exists.elim (And.right hp)
              (fun (L : ratRep)
                  (hLex : ∃ (U : ratRep),
                    LowerSum a b p g L ∧ UpperSum a b p g U ∧
                      ratLtRep (ratSubRep U L) eps) =>
                Exists.elim hLex
                  (fun (U : ratRep)
                      (hTriple : LowerSum a b p g L ∧ UpperSum a b p g U ∧
                        ratLtRep (ratSubRep U L) eps) =>
                    Exists.intro p
                      (And.intro (And.left hp)
                        (Exists.intro L
                          (Exists.intro U
                            (And.intro
                              (Iff.mpr (lowerSum_congr_fun a b p f g L hfg)
                                (And.left hTriple))
                              (And.intro
                                (Iff.mpr (upperSum_congr_fun a b p f g U hfg)
                                  (And.left (And.right hTriple)))
                                (And.right (And.right hTriple)))))))))))

    (h : Integrable a b f) :
    Integrable a b (fun (x : ratRep) => ratNegRep (f x)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem integrable_neg (a b : ratRep) (f : ratRep → ratRep)
    (h : Integrable a b f) :
    Integrable a b (fun (x : ratRep) => ratNegRep (f x)) :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (h eps heps)
      (fun (p : Partition)
          (hp : IsPartition a b p ∧
            ∃ (L : ratRep), ∃ (U : ratRep),
              LowerSum a b p f L ∧ UpperSum a b p f U ∧
                ratLtRep (ratSubRep U L) eps) =>
        Exists.elim (And.right hp)
          (fun (L : ratRep)
              (hLex : ∃ (U : ratRep),
                LowerSum a b p f L ∧ UpperSum a b p f U ∧
                  ratLtRep (ratSubRep U L) eps) =>
            Exists.elim hLex
              (fun (U : ratRep)
                  (hTriple : LowerSum a b p f L ∧ UpperSum a b p f U ∧
                    ratLtRep (ratSubRep U L) eps) =>
                Exists.intro p
                  (And.intro (And.left hp)
                    (Exists.intro (ratNegRep U)
                      (Exists.intro (ratNegRep L)
                        (And.intro
                          (upperSum_neg a b p f U
                            (And.left (And.right hTriple)))
                          (And.intro
                            (lowerSum_neg a b p f L (And.left hTriple))
                            (ratLtRep_congr_fst
                              (ratSubRep (ratNegRep L) (ratNegRep U))
                              (ratSubRep U L) eps
                              (And.right (And.right hTriple))
                              (ratRel_trans_gen
                                (ratSubRep (ratNegRep L) (ratNegRep U))
                                (ratNegRep (ratSubRep L U))
                                (ratSubRep U L)
                                (ratSubRep_neg_neg L U)
                                (ratRel_symm (ratSubRep U L)
                                  (ratNegRep (ratSubRep L U))
                                  (ratSubRep_neg L U))))))))))))

exercises.name: segLen_mul_add
exercises.title: 单元161 上和与下和的加法：先分开算再相加
exercises.prompt:
单元161 上和与下和的加法：先分开算再相加

可积性的判据只对单个函数说话：任给正 ε，找得到一个分割，使这个分割的上和 与下和之差小于 ε。两条曲线各自可积，意思是各自有各自的分割。要把两块面积 合起来算，第一个问题是：在同一组切点上，和的上下界是什么样子？

每一段上的两条不等式一相加，答案就出来了。第一条曲线压在常数 `u i` 下面， 第二条压在 `v i` 下面，两个函数值相加就压在 `u i + v i` 下面；下界的方向 相同，`l i + m i` 垫在两个函数值之和的下面。这一步不需要新的估计。

面积这边要换一次写法。一个矩形的高是两个数之和，宽是这一段的长度，于是 这块矩形的面积等于两块矩形面积之和，靠的是乘法对加法的分配律。有限和的 加法律再把段数那么多项按函数分成两摞，上和与下和就各自分成了两个。两条合 起来，同一个分割上两块面积之差的和恰好是和的面积之差——这是等式，不是估计。

有了这条等式，若两块在同一个分割上的差都小于 ε 的一半，它们的和就可积。 但两条曲线各自可积只给出各自的分割，两摞台阶一般不在同一组切点上。把它们 搬到同一组切点上，要先说明在分割里补切点不改变面积，这一步还没有做。

边界：只做同一个分割上的加法，不做常数倍，也不把两个不同分割的上下和搬到 一起。函数取 `ratRep → ratRep`，停在有理代表元层。不新增公理。

一段上的分配律

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 宽在右边，先交换成「宽乘高度和」，用分配律拆开，再逐项交换回高度在前。两条交换与一次分配拼成一条链。

    ratRel (ratMulRep (ratAddRep h1 h2) (segLen p i))
      (ratAddRep (ratMulRep h1 (segLen p i)) (ratMulRep h2 (segLen p i))) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem segLen_mul_add (p : Partition) (i : Nat) (h1 h2 : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratMulRep (ratAddRep h1 h2) (segLen p i))
      (ratAddRep (ratMulRep h1 (segLen p i)) (ratMulRep h2 (segLen p i))) :=
  ratRel_trans_gen
    (ratMulRep (ratAddRep h1 h2) (segLen p i))
    (ratMulRep (segLen p i) (ratAddRep h1 h2))
    (ratAddRep (ratMulRep h1 (segLen p i)) (ratMulRep h2 (segLen p i)))
    (ratMul_comm (ratAddRep h1 h2) (segLen p i))
    (ratRel_trans_gen
      (ratMulRep (segLen p i) (ratAddRep h1 h2))
      (ratAddRep (ratMulRep (segLen p i) h1) (ratMulRep (segLen p i) h2))
      (ratAddRep (ratMulRep h1 (segLen p i)) (ratMulRep h2 (segLen p i)))
      (ratMul_add (segLen p i) h1 h2)
      (ratRel_trans_gen
        (ratAddRep (ratMulRep (segLen p i) h1)
          (ratMulRep (segLen p i) h2))
        (ratAddRep (ratMulRep h1 (segLen p i))
          (ratMulRep (segLen p i) h2))
        (ratAddRep (ratMulRep h1 (segLen p i))
          (ratMulRep h2 (segLen p i)))
        (ratAddRep_wd_gen (ratMulRep (segLen p i) h1)
          (ratMulRep h1 (segLen p i)) (ratMulRep (segLen p i) h2)
          (ratMul_comm (segLen p i) h1))
        (ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen (ratMulRep h1 (segLen p i))
          (ratMulRep (segLen p i) h2) (ratMulRep h2 (segLen p i))
          (ratMul_comm (segLen p i) h2))))

    (sumTo_add

exercises.template:
theorem upperSum_add (a b : ratRep) (p : Partition)
    (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (U V : ratRep)
    (hU : UpperSum a b p f U) (hV : UpperSum a b p g V) :
    UpperSum a b p (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) (g x))
      (ratAddRep U V) :=

exercises.solution:
theorem upperSum_add (a b : ratRep) (p : Partition)
    (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (U V : ratRep)
    (hU : UpperSum a b p f U) (hV : UpperSum a b p g V) :
    UpperSum a b p (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) (g x))
      (ratAddRep U V) :=
  Exists.elim (upperSum_witness a b p f U hU)
    (fun (u : Nat → ratRep)
        (hu : UpperStep a b p f u ∧ ratRel U (stepSum p u)) =>
      Exists.elim (upperSum_witness a b p g V hV)
        (fun (v : Nat → ratRep)
            (hv : UpperStep a b p g v ∧ ratRel V (stepSum p v)) =>
          Exists.intro (fun (i : Nat) => ratAddRep (u i) (v i))
            (And.intro
              (upperStep_add a b p f g u v (And.left hu) (And.left hv))
              (ratRel_trans_gen
                (ratAddRep U V)
                (ratAddRep (stepSum p u) (stepSum p v))
                (stepSum p (fun (i : Nat) => ratAddRep (u i) (v i)))
                (ratRel_trans_gen
                  (ratAddRep U V)

theorem lowerSum_add (a b : ratRep) (p : Partition)
    (f g : ratRep → ratRep) (L M : ratRep)
    (hL : LowerSum a b p f L) (hM : LowerSum a b p g M) :
    LowerSum a b p (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) (g x))
      (ratAddRep L M) :=

    (fun (l : Nat → ratRep)

              (lowerStep_add a b p f g l m (And.left hl) (And.left hm))
              (ratRel_trans_gen
                (ratAddRep L M)
                (ratAddRep (stepSum p l) (stepSum p m))
                (stepSum p (fun (i : Nat) => ratAddRep (l i) (m i)))
                (ratRel_trans_gen
                  (ratAddRep L M)
                  (ratAddRep (stepSum p l) M)
                  (ratAddRep (stepSum p l) (stepSum p m))
                  (ratAddRep_wd_gen L (stepSum p l) M (And.right hl))

                    (And.right hm)))

    (hg : ratLtRep (ratSubRep (stepSum p v) (stepSum p m))
      (ratHalf eps)) :

exercises.solution:
theorem stepGap_add_lt (p : Partition) (l u m v : Nat → ratRep)
    (eps : ratRep)
    (hf : ratLtRep (ratSubRep (stepSum p u) (stepSum p l))
      (ratHalf eps))
    (hg : ratLtRep (ratSubRep (stepSum p v) (stepSum p m))
      (ratHalf eps)) :
    ratLtRep
      (ratSubRep (stepSum p (fun (i : Nat) => ratAddRep (u i) (v i)))
        (stepSum p (fun (i : Nat) => ratAddRep (l i) (m i)))) eps :=
  ratLtRep_congr_fst
    (ratSubRep (stepSum p (fun (i : Nat) => ratAddRep (u i) (v i)))
      (stepSum p (fun (i : Nat) => ratAddRep (l i) (m i))))
    (ratAddRep (ratSubRep (stepSum p u) (stepSum p l))
      (ratSubRep (stepSum p v) (stepSum p m)))
    eps
    (ratLtRep_congr_snd
      (ratAddRep (ratSubRep (stepSum p u) (stepSum p l))
        (ratSubRep (stepSum p v) (stepSum p m)))
      (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps))
      eps
      (ratLtRep_add (ratSubRep (stepSum p u) (stepSum p l))
        (ratHalf eps) (ratSubRep (stepSum p v) (stepSum p m))
        (ratHalf eps) hf hg)
      (ratHalf_add_self eps))
    (ratRel_trans_gen
      (ratSubRep (stepSum p (fun (i : Nat) => ratAddRep (u i) (v i)))
        (stepSum p (fun (i : Nat) => ratAddRep (l i) (m i))))
      (ratSubRep (ratAddRep (stepSum p u) (stepSum p v))
        (ratAddRep (stepSum p l) (stepSum p m)))
      (ratAddRep (ratSubRep (stepSum p u) (stepSum p l))
        (ratSubRep (stepSum p v) (stepSum p m)))
      (ratSubRep_wd
        (stepSum p (fun (i : Nat) => ratAddRep (u i) (v i)))
        (ratAddRep (stepSum p u) (stepSum p v))
        (stepSum p (fun (i : Nat) => ratAddRep (l i) (m i)))
        (ratAddRep (stepSum p l) (stepSum p m))
        (stepSum_add p u v) (stepSum_add p l m))
      (ratRel_symm
        (ratAddRep (ratSubRep (stepSum p u) (stepSum p l))
          (ratSubRep (stepSum p v) (stepSum p m)))
        (ratSubRep (ratAddRep (stepSum p u) (stepSum p v))
          (ratAddRep (stepSum p l) (stepSum p m)))
        (ratAdd_sub_sub (stepSum p u) (stepSum p l) (stepSum p v)
          (stepSum p m))))

hints.body: 把可积性的判据拆开：给定 ε，取出分割与四条台阶；和的下界取 `l + m`、上界取 `u + v`，两条台阶引理给出它们夹住和，差由 `stepGap_add_lt` 压到 ε 以下。最后把两个「存在」交给判据的另一个方向。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Integrable a b (fun x => f x + g x)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: integrable_of_gap · upperStep_add · lowerStep_add · stepGap_add_lt · Exists.elim · Exists.intro。

exercises.template:
theorem integrable_add_of_gap (a b : ratRep)
    (f g : ratRep → ratRep)
    (h : ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
      ∃ (p : Partition), IsPartition a b p ∧
        ∃ (l : Nat → ratRep), ∃ (u : Nat → ratRep),
          ∃ (m : Nat → ratRep), ∃ (v : Nat → ratRep),
            LowerStep a b p f l ∧ UpperStep a b p f u ∧
            LowerStep a b p g m ∧ UpperStep a b p g v ∧
            ratLtRep (ratSubRep (stepSum p u) (stepSum p l))
              (ratHalf eps) ∧
            ratLtRep (ratSubRep (stepSum p v) (stepSum p m))
              (ratHalf eps)) :
    Integrable a b (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) (g x)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem integrable_add_of_gap (a b : ratRep)
    (f g : ratRep → ratRep)
    (h : ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
      ∃ (p : Partition), IsPartition a b p ∧
        ∃ (l : Nat → ratRep), ∃ (u : Nat → ratRep),
          ∃ (m : Nat → ratRep), ∃ (v : Nat → ratRep),
            LowerStep a b p f l ∧ UpperStep a b p f u ∧
            LowerStep a b p g m ∧ UpperStep a b p g v ∧
            ratLtRep (ratSubRep (stepSum p u) (stepSum p l))
              (ratHalf eps) ∧
            ratLtRep (ratSubRep (stepSum p v) (stepSum p m))
              (ratHalf eps)) :
    Integrable a b (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) (g x)) :=
  integrable_of_gap a b (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) (g x))
    (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
      Exists.elim (h eps heps)
        (fun (p : Partition)
            (hp : IsPartition a b p ∧
              ∃ (l : Nat → ratRep), ∃ (u : Nat → ratRep),
                ∃ (m : Nat → ratRep), ∃ (v : Nat → ratRep),
                  LowerStep a b p f l ∧ UpperStep a b p f u ∧
                  LowerStep a b p g m ∧ UpperStep a b p g v ∧
                  ratLtRep (ratSubRep (stepSum p u) (stepSum p l))
                    (ratHalf eps) ∧
                  ratLtRep (ratSubRep (stepSum p v) (stepSum p m))
                    (ratHalf eps)) =>
          Exists.elim (And.right hp)
            (fun (l : Nat → ratRep)
                (hl : ∃ (u : Nat → ratRep), ∃ (m : Nat → ratRep),
                  ∃ (v : Nat → ratRep),
                    LowerStep a b p f l ∧ UpperStep a b p f u ∧
                    LowerStep a b p g m ∧ UpperStep a b p g v ∧
                    ratLtRep (ratSubRep (stepSum p u) (stepSum p l))
                      (ratHalf eps) ∧
                    ratLtRep (ratSubRep (stepSum p v) (stepSum p m))
                      (ratHalf eps)) =>
              Exists.elim hl
                (fun (u : Nat → ratRep)
                    (hu : ∃ (m : Nat → ratRep), ∃ (v : Nat → ratRep),
                      LowerStep a b p f l ∧ UpperStep a b p f u ∧
                      LowerStep a b p g m ∧ UpperStep a b p g v ∧
                      ratLtRep (ratSubRep (stepSum p u) (stepSum p l))
                        (ratHalf eps) ∧
                      ratLtRep (ratSubRep (stepSum p v) (stepSum p m))
                        (ratHalf eps)) =>
                  Exists.elim hu
                    (fun (m : Nat → ratRep)
                        (hm : ∃ (v : Nat → ratRep),
                          LowerStep a b p f l ∧ UpperStep a b p f u ∧
                          LowerStep a b p g m ∧ UpperStep a b p g v ∧
                          ratLtRep (ratSubRep (stepSum p u) (stepSum p l))
                            (ratHalf eps) ∧
                          ratLtRep (ratSubRep (stepSum p v) (stepSum p m))
                            (ratHalf eps)) =>
                      Exists.elim hm
                        (fun (v : Nat → ratRep)
                            (hv : LowerStep a b p f l ∧
                              UpperStep a b p f u ∧
                              LowerStep a b p g m ∧
                              UpperStep a b p g v ∧
                              ratLtRep (ratSubRep (stepSum p u) (stepSum p l))
                                (ratHalf eps) ∧
                              ratLtRep (ratSubRep (stepSum p v) (stepSum p m))
                                (ratHalf eps)) =>
                          Exists.intro p
                            (And.intro (And.left hp)
                              (Exists.intro
                                (fun (i : Nat) => ratAddRep (l i) (m i))
                                (Exists.intro
                                  (fun (i : Nat) => ratAddRep (u i) (v i))
                                  (And.intro
                                    (lowerStep_add a b p f g l m
                                      (And.left hv)
                                      (And.left
                                        (And.right (And.right hv))) )
                                    (And.intro
                                      (upperStep_add a b p f g u v
                                        (And.left (And.right hv))
                                        (And.left
                                          (And.right
                                            (And.right (And.right hv)))))
                                      (stepGap_add_lt p l u m v eps
                                        (And.left
                                          (And.right
                                            (And.right
                                              (And.right
                                                (And.right hv)))))
                                        (And.right
                                          (And.right
                                            (And.right
                                              (And.right
                                                (And.right hv)))))))))))))))))

exercises.unit: 单元162 整条曲线抬高：面积差只认起伏
exercises.name: segLen_mul_add_const
exercises.title: 单元162 整条曲线抬高：面积差只认起伏
exercises.prompt:
单元162 整条曲线抬高：面积差只认起伏

上一单元把两块台阶的面积分开算，但还没有处理一种最简单的变形：把整条 曲线往上搬一段。搬动不改变曲线自己的起伏，只改变它离横轴的高度。上和 与下和会各自多出什么？

每一段上，上界和下界都抬高同一个常数 k。矩形的高多了一截，宽没有变， 于是每一块矩形都多出「k 乘这一段的宽」。整条和因此多出 k 乘所有段宽之和， 而所有段宽之和正好是区间长度 b - a。上和与下和抬高的正是同一个数。

两个和之差不变。面积估计只认曲线在一个区间里起伏多少，不认它整体 挂得多高。常值曲线是最直接的读数——它的上和与下和都是 k·(b - a)， 抬一段就把这个数加到两者头上。对一般的曲线，这条事实把常数项从面积 估计里完全摘出去，后面谈线性时只剩函数本身的加法。

证明按四层走：一段上的分配律、矩形和、两摞台阶、两个和之差。每层只用 乘法对加法的分配律、加法结合律和「减去同一个加数」，没有新的估计。

这里只处理垂直平移。一般的正数倍要把常数与 ε 放在一起比较，那要等一条 有理数的阿基米德性质；这一步还没有做。函数取 `ratRep → ratRep`，停在有理 代表元层。

一段上高度加常数

        (ratMulRep k (segLen p i))) :=
  sorry

    ratRel (ratMulRep (ratAddRep h k) (segLen p i))
      (ratAddRep (ratMulRep h (segLen p i))
        (ratMulRep k (segLen p i))) :=
  ratRel_trans_gen
    (ratMulRep (ratAddRep h k) (segLen p i))
    (ratMulRep (segLen p i) (ratAddRep h k))
    (ratAddRep (ratMulRep h (segLen p i))
      (ratMulRep k (segLen p i)))
    (ratMul_comm (ratAddRep h k) (segLen p i))
    (ratRel_trans_gen
      (ratMulRep (segLen p i) (ratAddRep h k))
      (ratAddRep (ratMulRep (segLen p i) h)
        (ratMulRep (segLen p i) k))
      (ratAddRep (ratMulRep h (segLen p i))
        (ratMulRep k (segLen p i)))
      (ratMul_add (segLen p i) h k)
      (ratRel_trans_gen
        (ratAddRep (ratMulRep (segLen p i) h)
          (ratMulRep (segLen p i) k))
        (ratAddRep (ratMulRep h (segLen p i))
          (ratMulRep (segLen p i) k))
        (ratAddRep (ratMulRep h (segLen p i))
          (ratMulRep k (segLen p i)))

theorem stepSum_add_const (a b : ratRep) (p : Partition)
    (hp : IsPartition a b p) (h : Nat → ratRep) (k : ratRep) :

theorem stepSum_add_const (a b : ratRep) (p : Partition)
    (hp : IsPartition a b p) (h : Nat → ratRep) (k : ratRep) :
    ratRel (stepSum p (fun (i : Nat) => ratAddRep (h i) k))
      (ratAddRep (stepSum p h) (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a))) :=
  ratRel_trans_gen
    (stepSum p (fun (i : Nat) => ratAddRep (h i) k))
    (sumTo (fun (i : Nat) =>
      ratAddRep (ratMulRep (h i) (segLen p i))
        (ratMulRep k (segLen p i))) (partCount p))
    (ratAddRep (stepSum p h) (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a)))
    (sumTo_congr (fun (i : Nat) =>
        ratMulRep (ratAddRep (h i) k) (segLen p i))
      (fun (i : Nat) =>
        ratAddRep (ratMulRep (h i) (segLen p i))
          (ratMulRep k (segLen p i)))
      (partCount p)
      (fun (i : Nat) => segLen_mul_add_const p i (h i) k))
    (ratRel_trans_gen
      (sumTo (fun (i : Nat) =>
        ratAddRep (ratMulRep (h i) (segLen p i))
          (ratMulRep k (segLen p i))) (partCount p))
      (ratAddRep
        (sumTo (fun (i : Nat) => ratMulRep (h i) (segLen p i))
          (partCount p))
        (sumTo (fun (i : Nat) => ratMulRep k (segLen p i))
          (partCount p)))
      (ratAddRep (stepSum p h) (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a)))
      (sumTo_add (fun (i : Nat) => ratMulRep (h i) (segLen p i))
        (fun (i : Nat) => ratMulRep k (segLen p i)) (partCount p))

theorem integrable_add_const (a b : ratRep) (f : ratRep → ratRep)
    (k : ratRep) (h : Integrable a b f) :
    Integrable a b (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) k) :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (h eps heps)
      (fun (p : Partition)
          (hp : IsPartition a b p ∧
            ∃ (L : ratRep), ∃ (U : ratRep),
              LowerSum a b p f L ∧ UpperSum a b p f U ∧
                ratLtRep (ratSubRep U L) eps) =>
        Exists.elim (And.right hp)
          (fun (L : ratRep) (hL : ∃ (U : ratRep),
              LowerSum a b p f L ∧ UpperSum a b p f U ∧
                ratLtRep (ratSubRep U L) eps) =>
            Exists.elim hL
              (fun (U : ratRep)
                  (hU : LowerSum a b p f L ∧ UpperSum a b p f U ∧
                    ratLtRep (ratSubRep U L) eps) =>
                Exists.intro p
                  (And.intro (And.left hp)
                    (Exists.intro
                      (ratAddRep L (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a)))
                      (Exists.intro
                        (ratAddRep U (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a)))
                        (And.intro
                          (lowerSum_add_const a b p f L k
                            (And.left hp) (And.left hU))
                          (And.intro
                            (upperSum_add_const a b p f U k
                              (And.left hp) (And.left (And.right hU)))
                            (ratLtRep_congr_fst
                              (ratSubRep
                                (ratAddRep U (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a)))
                                (ratAddRep L (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a))))
                              (ratSubRep U L) eps
                              (And.right (And.right hU))
                              (stepGap_add_const p L U
                                (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a))))))))))))

exercises.template:
theorem integrable_add_const_iff (a b : ratRep) (f : ratRep → ratRep)
    (k : ratRep) :

theorem integrable_add_const_iff (a b : ratRep) (f : ratRep → ratRep)
    (k : ratRep) :
    Integrable a b f ↔ Integrable a b (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) k) :=
  Iff.intro
    (integrable_add_const a b f k)
    (fun (h : Integrable a b (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) k)) =>
      Iff.mp
        (integrable_congr_fun a b
          (fun (x : ratRep) =>
            ratAddRep (ratAddRep (f x) k) (ratNegRep k))
          f
          (fun (x : ratRep) =>
            ratRel_trans_gen
              (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (f x) k) (ratNegRep k))
              (ratAddRep (f x) (ratAddRep k (ratNegRep k)))
              (f x)
              (ratAdd_assoc (f x) k (ratNegRep k))
              (ratRel_trans_gen
                (ratAddRep (f x) (ratAddRep k (ratNegRep k)))
                (ratAddRep (f x) ratZeroRep)
                (f x)
                (ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen (f x)
                  (ratAddRep k (ratNegRep k)) ratZeroRep
                  (ratAdd_neg_gen k))
                (ratAdd_zero (f x)))))
        (integrable_add_const a b
          (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) k) (ratNegRep k) h))

exercises.prompt: 把「0 ≤ x」化成整数的大小

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把 `ratLeRep` 展开成 `leRep (leNum …) (leNum …)`，再用两条已给的交叉相乘公式把两个 `leNum` 换成 (0,0) 与 (a,b)；剩下的 `0 + b ≤ a + 0` 用 `zero_add` 与 `add_zero` 消掉。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratLeRep ratZeroRep (qrep a b m) ↔ LeNat b a`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: leNum_zero_lit · leNum_lit_zero · zero_add · add_zero · Eq.subst。

exercises.template:
theorem ratLeRep_zero_lit (a b m : Nat) :
    ratLeRep ratZeroRep (qrep a b m) ↔ LeNat b a :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem ratLeRep_zero_lit (a b m : Nat) :
    ratLeRep ratZeroRep (qrep a b m) ↔ LeNat b a :=
  Iff.intro
    (fun (h : ratLeRep ratZeroRep (qrep a b m)) =>
      @Eq.subst.{1} Nat
        (fun (z : Nat) => LeNat b z)
        (Nat.add a Nat.zero) a (add_zero a)
        (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
          (fun (z : Nat) => LeNat z (Nat.add a Nat.zero))
          (Nat.add Nat.zero b) b (zero_add b)
          (@Eq.subst.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
            (fun (p : Prod Nat Nat) => leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat Nat.zero Nat.zero) p)
            (leNum (qrep a b m) ratZeroRep) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)
            (leNum_lit_zero a b m)
            (@Eq.subst.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
              (fun (p : Prod Nat Nat) =>
                leRep p (leNum (qrep a b m) ratZeroRep))
              (leNum ratZeroRep (qrep a b m))
              (@prod_mk Nat Nat Nat.zero Nat.zero)
              (leNum_zero_lit a b m) h))))
    (fun (h : LeNat b a) =>
      @Eq.subst.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
        (fun (p : Prod Nat Nat) =>
          leRep p (leNum (qrep a b m) ratZeroRep))
        (@prod_mk Nat Nat Nat.zero Nat.zero)
        (leNum ratZeroRep (qrep a b m))
        (@Eq.symm.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
          (leNum ratZeroRep (qrep a b m))
          (@prod_mk Nat Nat Nat.zero Nat.zero)
          (leNum_zero_lit a b m))
        (@Eq.subst.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
          (fun (p : Prod Nat Nat) => leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat Nat.zero Nat.zero) p)
          (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (leNum (qrep a b m) ratZeroRep)
          (@Eq.symm.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
            (leNum (qrep a b m) ratZeroRep) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)
            (leNum_lit_zero a b m))
          (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
            (fun (z : Nat) => LeNat z (Nat.add a Nat.zero))
            b (Nat.add Nat.zero b)
            (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (Nat.add Nat.zero b) b (zero_add b))
            (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
              (fun (z : Nat) => LeNat b z)
              a (Nat.add a Nat.zero)
              (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (Nat.add a Nat.zero) a (add_zero a)) h))))

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 由正性取 `p = q + (k+1)`，由非负取 `r = s + u`；倍数取 n = (r+1)(m+1)。代进交叉相乘的形式后，`n·p` 拆成 `n·q + n·(k+1)`，`r` 拆成 `s + u`，公共项两两对齐，剩下的 `u(m+1) ≤ n(k+1)(j+1)` 由「u ≤ r < r+1 ≤ n」与「两个至少为 1 的因子」两步乘出来。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `∃ n, ratLeRep (qrep r s j) (ratMulRep (natToRat n) (qrep p q m))`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLtRep_zero_num · ratLeRep_zero_lit · leNat_exists_add · mul_add · mul_add_right · succ_mul · leNat_mul_right · leNat_trans · ratLeRep_lit。

exercises.template:
theorem arch_le_lit (p q m : Nat) (hpq : ratLtRep ratZeroRep (qrep p q m))
    (r s j : Nat) (hc : ratLeRep ratZeroRep (qrep r s j)) :
    ∃ (n : Nat), ratLeRep (qrep r s j)
      (ratMulRep (natToRat n) (qrep p q m)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem arch_le_lit (p q m : Nat) (hpq : ratLtRep ratZeroRep (qrep p q m))
    (r s j : Nat) (hc : ratLeRep ratZeroRep (qrep r s j)) :
    ∃ (n : Nat), ratLeRep (qrep r s j)
      (ratMulRep (natToRat n) (qrep p q m)) :=
  Exists.elim
    (leNat_exists_add (Nat.succ q) p (ratLtRep_zero_num p q m hpq))
    (fun (k : Nat) (hk : p = Nat.add (Nat.succ q) k) =>
      Exists.elim
        (leNat_exists_add s r (Iff.mp (ratLeRep_zero_lit r s j) hc))
        (fun (u : Nat) (hu : r = Nat.add s u) =>
          Exists.intro (myMul (Nat.succ r) (Nat.succ m))
            (@Eq.subst.{1} ratRep
              (fun (z : ratRep) => ratLeRep (qrep r s j) z)
              (qrep
                (myMul (myMul (Nat.succ r) (Nat.succ m)) p)
                (myMul (myMul (Nat.succ r) (Nat.succ m)) q)
                m)
              (ratMulRep (natToRat (myMul (Nat.succ r) (Nat.succ m)))
                (qrep p q m))
              (@Eq.symm.{1} ratRep
                (ratMulRep (natToRat (myMul (Nat.succ r) (Nat.succ m)))
                  (qrep p q m))
                (qrep
                  (myMul (myMul (Nat.succ r) (Nat.succ m)) p)
                  (myMul (myMul (Nat.succ r) (Nat.succ m)) q)
                  m)
                (natToRat_mul_rep (myMul (Nat.succ r) (Nat.succ m)) p q m))
              (Iff.mpr
                (ratLeRep_lit r s j
                  (myMul (myMul (Nat.succ r) (Nat.succ m)) p)
                  (myMul (myMul (Nat.succ r) (Nat.succ m)) q)
                  m)
                (arch_G p q m r s u k j hk hu)))))

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 任意代表元是三个分量，按「分母字段在外、分子序对在内」两层 `match` 拆开，两条前提的类型跟着变成字面形式，直接交给字面版本。前提要写在 `match` 里面的 `fun` 上，否则内核看不到替换后的形状。

hints.body: `ratLtRep ratZeroRep x → ratLeRep ratZeroRep c → ∃ n, ratLeRep c (ratMulRep (natToRat n) x)`。

hints.body: arch_le_lit · 两层 match · 前提写成 fun 的绑定点。

exercises.template:
theorem arch_le (x c : Prod (Prod Nat Nat) Nat) :
    ratLtRep ratZeroRep x → ratLeRep ratZeroRep c →
      ∃ (n : Nat), ratLeRep c (ratMulRep (natToRat n) x) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem arch_le (x c : Prod (Prod Nat Nat) Nat) :
    ratLtRep ratZeroRep x → ratLeRep ratZeroRep c →
      ∃ (n : Nat), ratLeRep c (ratMulRep (natToRat n) x) :=
  match x with
  | prod_mk (prod_mk p q) m =>
    match c with
    | prod_mk (prod_mk r s) j =>
      fun (hx : ratLtRep ratZeroRep (qrep p q m))
          (hc : ratLeRep ratZeroRep (qrep r s j)) =>
        arch_le_lit p q m hx r s j hc

hints.body: 把待超过的量换成 `c + 1` 再取倍数，得到 `c + 1 ≤ n·x`；另一侧 `c < c + 1` 由「0 < 1 加在右边」得到，两条一夹就是 `c < n·x`。

    (hc : ratLeRep ratZeroRep c) :
    ∃ (n : Nat), ratLtRep c (ratMulRep (natToRat n) x) :=
  Exists.elim
    (arch_le x (ratAddRep c ratOneRep) hx
      (ratLeRep_zero_add_nonneg c ratOneRep hc
        (ratLtRep_le ratZeroRep ratOneRep ratLtRep_zero_one)))

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 从 `L - x ≤ eta` 出发，两边加 x 得到 L ≤ x + eta；再在右边减去 eta。右端 `(x + eta) - eta` 先交换中间项，结合后 `eta + (-eta)` 收成零，再加零。

theorem le_sub_of_sub_le (L x eta : ratRep)
    (h : ratLeRep (ratSubRep L x) eta) :
    ratLeRep (ratSubRep L eta) x :=
  ratLeRep_congr_gen
    (ratSubRep L eta) (ratSubRep L eta)
    (ratAddRep (ratAddRep x eta) (ratNegRep eta)) x
    (ratRel_refl (ratSubRep L eta))
    (ratRel_trans_gen
      (ratAddRep (ratAddRep x eta) (ratNegRep eta))
      (ratAddRep x (ratAddRep eta (ratNegRep eta)))
      x
      (ratAdd_assoc x eta (ratNegRep eta))
      (ratRel_trans_gen
        (ratAddRep x (ratAddRep eta (ratNegRep eta)))
        (ratAddRep x ratZeroRep)
        x
        (ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen x (ratAddRep eta (ratNegRep eta))
          ratZeroRep (ratAdd_neg_gen eta))
        (ratAdd_zero x)))
    (ratLeRep_add_right L (ratAddRep x eta) (ratNegRep eta)

    (hp : IsPartition a b p) (eta delta : ratRep) (hm : MeshBelow p delta)
    (hu : ∀ (x y : ratRep), close x y delta → close (f x) (f y) eta) :

exercises.name: natToRat_le_succ
exercises.title: 单元166 一致连续函数可积：把误差分给段数
exercises.prompt:
单元166 一致连续函数可积：把误差分给段数

一条曲线被两摞台阶夹住时，上下和之差只取决于每段的振幅与区间长度。 网格越细，振幅越小；网格细化已经能造出任意细的分割。把这两件事接起来， 一致连续的函数就落在可积的那一类里：给定 ε，先把 ε 分给段数得到每段 容许的振幅 η，一致连续性再把 η 换成网格 δ，等分分割保证每段短于 δ。

这里真正起作用的是量词顺序。逐点连续对每个点给一个 δ，而分割的段数又 依赖 δ；调换这两个量词，每段上的振幅就无法用同一个 η 控制。一致连续把 δ 提到点之前，于是有限个段可以共用同一个振幅界。

闭区间上的连续函数确实一致连续，但这条桥（Heine–Cantor）要用到区间的 紧性或完备性。课程目前的完备性只到代表元层的 Cauchy 序列；有理代表元上 的闭区间不是紧的，逐点连续的函数可以在这类区间上无界。因此这里把一致 连续作为假设，得到的是它的积分形式，而不是用一条未经证明的定理把假设 藏起来。

算术部分只有一步：选段数 N 使 2(b-a) < N，再把 ε 除以 N。每段的振幅 取 η = ε/N，整条曲线的上下和之差不超过 2η(b-a)，而 2(b-a) < N 保证 它小于 ε。段数由阿基米德性质给出，除以 N 由等分分割那边的除法给出。

函数取 ratRep → ratRep，停在有理代表元层；不新增公理，也不碰 kernel/front。

自然数在有理数里的顺序

theorem natToRat_le_succ (n : Nat) :
    ratLeRep (natToRat n) (natToRat (Nat.succ n)) :=
  Iff.mpr (ratLeRep_lit n Nat.zero Nat.zero (Nat.succ n) Nat.zero Nat.zero)
    (leNat_congr
      (Nat.add (myMul n (Nat.succ Nat.zero))
        (myMul Nat.zero (Nat.succ Nat.zero)))
      (Nat.add (myMul (Nat.succ n) (Nat.succ Nat.zero))
        (myMul Nat.zero (Nat.succ Nat.zero)))
      n (Nat.succ n)
      (add_zero n) (add_zero (Nat.succ n))
      (le_succ n n (le_refl n)))

theorem div_gap_lt (d eps eta : ratRep) (n : Nat)
    (heta : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eta)
    (hN : ratRel (ratMulRep (natToRat (Nat.succ n)) eta) eps)
    (hd : ratLtRep (ratAddRep d d) (natToRat (Nat.succ n))) :

exercises.solution:
theorem div_gap_lt (d eps eta : ratRep) (n : Nat)
    (heta : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eta)
    (hN : ratRel (ratMulRep (natToRat (Nat.succ n)) eta) eps)
    (hd : ratLtRep (ratAddRep d d) (natToRat (Nat.succ n))) :
    ratLtRep
      (ratAddRep (ratMulRep eta d) (ratMulRep eta d)) eps :=
  ratLtRep_congr_snd
    (ratAddRep (ratMulRep eta d) (ratMulRep eta d))
    (ratMulRep eta (natToRat (Nat.succ n)))

      (ratMulRep eta (ratAddRep d d))

        eta hd heta)

        (ratAddRep (ratMulRep eta d) (ratMulRep eta d))
        (ratMul_add eta d d)))

      (ratMulRep eta (natToRat (Nat.succ n)))

exercises.unit: 单元166 一致连续函数可积：把误差分给段数
exercises.name: uniformlyContinuous_integrable
exercises.title: 一致连续推出可积
exercises.prompt: 一致连续推出可积

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 给定 ε，先用 `exists_nat_gt_double` 取 N 使 `2(b-a) < N`，令 η=ε/N；一致连续给网格 δ，等分分割给每段短于 δ 的分割 p；`strip_of_mesh` 给两条台阶与差 `η(b-a)+η(b-a)`；`div_gap_lt` 把这个差压到 ε 以下，最后交给 `integrable_of_gap`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `Integrable a b f`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: exists_nat_gt_double · ratDiv_pos · exists_mesh_partition · strip_of_mesh · div_gap_lt · integrable_of_gap · ratLtRep_sub_pos。

exercises.template:
theorem uniformlyContinuous_integrable (a b : ratRep)
    (f : ratRep → ratRep) (hab : ratLtRep a b)
    (hf : UniformlyContinuous f) : Integrable a b f :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem uniformlyContinuous_integrable (a b : ratRep)
    (f : ratRep → ratRep) (hab : ratLtRep a b)
    (hf : UniformlyContinuous f) : Integrable a b f :=
  integrable_of_gap a b f
    (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
      Exists.elim
        (exists_nat_gt_double (ratSubRep b a)
          (ratLtRep_le ratZeroRep (ratSubRep b a)
            (ratLtRep_sub_pos b a hab)))
        (fun (n : Nat)
            (hn : ratLtRep
              (ratAddRep (ratSubRep b a) (ratSubRep b a))
              (natToRat (Nat.succ n))) =>
          Exists.elim
            (hf (ratDiv n eps) (ratDiv_pos n eps heps))
            (fun (delta : ratRep)
                (hdelta : ratLtRep ratZeroRep delta ∧
                  ∀ (x y : ratRep),
                    close x y delta → close (f x) (f y) (ratDiv n eps)) =>
              Exists.elim
                (exists_mesh_partition a b delta hab (And.left hdelta))
                (fun (p : Partition)
                    (hp : IsPartition a b p ∧ MeshBelow p delta) =>
                  Exists.elim
                    (strip_of_mesh a b p f (And.left hp) (ratDiv n eps)
                      delta (And.right hp) (And.right hdelta))
                    (fun (l : Nat → ratRep)
                        (hlu : ∃ (u : Nat → ratRep),
                          LowerStep a b p f l ∧ UpperStep a b p f u ∧
                            ratRel
                              (ratSubRep (stepSum p u) (stepSum p l))
                              (ratAddRep
                                (ratMulRep (ratDiv n eps) (ratSubRep b a))
                                (ratMulRep (ratDiv n eps)
                                  (ratSubRep b a)))) =>
                      Exists.elim hlu
                        (fun (u : Nat → ratRep)
                            (hu : LowerStep a b p f l ∧
                              UpperStep a b p f u ∧
                                ratRel
                                  (ratSubRep (stepSum p u) (stepSum p l))
                                  (ratAddRep
                                    (ratMulRep (ratDiv n eps)
                                      (ratSubRep b a))
                                    (ratMulRep (ratDiv n eps)
                                      (ratSubRep b a)))) =>
                          Exists.intro p
                            (And.intro (And.left hp)
                              (Exists.intro l
                                (Exists.intro u
                                  (And.intro (And.left hu)
                                    (And.intro (And.left (And.right hu))
                                      (ratLtRep_congr_fst
                                        (ratSubRep (stepSum p u)
                                          (stepSum p l))
                                        (ratAddRep
                                          (ratMulRep (ratDiv n eps)
                                            (ratSubRep b a))
                                          (ratMulRep (ratDiv n eps)
                                            (ratSubRep b a)))
                                        eps
                                        (div_gap_lt (ratSubRep b a) eps
                                          (ratDiv n eps) n
                                          (ratDiv_pos n eps heps)
                                          (ratDiv_mul n eps) hn)
                                        (And.right (And.right hu))))))))))))))

hints.label: 思路

hints.label: 关键件

exercises.template:
theorem sub_le_of_pin (I J L U eps : ratRep)
    (hLI : ratLeRep L I) (hIU : ratLeRep I U) (hLJ : ratLeRep L J)
    (hgap : ratLtRep (ratSubRep U L) eps) :
    ratLeRep (ratSubRep I J) eps :=

theorem sub_le_of_pin (I J L U eps : ratRep)
    (hLI : ratLeRep L I) (hIU : ratLeRep I U) (hLJ : ratLeRep L J)
    (hgap : ratLtRep (ratSubRep U L) eps) :
    ratLeRep (ratSubRep I J) eps :=
  ratLeRep_trans (ratSubRep I J) (ratSubRep U J) eps
    (ratLeRep_add_right I U (ratNegRep J) hIU)
    (ratLeRep_trans (ratSubRep U J) (ratSubRep U L) eps
      (ratLeRep_add_left (ratNegRep J) (ratNegRep L) U
        (ratLeRep_neg_gen L J hLJ))
      (ratLtRep_le (ratSubRep U L) eps hgap))

exercises.name: hasIntegral_unique
exercises.title: 唯一性
exercises.prompt: 唯一性

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对每个正 ε，用 I 的可积性取一个缝小于 ε 的分割，它把 I 与 J 同时夹住（四个界分别来自两个候选），于是 `I-J ≤ ε`；ε 任意给出 `I ≤ J`。把 I 与 J 对调再走一遍得 `J ≤ I`，最后用反对称性收成 `ratRel`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel I J`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLeRep_of_sub_le_all · sub_le_of_pin · hasIntegral_lower · hasIntegral_upper · hasIntegral_integrable · ratLeRep_antisymm。

exercises.template:
theorem hasIntegral_unique (a b : ratRep) (f : ratRep → ratRep)
    (I J : ratRep) (hI : HasIntegral a b f I) (hJ : HasIntegral a b f J) :
    ratRel I J :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem hasIntegral_unique (a b : ratRep) (f : ratRep → ratRep)
    (I J : ratRep) (hI : HasIntegral a b f I) (hJ : HasIntegral a b f J) :
    ratRel I J :=
  ratLeRep_antisymm I J
    (ratLeRep_of_sub_le_all I J
      (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
        Exists.elim (hasIntegral_integrable a b f I hI eps heps)
          (fun (p : Partition)
              (hp : IsPartition a b p ∧
                ∃ (L : ratRep), ∃ (U : ratRep),
                  LowerSum a b p f L ∧ UpperSum a b p f U ∧
                    ratLtRep (ratSubRep U L) eps) =>
            Exists.elim (And.right hp)
              (fun (L : ratRep)
                  (hL : ∃ (U : ratRep),
                    LowerSum a b p f L ∧ UpperSum a b p f U ∧
                      ratLtRep (ratSubRep U L) eps) =>
                Exists.elim hL
                  (fun (U : ratRep)
                      (hU : LowerSum a b p f L ∧ UpperSum a b p f U ∧
                        ratLtRep (ratSubRep U L) eps) =>
                    sub_le_of_pin I J L U eps
                      (hasIntegral_lower a b f I hI p L
                        (And.left hp) (And.left hU))
                      (hasIntegral_upper a b f I hI p U
                        (And.left hp) (And.left (And.right hU)))
                      (hasIntegral_lower a b f J hJ p L
                        (And.left hp) (And.left hU))
                      (And.right (And.right hU)))))))
    (ratLeRep_of_sub_le_all J I
      (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
        Exists.elim (hasIntegral_integrable a b f I hI eps heps)
          (fun (p : Partition)
              (hp : IsPartition a b p ∧
                ∃ (L : ratRep), ∃ (U : ratRep),
                  LowerSum a b p f L ∧ UpperSum a b p f U ∧
                    ratLtRep (ratSubRep U L) eps) =>
            Exists.elim (And.right hp)
              (fun (L : ratRep)
                  (hL : ∃ (U : ratRep),
                    LowerSum a b p f L ∧ UpperSum a b p f U ∧
                      ratLtRep (ratSubRep U L) eps) =>
                Exists.elim hL
                  (fun (U : ratRep)
                      (hU : LowerSum a b p f L ∧ UpperSum a b p f U ∧
                        ratLtRep (ratSubRep U L) eps) =>
                    sub_le_of_pin J I L U eps
                      (hasIntegral_lower a b f J hJ p L
                        (And.left hp) (And.left hU))
                      (hasIntegral_upper a b f J hJ p U
                        (And.left hp) (And.left (And.right hU)))
                      (hasIntegral_lower a b f I hI p L
                        (And.left hp) (And.left hU))
                      (And.right (And.right hU)))))))

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把下和拆成一摞下界 l 与它的矩形和；逐段 l i ≤ k，所以 `stepSum l ≤ stepSum (常值 k)`，而后者等价于 `k·(b-a)`，沿等价关系搬过去。上界那条对称：逐段 k ≤ u，`stepSum (常值 k) ≤ stepSum u`，再把 `k·(b-a)` 与 U 接上。可积性交给 `integrable_const`。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `HasIntegral a b (fun _ => k) (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a))`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: lowerSum_witness · upperSum_witness · stepSum_mono · stepSum_const · lowerStep_value · upperStep_value · ratLeRep_congr_gen · integrable_const。

exercises.template:
theorem hasIntegral_const (a b k : ratRep) (hab : ratLtRep a b) :
    HasIntegral a b (fun (_ : ratRep) => k)
      (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a)) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem hasIntegral_const (a b k : ratRep) (hab : ratLtRep a b) :
    HasIntegral a b (fun (_ : ratRep) => k)
      (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a)) :=
  And.intro
    (fun (p : Partition) (L : ratRep) (hp : IsPartition a b p)
        (hL : LowerSum a b p (fun (_ : ratRep) => k) L) =>
      Exists.elim (lowerSum_witness a b p (fun (_ : ratRep) => k) L hL)
        (fun (l : Nat → ratRep)
            (hl : LowerStep a b p (fun (_ : ratRep) => k) l ∧
              ratRel L (stepSum p l)) =>
          ratLeRep_congr_gen (stepSum p l) L
            (stepSum p (fun (_ : Nat) => k)) (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a))
            (ratRel_symm L (stepSum p l) (And.right hl))
            (stepSum_const a b p hp k)
            (stepSum_mono a b p hp l (fun (_ : Nat) => k)
              (fun (i : Nat) (hi : LeNat (Nat.succ i) (partCount p)) =>
                lowerStep_value a b p (fun (_ : ratRep) => k) l
                  (And.left hl) hp i hi))))
    (And.intro
      (fun (p : Partition) (U : ratRep) (hp : IsPartition a b p)
          (hU : UpperSum a b p (fun (_ : ratRep) => k) U) =>
        Exists.elim (upperSum_witness a b p (fun (_ : ratRep) => k) U hU)
          (fun (u : Nat → ratRep)
              (hu : UpperStep a b p (fun (_ : ratRep) => k) u ∧
                ratRel U (stepSum p u)) =>
            ratLeRep_congr_gen (stepSum p (fun (_ : Nat) => k))
              (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a)) (stepSum p u) U
              (stepSum_const a b p hp k)
              (ratRel_symm U (stepSum p u) (And.right hu))
              (stepSum_mono a b p hp (fun (_ : Nat) => k) u
                (fun (i : Nat) (hi : LeNat (Nat.succ i) (partCount p)) =>
                  upperStep_value a b p (fun (_ : ratRep) => k) u
                    (And.left hu) hp i hi))))
      (integrable_const a b k hab))

exercises.unit: 单元168 面积值的取负：把曲线翻到轴下方
exercises.name: upperStep_neg_rev
exercises.title: 单元168 面积值的取负：把曲线翻到轴下方
exercises.prompt:
单元168 面积值的取负：把曲线翻到轴下方

已经知道曲线 f 在 [a,b] 上的面积值是 I。把曲线翻到轴下方，得到 -f： 它的面积值是多少？图上看是同一块面积换了方向，答案该是 -I。可是 HasIntegral 不是一句「面积等于多少」，它是两组量词——每个分割的下和都 不超过 I，每个分割的上和都不小于 I。取负把这两组量词互换：原来的下和 变成 -f 的上和，原来的上和变成 -f 的下和。所以 -I 要重新走过这两组 量词，不能只靠图上的一句话。

证明分三层。第一层在一段上：-f 的下界取负就是 f 的上界，-f 的上界取负 就是 f 的下界；序在取负下反转，这一层只用到这条。第二层把台阶乘宽求和： stepSum_neg 把和的负号搬到外面，于是 -f 的下和取负恰好是 f 的上和。 第三层把两层接起来：-f 的一个下和 L 先改写成 f 的上和 -L，由 I 的上界 性质得 I ≤ -L，两边取负就是 L ≤ -I；另一半是它的镜像。

取负的证明到此为止。加法与数乘要用到「乘积对同余因子不变」，课程库还 没有这条引理，留到后面的单元。函数仍取 ratRep → ratRep，停在有理代表 元层；不新增公理，也不碰 kernel/front。

exercises.solution:
theorem hasIntegral_neg (a b : ratRep) (f : ratRep → ratRep)
    (I : ratRep) (h : HasIntegral a b f I) :
    HasIntegral a b (fun (x : ratRep) => ratNegRep (f x))
      (ratNegRep I) :=
  And.intro
    (fun (p : Partition) (L : ratRep) (hp : IsPartition a b p)
        (hL : LowerSum a b p (fun (x : ratRep) => ratNegRep (f x)) L) =>
      ratLeRep_congr_gen
        (ratNegRep (ratNegRep L))
        L
        (ratNegRep I)
        (ratNegRep I)
        (ratNegRep_invol L)
        (ratRel_refl (ratNegRep I))
        (ratLeRep_neg_gen I (ratNegRep L)
          (hasIntegral_upper a b f I h p (ratNegRep L) hp
            (lowerSum_neg_rev a b p f L hL))))
    (And.intro
      (fun (p : Partition) (U : ratRep) (hp : IsPartition a b p)
          (hU : UpperSum a b p (fun (x : ratRep) => ratNegRep (f x)) U) =>
        ratLeRep_congr_gen
          (ratNegRep I)
          (ratNegRep I)
          (ratNegRep (ratNegRep U))
          U
          (ratRel_refl (ratNegRep I))
          (ratNegRep_invol U)
          (ratLeRep_neg_gen (ratNegRep U) I
            (hasIntegral_lower a b f I h p (ratNegRep U) hp
              (upperSum_neg_rev a b p f U hU))))
      (integrable_neg a b f (hasIntegral_integrable a b f I h)))

exercises.prompt:
单元169 面积值的符号：非负曲线不会算出负面积

一条曲线如果整条都在轴上方，它的面积值会不会算出负数？直觉说不会， 但 HasIntegral 并没有把面积当成一块可以量的图形：它说的是候选值 I 夹在 所有分割的上下和之间。要确认符号，只能从这些和里取一个来比。

取常值零台阶。曲线非负时，零逐段垫在函数值下面，所以零是一个下界；零乘 宽逐项为零，矩形和就是零，于是零是一个下和。下和不大于 I，符号就到手了。 曲线非正时把同一句话翻过来：零是上界，零是上和，I 不超过零。

两条论证都只用两切点分割：区间非空时，切点 a、b 构成一个合法分割。最后 把候选值换成与它相等的代表元，零曲线的读数就从 0·(b-a) 落到 0。

零台阶的矩形和

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把矩形和展开成有限和，每一项是 0 乘段宽；逐项用 `ratMul_zero_left` 换成 0，全零项的和由 `sumTo_zero_fun` 收口。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratRel (stepSum p (fun _ => ratZeroRep)) ratZeroRep`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: sumTo_congr · ratMul_zero_left · sumTo_zero_fun。

exercises.template:
theorem stepSum_zero (p : Partition) :
    ratRel (stepSum p (fun (_ : Nat) => ratZeroRep)) ratZeroRep :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem stepSum_zero (p : Partition) :
    ratRel (stepSum p (fun (_ : Nat) => ratZeroRep)) ratZeroRep :=
  ratRel_trans_gen
    (stepSum p (fun (_ : Nat) => ratZeroRep))
    (sumTo (fun (_ : Nat) => ratZeroRep) (partCount p))
    ratZeroRep
    (sumTo_congr
      (fun (i : Nat) => ratMulRep ratZeroRep (segLen p i))
      (fun (_ : Nat) => ratZeroRep)
      (partCount p)
      (fun (i : Nat) => ratMul_zero_left (segLen p i)))
    (sumTo_zero_fun (partCount p))

exercises.unit: 单元170 面积值的比较：曲线更高，面积不会更小
exercises.name: sub_le_sub
exercises.title: 单元170 面积值的比较：曲线更高，面积不会更小
exercises.prompt:
单元170 面积值的比较：曲线更高，面积不会更小

两条曲线放在同一条区间上，一条处处不低于另一条。它们的面积值谁大？ 直觉说高的那条。可是面积值不是一块可以直接叠放的图形：它只是夹在所有 上下和之间的一个数。两个这样的数要比较，只能回到那些和。

设 f 处处不超过 g，f 的面积值是 I，g 的面积值是 J。可积性给 g 一条很窄 的分割，上和 U 与下和 L 相差不到 ε。g 的上界压得住 g，也就压得住更低的 f，于是 I ≤ U；f 的下界垫得住 f，也就垫得住更高的 g，于是 L ≤ J。两条 不等式相减，I - J 不超过 U - L，而后者小于 ε。ε 任意，所以 I ≤ J。

比较成立之后，常数界是直接的推论：曲线不超过 k，面积值不超过 k(b-a)； 曲线不低于 k，面积值不低于 k(b-a)。两条合起来，一条曲线被两条水平线 夹住，它的面积值也被两个矩形面积夹住。最后，逐点相等的两条曲线有同一个 面积值：两个方向各比一次，反对称性把两个候选收成一个。

函数取 ratRep → ratRep，停在有理代表元层；不新增公理，也不碰 kernel/front。

两条不等式相减

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 先把 `I ≤ U` 两边同加 `-J`；再把 `L ≤ J` 取负翻成 `-J ≤ -L`，两边同加 `U`；传递性接起来。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratLeRep (ratSubRep I J) (ratSubRep U L)`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLeRep_add_right · ratLeRep_neg_gen · ratLeRep_add_left · ratLeRep_trans。

exercises.template:
theorem sub_le_sub (I U L J : ratRep) (hIU : ratLeRep I U)
    (hLJ : ratLeRep L J) :
    ratLeRep (ratSubRep I J) (ratSubRep U L) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem sub_le_sub (I U L J : ratRep) (hIU : ratLeRep I U)
    (hLJ : ratLeRep L J) :
    ratLeRep (ratSubRep I J) (ratSubRep U L) :=
  ratLeRep_trans (ratSubRep I J) (ratSubRep U J) (ratSubRep U L)
    (ratLeRep_add_right I U (ratNegRep J) hIU)
    (ratLeRep_add_left (ratNegRep J) (ratNegRep L) U
      (ratLeRep_neg_gen L J hLJ))

exercises.prompt: 面积值的比较

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 对任意正 ε，用 `hasIntegral_integrable` 取出 g 的窄分割；g 的上界也是 f 的上界，所以 I ≤ U，而 L ≤ J；两条界交给 `sub_le_sub`，再由 `ratLtRep_le` 收尾。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratLeRep I J`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: ratLeRep_of_sub_le_all · hasIntegral_integrable · upperSum_mono_fun · ratLtRep_le。

exercises.template:
theorem hasIntegral_mono (a b : ratRep) (f g : ratRep → ratRep)
    (I J : ratRep) (hI : HasIntegral a b f I) (hJ : HasIntegral a b g J)
    (hfg : ∀ (x : ratRep), ratLeRep (f x) (g x)) :
    ratLeRep I J :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem hasIntegral_mono (a b : ratRep) (f g : ratRep → ratRep)
    (I J : ratRep) (hI : HasIntegral a b f I) (hJ : HasIntegral a b g J)
    (hfg : ∀ (x : ratRep), ratLeRep (f x) (g x)) :
    ratLeRep I J :=
  ratLeRep_of_sub_le_all I J
    (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
      Exists.elim (hasIntegral_integrable a b g J hJ eps heps)
        (fun (p : Partition)
            (hp : IsPartition a b p ∧
              ∃ (L : ratRep), ∃ (U : ratRep),
                LowerSum a b p g L ∧ UpperSum a b p g U ∧
                  ratLtRep (ratSubRep U L) eps) =>
          Exists.elim (And.right hp)
            (fun (L : ratRep)
                (hL : ∃ (U : ratRep),
                  LowerSum a b p g L ∧ UpperSum a b p g U ∧
                    ratLtRep (ratSubRep U L) eps) =>
              Exists.elim hL
                (fun (U : ratRep)
                    (hU : LowerSum a b p g L ∧ UpperSum a b p g U ∧
                      ratLtRep (ratSubRep U L) eps) =>
                  ratLeRep_trans (ratSubRep I J) (ratSubRep U L) eps
                    (sub_le_sub I U L J
                      (hasIntegral_upper a b f I hI p U (And.left hp)
                        (upperSum_mono_fun a b p f g U hfg
                          (And.left (And.right hU))))
                      (hasIntegral_lower a b g J hJ p L (And.left hp)
                        (And.left hU)))
                    (ratLtRep_le (ratSubRep U L) eps
                      (And.right (And.right hU)))))))

exercises.title: 单元171 面积值的平移：整条曲线抬高，面积也抬高一块矩形
exercises.prompt:
单元171 面积值的平移：整条曲线抬高，面积也抬高一块矩形

面积值已经会随曲线取负，也会按逐点序比较。还有一个变形值得问：把整条 曲线抬高同一个常数 k，每一段的高度都多了 k，宽没变，面积值会怎样？

答案是多出一块 k(b-a)。理由不在图形上，而在两摞台阶上：抬高后的曲线 有一摞下界，把这摞下界整体减去 k，它又垫回原曲线下面；反过来，原曲线 的每一摞下界整体加上 k，也仍然垫在抬高后的曲线下面。两个方向都成立， 所以抬高前后的下和只差 k(b-a)。上界同理。

矩形和这一块由分配律给出：一段上「高度加 k」乘宽，等于原来的矩形加上 k 乘这段宽；整条和加起来，多出的正是 k 乘区间总长。

最后拿常值曲线试一次：常值 c 抬高 k 变成 c+k，面积值从 c(b-a) 变成 (c+k)(b-a)，正好多出 k(b-a)。

函数取 ratRep → ratRep，停在有理代表元层；不新增公理，也不碰 kernel/front。

先理清代数：加一个数再减掉它

  sorry

theorem sub_add_cancel (x k : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratSubRep (ratAddRep x k) k) x :=
  ratRel_trans_gen
    (ratSubRep (ratAddRep x k) k)
    (ratSubRep (ratAddRep k x) k)
    x
    (ratAddRep_wd_gen (ratAddRep x k) (ratAddRep k x) (ratNegRep k)
      (ratAdd_comm x k))
    (ratSubRep_add_self_sub k x)

      (stepSum p (fun (i : Nat) => ratSubRep (l i) k))

    (stepSum_congr_point a b p hp l
      (fun (i : Nat) => ratAddRep (ratSubRep (l i) k) k)
      (fun (i : Nat) (_ : LeNat (Nat.succ i) (partCount p)) =>
        ratRel_symm (ratAddRep (ratSubRep (l i) k) k) (l i)
          (ratSubRep_add_self (l i) k)))
    (stepSum_add_const a b p hp
      (fun (i : Nat) => ratSubRep (l i) k) k)

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 取出下界的见证 `l`；`l - k` 是原曲线的下界，所以它的矩形和不超过 I；再加上 k(b-a)，用 `stepSum_sub_const` 把 L 接过来。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratLeRep L (ratAddRep I (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a)))`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: lowerStep_sub_const · stepSum_sub_const · hasIntegral_lower · ratLeRep_add。

theorem lowerSum_add_const_le (a b : ratRep) (f : ratRep → ratRep)
    (I k L : ratRep) (h : HasIntegral a b f I) (p : Partition)
    (hp : IsPartition a b p)
    (hL : LowerSum a b p (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) k) L) :
    ratLeRep L (ratAddRep I (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a))) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem lowerSum_add_const_le (a b : ratRep) (f : ratRep → ratRep)
    (I k L : ratRep) (h : HasIntegral a b f I) (p : Partition)
    (hp : IsPartition a b p)
    (hL : LowerSum a b p (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) k) L) :
    ratLeRep L (ratAddRep I (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a))) :=
  Exists.elim
    (lowerSum_witness a b p (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) k) L hL)
    (fun (l : Nat → ratRep)
        (hl : LowerStep a b p (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) k) l ∧
          ratRel L (stepSum p l)) =>
      ratLeRep_congr_gen (stepSum p l) L
        (ratAddRep I (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a)))
        (ratAddRep I (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a)))
        (ratRel_symm L (stepSum p l) (And.right hl))
        (ratRel_refl (ratAddRep I (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a))))
        (ratLeRep_trans (stepSum p l)
          (ratAddRep
            (stepSum p (fun (i : Nat) => ratSubRep (l i) k))
            (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a)))
          (ratAddRep I (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a)))
          (ratLeRep_of_ratRel
            (stepSum p l)
            (ratAddRep
              (stepSum p (fun (i : Nat) => ratSubRep (l i) k))
              (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a)))
            (stepSum_sub_const a b p hp l k))
          (ratLeRep_add
            (stepSum p (fun (i : Nat) => ratSubRep (l i) k)) I
            (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a))
            (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a))
            (hasIntegral_lower a b f I h p
              (stepSum p (fun (i : Nat) => ratSubRep (l i) k)) hp
              (Exists.intro (fun (i : Nat) => ratSubRep (l i) k)
                (And.intro
                  (lowerStep_sub_const a b p f l k (And.left hl))
                  (ratRel_refl
                    (stepSum p (fun (i : Nat) => ratSubRep (l i) k))))))
            (ratLeRep_refl (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a))))))

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 取出上界的见证 `u`；`u - k` 压住原曲线，所以 I 不超过它的矩形和；两边加 k(b-a)，再把 U 接到同一个数上。

hints.label: 目标形态
hints.body: `ratLeRep (ratAddRep I (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a))) U`。

hints.label: 关键件
hints.body: upperStep_sub_const · stepSum_sub_const · hasIntegral_upper · ratLeRep_add。

exercises.template:
theorem upperSum_add_const_ge (a b : ratRep) (f : ratRep → ratRep)
    (I k U : ratRep) (h : HasIntegral a b f I) (p : Partition)
    (hp : IsPartition a b p)
    (hU : UpperSum a b p (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) k) U) :
    ratLeRep (ratAddRep I (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a))) U :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem upperSum_add_const_ge (a b : ratRep) (f : ratRep → ratRep)
    (I k U : ratRep) (h : HasIntegral a b f I) (p : Partition)
    (hp : IsPartition a b p)
    (hU : UpperSum a b p (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) k) U) :
    ratLeRep (ratAddRep I (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a))) U :=
  Exists.elim
    (upperSum_witness a b p (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) k) U hU)
    (fun (u : Nat → ratRep)
        (hu : UpperStep a b p (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) k) u ∧
          ratRel U (stepSum p u)) =>
      ratLeRep_congr_gen
        (ratAddRep I (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a)))
        (ratAddRep I (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a)))
        (ratAddRep
          (stepSum p (fun (i : Nat) => ratSubRep (u i) k))
          (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a)))
        U
        (ratRel_refl (ratAddRep I (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a))))
        (ratRel_trans_gen
          (ratAddRep
            (stepSum p (fun (i : Nat) => ratSubRep (u i) k))
            (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a)))
          (stepSum p u) U
          (ratRel_symm
            (stepSum p u)
            (ratAddRep
              (stepSum p (fun (i : Nat) => ratSubRep (u i) k))
              (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a)))
            (stepSum_sub_const a b p hp u k))
          (ratRel_symm U (stepSum p u) (And.right hu)))
        (ratLeRep_add I
          (stepSum p (fun (i : Nat) => ratSubRep (u i) k))
          (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a))
          (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a))
          (hasIntegral_upper a b f I h p
            (stepSum p (fun (i : Nat) => ratSubRep (u i) k)) hp
            (Exists.intro (fun (i : Nat) => ratSubRep (u i) k)
              (And.intro
                (upperStep_sub_const a b p f u k (And.left hu))
                (ratRel_refl
                  (stepSum p (fun (i : Nat) => ratSubRep (u i) k))))))
          (ratLeRep_refl (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a)))))

hints.label: 思路
hints.body: 把 `HasIntegral` 拆成三条：下界用 `lowerSum_add_const_le`，上界用 `upperSum_add_const_ge`，可积性用 `integrable_add_const`。

hints.label: 目标形态

exercises.template:
theorem hasIntegral_add_const (a b : ratRep) (f : ratRep → ratRep)
    (I k : ratRep) (h : HasIntegral a b f I) :
    HasIntegral a b (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) k)
      (ratAddRep I (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a))) :=
  sorry
exercises.solution:
theorem hasIntegral_add_const (a b : ratRep) (f : ratRep → ratRep)
    (I k : ratRep) (h : HasIntegral a b f I) :
    HasIntegral a b (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) k)
      (ratAddRep I (ratMulRep k (ratSubRep b a))) :=
  And.intro
    (fun (p : Partition) (L : ratRep) (hp : IsPartition a b p)
        (hL : LowerSum a b p (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) k) L) =>
      lowerSum_add_const_le a b f I k L h p hp hL)
    (And.intro
      (fun (p : Partition) (U : ratRep) (hp : IsPartition a b p)
          (hU : UpperSum a b p (fun (x : ratRep) => ratAddRep (f x) k) U) =>
        upperSum_add_const_ge a b f I k U h p hp hU)
      (integrable_add_const a b f k (hasIntegral_integrable a b f I h)))
